df7cf7fe2c11abc9249be02ac6c4dbd1080f96d2.source: Shout. For 30 seconds, all dead party members in earshot are resurrected with full Health and Energy. Resurrected party members deal 25…33% more damage. When this effect ends, affected party members die. This skill does not incur a death penalty.

82bbe3553db5b845f2573a39cc9f63932083f106.source: Shout. For 20 seconds, the next 1…4…5 touch skills used against allies within earshot fails.
82bbe3553db5b845f2573a39cc9f63932083f106.text: 喊叫。在 20 秒内，对听力范围内的盟友使用的下一个 1…4…5 接触技能会失败。

4814534c00547945f4aeac239bc2d2a07b2e6ddc.source: Shout. For 20 seconds, the next 1…4…5 touch skills used against you fails.

dd2120c7c18b3cf5597e69e140f299f5fe432cc4.text: 精英呐喊。听力范围内的盟友会失去残废状态。在 5…11…13 秒内，这些盟友的移动速度更快 33%。

884accad2582076b2b3a95dbb732a9f0d39d22b4.source: Elite Shout. If target foe is moving, that foe is knocked down.
884accad2582076b2b3a95dbb732a9f0d39d22b4.text: 精英呐喊。如果目标敌人正在移动，该敌人就会被击倒。

ead1b5f12c66f05f0df33cb41fddbf9ae7f7bb76.source: Shout. For 16…20 seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does +14…20 damage.
ead1b5f12c66f05f0df33cb41fddbf9ae7f7bb76.text: 喊叫。在 16…20 秒内，你的下一次攻击无法被格挡并造成 +14…20 伤害。

f4c3d701dae9934046b857023e9a710d08aafd90.source: Shout. For 3…5 seconds, party members within earshot cannot be knocked down.
f4c3d701dae9934046b857023e9a710d08aafd90.text: 喊叫。在 3…5 秒内，听力范围内的队员无法被击倒。

7f16f6301ff65cf66c88e716b8f73d1ad94e8c37.source: Shout. For 4…9…10 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 5…13…15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. "Fall Back!" ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally successfully hits with an attack.
7f16f6301ff65cf66c88e716b8f73d1ad94e8c37.text: 喊叫。在 4…9…10 秒内，听力范围内的所有盟友在移动时每秒获得 5…13…15 生命值，并且移动速度更快 33%。 “倒退！”当受此呼喊影响的盟友成功攻击时，该盟友就会结束。

e17491a5eae6f4c33b306bc06809f777f2d38def.source: Shout. All nearby foes lose 2…5…6 Energy. For 1…12…15 seconds, your melee attacks gain +5…25…30% chance of a critical hit against stationary foes.
e17491a5eae6f4c33b306bc06809f777f2d38def.text: 喊叫。所有附近的敌人都会失去 2…5…6 能量。在 1…12…15 秒内，你的近战攻击对静止的敌人有 +5…25…30% 的暴击几率。

e54576da0e880e7b2b528820e9e9c85b2a17329b.source: Shout. For 5…17…20 seconds, the next time target ally attacks, that ally deals +5…41…50 damage and inflicts a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
e54576da0e880e7b2b528820e9e9c85b2a17329b.text: 喊叫。在 5…17…20 秒内，下次目标盟友攻击时，该盟友会造成 +5…41…50 伤害并造成深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

f8968fa0e90edc6332fcba828c7680d681897f81.source: Shout. For 5…17…20 seconds, the next time target ally criticals, that ally also inflicts a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
f8968fa0e90edc6332fcba828c7680d681897f81.text: 喊叫。持续 5…17…20 秒，下一次目标盟友暴击时，该盟友也会造成深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

46407dee3f674742bea6c4afa38b60fbe7c1318c.source: Shout. If target foe has less than 50% Health, that foe takes 44…80 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor and a Deep Wound for 12…20 seconds.
46407dee3f674742bea6c4afa38b60fbe7c1318c.text: 喊叫。如果目标敌人的生命值低于 50%，则该敌人会受到 44…80 伤害，并遭受装甲破裂和深度伤口，持续 12…20 秒。

e79c7bdc167fa29f5ac82db1818962382ba374f0.text: 喊叫。所有在听力范围内且生命值低于 75% 的盟友都会获得 1…8…10 能量。

55a4ac08bd7fca372d680fa75f0832eceb88bd4a.text: 喊叫。在 10 秒内，所有在听力范围内且低于 75% 生命值的队伍成员都会获得 +1…4…5 生命恢复。

69cc6969314210589a59b7f4d6bc63fe64463c49.text: 喊叫。如果在听力范围内有任何死去的盟友，你的队伍移动速度会加快 33%，持续 5…10…11 秒。

8c048f9c28603237d6e824cc1e42d95a69bc5348.text: 喊叫。在 5…10…11 秒内，你和听力范围内的所有小队成员都会获得 +60 护甲来抵御传入的射弹攻击。

ef3e00f3556bfba2da4235a5bda9b04860e51646.source: Shout. For 5…17…20 seconds, all party members within earshot receive +24 armor when not moving. This effect ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally attacks.

a3ad39a5edbae8463349b599306c29c6e6492ef0.text: 喊叫。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的队伍成员受到燃烧敌人的伤害减少 5…29…35%。

7eb98d5fda8b0502c8aa469aaa6b65b53152dd72.source: Shout. For each foe within earshot (maximum 1…5…6), you gain one strike of adrenaline. For 10…18…20 seconds, your maximum Health is increased by 10…50…60.
7eb98d5fda8b0502c8aa469aaa6b65b53152dd72.text: 喊叫。对于听力范围内的每个敌人（最大 1…5…6），你都会获得一次肾上腺素打击。在 10…18…20 秒内，你的最大生命值会增加 10…50…60。

f1b80b63596b4eeefe85ea55e86780b18eadaf00.source: Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, spells cast by target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to cast. When this hex ends, you gain 1…6…7 energy. Unlike other skill descriptions, "energy" is lowercase here
f1b80b63596b4eeefe85ea55e86780b18eadaf00.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…13…15 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人施放的法术需要两倍的时间来施放。当这个六角形结束时，你获得 1…6…7 能量。与其他技能描述不同的是，这里的“能量”是小写的

d308fcb3d62a0412d82ecb0f722de00b433f2ca5.source: Enchantment Spell. If you cast a spell in the next 20 seconds, Arcane Echo is replaced with that spell for 20 seconds. Arcane Echo ends prematurely if you use a non-spell skill.
d308fcb3d62a0412d82ecb0f722de00b433f2ca5.text: 结界咒语。如果你在接下来的 20 秒内施展法术，奥术回响会在 20 秒内被该法术取代。如果您使用非法术技能，奥术回响会提前结束。

f42c5993f5035e0f006b1d04100a62bfcfbc5e26.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…8…10 seconds, all spells cast by the target foe cause 10 Overcast.
f42c5993f5035e0f006b1d04100a62bfcfbc5e26.text: 精英六角咒语。在 1…8…10 秒内，目标敌人施展的所有法术都会造成 10 阴暗。

18fd0f9a9e7189d23a0f500a4b909ffa4f962e97.source: Spell. For 5…29…35 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Arcane Larceny is replaced by that spell.
18fd0f9a9e7189d23a0f500a4b909ffa4f962e97.text: 咒语。在 5…29…35 秒内，目标敌人会禁用一个随机法术，并且奥术盗窃会被该法术取代。

28cc4a5d0e5792b3f34011f6f8bcd3a76e78c3d3.source: Spell. For 20 seconds, Arcane Mimicry becomes the non-form elite skill from target other ally.
28cc4a5d0e5792b3f34011f6f8bcd3a76e78c3d3.text: 咒语。在 20 秒内，奥术拟态成为目标其他盟友的非形态精英技能。

55416ab15436162ed2997bed9ddf5ce712a9d9a6.source: Spell. For 5…29…35 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe, and Arcane Thievery is replaced by that spell.
55416ab15436162ed2997bed9ddf5ce712a9d9a6.text: 咒语。在 5…29…35 秒内，目标敌人的一个随机法术被禁用，奥术窃贼被该法术取代。

5138ded7e7229f20cf30d27539883f8e609d4824.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 2 Energy for each enchantment on you (maximum 2…6…7 Energy).
5138ded7e7229f20cf30d27539883f8e609d4824.text: 精英结界法术。在 10 秒内，每当你施展法术时，你身上的每个结界都会获得 2 能量（最大 2…6…7 能量）。

b6c29f007e3f5d0185e6aee320a1e4f7a7a61d9e.source: Elite Signet. For 1…19…24 seconds, conditions you apply while wielding a bow last 150% longer.
b6c29f007e3f5d0185e6aee320a1e4f7a7a61d9e.text: 精英图章。在 1…19…24 秒内，你在挥舞弓时施加的条件会持续 150% 更长的时间。

8cefbf9249ac1885906f29df4009969bb327184a.source: Bow Attack. If this arrow hits, it strikes for +10…30…35 damage. This arrow cannot be blocked, but it moves 50% slower.
8cefbf9249ac1885906f29df4009969bb327184a.text: 弓攻击。如果此箭击中，则会造成 +10…30…35 伤害。该箭无法被阻挡，但移动速度较慢 50%。

3c6cbef8333213d0e45650d8fec67d4bc43cd290.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a spell, that party member gains 30…78…90 Health.
3c6cbef8333213d0e45650d8fec67d4bc43cd290.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，每次听力范围内的每个队员使用法术时，该队员都会获得 30…78…90 生命值。

b731b29b317599c0bb8c96035dc592c0b6242f13.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Spell, that ally gains 1…5…6 Energy.
b731b29b317599c0bb8c96035dc592c0b6242f13.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，每次听力范围内的每个盟友使用法术时，该盟友都会获得 1…5…6 能量。

78b67df8b5d01cb28649b56457a0ae3af084c707.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, you gain 24…53…60 armor, but move 50…21…14% slower.
78b67df8b5d01cb28649b56457a0ae3af084c707.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，你获得 24…53…60 护甲，但移动 50…21…14% 的速度变慢。

5556821957236a97567776da46ef7dd0a85a284d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…29…34 seconds, you gain +40 armor against physical damage and have +1 Water Magic.
5556821957236a97567776da46ef7dd0a85a284d.text: 结界咒语。在 10…29…34 秒内，你获得 +40 物理伤害护甲并拥有 +1 水系魔法。

909d72b469a4c995366bf1e390fa030f2f1b0bc5.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +10…34…40 armor and move 33% faster.
909d72b469a4c995366bf1e390fa030f2f1b0bc5.text: 结界咒语。在 8…18…20 秒内，你获得 +10…34…40 护甲并更快地移动 33%。

56a648226a466bc185a0496d8f9985ac83e135cf.source: Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes suffer from Weakness for 5…13…15 seconds. For 15 seconds, you take 5…17…20 less damage from foes suffering from a condition.
56a648226a466bc185a0496d8f9985ac83e135cf.text: 结界咒语。所有相邻敌人都会受到持续 5…13…15 秒的虚弱影响。在 15 秒内，你从患有某种疾病的敌人那里受到的伤害会减少 5…17…20。

39e648360444388e174a2875b616aebe74162d37.source: Skill. For 10…30…35 seconds, your spirits within earshot take 50% less damage and are immune to critical attacks.
39e648360444388e174a2875b616aebe74162d37.text: 技能。在 10…30…35 秒内，你听力范围内的灵魂受到的伤害会减少 50%，并且免疫致命攻击。

8c77ce4c94491dd869b73d77cc47da49d6ebaa58.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, you have 10 base damage reduction while casting Binding Rituals.
8c77ce4c94491dd869b73d77cc47da49d6ebaa58.text: 结界咒语。在 10…30…35 秒内，你在施放束缚仪式时可以减少 10 基础伤害。

fec28dbe78c979182240a7f8702e011a4d6c4c91.source: Hex Spell. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 35…59…65 earth damage. Burning foes struck by Ash Blast are hexed for 5 seconds and have a 20…64…75% chance to miss with attacks.
fec28dbe78c979182240a7f8702e011a4d6c4c91.text: 降咒魔法。目标和邻近的敌人会受到 35…59…65 的地球伤害。被灰烬爆炸击中的燃烧敌人会被施咒 5 秒，并且有 20…64…75% 几率攻击失败。

dc59cb54cb111a12f2779e9c207741442a17238b.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, if target foe dies, you gain 5…17…20 Energy and all your skills are recharged.
dc59cb54cb111a12f2779e9c207741442a17238b.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…13…15 秒内，如果目标敌人死亡，你将获得 5…17…20 能量，并且你的所有技能都会恢复。

2c333388273842ce558b2c893b999ce07ad62591.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, the next 1…8…10 attack skills you use remove one condition.
2c333388273842ce558b2c893b999ce07ad62591.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，您使用的下一个 1…8…10 攻击技能会消除一个条件。

e18a537758984e03e36f3ffce329f718677d9b65.source: Elite Skill. Must follow a dual attack. Target foe loses all enchantments.
e18a537758984e03e36f3ffce329f718677d9b65.text: 精英技能。必须遵循双重攻击。目标敌人失去所有结界。

28369b4c50e63ff90bde4a7892d070484c52be07.source: Hex Spell. For 9…12 seconds your attacks cannot miss target foe. Killing a foe hexed with Asuran Scan removes 5% Death Penalty.
28369b4c50e63ff90bde4a7892d070484c52be07.text: 降咒魔法。在 9…12 秒内，你的攻击不会错过目标敌人。杀死被阿苏兰扫描施咒的敌人可消除 5% 死刑。

f165f0133e2bd01737404e4b5493e119b9ddf977.source: Hex Spell. For 3…6…7 seconds, target foe's primary attribute is reduced to 0.
f165f0133e2bd01737404e4b5493e119b9ddf977.text: 降咒魔法。在3…6…7秒内，目标敌人的主要属性降低为0。

77f75956fb71bc0cdbf5eb1a81d4c993f0672ba0.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…9…10 seconds you have a 50% chance to block while attacking. When this enchantment ends, you inflict Weakness on all adjacent foes for 3…13…15 seconds.
77f75956fb71bc0cdbf5eb1a81d4c993f0672ba0.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 3…9…10 秒内，你有 50% 机会在攻击时进行格挡。当此结界结束时，你对所有相邻的敌人造成虚弱，持续 3…13…15 秒。

c3b5ee62271b952a4cdcd8a133078fdbdd6e328f.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Songkai's ashes for up to 45 seconds. While you hold her ashes, your spells and binding rituals cost -5…41…50% of the base Energy to cast.
c3b5ee62271b952a4cdcd8a133078fdbdd6e328f.text: 精英物品法术。持有宋凯的骨灰最多45秒。当你持有她的骨灰时，你的咒语和绑定仪式会消耗 -5…41…50% 的基础能量来施放。

2a43a3df2b4493c421872ca6bcc0033a0313484d.source: Hex Spell. For 5…29…35 seconds, the next time damage would drop target foe's Health below 50%, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds and Shadow Step to that foe. This spell has half the normal range.
2a43a3df2b4493c421872ca6bcc0033a0313484d.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…29…35 秒内，下次伤害会使目标敌人的生命值降至 50% 以下时，你会对该敌人造成持续 5…17…20 秒的深伤和暗影步。该法术的射程只有正常范围的一半。

3c69202afcb865827789c848f80cc0d1f96c285d.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. When you cast Aura of Displacement, Shadow Step to target foe. When you stop maintaining Aura of Displacement you return to your original location.
3c69202afcb865827789c848f80cc0d1f96c285d.text: 精英结界法术。当你对目标敌人施放位移光环、暗影步时。当你停止维持位移光环时，你会回到原来的位置。

403f60abbe2c38fccee6c55b447d815cfbaffcf3.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3 seconds, target ally gains 50…90…100% more Health when healed and takes 5…41…50% less damage.
403f60abbe2c38fccee6c55b447d815cfbaffcf3.text: 精英结界法术。在 3 秒内，目标盟友在治疗时获得更多 50…90…100% 生命值，并减少 5…41…50% 伤害。

55ed5c16d0b94e89dc762c754413fb527fab6251.source: Enchantment Spell. For 45 seconds, you deal 20…25 holy damage to all adjacent foes whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment.
55ed5c16d0b94e89dc762c754413fb527fab6251.text: 结界咒语。在 45 秒内，每当你失去苦行僧结界时，你都会对所有相邻敌人造成 20…25 神圣伤害。

c4f0c18012d4b4eda3301b3ca8e91a8f71d5425d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, you gain 0…1…1 Energy and are healed for 200…440…500% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.
c4f0c18012d4b4eda3301b3ca8e91a8f71d5425d.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，你获得 0…1…1 能量，并且每次施展法术时都会受到 200…440…500% 能量消耗的治疗。

259be6463dd6566131edd0649edfab570c6cd582.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, you gain 0…1…1 Energy and are healed for 200…360…400% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.
259be6463dd6566131edd0649edfab570c6cd582.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，你获得 0…1…1 能量，并且每次施展法术时都会受到 200…360…400% 能量消耗的治疗。

e663e84070886c9b7ee8dd47e420faafd9d9053c.source: Enchantment Spell. For 3…7…8 seconds, target other ally cannot be knocked down.
e663e84070886c9b7ee8dd47e420faafd9d9053c.text: 结界咒语。在 3…7…8 秒内，目标其他盟友无法被击倒。

3f835612c7e62d6fc1ac65c936804dec40f3c1f4.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. All corpses within earshot are exploited and you animate a level 1…14…17 bone horror plus one for each corpse exploited in this way. For 5…37…45 seconds, your Death Magic attribute is increased by +1.
3f835612c7e62d6fc1ac65c936804dec40f3c1f4.text: 精英结界法术。听力范围内的所有尸体都会被利用，并且您可以为 1…14…17 级的骨头恐怖加上一个以这种方式利用的尸体。在5…37…45秒内，你的死亡魔法属性增加+1。

499d90fd1427f254df82dadec7944b01f0c1c34e.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes begin Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds. For 30 seconds, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Crippled for 3…7…8 seconds.
499d90fd1427f254df82dadec7944b01f0c1c34e.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有附近的敌人都会开始流血，持续 5…13…15 秒。在 30 秒内，该结界没有任何作用。当此结界结束时，所有附近的敌人都会瘫痪 3…7…8 秒。

fdc04116fa2873dd7a1580e48d8b735b16b9571d.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you inflict Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds. If you are enchanted, you also inflict Cracked Armor for 1…8…10 seconds.
fdc04116fa2873dd7a1580e48d8b735b16b9571d.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成流血 5…13…15 秒。如果你被附魔，你还会造成护甲破裂，持续 1…8…10 秒。

8736d2c3b296982da9a0ab79a84f6cc2cdf350e3.source: Hammer Attack. If Auspicious Blow hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage and gain 3…7…8 Energy. If target foe is suffering from Weakness, this attack is unblockable.
8736d2c3b296982da9a0ab79a84f6cc2cdf350e3.text: 锤子攻击。如果吉祥一击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 伤害并获得 3…7…8 能量。如果目标敌人处于虚弱状态，则此攻击无法阻挡。

0e768f1677c8eaa3ad87669a20249cc08143b1fb.source: Hammer Attack. If Auspicious Blow hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage and gain 2…4…4 Energy. If target foe is suffering from Weakness, this attack is unblockable.
0e768f1677c8eaa3ad87669a20249cc08143b1fb.text: 锤子攻击。如果吉祥一击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 伤害并获得 2…4…4 能量。如果目标敌人处于虚弱状态，则此攻击无法阻挡。

cceef44761285a3961ec0f7dceb62a3b7cb7a515.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, the next spell you cast is disabled for an additional 10…6…5 seconds, and you gain 110…182…200% of that spell's Energy cost.
cceef44761285a3961ec0f7dceb62a3b7cb7a515.text: 结界咒语。在 20 秒内，你施放的下一个法术将被额外禁用 10…6…5 秒，并且你获得该法术能量消耗的 110…182…200% 点。

f77723875c6b34ef020e11a7a5dc3aae1ab01ccf.source: Elite Stance. For 8 seconds, the next attack against you is blocked. You gain 1…3…4 strikes of adrenaline when this stance ends.
f77723875c6b34ef020e11a7a5dc3aae1ab01ccf.text: 精英姿态。 8 秒内，对你的下一次攻击将被阻止。当该姿势结束时，你会获得 1…3…4 次肾上腺素冲击。

f17bea99fa6a18565e70d359f7c94cd08e59ecce.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, and whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, nearby foes are set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
f17bea99fa6a18565e70d359f7c94cd08e59ecce.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你获得 +20 防御物理伤害的护甲，你更快地获得肾上腺素 25%，你的攻击造成神圣伤害，每当你失去苦行僧结界时，附近的敌人就会着火 1…3…3 秒。该技能将被禁用 45 秒。

3dff4943a26f57c0f00b34c2c070c145b529c2a4.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all allies in earshot are healed for 5…41…50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
3dff4943a26f57c0f00b34c2c070c145b529c2a4.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的攻击会造成神圣伤害。每当你使用苦行僧攻击技能时，你就会失去 1 降咒。每当你失去苦行僧结界时，听力范围内的所有盟友都会获得 5…41…50 生命值治疗。该技能禁用 45 秒。

49bde38683d5362008e9a161a14476efb392c02e.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, you are healed for 5…41…50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
49bde38683d5362008e9a161a14476efb392c02e.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的攻击会造成神圣伤害。每当你使用苦行僧攻击技能时，你就会失去 1 降咒。每当你失去苦行僧结界时，你就会获得 5…41…50 生命值的治疗。该技能禁用 45 秒。

fc1b47c75418d335238aaf7fd6711f13aeb37d4e.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your scythe attacks deal dark damage, and steal 0…10…12 Health. You are immune to Disease, and inflict Disease on all adjacent foes for 3 seconds whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fc1b47c75418d335238aaf7fd6711f13aeb37d4e.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的镰刀攻击会造成黑暗伤害，并窃取 0…10…12 生命值。你对疾病免疫，每当你失去苦行僧结界时，你就会对所有邻近的敌人造成疾病，持续 3 秒。该技能禁用 45 秒。

607f554e04b72ad829bb29e4f586a1d073142e84.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and your attacks deal chaos damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, steal 1 Energy from all nearby foes. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
607f554e04b72ad829bb29e4f586a1d073142e84.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的苦行僧结界会更快地充能 50% 并且你的攻击会造成混乱伤害。每当你失去苦行僧结界时，就会从附近所有敌人身上窃取 1 能量。该技能禁用 45 秒。

a02226ea324062af947a8a941adbe926b49bc1fd.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you have +150 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all party members in earshot lose 1 condition. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
a02226ea324062af947a8a941adbe926b49bc1fd.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你拥有 +150 生命值、+30 元素护甲，并且你的攻击会造成土属性伤害。每当你失去苦行僧结界时，听力范围内的所有队员都会失去 1 状态。该技能将被禁用 45 秒。

d5c4c97bb08775fc3e8a0aa303d2db7ef30bd099.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you have +100 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment you lose 2 conditions. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
d5c4c97bb08775fc3e8a0aa303d2db7ef30bd099.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你拥有 +100 生命值、+30 元素护甲，并且你的攻击会造成土属性伤害。每当你失去苦行僧结界时，你就会失去 2 条件。该技能将被禁用 45 秒。

360f1b945eca9fa5cb5341416ac35d600032d1f8.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20…39…44 seconds, you gain +2 Blood Magic and +2 Curses, but whenever you sacrifice Health, you sacrifice 50% more than the normal amount.
360f1b945eca9fa5cb5341416ac35d600032d1f8.text: 结界咒语。在 20…39…44 秒内，你获得 +2 血魔法和 +2 诅咒，但每当你牺牲生命值时，你就会牺牲比正常数量更多的 50%。

cf6c99a68d40c0c814be8bde39c6654a8f97ffa7.source: Skill. If this skill hits a knocked-down foe, that foe becomes Dazed for 5…13…15 seconds.
cf6c99a68d40c0c814be8bde39c6654a8f97ffa7.text: 技能。如果该技能击中被击倒的敌人，该敌人会陷入茫然状态 5…13…15 秒。

a81fb68450b14c818781a8db6b9a913c3b0bb708.source: Axe Attack. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a Deep Wound, you strike for +4…14…16 damage, and that foe becomes Crippled for 15 seconds.
a81fb68450b14c818781a8db6b9a913c3b0bb708.text: 斧头攻击。如果此攻击击中遭受深度伤口的敌人，你会造成 +4…14…16 伤害，并且该敌人会在 15 秒内瘫痪。

a818e0ab8bf9c81f2f84d11c6524caa7bd328449.source: Axe Attack. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a Deep Wound, you strike for 5…21…25 more damage and that foe suffers from Weakness for 20 seconds.
a818e0ab8bf9c81f2f84d11c6524caa7bd328449.text: 斧头攻击。如果此攻击击中遭受深度伤害的敌人，您将造成 5…21…25 额外伤害，并且该敌人将受到虚弱 20 秒的伤害。

fbb2d16b5577211fd79f4d75349a7b8ceb08bd69.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If Backbreaker hits, you strike for +1…16…20 damage and your target is knocked down. If you have 8 Strength or higher, this knockdown lasts 4 seconds.
fbb2d16b5577211fd79f4d75349a7b8ceb08bd69.text: 精英锤攻击。如果 Backbreaker 击中，你会造成 +1…16…20 伤害，并且你的目标会被击倒。如果你有 8 力量或更高，则击倒持续 4 秒。

af7fa4cb174238cc5d45d4fbc02627a1143cd86d.source: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, that foe takes 35…119…140 damage.
af7fa4cb174238cc5d45d4fbc02627a1143cd86d.text: 降咒魔法。在 10 秒内，每当目标敌人施放法术时，该敌人就会受到 35…119…140 伤害。

b4d860feb0c5071b83d2477d3dffcb90e3654c27.source: Stance. For 8…18…20 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and you do not suffer extra damage from a critical attack.
b4d860feb0c5071b83d2477d3dffcb90e3654c27.text: 立场。在 8…18…20 秒内，你不会被击倒，也不会因致命攻击而受到额外伤害。

0657abfc42a49ee79f99c3005214f0db12076f9a.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot takes damage, that party member gains 15…63…75 Health.
0657abfc42a49ee79f99c3005214f0db12076f9a.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，下一次听力范围内的每位队员受到伤害时，该队员将获得 15…63…75 生命值。

a575f90fc18531bbab6f15e751b8d029a1a56902.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, foes adjacent to target ally take 10…26…30 holy damage each second.
a575f90fc18531bbab6f15e751b8d029a1a56902.text: 结界咒语。在 8 秒内，目标盟友附近的敌人每秒受到 10…26…30 神圣伤害。

d34c57cfda76ea0aa83de65df610693f365435cf.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…21…25 seconds, the next time target ally would be knocked down by a foe, that foe is knocked down instead.
d34c57cfda76ea0aa83de65df610693f365435cf.text: 精英结界法术。在 5…21…25 秒内，下一次目标盟友被敌人击倒时，该敌人将被击倒。

e6b0ca292d2cf5bea6a2f636d93b3dd7321d9df5.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds. For 20 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1…2…2 strikes of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.
e6b0ca292d2cf5bea6a2f636d93b3dd7321d9df5.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有附近的敌人都会被点燃，持续 1…3…3 秒。在 20 秒后，该结界没有任何作用。当此结界结束时，如果有任何敌人在听力范围内，你将获得 1…2…2 次肾上腺素打击。

7e6448ef460bff73454a999e8925c3fe4d646e0e.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains adrenaline and 1 Energy after taking damage. (The amount of adrenaline gained increases depending on your rank in Smiting Prayers.)
7e6448ef460bff73454a999e8925c3fe4d646e0e.text: 结界咒语。当你保持此结界时，目标盟友在受到伤害后会获得肾上腺素和 1 能量。 （获得的肾上腺素量会根据你在“打击祈祷”中的等级而增加。）

db37fe34d585a99810f886f386ff8ef9d5c8742e.source: Signet. Target foe takes 30…54…60 holy damage. If target foe was attacking, that foe is knocked down.
db37fe34d585a99810f886f386ff8ef9d5c8742e.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 30…54…60 神圣伤害。如果目标敌人正在攻击，则该敌人会被击倒。

bde63cb281d4d2fb9fd7cc0e70707a1ce820c1ae.source: Spell. Target foe takes 20…56…65 holy damage. This spell does double damage to summoned creatures.
bde63cb281d4d2fb9fd7cc0e70707a1ce820c1ae.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 20…56…65 神圣伤害。该法术对召唤生物造成双倍伤害。

2857bedb33e12c12b1b13218c2785f664be51ccf.source: Melee Attack. If it hits, this attack deals 10…50…60 holy damage. It deals double damage to summoned creatures.
2857bedb33e12c12b1b13218c2785f664be51ccf.text: 近战攻击。如果命中，此攻击会造成 10…50…60 神圣伤害。它对召唤生物造成双倍伤害。

d752ea11043560bcc487a620b29315d14c43de18.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…25…30 damage. If you are currently not in a stance, you also inflict Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds.
d752ea11043560bcc487a620b29315d14c43de18.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…25…30 伤害。如果你当前没有处于姿态，你还会造成流血 5…13…15 秒。

e4efce3b4fd749f347974bd9d552c6d501d6b467.source: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows cause Bleeding for 3…13…15 seconds. You have -40 armor while activating this skill.
e4efce3b4fd749f347974bd9d552c6d501d6b467.text: 准备。在 24 秒内，你的箭会导致流血 3…13…15 秒。激活此技能时，你拥有 -40 盔甲。

5877359397640750db4004204a847b069d77a884.source: Signet. You inflict Bleeding for 3…13…15 seconds on target foe and all adjacent foes.
5877359397640750db4004204a847b069d77a884.text: 印章。你对目标敌人和所有相邻敌人造成流血 3…13…15 秒。

74c7f0fc09c84f7c16062580cf668608d23eb457.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds.
74c7f0fc09c84f7c16062580cf668608d23eb457.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你的目标就会开始流血 5…17…20 秒。

1f2f8c5a9dca182d795bad8efb913e49f7189f4c.source: Trap. When Barbed Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 7…20…23 piercing damage, become Crippled, and begin Bleeding for 3…21…25 seconds. Barbed Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
1f2f8c5a9dca182d795bad8efb913e49f7189f4c.text: 陷阱。当倒刺陷阱被触发时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 7…20…23 穿刺伤害，变得残废，并开始流血，持续 3…21…25 秒。倒刺陷阱在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

e0cadff7e6604ff2b8d6f9998bc0819f61993427.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe takes 4…14…16 more damage when hit by physical damage.
e0cadff7e6604ff2b8d6f9998bc0819f61993427.text: 降咒魔法。在 30 秒内，目标敌人受到物理伤害时会承受 4…14…16 额外伤害。

cc6bdc9f5c16f3bccea4f16d8e83d262f1bdecde.source: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5…17…20 damage if they hit.
cc6bdc9f5c16f3bccea4f16d8e83d262f1bdecde.text: 精英弓攻击。你所有的准备工作都被删除了。向目标敌人以及目标附近最多 5 的敌人射箭。这些箭一旦击中就会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。

4f07d2c56d951cca21036b09eb1b813a98abb678.source: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, you move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from attacks. Battle Rage ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.
4f07d2c56d951cca21036b09eb1b813a98abb678.text: 精英姿态。在 5…17…20 秒内，你移动 33% 的速度更快，并从攻击中获得双倍的肾上腺素。如果您使用任何非肾上腺技能，战斗狂暴就会结束。

9b3be5c4d0e0cd77908ed4115b8584d713de693b.source: Spell. Create a Bed of Coals at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to target foe are struck for 5…24…29 fire damage each second. Any foe knocked down on the Bed of Coals is set on fire for 3…6…7 seconds.
9b3be5c4d0e0cd77908ed4115b8584d713de693b.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置创建一个煤床。在 5 秒内，目标敌人附近的敌人每秒都会受到 5…24…29 火焰伤害。任何被击倒在炭床上的敌人都会被点燃，持续 3…6…7 秒。

eef06c621e03cc66952f18dcb8e9278d974d6355.source: Elite Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. That foe becomes Dazed for 3…8…9 seconds.
eef06c621e03cc66952f18dcb8e9278d974d6355.text: 精英法术。暗影步瞄准敌人。该敌人会变得茫然 3…8…9 秒。

b35224c1d1449ce72de2799cca175a19a478c3b2.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack strikes a foe who is knocked down, the resulting dust cloud will blind adjacent foes for 3…6…7 seconds.
b35224c1d1449ce72de2799cca175a19a478c3b2.text: 锤子攻击。如果此攻击击中被击倒的敌人，产生的尘埃云将使相邻敌人致盲 3…6…7 秒。

4eb8cc90998ebcbd4d7122e1daf1abc9e4e7a3b5.source: Stance. For 8…13…14 seconds, you attack 33% faster and gain 100% more adrenaline. Berserker Stance ends if you use a skill.
4eb8cc90998ebcbd4d7122e1daf1abc9e4e7a3b5.text: 立场。在 8…13…14 秒内，你可以更快地攻击 33% 并获得 100% 更多的肾上腺素。如果使用技能，狂战士姿态就会结束。

4c789d7af1127a318ee313843b02a2d0f598b185.source: Stance. All your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds. For 5…10…11 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
4c789d7af1127a318ee313843b02a2d0f598b185.text: 立场。你的所有非攻击技能将被禁用 5 秒。在 5…10…11 秒内，你可以更快地攻击 25%。

fd86ce19ca99ffde5461f396311fd4ed41cbbc41.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Bestial Mauling that deals +5…17…20 damage. If the attack strikes a knocked-down foe, that foe is Dazed for 4…9…10 seconds.
fd86ce19ca99ffde5461f396311fd4ed41cbbc41.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行兽性撕咬，造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果攻击击中了被击倒的敌人，则该敌人会晕眩 4…9…10 秒。

01db0ff5323edb8d76c76237e3f96e80d94e2ab0.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Bestial Pounce that deals +5…17…20 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is casting a spell, that foe is knocked down.
01db0ff5323edb8d76c76237e3f96e80d94e2ab0.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行野兽猛扑，造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果攻击击中正在施法的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

420985962cbdb1eb7f608700b76eca7d15cf9c6b.source: Hex Spell. For 3 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes move 90% slower and take 1…24…30 damage each second while moving.
420985962cbdb1eb7f608700b76eca7d15cf9c6b.text: 降咒魔法。在 3 秒内，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人移动速度减慢 90% 并在移动时每秒受到 1…24…30 伤害。

10ff5b3e4ad97c9225a95b6317984cb3782c996d.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…51…60 cold damage. If that foe had more Health than you, Bitter Chill recharges instantly.
10ff5b3e4ad97c9225a95b6317984cb3782c996d.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 15…51…60 寒冷伤害。如果那个敌人的生命值比你多，苦寒会立即恢复。

237dae8ab71b3ddea90aa9a4b531415585475cf4.source: Lead Attack. If it hits, Black Lotus Strike strikes for +10…27…31 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Hex, you gain 5…11…13 Energy.
237dae8ab71b3ddea90aa9a4b531415585475cf4.text: 引导攻击。如果击中，黑莲花打击会造成 +10…27…31 伤害。如果目标敌人遭受妖术，你将获得 5…11…13 能量。

b8bbfaaa32592ffd68c44406c0d98d59bd8e61c7.source: Lead Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +8…18…20 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Hex, that foe is Crippled for 3…13…15 seconds.
b8bbfaaa32592ffd68c44406c0d98d59bd8e61c7.text: 引导攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +8…18…20 伤害。如果目标敌人正遭受妖术，则该敌人会瘫痪 3…13…15 秒。

c0c18552763f59660709c3117e40211f1bc686a1.source: Trap. When Black Powder Mine is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 20…30 damage, become Blinded, and begin Bleeding for 7…10 seconds. Black Powder Mine ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
c0c18552763f59660709c3117e40211f1bc686a1.text: 陷阱。当黑火药地雷被触发时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 20…30 伤害，变得失明，并开始流血 7…10 秒。黑火药地雷在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

004a06b214d32d9995dbb36833ed02563ab41458.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must strike a hexed foe. If it hits, this attack strikes for +5…17…20 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds.
004a06b214d32d9995dbb36833ed02563ab41458.text: 副手攻击。必须攻击被施咒的敌人。如果击中，此攻击会造成 +5…17…20 伤害，并且目标敌人中毒持续 5…17…20 秒。

93901ff06bb8c2764aab942a156f4e2fbfe9fd8e.source: Skill. For 2…7…8 seconds, all of touched target foe's skills are disabled, and all of your skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
93901ff06bb8c2764aab942a156f4e2fbfe9fd8e.text: 技能。在 2…7…8 秒内，所有接触的目标敌人的技能都将被禁用，并且你的所有技能将在 5 秒内被禁用。

1278c78751ab487f5f6158b8010dce8812981f3e.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +5…14…16 damage (maximum bonus 60) for each recharging dagger attack.
1278c78751ab487f5f6158b8010dce8812981f3e.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，每次充能匕首攻击都会造成 +5…14…16 伤害（最大奖励 60）。

ec97876cc204381b76c4759a004dac985027cc1a.source: Echo. For 20 seconds, target non-spirit ally has a 5…17…20% chance to block incoming attacks. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
ec97876cc204381b76c4759a004dac985027cc1a.text: 回声。在 20 秒内，目标非精神盟友有 5…17…20% 几率阻挡传入攻击。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。

e1ccff4a9ec8780e00f2ef84be2b6264ff7187b4.source: Echo. For 20 seconds, target non-spirit ally has +10…34…40 armor against slashing damage. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
e1ccff4a9ec8780e00f2ef84be2b6264ff7187b4.text: 回声。在 20 秒内，目标非精神盟友拥有 +10…34…40 护甲来抵抗挥砍伤害。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。

d689e39b46df5cfa37445f2c6b301c4536342a7a.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are set on Fire for 1…6…7 seconds.
d689e39b46df5cfa37445f2c6b301c4536342a7a.text: 回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当目标非精神盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，与该盟友相邻的所有敌人都会着火，持续 1…6…7 秒。

0466978263e23870e9fdef76226ab54fd5a1cdeb.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are set on Fire for 1…4…5 seconds.
0466978263e23870e9fdef76226ab54fd5a1cdeb.text: 回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当目标非精神盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，与该盟友相邻的所有敌人都会着火，持续 1…4…5 秒。

9531708c6c4193d3da1e68ce334383fceb9784fa.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +5…21…25 damage and sets target foe on Fire "Fire" is capitalized, unlike other descriptions which state "set on fire" for 1…3…3 seconds.
9531708c6c4193d3da1e68ce334383fceb9784fa.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击击中，它会造成 +5…21…25 伤害并使目标敌人着火。“Fire”是大写的，与其他描述“着火”1…3…3 秒不同。

463e6754444ea4ec845721a2e6ea7654df17ab5d.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, Monk enchantments you cast last 10…30…35% longer.
463e6754444ea4ec845721a2e6ea7654df17ab5d.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，你施放的武僧结界的持续时间会更长 10…30…35%。

1c46aefba9d532d6b878c68234aa80afceacdc78.source: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 10…98…120 Health and remove one condition and one hex.
1c46aefba9d532d6b878c68234aa80afceacdc78.text: 精英法术。治疗目标盟友的生命值 10…98…120 并消除一种状况和一种降咒。

a811082e5a918a7361609c2c5f70d42b6396143e.source: Signet. For each enchantment you are maintaining, you gain 3 Energy. You cannot gain more than 3…20…24 Energy in this way.
a811082e5a918a7361609c2c5f70d42b6396143e.text: 印章。对于您维持的每个结界，您都会获得 3 能量。通过这种方式你无法获得超过 3…20…24 的能量。

123638bd681c32af9faf48c31ffe978d4eb4cfd4.source: Item Spell. Hold Mingson's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all nearby foes are Blinded for 3…7…8 seconds.
123638bd681c32af9faf48c31ffe978d4eb4cfd4.text: 物品法术。保留明森的骨灰最多 15…51…60 秒。当你撒下他的骨灰时，附近的所有敌人都会被致盲 3…7…8 秒。

8e4fcda30371e64d3e69cebf0c89c260953f7810.source: Spell. Target foe is Blinded for 3…7…8 seconds.
8e4fcda30371e64d3e69cebf0c89c260953f7810.text: 咒语。目标敌人被致盲 3…7…8 秒。

c3d7ba5beb022d64c4a822921a8668e68de845bc.source: Spell. Must follow an off-hand attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes become Blinded for 3…13…15 seconds.
c3d7ba5beb022d64c4a822921a8668e68de845bc.text: 咒语。必须跟随副手攻击。目标敌人和所有邻近的敌人会被致盲 3…13…15 秒。

756dbff522b96349356f28cddb44efee43ceb0e2.source: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 5…41…50 lightning damage. That foe and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 3…7…8 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If this spell strikes an attacking foe, all adjacent foes are also struck and this spell deals 50% more damage.
756dbff522b96349356f28cddb44efee43ceb0e2.text: 精英法术。目标敌人受到 5…41…50 闪电伤害。该敌人和所有邻近的敌人都会被致盲 3…7…8 秒。该法术具有 25% 护甲穿透力。如果该法术击中攻击中的敌人，则所有邻近的敌人也会被击中，并且该法术造成 50% 额外伤害。

423c8d8710668fb528bd042b99986f0690ed7678.source: Hex Spell. For 3…10…12 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes are hexed with Blood Bond. Whenever an ally hits one of them with an attack, that ally gains 5…17…20 Health. If one of these foes dies while hexed, all allies adjacent to that foe are healed for 20…84…100 Health.
423c8d8710668fb528bd042b99986f0690ed7678.text: 降咒魔法。在 3…10…12 秒内，目标敌人和所有邻近的敌人都会被血之契约施咒。每当一名盟友攻击其中一名盟友时，该盟友就会获得 5…17…20 生命值。如果这些敌人之一在施咒时死亡，则与该敌人相邻的所有盟友都会获得 20…84…100 生命值治疗。

7e0e4964ae95141c08482caec507ab3516ce6ab0.source: Spell. If your Health is above 90%, you begin Bleeding for 6 seconds. Steal up to 20…56…65 Health from target foe.
7e0e4964ae95141c08482caec507ab3516ce6ab0.text: 咒语。如果你的生命值高于 90%，你就会开始流血 6 秒。从目标敌人处偷取 20…56…65 生命值。

518726dfde1888d9287e1de7525351713ad5abd4.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3…5…6 Energy regeneration.
518726dfde1888d9287e1de7525351713ad5abd4.text: 精英结界法术。在 10 秒内，目标其他盟友获得 +3…5…6 能量回复。

2578e5fdb6011a3aa4c0818f9d0e1dcc21987d65.source: Spell. Steal up to 5…37…45 Health from target foe. If that foe was attacking, that foe suffers Weakness for 3…10…12 seconds.
2578e5fdb6011a3aa4c0818f9d0e1dcc21987d65.text: 咒语。从目标敌人处偷取 5…37…45 生命值。如果该敌人正在攻击，则该敌人会受到弱点 3…10…12 秒。

262f07618caaad577e4299325a7fb108693f71a2.source: Spell. All of your undead allies are healed for 30…99…116 Health. You sacrifice an additional 2% maximum Health per minion healed in this way.
262f07618caaad577e4299325a7fb108693f71a2.text: 咒语。你所有的不死盟友都得到了 30…99…116 生命值的治疗。通过这种方式治疗每个小兵，你会额外牺牲 2% 最大生命值。

79bc63035af3757acf38c5464dc894aaebc6fba5.source: Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you gain +3…5…6 Health regeneration. When Blood Renewal ends, you gain 40…160…190 Health.
79bc63035af3757acf38c5464dc894aaebc6fba5.text: 结界咒语。在 7 秒内，你获得 +3…5…6 生命恢复。当血液更新结束时，你获得 40…160…190 生命值。

402816ab2fd5ce37496c27614475d3bdd71dd129.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…13…14 seconds, target touched ally gains +3 Energy regeneration. Blood Ritual cannot be used on the caster.
402816ab2fd5ce37496c27614475d3bdd71dd129.text: 结界咒语。在 8…13…14 秒内，目标接触的盟友获得 +3 能量回复。血之仪式不能对施法者使用。

2110afec5f335b7936f2ae538d6fd591ad6ebe94.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit who dies after 30…126…150 seconds. Attacks by that spirit steal up to 5…21…25 Health.
2110afec5f335b7936f2ae538d6fd591ad6ebe94.text: 缚灵仪式。创建一个等级为 1…10…12 的精魂，该精魂会在 30…126…150 秒后死亡。该灵魂的攻击会窃取最多 5…21…25 的生命值。

39ae9373aad589b9bdf7afee600be210e43b7623.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit who dies after 30…126…150 seconds. Attacks by that spirit steal up to 5…21…25 Health.
39ae9373aad589b9bdf7afee600be210e43b7623.text: 缚灵仪式。创建一个等级为 1…7…8 的精魂，该精魂会在 30…126…150 秒后死亡。该灵魂的攻击会窃取最多 5…21…25 的生命值。

988db57bfd6550a193c75a94afffc4cc1f7fe97d.source: Hex Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes are hexed with Blurred Vision. While hexed, those foes have a 50% chance to miss with attacks.
988db57bfd6550a193c75a94afffc4cc1f7fe97d.text: 降咒魔法。在 4…9…10 秒内，目标敌人和邻近敌人会受到视力模糊的影响。当施咒时，这些敌人有 50% 的机会错过攻击。

a177735bd63dcc1db28fb06859b72cd50fd8e316.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes +10…34…40 damage. If target foe has Cracked Armor, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 0…12…15 seconds.
a177735bd63dcc1db28fb06859b72cd50fd8e316.text: 近战攻击。如果此攻击命中，目标敌人将受到 +10…34…40 伤害。如果目标敌人的护甲破裂，则该敌人会受到深度伤害，持续 0…12…15 秒。

57fb41fd4e82be8f4659f5a3deb4b191c5cd1566.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If it hits a foe with Cracked Armor, you gain 5…9…10 Energy.
57fb41fd4e82be8f4659f5a3deb4b191c5cd1566.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果它击中了装甲破裂的敌人，您将获得 5…9…10 能量。

4cb802246634ec46f6ded9e0b07956fd60adb9a6.source: Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks. You gain 5 Energy for each successful melee attack blocked. Bonetti's Defense ends if you use a skill.
4cb802246634ec46f6ded9e0b07956fd60adb9a6.text: 立场。在 5…10…11 秒内，你有 75% 机会阻挡近战和投射物攻击。每次成功阻止近战攻击，您都会获得 5 能量。如果您使用技能，博内蒂的防御就会结束。

795a4d8f9ead40d29372f8a93ceb0627f59d2c6e.source: Enchantment Spell. For 15…51…60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, you gain 5…41…50 Health and 1…5…6 Energy.
795a4d8f9ead40d29372f8a93ceb0627f59d2c6e.text: 结界咒语。在 15…51…60 秒内，每当你创造一个生物时，你都会获得 5…41…50 生命值和 1…5…6 能量。

3aeffcf25046357a22e5ac86967031f7b748ad9b.source: Elite Signet. Heal target ally for 20…68…80 Health. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer spell that targets an ally heals for an additional 20…84…100 Health.
3aeffcf25046357a22e5ac86967031f7b748ad9b.text: 精英图章。治疗目标盟友的生命值 20…68…80。你的下一个针对盟友的治疗或保护祈祷法术可以治疗额外的 20…84…100 生命值。

9734668c1dc514e1eb83b4832416a72243483def.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 Spirit. Non-Spirit creatures that are knocked down in its range take 5 damage and begin Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds. This Spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
9734668c1dc514e1eb83b4832416a72243483def.text: 自然仪式。创建一个等级为1…8…10的精灵。在其范围内被击倒的非灵体生物会受到 5 伤害并开始流血 5…17…20 秒。该精魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

d2e9f167428f48e1f73f283d778b223592911708.source: Skill. You headbutt target touched foe dealing 45…70 damage and knocking down that foe if it hits.
d2e9f167428f48e1f73f283d778b223592911708.text: 技能。你用头撞目标所触及的敌人，造成 45…70 伤害，并击倒该敌人（如果击中）。

58b79163993c055162d79224ea34e68871e3c1b6.source: Spell. Create Breath of Fire at target foe's current location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 10…34…40 fire damage each second.
58b79163993c055162d79224ea34e68871e3c1b6.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的当前位置产生火焰呼吸。在 5 秒内，邻近该位置的敌人每秒都会受到 10…34…40 火焰伤害。

682fe61748a92bd2d3ff6dc6bb9566eac3137b79.source: Spell. All party members are relieved of Burning and are healed for 50…60 Health.
682fe61748a92bd2d3ff6dc6bb9566eac3137b79.text: 咒语。所有队员都解除了燃烧状态，并获得了 50…60 健康值的治愈。

6c47114a3ad5eb86f001cc84e9c7e8fc289aac3b.source: Elite Bow Attack. You shoot a broad head arrow that moves slower than normal. If it hits, target foe is Dazed for 5…17…20 seconds, and if target foe is casting a spell that spell is interrupted.
6c47114a3ad5eb86f001cc84e9c7e8fc289aac3b.text: 精英弓攻击。你射出一支宽头箭头，其移动速度比正常情况慢。如果命中，目标敌人会晕眩 5…17…20 秒，如果目标敌人正在施放法术，则该法术会被打断。

f542766c88cd807df10c7f88114667d0e374d766.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Brutal Strike that deals +5…29…35 damage. If that attack strikes a foe whose Health is below 50%, that foe takes an additional +5…29…35 damage.
f542766c88cd807df10c7f88114667d0e374d766.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行残酷打击，造成 +5…29…35 伤害。如果该攻击击中生命值低于 50% 的敌人，则该敌人会受到额外的 +5…29…35 伤害。

650ed8b9ca6a06f16f94f9f74e72db94b6c2f54e.source: Weapon Spell. Give target ally a Brutal Weapon for 10…34…40 seconds. The bearer's weapon strikes for +5…13…15 damage as long as the bearer is under no enchantments.
650ed8b9ca6a06f16f94f9f74e72db94b6c2f54e.text: 武器咒语。给予目标盟友一把残酷武器，持续 10…34…40 秒。只要持有者没有结界，持有者的武器就会造成 +5…13…15 伤害。

f57f42aa319f1e80d8bc43cf8126f2c480b32c1b.source: Elite Stance. For 1…6…7 seconds, you move 50% faster and if you strike a moving foe in melee, that foe is knocked down. Bull's Charge ends if you use a skill.
f57f42aa319f1e80d8bc43cf8126f2c480b32c1b.text: 精英姿态。在 1…6…7 秒内，你移动 50% 的速度更快，如果你在近战中击中移动的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。如果您使用技能，公牛冲锋就会结束。

b017c0b7b390e8d7d18de668ec24eb30917b8fb0.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits a moving foe, you strike for +5…25…30 damage, and your target is knocked down.
b017c0b7b390e8d7d18de668ec24eb30917b8fb0.text: 近战攻击。如果此攻击击中移动的敌人，你会受到 +5…25…30 伤害，并且你的目标会被击倒。

c6acade5f9b97c73c9c4ca157eaff1d1340757c6.source: Elite Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…26…30 damage and cause Burning for 2…7…8 seconds.
c6acade5f9b97c73c9c4ca157eaff1d1340757c6.text: 精英弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会受到 +10…26…30 伤害并造成燃烧 2…7…8 秒。

7100a073380e1cc70e308215425a655d559a6ad7.source: Echo. For 20 seconds, if target non-spirit ally hits a foe with more Health than that ally, that foe is set on Fire "Fire" is capitalized, unlike other descriptions which state "set on fire" for 1…3…3 seconds. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
7100a073380e1cc70e308215425a655d559a6ad7.text: 回声。在 20 秒内，如果目标非精神盟友击中的敌人的生命值高于该盟友，则该敌人会着火。“Fire”是大写的，与其他描述“着火”1…3…3 秒不同。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。

43580e7be439dc04aa3c20adc0e32ca33945cb97.source: Skill. For 3…8…9 seconds, while wielding a shield, the next attack skill used against you is blocked. If it was a melee attack, your attacker is set on fire for 1…5…6 seconds.
43580e7be439dc04aa3c20adc0e32ca33945cb97.text: 技能。在3…8…9秒内，当你挥舞盾牌时，对你使用的下一个攻击技能会被阻挡。如果是近战攻击，攻击者会被点燃 1…5…6 秒。

b454e13aa6e2dbdf6c45b8e53667769bf2f34489.source: Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you are set on fire and move 30…42…45% faster. When Burning Speed ends, all adjacent foes are set on fire for 3…8…9 seconds.
b454e13aa6e2dbdf6c45b8e53667769bf2f34489.text: 结界咒语。在 7 秒内，你会着火并移动 30…42…45% 更快。当燃烧速度结束时，所有相邻的敌人都会被点燃，持续 3…8…9 秒。

74d357f0b8e26969b0bdc0065ebcbd455afa17b8.source: Stance. For 2…8…10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. When this stance ends, you lose all adrenaline.
74d357f0b8e26969b0bdc0065ebcbd455afa17b8.text: 立场。在 2…8…10 秒内，你可以更快地攻击 33%。当这个姿势结束时，你会失去所有的肾上腺素。

721f2ede77cfe03d86fa16d97345d02978f19e7d.source: Hex Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever target foe uses a shout or chant, that foe takes 30…90…105 damage.
721f2ede77cfe03d86fa16d97345d02978f19e7d.text: 降咒魔法。在 15 秒内，每当目标敌人使用喊叫或圣歌时，该敌人就会受到 30…90…105 伤害。

2a3be11a9cd7066fc648a9c27646f1a6a80ce403.source: Hex Spell. For 3…20…24 seconds, target foe's attacks do +10 damage, but there is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack will be done to that foe instead. (Maximum 15…83…100 damage.)
2a3be11a9cd7066fc648a9c27646f1a6a80ce403.text: 降咒魔法。在 3…20…24 秒内，目标敌人的攻击会造成 +10 伤害，但每次攻击有 50% 的几率对该敌人造成伤害。 （最大伤害为 15…83…100。）

c5d7a48e316b7ed63efb14d752b7a86aed592e95.source: Hex Spell. For 3…10…12 seconds, target foe's attacks do +10 damage, but there is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack will be done to that foe instead. (Maximum 15…51…60 damage.)
c5d7a48e316b7ed63efb14d752b7a86aed592e95.text: 降咒魔法。在 3…10…12 秒内，目标敌人的攻击会造成 +10 伤害，但每次攻击有 50% 的几率对该敌人造成伤害。 （最大伤害为 15…51…60。）

ef30670c4cd614ed4a9b76ea098058a3b6328835.source: Shout. For 30 seconds, your animal companion has a 33% faster attack speed and moves 33% faster.
ef30670c4cd614ed4a9b76ea098058a3b6328835.text: 喊叫。在 30 秒内，你的动物伙伴的攻击速度加快 33%，移动速度加快 33%。

6939c93c16bbfcfac68d5b8b2441e4b338a899db.source: Shout. For 30 seconds, your animal companion has a 25% faster attack speed and moves 25% faster.
6939c93c16bbfcfac68d5b8b2441e4b338a899db.text: 喊叫。在 30 秒内，你的动物伙伴的攻击速度加快 25%，移动速度加快 25%。

2929d689b4f53917546eb14649b707beb05ea260.source: Shout. For 120 seconds, your animal companion has a 5…17…20 base damage reduction.
2929d689b4f53917546eb14649b707beb05ea260.text: 喊叫。在 120 秒内，你的动物伙伴的基础伤害减免为 5…17…20。

dff1c850d72f6d37478803deaabd808c17301fc0.source: Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves 3 times faster and cannot be blocked.
dff1c850d72f6d37478803deaabd808c17301fc0.text: 弓攻击。射出一支移动速度快 3 倍并且无法被阻挡的箭。

e3e34804f70def8b20cbf4adc7c8843c4a5c7562.source: Spell. Target foe and all foes adjacent to your target are Crippled and Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds. Caltrops has half the normal range.
e3e34804f70def8b20cbf4adc7c8843c4a5c7562.text: 咒语。目标敌人和所有与你的目标相邻的敌人都会被削弱并流血，持续 5…13…15 秒。菱角的范围是正常范围的一半。

59bec8dc74410068a2b36160dc923e92ef993758.source: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 20…72…85 lightning damage. If you are holding an item, you gain 7 Energy and 5…41…50 Health.
59bec8dc74410068a2b36160dc923e92ef993758.text: 精英法术。目标敌人受到 20…72…85 闪电伤害。如果您持有物品，您将获得 7 能量和 5…41…50 生命值。

6283363b147ced910188c9b11270ab719ac2b178.source: Signet. Target foe takes 26…50…56 holy damage. If that foe was attacking, you gain 4…12…14 Energy.
6283363b147ced910188c9b11270ab719ac2b178.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 26…50…56 神圣伤害。如果敌人正在攻击，您将获得 4…12…14 能量。

d12be323eb11aa4f8f9ef1d4cf9bf5fb533ce107.source: Elite Signet. All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire "Fire" is capitalized, unlike other descriptions which state "set on fire" for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.
d12be323eb11aa4f8f9ef1d4cf9bf5fb533ce107.text: 精英图章。所有队员失去一切条件。你着火了 “Fire”是大写的，与其他描述不同的是，对于以这种方式删除的每个条件，“着火”为 1 秒。

c67ff3545dc5c0cc29c1913b58e9f97d510a56ba.source: Spell. Target foe and up to two other foes near your target are struck for 10…70…85 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
c67ff3545dc5c0cc29c1913b58e9f97d510a56ba.text: 咒语。目标敌人和目标附近最多两个敌人会受到 10…70…85 闪电伤害。该法术具有 25% 护甲穿透力。

d61b7cca6d46d753f067d3328156eca0b6251ef1.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5…77…95 lightning damage. That foe is struck for an additional 5…29…35 lightning damage if you are holding an item.
d61b7cca6d46d753f067d3328156eca0b6251ef1.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 5…77…95 闪电伤害。如果您持有物品，该敌人会受到额外的 5…29…35 闪电伤害。

e9a5a70e07d61d559c801750da3c11fe4e9e8974.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…46…56 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for each foe in the area.
e9a5a70e07d61d559c801750da3c11fe4e9e8974.text: 结界咒语。在 8…46…56 秒内，每当你施展法术时，你都会为该区域中的每个敌人获得 1 能量。

92a97ab2291f220d8ab854650da4b4cd1a4e853e.source: Spell. Create a Chaos Storm at target foe's location that lasts for 10 seconds. Each second, foes adjacent to this location take 5…21…25 damage and lose 0…2…2 Energy.
92a97ab2291f220d8ab854650da4b4cd1a4e853e.text: 咒语。在目标敌人所在位置制造持续 10 秒的混沌风暴。每秒，邻近该位置的敌人都会受到 5…21…25 伤害并失去 0…2…2 能量。

e51f770639d5cd2c7a2dcb4c296cc4090d5e0d7e.source: Elite Stance. For 1…8…10 seconds, you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10…74…90 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
e51f770639d5cd2c7a2dcb4c296cc4090d5e0d7e.text: 精英姿态。对于 1…8…10 秒，您可以更快地运行 33%。你的下一次成功的近战攻击会造成 +10…74…90 伤害，并且该姿势结束。如果你使用了技能，这个姿势就会结束。

a37e4b1d2115147d3838aba8189ea39eb7d2605d.source: Elite Stance. For 1…8…10 seconds, you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10…66…80 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
a37e4b1d2115147d3838aba8189ea39eb7d2605d.text: 精英姿态。对于 1…8…10 秒，您可以更快地运行 33%。你的下一次成功的近战攻击会造成 +10…66…80 伤害，并且该姿态结束。如果你使用了技能，这个姿势就会结束。

38499911fc9b0af8bdbb87e17081eb6c60391825.source: Skill. Charm target animal. Once charmed, your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped. You cannot charm an animal that is more than 4 levels above you.
38499911fc9b0af8bdbb87e17081eb6c60391825.text: 技能。魅惑目标动物。一旦被魅惑，只要您装备了魅惑动物，您的动物伙伴就会与您同行。你无法魅惑等级高于你 4 的动物。

c7f2ab172fe2f64c1e74476ecd247197a4d32417.source: Skill. Your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped and have at least 8 points in Beast Mastery.
c7f2ab172fe2f64c1e74476ecd247197a4d32417.text: 技能。只要您装备了魅力动物并且在野兽掌握中拥有至少 8 点，您的动物伙伴就会与您同行。

740d30ced50b36395e99cb65b04fe2d2de73519e.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits a foe with Cracked Armor, that foe suffers a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
740d30ced50b36395e99cb65b04fe2d2de73519e.text: 长矛攻击。如果此攻击击中装甲破裂的敌人，则该敌人会受到深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

acb32ef316de419b7a5c51b0bec17b00b885895f.source: Spell. You become Poisoned for 10 seconds. Foes in the area of your target are struck for 10…37…44 cold damage and lose 1…2…2 enchantments.
acb32ef316de419b7a5c51b0bec17b00b885895f.text: 咒语。你中毒 10 秒。目标区域内的敌人会受到 10…37…44 寒冷伤害并失去 1…2…2 结界。

7f60fbeb1e9ff44b061b4c887b79e93b4d3cea11.source: Scythe Attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +3…13…15 damage. For each foe hit who has less Health than you, that foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10…26…30 cold damage.
7f60fbeb1e9ff44b061b4c887b79e93b4d3cea11.text: 镰刀攻击。如果击中，该攻击会造成 +3…13…15 伤害。对于生命值低于你的每个被击中的敌人，该敌人和所有相邻的敌人都会受到 10…26…30 寒冷伤害。

a1b8b57ca1992d2778b2e862bd3f7c7cdb7c63f5.source: Hex Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30…54…60 cold damage. For 10 seconds, the next Water Magic hex targeting a hexed foe lasts 25…85…100% longer.
a1b8b57ca1992d2778b2e862bd3f7c7cdb7c63f5.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人和所有邻近敌人都会受到 30…54…60 寒冷伤害。在 10 秒内，针对施咒敌人的下一个水魔法咒语持续时间更长 25…85…100%。

1cf71a18c708ad62c4e2b75dd9d93da6352f4fdd.source: Preparation. For 1…10…12 seconds, your arrows deal 1…7…8 more damage and spread Choking Gas to all adjacent foes on impact. Choking Gas interrupts foes attempting to cast spells.
1cf71a18c708ad62c4e2b75dd9d93da6352f4fdd.text: 准备。在 1…10…12 秒内，你的箭会造成 1…7…8 更多伤害，并将窒息气体传播到撞击时的所有相邻敌人。窒息气体会打断试图施展法术的敌人。

9822654fb86ade626999cd684be92fbccd14fe8b.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a shout or chant, that ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health.
9822654fb86ade626999cd684be92fbccd14fe8b.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，下次每个在听力范围内的盟友使用喊叫或圣歌时，该盟友就会获得 30…78…90 生命值的治疗。

1570d2b6c1e673e8f0ff50526850c68d75743b2d.source: Spell. Create Churning Earth at target foe's location. For the next 5 seconds, Churning Earth strikes foes near that location for 10…34…40 earth damage each second. Any foe moving faster than normal when struck by Churning Earth is knocked down.
1570d2b6c1e673e8f0ff50526850c68d75743b2d.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置制造搅拌地球。在接下来的 5 秒内，搅拌地球每秒攻击该位置附近的敌人，造成 10…34…40 地球伤害。任何移动速度比正常速度更快的敌人在被搅动地球击中时都会被击倒。

07b5002c374063bce55e9b55f3c75ff2dc93c46f.source: Elite Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes take 10…54…65 lightning damage. If you are within earshot of a spirit or holding a bundle item, you gain 10 Energy.
07b5002c374063bce55e9b55f3c75ff2dc93c46f.text: 精英法术。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会受到 10…54…65 闪电伤害。如果您在灵魂的听力范围内或持有捆绑物品，您将获得 10 能量。

96e640e148251060e28db3ac5b25a2e7b5c1fd42.source: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
96e640e148251060e28db3ac5b25a2e7b5c1fd42.text: 精英斧头攻击。如果这次攻击击中，你会造成 +10…34…40 伤害，并对 1…2…2 相邻敌人造成 10…34…40 斩击伤害。

00e74ad05a4b733b3c575e30156d46bb5867688f.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +6…9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). If target foe is non-human it is knocked down.
00e74ad05a4b733b3c575e30156d46bb5867688f.text: 近战攻击。如果此攻击命中，则会对每个相邻敌人造成 +6…9 伤害（最大 60 伤害）。如果目标敌人是非人类，它就会被击倒。

3b7a99c631d5467632c22ad6af56d2680aed1a1c.source: Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, target and adjacent foes are hexed with Clumsiness. The next time each foe attacks, the attack is interrupted and that foe suffers 10…66…80 damage.
3b7a99c631d5467632c22ad6af56d2680aed1a1c.text: 降咒魔法。在 4 秒内，目标和邻近的敌人会受到笨拙的咒语。每个敌人下次攻击时，攻击都会被打断，并且该敌人会受到 10…66…80 伤害。

1f0e0dee3939b79b68155d445d0be567d702b572.source: Skill. You heal your animal companion for 40…104…120 Health. If your companion is dead, it is resurrected with 10…48…58% Health. If you have Comfort Animal equipped, your animal companion will travel with you.
1f0e0dee3939b79b68155d445d0be567d702b572.text: 技能。你治愈你的动物伙伴的健康，获得 40…104…120 的健康。如果你的同伴死了，它会以 10…48…58% 生命值复活。如果您配备了舒适动物，您的动物伙伴将与您同行。

615e2b74da80defe964187f531976a06a1a5fe98.source: Skill. If you have less Health than your pet, you are healed for 30…102…120 Health. If your pet has less Health than you, it is healed for 30…102…120 Health.
615e2b74da80defe964187f531976a06a1a5fe98.text: 技能。如果您的生命值低于您的宠物，您的生命值将得到 30…102…120 的治疗。如果你的宠物的生命值低于你，它的生命值会得到 30…102…120 的治疗。

fe2047a8d9911a1a44173835985584f50643fed7.source: Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that skill is interrupted and disabled for target foe and all foes in the area for an additional 5…11…12 seconds.
fe2047a8d9911a1a44173835985584f50643fed7.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在使用某项技能，则该技能会被打断，并且对目标敌人和该区域中的所有敌人禁用，持续 5…11…12 秒。

7ca0ce3a6547adb61dcdada43f01e703f5fff808.source: Bow Attack. If Concussion Shot hits while target foe is casting a spell, the spell is interrupted and your target is Dazed for 5…17…20 seconds. This attack deals only 1…13…16 damage.
7ca0ce3a6547adb61dcdada43f01e703f5fff808.text: 弓攻击。如果目标敌人正在施法时震荡射击击中，则该法术会被打断，并且你的目标会晕眩 5…17…20 秒。该攻击仅造成 1…13…16 伤害。

2cb4d445591b77c9b5c05339fe8923fc15c2e612.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all arrows that hit strike for fire damage. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
2cb4d445591b77c9b5c05339fe8923fc15c2e612.text: 自然仪式。打造1…8…10级精神。对于其射程内的非灵体生物，所有命中的箭都会造成火焰伤害。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

46373e50fd81412417690704407df9c1b294f107.source: Hex Spell. For 2…8…10 seconds, target foe takes twice as long to activate non-attack skills.
46373e50fd81412417690704407df9c1b294f107.text: 降咒魔法。在 2…8…10 秒内，目标敌人需要两倍的时间来激活非攻击技能。

9b0a922a663cacb8a52bb29a09538afd494b9cfa.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a fire weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5…17…20 fire damage.
9b0a922a663cacb8a52bb29a09538afd494b9cfa.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，如果你使用火焰武器，你的攻击会造成额外的 5…17…20 火焰伤害。

7441050b346b93082e2108c24281811d87608b69.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a cold weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5…17…20 cold damage.
7441050b346b93082e2108c24281811d87608b69.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，如果你使用冷武器，你的攻击会造成额外的 5…17…20 冷伤害。

786345264a7c9cfce4883df1d601bfb8c191a913.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a lightning weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5…17…20 lightning damage.
786345264a7c9cfce4883df1d601bfb8c191a913.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，如果你使用闪电武器，你的攻击会造成额外的 5…17…20 闪电伤害。

0d764c27a5684ed813a75b0e120c87820e88a9d3.source: Hex Spell. For 2…13…16 seconds, target foe suffers -8 Health degeneration.
0d764c27a5684ed813a75b0e120c87820e88a9d3.text: 降咒魔法。在 2…13…16 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -8 生命值退化。

e1cab6c2af46c4ffcc0a0785bf9b5fcb8c9fff7f.source: Hex Spell. For 4…15…18 seconds, target foe experiences -5 Health degeneration.
e1cab6c2af46c4ffcc0a0785bf9b5fcb8c9fff7f.text: 降咒魔法。在 4…15…18 秒内，目标敌人经历 -5 生命值退化。

6a96ad56f6b447457aa8109aff7a45beb1b6fcdb.source: Spell. Exploit a random corpse. You teleport to that corpse's location and gain 25…85…100 Health and 5…17…20 Energy.
6a96ad56f6b447457aa8109aff7a45beb1b6fcdb.text: 咒语。利用随机尸体。您传送到该尸体的位置并获得 25…85…100 生命值和 5…17…20 能量。

b7a4a100d1a423361bd76f5d03e7aef9d2b46264.source: Elite Spell. You steal 5…57…70 Health from target foe. All hostile summoned creatures in earshot of that foe take 25…105…125 damage.
b7a4a100d1a423361bd76f5d03e7aef9d2b46264.text: 精英法术。你从目标敌人那里偷取 5…57…70 生命值。该敌人听力范围内的所有敌对召唤生物都会受到 25…105…125 伤害。

e9bb9ccfbb74620601d44864cba299b889a74279.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you suffer from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that same condition and you sacrifice 10…6…5% maximum Health.
e9bb9ccfbb74620601d44864cba299b889a74279.text: 精英结界法术。在 60 秒内，每当你遭受新的状况时，该区域中的所有敌人都会遭受相同的状况，并且你牺牲 10…6…5% 最大生命值。

a90f49a8529d3319fdd364aad01405eced8f365f.source: Skill. Lose all enchantments. For each one lost, you gain 0…64…80 Health, lose one hex, and lose one condition (maximum 1…7…8 hexes and conditions).
a90f49a8529d3319fdd364aad01405eced8f365f.text: 技能。失去所有结界。每失去一个，你就会获得 0…64…80 生命值，失去一个降咒，并失去一个条件（最多 1…7…8 降咒和条件）。

870165172b5b5c6af7ceb6a65cc1269e1d15d037.source: Spell. Remove all hexes from target other ally. For 8…18…20 seconds, that ally gains +10 armor for each Necromancer hex that was removed.
870165172b5b5c6af7ceb6a65cc1269e1d15d037.text: 咒语。移除目标其他盟友的所有六角形。在 8…18…20 秒内，该盟友为每个被移除的死灵法师六角体获得 +10 护甲值。

f30a38622b39dc96193ede9bd4091c2ae9034954.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you gain +10 armor if you have a condition and gain 1…3…3 Health regen for each condition you are suffering from. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of 1…2…2 conditions.
f30a38622b39dc96193ede9bd4091c2ae9034954.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 10 秒内，如果您有某种状况，您将获得 +10 护甲，并为您所遭受的每种状况获得 1…3…3 生命恢复。当此结界结束时，你的 1…2…2 病症就会痊愈。

4816a9a5b61627aacf83d639c96614f5d7c0c90a.source: Elite Hex Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed in this way, that foe suffers from -1…7…8 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
4816a9a5b61627aacf83d639c96614f5d7c0c90a.text: 精英六角咒语。移除目标敌人的一项结界。如果以这种方式移除结界，该敌人将遭受 -1…7…8 生命值退化，持续 10 秒。

6de52045a7b3b5db976aa841bc12a4ce759da1d7.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits an attacking foe, that foe is knocked down.
6de52045a7b3b5db976aa841bc12a4ce759da1d7.text: 锤子攻击。如果此攻击击中攻击敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

95fb426e88a3a52c876f4a5ebc29c427fe05ec6b.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5…29…35 damage. If you hit an attacking foe, you gain 2…5…6 Energy.
95fb426e88a3a52c876f4a5ebc29c427fe05ec6b.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +5…29…35 伤害。如果您击中攻击的敌人，您将获得 2…5…6 能量。

6a1a2e6a57ab34991b9df32aa0ad068e080806f3.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves and attacks 50% slower and suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration.
6a1a2e6a57ab34991b9df32aa0ad068e080806f3.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标移动和攻击 50% 的速度变慢，并遭受 -1…7…8 生命值退化。

db30bda8ceea7fc852a7ee91386a74af08ff80da.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves 50% slower and suffers -2…5…6 Health degeneration.
db30bda8ceea7fc852a7ee91386a74af08ff80da.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标移动 50% 的速度变慢，并遭受 -2…5…6 生命值退化。

84d332909e1b5546ad4f895f68dbe1eb42c487cc.source: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot causes Crippling for 5…13…15 seconds.
84d332909e1b5546ad4f895f68dbe1eb42c487cc.text: 精英圣歌。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个攻击技能会造成 5…13…15 秒的瘫痪。

0527895bdb1a7009b7ff48d8781a8ec0fa489beb.source: Spell. Send out a Crippling Dagger at target foe. Crippling Dagger strikes for 15…51…60 earth damage if it hits, and Cripples moving foes for 3…13…15 seconds. This spell has half the normal range.
0527895bdb1a7009b7ff48d8781a8ec0fa489beb.text: 咒语。向目标敌人发射一把致残匕首。致残匕首击中后会造成 15…51…60 土属性伤害，并使移动中的敌人致残 3…13…15 秒。该法术的射程只有正常范围的一半。

2ecd108059334bcdde4bd2568274153da17ae07e.source: Elite Bow Attack. If Crippling Shot hits, your target becomes Crippled for 4…12…14 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
2ecd108059334bcdde4bd2568274153da17ae07e.text: 精英弓攻击。如果致残射击命中，您的目标会致残 4…12…14 秒。此攻击无法被阻止。

3cfe7cfd31792fe7c408e92e88a079a799dd4c28.source: Elite Sword Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Crippled for 5…13…15 seconds and begins Bleeding for 10…22…25 seconds.
3cfe7cfd31792fe7c408e92e88a079a799dd4c28.text: 精英剑攻击。如果这次攻击击中，目标敌人会瘫痪 5…13…15 秒，并开始流血 10…22…25 秒。

3a48d127ed196a60a43592553c7bac88ca88543b.source: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3…10…12 seconds. This skill deals +3…13…15 extra damage if that foe is moving.
3a48d127ed196a60a43592553c7bac88ca88543b.text: 镰刀攻击。如果此攻击击中敌人，则该敌人会瘫痪 3…10…12 秒。如果敌人正在移动，该技能会造成 +3…13…15 额外伤害。

f965028e0906781fee47673743cbf9ace9ddf036.source: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3…7…8 seconds. If you have more Health than target foe, all adjacent foes take 10…26…30 earth damage.
f965028e0906781fee47673743cbf9ace9ddf036.text: 镰刀攻击。如果此攻击击中敌人，则该敌人会瘫痪 3…7…8 秒。如果你的生命值高于目标敌人，则所有相邻敌人都会受到 10…26…30 土系伤害。

5a85162371ca2cbe8d6ef6d71ad8e2c593f70bc2.source: Enchantment Spell. For 4 seconds and 1 second for each rank of Critical Strikes, you attack 33% faster and gain +15…25 armor. This skill reapplies itself every time you land a critical hit.
5a85162371ca2cbe8d6ef6d71ad8e2c593f70bc2.text: 结界咒语。对于每个等级的致命一击，持续 4 秒和 1 秒，你可以更快地攻击 33% 并获得 +15…25 护甲。每次你受到重击时，该技能都会重新应用。

996378f3fb8bce0b30c4b9a3250ae8ddb58ce424.source: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you inflict +5…17…20 damage. If this attack results in a critical hit, target foe is interrupted.
996378f3fb8bce0b30c4b9a3250ae8ddb58ce424.text: 斧头攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果这次攻击造成重击，目标敌人就会被打断。

8490f5a4521c01bdbb19646ce21dcca597e39e50.source: Enchantment Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. Critical Defenses refreshes every time you land a critical hit.
8490f5a4521c01bdbb19646ce21dcca597e39e50.text: 结界咒语。在 4…9…10 秒内，你有 75% 的机会进行阻挡。每当你受到致命一击时，致命一击防御就会刷新。

0e9e37ec855f5fa3baa8fa406f4711aa8ab122a7.source: Skill. For 10…30…35 seconds, you have an additional 3…13…15% chance to land a critical hit when attacking. You gain 1 Energy whenever you score a critical hit.
0e9e37ec855f5fa3baa8fa406f4711aa8ab122a7.text: 技能。在 10…30…35 秒内，你在攻击时有额外的 3…13…15% 机会造成暴击。每当你获得重击时，你就会获得 1 能量。

f74a07d94ff8ab1273f37482a03dc72965e84984.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10…26…30 damage, results in a critical hit, and you gain 1…3…3 Energy.
f74a07d94ff8ab1273f37482a03dc72965e84984.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，该攻击会造成 +10…26…30 伤害，造成致命一击，并且你获得 1…3…3 能量。

af140b80bbee6cdf24dd577e8021f293c849850d.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits target foe, it deals +5…17…20 damage. If that foe is near any of your allies, this attack cannot be blocked.
af140b80bbee6cdf24dd577e8021f293c849850d.text: 弓攻击。如果此攻击击中目标敌人，则会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果该敌人靠近您的任何盟友，则无法阻止此攻击。

a2c094aebdda7bd64738a3b1ab3e9145d910b7af.source: Hammer Attack. Attack all adjacent foes. Each foe you hit is struck for +1…16…20 damage.
a2c094aebdda7bd64738a3b1ab3e9145d910b7af.text: 锤子攻击。攻击所有邻近的敌人。你击中的每个敌人都会受到 +1…16…20 伤害。

58a284ecd8263b3e0041330b822c8ee03d576777.source: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…42…50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
58a284ecd8263b3e0041330b822c8ee03d576777.text: 精英长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +10…42…50 伤害。如果它击中不动的目标，你会造成深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

f47550a2d775ba3c831bee35d544b1250117fefd.source: Item Spell. Hold Daoshen's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, all Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. When you drop his ashes, all nearby foes are struck for 15…71…85 lightning damage.
f47550a2d775ba3c831bee35d544b1250117fefd.text: 物品法术。持有道神骨灰最多15…51…60秒。当你持有他的骨灰时，所有仪式者技能都有10%护甲穿透。当你撒下他的骨灰时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 15…71…85 闪电伤害。

53121a68deaa27473b4701d59e65a32586c73f15.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +1…16…20 damage. If you hit a knocked-down foe you inflict a Deep Wound, lowering your target's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.
53121a68deaa27473b4701d59e65a32586c73f15.text: 锤子攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +1…16…20 伤害。如果你击中被击倒的敌人，你会造成深度伤害，使目标的最大生命值降低 20%，持续 5…17…20 秒。

7b41f6a72a60ead363e32bfe96e866713fc72fa7.source: Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted and suffer 15…63…75 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.
7b41f6a72a60ead363e32bfe96e866713fc72fa7.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在使用技能，则该敌人和该区域中的所有敌人都会被打断并受到 15…63…75 伤害，并且该区域中的敌人会受到 75% 的伤害。

437ddaa9a4aae0bb6ac93057acc439de32ba6ebc.source: Spell. Interrupt target foe's skill. If that foe was suffering from a Mesmer hex, that foe and all foes in the area take 25…50 damage and have 3…5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
437ddaa9a4aae0bb6ac93057acc439de32ba6ebc.text: 咒语。打断目标敌人的技能。如果该敌人正在遭受催眠术，则该敌人以及该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 25…50 伤害，并在 10 秒内造成 3…5 生命值退化。

f4c1b88527856f91d28cbaa472879add19be4efd.source: Spell. Foes adjacent to you are struck for 10…58…70 damage but are cured of any negative conditions. Each condition removed deals 5…13…15 damage.
f4c1b88527856f91d28cbaa472879add19be4efd.text: 咒语。与你相邻的敌人会受到 10…58…70 伤害，但任何负面状况都会被治愈。每个移除的条件都会造成 5…13…15 伤害。

b191e5a7d3e65a25dbb18984dc8588f42cd95fbc.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds and 3 seconds longer for every rank of Soul Reaping, your Necromancer spells cost -1…5…6 Energy to cast but you suffer from Bleeding for 10 seconds each time you cast a Necromancer spell.
b191e5a7d3e65a25dbb18984dc8588f42cd95fbc.text: 精英结界法术。每等级的灵魂收割，持续 5 秒和 3 秒，你的死灵法师法术需要消耗 -1…5…6 能量来施放，但每次你施放死灵法师法术时，你都会流血 10 秒。

f6d08207ef960c86647dc0d627989fa6205d9b0a.source: Spell. Remove one Hex from target ally. If a Hex was removed, that ally is healed for 30…86…100 Health.
f6d08207ef960c86647dc0d627989fa6205d9b0a.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个降咒。如果妖术被移除，该盟友的生命值将得到 30…86…100 的治疗。

75a81bfb153abbfb636d1d02b9f0b8b3260ff619.source: Axe Attack. Perform a spinning axe attack striking for +4…10…12 damage to all adjacent opponents.
75a81bfb153abbfb636d1d02b9f0b8b3260ff619.text: 斧头攻击。对所有相邻对手进行旋转斧头攻击，造成 +4…10…12 伤害。

c196860093724cc43242e338cf500d8f81cb221d.source: Spell. Send out three Dancing Daggers at target foe, each striking for 5…29…35 earth damage if they hit. Dancing Daggers has half the normal range. This skill counts as a lead attack.
c196860093724cc43242e338cf500d8f81cb221d.text: 咒语。向目标敌人发射三把舞动匕首，每击中都会造成 5…29…35 土属性伤害。舞动匕首的射程只有正常射程的一半。该技能算作主攻。

9248a7ca7d612915afca77e1917bd5778562aa9a.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3…14…17 seconds, every time you successfully land a critical hit, you remove one enchantment from your target. If you remove an enchantment in this way, you lose 10…4…3 Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.
9248a7ca7d612915afca77e1917bd5778562aa9a.text: 精英结界法术。在 3…14…17 秒内，每次你成功击中致命一击，你就会从目标身上移除一个结界。如果你以这种方式移除结界，你会失去 10…4…3 能量或黑暗叛教结束。

09aaaf0a229a3e2489c59e0b3367faa9bc02b233.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, whenever target ally sacrifices Health, Dark Aura deals 5…41…50 shadow damage to adjacent foes, and you lose 5…17…20 Health.
09aaaf0a229a3e2489c59e0b3367faa9bc02b233.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，每当目标盟友牺牲生命值时，黑暗光环会对相邻敌人造成 5…41…50 暗影伤害，并且你失去 5…17…20 生命值。

bf3b57325808ec53f840695c85cfedeb26bf4bf8.source: Enchantment Spell. For the next 30…54…60 seconds, whenever you receive damage, your closest minion suffers 75% of that damage for you.
bf3b57325808ec53f840695c85cfedeb26bf4bf8.text: 结界咒语。在接下来的 30…54…60 秒内，每当你受到伤害时，你最近的随从都会为你承受 75% 的伤害。

233986994ac3b53ec4ae8cb0428844741f329cab.source: Stance. For 5…13…15 seconds, you move 25% faster and take half damage. Dark Escape ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
233986994ac3b53ec4ae8cb0428844741f329cab.text: 立场。在 5…13…15 秒内，你移动 25% 的速度更快并受到一半的伤害。如果你成功攻击，黑暗逃脱就会结束。

bd8c5546212253b8d13410cc937beedfe3c63dda.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever any party member hits with an attack, that party member gains one hit of adrenaline. (50% failure chance with Blood Magic of 4 or less.)
bd8c5546212253b8d13410cc937beedfe3c63dda.text: 结界咒语。在 5 秒内，每当任何队员发起攻击时，该队员都会获得一击肾上腺素。 （血魔法的 50% 失败几率为 4 或更少。）

e47bdfea77710af9a6b595fcf742711d9cbcebc2.source: Spell. Deal 20…52…60 shadow damage to target foe.
e47bdfea77710af9a6b595fcf742711d9cbcebc2.text: 咒语。对目标敌人造成 20…52…60 暗影伤害。

762398d204baa75363015ebfe6040eddc26aca8c.source: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. For 1…5…6 seconds, that foe moves 33% slower.
762398d204baa75363015ebfe6040eddc26aca8c.text: 降咒魔法。暗影步瞄准敌人。在 1…5…6 秒内，该敌人的移动速度变慢 33%。

c531c865744636a17b9f83a4fae7b301bc2dd294.source: Stance. For 3 seconds, you run 50% faster.
c531c865744636a17b9f83a4fae7b301bc2dd294.text: 立场。对于 3 秒，您可以更快地运行 50%。

c2718e4ab36656557eef7f03e038cbd372b6d6e7.source: Stance. For 3 seconds, you run 50% faster. Every 2 points in Shadow Arts lowers recharge by 1 second (max 6 seconds).
c2718e4ab36656557eef7f03e038cbd372b6d6e7.text: 立场。对于 3 秒，您可以更快地运行 50%。暗影艺术中的每个 2 点都会减少 1 秒的充能（最多 6 秒）。

b28f37ba3c4b9495727b6ea89c20bdfabb14821e.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, half-ranged spells cast 5…41…50% faster and recharge 5…49…60% faster.
b28f37ba3c4b9495727b6ea89c20bdfabb14821e.text: 结界咒语。在 10…30…35 秒内，半程法术施放 5…41…50% 的速度更快，充能 5…49…60% 的速度更快。

272b5696f1e3bfd80d0e062f61f83a894860050a.source: Stance. All of your attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds. For 5…13…15 seconds, your Assassin skills activate and recharge 33% faster.
272b5696f1e3bfd80d0e062f61f83a894860050a.text: 立场。你的所有攻击技能都会被禁用 10 秒。在 5…13…15 秒内，你的刺客技能激活和充能速度会更快 33%。

b21cfec40cac3b49eb7ec798f3547811285dc8f7.source: Skill. For 8 seconds, while you have a sword equipped, you block the next melee attack against you, and your attacker is struck for 15…75…90 damage and begins Bleeding for 3…21…25 seconds.
b21cfec40cac3b49eb7ec798f3547811285dc8f7.text: 技能。在 8 秒内，当你装备剑时，你会阻挡对你的下一次近战攻击，并且你的攻击者会受到 15…75…90 伤害并开始流血 3…21…25 秒。

d28a0823e737ce336be6fb2aceeb9288cd17ba89.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Death Blossom strikes target foe for +20…40…45 damage and all adjacent foes take 20…40…45 damage.
d28a0823e737ce336be6fb2aceeb9288cd17ba89.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，死亡之花会对目标敌人造成 +20…40…45 伤害，并且所有相邻敌人受到 20…40…45 伤害。

0e63546614f555a11df3bc9ee74d30e0eae5a76f.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, if target ally dies, all adjacent foes take 26…85…100 damage and are Poisoned for 15 seconds.
0e63546614f555a11df3bc9ee74d30e0eae5a76f.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，如果目标盟友死亡，所有相邻敌人都会受到 26…85…100 伤害并中毒 15 秒。

12855b510c6fb8fb6b94c3042be3fd2fd69eae12.source: Signet. Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 15…83…100% Energy. The next time that ally dies within 120 seconds, so do you.
12855b510c6fb8fb6b94c3042be3fd2fd69eae12.text: 印章。使用您当前的生命值和 15…83…100% 能量复活目标队员。下次该盟友在 120 秒内死亡时，你也会死亡。

8045a96ea362a92d54f055bb43d2328188e60528.source: Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. If that foe has more Health than you, you are healed for 65…173…200.
8045a96ea362a92d54f055bb43d2328188e60528.text: 咒语。暗影步瞄准敌人。如果那个敌人的生命值比你多，你就会得到 65…173…200 的治疗。

910ceab38a2879b483c7b7cad3aee61f73505519.source: Spell. Shadow Step to target ally. If you have less Health than that ally, you gain 40…112…130 Health.
910ceab38a2879b483c7b7cad3aee61f73505519.text: 咒语。暗影步瞄准盟友。如果您的生命值低于该盟友，您将获得 40…112…130 生命值。

aad1ae13192d6453f74eeb792773b89967c71034.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5…41…50 cold damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you deal an additional 5…41…50 shadow damage.
aad1ae13192d6453f74eeb792773b89967c71034.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 5…41…50 寒冷伤害。如果该敌人的生命值高于 50%，你会造成额外的 5…41…50 暗影伤害。

a4e921e00fefd3cc15c05bc6c885390da64db005.source: Spell. Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and strikes for 30…78…90 cold damage on up to three targets in the area.
a4e921e00fefd3cc15c05bc6c885390da64db005.text: 咒语。死亡虫群缓慢飞出，对区域内最多三个目标造成 30…78…90 寒冷伤害。

d690a27141de55d7d4bb3f37c149812ebab445ce.source: Bow Attack. If Debilitating Shot hits, your target loses 1…8…10 Energy.
d690a27141de55d7d4bb3f37c149812ebab445ce.text: 弓攻击。如果衰弱射击命中，你的目标会失去 1…8…10 能量。

f192f465b8de951f16c52bc452747f82e5456505.source: Elite Axe Attack. You lose all adrenaline and all Energy. This attack is unblockable, you deal +5…65…80 damage and cause a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds. This attack is always critical and if foe is killed, nearby foes are Weakened for 8 seconds.
f192f465b8de951f16c52bc452747f82e5456505.text: 精英斧头攻击。你失去了所有的肾上腺素和所有的能量。此攻击无法阻挡，你会造成 +5…65…80 伤害并造成深度伤口，持续 5…17…20 秒。这种攻击总是至关重要的，如果敌人被杀死，附近的敌人就会被削弱 8 秒。

62d9c45bd93dcd5ff712bbe647d8cf22fb2d6462.source: Hex Spell. You cause a Deep Freeze at target foe's location. All foes in this area are struck for 10…70…85 cold damage, and for 10 seconds, they move 66% slower.
62d9c45bd93dcd5ff712bbe647d8cf22fb2d6462.text: 降咒魔法。你对目标敌人的位置造成深度冻结。该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 10…70…85 寒冷伤害，并且在 10 秒内，他们的移动速度会变慢 66%。

558713dcf1e9336c2bac50d04dc792b9f76debf5.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10…26…30 seconds, whenever target foe hits with an attack, you gain 2 Energy.
558713dcf1e9336c2bac50d04dc792b9f76debf5.text: 精英六角咒语。在 10…26…30 秒内，每当目标敌人受到攻击时，你都会获得 2 能量。

28f21086986e9b85ac47090c48f71720302ba08e.source: Elite Chant. For 4…9…10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.
28f21086986e9b85ac47090c48f71720302ba08e.text: 精英圣歌。在 4…9…10 秒内，听力范围内的每个队员都有 50% 的机会阻止传入的攻击。如果该队员使用攻击技能命中，则此吟唱结束。

61f5ccb61d5eb9fbc0c818823e6ec5b4593f3c6a.source: Stance. For 1…4…5 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks. When Defensive Stance ends, you gain one strike of adrenaline for each melee attack skill you have (maximum 0…3…4).
61f5ccb61d5eb9fbc0c818823e6ec5b4593f3c6a.text: 立场。在 1…4…5 秒内，你有 75% 机会阻挡近战和投射物攻击。当防御姿态结束时，你拥有的每一项近战攻击技能都会获得一次肾上腺素打击（最多 0…3…4）。

51b8753d94a47f2daa6f4859ea620eb15d080f60.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Xinrae's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you cannot lose more than 20% of your max Health from a single hit. When you drop her ashes, you steal 5…41…50 Health from all nearby foes.
51b8753d94a47f2daa6f4859ea620eb15d080f60.text: 精英物品法术。保留 Xinrae 的骨灰最多 15…51…60 秒。当你持有她的骨灰时，单次命中你的最大生命值损失不会超过 20%。当你撒下她的骨灰时，你会从附近所有敌人那里窃取 5…41…50 生命值。

5c4b47dfb54b0a0fda57fc9277003bf7199b6027.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, the next time target foe blocks, that foe takes 30…102…120 damage.
5c4b47dfb54b0a0fda57fc9277003bf7199b6027.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，下次目标敌人格挡时，该敌人会受到 30…102…120 伤害。

cf47cd01788a4f425da1c63cc028bdfed9c94fa9.source: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes take 6…49…60 shadow damage and 4…17…20 shadow damage for each enchantment on them.
cf47cd01788a4f425da1c63cc028bdfed9c94fa9.text: 咒语。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人因其身上的每个结界而受到 6…49…60 暗影伤害和 4…17…20 暗影伤害。

36f6c62f5eb4dc001e3943865644e7fc219151f4.source: Hex Spell. For 5…29…35 seconds, target foe gains only two-thirds Health from healing.
36f6c62f5eb4dc001e3943865644e7fc219151f4.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…29…35 秒内，目标敌人仅从治疗中获得三分之二的生命值。

a4db0f92b77b07deacc9f7c5710c629a385f723f.source: Stance. For 1…5…6 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block attacks. If you block a projectile attack, adjacent foes suffer from Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds.
a4db0f92b77b07deacc9f7c5710c629a385f723f.text: 立场。在 1…5…6 秒内，你有 75% 机会阻止攻击。如果你格挡射弹攻击，相邻敌人会流血 5…13…15 秒。

d69a0dc48cd30e7ede28a490cb7558f131cbc4b0.source: Ranged Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes 18…30 damage. If that foe has Cracked Armor, it begins Bleeding for 18…30 seconds.
d69a0dc48cd30e7ede28a490cb7558f131cbc4b0.text: 远程攻击。如果此攻击命中，目标敌人将受到 18…30 伤害。如果该敌人的护甲破裂，它就会开始流血 18…30 秒。

0bd0f8999419ea7f354ecfb039a5a1723ae34b58.source: Elite Skill. For 20 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health, an additional 20 armor, and you take -1…8…10 less damage.
0bd0f8999419ea7f354ecfb039a5a1723ae34b58.text: 精英技能。在 20 秒内，你拥有额外的 90…258…300 生命值、额外的 20 护甲，并且你受到的伤害更少 -1…8…10。

4dc0ce1ca119177f80f28b21fbae5fd092c61fac.source: Elite Stance. For 20 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health and an additional 20 armor.
4dc0ce1ca119177f80f28b21fbae5fd092c61fac.text: 精英姿态。在 20 秒内，您拥有额外的 90…258…300 生命值和额外的 20 护甲。

6a51c1c3b9a783f8ea4731cd1fd7989f8d804913.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30…54…60 seconds, whenever you use a skill that targets a foe, you deal 5…17…20 shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.
6a51c1c3b9a783f8ea4731cd1fd7989f8d804913.text: 结界咒语。在 30…54…60 秒内，每当你使用针对敌人的技能时，你都会对与你相邻的所有其他敌人造成 5…17…20 暗影伤害。

480be9399c79fae334351640cb833a82a8f577c6.source: Spell. Remove one hex from target ally and one additional hex for each recharging Divine Favor skill you have.
480be9399c79fae334351640cb833a82a8f577c6.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形，并为你拥有的每一个充电神圣恩惠技能额外移除一个六角形。

0c2f7cfed7199e32bdf63c49d452f571557b1be7.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, that foe and one nearby foe lose 1…4…5 Energy.
0c2f7cfed7199e32bdf63c49d452f571557b1be7.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，每当目标敌人施展法术时，该敌人和附近的一名敌人就会失去 1…4…5 能量。

ac82549535e3f043083af331c82f751b5a9dab6f.source: Lead Attack. If you have less than 50…74…80% Health, you deal +15…51…60 damage.
ac82549535e3f043083af331c82f751b5a9dab6f.text: 引导攻击。如果你的生命值低于 50…74…80%，你会造成 +15…51…60 伤害。

e6af5dbc53033c06373ef5360d6bda704a6aa67b.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage, and your target suffers from one of the following conditions: Deep Wound (for 20 seconds), Weakness (for 20 seconds), Bleeding (for 25 seconds), or Crippled (for 15 seconds). After making a Desperation Blow, you are knocked down.
e6af5dbc53033c06373ef5360d6bda704a6aa67b.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击击中，你会受到 +10…34…40 伤害，并且你的目标会遭受以下状况之一：深伤（持续 20 秒）、虚弱（持续 20 秒）、流血（持续 25 秒）或残废（持续 15 秒）。进行绝望一击后，你会被击倒。

ed7b4fb2d4209cb9e80ac3bafa5b68781efa91bc.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 Spirit that dies after 30 seconds. When this Spirit dies, all foes in the area take 5…21…25 damage for each second the Spirit was alive (maximum 150 damage).
ed7b4fb2d4209cb9e80ac3bafa5b68781efa91bc.text: 缚灵仪式。创建一个等级为 1…11…14 的精魂，该精魂会在 30 秒后死亡。当该战魂死亡时，该战魂存活的每一秒，该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 5…21…25 伤害（最大 150 伤害）。

ee5b5f28112d2f44aeb777caa1ee3507f102b3e4.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 Spirit "spirit" is capitalized in the non-concise description that dies after 30 seconds. When this Spirit dies, all foes in the area take 1…8…10 damage for each second the Spirit was alive (maximum of 150 damage).
ee5b5f28112d2f44aeb777caa1ee3507f102b3e4.text: 缚灵仪式。创建一个等级1…8…10 Spirit“精神”在不简洁的描述中大写，在30秒后死亡。当该战魂死亡时，该战魂存活的每一秒，该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 1…8…10 伤害（最大伤害为 150）。

b20396028d84fe23bc1550a9acdde81e6a158ad5.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30…54…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…71…85 lightning damage.
b20396028d84fe23bc1550a9acdde81e6a158ad5.text: 精英物品法术。持有 Glaive 的骨灰最多 30…54…60 秒。当你持有她的骨灰时，所有仪式技能都有20%护甲穿透。当你撒下她的骨灰时，该区域的所有敌人都会受到 15…71…85 闪电伤害。

0c37f4102b61670851ab59150c3a1bbac93fd88f.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30…54…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…71…85 lightning damage.
0c37f4102b61670851ab59150c3a1bbac93fd88f.text: 精英物品法术。持有 Glaive 的骨灰最多 30…54…60 秒。当你持有她的骨灰时，所有仪式技能都有10%护甲穿透。当你撒下她的骨灰时，该区域的所有敌人都会受到 15…71…85 闪电伤害。

b48fd1ee0b172305161e1ca569621a95c17bb254.source: Bow Attack. If Determined Shot hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage. If Determined Shot fails to hit, all of your attack skills are recharged.
b48fd1ee0b172305161e1ca569621a95c17bb254.text: 弓攻击。如果坚定射击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果确定射击失败，你的所有攻击技能都会被充能。

b3865fba0076557913541213be5163d7cfeb53ac.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If Devastating Hammer hits, your target is knocked down and suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
b3865fba0076557913541213be5163d7cfeb53ac.text: 精英锤攻击。如果毁灭之锤击中，你的目标会被击倒并遭受虚弱状态 5…17…20 秒。

596567ba403f25573cc8383ee6ef7468183ac17a.source: Sword Attack. Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was an attack, all of that foe's attack skills are disabled for 0…2…3 seconds.
596567ba403f25573cc8383ee6ef7468183ac17a.text: 剑攻击。打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是攻击，则该敌人的所有攻击技能都将被禁用 0…2…3 秒。

5379df1e21bb660f136fb511f74a1b66eea6e7a3.source: Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe. If that foe is hexed, this skill recharges 20…44…50% faster.
5379df1e21bb660f136fb511f74a1b66eea6e7a3.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的一项结界。如果该敌人被施咒，该技能会更快地恢复 20…44…50%。

b93b8f36c3219134d13858f2a7f624862269a410.source: Stance. For 1…3…4 seconds, you gain +10 armor and have a 75% chance to block attacks. Disciplined Stance ends if you use an adrenal skill.
b93b8f36c3219134d13858f2a7f624862269a410.text: 立场。在 1…3…4 秒内，你获得 +10 护甲并有 75% 几率阻挡攻击。如果您使用肾上腺技能，纪律姿态就会结束。

109611b3c5d80c5ca5c81b62127ca4be092f59e7.source: Elite Spell. If target foe is suffering from a condition and under the effects of a hex or an enchantment, that foe suffers 30…94…110 damage.
109611b3c5d80c5ca5c81b62127ca4be092f59e7.text: 精英法术。如果目标敌人患有某种病症并且受到妖术或结界的影响，则该敌人会受到 30…94…110 伤害。

af7b2169604aaab8dcbdbe8dd7b944fda5de5898.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit. This spirit deals 5…17…20 damage and anyone struck by its attack loses one enchantment. This spirit dies after 10…30…35 seconds.
af7b2169604aaab8dcbdbe8dd7b944fda5de5898.text: 缚灵仪式。打造1…10…12级精神。该精魂造成 5…17…20 伤害，任何被其攻击击中的人都会失去一个结界。该灵魂会在 10…30…35 秒后死亡。

77b46b657cece3624c82d47455a13afb4f041404.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. This spirit deals 5…17…20 damage and anyone struck by its attack loses one enchantment. This spirit dies after 15…35…40 seconds.
