77b46b657cece3624c82d47455a13afb4f041404.text: 缚灵仪式。打造1…7…8级精神。该精魂造成 5…17…20 伤害，任何被其攻击击中的人都会失去一个结界。该灵魂会在 15…35…40 秒后死亡。

0fa41de42d7276ea39e06d6aa83d73b8d1624369.source: Axe Attack. If it hits, this axe blow will inflict a Deep Wound on the target foe, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.
0fa41de42d7276ea39e06d6aa83d73b8d1624369.text: 斧头攻击。如果击中，该斧头打击将对目标敌人造成深度伤害，使该敌人的最大生命值降低 20%，持续 5…17…20 秒。

ed9d71658830c60cabccae25b2c61019bb4ac8c5.source: Spell. Remove one condition from target ally. If that ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally is healed for 15…63…75 Health.
ed9d71658830c60cabccae25b2c61019bb4ac8c5.text: 咒语。移除目标盟友的一项条件。如果该盟友受到结界的影响，则该盟友的生命值将得到 15…63…75 的治疗。

3142a250c3003996166dafc96364fbbe27cb735f.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. All non-spirit allies within its range have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Every time an attack is blocked in this way, this spirit takes 60 damage. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
3142a250c3003996166dafc96364fbbe27cb735f.text: 缚灵仪式。打造1…11…14级精神。其范围内的所有非精神盟友都有 75% 的机会阻挡传入的攻击。每当如此格挡攻击时，该战魂就会受到 60 的伤害。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

ee7688bebce62e1941fa9f5f70632446da2eef95.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. All non-spirit allies within its range have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Every time an attack is blocked in this way, this spirit takes 60 damage. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
ee7688bebce62e1941fa9f5f70632446da2eef95.text: 缚灵仪式。打造1…8…10级精神。其范围内的所有非精神盟友都有 75% 的机会阻挡传入的攻击。每次以这种方式格挡攻击时，该战魂都会受到 60 的伤害。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

99bafd0554562883b914a552d86eab93440ef672.source: Preparation. For 36 seconds, whenever your arrows critical, they also interrupt your target.
99bafd0554562883b914a552d86eab93440ef672.text: 准备。在 36 秒内，每当你的箭危急时，它们也会打断你的目标。

601e0943278c02f97cea9bf40a64a7e2b4984a1a.source: Axe Attack. If it hits, this attack interrupts the target's current action. If that action was a skill, that skill is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.
601e0943278c02f97cea9bf40a64a7e2b4984a1a.text: 斧头攻击。如果击中，该攻击会打断目标当前的行动。如果该动作是一项技能，则该技能将被额外禁用 20 秒。

e0086a9689ec20cbd3e523875521171bec3694f1.source: Spell. Send out a Disrupting Dagger at target foe that strikes for 10…30…35 earth damage. If that foe was activating a skill, that skill is interrupted. This spell has half the normal range.
e0086a9689ec20cbd3e523875521171bec3694f1.text: 咒语。向目标敌人发射一把干扰匕首，造成 10…30…35 大地伤害。如果该敌人正在激活技能，则该技能会被打断。该法术的射程只有正常范围的一半。

c89a1d72a1f3f60b6d13c8e084d2033c79e01d83.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Disrupting Lunge that deals +1…10…12 damage. If that attack strikes a foe using a skill that skill is interrupted and is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.
c89a1d72a1f3f60b6d13c8e084d2033c79e01d83.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行干扰性突刺，造成 +1…10…12 伤害。如果该攻击使用技能击中敌人，则该技能会被中断并被禁用额外的 20 秒。

cab1fb16af564aba2e2899a8c2d3915c791b0d76.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, target foe's action is interrupted. If that action was a Skill, you strike for +10…34…40 damage.
cab1fb16af564aba2e2899a8c2d3915c791b0d76.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，目标敌人的行动就会被打断。如果该动作是技能，则你的攻击会造成 +10…34…40 伤害。

f096313965350cb2fd9b83d305f5c854082bd277.source: Lead Attack. If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, it is disabled for 3…9…10 seconds.
f096313965350cb2fd9b83d305f5c854082bd277.text: 引导攻击。如果此攻击命中，则会打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是咒语，则它会被禁用 3…9…10 秒。

790e2d56d7e55ecfe98e320c500ac8cc7b7c9efc.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is interrupted.
790e2d56d7e55ecfe98e320c500ac8cc7b7c9efc.text: 长矛攻击。如果此攻击击中患有某种病症的敌人，该敌人就会被打断。

f1ea591cac8de6e648e58e7f861cfea8aa5cd45b.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit. This spirit deals 5…17…20 damage and anyone struck by its attack is interrupted. This spirit dies after 10…22…25 seconds.
f1ea591cac8de6e648e58e7f861cfea8aa5cd45b.text: 缚灵仪式。打造1…10…12级精神。该精魂造成 5…17…20 伤害，任何被其攻击击中的人都会被打断。该灵魂会在 10…22…25 秒后死亡。

cbd8b47a506f6b151927436cb8091d88ddb54130.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. This spirit deals 5…17…20 damage and anyone struck by its attack is interrupted. This spirit dies after 10…22…25 seconds.
cbd8b47a506f6b151927436cb8091d88ddb54130.text: 缚灵仪式。打造1…7…8级精神。该精魂造成 5…17…20 伤害，任何被其攻击击中的人都会被打断。该灵魂会在 10…22…25 秒后死亡。

ac87fc8269a9eaea26a04f205e7a041a6e630f75.source: Stance. For 1…4…5 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block an attack this way, you lose 2 Energy or Distortion ends.
ac87fc8269a9eaea26a04f205e7a041a6e630f75.text: 立场。在 1…4…5 秒内，你有 75% 机会阻止攻击。每当你以这种方式阻挡攻击时，你就会失去 2 能量或扭曲结束。

8b8a284e772ddd035ce59106810320af6610108e.source: Melee Attack. Swipe your weapon at the target, dealing no damage but disrupting the target's current action (and the actions of foes adjacent to your target).
8b8a284e772ddd035ce59106810320af6610108e.text: 近战攻击。将武器扫向目标，不会造成任何伤害，但会扰乱目标当前的行动（以及目标附近敌人的行动）。

f876b20e66d745f86d862d4cfe157fcb81ee7822.source: Bow Attack. If Distracting Shot hits, it interrupts target foe's action but deals only 1…13…16 damage. If the interrupted action was a skill, that skill is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.
f876b20e66d745f86d862d4cfe157fcb81ee7822.text: 弓攻击。如果分散射击击中，它会打断目标敌人的行动，但仅造成 1…13…16 伤害。如果被打断的动作是一项技能，则该技能将被额外禁用 20 秒。

3c9465059281c0a1a0d2acd058f558a67df8212b.source: Melee Attack. If Distracting Strike hits, it deals no damage and interrupts target foe's action. If target foe has Cracked Armor, that skill is disabled for 30 seconds.
3c9465059281c0a1a0d2acd058f558a67df8212b.text: 近战攻击。如果分散打击击中，它不会造成伤害并打断目标敌人的行动。如果目标敌人的护甲破裂，该技能将被禁用 30 秒。

bb12b1fded76064c5cf6a2fc000ae9ab054bec89.source: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe uses a skill, that skill takes an additional 10…47…56 seconds to recharge.
bb12b1fded76064c5cf6a2fc000ae9ab054bec89.text: 降咒魔法。在 6 秒内，下次目标敌人使用技能时，该技能需要额外的 10…47…56 秒来恢复。

643b81fe9468110372051b5f4b2388d0acd608b7.source: Elite Spell. Remove up to 1…3…3 hex[es] from target ally. For each hex removed in this way, that ally loses one condition and gains 15…63…75 Health.
643b81fe9468110372051b5f4b2388d0acd608b7.text: 精英法术。从目标盟友身上移除最多 1…3…3 降咒。以这种方式每移除一个六角形，该盟友都会失去一个条件并获得 15…63…75 生命值。

e2a3d2b98ac172e1ddb4602d86c0ebb726ebed0c.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever you cast a Protection Prayer should be Protection Prayers or Divine Favor spell that targets an ally, that ally is healed for 15…51…60 Health, and you lose 1 Energy.
e2a3d2b98ac172e1ddb4602d86c0ebb726ebed0c.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，每当你施展保护祈祷（应是针对盟友的保护祈祷或神圣恩惠法术）时，该盟友就会得到 15…51…60 生命值的治疗，并且你会失去 1 能量。

75c840d1c093e30d6b7d19b2b0a44f845d84a295.source: Spell. Heals you and party members within earshot for 15…51…60 points.
75c840d1c093e30d6b7d19b2b0a44f845d84a295.text: 咒语。治愈你和听力范围内的队友，获得 15…51…60 点。

848e03570069dc9771cf3fc670c67a030c7c4ab9.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and that ally is healed for 26…197…240 Health.
848e03570069dc9771cf3fc670c67a030c7c4ab9.text: 结界咒语。在 10 秒内，下一次目标盟友受到致命伤害时，该伤害将被抵消，并且该盟友将获得 26…197…240 生命值的治疗。

18ff9a06a6d94998e9f63627e8743e04b2d9c3c0.source: Enchantment Spell. For 1…11…14 seconds, Monk Spells cost you 5 less Energy to cast. (Minimum cost: 1 Energy.)
18ff9a06a6d94998e9f63627e8743e04b2d9c3c0.text: 结界咒语。在 1…11…14 秒内，武僧法术会消耗 5 更少的能量来施放。 （最低成本：1 能源。）

785e522e9b7b01022b0dbe50ac8b7d2360bfadbd.source: Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 27…65…75% chance to block incoming projectiles. Dodge ends if you attack.
785e522e9b7b01022b0dbe50ac8b7d2360bfadbd.text: 立场。在 5…10…11 秒内，你移动 33% 的速度更快，并且有 27…65…75% 的机会阻挡传入的射弹。如果你攻击，闪避就会结束。

19c93bbf017cf31aa631c22147906e2ed87c2f65.source: Signet. For 8…18…20 seconds, you have +10…34…40 armor and cannot be knocked down, but your movement is slowed by 75%.
19c93bbf017cf31aa631c22147906e2ed87c2f65.text: 印章。在 8…18…20 秒内，你拥有 +10…34…40 盔甲并且无法被击倒，但你的移动速度会减慢 75%。

a3a29ff5557e1764cdb0b71074597f46baf5898b.source: Spell. Strike target foe for 10…50…60 lightning (maximum 135) damage for every recharging binding ritual you have.
a3a29ff5557e1764cdb0b71074597f46baf5898b.text: 咒语。每次充电绑定仪式都会对目标敌人造成 10…50…60 闪电伤害（最大 135）。

44f493c44eeb74784c3d5d2dec3aa9e016f5dfd2.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Invoke the power of the Dragon. For 8 seconds, you and target ally are enchanted with Double Dragon. Adjacent foes are dealt 10…34…40 fire damage each second. Additionally, when you or your ally use skills that target a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1…3…4 seconds.
44f493c44eeb74784c3d5d2dec3aa9e016f5dfd2.text: 精英结界法术。召唤龙之力量。在 8 秒内，你和目标盟友被双龙附魔。每秒对相邻敌人造成 10…34…40 火焰伤害。此外，当你或你的盟友使用针对敌人的技能时，该敌人会被点燃 1…3…4 秒。

475dc8f886ced43dbc60f8f4c26ddfa4eabe0362.source: Elite Sword Attack. If Dragon Slash hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and gain 1…4…5 strikes of adrenaline.
475dc8f886ced43dbc60f8f4c26ddfa4eabe0362.text: 精英剑攻击。如果龙斩命中，你会造成 +10…34…40 伤害并获得 1…4…5 肾上腺素攻击。

70c0a80bd829d7a827caaa4f6cd20dddab09733f.source: Spell. You invoke a Dragon's Stomp at target foe's location. All foes near this location are knocked down and are struck for 26…85…100 earth damage.
70c0a80bd829d7a827caaa4f6cd20dddab09733f.text: 咒语。你在目标敌人的位置调用龙之践踏。该位置附近的所有敌人都会被击倒并受到 26…85…100 地球伤害。

556ad57fce364805d67275cf161afdfd651318bd.source: Spell. Remove one Mesmer hex from target foe. If a hex was removed in this way, that foe loses 1…4…5 Energy and you gain 4 Energy for each point lost.
556ad57fce364805d67275cf161afdfd651318bd.text: 咒语。从目标敌人身上移除一个幻术师六角形。如果以这种方式移除了六角形，则该敌人会失去 1…4…5 能量，而你每损失一点就会获得 4 能量。

e70874fb733680204fdac42d9306c4d4464de4fd.source: Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you gain 8…15…17 Energy and 40…104…120 Health.
e70874fb733680204fdac42d9306c4d4464de4fd.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的结界。如果结界被移除，您将获得 8…15…17 能量和 40…104…120 生命值。

2731189435c2f78a337ce157c11ba2000f856b80.source: Spell. All negative conditions are transferred from target other ally to yourself. For each condition acquired, you gain 6…22…26 Health.
2731189435c2f78a337ce157c11ba2000f856b80.text: 咒语。所有负面条件都会从目标其他盟友转移到您自己身上。对于获得的每种状况，您都会获得 6…22…26 生命值。

79718960663eb98d296ae9b7ac91fea7be97854b.source: Spell. Teleport target allied spirit to your location.
79718960663eb98d296ae9b7ac91fea7be97854b.text: 咒语。将目标盟友的灵魂传送到你所在的位置。

5baea2225c79f4829d505bbaccf1cfd47c468034.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and your target suffers from one of the following conditions: Deep Wound (for 20 seconds), Weakness (for 20 seconds), Bleeding (for 25 seconds), or Crippled (for 15 seconds). After making a Drunken Blow, you are knocked down.
5baea2225c79f4829d505bbaccf1cfd47c468034.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击击中，你会受到 +10…34…40 伤害，并且你的目标会遭受以下状况之一：深伤（持续 20 秒）、虚弱（持续 20 秒）、流血（持续 25 秒）或残废（持续 15 秒）。进行醉拳后，你会被击倒。

c640ae101fa62c07d3c8772f88ad08b8f9cded4e.source: Stance. For 72…90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10…15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25…33% instead.
c640ae101fa62c07d3c8772f88ad08b8f9cded4e.text: 立场。在 72…90 秒内，你的移动和攻击速度增加 10…15%。如果你在激活该技能时喝醉了，你的移动速度和攻击速度会增加25…33%。

fdbd259489bde3aa2169932c6754999e968b8dbe.source: Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you gain 75% chance to block attacks and 34…55…60 armor against elemental damage.
fdbd259489bde3aa2169932c6754999e968b8dbe.text: 立场。在 5…10…11 秒内，你获得 75% 格挡攻击的机会和 34…55…60 防御元素伤害的护甲。

413a935444ceeb61e3ed509db94ddf46a5995862.source: Bow Attack. Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 25% less damage.
413a935444ceeb61e3ed509db94ddf46a5995862.text: 弓攻击。同时向目标敌人射出两支箭。这些箭造成的伤害较少 25%。

1e84fad422240ecf1092de0a491037dee348decc.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot achieve a critical hit and deal 3…17…20 less damage.
1e84fad422240ecf1092de0a491037dee348decc.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人无法造成致命一击并造成 3…17…20 更少的伤害。

83736ceb25e1800bb6301b221ac635af6e1a6404.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1…3…4 seconds.
83736ceb25e1800bb6301b221ac635af6e1a6404.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有附近的敌人都会受到 10…34…40 土系伤害。在 30 秒内，你的攻击会造成土属性伤害。当此结界结束时，所有附近的敌人都会被致盲 1…3…4 秒。

43db245af6ac1467b68ab047e60445a86d9d572f.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are Blinded for 1…3…4 seconds.
43db245af6ac1467b68ab047e60445a86d9d572f.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会受到 10…34…40 地属性伤害。在 30 秒内，你的攻击会造成土属性伤害。当此结界结束时，所有相邻的敌人都会被致盲 1…3…4 秒。

3d4ace80e51bf64228c39c37b842c77001289fa8.source: Trap. When Dust Trap is triggered, every second (for 5 seconds total), all nearby foes are Blinded for 3…7…8 seconds and take 10…22…25 damage. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted. Dust Trap ends after 90 seconds.
3d4ace80e51bf64228c39c37b842c77001289fa8.text: 陷阱。当灰尘陷阱被触发时，每秒（总共 5 秒），所有附近的敌人都会被致盲 3…7…8 秒，并受到 10…22…25 点伤害。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。灰尘陷阱在 90 秒后结束。

3e29ace7b12623555a0b2527de90716ba5f37840.source: Elite Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, if you are wielding a hammer, you attack 33% faster, you gain +40 armor, and your attack skills interrupt foes when they hit.
3e29ace7b12623555a0b2527de90716ba5f37840.text: 精英姿态。在 5…10…11 秒内，如果你挥舞着锤子，你的攻击速度会加快 33%，你会获得 +40 点护甲，并且你的攻击技能会在敌人击中时打断他们。

cef48a7816ee1744e688f250c635eac0333489a5.source: Enchantment Spell. For 24…30 seconds, your stances last 55…100% longer. If you activated this skill while drunk, you cannot be knocked down.
cef48a7816ee1744e688f250c635eac0333489a5.text: 结界咒语。 24…30 秒，你的姿势持续时间延长 55…100%。如果你在醉酒状态下发动这个技能，你就不会被击倒。

ca5c08879cfd97ce09408f155d67c7e44409cef4.source: Spell. Heal target other ally for 20…56…65 Health and an additional 15…35…40 Health for each enchantment or hex on that ally.
ca5c08879cfd97ce09408f155d67c7e44409cef4.text: 咒语。为目标其他盟友治疗 20…56…65 点生命值，并为该盟友的每个结界或妖术额外治疗 15…35…40 点生命值。

cc885ac7af41d390d863971db38b3d6a56bc91c6.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, target ally and all nearby allies are enchanted with Dwayna's Sorrow. If an ally dies while under the effects of Dwayna's Sorrow, your party is healed for 5…41…50.
cc885ac7af41d390d863971db38b3d6a56bc91c6.text: 结界咒语。持续 30 秒，目标盟友和附近所有盟友都受到德薇娜之哀的结魔。如果一名盟友在德薇娜之哀的影响下死亡，你的队伍将获得 5…41…50 点治疗。

b70b7eaaec8d8fac9987f30157df78e87cee3761.source: Spell. Target touched ally is healed for 60 Health for each Enchantment on you (maximum 60…204…240).
b70b7eaaec8d8fac9987f30157df78e87cee3761.text: 咒语。你身上的每个结界都会为你所接触的目标盟友治疗 60 点生命值（最多 60…204…240 点）。

c2345fcad6002b28dfdea1ed6f786f2c7eca2c9d.source: Skill. Target touched foe takes 50…70 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 15…25 seconds.
c2345fcad6002b28dfdea1ed6f786f2c7eca2c9d.text: 技能。目标接触的敌人受到 50…70 点穿刺伤害并开始流血 15…25 秒。

3eef74d4b56be77359e5fc4f0770e3614ab93bb6.source: Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, you are attuned to Earth. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Earth Magic.
3eef74d4b56be77359e5fc4f0770e3614ab93bb6.text: 结界咒语。在 36…55…60 秒的时间里，你与地球协调一致。每次使用土系魔法时，你将获得 1 点能量加上该技能的基础能量消耗 30% 点。

d08317e92fa902af50df4d74b47f4009d12123fd.source: Elite Hammer Attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
d08317e92fa902af50df4d74b47f4009d12123fd.text: 精英锤攻击。目标敌人和所有邻近的敌人都被击倒。 （锤子精通 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

d7f5374e80041e1e027be5efd8af23034f11bda1.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. All non-spirit foes knocked down within its range are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Whenever this happens, this spirit loses 50…30…25 Health. This spirit dies after 15…39…45 seconds.
d7f5374e80041e1e027be5efd8af23034f11bda1.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。所有在其范围内被击倒的非精神敌人都会被击倒至少 3 秒。每当这种情况发生时，该灵魂就会失去 50…30…25 点生命值。该灵魂会在 15…39…45 秒后死亡。

771afda49804ae4f3ba9e2e3a7a1b29398ddb7de.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ebon Vanguard Assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike. This summoned Assassin Shadow Steps to target foe. If that foe is a Charr, the Assassin lives for 24…30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12…15 seconds.
771afda49804ae4f3ba9e2e3a7a1b29398ddb7de.text: 咒文。召唤一个等级 14…20 的黑锋先锋刺客，拥有铁掌、狐牙和九尾攻击。这会召唤刺客暗影步来瞄准敌人。如果敌人是夏尔，刺客的生命时间为 24…30 秒。如果目标敌人不是夏尔，刺客的生命时间为 12…15 秒。

0a40750d18dff9ab798c4663263c3e4664cf1e74.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 54…90 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 5…25 seconds. This attack has a 10% chance of doing an additional +540…900 piercing damage. If this attack hits a Charr it has a 25% chance of doing an additional +540…900 piercing damage.
0a40750d18dff9ab798c4663263c3e4664cf1e74.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 54…90 点穿刺伤害并开始流血 5…25 秒。这次攻击有 10% 的几率造成额外 +540…900 的穿刺伤害。如果这次攻击击中夏尔，它有 25% 的几率造成额外 +540…900 的穿刺伤害。

aacd1280ec898ee874eceb4b5716b8e74871241d.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.
aacd1280ec898ee874eceb4b5716b8e74871241d.text: 精英结界法术。在 30 秒内，回声会被你使用的下一个技能所取代。回声作为该技能持续30秒。

692b6cc98075f671fd67d1e5a74e7388f3635839.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. All non-spirit foes knocked down within its range are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Whenever this happens, this spirit loses 50…30…25 Health. This spirit dies after 15…39…45 seconds.
692b6cc98075f671fd67d1e5a74e7388f3635839.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。所有在其范围内被击倒的非精神敌人都会被击倒至少 3 秒。每当这种情况发生时，该灵魂就会失去 50…30…25 点生命值。该灵魂会在 15…39…45 秒后死亡。

6400727bd90064271da618f0b3cb1b0606dbad4b.source: Hex Spell. For 3 seconds, target and all nearby foes move 90% slower. When Earthen Shackles ends, it applies Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
6400727bd90064271da618f0b3cb1b0606dbad4b.text: 降咒魔法。在 3 秒内，目标和所有附近敌人的移动速度减慢 90%。当大地枷锁结束时，它会施加弱点5…17…20秒。

00e8e5615d947877450bd53e0861405cb1a037b2.source: Spell. You invoke an Earthquake at target foe's location. All foes near this location are knocked down and are struck for 26…85…100 earth damage.
00e8e5615d947877450bd53e0861405cb1a037b2.text: 咒文。你在目标敌人的位置引发地震。该位置附近的所有敌人都会被击倒并受到 26…85…100 点土属性伤害。

0f136b9027b5a1f5e3cd685fc635526885d3917f.source: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Courage at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor and an additional +24 armor against Charr.
0f136b9027b5a1f5e3cd685fc635526885d3917f.text: 守卫咒语。你在当前位置种植了黑檀勇气战旗。持续 14…20 秒，该区域的非灵体盟友获得 +24 点护甲值，并对夏尔额外获得 +24 点护甲值。

3a192aa551fbe4cf3cfda844cd4a7a5587e4d44f.source: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Honor at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area strike for +8…15 damage and an additional +7…10 vs. Charr.
3a192aa551fbe4cf3cfda844cd4a7a5587e4d44f.text: 守卫咒语。你在当前位置种植了黑檀荣誉战旗。持续 14…20 秒，该区域的非灵体盟友对夏尔造成 +8…15 点伤害，并额外造成 +7…10 点伤害。

2118d3cdc5bcaf5ec2ef63dedad06279564661ea.source: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 44…60% chance to halve skill recharge of spells they cast.
2118d3cdc5bcaf5ec2ef63dedad06279564661ea.text: 守卫咒语。你在当前位置种植了黑檀智慧战旗。 14…20秒内，该区域内的非灵体盟友有44…60%的几率使他们施展的法术技能回复减半。

d55f2b3058ca41f916aa36b13426470a2589ca71.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1…6…7 seconds. For 30 seconds, if you are wielding an earth weapon, your melee attacks deal +3…25…30 earth damage. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of Blindness.
d55f2b3058ca41f916aa36b13426470a2589ca71.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。当你施放此结界时，附近所有敌人都会被致盲 1…6…7 秒。在 30 秒内，如果你使用土系武器，你的近战攻击会造成 +3…25…30 点土系伤害。当这个结界结束时，你的失明就被治愈了。

87b9ee16daaeac0a010f4bf6ae3e52f7a2d6c512.source: Spell. Shadow Step to target other ally. You and that other ally are healed for 70…110 health.
87b9ee16daaeac0a010f4bf6ae3e52f7a2d6c512.text: 咒语。暗影步瞄准其他盟友。你和另一位盟友的生命值已恢复 70…110 点。

b306879824bba7edcc4b552f1394d5927dd63857.source: Spell. Send a projectile that strikes target foe for 10…70…85 earth damage and causes Weakness for 5…13…15 seconds if it hits.
b306879824bba7edcc4b552f1394d5927dd63857.text: 咒语。发射一枚射弹，对目标敌人造成 10…70…85 点土属性伤害，击中后会造成 5…13…15 秒的虚弱。

adf199b3e42d58a35d91a2bf2ea43eb5c34c03a8.source: Item Spell. Hold Lee Sa's ashes for 5…13…15 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you gain +2 Energy regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you gain +1…8…10 Energy.
adf199b3e42d58a35d91a2bf2ea43eb5c34c03a8.text: 物品法术。按住李萨的骨灰 5…13…15 秒。 While you hold her ashes, you gain +2 Energy regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you gain +1…8…10 Energy.

6ad6d4c67e232581a5b7508f17363fe0766b64f3.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next Shout or Chant used by each ally within earshot costs 3…6…7 less Energy.
6ad6d4c67e232581a5b7508f17363fe0766b64f3.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一次喊叫或圣歌会消耗 3…6…7 的能量。

999ba96db4dd3765497ff154aaa115f3575980aa.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever a shout or chant ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally gains 1…2…2 Energy.
999ba96db4dd3765497ff154aaa115f3575980aa.text: 回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当目标非精神盟友的喊叫或吟唱结束时，该盟友获得 1…2…2 点能量。

485b34a8138c588442f1ac607a830b774404a5ed.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. If a non-spirit creature within range dies, Edge of Extinction deals 14…43…50 damage to all creatures of the same type that are below 90% Health and within range of the spirit. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
485b34a8138c588442f1ac607a830b774404a5ed.text: 自然仪式。创建一个关卡1…8…10精神。如果范围内的非灵体生物死亡，灭绝边缘会造成14…43…50对以下所有同类型生物造成伤害90%身体健康，精神在一定范围内。此灵死后30…198…240秒。

1007d73ec5db96c1a3249496370e2331f90c35b9.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25…53…60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1…2…2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.
1007d73ec5db96c1a3249496370e2331f90c35b9.text: 精英结界法术。在 25…53…60 秒内，你与风、火、水和土相协调，并获得这些属性 +1…2…2 点。每次你使用与任何这些元素相关的魔法时，你都会获得 1 点能量加上该技能的基本能量消耗 50% 点。

88a2432b2f472ce9729e95b87f9ef5670dfe1a2d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1…4…5 seconds.
88a2432b2f472ce9729e95b87f9ef5670dfe1a2d.text: 结界咒语。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当你对敌人施加元素妖术时，该敌人就会着火 1…4…5 秒。

f629d8fd46da914294b8065efbdfff629fadae32.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1…2…2 seconds.
f629d8fd46da914294b8065efbdfff629fadae32.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，每当你对敌人施加元素妖术时，该敌人就会着火 1…2…2 秒。

9cb20e3ff414d8bbbc17d6ab07f6fcc7b7f381c4.source: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
9cb20e3ff414d8bbbc17d6ab07f6fcc7b7f381c4.text: 结界咒语。在 40…60 秒内，你的元素属性提升 1 点。每次施展法术时，每 10 级能量储存，你会获得 1 点能量，并治疗 100…300% 点法术能量消耗。

d215dd388d9ddf6c4ff3ac1bc255b2f49ca0d205.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…5…6 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills cost 15 less Energy (minimum cost 10 Energy), and skills recharge 25% slower. This spirit dies after 1…48…60 seconds.
d215dd388d9ddf6c4ff3ac1bc255b2f49ca0d205.text: 自然仪式。创造1…5…6级武魂。对于其范围内的非精神生物，所有技能消耗的能量减少 15 点（最低消耗 10 点能量），并且技能的充能速度减慢 25%。该灵魂会在 1…48…60 秒后死亡。

510d8e08053b28e9373dd5b2d29d0330071af87b.source: Spell. Target foe takes 1…2…2 damage for each point of Energy you have (maximum 130 damage).
510d8e08053b28e9373dd5b2d29d0330071af87b.text: 咒语。你每拥有一点能量，目标敌人就会受到 1…2…2 点伤害（最多 130 点伤害）。

2add103f90dff8a95f1bbcf5cb14df73a254875e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
2add103f90dff8a95f1bbcf5cb14df73a254875e.text: 精英结界法术。持续 36…55…60 秒，能量增益每点最大能量，使你和目标盟友的最大生命值提高 1…3…3。当此结界首次应用时，你和你的目标获得 1…10…12 点能量。每拥有 2 点能量储存，您就会额外获得 1 点能量。

b7610b88b44a282cd5f172235242bcbb3a8a34d3.source: Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy and takes 9 damage for each point of Energy lost.
b7610b88b44a282cd5f172235242bcbb3a8a34d3.text: 咒语。目标敌人损失 1…8…10 点能量，每损失一点能量就会受到 9 点伤害。

c5a6ffebd2cee6a0a9377edbe695858a3e2818fe.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, You gain +40 armor against elemental damage, but you lose 24…14…12 armor against physical damage.
c5a6ffebd2cee6a0a9377edbe695858a3e2818fe.text: 姿态。在 30…78…90 秒内，你针对元素伤害获得 +40 护甲值，但针对物理伤害你失去 24…14…12 护甲值。

53f57adf83d93dd539ce46540d6d0ba90dcfe960.source: Elite Spell. You and target other ally lose 1 condition and 1 hex, and are healed for 50.
53f57adf83d93dd539ce46540d6d0ba90dcfe960.text: 精英法术。你和目标其他盟友失去 1 点状态和 1 降咒，并获得 50 点治疗。

e35a4c580ee58ad498435d949a3088f898bee73e.source: Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks, that foe takes 10…46…55 damage and deals 1…12…15 less damage.
e35a4c580ee58ad498435d949a3088f898bee73e.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…13…15 秒内，每当目标敌人攻击时，该敌人受到 10…46…55 点伤害，并减少 1…12…15 点伤害。

951bd021b70ece0669ab2fb41729374bd5bfef8d.source: Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks, that foe takes 15…39…45 damage.
951bd021b70ece0669ab2fb41729374bd5bfef8d.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…13…15 秒内，每当目标敌人攻击时，该敌人就会受到 15…39…45 点伤害。

f5479e94ff0f3dd412e2c3144122bc3f3c9b6ba5.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. All allies within its range holding an item gain 15…39…45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy. This spirit dies after 15…51…60 seconds.
f5479e94ff0f3dd412e2c3144122bc3f3c9b6ba5.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。其范围内持有物品的所有盟友获得 15…39…45 最大生命值和 10 最大能量。该灵魂会在 15…51…60 秒后死亡。

e5489e124264dbcbd651fb128c2d92e933ea8e98.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. All allies within its range holding an item gain 15…39…45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy. This spirit dies after 15…51…60 seconds.
e5489e124264dbcbd651fb128c2d92e933ea8e98.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。其范围内持有物品的所有盟友获得 15…39…45 最大生命值和 10 最大能量。该灵魂会在 15…51…60 秒后死亡。

64fd934355273773e030ae7305992cd7b1fa41e4.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you move 25% faster. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you lose 1 condition.
64fd934355273773e030ae7305992cd7b1fa41e4.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 7 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。如果此结界提前结束，你将失去 1 状态。

d4348e3a8b88eb1c1cb5ae8611dea9f4d3769f34.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe casts enchantments 100…180…200% slower. If target foe is not under the effects of an enchantment when this hex is applied, that foe takes 10…82…100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.
d4348e3a8b88eb1c1cb5ae8611dea9f4d3769f34.text: 精英六角咒语。在 10 秒内，目标敌人施放结界的速度减慢 100…180…200%。如果应用此咒语时目标敌人并未受到结界的影响，则该敌人将受到 10…82…100 点伤害，所有相邻敌人将受到 75% 点伤害。

d7f4e97483b0a3305f68793bf98fa74be1e6fdb9.source: Skill. For 7…16…18 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health.
d7f4e97483b0a3305f68793bf98fa74be1e6fdb9.text: 技能。在 7…16…18 秒内，您还有额外的 90…258…300 生命值。

d97a8db9ee0fe132172c5046494777e8f6d0cb8f.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, chants and shouts last 50% longer on target non-spirit ally.
d97a8db9ee0fe132172c5046494777e8f6d0cb8f.text: 回声。持续 10…30…35 秒，目标非灵体盟友的吟唱和呼喊持续时间延长 50%。

03f40a2d5369be20df8e4369e419bdecf1059aa3.source: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe suffers -1…4…5 Health degeneration. If that foe is moving when Enduring Toxin would end, Enduring Toxin is renewed for another 5 seconds.
03f40a2d5369be20df8e4369e419bdecf1059aa3.text: 降咒魔法。在 5 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…4…5 点生命值退化。如果在持久毒素结束时该敌人正在移动，则持久毒素会再更新 5 秒。

f2d16bc2fb828c6713a1b99a734e531d349582d0.source: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 2…8…9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
f2d16bc2fb828c6713a1b99a734e531d349582d0.text: 精英法术。目标敌人失败2…8…9活力。你收获3每损失一点能量的能量。

255f88cc4a49dad3d277f0044c6981e6aedf7f15.source: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.
255f88cc4a49dad3d277f0044c6981e6aedf7f15.text: 精英法术。目标敌人损失 1…8…10 点能量。每损失一点能量，该敌人就会受到 7 点伤害，而附近的所有敌人都会受到该伤害的 75%。

0119848753b7974212d2ff0f83536ab41b0e77d9.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Spells cast within its range that cause Overcast cause an additional 10 Overcast. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
0119848753b7974212d2ff0f83536ab41b0e77d9.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。在其范围内施放造成阴暗的法术会额外造成 10 点阴暗。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

e53e6ac2960c39517a9c080125bb460a93a09747.source: Scythe Attack. If it hits, this attack deals +1…8…10 damage and removes a Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, you do an additional +1…8…10 damage and strike all adjacent foes.
e53e6ac2960c39517a9c080125bb460a93a09747.text: 镰刀攻击。如果击中，这次攻击会造成 +1…8…10 点伤害并移除苦行僧结界。如果结界被移除，你会造成额外 +1…8…10 点伤害并攻击所有相邻的敌人。

726a878342a89d07e0a2ebcfee79f66bfb0bc3a8.source: Enchantment Spell. You gain 1…3…3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy. For 10 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1…3…3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy.
726a878342a89d07e0a2ebcfee79f66bfb0bc3a8.text: 结界咒语。 You gain 1…3…3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy. For 10 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing.当此结界结束时，你为听力范围内的每个敌人获得 1…3…3 点能量，最多 8 点能量。

ae40979d3e6d103c5c0b658b3f394f2f68aa0eae.source: Spell. Cause an Eruption at target foe's location. Each second for 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.
ae40979d3e6d103c5c0b658b3f394f2f68aa0eae.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置引起火山爆发。 Each second for 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.

6fc133d5175a794ad3c6dea52ba3616674415de7.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.
6fc133d5175a794ad3c6dea52ba3616674415de7.text: 精英姿态。 For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.

fa80e657ae6550a642c6e6775248701c8ac7d394.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks. Escape ends if you make a melee attack.
fa80e657ae6550a642c6e6775248701c8ac7d394.text: 精英姿态。在 1…7…8 秒内，你的移动速度加快 33%，并且有 75% 的机会阻挡攻击。如果你进行近战攻击，逃脱就会结束。

75e9e1178f589700cc3148b3ee99c14cabfd70b8.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes physical or elemental damage, you gain 1 Energy.
75e9e1178f589700cc3148b3ee99c14cabfd70b8.text: 结界咒语。 While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes physical or elemental damage, you gain 1 Energy.

f6fbbf628eb24884916d74bf0d8bac8c6c5ce86e.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…51…60 lightning damage. If any spirits are within earshot, you gain 1…7…9 Energy.
f6fbbf628eb24884916d74bf0d8bac8c6c5ce86e.text: 咒语。 Target foe is struck for 15…51…60 lightning damage.如果任何灵魂在听力范围内，你将获得 1…7…9 能量。

e3c9f764866292138ca4556f8d25c6be7cd4dc5d.source: Enchantment Spell. You have +100 max Health. When this enchantment ends, all party members in the area are resurrected with 40…50% Health and 20…30% Energy.
e3c9f764866292138ca4556f8d25c6be7cd4dc5d.text: 结界咒语。您的最大生命值为 +100。当此结界结束时，该区域内的所有小队成员都会复活并获得 40…50% 点生命值和 20…30% 点能量。

b5aa264f70769ccaec1b7f8870a9e29ba409e3ff.source: Spell. Target foe loses 4…6…7 Energy. You gain 2 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
b5aa264f70769ccaec1b7f8870a9e29ba409e3ff.text: 咒文。目标敌人损失 4…6…7 点能量。每损失一点能量，您就会获得 2 点能量。

dfaa72460af8a87a8d3d40801a8cb1536094c709.source: Spell. Target foe loses 3 Energy. You are healed 20…56…65 for each point of Energy lost.
dfaa72460af8a87a8d3d40801a8cb1536094c709.text: 咒文。目标敌人损失 3 点能量。每损失一点能量，你就会得到 20…56…65 点治疗。

b18ac00918ffa4c7e21ac99d04ed5e375ccee4f1.source: Hex Spell. You lose all Energy. For 5…9…10 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…3 Energy degeneration, and you experience +1…3…3 Energy regeneration.
b18ac00918ffa4c7e21ac99d04ed5e375ccee4f1.text: 降咒魔法。你失去了所有能量。 For 5…9…10 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…3 Energy degeneration, and you experience +1…3…3 Energy regeneration.

62ff7116fea56c853719f269508e64da42f65f9d.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 25…45…50 lightning damage and suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
62ff7116fea56c853719f269508e64da42f65f9d.text: 咒文。目标敌人受到 25…45…50 点闪电伤害，并遭受虚弱 5…17…20 秒。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

0443910f35392af261dfac7a287321afc748e44c.source: Spell. Target suffers from Weakness for 10…26…30 seconds.
0443910f35392af261dfac7a287321afc748e44c.text: 咒语。目标处于虚弱状态10…26…30秒。

5d674eebd9bf46260d2b581bbb4c7b0bc908191e.source: Hex Spell. Target foe loses 5…8 Energy. For each point of Energy lost in this way, that foe and all foes in the area suffer -1 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
5d674eebd9bf46260d2b581bbb4c7b0bc908191e.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人损失 5…8 点能量。以这种方式每损失一点能量，该敌人和该区域内的所有敌人都会遭受 -1 生命值退化，持续 10 秒。

989d69692a95da2ed33c7d5e781919c5847a1b8b.source: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe has -1 Energy degeneration. If this hex is removed prematurely, that foe loses 1…4…5 Energy.
989d69692a95da2ed33c7d5e781919c5847a1b8b.text: 降咒魔法。 10秒内，目标敌人有-1点能量衰退。 If this hex is removed prematurely, that foe loses 1…4…5 Energy.

1d85ab3b6f1aae4a35081a88ae59e0a9de5d03c1.source: Elite Skill. For 3 seconds, all damage you take is reduced by 75%. When Ether Prism ends, you gain 5…17…20 Energy.
1d85ab3b6f1aae4a35081a88ae59e0a9de5d03c1.text: 精英技能。 3秒内，你受到的所有伤害减少75%点。以太棱镜结束时，你获得5…17…20点能量。

cd46c0aa747c1bc3eb50502a52771b5cec99e37c.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Lose all enchantments. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +6 Energy regeneration. When Ether Prodigy ends, you lose 2 Health for each point of Energy you have.
cd46c0aa747c1bc3eb50502a52771b5cec99e37c.text: 精英结界法术。失去所有结界。 For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +6 Energy regeneration. When Ether Prodigy ends, you lose 2 Health for each point of Energy you have.

04d49ddde9a97a50dda8f544f7bca70d148a3cbd.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, each time you cast a spell, you gain 1…3…4 Energy and 5…17…20 Health for each enchantment on you.
04d49ddde9a97a50dda8f544f7bca70d148a3cbd.text: 精英结界法术。在 5…17…20 秒内，每次施展法术，你身上的每个结界都会获得 1…3…4 点能量和 5…17…20 点生命值。

34a096ba954ef4735bae1e0a51245595374e922f.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, each time you cast a spell, you gain 1…3…3 Energy and 5…17…20 Health for each enchantment on you.
34a096ba954ef4735bae1e0a51245595374e922f.text: 精英结界法术。 For 10 seconds, each time you cast a spell, you gain 1…3…3 Energy and 5…17…20 Health for each enchantment on you.

c247b3c160a37cd650e592a7cbd885ab91b26157.source: Signet. If you have less than 5…9…10 Energy, gain 10…18…20 Energy.
c247b3c160a37cd650e592a7cbd885ab91b26157.text: 印章。 If you have less than 5…9…10 Energy, gain 10…18…20 Energy.

6c2bae6c69d6c04627893b25915eac621fd60817.source: Hex Spell. For 6…11…12 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When Ethereal Burden ends, you gain 10…16…18 Energy.
6c2bae6c69d6c04627893b25915eac621fd60817.text: 降咒魔法。在 6…11…12 秒内，目标敌人的移动速度减慢 50%。 When Ethereal Burden ends, you gain 10…16…18 Energy.

fb30a15135ee10eedb0fa891c7fedeeb85129cf1.source: Spell. Target ally is healed for 25…85…100. This spell is easily interrupted.
fb30a15135ee10eedb0fa891c7fedeeb85129cf1.text: 咒语。目标盟友治疗 25…85…100 点。该法术很容易被打断。

c1478636e4a5281db9f457ccf70c6f5585f350b1.source: Elite Axe Attack. If Eviscerate hits, you strike for +10…38…45 damage and inflict a Deep Wound, lowering your target's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.
c1478636e4a5281db9f457ccf70c6f5585f350b1.text: 精英斧头攻击。 If Eviscerate hits, you strike for +10…38…45 damage and inflict a Deep Wound, lowering your target's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.

d72203302a33e1b1435c79a41c820eccfef1c917.source: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +15…39…45 damage.
d72203302a33e1b1435c79a41c820eccfef1c917.text: 斧头攻击。 If this attack hits, you strike for +15…39…45 damage.

4b2f2daf27058b1cc40e4a1d19486a0fbe71e6e6.source: Dual Attack. Must follow a lead attack. Target foe's action is interrupted. If that action was casting a spell, target foe suffers 10 Overcast.
4b2f2daf27058b1cc40e4a1d19486a0fbe71e6e6.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。目标敌人的行动被打断。 If that action was casting a spell, target foe suffers 10 Overcast.

aaea6edf567dfcf51b65a92c3981371511734fac.source: Elite Spell. Remove up to 2 Hexes from target ally.
aaea6edf567dfcf51b65a92c3981371511734fac.text: 精英法术。从目标盟友身上移除最多 2 个六角形。

44f1e5e083a31b86ed1a8ab05e858435bfb9a2c8.source: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your bow attack skills cost 1…2…2 less Energy and deal 1…8…10 extra damage.
44f1e5e083a31b86ed1a8ab05e858435bfb9a2c8.text: 准备。在 24 秒内，你的弓箭攻击技能消耗 1…2…2 点能量，并造成 1…8…10 点额外伤害。

7785e9326694940dab6f5ba73157cbc5c38c2c38.source: Elite Stance. For 1…16…20 seconds, you attack 33% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 2.
7785e9326694940dab6f5ba73157cbc5c38c2c38.text: 精英姿态。持续1…16…20秒，你的攻击速度加快33%，你的射击属性增加2。

28b6eacc0a056c0855ebb21f4dfb6dbc77436f67.source: Elite Stance. For 1…16…20 seconds, you attack 15% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 1.
28b6eacc0a056c0855ebb21f4dfb6dbc77436f67.text: 精英姿态。持续1…16…20秒，你的攻击速度加快15%，你的射击属性增加1。

ffee8ee27e0799f7b53e4e2944ba7b04758f5d0b.source: Enchantment Spell. For 15…51…60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, up to 5 foes near that creature are struck for 20…56…65 lightning damage.
ffee8ee27e0799f7b53e4e2944ba7b04758f5d0b.text: 结界咒语。在 15…51…60 秒内，每当你创造一个生物时，该生物附近最多 5 个敌人会受到 20…56…65 点闪电伤害。

021ca1a9a2a8db5bda6b502e340c71b0298d044b.source: Hex Spell. For 1…9…11 seconds, target foe cannot block your attacks.
021ca1a9a2a8db5bda6b502e340c71b0298d044b.text: 降咒魔法。在 1…9…11 秒内，目标敌人无法阻挡你的攻击。

3c964de4c25cae1d694ce4b279d2c80ca257b8c8.source: Skill. Target foe loses 1 enchantment. All of your other non-attack skills are disabled for 8…5…4 seconds. For each skill disabled in this way, target touched foe loses 1 additional enchantment.
3c964de4c25cae1d694ce4b279d2c80ca257b8c8.text: 技能。目标敌人失去 1 点结界。你的所有其他非攻击技能将被禁用 8…5…4 秒。对于以这种方式禁用的每个技能，目标接触的敌人会失去 1 点额外的魔力。

7f35fdb43e710952e9b6fb69b42d44835a44a270.source: Elite Spell. Spread all conditions from target foe to foes near your target. The durations of those conditions are increased by 5…81…100% (maximum 30 seconds).
7f35fdb43e710952e9b6fb69b42d44835a44a270.text: 精英法术。将所有状况从目标敌人传播到目标附近的敌人。这些条件的持续时间增加 5…81…100%（最长 30 秒）。

c7e88aed85911ce5e806765ba6ad233f1fb12cdd.source: Skill. For 10 seconds, your next Dervish enchantment lasts 10…122…150% longer.
c7e88aed85911ce5e806765ba6ad233f1fb12cdd.text: 技能。在 10 秒内，你的下一个苦行僧结界将持续 10…122…150% 秒。

43bdc0a5fc3df3f416b725427fe2ce7e93a3b4b4.source: Spell. Remove one condition from each party member. Party members relieved of Burning are healed for 10…82…100 Health.
43bdc0a5fc3df3f416b725427fe2ce7e93a3b4b4.text: 咒语。取消每位队员的一项条件。解除燃烧的队员治愈了 10…82…100 点生命值。

cd6727984581ffde5270d5f9787c261c4deeb5cf.source: Hex Spell. For the next 4…15…18 seconds, target foe attacks 50% slower, and that foe suffers -1…3…3 Health degeneration.
cd6727984581ffde5270d5f9787c261c4deeb5cf.text: 降咒魔法。在接下来的 4…15…18 秒内，目标敌人的攻击速度减慢 50%，并且该敌人遭受 -1…3…3 点生命值退化。

d5bb841aa73132cb023bd6ddb45a33af8149d1ad.source: Enchantment Spell. If damage drops your Health below 50%, Faithful Intervention ends. When Faithful Intervention ends, you are healed for 30…126…150 Health.
d5bb841aa73132cb023bd6ddb45a33af8149d1ad.text: 结界咒语。如果伤害使你的生命值低于 50%，忠实干预就会结束。当忠实干预结束时，你将获得 30…126…150 点生命值的治愈。

46cfbe7480cd1c8335ab63eb905e40d21f0b7580.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must strike a knocked-down foe. If it hits, you strike for +15…31…35 damage and gain 1…10…12 Energy.
46cfbe7480cd1c8335ab63eb905e40d21f0b7580.text: 副手攻击。必须攻击被击倒的敌人。如果击中，你将受到 +15…31…35 点伤害并获得 1…10…12 点能量。

d60803667f7048baf127016e2df3b4710fc51ed8.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must strike a knocked-down foe. If it hits, Falling Spider strikes for +15…31…35 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds.
d60803667f7048baf127016e2df3b4710fc51ed8.text: 副手攻击。必须攻击被击倒的敌人。如果击中，坠落蜘蛛会造成 +15…31…35 点伤害，并且目标敌人中毒 5…17…20 秒。

7c4e1be61cd192a37ecc7654c6fe33a1f2e03543.source: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes suffer from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
7c4e1be61cd192a37ecc7654c6fe33a1f2e03543.text: 咒文。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会受到虚弱的影响，持续 5…17…20 秒。

15cba6829341c53ce22acc825d108f2add07553c.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit creature in its range reaches 0 Energy, that creature takes 20…60…70 damage. This spirit dies after 30…150…180 seconds.
15cba6829341c53ce22acc825d108f2add07553c.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。每当其范围内的非灵体生物的能量达到 0 时，该生物就会受到 20…60…70 点伤害。该灵魂会在 30…150…180 秒后死亡。

b345d9630649944bd882dd9427a639f1d0b80695.source: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If you hit more than one foe, this attack recharges instantly.
b345d9630649944bd882dd9427a639f1d0b80695.text: 镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果你击中了多个敌人，这种攻击会立即恢复。

0c5cb4c5d8b1b437a90a0b57f8461a090092f615.source: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…29…35 damage. If you hit more than one foe, this attack recharges instantly.
0c5cb4c5d8b1b437a90a0b57f8461a090092f615.text: 镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。如果你击中了多个敌人，这种攻击会立即恢复。

a9a23433820d406934f825e070406633c899204d.source: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes suffer from Weakness for 1…13…16 seconds.
a9a23433820d406934f825e070406633c899204d.text: 咒文。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会受到虚弱的影响，持续 1…13…16 秒。

d81223426631531858b960b40d4eeb19703d6cf1.source: Skill. Target touched foe loses 5…53…65 Health and suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
d81223426631531858b960b40d4eeb19703d6cf1.text: 技能。目标触及敌人会损失 5…53…65 点生命值并遭受虚弱 5…17…20 秒。

08f09f7a3555affc23ab0d5ad5b66d6770d1f065.source: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts an Enraged Lunge that applies a Deep Wound to target foe for 5…17…20 seconds and deals +10…42…50 damage.
08f09f7a3555affc23ab0d5ad5b66d6770d1f065.text: 精英宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行激怒突袭，对目标敌人造成深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒，并造成 +10…42…50 点伤害。

73bce4eb23733169713a24aab73d62f43c7c32ea.source: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts an Enraged Lunge that deals +3…19…23 damage (maximum bonus 60) for each recharging Beast Mastery skill.
73bce4eb23733169713a24aab73d62f43c7c32ea.text: 精英宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴会尝试一次狂怒冲刺，每次充能野兽掌握技能都会造成 +3…19…23 点伤害（最大加值 60）。

3e9e6ae11663ff001858d0b29976ff1232a0ca06.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If Enraged Smash hits, you gain 1…3…4 strikes of adrenaline. If you hit a moving foe, you strike for +10…34…40 damage, and target foe is knocked down.
3e9e6ae11663ff001858d0b29976ff1232a0ca06.text: 精英锤攻击。如果激怒粉碎击中，你将获得 1…3…4 次肾上腺素打击。如果你击中移动的敌人，你会造成 +10…34…40 点伤害，并且目标敌人被击倒。

767cd1d257ba7f79453d4d71a6f4fb20ed2b3e58.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If Enraged Smash hits, you gain 1…3…3 strikes of adrenaline. If you hit a moving foe, you strike for +10…34…40 damage, and target foe is knocked down.
767cd1d257ba7f79453d4d71a6f4fb20ed2b3e58.text: 精英锤攻击。如果激怒粉碎击中，你将获得 1…3…3 次肾上腺素打击。如果你击中移动的敌人，你会造成 +10…34…40 点伤害，并且目标敌人被击倒。

ddae16f942906ed9f89eaafb75c8abb53fc56d3a.source: Stance. For 5…13…15 seconds, you move 25% faster. Enraging Charge ends when you successfully strike a target, at which point you gain 0…2…3 strikes of adrenaline if you hit with a melee attack.
ddae16f942906ed9f89eaafb75c8abb53fc56d3a.text: 立场。在 5…13…15 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。当你成功击中目标时，激怒冲锋就会结束，此时，如果你用近战攻击击中，你将获得 0…2…3 次肾上腺素打击。

217ede217f7560afea678221d3bd7339df9b43f5.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, arrows move twice as fast and strike for +6 damage. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
217ede217f7560afea678221d3bd7339df9b43f5.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。对于其射程内的非精神生物，箭的移动速度是原来的两倍，并且造成 +6 伤害。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

0404c12ec6b25d61d5e700080812aae7ae9a8112.source: Spell. Destroy target animated undead ally. All of your other animated undead allies are healed for 10…82…100 Health.
0404c12ec6b25d61d5e700080812aae7ae9a8112.text: 咒语。摧毁目标动画不死盟友。你的所有其他动画不死盟友都获得了 10…82…100 点生命值的治疗。

201525751c76ecb759a57dc95303541b28530bbf.source: Elite Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 16…67…80 shadow damage. You steal up to 8…34…40 Health from each struck foe who is suffering from a hex.
201525751c76ecb759a57dc95303541b28530bbf.text: 精英法术。目标敌人和所有邻近敌人都会受到 16…67…80 点暗影伤害。您可以从每个遭受妖术攻击的敌人身上窃取最多 8…34…40 点生命值。

71d4c41c43e5ef558b56b67675d1ef52a012d733.source: Spell. Entangling Asp must follow a lead attack. Target foe is knocked down and becomes Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds.
71d4c41c43e5ef558b56b67675d1ef52a012d733.text: 咒文。纠缠天冬氨酸必须跟随先导攻击。目标敌人被击倒并中毒 5…17…20 秒。

f0a2a315d09be863cf02e513db200bb713e14b81.source: Spell. Target foe loses one enchantment. For every remaining enchantment, target foe is poisoned for 3…9…10 seconds.
f0a2a315d09be863cf02e513db200bb713e14b81.text: 咒语。目标敌人失去一项结界。每剩余一个结界，目标敌人就会中毒 3…9…10 秒。

0fbb9f01bd3d570391ad959acbc4123bd8f5945b.source: Spell. Spread all negative conditions and their remaining durations from target foe to all foes adjacent to your target.
0fbb9f01bd3d570391ad959acbc4123bd8f5945b.text: 咒语。将所有负面状况及其剩余持续时间从目标敌人传播到与目标相邻的所有敌人。

c3586025b33f28d062a0537e298f1009e0732d4c.source: Spell. Destroy all nearby allies' spirits. For each spirit destroyed in this way, all party members are healed for 50…90…100 Health.
c3586025b33f28d062a0537e298f1009e0732d4c.text: 咒文。消灭附近所有盟友的灵魂。对于以这种方式摧毁的每个灵魂，所有小队成员都会得到 50…90…100 点生命值的治疗。

6e7a28479fba01631938a64055b3cfbe13dc5b9c.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and conditions expire 50% faster.
6e7a28479fba01631938a64055b3cfbe13dc5b9c.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，您的移动速度快了 25%，条件到期速度快了 50%。

818d1f559268da0b15ce990fe47b0fda33959f00.source: Enchantment Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, you have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. This enchantment ends if you successfully hit with an attack or use a skill.
818d1f559268da0b15ce990fe47b0fda33959f00.text: 结界咒语。在 4…9…10 秒内，你拥有 +7 点生命恢复和 +80 点护甲。如果你成功攻击或使用技能，此结界就会结束。

2bfeeb8fd5048051f807b0e662b9af19a39631dd.source: Skill. For 5…17…20 seconds, your pet attacks 33% faster and deals +3…9…10 additional damage.
2bfeeb8fd5048051f807b0e662b9af19a39631dd.text: 技能。在 5…17…20 秒内，你的宠物攻击速度提高 33% 点，并造成 +3…9…10 点额外伤害。

5040984931b11fa8222f5bc79254da8594c2c56a.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Feral Lunge that deals +5…29…35 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is attacking, that foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…21…25 seconds.
5040984931b11fa8222f5bc79254da8594c2c56a.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行野性冲刺，造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。如果攻击击中正在攻击的敌人，该敌人会流血5…21…25秒。

a2cd956effa51572116dc477ba002453335e30df.source: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.
a2cd956effa51572116dc477ba002453335e30df.text: 精英宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行凶猛打击，造成 +13…25…28 点伤害。如果攻击命中，你将获得肾上腺素和 3…9…10 能量。

0bda0fe4a800c8898703f9f37d9a6ef763742704.source: Spell. Target foe loses one enchantment. If an enchantment is removed in this way, that foe also loses 4…9…10 Energy.
0bda0fe4a800c8898703f9f37d9a6ef763742704.text: 咒文。目标敌人失去一项结界。如果以这种方式移除结界，该敌人也会损失 4…9…10 点能量。

9c0791478c6c4473976f8be33f361cc20f1ba416.source: Skill. For 30 seconds you have +2…3 Health regeneration. If you are drunk when activating this skill, you also have +200…300 maximum Health.
9c0791478c6c4473976f8be33f361cc20f1ba416.text: 技能。在 30 秒内，您将获得 +2…3 点生命值回复。如果你在激活该技能时喝醉了，你还有+200…300最大生命值。

7c26671f644ad80fb16b425024f738a56929b770.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.
7c26671f644ad80fb16b425024f738a56929b770.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 4…9…10 秒内，你无法被击倒并且移动速度加快 25%。如果该结界阻止击倒，它就会提前结束。

d7598b59a97c84d8cd1fc9cc28e6960b035da13c.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2…7…8 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.
d7598b59a97c84d8cd1fc9cc28e6960b035da13c.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 2…7…8 秒内，你无法被击倒并且移动速度加快 25%。如果该结界阻止击倒，它就会提前结束。

1761de3f2c2f893667cc63bc1f3f13af523736f0.source: Spell. Lose half your Health. Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 5…17…20% Energy.
1761de3f2c2f893667cc63bc1f3f13af523736f0.text: 咒语。失去一半的生命值。以你当前的生命值和 5…17…20% 能量复活目标队员。

b3cb8593f97c630d9e51ed27fe10e70d9b85ef11.source: Elite Skill. All of your attack skills become recharged. You gain 2…6…7 Energy for each skill recharged by Flourish.
b3cb8593f97c630d9e51ed27fe10e70d9b85ef11.text: 精英技能。你所有的攻击技能都会被充能。每通过 Flourish 充能一次技能，你就会获得 2…6…7 点能量。

d387dc2bc58c236fd641f876cd2a80b258857ead.source: Stance. For 5 seconds, your attack rate is increased by 33%, but you deal 25% less damage.
d387dc2bc58c236fd641f876cd2a80b258857ead.text: 立场。在 5 秒内，你的攻击率提高 33%，但造成的伤害减少 25%。

73077b84a6daa606ff4001b899e11822b61259fc.source: Elite Skill. For 45 seconds, you gain 0…120…150% more adrenaline.
73077b84a6daa606ff4001b899e11822b61259fc.text: 精英技能。在 45 秒内，您会获得额外 0…120…150% 的肾上腺素。

96bf53e21fe0c6c02eda560cc901017677fa4c2f.source: Bow Attack. This shot moves three times faster, cannot be blocked, and strikes for +10…34…40 damage but all of your other attack skills are disabled for 8…5…4 seconds.
96bf53e21fe0c6c02eda560cc901017677fa4c2f.text: 弓攻击。该射击移动速度快三倍，无法被格挡，造成 +10…34…40 点伤害，但你的所有其他攻击技能将被禁用 8…5…4 秒。

ed61b927a6bbf602cca393b47ad90c8b462fa8ce.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If Forceful Blow hits, you strike for +10…26…30 damage and any stance being used by target foe ends. Target foe suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
ed61b927a6bbf602cca393b47ad90c8b462fa8ce.text: 精英锤攻击。如果强力打击击中，你会造成 +10…26…30 点伤害，并且目标敌人所使用的任何姿态都会结束。目标敌人受到虚弱5…17…20秒。此攻击无法被阻止。

40fefdbe2851c88fb99747d38da7b80fc97b0ad5.source: Bow Attack. Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. If you are under the effects of an enchantment or hex, you shoot only one arrow.
40fefdbe2851c88fb99747d38da7b80fc97b0ad5.text: 弓攻击。同时向目标敌人射出两支箭。如果你受到结界或妖术的影响，你只能射出一支箭。

653ebdabae84c9288a2619b97c420c70f0f295ec.source: Spell. All conditions are transferred from target other ally to yourself. For each condition acquired in this way, you gain 0…36…45 Health and 2…4…4 Energy. This skill recharges twice as fast if you remove Disease from your target.
653ebdabae84c9288a2619b97c420c70f0f295ec.text: 咒语。所有条件均从目标其他盟友转移到您自己。对于以这种方式获得的每个条件，您将获得 0…36…45 点生命值和 2…4…4 点能量。如果您从目标中移除疾病，则该技能的恢复速度会加快两倍。

c667586545c4a18f00d0d2ae63f45543a9d2ecea.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range have +50…130…150 maximum Health and gain +8 armor. This spirit dies after 15…75…90 seconds.
c667586545c4a18f00d0d2ae63f45543a9d2ecea.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。范围内的非灵体生物拥有 +50…130…150 最大生命值并获得 +8 护甲值。该灵魂会在 15…75…90 秒后死亡。

36772717b079a8aa3621743b0d63564d0c7970c4.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…55…65 cold damage. If that foe is knocked down, that foe becomes Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds.
36772717b079a8aa3621743b0d63564d0c7970c4.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 15…55…65 点寒冷伤害。如果该敌人被击倒，则该敌人会中毒 5…17…20 秒。

27f7b5e7f7501f5195f071b2f9c52929a9c1d4ad.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10…22…25 seconds, whenever target foe suffers from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that condition as well. If target foe has two or more conditions that foe is Dazed for 1…3…3 seconds.
27f7b5e7f7501f5195f071b2f9c52929a9c1d4ad.text: 精英六角咒语。在 10…22…25 秒内，每当目标敌人遭受新的状况时，该区域中的所有敌人也会遭受该状况。如果目标敌人有两种或以上状况，则敌人晕眩 1…3…3 秒。

7795d3a7eb1f91240d23938ecd9d3a763fce9625.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe suffers from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that condition as well.
7795d3a7eb1f91240d23938ecd9d3a763fce9625.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…13…15 秒内，每当目标敌人遭受新的状况时，该区域中的所有敌人也会遭受该状况。

ac0aecf44a37113dd2e76462f94132598ecff30e.source: Hammer Attack. If Fierce Blow hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage. If target foe was suffering from Weakness, that foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 1…7…8 seconds.
ac0aecf44a37113dd2e76462f94132598ecff30e.text: 锤子攻击。如果猛击命中，你会受到 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人受到虚弱的影响，则该敌人也会受到深度伤害，持续 1…7…8 秒。

5cd7937506869bcd0fedade061d244568ac7f271.source: Sword Attack. Lose all adrenaline. If Final Thrust hits, you deal 5…33…40 more damage. This damage is doubled if your target was below 50% Health.
5cd7937506869bcd0fedade061d244568ac7f271.text: 剑攻击。失去所有肾上腺素。如果最终刺击击中，你会造成 5…33…40 点以上伤害。如果你的目标生命值低于 50%，则伤害会加倍。

324ae266ed241cf2a85f29fe1bfb14447b563696.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally is healed for 15…63…75 Health.
324ae266ed241cf2a85f29fe1bfb14447b563696.text: 回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当目标非精神盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，该盟友就会受到 15…63…75 点生命值的治疗。

02cf061e3d1b077c50ad6bd542f55710a175e5bb.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, the next 5 times that a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally is healed for 15…63…75 Health.
02cf061e3d1b077c50ad6bd542f55710a175e5bb.text: 回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，接下来的 5 次吟唱或喊叫在目标非精神盟友上结束时，该盟友将被治疗 15…63…75 点生命值。

dcce255c2ad68561f0fe8bd0dddfab2d93161aa2.source: Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, you are attuned to Fire. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Fire Magic.
dcce255c2ad68561f0fe8bd0dddfab2d93161aa2.text: 结界咒语。在 36…55…60 秒的时间里，你与火协调。每次使用火系魔法时，你将获得 1 点能量加上该技能的基础能量消耗 30% 点。

18ac82800e078ebe2895b546172c870806212ad7.source: Spell. Create a Fire Storm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 5…29…35 fire damage each second.
18ac82800e078ebe2895b546172c870806212ad7.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置制造火焰风暴。持续 10 秒，该位置附近的敌人每秒受到 5…29…35 点火焰伤害。

85142ccc4644283c0876d5ea2c014dbddafb4052.source: Spell. Send out a ball of fire that strikes target foe and all nearby foes for 7…91…112 fire damage.
85142ccc4644283c0876d5ea2c014dbddafb4052.text: 咒语。发射一个火球，攻击目标敌人和附近的所有敌人，造成 7…91…112 点火焰伤害。

60736d4af861d87a1d8708619c227e0c7834a073.source: Stance. For 1…12…15 seconds, you attack 33% faster but move 33% slower.
60736d4af861d87a1d8708619c227e0c7834a073.text: 立场。在 1…12…15 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 33%，但移动速度减慢 33%。

9211ac838fe45847285d0988d7425f7e08facb38.source: Stance. For 1…12…15 seconds, you attack 33% faster but move 33% slower. Ends if you use a ranged attack skill.
9211ac838fe45847285d0988d7425f7e08facb38.text: 立场。在 1…12…15 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 33%，但移动速度减慢 33%。如果您使用远程攻击技能则结束。

89aaf7f3cd5a0801a7842e04472cc1d5f849f8d2.source: Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 15…99…120 fire damage.
89aaf7f3cd5a0801a7842e04472cc1d5f849f8d2.text: 咒语。所有附近的敌人都会受到 15…99…120 点火焰伤害。

7a6e568b5f95adfb22556a281fe8c4e920bec8a0.source: Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes are struck for 15…99…120 fire damage. For 8…13…14 seconds, you move 25% faster. Flame Djinn's Haste recharges 50% faster if a foe was struck by this spell.
7a6e568b5f95adfb22556a281fe8c4e920bec8a0.text: 结界咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会受到 15…99…120 点火焰伤害。在 8…13…14 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。如果敌人被此法术击中，火焰巨灵的急速充能速度会加快 50%。

68483c335c29b91292339abdc52048747b65ca37.source: Trap. When Flame Trap is triggered, every second (for 3 seconds total), all nearby foes are struck for 5…17…20 fire damage and set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds. Flame Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
68483c335c29b91292339abdc52048747b65ca37.text: 陷阱。当火焰陷阱被触发时，每秒（总计 3 秒），所有附近的敌人都会受到 5…17…20 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…3…3 秒。火焰陷阱在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

1b28bd9838c6ed0b6d8500d55ffe454833f24679.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. Fox Fangs cannot be blocked and strikes for +10…30…35 damage if it hits.
1b28bd9838c6ed0b6d8500d55ffe454833f24679.text: 副手攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。狐牙无法被格挡，击中后会造成 +10…30…35 伤害。

18915ebd6630decf38827a7636d9de550b5ac411.text: 咒文。发射一枚照明弹，击中目标敌人时会造成 20…56…65 点火焰伤害。如果你处于阴天，耀斑也会击中相邻的敌人。

e42891cdf24858d00e59f86d838a96f7d2eff185.source: Elite Stance. For 5…25…30 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks while attacking. If you block an attack in this way, your attacker takes 5…17…20 damage.
e42891cdf24858d00e59f86d838a96f7d2eff185.text: 精英姿态。在 5…25…30 秒内，你在攻击时有 75% 的机会阻挡传入的攻击。如果您以这种方式阻止攻击，您的攻击者将受到 5…17…20 点伤害。

1145df5af6ed13513506b017eeae816c423de5c2.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. Fox Fangs cannot be blocked and strikes for +10…22…25 damage if it hits.
1145df5af6ed13513506b017eeae816c423de5c2.text: 副手攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。狐牙无法被格挡，击中后会造成 +10…22…25 伤害。

24cd87d4ab249a4359757260e261ecf439162ff8.text: 剑攻击。 This attack strikes for +1…32…40 damage if it hits.

b64c15a3ef2db793cbcb7fa2325dca6b7b4678d2.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits a Bleeding foe, you strike for 5…17…20 more damage and that foe suffers a Deep Wound, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.
b64c15a3ef2db793cbcb7fa2325dca6b7b4678d2.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击击中正在流血的敌人，你会额外造成 5…17…20 点伤害，并且该敌人会受到深度伤害，从而使该敌人的最大生命值降低 20% 点，持续 5…17…20 秒。

1f01f02f3967e752a0524d26f09c645f57c52396.text: 咒语。 Target foe is struck for 20…56…65 lightning damage. If you are within earshot of a spirit, that foe is Blinded for 2…5…6 seconds.

1ae6780af708da2604893965c92fbdda6f409b43.text: 降咒魔法。在 8…18…20 秒内，目标和邻近敌人每次遭受新状况或从新状况恢复时都会受到 5…17…20 点伤害。

78d0adcbd6d06231238a35eb0f3522a0b6854d78.source: Hex Spell. If target foe is under the effect of a Water Magic hex, that foe is struck for 20…68…80 cold damage. Otherwise, that foe moves 66% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.

b039016dc00b5f2685f75755f7418d5fa4469360.source: Stance. For 8 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks, but take double damage.

62cbde301485663799dad94e8514d04098e68d95.text: 精英姿态。在 5…10…11 秒内，您有 75% 次机会阻止传入攻击。每当你以这种方式阻挡近战攻击时，攻击者都会受到 5…29…35 点伤害。

28110a657bbb133e0545de4f2a6e0de2ec64e43a.source: Elite Preparation. For 10…30…35 seconds, your arrows strike for +6…17…20 damage if they hit and cause Bleeding for 10…18…20 seconds if they are blocked.

379947d6239eb33881b8b94453864f4928106659.source: Skill. You and target touched foe are knocked down. You lose your current stance.
379947d6239eb33881b8b94453864f4928106659.text: 技能。你和目标接触的敌人都会被击倒。你会失去当前的立场。

dffe1a4aa3615c4a9bbce4533a0010ca1d672afa.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, all nearby foes move 50% slower.
dffe1a4aa3615c4a9bbce4533a0010ca1d672afa.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，所有附近敌人的移动速度减慢 50%。

b8507553cb74325ba451d7c31c74c5bf6a52e922.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Kuurong's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…63…75 damage and knocked down.
b8507553cb74325ba451d7c31c74c5bf6a52e922.text: 精英物品法术。保留 Kuurong 的骨灰长达 15…51…60 秒。当你撒下他的骨灰时，该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 15…63…75 点伤害并被击倒。

0056b66ba6308064cea519d3f2815a47beaed3df.source: Enchantment Spell. For 22…40 seconds, target ally has +24 armor, +60 maximum Health, and an additional +24 armor against Destroyers.
0056b66ba6308064cea519d3f2815a47beaed3df.text: 结界咒语。持续 22…40 秒，目标盟友拥有 +24 点护甲、+60 最大生命值，以及针对毁灭者的额外 +24 点护甲。

806222b1c2ccdf2b41ede5008b3418d0c69f7209.source: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target other ally's weapon strikes for +15…20 damage and has a 28…40% chance to cause knock down.
806222b1c2ccdf2b41ede5008b3418d0c69f7209.text: 武器咒语。 20 秒内，目标其他盟友的武器攻击造成 +15…20 伤害，并有 28…40% 几率造成击倒。

dcaec8a240e708ef7f98c9af3f6c1e0b390f8859.source: Spell. Send a projectile that strikes for 5…41…50 earth damage if it hits. If this spell hits a weakened Unlike the concise description, "weakened" is lowercase here foe, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
dcaec8a240e708ef7f98c9af3f6c1e0b390f8859.text: 咒文。发射一枚射弹，击中目标5…41…50如果撞击，会对地球造成损害。如果这个法术击中弱化的敌人，与简洁的描述不同，“弱化”在这里是小写的敌人，你将获得5能量加1为每个人提供能源2储能排名。

c99a919fe6a78b3d45e39723402c9f4b9f8e9933.source: Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next 1 spell cannot be interrupted and ignores the effects of being Dazed.
c99a919fe6a78b3d45e39723402c9f4b9f8e9933.text: 字形。在 15 秒内，你的下一个 1 个法术无法被打断并忽略晕眩的效果。

8bc300c369ebd80d11e22fe7f23f4f05480443f7.source: Glyph. For 25 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 2 for your next 10 spells.
8bc300c369ebd80d11e22fe7f23f4f05480443f7.text: 字形。在 25 秒内，你的元素属性将在接下来的 10 个法术中提升 2 点。

d3d0a49979210c3a498fb9d5685705cca9c6fb98.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all physical damage is fire damage instead. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
d3d0a49979210c3a498fb9d5685705cca9c6fb98.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。对于其范围内的非灵体生物，所有物理伤害均改为火焰伤害。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

b08902d7b0aa308040e2aa7b5dd043937eba3268.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you deal 5…21…25 less damage and steal 5…21…25 Health whenever you hit with a scythe attack. When you cast this enchantment you steal 5…21…25 Health from all adjacent foes.
b08902d7b0aa308040e2aa7b5dd043937eba3268.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 20 秒内，每当你用镰刀攻击击中时，你造成的伤害会减少 5…21…25 点，并会窃取 5…21…25 点生命值。当你施放此结界时，你会从所有邻近的敌人身上窃取 5…21…25 点生命值。

0161295b3fea61603f780909ab68420766156e5e.source: Elite Spell. If target foe has more Health than you, you gain half the difference (up to your maximum Health), and that foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose half the difference, and that foe gains an equal amount.
0161295b3fea61603f780909ab68420766156e5e.text: 精英法术。如果目标敌人的生命值比你多，你将获得一半的差异（最多可达你的最大生命值），而该敌人会损失等量的生命值。如果该敌人的生命值低于您，您将损失一半的生命值，而该敌人则获得同等数量的生命值。

2a9541ce2ba5b4a9808857b71abd9fc611bba081.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 cold damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal cold damage. When this enchantment ends, you transfer 1…2…2 conditions to all nearby foes. Additional word spacing (i.e. 2 spaces instead of the usual 1 space) after "transfer".
2a9541ce2ba5b4a9808857b71abd9fc611bba081.text: 闪光附魔咒语。附近所有敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点寒冷伤害。你的攻击会造成冰冷伤害，持续 30 秒。当此结界结束时，你将 1…2…2 条件转移给所有附近的敌人。 “转移”后的额外字间距（即 2 个空格，而不是通常的 1 个空格）。

bf10c328f0418c7532e350fac10a24a8198a984b.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, your attack skills also Cripple that foe for 1…9…11 seconds and you transfer 1…3…3 conditions from yourself to that foe.
bf10c328f0418c7532e350fac10a24a8198a984b.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。在 20 秒内，你的攻击技能也会使该敌人瘫痪 1…9…11 秒，并且你将 1…3…3 状态从你自己转移到该敌人身上。

7bff65942283739a766b6d9f8aac140e1a3904c7.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage. If this attack is blocked, your target is knocked down and suffers 10…29…34 damage.
7bff65942283739a766b6d9f8aac140e1a3904c7.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果这次攻击被格挡，你的目标就会被击倒并遭受 10…29…34 点伤害。

0fd40488716de3edf0440123f4dbbddf9ff282d4.source: Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, target ally gains +4…8…9 Health regeneration.
0fd40488716de3edf0440123f4dbbddf9ff282d4.text: 结界咒语。 15 秒内，目标盟友获得 +4…8…9 点生命恢复。

5b1713e1727e78858eb050946ecc98ad910c5465.source: Elite Spell. Target ally is healed for 20…100…120. All party members in earshot of your target gain Health equal to the Divine Favor bonus from this spell. Your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
5b1713e1727e78858eb050946ecc98ad910c5465.text: 精英法术。目标盟友获得 20…100…120 点治疗。目标听力范围内的所有小队成员都会获得等于该法术神圣恩惠加值的生命值。你的重击祈祷被禁用 20 秒。

9517694c985411be4eb2b9831e5d0a965a2a0667.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage, that ally is healed for 5…29…35 Health.
9517694c985411be4eb2b9831e5d0a965a2a0667.text: 精英结界法术。在 10 秒内，每当目标盟友受到伤害时，该盟友就会恢复 5…29…35 点生命值。

9b6a45585b7da3033fe439edd0d6b60347614f41.source: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 40…104…120 Health. If your target has an enchantment, you gain 1…3…3 Energy.
9b6a45585b7da3033fe439edd0d6b60347614f41.text: 精英法术。治疗目标盟友 40…104…120 生命值。如果你的目标有结界，你将获得 1…3…3 点能量。

634c468206540308fe63c71d983e0b3332585ea7.source: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 20…92…110 Health. Up to 2 additional allies near target ally are healed for 10…82…100 Health.
634c468206540308fe63c71d983e0b3332585ea7.text: 咒语。目标其他盟友获得 20…92…110 点生命值治疗。目标盟友附近最多有 2 名额外盟友被治愈 10…82…100 点生命值。

101f72ca2de52eee48bf9b003c1228ee54d5a7cc.source: Enchantment Spell. For 2…6…7 seconds, target ally has a 50% chance to block attacks.
101f72ca2de52eee48bf9b003c1228ee54d5a7cc.text: 结界咒语。 2…6…7秒内，目标盟友有50%的几率格挡攻击。

a5cfd471fea59fce9c0c7dd33b0cf7879d9d9b5e.source: Spell. Heal adjacent creatures for 30…150…180 Health. The caster is not healed.
a5cfd471fea59fce9c0c7dd33b0cf7879d9d9b5e.text: 咒文。治疗邻近生物 30…150…180 点生命值。施法者没有被治愈。

1981db2b22694f9904b52eead3f9a81895f243ca.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target other ally takes damage, that ally and all adjacent allies gain 3…25…30 Health.
1981db2b22694f9904b52eead3f9a81895f243ca.text: 结界咒语。在 10 秒内，每当目标其他盟友受到伤害时，该盟友和所有相邻盟友都会获得 3…25…30 点生命值。

f8e4262aac657ff6322190e11ed0216be372622c.source: Signet. You gain 82…154…172 Health. You have -40 armor while using this skill.
f8e4262aac657ff6322190e11ed0216be372622c.text: 印章。您获得 82…154…172 点生命值。使用此技能时你有 -40 护甲值。

8db5dd95850c3ec1f3d5252c5e1b64e4279e71ca.source: Trap. For 10 seconds, all adjacent allies are healed for 15…51…60 every 2 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
8db5dd95850c3ec1f3d5252c5e1b64e4279e71ca.text: 陷阱。在 10 秒内，所有相邻盟友每 2 秒就会被治疗 15…51…60 点。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

959216d09405e1039af0739bd98dc15ed5de33e1.source: Spell. Heal target touched ally for 20…68…80 Health. Health gain from Divine Favor is doubled for this spell.
959216d09405e1039af0739bd98dc15ed5de33e1.text: 咒语。治愈目标触及盟友 20…68…80 点生命值。此法术从神圣恩惠中获得的生命值加倍。

729f87df48c3c83385a947cf310fe3557d7437ad.source: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 40…88…100. This spell has half the normal range.
729f87df48c3c83385a947cf310fe3557d7437ad.text: 咒语。目标其他盟友的治疗量为 40…88…100。该法术的射程是正常范围的一半。

7d9159ea146b2c2df67942eab0973b15a5172f98.source: Stance. For 2…8…10 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
7d9159ea146b2c2df67942eab0973b15a5172f98.text: 立场。在 2…8…10 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 25%。

a888d84124f8f083032ddfd1c3b8ea78d206ed34.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes take 5…25…30 holy damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are set on fire for 2…4…5 seconds.
a888d84124f8f083032ddfd1c3b8ea78d206ed34.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有附近的敌人都会受到 5…25…30 点神圣伤害。你的攻击会造成神圣伤害，持续 30 秒。当这个结界结束时，所有附近的敌人都会被点燃，持续 2…4…5 秒。

cf82c2e5a33b98781631ad63787a626ff3031fd0.source: Spell. You are healed for 30…126…150. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
cf82c2e5a33b98781631ad63787a626ff3031fd0.text: 咒语。你的治疗量为 30…126…150。 暗影步到直接远离目标的附近位置。

04718a97ebfa9cde9caf6b40f5dde93861d6e723.source: Hammer Attack. Lose all adrenaline. If this attack hits a foe suffering from Weakness, that foe is knocked down and you strike for +1…24…30 damage.
04718a97ebfa9cde9caf6b40f5dde93861d6e723.text: 锤子攻击。失去所有肾上腺素。如果这次攻击击中了虚弱的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒，并且你会受到 +1…24…30 点伤害。

c967b81c9f63035c0c9b135374b626683edeaf8e.source: Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you attack 33% faster. This stance ends if you use an attack skill.
c967b81c9f63035c0c9b135374b626683edeaf8e.text: 立场。在 5…10…11 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 33%。如果使用攻击技能，该姿势就会结束。

6589332c6f617167d8cdba55749aa07fb092097f.source: Elite Echo. For 3…13…15 seconds, target non-spirit ally gains +1…3…3 to all attributes. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally. PvE Skill
6589332c6f617167d8cdba55749aa07fb092097f.text: 精英回声。 3…13…15秒内，目标非精神盟友所有属性获得+1…3…3。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。 PvE技能

cc81892e85f78953f46d9cd6d2518f35e59ea393.source: Stance. For 5…65…80 seconds, the next time you are the target of a hex, that hex fails and the caster takes 10…39…46 damage.
cc81892e85f78953f46d9cd6d2518f35e59ea393.text: 立场。在 5…65…80 秒内，下次当你成为妖术的目标时，该妖术会失败并且施法者受到 10…39…46 点伤害。

ab54a33172a35fcf35ca6f4df4df76cc820f38e4.source: Signet. Target touched ally and up to 2…4…5 adjacent allies each lose one hex. You gain 1…3…4 Energy for each hex removed this way.
ab54a33172a35fcf35ca6f4df4df76cc820f38e4.text: 印章。目标触及盟友，最多 2…4…5 个相邻盟友各损失 1 个降咒。通过这种方式移除每个六角形，您将获得 1…3…4 能量。

8bef3be2b49641cd516c7b597a26c6bd94656c2b.source: Elite Spell. Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed in this way, foes in the area of that ally take 30…78…90 damage and lose one enchantment.
8bef3be2b49641cd516c7b597a26c6bd94656c2b.text: 精英法术。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。如果以这种方式移除六角形，该盟友区域内的敌人会受到 30…78…90 点伤害并失去一个结界。

e8fb62d87246aa5b3af3ea27526182a2d299f21f.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot casts a spell, that ally loses 1 hex.
e8fb62d87246aa5b3af3ea27526182a2d299f21f.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，每次听力范围内的每个盟友施展法术时，该盟友都会损失 1 个降咒。

f24fd6dc02f228d1d3528bbadfb25e9d45d6a55d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you have +1…7…8 Health regeneration. Hexer's Vigor ends if you cast a non-hex skill.
f24fd6dc02f228d1d3528bbadfb25e9d45d6a55d.text: 结界咒语。在 10 秒内，您将获得 +1…7…8 点生命恢复。如果你施展非妖术技能，妖术的活力就会结束。

3d2adc1e69b305885c55a083a8016004754efe0c.source: Elite Hex Spell. Your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 3 seconds. For 1…8…10 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When this hex ends that foe is Crippled for 1…12…15 seconds.
3d2adc1e69b305885c55a083a8016004754efe0c.text: 精英六角咒语。你的非刺客技能会被禁用 3 秒。在 1…8…10 秒内，目标敌人的移动速度减慢 50%。当这个六角形结束时，敌人会瘫痪 1…12…15 秒。

9afb82f9e9ccffc98bb53e6b4616c2c940702ff9.source: Enchantment Spell. For 1…48…60 seconds, your Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster. This enchantment ends if you cast another enchantment.
9afb82f9e9ccffc98bb53e6b4616c2c940702ff9.text: 结界咒语。在 1…48…60 秒内，你的治疗祈祷法术的施法速度加快 50%。如果您施放另一个结界，该结界就会结束。

df6f1a9a23db9d0cbef57a306ede017e2a92ea99.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If it hits a summoned creature, all nearby foes take 15…75…90 holy damage, and are set on fire for 3 seconds.
df6f1a9a23db9d0cbef57a306ede017e2a92ea99.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果它击中召唤生物，附近所有敌人都会受到 15…75…90 点神圣伤害，并被点燃 3 秒。

288898ec6d89a12572769629688865a29d550d58.source: Skill. Touched target foe takes 10…46…55 holy damage. If knocked down, your target takes an additional 10…46…55 holy damage.
288898ec6d89a12572769629688865a29d550d58.text: 技能。被触碰的目标敌人会受到 10…46…55 点神圣伤害。如果被击倒，你的目标会额外受到 10…46…55 点神圣伤害。

d0c45571f8985a51306cf13cc6c01d46419c5d15.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, any hex cast on target ally takes twice as long to cast. When Holy Veil ends, one hex is removed from target ally.
d0c45571f8985a51306cf13cc6c01d46419c5d15.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，对目标盟友施放的任何妖术都需要两倍的时间来施放。当神圣面纱结束时，目标盟友身上的一个六角形会被移除。

86025fd68dc199cabe4db7de63618fd5259911bb.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…26…30 seconds, the next 1…8…10 times target other ally takes attack damage, this spell deals 66% of the damage back to the source (maximum of 5…41…50 damage).
86025fd68dc199cabe4db7de63618fd5259911bb.text: 结界咒语。在10…26…30秒内，接下来的1…8…10次目标其他盟友受到攻击伤害，该法术对源造成66%点伤害（最多5…41…50点伤害）。

d2dd2213402e4f1369e709808cf77bf427eb5cab.source: Weapon Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, target ally's attacks cannot be blocked.
d2dd2213402e4f1369e709808cf77bf427eb5cab.text: 武器咒语。 4…9…10秒内，目标友军的攻击无法被格挡。

cb8f37f6981934fd1d26544957b7cefbacf9d92b.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, your next 0…2…3 attacks cannot be blocked. When activated, this skill removes the Blindness condition.
cb8f37f6981934fd1d26544957b7cefbacf9d92b.text: 结界咒语。 20秒内，你接下来的0…2…3次攻击无法被阻挡。激活后，该技能会消除失明状态。

546e6f283599338251f37c021744f07788b12dc3.source: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets a foe, the spell fails and you steal up to 5…12…14 Energy from that foe.
546e6f283599338251f37c021744f07788b12dc3.text: 降咒魔法。在 6 秒内，下次目标敌人施放以敌人为目标的法术时，该法术会失败，并且你会从该敌人身上偷取最多 5…12…14 点能量。

9bfe1fdff3fa197da9ceab78a3d6d725d49e2af8.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…10…11 seconds, both you and target ally move 33% faster. When you cast this spell, all foes adjacent to you and your target take 15…59…70 cold damage. Foes struck by Gust while attacking or moving are knocked down.
9bfe1fdff3fa197da9ceab78a3d6d725d49e2af8.text: 精英结界法术。在 5…10…11 秒内，你和目标盟友的移动速度都快了 33%。当你施放此法术时，与你和你的目标相邻的所有敌人都会受到 15…59…70 点寒冷伤害。攻击或移动时被阵风击中的敌人会被击倒。

cde4db67068554b061583bc15de61c45f7e4950e.source: Hammer Attack. Lose all adrenaline. If Hammer Bash hits, your target is knocked down.
cde4db67068554b061583bc15de61c45f7e4950e.text: 锤子攻击。失去所有肾上腺素。如果锤击击中，你的目标就会被击倒。

4f49f961d3146d19ed26e9206ee60d7c04fcd732.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Horns of the Ox strikes for +1…9…11 damage. If struck foe is not adjacent to any allies, that foe is knocked down.
4f49f961d3146d19ed26e9206ee60d7c04fcd732.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，牛角会造成 +1…9…11 伤害。如果被击中的敌人不与任何盟友相邻，则该敌人会被击倒。

9bb6cdf2f2a7267645c4230aaf45898ffcbe4007.source: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10…30…35 slashing damage.
9bb6cdf2f2a7267645c4230aaf45898ffcbe4007.text: 精英技能。在 15 秒内，每当你用剑攻击时，所有相邻的敌人都会受到 10…30…35 点切割伤害。

ee68d18c4b3ba090eece9320dc6c71bfb61bc80c.source: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10…26…30 slashing damage.
ee68d18c4b3ba090eece9320dc6c71bfb61bc80c.text: 精英技能。在 15 秒内，每当你用剑攻击时，所有相邻的敌人都会受到 10…26…30 点切割伤害。

725d5e093f7bd1c4aba9737b6cb7c16a9d30c7f3.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, your target is Crippled for 3…13…15 seconds, slowing his movement.
725d5e093f7bd1c4aba9737b6cb7c16a9d30c7f3.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你的目标会瘫痪 3…13…15 秒，并减慢他的移动速度。

5646f500286e74b8f0732e174e772989639619e4.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, attacks against moving foes also Cripple that foe for 2…8…9 seconds. When you cast this enchantment, you are relieved of Cripple and 1 other condition. This enchantment ends after you apply Cripple 1…3…3 times. says "times" even if the value is 1.
5646f500286e74b8f0732e174e772989639619e4.text: 闪光附魔咒语。持续 5…17…20 秒，对移动敌人的攻击也会使该敌人瘫痪 2…8…9 秒。当你施放此结界时，你将解除瘫痪和 1 其他状况。此结界会在您应用瘫痪 1…3…3 次后结束。即使值为 1，也表示“次”。

84701c28549e83ef089a8223c834ac0a5a563098.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, melee attacks against moving foes also Cripple those foes for 2…8…9 seconds. When you cast this enchantment, you are relieved of Cripple and 1 other condition. This enchantment ends after you apply Cripple 1…3…3 times.
84701c28549e83ef089a8223c834ac0a5a563098.text: 闪光附魔咒语。持续 5…17…20 秒，对移动敌人的近战攻击也会使这些敌人瘫痪 2…8…9 秒。当你施放此结界时，你将解除瘫痪和 1 其他状况。此结界会在您应用瘫痪 1…3…3 次后结束。

19057943de0ba98da88eb568b9874d580caa2491.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2…7…8 seconds, you move 25% faster and deal +3…10…12 more damage against moving foes.
19057943de0ba98da88eb568b9874d580caa2491.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 2…7…8 秒内，你的移动速度提高 25%，对移动的敌人造成的伤害增加 +3…10…12。

edb09520923c513f3820930f8385f9fd8eb6da15.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, it deals an additional 5…33…40 damage.
edb09520923c513f3820930f8385f9fd8eb6da15.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果此攻击击中移动的敌人，则会造成额外 5…33…40 点伤害。

13c14fab95d2e726f1a5816445ae38349b393f77.source: Echo. For 8…18…20 seconds, target ally moves 25% faster. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
13c14fab95d2e726f1a5816445ae38349b393f77.text: 回声。在 8…18…20 秒内，目标盟友的移动速度加快 25%。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。

f1e1f173eab8cfd5d646ab5e51ec4c87f72ba90a.source: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 40…88…100 damage. You are Dazed for 10 seconds.
f1e1f173eab8cfd5d646ab5e51ec4c87f72ba90a.text: 精英技能。目标接触的敌人受到 40…88…100 点伤害。您茫然了 10 秒。

033518087d7d1f2d92e1d4f2f6109b320675a0a0.source: Spell. Heal yourself and all adjacent creatures for 30…150…180 points.
033518087d7d1f2d92e1d4f2f6109b320675a0a0.text: 咒语。治愈你自己和所有邻近的生物 30…150…180 点。

29448cc22e0e8406e7b3cf1277f284023fe976f5.source: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, your animal companion steals 1…16…20 Health whenever it hits with an attack. You and your companion are both healed for 20…87…104 Health. If your companion is dead, it's resurrected with 50% Health. If you have this skill equipped, your companion will travel with you.
29448cc22e0e8406e7b3cf1277f284023fe976f5.text: 精英技能。在 15 秒内，你的动物伙伴每次受到攻击都会窃取 1…16…20 点生命值。你和你的同伴都获得了 20…87…104 点生命值的治愈。如果你的同伴死亡，它会复活并拥有 50% 点生命值。如果你装备了这个技能，你的同伴就会和你一起旅行。

b15912123c46008d88c8ab14ff0320b9e4135907.source: Spell. Heal target other ally for 35…151…180 Health.
b15912123c46008d88c8ab14ff0320b9e4135907.text: 咒语。治疗目标其他盟友 35…151…180 生命值。

2af8b3c704e516a1aca0b9f0d05a4a8666aa71fe.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, your target bleeds for 3…21…25 seconds.
2af8b3c704e516a1aca0b9f0d05a4a8666aa71fe.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你的目标会流血 3…21…25 秒。

7d46a9cff6a8afcbd1bf0b378132419a155130f1.source: Spell. Transfer all conditions from all foes in the area to target foe.
7d46a9cff6a8afcbd1bf0b378132419a155130f1.text: 咒语。将区域内所有敌人的所有状况转移到目标敌人。

6307fed9268f5ead3873f3164ce158cfa56f9126.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower.
6307fed9268f5ead3873f3164ce158cfa56f9126.text: 降咒魔法。持续 8…18…20 秒，目标敌人的腿部被冰包裹，导致敌人移动速度减慢 66%。

6751c713889e7356ee47b3fcacb071ea2e9e26b8.source: Spell. Heal entire party for 30…66…75 Health.
6751c713889e7356ee47b3fcacb071ea2e9e26b8.text: 咒文。治愈整个队伍 30…66…75 生命值。

39969503dfadcaa1520cbb11c27b5ea87707430c.source: Enchantment Spell. Send out an Ice Spear, striking target foe for 10…50…60 cold damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, you gain +1…3…4 Health regeneration for 5 seconds.
39969503dfadcaa1520cbb11c27b5ea87707430c.text: 结界咒语。发射冰矛，攻击目标敌人，命中后造成 10…50…60 冰冷伤害。如果你处于阴天，你将获得 +1…3…4 生命恢复，持续 5 秒。

d135ec08f713443ae437b5ab79900c88c4c2e395.source: Hex Spell. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 20…68…80 cold damage and move 66% slower for 2…5…6 seconds.
d135ec08f713443ae437b5ab79900c88c4c2e395.text: 降咒魔法。目标和邻近敌人受到 20…68…80 点冰冷伤害，移动速度减慢 66%，持续 2…5…6 秒。

76582d36ae5195f57be0385541b1ef888f876c03.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…63…75 cold damage. If that foe has a Water Magic hex, Icy Prism deals +The "+" is inconsistent with other skill descriptions. In this case, the additional damage is dealt to nearby foes, and not to the target15…63…75 cold damage to all other nearby foes.
76582d36ae5195f57be0385541b1ef888f876c03.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害。如果该敌人拥有水魔法六角形，冰冷棱镜会造成+。“+”与其他技能描述不一致。在这种情况下，额外伤害是对附近的敌人造成的，而不是对目标附近所有其他敌人造成 15…63…75 点冰冷伤害。

9115491740b90d040cfe622ccbe7db00cb888010.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…8…10 seconds, target foe's movement speed is reduced by 66%. While under the effects of an enchantment, that foe's movement is reduced by 90%.
9115491740b90d040cfe622ccbe7db00cb888010.text: 精英六角咒语。 1…8…10秒内，目标敌人的移动速度降低66%。在结界效果下，该敌人的移动速度降低90%。

ed9e95781537598967326ade7be7b50592eb4efa.source: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10…74…90 cold damage. For 10…30…35 seconds, if target foe dies all nearby foes are struck for 20…92…110 cold damage.
ed9e95781537598967326ade7be7b50592eb4efa.text: 精英六角咒语。目标敌人受到 10…74…90 点寒冷伤害。持续 10…30…35 秒，如果目标敌人死亡，附近所有敌人都会受到 20…92…110 点寒冷伤害。

b4d4be1fbaef0ede5e3b3df7e2da1b9d4b931cf2.source: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows explode on contact, dealing 3…15…18 fire damage to target and all adjacent foes.
b4d4be1fbaef0ede5e3b3df7e2da1b9d4b931cf2.text: 准备。持续 24 秒，你的箭在接触时爆炸，对目标和所有相邻敌人造成 3…15…18 点火焰伤害。

92929012ce63d63c258ec18d31a02f4523305ff8.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds target foe cannot use signets.
92929012ce63d63c258ec18d31a02f4523305ff8.text: 降咒魔法。在 8…18…20 秒内，目标敌人无法使用图章。

47fdf5d71c90d576f086fad3d8117e03e2f0da0d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…10…11 seconds you are no longer Crippled, and you move 33% faster. When Illusion of Haste ends, you become Crippled for 3 seconds.
47fdf5d71c90d576f086fad3d8117e03e2f0da0d.text: 结界咒语。在 5…10…11 秒内，你不再处于瘫痪状态，并且你的移动速度加快了 33% 秒。当急速幻象结束时，你会变得残废3秒。

f653f32facdcfc2467f66ad6778471d207025a1a.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…10…11 seconds, you move 33% faster. When Illusion of Haste ends, you become Crippled for 3 seconds.
f653f32facdcfc2467f66ad6778471d207025a1a.text: 结界咒语。在 5…10…11 秒内，您移动速度加快 33%。当急速幻象结束时，你会变得残废3秒。

cafab127e84dbb2753048b4d5a71fa91880b3876.source: Hex Spell. For 8 seconds, target foe has -3…9…10 Health degeneration and takes 3…9…10 damage each second. When Illusion of Pain ends, that foe is healed for 36…103…120.
cafab127e84dbb2753048b4d5a71fa91880b3876.text: 降咒魔法。持续 8 秒，目标敌人的生命值下降 -3…9…10 点，每秒受到 3…9…10 点伤害。当痛苦幻象结束时，该敌人将获得 36…103…120 点治疗。
