95784c4674b7c5c4d662d74de08b8856a08960e5.source: Hex Spell. For 8 seconds, target foe has -3…9…10 Health degeneration and takes 3…9…10 damage each second. When Illusion of Pain ends or is reapplied, that foe is healed for 36…103…120.
95784c4674b7c5c4d662d74de08b8856a08960e5.text: 降咒魔法。持续 8 秒，目标敌人的生命值下降 -3…9…10 点，每秒受到 3…9…10 点伤害。当痛苦幻象结束或重新施加时，该敌人将获得 36…103…120 点治疗。

a9a87be890922baea79aa5bbb968989f4bd434ca.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…46…55 seconds. a period is used instead of a comma Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster and heal for 50% more Health.
a9a87be890922baea79aa5bbb968989f4bd434ca.text: 精英结界法术。 10…46…55 秒。使用句号代替逗号 治疗祈祷法术的施法速度提高 50%，生命值增加 50%。

9954750096bb51aeb5c99e7154c939c21f914d75.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, your Healing Prayers spells heal for 20% less Health, but cost -1…3…4 Energy.
9954750096bb51aeb5c99e7154c939c21f914d75.text: 精英结界法术。当你维持此结界时，你的治疗祈祷法术会减少 20% 点生命值，但会消耗 -1…3…4 点能量。

cb36b625695923c671c80d4458f641a1602dd6dd.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit. Instead, Illusionary Weaponry deals 20…52…60 damage to your targets for each melee attack.
cb36b625695923c671c80d4458f641a1602dd6dd.text: 精英结界法术。在 30 秒内，你的近战攻击既没有命中也没有命中。相反，幻影武器每次近战攻击会对目标造成 20…52…60 点伤害。

5ac6cb961df83f6cf5ebc0156e400ed32ba46069.source: Hex Spell. For 5…9…10 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…3 Health degeneration. If that foe was attacking, that foe takes 10…44…52 damage.
5ac6cb961df83f6cf5ebc0156e400ed32ba46069.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…9…10 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…3 点生命值退化。如果该敌人正在攻击，则该敌人会受到 10…44…52 点伤害。

9422951955578c613e7df59e52d9c0a7d742137c.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower.
9422951955578c613e7df59e52d9c0a7d742137c.text: 降咒魔法。在 8…18…20 秒内，目标敌人的移动速度减慢 50%。

54edaba7cbaf93bd39a9becc6dc7507e151ade2c.source: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 5…41…50% of your current Health (maximum 300 Health).
54edaba7cbaf93bd39a9becc6dc7507e151ade2c.text: 咒语。目标其他盟友的生命值将被治愈 5…41…50% 点（最多 300 点生命值）。

f9a0c175e0a14582f6a52cfd1c3edb22fe876d24.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20…64…75 fire damage and is set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds.
f9a0c175e0a14582f6a52cfd1c3edb22fe876d24.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 20…64…75 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…3…3 秒。

e360203a7ecd40aefd6e4e6595b91508cdb47b3e.source: Skill. Must follow a dual attack. Target foe is struck for 25…85…100 earth damage and suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
e360203a7ecd40aefd6e4e6595b91508cdb47b3e.text: 技能。必须遵循双重攻击。目标敌人受到 25…85…100 点土属性伤害，并受到深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

4d1174f7f8aa49b8bdfeca7a291edcf31cebf2af.source: Enchantment Spell. You lose 50…202…240 Health. Illusion of Weakness ends if damage drops your Health below 25% of your maximum. When Illusion of Weakness ends, you gain 50…202…240 Health.
4d1174f7f8aa49b8bdfeca7a291edcf31cebf2af.text: 结界咒语。您失去 50…202…240 生命值。如果伤害使你的生命值低于最大生命值的 25%，虚弱幻象就会结束。当虚弱幻象结束时，你获得 50…202…240 点生命值。

54ddaad2a47a3b0ff983e6258e9ab7a877bf8744.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit. Instead, Illusionary Weaponry deals 20…52…60 damage to your targets for each melee attack. You have +5 armor for each equipped Illusion Magic skill.
54ddaad2a47a3b0ff983e6258e9ab7a877bf8744.text: 精英结界法术。在 30 秒内，你的近战攻击既没有命中也没有命中。相反，幻影武器每次近战攻击会对目标造成 20…52…60 点伤害。每装备一个幻象魔法技能，你就有 +5 点护甲。

f7085a313823ac128e930537e7b2592a5459d0d6.source: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 2 foes near your target. Those foes are set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds.
f7085a313823ac128e930537e7b2592a5459d0d6.text: 精英弓攻击。向目标敌人以及目标附近最多 2 个敌人射箭。这些敌人会被点燃 1…3…3 秒。

dfcd30186fdd7b2d278ab37ab54f4f607748824b.source: Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are struck for 20…68…80 fire damage and are set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds. Activates early if target foe dies.
dfcd30186fdd7b2d278ab37ab54f4f607748824b.text: 降咒魔法。 3 秒后，目标敌人和附近的所有敌人都会受到 20…68…80 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…3…3 秒。如果目标敌人死亡，则提前激活。

02df1161f305495c80a8bbb1c284b3f4bd9e1f1d.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, the next time target foe or any adjacent foe attacks, they take 30…114…135 damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.
02df1161f305495c80a8bbb1c284b3f4bd9e1f1d.text: 精英六角咒语。在 4 秒内，下次目标敌人或任何相邻敌人攻击时，他们会受到 30…114…135 点伤害并致盲 10 秒。

0dbc40c42b2c9e7c546469a20ab40fd6f6f6a89e.source: Spell. All adjacent foes are struck for 30…114…135 fire damage.
0dbc40c42b2c9e7c546469a20ab40fd6f6f6a89e.text: 咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会受到 30…114…135 点火焰伤害。

bcefb981945572b8948110e96cf1a8a76bc11546.source: Scythe Attack. Deal +3…13…15 damage and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If you lose an enchantment in this way, Irresistible Sweep cannot be blocked, removes a stance, and deals +3…13…15 additional damage.
bcefb981945572b8948110e96cf1a8a76bc11546.text: 镰刀攻击。造成 +3…13…15 点伤害并失去 1 苦行僧结界。如果你以这种方式失去结界，势不可挡的横扫将无法被格挡，移除姿态，并造成 +3…13…15 点额外伤害。

f1292360d4651f1f535be5685d22b341691507e4.source: Scythe Attack. Deal +3…13…15 damage and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If you lose an enchantment in this way, Irresistible Sweep cannot be blocked and removes a stance.
f1292360d4651f1f535be5685d22b341691507e4.text: 镰刀攻击。造成 +3…13…15 点伤害并失去 1 苦行僧结界。如果你以这种方式失去结界，势不可挡的横扫将无法被格挡并移除姿态。

75a3aeee7b8fd84fefc1c7957ab1331250a5f304.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline twice as fast. This spirit dies after 30…102…120 seconds.
75a3aeee7b8fd84fefc1c7957ab1331250a5f304.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。在其范围内的非灵体生物获得肾上腺素的速度是其两倍。该灵魂会在 30…102…120 秒后死亡。

34a9e8a202740a3c55f97962aa0080f85b6729e7.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level 0…12…15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks.
34a9e8a202740a3c55f97962aa0080f85b6729e7.text: 精英结界法术。在 60 秒内，每当目标不死仆从死亡时，它就会被等级 0…12…15 的锯齿状恐怖所取代，每次攻击都会导致流血。

247a11a65e81336eb65aed2b29b7f8ee54a9be69.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline 33…59…66% as fast. This spirit dies after 30…102…120 seconds.
247a11a65e81336eb65aed2b29b7f8ee54a9be69.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。其范围内的非灵体生物获得肾上腺素的速度提高 33…59…66%。该灵魂会在 30…102…120 秒后死亡。

fbee444f31e2ef6e1a598df700eac87000ff84e1.source: Enchantment Spell. For the next 15…51…60 seconds, whenever you receive a condition, that condition is transferred to your closest minion instead.
fbee444f31e2ef6e1a598df700eac87000ff84e1.text: 结界咒语。在接下来的 15…51…60 秒内，每当你收到条件时，该条件都会转移到你最近的随从身上。

94799220d204d2a695b56acbd977b0842c637586.source: Spell. Lose half your current Health. Target other ally is healed for 100…129…136% of the amount you lost.
94799220d204d2a695b56acbd977b0842c637586.text: 咒语。失去当前生命值的一半。目标其他盟友的治疗量相当于你损失的 100…129…136% 点。

b10b7e960817b99813fcde359dd05be80e40ef3d.source: Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe hits with an attack, you steal up to 15…39…45 Health from that foe.
b10b7e960817b99813fcde359dd05be80e40ef3d.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…13…15 秒内，每当目标敌人受到攻击时，你就会从该敌人身上窃取最多 15…39…45 点生命值。

de5ddfd54974ff268ee3d496ecc259eb1f2307ed.source: Skill. You lose all adrenaline and target other ally gains 1…7…8 strikes of adrenaline.
de5ddfd54974ff268ee3d496ecc259eb1f2307ed.text: 技能。你失去所有肾上腺素，目标其他盟友获得 1…7…8 次肾上腺素打击。

cd852f3b7bf5ef07046f807a90e8428cdcea7d1a.source: Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe and gain 3…13…15 Energy. For 20 seconds, Inspired Enchantment is replaced with the enchantment removed from target foe.
cd852f3b7bf5ef07046f807a90e8428cdcea7d1a.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的结界并获得 3…13…15 点能量。持续 20 秒，灵感结界被从目标敌人身上移除的结界所取代。

605b10335bea044683a137d46a3de7c397c5e378.source: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally and gain 4…9…10 Energy. For 20 seconds, Inspired Hex is replaced with the hex that was removed.
605b10335bea044683a137d46a3de7c397c5e378.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形并获得 4…9…10 点能量。在 20 秒内，灵感降咒被替换为被移除的降咒。

a812e27c9ef27c1513540d303ccd53b01ccb3e7a.source: Skill. For 10 seconds, the next time you deal elemental damage with a spell to a target, you deal 60…70% of that damage to all other foes in the area.
a812e27c9ef27c1513540d303ccd53b01ccb3e7a.text: 技能。在 10 秒内，下次你用法术对目标造成元素伤害时，你会对区域内的所有其他敌人造成 60…70% 点伤害。

b017a97123ef7f7c94f12b8cfd02fdc15a72e566.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, you have +40…88…100 max Health and take 1…8…10 less damage from foes with less Health than you.
b017a97123ef7f7c94f12b8cfd02fdc15a72e566.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，你的最大生命值为 +40…88…100，受到生命值低于你的敌人的伤害减少 1…8…10。

f5471454152e53af50ae41d8cdf9658d87297a76.source: Lead Attack. If Jagged Strike hits, your target suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds.
f5471454152e53af50ae41d8cdf9658d87297a76.text: 引导攻击。如果锯齿之击击中，你的目标会流血 5…17…20 秒。

e7722215b396e6ee80b4e7b2ee5eafebc1229d5b.source: Elite Spell. Target foe and up to two other foes near your target are struck for 10…74…90 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
e7722215b396e6ee80b4e7b2ee5eafebc1229d5b.text: 精英法术。目标敌人和目标附近最多两个敌人会受到 10…74…90 点闪电伤害。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

5e1f41bc5158333ae8488920feeef289ab96680a.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…14…15 seconds, you have +15 armor. Your Air Magic spells that target a foe activate and recharge 33% faster, but you are Overcast by 2 points.
5e1f41bc5158333ae8488920feeef289ab96680a.text: 结界咒语。在 8…14…15 秒内，你拥有 +15 护甲。你以敌人为目标的空气魔法法术的激活和充能速度加快了 33% 点，但你的阴暗程度提高了 2 点。

4f977d4528cf7d36dfb9353509c5427f9711ba51.source: Skill. Target touched foe suffers 5…41…50 damage, and if that foe is suffering from a hex or condition that foe is knocked down. Iron Palm counts as a lead attack.
4f977d4528cf7d36dfb9353509c5427f9711ba51.text: 技能。目标接触的敌人会受到 5…41…50 点伤害，如果该敌人遭受巫术或状况，则该敌人会被击倒。铁掌算作主攻。

2f1959556fc2525875b46f3317fb890f92607b70.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage. If Irresistible Blow is blocked, your target is knocked down and takes 5…17…20 damage.
2f1959556fc2525875b46f3317fb890f92607b70.text: 锤子攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果不可抗拒的打击被格挡，你的目标就会被击倒并受到 5…17…20 点伤害。

eaa151dfa63acd487da6ed96e4ba9ffde6ea0357.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -0…2…3 Health degeneration. When this hex is applied, these foes take 10…42…50 damage if you are within earshot of a spirit or corpse.
eaa151dfa63acd487da6ed96e4ba9ffde6ea0357.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人遭受 -0…2…3 点生命值退化。当应用此咒语时，如果您位于灵魂或尸体的听力范围内，这些敌人会受到 10…42…50 点伤害。

f4c29983caaaed9b22b93548e6f1663ffd56e7fe.source: Spell. Lava Arrows fly toward up to 3 foes near your target and strike for 20…56…65 fire damage if they hit.
f4c29983caaaed9b22b93548e6f1663ffd56e7fe.text: 咒语。熔岩箭飞向目标附近最多 3 个敌人，命中后会造成 20…56…65 点火焰伤害。

435a03e32f00e13143649e10960821fb440d1746.source: Spell. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to the location where this spell was cast are struck for 5…41…50 fire damage each second. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby foes instead of adjacent ones.
435a03e32f00e13143649e10960821fb440d1746.text: 咒语。持续 5 秒，施放该法术的位置附近的敌人每秒受到 5…41…50 点火焰伤害。如果你处于阴暗状态，该法术会攻击附近的敌人而不是相邻的敌人。

0d57e6a41e9d40d818084c1a4f22d423e3db2e73.source: Skill. You gain 30…66…75 Health. For each ally within earshot, you also gain +10…18…20 Health (maximum 140 Health).
0d57e6a41e9d40d818084c1a4f22d423e3db2e73.text: 技能。您获得 30…66…75 点生命值。对于听力范围内的每个盟友，你还获得 +10…18…20 点生命值（最多 140 点生命值）。

8a49456d71fcd3fba67e674731bd2d9eafa83bac.source: Skill. For each nearby ally, you gain 2…4…4 Energy (maximum 8…11…12 Energy).
8a49456d71fcd3fba67e674731bd2d9eafa83bac.text: 技能。对于附近的每个盟友，你获得 2…4…4 点能量（最多 8…11…12 点能量）。

c1ce60ff6c159e15b33eada859d8028c17069ad0.source: Lead Attack. If Mantis Sting hits, target foe takes +5…13…15 damage. If this attack strikes a moving foe, that foe is Crippled for 3…13…15 seconds.
c1ce60ff6c159e15b33eada859d8028c17069ad0.text: 引导攻击。如果螳螂刺击中，目标敌人会受到 +5…13…15 点伤害。如果此攻击击中移动的敌人，则该敌人会瘫痪 3…13…15 秒。

7f066f25ed0b2736744036768d25467ec3fe77c5.source: Signet. Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a spell, you gain 3…13…15 Energy.
7f066f25ed0b2736744036768d25467ec3fe77c5.text: 印章。打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是咒语，你将获得 3…13…15 点能量。

860a64b5930eac413d9443afbc72ad8b014a9d0b.source: Sword Attack. If Jaizhenju Strike hits, you strike for +1…24…30 damage. If you are not using a stance, Jaizhenju Strike cannot be blocked.
860a64b5930eac413d9443afbc72ad8b014a9d0b.text: 剑攻击。如果劫真聚击命中，你的攻击会造成 +1…24…30 伤害。如果不使用架势，则无法格挡斩真聚击。

21147bd4a20cdaae4cbbc3f76e58adffb4c793a5.source: Enchantment Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, for the next 1…16…20 seconds, your next enchantment spell casts 0…1…1 seconds faster and costs 1…8…10 less Energy.
21147bd4a20cdaae4cbbc3f76e58adffb4c793a5.text: 结界咒语。移除目标敌人的结界。如果结界被移除，在接下来的 1…16…20 秒内，你的下一个结界法术的施法速度会加快 0…1…1 秒，并且消耗的能量会减少 1…8…10。

6ef6900f3c048d912906bb171ade631d0c47d9f4.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, target ally's attacks deal holy damage and have +20% armor penetration.
6ef6900f3c048d912906bb171ade631d0c47d9f4.text: 结界咒语。 8…18…20秒内，目标盟友的攻击造成神圣伤害并具有+20%点护甲穿透。

2b1f77f3e67421f01e43942e58fc9c981f887c6b.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and one nearby foe takes 30…150…180 holy damage.
2b1f77f3e67421f01e43942e58fc9c981f887c6b.text: 结界咒语。在 10 秒内，下次目标盟友受到致命伤害时，该伤害会被抵消，并且附近的一名敌人会受到 30…150…180 点神圣伤害。

8cb86a98c5b92d06de4aad04e5f6a1aa5bf12f00.source: Elite Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13…27…30 Holy damage for most skills, the "h" of holy is lowercase and knocks down attacking foes. PvE Skill
8cb86a98c5b92d06de4aad04e5f6a1aa5bf12f00.text: 精英近战攻击。攻击目标和邻近的敌人。大多数技能的每次攻击都会造成 +13…27…30 点神圣伤害，神圣的“h”是小写的，会击倒攻击的敌人。 PvE技能

4755b1f1185a6ecb5b7a29ceabfa7723a15ad779.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit allies within its range are healed for 1…6…7 Health for each second this spirit was alive. This spirit dies after 20 seconds.
4755b1f1185a6ecb5b7a29ceabfa7723a15ad779.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。当该灵魂死亡时，该灵魂每存活一秒，其范围内的所有非灵魂盟友都会受到 1…6…7 生命值的治疗。该灵魂会在 20 秒后死亡。

55d4eac9a26a1aaa3044373a3c01f06ea0f8b8d0.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10…22…25 damage. If it hits a foe that was Crippled, that foe and all adjacent foes take 1…25…31 damage.
55d4eac9a26a1aaa3044373a3c01f06ea0f8b8d0.text: 副手攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。如果击中，该攻击会造成 +10…22…25 伤害。如果它击中了残废的敌人，则该敌人和所有相邻的敌人都会受到 1…25…31 点伤害。

8122ba7e778d8b2b9c5aee571ce2d4b08cec1cdf.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage. If you land a critical hit, you deal an additional +5…21…25 damage.
8122ba7e778d8b2b9c5aee571ce2d4b08cec1cdf.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果你击中致命一击，你会额外造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。

f651cd2fa0e17bc4bb771a32b7f0ca681866e9ef.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5…13…15 damage. If you land a critical hit, you deal an additional +5…25…30 damage.
f651cd2fa0e17bc4bb771a32b7f0ca681866e9ef.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +5…13…15 点伤害。如果你击中致命一击，你会额外造成 +5…25…30 点伤害。

120317cf6384c3fb87e8a5880fad7c76f7626ed1.source: Axe Attack. If it hits, this attack always results in a critical hit.
120317cf6384c3fb87e8a5880fad7c76f7626ed1.text: 斧头攻击。如果击中，这次攻击总是会造成致命一击。

dac3957196ae9500cfd04c3a0d137a21ce580337.source: Elite Signet. All of your signets except Keystone Signet are recharged. For 20 seconds, the next 0…5…6 times you use a signet that targets a foe, all other foes adjacent to your target take 15…51…60 damage and are interrupted.
dac3957196ae9500cfd04c3a0d137a21ce580337.text: 精英图章。除 Keystone 印章外，您的所有印章均已充值。在 20 秒内，接下来 0…5…6 次你使用印章瞄准敌人时，与你的目标相邻的所有其他敌人都会受到 15…51…60 点伤害并被打断。

d668a860f29bc05bb2b55e7b9fa4e5887c11b9b9.source: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows deal fire damage and hit for an additional 3…20…24 fire damage.
d668a860f29bc05bb2b55e7b9fa4e5887c11b9b9.text: 准备。在 24 秒内，你的箭会造成火焰伤害并额外造成 3…20…24 点火焰伤害。

ae4d1ab4421faf2ea94d784d9aad929ff671e5be.source: Enchantment Spell. For 12 seconds, you gain +20…68…80 armor. Whenever you cast a spell, Kinetic Armor is renewed for 12 seconds.
ae4d1ab4421faf2ea94d784d9aad929ff671e5be.text: 结界咒语。在 12 秒内，你获得 +20…68…80 点护甲。每当你施展法术时，动能护甲就会更新 12 秒。

b108d39dade2ba5a3e0b9ed77e904fd6ee1f5267.source: Spell. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to the location in which the spell was cast take 8…27…32 holy damage each second.
b108d39dade2ba5a3e0b9ed77e904fd6ee1f5267.text: 咒语。在 5 秒内，施法位置附近的敌人每秒受到 8…27…32 点神圣伤害。

1d7daae5837f33c11652f66cec01ae90f0d23205.source: Hex Spell. For 6…11…12 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When Kitah's Burden ends you gain 10…16…18 Energy.
1d7daae5837f33c11652f66cec01ae90f0d23205.text: 降咒魔法。在 6…11…12 秒内，目标敌人的移动速度减慢 50%。当基塔的负担结束时，你将获得 10…16…18 点能量。

2b818bea92814ae9acf643a969beaafe0b818187.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits a Crippled foe, you gain 2…6…7 Energy and 1…3…3 strikes Plural "1 strikes" when it should be "1 strike" of adrenaline.
2b818bea92814ae9acf643a969beaafe0b818187.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击击中了残废的敌人，你将获得 2…6…7 能量，并且 1…3…3 击中复数“1 击”，而实际上应该是“1 击”肾上腺素。

2701b91d453c95432a7c01fabc81019d622c4131.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit allies within its range are healed for 1…6…7 Health for each second this spirit was alive. This spirit dies after 20 seconds.
2701b91d453c95432a7c01fabc81019d622c4131.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。当该灵魂死亡时，该灵魂每存活一秒，其范围内的所有非灵魂盟友都会受到 1…6…7 生命值的治疗。该灵魂会在 20 秒后死亡。

6abe8fd267e045bf83606eb24e831c131609f249.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 30% less damage with attacks, but gains 14…43…50% more Health when healed.
6abe8fd267e045bf83606eb24e831c131609f249.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，目标盟友的攻击造成的伤害减少 30% 点，但在治疗时获得的生命值增加 14…43…50% 点。

c69c876a67d569f3822ebd4cfe62d07d6fe0468a.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, damage dealt to target other ally is reduced by 20…44…50%. If your Health is below 50% when that ally takes damage, Life Barrier ends.
c69c876a67d569f3822ebd4cfe62d07d6fe0468a.text: 精英结界法术。当你维持此结界时，对目标其他盟友造成的伤害减少 20…44…50%。如果当该盟友受到伤害时你的生命值低于 50%，生命屏障结束。

7372955ae1f363de74230bb45734ddbb53d9eab0.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target other ally takes damage from an attack, half the damage is redirected to you. The damage you receive this way is reduced by 3…25…30.
7372955ae1f363de74230bb45734ddbb53d9eab0.text: 结界咒语。当你保持这个结界时，每当目标其他盟友受到攻击伤害时，一半的伤害就会转移到你身上。通过这种方式你受到的伤害会减少 3…25…30。

875c08a2d3c5b506d0f809bb6b07d071021534fc.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Remove 0…2…2 conditions from target ally. For 8 seconds, the next time that ally would take damage or life steal, that ally gains that amount of Health instead (maximum 20…84…100).
875c08a2d3c5b506d0f809bb6b07d071021534fc.text: 精英结界法术。移除目标盟友 0…2…2 个条件。在 8 秒内，下次该盟友受到伤害或生命偷取时，该盟友会获得同等数量的生命值（最多 20…84…100）。

140a0a88e60403b6c0a559d794fd56f44b4e48dc.source: Hex Spell. For 12…22…24 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…3 Health degeneration, and you gain +1…3…3 Health regeneration.
140a0a88e60403b6c0a559d794fd56f44b4e48dc.text: 降咒魔法。在 12…22…24 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…3 点生命值退化，而你获得 +1…3…3 点生命值恢复。

d18657ae4fc3b072e661f8680027f1783c9fd72d.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 6…11…12 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes suffer -3…7…8 Health degeneration, which you gain as Health regeneration.
d18657ae4fc3b072e661f8680027f1783c9fd72d.text: 精英六角咒语。在 6…11…12 秒内，目标敌人和邻近敌人遭受 -3…7…8 点生命值退化，这是你通过生命值再生获得的。

f5a5869d95e73fe260cf47ee8ee9f67f124253bc.source: Spell. Target foe takes 12…41…48 shadow damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you steal up to 12…41…48 Health.
f5a5869d95e73fe260cf47ee8ee9f67f124253bc.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 12…41…48 点暗影伤害。如果该敌人的生命值高于 50%，则您最多窃取 12…41…48 点生命值。

5aee07f6872825ff58689c6f0051503cbe0d0e23.source: Touch Skill. If target touched foe is knocked down, that foe loses one enchantment.
5aee07f6872825ff58689c6f0051503cbe0d0e23.text: 触摸技能。如果目标接触的敌人被击倒，该敌人就会失去一项结界。

ec80ef3135966d8175b12af98209195fef6558df.source: Spell. All foes in the area are struck for 55…80 holy damage. The location of hidden objects are briefly indicated on your Compass. Any hidden objects in the area are revealed.
ec80ef3135966d8175b12af98209195fef6558df.text: 咒语。该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 55…80 点神圣伤害。指南针上会简要指示隐藏物体的位置。该区域中的任何隐藏物体都会被揭示。

5f046856ac1a0a3beca3f3893ac56a5bc92a3fec.source: Elite Spell. All party members are healed for 5…57…70 Health.
5f046856ac1a0a3beca3f3893ac56a5bc92a3fec.text: 精英法术。所有队员均已治愈 5…57…70 点生命值。

b7528c856ef2f5dac061b32e4da0b0d0d55b4147.source: Elite Spell. All party members are healed for 5…57…70 Health. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
b7528c856ef2f5dac061b32e4da0b0d0d55b4147.text: 精英法术。所有队员均已治愈 5…57…70 点生命值。你所有的重击祈祷都会被禁用 20 秒。

2f10dc140df36d7048d45ce20b62b962ac5b8524.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Bleeding creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit creatures within its range that have less than 90% Health begin Bleeding for 5…21…25 seconds. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
2f10dc140df36d7048d45ce20b62b962ac5b8524.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。在其范围内的流血生物会遭受-2生命值退化。当该灵魂死亡时，其范围内所有生命值低于 90% 的非灵魂生物开始流血，持续 5…21…25 秒。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

dad1b452b84f1c2f6fc42d547795d534256330ca.source: Axe Attack. If Lacerating Chop hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If it strikes a knocked down foe your target suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds.
dad1b452b84f1c2f6fc42d547795d534256330ca.text: 斧头攻击。如果撕裂斩击中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果它击中了被击倒的敌人，你的目标就会流血 5…17…20 秒。

ef6141068ec99ccc02f73c236f4da38523289787.source: Skill. Target demonic servant of Abaddon takes 100 holy damage and is interrupted. This skill strikes one additional foe in the area for each rank of Lightbringer you have attained. This skill is disabled for 15 seconds after it is used.
ef6141068ec99ccc02f73c236f4da38523289787.text: 技能。目标阿巴顿恶魔仆从受到 100 点神圣伤害并被打断。您每达到一个光明使者等级，该技能就会在该区域额外打击一名敌人。该技能使用后15秒内无效。

fd93215841fcb480af82b8770cd63e9b88455fc3.source: Spell. Resurrect all dead party members in the area. They are returned to life with 25% Health and zero Energy.
fd93215841fcb480af82b8770cd63e9b88455fc3.text: 咒文。复活该地区所有死去的队员。他们以 25% 的生命值和零能量恢复生命。

4acb6df194ae7af85ff81b0890a62c2d3c820124.source: Signet. If you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon, you gain 4…5 strikes of adrenaline and 22…24 Energy.
4acb6df194ae7af85ff81b0890a62c2d3c820124.text: 印章。如果你处于阿巴顿恶魔仆从的区域内，你将获得 4…5 次肾上腺素打击和 22…24 点能量。

31d42a08b65eb1cd75bb978c259d7fcfdacd5fd2.source: Scythe Attack. This attack interrupts an action if it hits. If you are enchanted, any skill you interrupt is disabled for additional 1…8…10 seconds. This attack does 50% normal damage.
31d42a08b65eb1cd75bb978c259d7fcfdacd5fd2.text: 镰刀攻击。如果命中，此攻击会中断动作。如果你被附魔，任何被你打断的技能都会被额外禁用 1…8…10 秒。这次攻击造成 50% 点普通伤害。

c636a8ed4e592c2a1ae1c7bffff1dcb6ed9a0ed9.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you have +0…4…5 Energy regeneration. This enchantment reapplies itself every time you cast a spell on a foe.
c636a8ed4e592c2a1ae1c7bffff1dcb6ed9a0ed9.text: 精英结界法术。 10 秒，你有 +0…4…5 能量再生。每当你对敌人施展法术时，这个结界就会重新生效。

760bb7bbbb659bb74912da90ca36680f1bfad939.source: Spell. Target foe loses one Enchantment. If you have more Enchantments than target foe, this skill has no effect.
760bb7bbbb659bb74912da90ca36680f1bfad939.text: 咒语。目标敌人失去一项结界。如果你的结界比目标敌人多，则该技能无效。

7e90ebe1618af68561eef292b3bcba6997aba0d3.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. When you activate this enchantment, all adjacent foes are interrupted. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are interrupted. 50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.
7e90ebe1618af68561eef292b3bcba6997aba0d3.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 3…13…15 秒内，你的苦行僧结界充能速度会加快 33%。当你激活这个结界时，所有邻近的敌人都会被打断。当这个结界结束时，所有邻近的敌人都会被打断。 50% 失败几率，除非风之祈愿 5 或更高。

5b11f8f41db998ad504b6c0c9afcbae61afb01fe.source: Spell. Create a Maelstrom at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, foes adjacent to that area are struck for 10…22…25 cold damage each second. Maelstrom interrupts spell-casting when it hits.
5b11f8f41db998ad504b6c0c9afcbae61afb01fe.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置制造漩涡。持续 10 秒，该区域附近的敌人每秒受到 10…22…25 点寒冷伤害。漩涡击中时会打断施法。

ebd43862cdb6b8f73bc5c9865480ceaa10401c8e.source: Elite Bow Attack. If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, it is disabled for an additional 10 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
ebd43862cdb6b8f73bc5c9865480ceaa10401c8e.text: 精英弓攻击。如果此攻击命中，则会打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是咒语，则它会额外禁用 10 秒。此攻击无法被阻止。

7da2b369ab666a878033db9fa1b33bd67339568e.source: Elite Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +7…21…25 damage. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
7da2b369ab666a878033db9fa1b33bd67339568e.text: 精英近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +7…21…25 点伤害。如果你的目标受到结界的影响，则该攻击无法被阻挡。

e8bdfe99da7c586082a0e013849f17d0ed4b940e.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is knocked down. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
e8bdfe99da7c586082a0e013849f17d0ed4b940e.text: 精英锤攻击。如果这次攻击命中，目标敌人就会被击倒。如果你的目标受到结界的影响，则该攻击无法被阻挡。

fd1cf057890f71ad97320b107043de9189f2c0ee.source: Enchantment Spell. For 1…7…8 seconds, you block the next attack against you and deal 10…42…50 damage to your attacker. If you are Overcast, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.
fd1cf057890f71ad97320b107043de9189f2c0ee.text: 结界咒语。在 1…7…8 秒内，你阻挡对你的下一次攻击并对攻击者造成 10…42…50 点伤害。如果你是阴天，所有能听到的队员也会被迷惑。

13d0e0e4db0d1486279f652eaf9cccdd12e6ed47.source: Spell. Send out a Lightning Bolt that strikes for 5…41…50 lightning damage if it hits. If Lightning Bolt strikes a moving foe, that foe is struck for 5…41…50 additional lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
13d0e0e4db0d1486279f652eaf9cccdd12e6ed47.text: 咒文。发出一道闪电，击中后会造成 5…41…50 点闪电伤害。如果闪电击中移动的敌人，该敌人会受到 5…41…50 点额外闪电伤害。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

ba4c70645e340650f71335c4da4e67bc52e7cd9c.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10…82…100 lightning damage and applies Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds. Lightning Hammer has 25% armor penetration.
ba4c70645e340650f71335c4da4e67bc52e7cd9c.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 10…82…100 点闪电伤害，并施加裂痕护甲，持续 5…17…20 秒。闪电之锤拥有 25% 的护甲穿透力。

4e70221bfe8dfe08bd1c4742413d3cab3cefacd3.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10…82…100 lightning damage. Lightning Hammer has 25% armor penetration.
4e70221bfe8dfe08bd1c4742413d3cab3cefacd3.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 10…82…100 点闪电伤害。闪电之锤拥有 25% 的护甲穿透力。

ec611268036ad1c90fd4ab2ae9a26d8ba4dbc63d.source: Spell. Send out a Lightning Javelin that strikes for 15…43…50 lightning damage if it hits. Lightning Javelin interrupts attacking foes. This spell has 25% armor penetration and strikes all foes between you and your target.
ec611268036ad1c90fd4ab2ae9a26d8ba4dbc63d.text: 咒语。发射闪电标枪，命中后造成 15…43…50 点闪电伤害。闪电标枪打断敌人的攻击。该法术具有 25% 的护甲穿透力，攻击你和目标之间的所有敌人。

4bdb51c4c4717cd42fc3d8a5958dbb2275ebe904.source: Enchantment Spell. Target foe takes 15…63…75 damage. If you are Overcast, Magnetic Surge enchants all allies in earshot for 1…4…5 seconds to block the next attack against them.
4bdb51c4c4717cd42fc3d8a5958dbb2275ebe904.text: 结界咒语。目标敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害。如果你处于阴暗状态，磁力涌动会对听力范围内的所有盟友进行附魔，持续 1…4…5 秒，以阻止对他们的下一次攻击。

54a29a5b0a95390e788d38bc6a9677de5345dc64.source: Spear Attack. If your attack hits a Bleeding foe, that foe is Crippled for 5…17…20 seconds.
54a29a5b0a95390e788d38bc6a9677de5345dc64.text: 长矛攻击。如果你的攻击击中了流血的敌人，该敌人就会瘫痪 5…17…20 秒。

d0ecdd4299fcf456e095d291d93918c4291a040f.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Maiming Strike that deals +5…17…20 damage. If that attack hits that foe becomes Crippled for 3…13…15 seconds.
d0ecdd4299fcf456e095d291d93918c4291a040f.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行致残打击，造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果该攻击击中该敌人，该敌人将陷入瘫痪 3…13…15 秒。

55746ea8f852f5ab5ef3d3e1053cd1298c787254.source: Hex Spell. For 5…29…35 seconds, target foe suffers -1 Energy degeneration and you suffer -1 Health degeneration. If target foe's Energy reaches 0, that foe takes 5…41…50 damage and Malaise ends.
55746ea8f852f5ab5ef3d3e1053cd1298c787254.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…29…35 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1 点能量退化，而你则遭受 -1 点生命值退化。如果目标敌人的能量达到 0，则该敌人受到 5…41…50 点伤害，不适结束。

cdfca6d0dcbbb30a9ee4345068d7afd1cd16b63e.source: Spell. Send out a Lightning Orb that strikes target foe for 10…82…100 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
cdfca6d0dcbbb30a9ee4345068d7afd1cd16b63e.text: 咒文。发射一颗闪电球，攻击目标敌人，造成 10…82…100 点闪电伤害。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

1badedf8808c9d1471e3ce1ffeae9c8e067c3d4a.source: Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks, and you attack 33% faster.
1badedf8808c9d1471e3ce1ffeae9c8e067c3d4a.text: 立场。在 5…10…11 秒内，你有 75% 的机会格挡近战和投射物攻击，并且你的攻击速度加快 33%。

c82b27e1ad0a536a609a17580ecb631dd3da9fc1.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you deal +10…26…30 damage and this attack results in a critical hit.
c82b27e1ad0a536a609a17580ecb631dd3da9fc1.text: 近战攻击。如果此攻击击中患有某种病症的敌人，你会造成 +10…26…30 伤害，并且此攻击会造成致命一击。

a31d94bec180c6a8653b4739b99adc8949fa4914.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe receives 20% less benefit from healing. If target foe dies while hexed with Malign Intervention, a level 1…14…17 masterless bone horror is summoned.
a31d94bec180c6a8653b4739b99adc8949fa4914.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人获得的治疗效果减少 20%。如果目标敌人在被恶意干预施咒时死亡，则会召唤等级为 1…14…17 的无主骨恐魔。

d7a04df3f505e274ed99af2ffa075ad611d74bcc.source: Skill. Target foe becomes Crippled for 5…17…20 seconds. This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
d7a04df3f505e274ed99af2ffa075ad611d74bcc.text: 技能。目标敌人瘫痪 5…17…20 秒。该技能算作副手攻击。

0ef226d3b8e560697217fafbd666c8f97ec694b1.source: Stance. For 1…31…38 seconds, the next time you would be interrupted, you are not interrupted.
0ef226d3b8e560697217fafbd666c8f97ec694b1.text: 立场。在 1…31…38 秒内，下次您将被打扰时，您不会被打扰。

d5358deba6ed9b587a6597ba9448f31d87dfbf9e.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, whenever you take earth damage, the damage is reduced by 26…45…50% and you gain 2 Energy.
d5358deba6ed9b587a6597ba9448f31d87dfbf9e.text: 立场。在 30…78…90 秒内，每当你受到土系伤害时，伤害就会减少 26…45…50% 点，并获得 2 点能量。

cf40c53433a1e1ba7f5bdd536dfcfeb000b5c651.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, whenever you take fire damage, the damage is reduced by 26…45…50% and you gain 2 Energy.
cf40c53433a1e1ba7f5bdd536dfcfeb000b5c651.text: 立场。 30…78…90秒内，每当你受到火焰伤害时，伤害就会减少26…45…50%点，并获得2点能量。

27bf4e32181dd3be91962bbfbf11089db3a8c347.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, whenever you take cold damage, the damage is reduced by 26…45…50% and you gain 2 Energy.
27bf4e32181dd3be91962bbfbf11089db3a8c347.text: 立场。 30…78…90秒内，每当你受到寒冷伤害时，伤害就会减少26…45…50%点，并获得2点能量。

9f8c3dc1bea13b685004d4f22bcfb7947c5329c0.source: Stance. For 5…21…25 seconds, signets you successfully activate while in this stance recharge 10…34…40% faster.
9f8c3dc1bea13b685004d4f22bcfb7947c5329c0.text: 立场。在 5…21…25 秒内，您在此姿态下成功激活的图章充能速度会加快 10…34…40% 秒。

7289584879947298b774de59cbf6d8b6f671a79f.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, whenever you take lightning damage, the damage is reduced by 26…45…50% and you gain 2 Energy.
7289584879947298b774de59cbf6d8b6f671a79f.text: 立场。 30…78…90秒内，每当你受到闪电伤害时，伤害就会减少26…45…50%点，并获得2点能量。

e59701d43c130527cf3b00ac312043a4a088fb7c.source: Hex Spell. Strike target foe for 10…50…60 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If you are Overcast, that foe is hexed with Lightning Strike for 3 seconds. When this hex ends, that foe is struck again for 20…36…40 lightning damage.
e59701d43c130527cf3b00ac312043a4a088fb7c.text: 降咒魔法。攻击目标敌人，造成 10…50…60 点闪电伤害。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。如果你处于阴暗状态，该敌人会受到闪电打击的咒语，持续 3 秒。当这个六角形结束时，该敌人会再次受到 20…36…40 点闪电伤害。

d3c9f8ef02d379b321a24f09c60e82504b7fee71.source: Stance. For 5…21…25 seconds, any Illusion Magic hex you cast lasts 10…34…40% longer.
d3c9f8ef02d379b321a24f09c60e82504b7fee71.text: 立场。在 5…21…25 秒内，你施放的任何幻象魔法咒语的持续时间延长 10…34…40%。

42762d580ffcb86eb7a992748de00c5d2d63130b.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you gain no benefit from it. You gain 10…22…25 Energy when Mantra of Recall ends.
42762d580ffcb86eb7a992748de00c5d2d63130b.text: 精英结界法术。在 20 秒内，你没有从中获得任何好处。当回忆咒语结束时，你获得 10…22…25 能量。

f1ecc529c2b8de660a80167d40124bb11f81ec92.source: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.
f1ecc529c2b8de660a80167d40124bb11f81ec92.text: 精英姿态。在 5…17…20 秒内，你施放的法术充能速度加快 33%。

bbe2365370b0d6ae091f83162bb17386419f3163.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 10…5…4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.
bbe2365370b0d6ae091f83162bb17386419f3163.text: 立场。在 30…78…90 秒内，你不会被打断，但每次你会被打断，你都会损失 10…5…4 点能量或决心咒语结束。

d271c9bf33e2a7951f987100ef89ea4c8518db09.source: Stance. For 5 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 10…5…4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.
d271c9bf33e2a7951f987100ef89ea4c8518db09.text: 立场。在 5 秒内，你不会被打断，但每次你会被打断，你都会损失 10…5…4 点能量或决心咒语结束。

2f3fc5cb749184bf856d10230531b4ae7db2d2fe.source: Stance. For 10…34…40 seconds, you have +3 armor for each signet you have equipped. Whenever you use a signet, you gain 5…49…60 health.
2f3fc5cb749184bf856d10230531b4ae7db2d2fe.text: 立场。在 10…34…40 秒内，你装备的每个徽记拥有 +3 点护甲。每当你使用图章时，你都会获得 5…49…60 点生命值。

eaf93e2ed5b1f6eae4f0868cea4e2542187fe676.source: Stance. For 10…34…40 seconds, you have +3 armor for each signet you have equipped. Whenever you use a signet, you gain 5…49…60 Health.
eaf93e2ed5b1f6eae4f0868cea4e2542187fe676.text: 立场。在 10…34…40 秒内，你装备的每个徽记拥有 +3 点护甲。每当您使用图章时，您都会获得 5…49…60 点生命值。

0faa16034bdcaa3ceae080bec13c822fb01186d4.source: Bow Attack. If Marauder's Shot hits, you strike for +25…49…55 damage and all your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
0faa16034bdcaa3ceae080bec13c822fb01186d4.text: 弓攻击。如果掠夺者射击击中，你会造成 +25…49…55 点伤害，并且你的所有非攻击技能将被禁用 5 秒。

cd5c4c3f40dcafe8fe5965a03f97a34709a6ce2c.source: Hex Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, target foe gains 50% less benefit from healing.
cd5c4c3f40dcafe8fe5965a03f97a34709a6ce2c.text: 降咒魔法。在 4…9…10 秒内，目标敌人获得的治疗效果减少 50%。

35af1287e235c7c19e0ec8fbe6a079719599ddbc.source: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, allies hitting target foe gain 0…2…2 strikes of adrenaline. When this hex ends, that foe suffers from Cracked Armor for 1…12…15 seconds.
35af1287e235c7c19e0ec8fbe6a079719599ddbc.text: 降咒魔法。在 5 秒内，击中目标敌人的盟友获得 0…2…2 次肾上腺素打击。当这个降咒结束时，该敌人会遭受装甲破裂1…12…15秒。

1b7839a6d2158ed525e59c58001fa1eafef2df8f.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…21…25 seconds, target foe suffers from -1…4…5 Health degeneration, and enchantments and stances on target foe expire 20…52…60% faster. All of your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
1b7839a6d2158ed525e59c58001fa1eafef2df8f.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…21…25 秒内，目标敌人的生命值下降 -1…4…5 点，目标敌人的结界和姿态失效速度加快 20…52…60% 点。你的所有非刺客技能都会被禁用 5 秒。

670c03a9211a505512c7500a05e90810a8d1b0ec.source: Elite Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14…83…100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
670c03a9211a505512c7500a05e90810a8d1b0ec.text: 精英六角咒语。 3 秒后，目标敌人被击倒并受到 14…83…100 点闪电伤害，并且装甲破裂，持续 5…17…20 秒。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

4f849de8b3fb3a97fa286cfafe311e30a733ffb1.source: Hex Spell. For 20 seconds, the next time you hit target foe with a dual attack skill that foe is knocked down.
4f849de8b3fb3a97fa286cfafe311e30a733ffb1.text: 降咒魔法。 20秒内，下次你用双重攻击技能击中目标敌人时，敌人就会被击倒。

8524f60bb63676a77868f79c07dc82bc551ce109.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, whenever target foe takes physical damage, Mark of Pain deals 10…34…40 shadow damage to adjacent foes.
8524f60bb63676a77868f79c07dc82bc551ce109.text: 降咒魔法。持续 30 秒，每当目标敌人受到物理伤害时，痛苦印记会对相邻敌人造成 10…34…40 点暗影伤害。

0a813348eccb56b5dcbad0b2c647b4bf18780fbc.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target ally would take damage, that ally is healed for that amount instead, maximum 6…49…60. All your Protection Prayers are disabled for 5 seconds.
0a813348eccb56b5dcbad0b2c647b4bf18780fbc.text: 精英结界法术。在 10 秒内，每当目标盟友受到伤害时，该盟友就会受到相应数量的治疗，最多 6…49…60。你的所有保护祈祷都将被禁用，持续 5 秒。

e5e961f028eb5f6a8a83455feaca65ceb02973e1.source: Hex Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Mark of Rodgort. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever each foe is struck for fire damage, that foe is set on fire for 1…3…4 seconds.
e5e961f028eb5f6a8a83455feaca65ceb02973e1.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都被罗德戈特印记施咒。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当每个敌人受到火焰伤害时，该敌人就会着火 1…3…4 秒。

19228cf6cb0f4da7689cc7108dec6ea654e82455.source: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets an ally of that foe, the spell fails and you steal up to 10…76…92 Health from that foe.
19228cf6cb0f4da7689cc7108dec6ea654e82455.text: 降咒魔法。在 6 秒内，目标敌人下一次施放以该敌人的盟友为目标的法术时，该法术会失败，并且你会从该敌人处窃取最多 10…76…92 点生命值。

47e9b6abf4b93ffc6f4658c5c606bc368fdabc20.source: Elite Preparation. For 18 seconds, you gain 5…9…10 Energy whenever your arrows hit, but lose 10 Energy whenever your arrows fail to strike.
47e9b6abf4b93ffc6f4658c5c606bc368fdabc20.text: 精英准备。在 18 秒内，每当你的箭射中你就会获得 5…9…10 点能量，但每当你的箭没有射中你就会失去 10 点能量。

7919deb3ff996b5b510b81a3f58bef50e4668d2e.source: Elite Spell. Transfer all conditions and their remaining durations from your allies to you.
7919deb3ff996b5b510b81a3f58bef50e4668d2e.text: 精英法术。将所有条件及其剩余持续时间从你的盟友转移给你。

7c24cdc93e0dc53916ae3e9a3ca8afaafa4b0082.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…34…40 seconds, you have +2 to your Death Magic and Soul Reaping attributes and sacrifice 5…3…3% of your maximum Health when you cast a spell.
7c24cdc93e0dc53916ae3e9a3ca8afaafa4b0082.text: 结界咒语。在 10…34…40 秒内，你的死亡魔法和灵魂收割属性拥有 +2 点，并在施展法术时牺牲 5…3…3% 点最大生命值。

7fdce2cb7b81c91a656b37222b928c852325e45f.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, you gain 1…3…3 Energy whenever you sacrifice Health.
7fdce2cb7b81c91a656b37222b928c852325e45f.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，每当你牺牲生命值时，你就会获得 1…3…3 点能量。

f596a842473c9d82ca1a969f50d86c212e014c72.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 1…49…61 seconds, all of your elemental attributes are set to 8…13…14 and your elemental spells return 1 Energy plus 30% of their Energy cost.
f596a842473c9d82ca1a969f50d86c212e014c72.text: 精英结界法术。在 1…49…61 秒内，你的所有元素属性都设置为 8…13…14，你的元素法术返回 1 能量加上 30% 的能量消耗。

f6e6e40a274ad3b027855daeea6ace3ff8badabe.source: Enchantment Spell. Lose all adrenaline. For 20 seconds, you gain 1…3…4 Energy every time an enchantment on you ends.
f6e6e40a274ad3b027855daeea6ace3ff8badabe.text: 结界咒语。失去所有肾上腺素。在 20 秒内，每当你身上的结界结束时，你都会获得 1…3…4 点能量。

d18f930c2eceff08f8959464ed7cecfb27d39e1a.source: Hex Spell. For 5…25…30 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack 50% slower.
d18f930c2eceff08f8959464ed7cecfb27d39e1a.text: 降咒魔法。持续 5…25…30 秒，目标敌人和区域内所有敌人的攻击速度减慢 50%。

9726d84f3531ed4ef425766b46ac3bbbab166dbc.source: Elite Preparation. For 18 seconds, whenever your arrows hit, they cause Bleeding for 3…21…25 seconds, and if they hit a target who is under an enchantment, they do +8…24…28 damage.
9726d84f3531ed4ef425766b46ac3bbbab166dbc.text: 精英准备。在 18 秒内，每当你的箭射中时，它们都会造成流血 3…21…25 秒，如果它们击中处于结界之下的目标，则会造成 +8…24…28 点伤害。

070793008b6c5d65fcf91589e89188330f31bc00.source: Skill. Target touched foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10…50…60 lightning damage, are Blinded for 1…3…4 seconds, and have Cracked Armor for 1…8…10 seconds. This skill has 25% armor penetration.
070793008b6c5d65fcf91589e89188330f31bc00.text: 技能。目标接触的敌人和所有邻近的敌人都会受到 10…50…60 点闪电伤害，失明 1…3…4 秒，并且装甲破裂，持续 1…8…10 秒。该技能有25%的护甲穿透。

7e00cb45be4a9465ad047c9be048fef82c28b8ad.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 6…25…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1…3…4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.
7e00cb45be4a9465ad047c9be048fef82c28b8ad.text: 精英六角咒语。在 6…25…30 秒内，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会遭受 -1…3…4 点生命值退化，并减少 25% 点治疗效果。

0d37482c8579b67425e26fe3be29975729f98f9e.source: Skill. All of your signets are disabled for 12 seconds. You are healed for 50…98…110 Health, and gain 0…2…3 strikes of adrenaline.
0d37482c8579b67425e26fe3be29975729f98f9e.text: 技能。您的所有图章将被禁用 12 秒。您已治愈 50…98…110 点生命值，并获得 0…2…3 次肾上腺素冲击。

8d0a7463f2c7df196c6bbf617c2acdd08f1b14d7.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 7…91…112 fire damage. If that foe is attacking or casting a spell, nearby foes are also struck for 7…91…112 fire damage.
8d0a7463f2c7df196c6bbf617c2acdd08f1b14d7.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 7…91…112 点火焰伤害。如果该敌人正在攻击或施法，附近的敌人也会受到 7…91…112 点火焰伤害。

eccac98b18806de9f913996b6ef87107b5475d19.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally hits a foe, you gain 2…14…17 Health.
eccac98b18806de9f913996b6ef87107b5475d19.text: 结界咒语。当你保持此结界时，每当目标盟友击中敌人时，你都会获得 2…14…17 点生命值。

64c30cdc3e30a92d59bb10274893382383d885f7.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Melandru's Assault that deals +5…17…20 damage to all nearby foes.
64c30cdc3e30a92d59bb10274893382383d885f7.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试梅兰德鲁的攻击，对附近所有敌人造成 +5…17…20 伤害。

2fbdfcd6c43747c077e47001e40b489d97f8db25.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Melandru's Assault that deals +5…17…20 damage. If that attack strikes a foe with an enchantment, that foe and all adjacent foes take +5…29…35 additional damage.
2fbdfcd6c43747c077e47001e40b489d97f8db25.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试梅兰德鲁的攻击，造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果该攻击击中带有结界的敌人，则该敌人和所有邻近的敌人会受到 +5…29…35 点额外伤害。

1b92576a401e72d683cd5087037a09c19b039079.source: Elite Stance. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +4 Health regeneration and +1 Energy regeneration for each condition and hex you are suffering.
1b92576a401e72d683cd5087037a09c19b039079.text: 精英姿态。在 8…18…20 秒内，您将获得 +4 点生命再生和 +1 点能量再生，针对您所遭受的每种状况和降咒。

7ff0be82477f75088abd5b196c8d2ef1a22732de.source: Elite Bow Attack. If Melandru's Shot hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5…21…25 seconds. If it hits a foe that is moving or knocked down, that foe takes +10…22…25 damage and is Crippled for 5…13…15 seconds.
7ff0be82477f75088abd5b196c8d2ef1a22732de.text: 精英弓攻击。如果梅兰德鲁的射击击中，你的目标就会开始流血 5…21…25 秒。如果它击中正在移动或被击倒的敌人，该敌人会受到 +10…22…25 点伤害并瘫痪 5…13…15 秒。

875cab6092812c1c7b87a1e2083b29c8898b8f43.source: Spell. Remove one condition (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, or Deep Wound) from target ally. For each remaining Condition, that ally is healed for 5…57…70 Health.
875cab6092812c1c7b87a1e2083b29c8898b8f43.text: 咒语。移除目标盟友的一种状况（中毒、疾病、失明、茫然、流血、残废、燃烧、虚弱、盔甲破裂或深伤）。对于每个剩余的状况，该盟友都会获得 5…57…70 点生命值的治疗。

94a89e9d693e6e0d083d9dd9824b210cb824548f.source: Spell. Target ally is healed for 20…96…115 Health. That ally loses one condition for each spirit within earshot.
94a89e9d693e6e0d083d9dd9824b210cb824548f.text: 咒语。目标盟友已治愈 20…96…115 点生命值。该盟友会为听力范围内的每个灵魂失去一个条件。

c2e677eda3f55833881b500115cbacb03473692d.source: Spell. Remove one condition (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, or Deep Wound) from target other ally. If a condition is removed, that ally is healed for 5…57…70 Health.
c2e677eda3f55833881b500115cbacb03473692d.text: 咒语。移除目标其他盟友的一种状况（中毒、疾病、失明、茫然、流血、残废、燃烧、虚弱、盔甲破裂或深度伤口）。如果某个条件被移除，该盟友就会获得 5…57…70 点生命值的治疗。

80aa482029bce52de5621317bbd76d6914dfb888.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains +1…3…4 Health regeneration.
80aa482029bce52de5621317bbd76d6914dfb888.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，目标盟友获得 +1…3…4 点生命恢复。

2d37ab67b77faa96bba43d7f451ac45ecd9ee568.source: Spell. Target ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health. If that ally is under the effects of a weapon spell, that ally loses one condition.
2d37ab67b77faa96bba43d7f451ac45ecd9ee568.text: 咒语。目标盟友已治愈 30…78…90 点生命值。如果该盟友受到武器法术的影响，则该盟友会失去一项条件。

52582f6b30d96db34bfc1280138329d5077d307e.source: Echo. For 15 seconds, target non-spirit ally has +2…3…3 Health regeneration. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
52582f6b30d96db34bfc1280138329d5077d307e.text: 回声。 15秒内，目标非精神盟友恢复+2…3…3点生命值。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。

0661a97cda8e813618199d95443eedecb20aa3f7.source: Echo. For 15 seconds, you have +2…3…3 Health regeneration. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on you.
0661a97cda8e813618199d95443eedecb20aa3f7.text: 回声。在 15 秒内，您将获得 +2…3…3 点生命恢复。每当你的吟唱或喊叫结束时，这种回声就会重新出现。

160e7f2ece2ebdc54ac6cb06126c2042c0dc1b6e.source: Spell. Touched ally loses two conditions and is healed for 15…51…60 Health for each condition removed in this way.
160e7f2ece2ebdc54ac6cb06126c2042c0dc1b6e.text: 咒语。被触碰的盟友会失去两个状态，并以这种方式消除每个状态，治疗 15…51…60 点生命值。

612946ae81d7a5854327f44714f044eb45c56638.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…11 seconds you have a 50% chance to block attacks. This Enchantment is reapplied every time an enemy strikes you.
612946ae81d7a5854327f44714f044eb45c56638.text: 结界咒语。在 5…11 秒内，您有 50% 次机会阻止攻击。每当敌人攻击你时，这个结界就会重新应用。

122bce3d7323cb403c72460810c209888f8934df.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits a foe with less than 50% Health, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
122bce3d7323cb403c72460810c209888f8934df.text: 长矛攻击。如果此攻击击中生命值低于 50% 的敌人，该敌人将受到深度伤害 5…17…20 秒。

ab5719068cf1ce21f6cbec1b64124e4ff82eeed0.source: Item Spell. Hold Naomei's ashes for up to 45 seconds. When you drop her ashes, all party members in the area are resurrected with 15…63…75% Health and zero Energy.
ab5719068cf1ce21f6cbec1b64124e4ff82eeed0.text: 物品法术。保留 Naomei 的骨灰最多 45 秒。当你撒下她的骨灰时，该地区的所有队员都会复活，并拥有 15…63…75% 生命值和零能量。

fc54c667c8d453f96bd97fbceece88999ad4aa4b.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, you have an additional 50% chance to double strike while using daggers.
fc54c667c8d453f96bd97fbceece88999ad4aa4b.text: 精英结界法术。在 10…30…35 秒内，使用匕首时你有额外 50% 次双重攻击的机会。

c35669336696f7da5ca20c3622bed7327703ddc7.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10…22…25 damage and you gain 5…17…20 Energy.
c35669336696f7da5ca20c3622bed7327703ddc7.text: 副手攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。如果命中，这次攻击会造成 +10…22…25 点伤害，并且你获得 5…17…20 点能量。

5702fd82652e3e525da76d6a057f40b61c89db5b.source: Skill. Strike target foe for 45…70 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe takes an additional 30…50 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor for 14…20 seconds.
5702fd82652e3e525da76d6a057f40b61c89db5b.text: 技能。对目标敌人造成 45…70 点伤害。如果目标敌人被击倒，该敌人会受到额外 30…50 点伤害，并遭受装甲破裂，持续 14…20 秒。

39f8d1aef20bb9b326e94ea2f21a01e275d95d20.source: Chant. For 5…17…20 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Signet, that ally loses 1 Condition.
39f8d1aef20bb9b326e94ea2f21a01e275d95d20.text: 吟诵。在 5…17…20 秒内，每次听到范围内的每个盟友下一次使用图章时，该盟友都会失去 1 状态。

ba93e0f0c0a059177edf91d1d2b237b3a7fe35cf.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a signet, that ally gains 1…7…8 Energy.
ba93e0f0c0a059177edf91d1d2b237b3a7fe35cf.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，每次听力范围内的每个盟友下一次使用图章时，该盟友都会获得 1…7…8 点能量。

e18aef6b3a724acd1afd3a1045d77f5c5b9debfa.source: Elite Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes take 15…51…60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe and all adjacent foes take an additional 15…51…60 fire damage and are set on fire for 1…8…10 seconds.
e18aef6b3a724acd1afd3a1045d77f5c5b9debfa.text: 精英法术。目标敌人和所有邻近敌人受到 15…51…60 点火焰伤害。如果你的能量多于目标敌人，则该敌人和所有相邻敌人会受到额外 15…51…60 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…8…10 秒。

ecd836e075d39718b831038c718ca57cd2061869.source: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10…50…60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10…50…60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.
ecd836e075d39718b831038c718ca57cd2061869.text: 精英六角咒语。目标敌人受到 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害。如果你的能量比目标敌人多，则该敌人会受到额外 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害，并且移动速度减慢 90% 点，持续 1…4…5 秒。

2d1b03b361a06a7e3ae41d7020166c33218c22cc.source: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 7…91…112 fire damage and knocked down.
2d1b03b361a06a7e3ae41d7020166c33218c22cc.text: 咒文。目标敌人和所有邻近敌人都会受到 7…91…112 点火焰伤害并被击倒。

5b62fcd2177c5bc53df1146fb5099ab9ee24d318.source: Spell. Create a Meteor Shower at target foe's location. For 9 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 7…91…112 fire damage and knocked down every 3 seconds.
5b62fcd2177c5bc53df1146fb5099ab9ee24d318.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置制造流星雨。在 9 秒内，该位置附近的敌人每 3 秒就会受到 7…91…112 点火焰伤害并被击倒。

e40b6676019cb1fea6acefb422c189224bc0d455.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage.
e40b6676019cb1fea6acefb422c189224bc0d455.text: 锤子攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +10…34…40 点伤害。

c38be668120ecde71cdb6e5e3f061757250e656c.source: Elite Spell. Target foe suffers 10…42…50 lightning damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers 10…42…50 more lightning damage and is knocked down. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
c38be668120ecde71cdb6e5e3f061757250e656c.text: 精英法术。目标敌人受到 10…42…50 点闪电伤害。如果你的能量比目标敌人多，则该敌人会多遭受 10…42…50 点闪电伤害并被击倒。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

11ef5158c44ca9b74bd9036cc0aa9d1b1f5aa5bf.source: Hex Spell. For 5…33…40 seconds, whenever this foe is the target of any of your non-hex Mesmer skills, that foe loses 1 Energy and takes 5…21…25 damage per point of Energy lost. If the target foe's Energy drops to 0, Mind Wrack ends and that foe takes 15…83…100 damage.
11ef5158c44ca9b74bd9036cc0aa9d1b1f5aa5bf.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…33…40 秒内，每当该敌人成为你的任何非降咒幻术师技能的目标时，该敌人就会失去 1 点能量，并且每损失一点能量就会受到 5…21…25 点伤害。如果目标敌人的能量降至 0，精神毁灭结束，该敌人受到 15…83…100 点伤害。

ecab45767657632ff19f203f3a39f6567cad5729.source: Hex Spell. For 5…33…40 seconds, whenever this foe is the target of one of your non-hex Mesmer skills, that foe loses 1 Energy. If the target foe's Energy drops to 0, Mind Wrack ends and that foe takes 15…83…100 damage.
ecab45767657632ff19f203f3a39f6567cad5729.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…33…40 秒内，每当该敌人成为你的非降咒幻术师技能之一的目标时，该敌人就会损失 1 点能量。如果目标敌人的能量下降到 0，心灵毁灭就会结束，并且该敌人受到 15…83…100 点伤害。

bfef17386da17b2b412fa0dd17bce988726c5cee.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…16 seconds, you move 20…33% faster and your Spells take 20% less time to cast.
bfef17386da17b2b412fa0dd17bce988726c5cee.text: 结界咒语。在 10…16 秒内，你的移动速度加快了 20…33%，你的法术施展时间减少了 20%。

2a85342c3e78c429bf7012d7a111bd68082c7f5c.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have a 40% chance to block and an extra 4…9…10% for each additional enchantment (max 80%). All nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage each time a Dervish enchantment is removed from you.
2a85342c3e78c429bf7012d7a111bd68082c7f5c.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 20 秒内，你有 40% 次阻挡机会，每增加一个结界就有额外 4…9…10% 次阻挡机会（最多 80% 次）。每次从你身上移除苦行僧结界时，所有附近的敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点地球伤害。

725cf21cbbeed190a6ed45406d3a84dacc7e1db6.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1…6…7 seconds, you have a 30…54…60% chance to block incoming attacks. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage.
725cf21cbbeed190a6ed45406d3a84dacc7e1db6.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 1…6…7 秒内，您有 30…54…60% 次机会阻止传入攻击。当你施放此结界时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点土属性伤害。

4b5fa7c7decd6dc1306dee940550e852354d4897.source: Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe. All of that foe's party members also lose that same enchantment.
4b5fa7c7decd6dc1306dee940550e852354d4897.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的一项结界。所有敌人的队伍成员也失去了同样的魅力。

ec6593501f480ab8a3e1769977ad3241fcc7582f.source: Elite Hex Spell. Shatter a Mirror of Ice. All foes near you and target ally take 15…59…70 cold damage and move 66% slower for 2…5…6 seconds. If you strike a foe hexed with Water Magic, Mirror of Ice recharges 50% faster.
ec6593501f480ab8a3e1769977ad3241fcc7582f.text: 精英六角咒语。打碎冰镜。你附近的所有敌人和目标盟友都会受到 15…59…70 点寒冷伤害，移动速度减慢 66%，持续 2…5…6 秒。如果你用水魔法击中敌人，冰之镜的充能速度会加快 50%。

561014640b6a112802be84f37aff827bda34b89c.source: Hex Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, whenever target foe enters a stance, you enter the same stance.
561014640b6a112802be84f37aff827bda34b89c.text: 降咒魔法。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当目标敌人进入姿态时，你也进入相同的姿态。

790edd37ad32743234d7f016ee9ff840be1eb9d0.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…38…45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effects of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50…210…250% of the Energy cost of the spell.
790edd37ad32743234d7f016ee9ff840be1eb9d0.text: 精英结界法术。在 10…38…45 秒内，你在水魔法六角形效果下受到的敌人伤害减少 33%。每当你施展元素法术时，所有听力范围内的非灵魂盟友都会受到法术能量消耗 50…210…250% 点的治疗。

9d013eddd14a893bffb6f3b1f81839e77a963e1e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…38…45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effects of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50…210…250% of the Energy cost of the spell. This spell does not heal allies above 80% Health.
9d013eddd14a893bffb6f3b1f81839e77a963e1e.text: 精英结界法术。在 10…38…45 秒内，你在水魔法六角形效果下受到的敌人伤害减少 33%。每当你施展元素法术时，所有听力范围内的非灵魂盟友都会受到法术能量消耗 50…210…250% 点的治疗。该法术无法治愈生命值高于 80% 的盟友。

290eef13b3db2cf246d350e5ee00666213077a91.source: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next spell that target foe casts on one of your allies fails and deals 10…66…80 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all nearby foes.
290eef13b3db2cf246d350e5ee00666213077a91.text: 降咒魔法。在 6 秒内，目标敌人对你的盟友之一施放的下一个法术会失败，并对该敌人造成 10…66…80 点伤害，并对附近所有敌人造成 75% 点伤害。

32d0ff36c3b72bd98b1cba999df40f85334be1a1.source: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next spell that target foe casts on one of your allies fails and deals 10…50…60 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all nearby foes.
32d0ff36c3b72bd98b1cba999df40f85334be1a1.text: 降咒魔法。在 6 秒内，目标敌人对你的盟友之一施放的下一个法术会失败，并对该敌人造成 10…50…60 点伤害，并对附近所有敌人造成 75% 点伤害。

7ce43273d9bab85f67bb90bf05315b1fc205694a.source: Spear Attack. Your spear moves three times faster. If it hits, you deal +10…34…40 damage.
7ce43273d9bab85f67bb90bf05315b1fc205694a.text: 长矛攻击。你的矛移动速度快三倍。如果击中，你会造成 +10…34…40 伤害。

a2df995f8ff268b8b79517b24dbc1aac9b156b65.source: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a Dual Attack. If it hits, Moebius Strike strikes for +10…30…35 damage. If you strike a foe whose Health is below 50%, all your other attack skills are recharged.
a2df995f8ff268b8b79517b24dbc1aac9b156b65.text: 精英副手攻击。必须遵循双重攻击。如果击中，莫比斯之击会造成 +10…30…35 伤害。如果你攻击生命值低于 50% 的敌人，你的所有其他攻击技能都会恢复。

e9a6eb307fec6fc0a12aa7973aa6a3d3eebc32cf.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage and gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
e9a6eb307fec6fc0a12aa7973aa6a3d3eebc32cf.text: 锤子攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +5…17…20 点伤害并获得 2 点肾上腺素打击。

83e1627c39fb6d3c2be409257a3c928710c9ad90.source: Item Spell. Hold Vorizun's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain +15 armor and +30 maximum Energy.
83e1627c39fb6d3c2be409257a3c928710c9ad90.text: 物品法术。保留沃里尊的骨灰最多 15…51…60 秒。当你持有他的骨灰时，你获得+15护甲和+30最大能量。

a8d0467676c11919406e0ba73a0012c12ad9d861.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration and takes 100% longer to activate skills.
a8d0467676c11919406e0ba73a0012c12ad9d861.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…7…8 点生命值退化，并且需要 100% 更长的时间来激活技能。

39b2b6021b623cb6acbd00bd757aa86a867b052d.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 4…14…16 seconds, target foe suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration and takes 100% longer to activate skills.
39b2b6021b623cb6acbd00bd757aa86a867b052d.text: 精英六角咒语。在 4…14…16 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…7…8 点生命值退化，并且需要 100% 更长的时间来激活技能。

10e6d159ae14f75d5fa71054086921f8782c5a0e.source: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…51…60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, you gain 1…7…8 Energy.
10e6d159ae14f75d5fa71054086921f8782c5a0e.text: 精英法术。目标敌人受到 15…51…60 点火焰伤害。如果你的能量多于目标敌人，你将获得 1…7…8 能量。

b5bc37fdfe222db69fd3e764d1935d00b263e43a.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range move 10% slower and speed boosts have no effect. This spirit dies after 30…150…180 seconds.
b5bc37fdfe222db69fd3e764d1935d00b263e43a.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。其范围内的非精神生物移动速度减慢 10%，并且速度提升没有效果。该灵魂会在 30…150…180 秒后死亡。

50556d3b88e49963d60ae1e908e06d8edde2889e.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes suffer from Disease for 1…8…10 seconds. For 20 seconds, nothing happens. Disease duration is doubled if you are enchanted when you activate this skill. When this enchantment ends, all party members in earshot are cured of Disease.
50556d3b88e49963d60ae1e908e06d8edde2889e.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会受到疾病影响，持续 1…8…10 秒。在 20 秒内，什么也没有发生。如果您在激活此技能时被附魔，则疾病持续时间会加倍。当这个结界结束时，所有在听力范围内的队员的疾病都会被治愈。

d2326a047fe3513b3da0aa48111386932e85cf4b.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes suffer from Disease for 2…5…6 seconds. For 20 seconds, nothing happens. Disease duration is doubled if you are enchanted when you activate this skill. When this enchantment ends, all party members in earshot are cured of Disease.
d2326a047fe3513b3da0aa48111386932e85cf4b.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会受到疾病影响，持续 2…5…6 秒。在 20 秒内，什么也没有发生。如果您在激活此技能时被附魔，则疾病持续时间会加倍。当这个结界结束时，所有在听力范围内的队员的疾病都会被治愈。

b754d991c8a5836ccd4ec709ba9ababc266abfe9.source: Spell. You are healed for 5…53…65 Health. Also heals all enchanted party members for 5…53…65 Health.
b754d991c8a5836ccd4ec709ba9ababc266abfe9.text: 咒语。您已治愈 5…53…65 点生命值。还可以治疗所有被施魔法的小队成员 5…53…65 点生命值。

9347b2d2e86f1153900bc9c97472e5c8735163a2.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, you have +1…3…4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.
9347b2d2e86f1153900bc9c97472e5c8735163a2.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，你身上的每个结界都会恢复 +1…3…4 点生命值（最多 8）。

27bfeecbe910076ab855e35fe1ab8d4ba7e37fad.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, you have +1…3…4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 3) on you.
27bfeecbe910076ab855e35fe1ab8d4ba7e37fad.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，你身上的每个结界都会恢复 +1…3…4 点生命值（最多 3）。

d64e330eec731637042fc2c9abb03531739bca6f.source: Spell. Create a sandstorm at your location that lasts 3 seconds. Each second, foes nearby this location take 10…34…40 earth damage. Attacking foes take an additional 10…18…20 damage. If you are enchanted when you cast this spell, it lasts twice as long.
d64e330eec731637042fc2c9abb03531739bca6f.text: 咒语。在您所在的位置制造持续 3 秒的沙尘暴。每秒，该位置附近的敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点地球伤害。攻击敌人会额外受到 10…18…20 点伤害。如果你在施展此法术时被附魔，那么它的持续时间会是原来的两倍。

2e7a0dbac107238ef774a34ec7c191a164a3ee51.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +3…10…12 damage. If you are enchanted, this attack deals an additional +3…10…12 damage.
2e7a0dbac107238ef774a34ec7c191a164a3ee51.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +3…10…12 点伤害。如果你被附魔，这次攻击会造成额外 +3…10…12 点伤害。

81ca07180fe7a8ceb9eadfdf5938de06cb6ac90e.source: Spell. Deals 10…50…60 cold damage to all nearby foes. If you are enchanted, this spell deals an additional 10…50…60 cold damage.
81ca07180fe7a8ceb9eadfdf5938de06cb6ac90e.text: 咒语。对附近所有敌人造成 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害。如果你被附魔，该法术会额外造成 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害。

15f47f280c02142cfb5bc9dfaae092d767938b4f.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, every time you successfully hit with an attack, you gain 3…13…15 Health for each enchantment on you (maximum 25 Health).
15f47f280c02142cfb5bc9dfaae092d767938b4f.text: 结界咒语。在 20 秒内，每次你成功攻击一次，你身上的每个结界都会获得 3…13…15 点生命值（最多 25 点生命值）。

f4fc4f6aac093c2b101ce9d532dc63892db1af33.source: Spell. You are healed for 50…146…170 Health. If you are not enchanted, this spell activates 50% faster.
f4fc4f6aac093c2b101ce9d532dc63892db1af33.text: 咒语。您已治愈 50…146…170 点生命值。如果你没有被附魔，这个法术的激活速度会快 50%。

5d50b54b0dce97e05cc0b7f6729b75e224dd2489.source: Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you run 33% faster and have a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. Natural Stride ends if you become hexed or enchanted.
5d50b54b0dce97e05cc0b7f6729b75e224dd2489.text: 立场。在 1…7…8 秒内，您的运行速度提高了 33%，并且有 50% 的机会阻止传入攻击。如果你被施咒或着魔，自然步伐就会结束。

d5519bd7934be906c6c12fdb638ade7d073497cd.source: Skill. For 4…13…15 seconds, you gain 33% more adrenaline while not under the effects of an Enchantment.
d5519bd7934be906c6c12fdb638ade7d073497cd.text: 技能。在 4…13…15 秒内，当你不在结界的影响下时，你会获得额外 33% 的肾上腺素。

da1113ea76bdb1c32bafece92fa0dafe770ac00d.source: Weapon Spell. For 12 seconds, target ally has a Nightmare Weapon. Target ally's next 3 attacks are reduced by 10…42…50 damage and steal up to 10…42…50 Health.
da1113ea76bdb1c32bafece92fa0dafe770ac00d.text: 武器咒语。 12 秒内，目标盟友拥有梦魇武器。目标盟友接下来的 3 次攻击减少 10…42…50 点伤害并窃取最多 10…42…50 点生命值。

53fadfa67a25cb10c8bb187825b0612884c6943b.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For 30…198…240 seconds, enchantments and hexes cast by non-spirit creatures in range take twice as long to cast, and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
53fadfa67a25cb10c8bb187825b0612884c6943b.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。在 30…198…240 秒内，范围内的非灵体生物施放的结界和妖术需要两倍的时间来施放，并且维持结界所需的能量也是两倍。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

407ce4371cb5ae6018f03fccc61b5bedc631ce81.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. Nine Tail Strike cannot be blocked and strikes for +15…35…40 damage if it hits.
407ce4371cb5ae6018f03fccc61b5bedc631ce81.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。九尾一击无法被格挡，击中后会造成 +15…35…40 伤害。

f3c2b58c1acf2f48838ec56ef119832b81909e98.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For 30…198…240 seconds, enchantments and hexes cast by non-spirit creatures in range take 50…70…75% longer to cast, and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
f3c2b58c1acf2f48838ec56ef119832b81909e98.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。在 30…198…240 秒内，范围内的非灵体生物施放的结界和妖术需要花费 50…70…75% 的时间来施放，并且维持结界所需的能量是两倍。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

b0ad3504a1ff68008f87c62f7f6f86ad99eff16b.source: Skill. If target foe is suffering from a condition or hex, that foe suffers 60…90 damage.
b0ad3504a1ff68008f87c62f7f6f86ad99eff16b.text: 技能。如果目标敌人患有某种状况或妖术，则该敌人将遭受 60…90 点伤害。

afd2566b8f191ecc0751e8512f28953fe4bd4742.source: Spell. Exploit a random corpse or sacrifice 30…22…20% health to teleport to target foe's location. You become Diseased for 6 seconds and all nearby foes become Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds.
afd2566b8f191ecc0751e8512f28953fe4bd4742.text: 咒文。利用随机尸体或牺牲 30…22…20% 生命值来传送到目标敌人的位置。你会生病 6 秒，所有附近的敌人都会中毒 5…17…20 秒。

5d5d12d9c2e9b0c256c03519da0e65c9b2b965df.source: Bow Attack. Needling Shot strikes for only 10…26…30 damage and moves faster than normal. If Needling Shot strikes a foe below 50% Health, Needling Shot recharges instantly. Your other attack skills are disabled for 2 seconds.
5d5d12d9c2e9b0c256c03519da0e65c9b2b965df.text: 弓攻击。针刺射击仅造成 10…26…30 点伤害，并且移动速度比正常情况更快。如果针刺射击击中生命值低于 50% 的敌人，针刺射击会立即充能。你的其他攻击技能将被禁用2秒。

7d0d8db7aa990bf3d6ff1c877e67e80408211f65.source: Skill. For 18…25 seconds, you and your pet attack 25% faster and have +1…3 Health regeneration.
7d0d8db7aa990bf3d6ff1c877e67e80408211f65.text: 技能。在 18…25 秒内，你和你的宠物的攻击速度提高 25% 点，生命恢复速度提高 +1…3 点。

d4ddc208823b8d6b94c741f85d1274d24edadc25.source: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…3…3 enchantments. If an enchantment was lost in this way, that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10…82…100 Health.
d4ddc208823b8d6b94c741f85d1274d24edadc25.text: 精英法术。目标敌人失去 1…3…3 个结界。如果结界以这种方式丢失，该敌人和所有邻近的敌人都会失去 10…82…100 点生命值。

4286012297f6113f8caa30c9ced2124e491dcbfd.source: Hex Spell. For 10…18…20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Painful Bond and take 8…18…20 damage whenever hit by a spirit's attack.
4286012297f6113f8caa30c9ced2124e491dcbfd.text: 降咒魔法。 10…18…20 秒内，目标敌人和附近的所有敌人都会被痛苦束缚施咒，并在受到精魂攻击时受到 8…18…20 点伤害。

507284946ddaf1a0e78e61f25b7a6f4c57eb2c44.source: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 10…54…65 damage and is Crippled for 1…4…5 seconds. This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
507284946ddaf1a0e78e61f25b7a6f4c57eb2c44.text: 精英技能。目标接触的敌人受到 10…54…65 点伤害并瘫痪 1…4…5 秒。该技能算作副手攻击。

670409731e539885d3dfe765ceb82e79751a1b97.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…8…10 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Panic. When a foe hexed with Panic successfully uses a skill, all other nearby foes are interrupted.
670409731e539885d3dfe765ceb82e79751a1b97.text: 精英六角咒语。持续 1…8…10 秒，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会被恐慌施咒。当被恐慌施咒的敌人成功使用技能时，附近所有其他敌人都会被打断。

26090024eb6c4032d19a0c03a55552002dc5e0d5.source: Hex Spell. For 20 seconds, target foe suffers -1 Health degeneration. The caster is healed for 30…102…120 when Parasitic Bond ends.
26090024eb6c4032d19a0c03a55552002dc5e0d5.text: 降咒魔法。在 20 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1 点生命值退化。当寄生羁绊结束时，施法者会受到 30…102…120 点治疗。

8262e0c0b1874264a7d6c42915147072d5c772c0.source: Enchantment Spell. For 2 seconds, target ally is enchanted with Patient Spirit. Unless this enchantment ends prematurely, that ally is healed for 30…102…120 Health when the enchantment ends.
8262e0c0b1874264a7d6c42915147072d5c772c0.text: 结界咒语。 2 秒，目标盟友被耐心精神附魔。除非该结界提前结束，否则该盟友会在结界结束时恢复 30…102…120 点生命值。

5a78f1d33e8f25e8cf1fcc2ed8e7e6be2a5af31e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…7…9 conditions and hex[es]. For 1…3…3 seconds, conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
5a78f1d33e8f25e8cf1fcc2ed8e7e6be2a5af31e.text: 精英结界法术。目标盟友损失 0…7…9 个条件和降咒。在 1…3…3 秒内，该盟友的条件和降咒到期速度快 90%。你所有的重击祈祷都会被禁用 20 秒。

a0aa5369b3056651ee3e81b0cc35be94083ebd70.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…3…4 conditions and hex[es]. For 1…3…3 seconds, conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
a0aa5369b3056651ee3e81b0cc35be94083ebd70.text: 精英结界法术。目标盟友损失 0…3…4 个条件和降咒。在 1…3…3 秒内，该盟友的条件和降咒到期速度快 90%。你所有的重击祈祷都会被禁用 20 秒。

814882b61456b589a938622a65a24f37ae12da77.source: Bow Attack. If Penetrating Attack hits, you strike for +5…21…25 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
814882b61456b589a938622a65a24f37ae12da77.text: 弓攻击。如果穿透攻击命中，你将受到 +5…21…25 点伤害，并且该攻击具有 10% 点护甲穿透力。

fb6e293540bc16aa0c563eb02654947264c64edf.source: Bow Attack. If Penetrating Attack hits, you strike for +5…13…15 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
fb6e293540bc16aa0c563eb02654947264c64edf.text: 弓攻击。如果穿透攻击击中，你将受到 +5…13…15 点伤害，并且该攻击具有 10% 点护甲穿透力。

4614b8b2a554fe633c5edbb115a1c564e6255db4.source: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…22…25 damage. This axe attack has 20% armor penetration.
4614b8b2a554fe633c5edbb115a1c564e6255db4.text: 斧头攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +10…22…25 点伤害。这斧头攻击有20%护甲穿透。

ec9b053d289c0a68aba15925009c0998250782a3.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…10…11 seconds, target ally has a 50% chance to block attacks from enchanted foes.
ec9b053d289c0a68aba15925009c0998250782a3.text: 结界咒语。在 5…10…11 秒内，目标盟友有 50% 几率格挡来自结界敌人的攻击。

effb1ef229300e233b8d58f8c9bd040697b20e7c.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, whenever a spell you cast is interrupted, that spell is instantly recharged.
effb1ef229300e233b8d58f8c9bd040697b20e7c.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，每当你施展的法术被打断时，该法术就会立即恢复。

9665fc45b7b83077fc55d97a6e7ea28f9dec1aee.source: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
9665fc45b7b83077fc55d97a6e7ea28f9dec1aee.text: 精英弓攻击。如果誓言射击击中，你除誓言射击之外的所有技能都会恢复。如果错过了，你的所有技能都会被禁用10…5…4秒。 （50%错失专业知识的机会7或更少。）

470176470733322d42afbae2924631705fab8bca.source: Spell. Deal 22…94…112 damage to target foe. This spell ignores armor.
470176470733322d42afbae2924631705fab8bca.text: 咒语。对目标敌人造成 22…94…112 点伤害。该法术无视护甲。

88bdf49a1080b00d0b195d5cfa2aabb317f734f8.source: Spell. Deal 22…78…92 damage to target foe. This spell ignores armor.
88bdf49a1080b00d0b195d5cfa2aabb317f734f8.text: 咒语。对目标敌人造成 22…78…92 点伤害。该法术无视护甲。

ae2868dd67f221f3990d17d27a0bdc23e15c3cd6.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. When any creature within its range dies, conditions on that creature spread to any creature in the area already suffering from a condition. This spirit dies after 30…150…180 seconds.
ae2868dd67f221f3990d17d27a0bdc23e15c3cd6.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。当其范围内的任何生物死亡时，该生物身上的病症会传播到该区域中已经患有某种病症的任何生物。该灵魂会在 30…150…180 秒后死亡。

496f2e4d5c89517a209569db92715b6348f827c8.source: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…4 Health degeneration. When Phantom Pain ends, that foe suffers a Deep Wound, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.
496f2e4d5c89517a209569db92715b6348f827c8.text: 降咒魔法。在 10 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…4 点生命值退化。当幻痛结束时，该敌人会受到深度伤害，使该敌人的最大生命值降低 20% 点，持续 5…17…20 秒。

833ef8167c792751e9c44760764fccb395253ad1.source: Spell. A fiery Phoenix rises at your location and flies out to your target, exploding on impact. This explosion strikes your target and nearby foes for 10…50…60 fire damage. If you are Overcast, allies in the blast radius are healed for 20…68…80 Health.
833ef8167c792751e9c44760764fccb395253ad1.text: 咒语。一只火热的凤凰在你所在的位置升起，飞向你的目标，撞击时爆炸。这次爆炸会对你的目标和附近的敌人造成 10…50…60 点火焰伤害。如果你处于阴天，爆炸半径内的盟友将获得 20…68…80 点生命值治疗。

7fec5bce7c020e392c8a684dee7ab20afcf61905.source: Stance. For 30…78…90 seconds, You gain +40 armor against physical damage, but you lose 24…14…12 armor against elemental damage.
7fec5bce7c020e392c8a684dee7ab20afcf61905.text: 立场。在 30…78…90 秒内，你获得 +40 点物理伤害护甲值，但失去 24…14…12 点元素伤害护甲值。

862e00449e561c9e56e49c9d41ec2a3b754b7a2f.source: Trap. When Piercing Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5…41…50 piercing damage. Any foes with Cracked Armor are struck for an additional 15…51…60 damage. Piercing Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
862e00449e561c9e56e49c9d41ec2a3b754b7a2f.text: 陷阱。触发穿刺陷阱时，周围所有敌人都会受到 5…41…50 点穿刺伤害。任何拥有裂纹护甲的敌人都会受到 15…51…60 点额外伤害。穿刺陷阱在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

921d6f0ecc53f169fb007a0f48efc16a66ece8f1.source: Bow Attack. If Pin Down hits, your target is Crippled for 3…13…15 seconds.
921d6f0ecc53f169fb007a0f48efc16a66ece8f1.text: 弓攻击。如果“锁定”击中，你的目标会瘫痪 3…13…15 秒。

e88c7009c067d97b829ef404fd7432cd59b5cc0a.source: Melee Attack. If it hits, this attack deals +10…18…20 damage and removes 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15…35…40 damage.
e88c7009c067d97b829ef404fd7432cd59b5cc0a.text: 近战攻击。如果命中，这次攻击会造成 +10…18…20 点伤害并移除 1 个苦行僧结界。如果苦行僧结界被移除，该技能的充能速度会加快 75% 倍，相邻敌人会受到 15…35…40 点伤害。

358fc4d132fa4d896e76aed8b6e9fcd3550cea1c.source: Melee Attack. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15…35…40 damage.
358fc4d132fa4d896e76aed8b6e9fcd3550cea1c.text: 近战攻击。你移除了 1 苦行僧结界。如果苦行僧结界被移除，该技能的充能速度会加快 75%，并且相邻的敌人会受到 15…35…40 点伤害。

e1126f7e95ff9654cb51e0ac127400bba0bfc668.source: Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 1 Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.
e1126f7e95ff9654cb51e0ac127400bba0bfc668.text: 立场。在 5…17…20 秒内，你不能被打断，但每次你会被打断，你都会失去 1 苦行僧结界或虔诚专注结束。

58925f98e9cbca4b76162a5ac23768aedcf79e7f.source: Stance. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. For 1…6…7 seconds, you attack 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed, this stance lasts twice as long.
58925f98e9cbca4b76162a5ac23768aedcf79e7f.text: 立场。移除 1 苦行僧结界。在 1…6…7 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 25%。如果结界被移除，这个姿势的持续时间会是原来的两倍。

fdc463ef8de9ca14ea7f48733411f4c7755b23da.source: Stance. Remove one Dervish enchantment. For 1…4…5 seconds, you attack 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed, this stance lasts twice as long.
fdc463ef8de9ca14ea7f48733411f4c7755b23da.text: 立场。移除一项苦行僧结界。在 1…4…5 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 25%。如果结界被移除，这个姿势的持续时间会是原来的两倍。

4a8e984553cf8950a2dbecbc55cac5d534a7179a.source: Stance. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment and for 1…6…7 seconds you move 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed you move 50% faster instead.
4a8e984553cf8950a2dbecbc55cac5d534a7179a.text: 立场。你移除了 1 苦行僧结界，并且在 1…6…7 秒内你的移动速度加快了 25%。如果结界被移除，你的移动速度会加快 50%。

8797ef2fbc20c51e8169083a4425cd73467b8e39.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, nothing happens. When this enchantment ends, Pious Renewal is recharged and you gain 0…4…5 Energy and 0…24…30 Health.
8797ef2fbc20c51e8169083a4425cd73467b8e39.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。 8 秒内什么也没有发生。当此结界结束时，虔诚更新会重新充电，您将获得 0…4…5 点能量和 0…24…30 点生命值。

e4fc98dac18d6227eac606f9e10eb746f5f83176.source: Spell. You gain 80…136…150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed in this way, you also lose 1…3…3 hex[es].
e4fc98dac18d6227eac606f9e10eb746f5f83176.text: 咒语。你获得 80…136…150 点生命值并移除 1 苦行僧结界。如果以这种方式移除结界，您还会损失 1…3…3 降咒。

45600863e6f1021830e84d2075e6a5da007abc9d.source: Spell. You gain 80…136…150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed in this way, you also lose 1 hex.
45600863e6f1021830e84d2075e6a5da007abc9d.text: 咒语。你获得 80…136…150 点生命值并移除 1 苦行僧结界。如果以这种方式移除结界，您还会损失 1 降咒。

ff23222885e53aaf33e6e20b4b489c2697ab20ca.source: Spell. Transfer 1…3…3 negative conditions and [its/their] remaining durations from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.
ff23222885e53aaf33e6e20b4b489c2697ab20ca.text: 咒语。将 1…3…3 个负面条件和[其/他们的]剩余持续时间从自己转移到目标敌人和所有相邻敌人。

1d812352524a3e58120672a00da7658b5c659953.source: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)
1d812352524a3e58120672a00da7658b5c659953.text: 精英图章。将所有负面状态及其剩余持续时间 100…180…200% 从自己转移到目标敌人。 （诅咒 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

9b593315c6ba8e07ef50969f126d28250ef6b367.source: Skill. Transfer 1…3…3 negative conditions and [its/their] remaining durations from yourself to target touched foe.
9b593315c6ba8e07ef50969f126d28250ef6b367.text: 技能。将 1…3…3 个负面条件和[其/他们的]剩余持续时间从自己转移到目标接触的敌人。

78bf212f5975e80659f6d2606e4176af77d4dee9.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +20 armor and cannot be the target of enemy spells, but cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.
78bf212f5975e80659f6d2606e4176af77d4dee9.text: 精英结界法术。在 8…18…20 秒内，你获得 +20 护甲值，并且不能成为敌方法术的目标，但无法攻击并具有 -2 能量退化。

125584f76567333772ac09aa3945510d3f167961.text: 精英法术。您获得 8…18…20 能量。

4797da1cc05bdd47939beb02046e9a8a0116b514.source: Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that has half the normal range, but strikes for +10…34…40 damage.
4797da1cc05bdd47939beb02046e9a8a0116b514.text: 弓攻击。射出射程为正常射程一半的箭，但会造成 +10…34…40 伤害。

1e1e6b2b445ad1fcdf352747a4cb4b58c8a0f819.source: Elite Spell. Gain 8…15…17 Energy. If any spirits are within earshot, you do not sacrifice Health.
1e1e6b2b445ad1fcdf352747a4cb4b58c8a0f819.text: 精英法术。获得 8…15…17 能量。如果有任何灵魂在听力范围内，你就不会牺牲生命值。

b37c772b98d954be72788220f2c1badd3540a842.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, you attack, move and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
b37c772b98d954be72788220f2c1badd3540a842.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。在 3…13…15 秒内，你的攻击、移动和获得肾上腺素的速度加快 25%。

211dabba5c370bd89a1e43a30c92ffe293d25855.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2…7…8 seconds, you attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
211dabba5c370bd89a1e43a30c92ffe293d25855.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。在 2…7…8 秒内，你攻击并获得肾上腺素的速度加快 25%。

24acb7cbdb60f21a52cbab677f56c48821963103.source: Spell. Target foe and adjacent foes take 10…26…30 shadow damage. Foes already suffering from a condition are Poisoned and Weakened for 3…10…12 seconds.
24acb7cbdb60f21a52cbab677f56c48821963103.text: 咒语。目标敌人和邻近敌人受到 10…26…30 点暗影伤害。已经患有某种疾病的敌人会中毒并虚弱 3…10…12 秒。

8cb99f93f57a88c2188075cdbaf7edbddaef3b28.source: Elite Bow Attack. If Poison Arrow hits, your target becomes Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds.
8cb99f93f57a88c2188075cdbaf7edbddaef3b28.text: 精英弓攻击。如果毒箭命中，你的目标会中毒 5…17…20 秒。

7ec63b29cecc0e1af943fbe5fba5e27bf0be702e.source: Signet. For 60 seconds, your next attack also inflicts Poison for 8…14…15 seconds.
7ec63b29cecc0e1af943fbe5fba5e27bf0be702e.text: 印章。持续 60 秒，你的下一次攻击还会造成中毒，持续 8…14…15 秒。

f9aabdf460a987756f3701b50f9330e412ece65a.source: Spell. You and all adjacent foes are Poisoned for 5…13…15 seconds.
f9aabdf460a987756f3701b50f9330e412ece65a.text: 咒语。你和所有邻近的敌人都会中毒 5…13…15 秒。

e42b668fd301e9e7d75672e872f39932d4f22609.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Poisonous Bite that Poisons target foe for 5…17…20 seconds.
e42b668fd301e9e7d75672e872f39932d4f22609.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行毒咬，使目标敌人中毒，持续 5…17…20 秒。

5e3d9f3d57cdccfdaab7b24ff927eae8def56a36.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion's next attack is a Pounce that deals +5…17…20 damage. If the attack strikes a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.
5e3d9f3d57cdccfdaab7b24ff927eae8def56a36.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴的下一次攻击是猛扑，造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果攻击击中移动的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

9ad6c0a3bbbfd64a9449e7fc4a7b0860c16c015b.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage.
9ad6c0a3bbbfd64a9449e7fc4a7b0860c16c015b.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +10…34…40 点伤害。

e636c7bfac6138607cc5756f5c62a5546d91c18b.source: Elite Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled for 1…10…12 seconds and that skill is interrupted.
e636c7bfac6138607cc5756f5c62a5546d91c18b.text: 精英法术。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或咏唱，则该技能和所有相同属性的技能将被禁用1…10…12秒，并且该技能会被打断。

b03f17e4486972a1b95e67ecda486353965b8ec4.source: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and you gain 1…25…31 Energy.
b03f17e4486972a1b95e67ecda486353965b8ec4.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，该技能会被打断，并且你获得 1…25…31 点能量。

6ef752453a5fd3d66648a8733e107eab3bc5fd9a.source: Elite Hex Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and for 4…9…10 seconds, that foe has -2 Energy degeneration.
6ef752453a5fd3d66648a8733e107eab3bc5fd9a.text: 精英六角咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，该技能会被打断，并且在 4…9…10 秒内，该敌人会有 -2 点能量衰退。

290f740b3e51dfec9b6df4cea02b69f6fa2c1e44.source: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe loses 3…14…17 Energy.
290f740b3e51dfec9b6df4cea02b69f6fa2c1e44.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，则该技能会被打断，并且目标敌人会损失 3…14…17 点能量。

78c4e0aef32c532fe5627d18e13099a4552b7c9f.source: Elite Hex Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and for 10 seconds, whenever that foe casts a spell, you steal up to 5…13…15 Energy from that foe.
78c4e0aef32c532fe5627d18e13099a4552b7c9f.text: 精英六角咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，该技能会被打断，并且在 10 秒内，每当该敌人施展法术时，你都会从该敌人身上偷取最多 5…13…15 点能量。

e0f8f77a5a15bba76818021169b26843599428b1.source: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and disabled for an additional 5…11…13 seconds.
e0f8f77a5a15bba76818021169b26843599428b1.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，则该技能会被打断并额外禁用 5…11…13 秒。

fa69c294be522b5f09f4c79fe1a7e3666050754b.source: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe gains 10…6…5 Energy.
fa69c294be522b5f09f4c79fe1a7e3666050754b.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，该技能会被打断并且目标敌人获得 10…6…5 点能量。

82bd836094c8afb840a9a59e5429041e55f2ab72.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member hits a foe with physical damage, that foe loses one enchantment. For each Monk enchantment removed, you lose 10…4…3% maximum Health.
82bd836094c8afb840a9a59e5429041e55f2ab72.text: 精英结界法术。 5秒内，每当一名队员对敌人造成物理伤害时，该敌人就会失去一个结界。每移除一个武僧结界，你就会损失 10…4…3% 最大生命值。

149cfdb39b7700b2052e23e92f210af8fcfb8149.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member hits a foe with physical damage, that party member does +3…13…16 damage.
149cfdb39b7700b2052e23e92f210af8fcfb8149.text: 结界咒语。在 5 秒内，每当一名队员对敌人造成物理伤害时，该队员就会造成 +3…13…16 点伤害。

1cc28ba1eca7c826784cfea5ff57404e3a5943b5.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member who is not under the effects of another Necromancer enchantment hits a foe with physical damage, that party member steals up to 3…13…16 Health.
1cc28ba1eca7c826784cfea5ff57404e3a5943b5.text: 精英结界法术。在 5 秒内，每当未受到其他死灵法师结界影响的队伍成员对敌人造成物理伤害时，该队伍成员会窃取最多 3…13…16 点生命值。

29b4a7cc4feec5dd26846479351ed619ff0785f3.source: Elite Spell. For 5 seconds, your minions deal +3…13…16 damage, but you lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever one of your minions hits with an attack.
29b4a7cc4feec5dd26846479351ed619ff0785f3.text: 精英法术。在 5 秒内，你的小兵会造成 +3…13…16 点伤害，但每当你的一个小兵受到攻击时，你就会损失 2% 点最大生命值。

66b8454f345e7a92a8a441a5f328ac7e3ee06fd6.source: Spell. Heal target ally for 30…70…80 Health.
66b8454f345e7a92a8a441a5f328ac7e3ee06fd6.text: 咒语。治疗目标盟友 30…70…80 生命值。

028e2a498613b1923b8086b06ba3808d6903cdb1.source: Shout. For 10…22…25 seconds, your animal companion gains +24 armor and cannot be blocked.
028e2a498613b1923b8086b06ba3808d6903cdb1.text: 喊叫。在 10…22…25 秒内，你的动物伙伴获得 +24 点护甲并且无法被阻挡。

8afa26438a372a7e13119a4ea7f0431c8af9a041.source: Shout. For 5…13…15 seconds, your animal companion gains +24 armor and cannot be blocked.
8afa26438a372a7e13119a4ea7f0431c8af9a041.text: 喊叫。在 5…13…15 秒内，你的动物伙伴获得 +24 点护甲并且无法被阻挡。

7684a248fbc6c59c76a6ce57ad6d5ddbb16ff761.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, your spells cast 20…44…50% faster, and recharge 40…72…80% faster, but you continuously gain Overcast. PvE Skill
7684a248fbc6c59c76a6ce57ad6d5ddbb16ff761.text: 精英结界法术。当你保持这种结界时，你的法术施放速度会更快 20…44…50%，充能速度会更快 40…72…80%，但你会持续获得阴暗。 PvE技能

440517690f26ea9aa168ad4bb8d8180a6e7622b8.source: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +1…16…20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe is Dazed for 1…7…8 seconds.
440517690f26ea9aa168ad4bb8d8180a6e7622b8.text: 锤子攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人被击倒，则该敌人会晕眩 1…7…8 秒。
