af42c56c01e333dadd0024bf2096b1dd61e855dd.source: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…3 Health degeneration. If target foe is using a skill, then Overload deals 15…63…75 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.
af42c56c01e333dadd0024bf2096b1dd61e855dd.text: 降咒魔法。在 5 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…3 点生命值退化。如果目标敌人正在使用技能，则过载会对该敌人造成 15…63…75 点伤害，并对所有相邻敌人造成 75% 点伤害。

d5e0a428f2419e325146a07771ab2c158ef5b982.source: Bow Attack. If Power Shot hits, target foe takes 25…45…50 damage.
d5e0a428f2419e325146a07771ab2c158ef5b982.text: 弓攻击。如果强力射击击中，目标敌人会受到 25…45…50 点伤害。

9b4f756208c1a0fa937711407de821aad1e3ed42.source: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or a chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe takes 30…102…120 damage.
9b4f756208c1a0fa937711407de821aad1e3ed42.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，则该技能会被打断，并且目标敌人会受到 30…102…120 点伤害。

e0e6ae1396bdf450741077fe77e89a98e2a0b786.source: Elite Stance. For 20…32…35 seconds, your Preparations recharge 50% faster and last 30…246…300% longer.
e0e6ae1396bdf450741077fe77e89a98e2a0b786.text: 精英姿态。在 20…32…35 秒内，您的准备充能速度加快 50%，持续时间延长 30…246…300%。

10dc5ce02e8c2b34fac6bebc1deb356b3e4db10f.source: Bow Attack. If Precision Shot hits, you strike for +3…9…10 damage. Precision Shot cannot be blocked. This action is easily interrupted.
10dc5ce02e8c2b34fac6bebc1deb356b3e4db10f.text: 弓攻击。如果精确射击击中，你会受到 +3…9…10 点伤害。精准射击无法被格挡。这个动作很容易被打断。

180f8618fdbc3bce0e49759f4e9a32fbfaf8e199.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Predator's Pounce that deals +5…29…35 damage. If that attack hits, your animal companion gains 5…41…50 Health.
180f8618fdbc3bce0e49759f4e9a32fbfaf8e199.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行掠夺者突袭，造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。如果该攻击命中，你的动物伙伴将获得 5…41…50 点生命值。

cbe603d19d895130ab2fb174ccc1e567986941e8.source: Shout. For 5…17…20 seconds, your animal companion attacks 25% faster and heals you for 1…25…31 Health with each successful attack.
cbe603d19d895130ab2fb174ccc1e567986941e8.text: 喊叫。在 5…17…20 秒内，你的动物伙伴攻击速度提高 25% 点，每次成功攻击可为你治疗 1…25…31 点生命值。

85c6d988cd4fcd2efdab700d25de476fa8a26773.source: Shout. For 5…17…20 seconds, attacks by your animal companion heal you for 1…25…31 Health.
85c6d988cd4fcd2efdab700d25de476fa8a26773.text: 喊叫。在 5…17…20 秒内，你的动物伙伴的攻击会治愈你 1…25…31 点生命值。

e75355d23366232715ccfa4922039877d4642220.source: Hex Spell. For 4…7…8 seconds, target foe cannot attack. This effect ends if the target takes damage.
e75355d23366232715ccfa4922039877d4642220.text: 降咒魔法。 4…7…8 秒内，目标敌人无法攻击。如果目标受到伤害，该效果就会结束。

fa5e1b8f7d31f20b2a0523bdd66ca462dff5d3c3.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all healing is reduced by 20%. If any of your attacks hit, you gain 5 Health. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
fa5e1b8f7d31f20b2a0523bdd66ca462dff5d3c3.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。对于其范围内的非灵体生物，所有治疗效果降低20%。如果您的任何攻击命中，您将获得 5 点生命值。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

45073b1beb7cc2db0279539614cd23a7a8880f45.source: Elite Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…22…25 damage. If you are under the effects of a preparation, you gain 1…7…9 Energy.
45073b1beb7cc2db0279539614cd23a7a8880f45.text: 精英弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果您处于制剂的效果下，您将获得 1…7…9 能量。

816b60a3da949b5c4121bb9d449753c52b8cdbcc.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5…25…30 damage. This spirit dies after 30…126…150 seconds.
816b60a3da949b5c4121bb9d449753c52b8cdbcc.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…10…12级武魂。该战魂的攻击造成 5…25…30 点伤害。该灵魂会在 30…126…150 秒后死亡。

f18b9d9621f2f2b7a5f66ed9976486b7f4f8f6e8.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally in the area for 10…94…115 Health. This spirit dies after 90 seconds.
f18b9d9621f2f2b7a5f66ed9976486b7f4f8f6e8.text: 精英束缚仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。每 4 秒，该精魂会治愈该区域内的一名非精魂盟友 10…94…115 点生命值。该灵魂会在 90 秒后死亡。

d337b39d3b0be56ce8a391cb48369bebc4a6eecd.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5…25…30 damage. This spirit dies after 30…126…150 seconds.
d337b39d3b0be56ce8a391cb48369bebc4a6eecd.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…7…8级武魂。该战魂的攻击造成 5…25…30 点伤害。该灵魂会在 30…126…150 秒后死亡。

91a92b7a2dbda5c3c4afdc1ef36915c6948e8dbd.source: Hex Spell. For 6…10 seconds, every time target foe deals damage that foe takes 100…140% of the damage it causes (maximum 80 damage).
91a92b7a2dbda5c3c4afdc1ef36915c6948e8dbd.text: 降咒魔法。在 6…10 秒内，每当目标敌人造成伤害时，敌人就会承受其造成伤害的 100…140% 点（最多 80 点伤害）。

e60c9ba351a6345161fd92dfc2ca9464752891a4.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally in the area for 10…94…115 Health. This spirit dies after 90 seconds.
e60c9ba351a6345161fd92dfc2ca9464752891a4.text: 精英束缚仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。每 4 秒，该精魂会治愈该区域内的一名非精魂盟友 10…94…115 点生命值。该灵魂会在 90 秒后死亡。

e472404f97252bedd0c120d1f1fbbfbe3403e6b5.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks and takes 1…37…46 damage whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.
e472404f97252bedd0c120d1f1fbbfbe3403e6b5.text: 降咒魔法。在 30 秒内，目标敌人有 25% 次攻击失败的机会，并且每当该敌人在战斗中未能击中时就会受到 1…37…46 点伤害。

5db1a77bd9bcf9f547225158a31d2413b7687f72.source: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, the next time target foe uses an elite skill, that foe loses 3…13…15 Energy.
5db1a77bd9bcf9f547225158a31d2413b7687f72.text: 降咒魔法。在 5 秒内，目标敌人下次使用精英技能时，该敌人会损失 3…13…15 点能量。

92e714eac8470c03fc2e09a8ec4430d85409451d.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 Spirit. For non-Spirit creatures within its range, Signets cost 10 Energy to use. This Spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
92e714eac8470c03fc2e09a8ec4430d85409451d.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级魂灵。对于其范围内的非精神生物，徽记的使用成本为 10 点能量。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

54e10cdfb1e8d04b2713ea8cb39dd1aed710dbfa.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…9 seconds, you attack 33% faster and move 33% faster, but you take 150…130…125% damage .
54e10cdfb1e8d04b2713ea8cb39dd1aed710dbfa.text: 精英姿态。在 1…7…9 秒内，你的攻击速度加快了 33%，移动速度加快了 33%，但你受到了 150…130…125% 点伤害。

893bf49f527fb27ac9dc4fc660f1357b3bac301f.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…9 seconds, you attack 33% faster and move 33% faster, but you take 200…160…150% damage .
893bf49f527fb27ac9dc4fc660f1357b3bac301f.text: 精英姿态。在 1…7…9 秒内，你的攻击速度加快了 33%，移动速度加快了 33%，但你受到了 200…160…150% 点伤害。

42f9ed9b40de05b36534d7e0920ced906acbc8a6.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally cannot lose more than 5% max Health due to damage from a single attack or spell. When Protective Bond prevents damage, you lose 6…4…3 Energy or the spell ends.
42f9ed9b40de05b36534d7e0920ced906acbc8a6.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，目标盟友不会因单次攻击或法术伤害而损失超过 5% 点最大生命值。当保护纽带防止伤害时，你会损失 6…4…3 点能量或法术结束。

51b31eae436bb1a4fd42495b59d5e1c46982eddc.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…19…23 seconds, target ally cannot lose more than 10% max Health due to damage from a single attack or spell.
51b31eae436bb1a4fd42495b59d5e1c46982eddc.text: 结界咒语。在 5…19…23 秒内，目标盟友因单次攻击或法术伤害而损失的最大生命值不能超过 10%。

960c3375dbab1e56e92fdd5238069c8da140b55e.source: Item Spell. Hold Kaolai's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain 20 armor. When you drop his ashes, all party members are healed for 20…80…95 Health.
960c3375dbab1e56e92fdd5238069c8da140b55e.text: 物品法术。保存考莱的骨灰长达 15…51…60 秒。当你持有他的骨灰时，你会获得 20 点护甲值。当你撒下他的骨灰时，所有队员都会获得 20…80…95 生命值的治疗。

ec3ab205ad90d0011472c5c38bb40126f4a06b1b.source: Skill. For 5…10…11 seconds, allies adjacent to you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Protector's Defense ends if you move.
ec3ab205ad90d0011472c5c38bb40126f4a06b1b.text: 技能。在 5…10…11 秒内，与你相邻的盟友有 75% 的机会阻挡传入的攻击。如果你移动，保护者的防御就会结束。

c51199deeab7c41669f06bcaeec7e8394536c80d.source: Skill. For 4…7…8 seconds, allies adjacent to you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Protector's Defense ends if you move.
c51199deeab7c41669f06bcaeec7e8394536c80d.text: 技能。在 4…7…8 秒内，与你相邻的盟友有 75% 的机会阻挡传入的攻击。如果你移动，保护者的防御就会结束。

fc0a94eb5c45bf421dc6ab7aacadeeacfcff079f.source: Elite Spell. Interrupt the target foe's action. If that action was a skill, that foe and nearby foes are knocked down for 2…4…4 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
fc0a94eb5c45bf421dc6ab7aacadeeacfcff079f.text: 精英法术。打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是技能，则该敌人和附近的敌人会被击倒2…4…4秒。 （50%快速铸造失败的几率4或更少。）

8d824050face4a62f103f6b61c4d3ef0e8f80e80.source: Melee Attack. If this attack strikes a moving foe, you strike for 10…34…40 more damage.
8d824050face4a62f103f6b61c4d3ef0e8f80e80.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击击中移动的敌人，你会额外受到 10…34…40 点伤害。

cf4f58a64d12ed11a5277738c15ecd536f6eab41.source: Elite Spell. All of your other skills are disabled for 8 seconds. If target foe is using a skill, that skill is interrupted and disabled for an additional 5…11…12 seconds.
cf4f58a64d12ed11a5277738c15ecd536f6eab41.text: 精英法术。你的所有其他技能都会被禁用 8 秒。如果目标敌人正在使用技能，则该技能会被中断并额外禁用 5…11…12 秒。

e9291aee30fa1e4087ae78a5d7420309ff03babf.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the raven. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and a 20…30% chance to block, All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills.
e9291aee30fa1e4087ae78a5d7420309ff03babf.text: 精英形态。你失去了所有效果并呈现出乌鸦的样子。 60秒内，你有80点护甲，660…700点生命值，以及20…30%的格挡几率，你的所有属性都设置为0，乌鸦攻击取代你的技能。

22fd48c153ac00559d98071d989fa2fec87f53de.source: Elite Spell. Deal 20…36…40 damage and steal 20…36…40 Health from target foe and all nearby foes.
22fd48c153ac00559d98071d989fa2fec87f53de.text: 精英法术。造成 20…36…40 点伤害，并从目标敌人和附近所有敌人身上窃取 20…36…40 点生命值。

4e4535f824725764bf5fda998da445efe702a0d8.source: Elite Spell. Invoke a Ray of Judgment at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, target foe and all foes adjacent to this location take 10…42…50 holy damage each second and begin Burning for 1…3…3 seconds.
4e4535f824725764bf5fda998da445efe702a0d8.text: 精英法术。在目标敌人的位置召唤审判之光。持续 5 秒，目标敌人以及该位置附近的所有敌人每秒受到 10…42…50 点神圣伤害，并开始燃烧 1…3…3 秒。

a7e8d33b4d73ec2a8c14aa8365da459abb0f8f26.source: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows move twice as fast and deal 3…9…10 extra damage.
a7e8d33b4d73ec2a8c14aa8365da459abb0f8f26.text: 准备。在 24 秒内，你的箭的移动速度是原来的两倍，并造成 3…9…10 点额外伤害。

805e2f5de4d419f34ddf0707ec907f842a10f462.source: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows move twice as fast.
805e2f5de4d419f34ddf0707ec907f842a10f462.text: 准备。在 24 秒内，你的箭的移动速度是原来的两倍。

9eab3f27e00cfac06386bad72c95d4db7a9bee69.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +3…13…15 damage. Each foe you hit loses 1 condition. For each foe who loses a condition, all foes adjacent to that target foe take 10…34…40 holy damage.
9eab3f27e00cfac06386bad72c95d4db7a9bee69.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +3…13…15 点伤害。你击中的每个敌人都会失去 1 点状态。对于每失去一个状态的敌人，与该目标敌人相邻的所有敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点神圣伤害。

ec1fee1373f2e10a67d571bc88e57db8ae2f5cab.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe suffers -1…4…5 Health degeneration. If that foe dies while hexed with Reaper's Mark, you gain 5…13…15 Energy.
ec1fee1373f2e10a67d571bc88e57db8ae2f5cab.text: 精英六角咒语。在 30 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…4…5 点生命值退化。如果该敌人在被死神印记施咒时死亡，你将获得 5…13…15 点能量。

d579b74cddff5b5d0043f08386490624c5b66341.source: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you Cripple your target for 3…13…15 seconds. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, this attack knocks down for 2…3…3 seconds.
d579b74cddff5b5d0043f08386490624c5b66341.text: 精英镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会使目标瘫痪 3…13…15 秒。你失去 1 苦行僧结界。如果结界被移除，则该攻击会击倒 2…3…3 秒。

c8112ae07f7deec30e405b638e3b590808273b92.source: Spell. Resurrect target party member. Target party member is returned to life with 25% Health and zero Energy, and is teleported to your current location. All of target's skills are disabled for 10…4…3 seconds. This spell consumes all of your remaining Energy.
c8112ae07f7deec30e405b638e3b590808273b92.text: 咒语。复活目标队员。目标队员以 25% 点生命值和零能量复活，并传送到您当前的位置。目标所有技能禁用10…4…3秒。该法术会消耗你所有剩余的能量。

fb40a4f009567b4a3934c69738e838a8e683af09.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain Recall, nothing happens. When Recall ends, you Shadow Step to the ally you targeted when you activated this skill and all of your skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
fb40a4f009567b4a3934c69738e838a8e683af09.text: 结界咒语。当你维持召回状态时，什么也不会发生。当召回结束时，你会向激活该技能时目标的盟友进行暗影步，并且你的所有技能将被禁用 3 秒。

bc31de5eb41ba6d9730109ae3fbd6ea13973f6fb.source: Hex Spell. For 6…11…12 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes are hexed with Reckless Haste. While hexed, they attack 25% faster but have a 50% chance to miss with attacks.
bc31de5eb41ba6d9730109ae3fbd6ea13973f6fb.text: 降咒魔法。持续 6…11…12 秒，目标敌人和所有邻近的敌人都被鲁莽急速施咒。施咒后，它们的攻击速度会加快 25%，但有 50% 的几率会错过攻击。

b15c5e3893df9393988b85ccce6f36afe47c2f9d.source: Elite Spell. All of your Spirits die. You gain 5…17…20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged if a Spirit died in this way.
b15c5e3893df9393988b85ccce6f36afe47c2f9d.text: 精英法术。你所有的灵魂都会死去。如果灵魂以这种方式死亡，你将获得 5…17…20 点能量，并且你所有的束缚仪式都会重新充电。

3fbe1dce50286f828020a04c4ba83d34eddb0955.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts the target foe's action. If that action is a skill, that foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down for 2…3…3 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
3fbe1dce50286f828020a04c4ba83d34eddb0955.text: 精英法术。打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是技能，则该敌人和所有相邻的敌人都会被击倒2…3…3秒。 （50%快速铸造失败的几率4或更少。）

975d16ff549bfd5a13496d3c6245f7cee23771fa.source: Hammer Attack. If you hit a knocked-down foe, that foe suffers from Weakness and a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
975d16ff549bfd5a13496d3c6245f7cee23771fa.text: 锤子攻击。如果你击中了一个被击倒的敌人，该敌人会受到虚弱和深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

01834597a0e1070855c6819758ce26a0385e9f15.source: Elite Bow Attack. If Punishing Shot hits, you strike for +10…18…20 damage and your target is interrupted.
01834597a0e1070855c6819758ce26a0385e9f15.text: 精英弓攻击。如果惩罚射击命中，你会造成 +10…18…20 点伤害，并且你的目标会被打断。

d95867b5f1b922233f29c3df7258c70ef130a204.source: Sword Attack. If Pure Strike hits, you strike for +1…24…30 damage. If you are not using a stance, Pure Strike cannot be blocked.
d95867b5f1b922233f29c3df7258c70ef130a204.text: 剑攻击。如果纯粹打击命中，你会造成 +1…24…30 点伤害。如果您没有使用姿势，则无法格挡纯粹打击。

3b7b1a47b9859e38e9180e7ffacb41fb4e84e8d0.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. Conditions on allies within range of this spirit expire 20…44…50% faster. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
3b7b1a47b9859e38e9180e7ffacb41fb4e84e8d0.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。在该精神范围内的盟友的状况会加快 20…44…50%。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

5079a7c3c6ca048d895e6f91f42e1fba227ee205.source: Item Spell. Hold Li Ming's ashes for 5…17…20 seconds. While you hold her ashes, conditions on you expire 10…42…50% faster. When you drop her ashes, all allies within earshot lose 1…3…4 conditions.
5079a7c3c6ca048d895e6f91f42e1fba227ee205.text: 物品法术。按住李明的骨灰5…17…20秒。当你保存她的骨灰时，你身上的条件会加速 10…42…50%。当你撒下她的骨灰时，听力范围内的所有盟友都会失去 1…3…4 条件。

81d5a87ac7c5decf2b8a1a63fd9d2d9ddd258ec9.source: Spell. Remove all conditions (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, and Deep Wound) from target ally.
81d5a87ac7c5decf2b8a1a63fd9d2d9ddd258ec9.text: 咒语。消除目标盟友的所有状况（中毒、疾病、失明、茫然、流血、残废、燃烧、虚弱、盔甲破裂和深度伤口）。

2215a5bced556d8607f1a005db6cec57eb9aab2b.source: Signet. Remove all hexes and conditions from target ally. You lose 10 Energy for each hex and each condition removed.
2215a5bced556d8607f1a005db6cec57eb9aab2b.text: 印章。移除目标盟友的所有格子和条件。每移除一个六角形并消除每个条件，您就会损失 10 点能量。

ede4e0b73e4e906c19b3bf66ebb0c5c9373287db.source: Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, target non-spirit ally loses 1 condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally.
ede4e0b73e4e906c19b3bf66ebb0c5c9373287db.text: 回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当目标非灵体盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，该盟友就会失去 1 状态。

3ce0d2b9e57407ca0ad02de15e131ac5f2cbddee.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, conditions expire 5…41…50% faster on target ally. When this enchantment ends, one condition is removed from that ally.
3ce0d2b9e57407ca0ad02de15e131ac5f2cbddee.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，目标盟友的条件到期速度会加快 5…41…50% 倍。当此结界结束时，该盟友的一个状况就会消失。

5a0549cbb6fe079ab1d9c9cc5d104e9a54fbd132.source: Hex Spell. For 5…21…25 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…3 Health degeneration. If that foe dies while under the effects of this hex, all nearby foes take 25…73…85 damage.
5a0549cbb6fe079ab1d9c9cc5d104e9a54fbd132.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…21…25 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…3 点生命值退化。如果该敌人在该咒语的影响下死亡，则附近的所有敌人都会受到 25…73…85 点伤害。

284600b2f19246d097e5f814faaeb777e75254e9.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Conditions on allies within range of this spirit expire 20…44…50% faster. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
284600b2f19246d097e5f814faaeb777e75254e9.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。在该精神范围内的盟友的状况会加快 20…44…50%。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

f07654b3adf7de553565131274e7bc7ba7c9e082.source: Spell. The corpse nearest your target explodes, sending out a shockwave that deals 24…101…120 damage to nearby foes.
f07654b3adf7de553565131274e7bc7ba7c9e082.text: 咒文。最靠近目标的尸体爆炸，发出冲击波，对附近的敌人造成 24…101…120 点伤害。

bd383224c2510a151715732c93c96e46d29c1431.source: Spell. Destroy one of your target animated undead minions. All foes near that creature are Diseased for 5…13…15 seconds.
bd383224c2510a151715732c93c96e46d29c1431.text: 咒语。摧毁你的目标动画不死小兵之一。该生物附近的所有敌人都会患病 5…13…15 秒。

71d009baf26896f3bd2ef7dad67547d01bd8e170.source: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.
71d009baf26896f3bd2ef7dad67547d01bd8e170.text: 精英弓攻击。射出移动速度两倍的箭。

8edad53ae6a0c0244dd68950df2bc8299cfd23aa.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range gain +1…3…3 Health regeneration. This spirit dies after 15…39…45 seconds.
8edad53ae6a0c0244dd68950df2bc8299cfd23aa.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。其范围内的非精神盟友获得 +1…3…3 生命恢复。该灵魂会在 15…39…45 秒后死亡。

071b989f4df3fecff29e1e8e376134596e57c3f5.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills recharge twice as fast and cost 30% more of the base Energy to cast. This spirit dies after 15…75…90 seconds.
071b989f4df3fecff29e1e8e376134596e57c3f5.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。对于其范围内的非精神生物，所有技能的充能速度提高一倍，并且施放时消耗的基础能量增加 30%。该灵魂会在 15…75…90 秒后死亡。

ccb15591d11491d1891ab3800a542320f39467e1.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range gain +1…3…3 Health regeneration. This spirit dies after 15…39…45 seconds.
ccb15591d11491d1891ab3800a542320f39467e1.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。其范围内的非精神盟友获得 +1…3…3 生命恢复。该灵魂会在 15…39…45 秒后死亡。

a8c0de403fed84d3e528f3597c35887182b161eb.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe suffers from -1…5…6 Health degeneration. If that foe has another hex when Recurring Insecurity would end, it is reapplied.
a8c0de403fed84d3e528f3597c35887182b161eb.text: 精英六角咒语。 5 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…5…6 点生命值退化。如果该敌人在反复出现的不安全状态结束时有另一个咒语，则会重新应用它。

6df6136b34fe063a6cf7f87f2bd2719f4d4de2f1.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. All non-spirit creatures within its range lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. This spirit dies after 30…150…180 seconds.
6df6136b34fe063a6cf7f87f2bd2719f4d4de2f1.text: 精英自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。所有在其范围内的非灵体生物每次攻击或使用技能都会损失 1 点能量。该灵魂会在 30…150…180 秒后死亡。

166b2bff0c72e63752dc356a36c8a44ad6cac41f.source: Elite Sword Attack. If Quivering Blade hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, that foe is Dazed for 10 seconds.
166b2bff0c72e63752dc356a36c8a44ad6cac41f.text: 精英剑攻击。如果颤抖之刃击中，你将受到 +10…34…40 点伤害。如果此攻击击中移动中的敌人，则该敌人会晕眩 10 秒。

4c019573155524a536271db14ef624a0fe003603.source: Scythe Attack. This attack strikes for +1 damage for each point of Energy you currently have, maximum 5…25…30. You gain 1…6…7 Energy if this attack hits.
4c019573155524a536271db14ef624a0fe003603.text: 镰刀攻击。您当前拥有的每点能量，此攻击都会造成 +1 点伤害，最多 5…25…30。如果此攻击击中，您将获得 1…6…7 点能量。

abc3c317147bbac9236fd0fe9c50d64d88fe1c34.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…16…20 spirit. This spirit heals all party members within earshot for 3…9…10 Health each second. This spirit loses 3…9…10 Health for each party member healed in this way. This spirit dies after 30…78…90 seconds.
abc3c317147bbac9236fd0fe9c50d64d88fe1c34.text: 缚灵仪式。创造一个1…16…20级的武魂。这种精神每秒可以治愈听力范围内的所有队员 3…9…10 点生命值。每个以这种方式治愈的队员都会失去 3…9…10 点生命值。该灵魂会在 30…78…90 秒后死亡。

b630bfb4e8251f40f6e02d595f99d423aa2134c2.source: Ward Spell. For 5 seconds, foes in the area have -4…6 Health degeneration. When the portal ends, foes in the area are Diseased for 12…20 seconds.
b630bfb4e8251f40f6e02d595f99d423aa2134c2.text: 守卫咒语。 5 秒内，该区域内的敌人生命值下降 -4…6。当传送门结束时，该区域的敌人会患病 12…20 秒。

6a75a0a25e26c36ed421fdb7ab5208dff78960f0.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…13…16 spirit. This spirit heals all party members within earshot for 3…9…10 Health each second. This spirit loses 3…9…10 Health for each party member healed in this way. This spirit dies after 30…78…90 seconds.
6a75a0a25e26c36ed421fdb7ab5208dff78960f0.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…13…16级武魂。这种精神每秒可以治愈听力范围内的所有队员 3…9…10 点生命值。每个以这种方式治愈的队员都会失去 3…9…10 点生命值。该灵魂会在 30…78…90 秒后死亡。

608fcf38a2131bebdab31ae17c1b63e6d782803d.source: Elite Skill. Gain 1…6…7 strikes of adrenaline. For 8 seconds, whenever you use an adrenal skill, that skill recharges for 3 seconds.
608fcf38a2131bebdab31ae17c1b63e6d782803d.text: 精英技能。获得 1…6…7 次肾上腺素冲击。 8秒内，每当你使用肾上腺技能时，该技能就会恢复3秒。

f353561e33a4934a21f452df5f456b453cf4c629.source: Elite Skill. For 3…13…15 seconds, both you and your animal companion attack 33% faster and run 25% faster.
f353561e33a4934a21f452df5f456b453cf4c629.text: 精英技能。在 3…13…15 秒内，你和你的动物伙伴攻击速度加快 33%，奔跑速度加快 25%。

c9494fb347cacf9b209ef1fe940688d7cc07077e.source: Preparation. For 5…21…25 seconds, you attack 33% faster while wielding a bow.
c9494fb347cacf9b209ef1fe940688d7cc07077e.text: 准备。在 5…21…25 秒内，你使用弓时攻击速度提高 33%。

5332365e3308533b53a371ebe609075076b71c26.source: Spell. Lose all enchantments. Each party member is healed for 5…29…35 Health for each Monk enchantment lost.
5332365e3308533b53a371ebe609075076b71c26.text: 咒语。失去所有结界。每失去一个武僧结界，每个队伍成员就会恢复 5…29…35 点生命值。

66b6e826fe40074a08e2528064d223d0ea2c77b1.source: Signet. Resurrect target party member. That party member is returned to life with 100% Health and 25% Energy. This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.
66b6e826fe40074a08e2528064d223d0ea2c77b1.text: 印章。复活目标队员。该队员以 100% 生命值和 25% 能量复活。只有当你士气提升时，这个印章才会重新充电。

8c27c2fc980b9b870466eccc2c9713e352c4f4c9.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes attack damage, this spell deals 33% of the damage back to the source (maximum 5…17…20 damage).
8c27c2fc980b9b870466eccc2c9713e352c4f4c9.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，每当目标盟友受到攻击伤害时，此法术会对来源造成 33% 点伤害（最多 5…17…20 点伤害）。

ce24e34d9b60ea6f5a9e874e6896777a05bffac5.source: Spell. All adjacent foes are Crippled for 3…7…8 seconds. Shadow Step to target other ally's location.
ce24e34d9b60ea6f5a9e874e6896777a05bffac5.text: 咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会瘫痪 3…7…8 秒。暗影步瞄准其他盟友的位置。

a96966b4acee28fd9b41da6dcb8cc34949dd5078.source: Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe and gain 3…13…15 Energy. For 20 seconds, Revealed Enchantment is replaced with the enchantment removed from target foe.
a96966b4acee28fd9b41da6dcb8cc34949dd5078.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的结界并获得 3…13…15 点能量。持续 20 秒，显露结界被从目标敌人身上移除的结界所取代。

742d6d8b4df73b78bd360ee1721334feb9ba4705.source: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally and gain 4…9…10 Energy. For 20 seconds, Revealed Hex is replaced with the hex that was removed.
742d6d8b4df73b78bd360ee1721334feb9ba4705.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形并获得 4…9…10 点能量。在 20 秒内，显示的降咒将替换为已删除的降咒。

89e097e4374e21b8c2de019facc330e264d910b4.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, the foe dealing the damage takes that damage instead (maximum 5…61…75).
89e097e4374e21b8c2de019facc330e264d910b4.text: 结界咒语。在 8 秒内，下一次目标盟友受到伤害时，造成伤害的敌人将承受该伤害（最多 5…61…75）。

08cec9c03b55bcad09b97773932c94a247c64ae8.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage or life steal, that ally gains that amount of Health instead, maximum 15…67…80.
08cec9c03b55bcad09b97773932c94a247c64ae8.text: 结界咒语。在 8 秒内，下次目标盟友受到伤害或生命偷取时，该盟友会获得同等数量的生命值，最多 15…67…80。

c32c1760489d72b9c0f86f98b012e0afaf123771.source: Enchantment Spell. Remove one hex from target ally. If a hex was removed in this way, for 5…9…10 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, that damage is reduced by 5…41…50.
c32c1760489d72b9c0f86f98b012e0afaf123771.text: 结界咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。如果以此方式移除六角形，则在 5…9…10 秒内，下次目标盟友受到伤害时，伤害会减少 5…41…50。

07c4732a6e8c4c358b76e3311533fb661d0c0fa6.text: 印章。你失去 1 个条件。

ff82ccb507b8625344fd8bc6d508e1fd82f1b5f3.source: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally.
ff82ccb507b8625344fd8bc6d508e1fd82f1b5f3.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。

18406840d2af15864cac55d0cfcf1419c53e84d5.source: Spell. Remove 5…8…9 enchantments from target foe. For each Monk enchantment removed, you lose 55…31…25 Health.
18406840d2af15864cac55d0cfcf1419c53e84d5.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人 5…8…9 个结界。每移除一个武僧结界，你就会损失 55…31…25 点生命值。

c6ca12645d046bf5056d5a978ad9745f4e8e631a.source: Skill. Resurrect all allied animal companions in the area. They come back to life with 10…77…94% Health.
c6ca12645d046bf5056d5a978ad9745f4e8e631a.text: 技能。复活该地区的所有盟友动物伙伴。他们复活后的生命值为 10…77…94%。

10da577990fc9f540a53fb411efe47b0551203d8.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes take 10…34…40 cold damage. For 30 there is an extra space between "For" and "30" seconds, your attack skills remove enchantments from knocked-down foes. When this enchantment ends, nearby foes are affected by Cracked Armor for 1…8…10 seconds.
10da577990fc9f540a53fb411efe47b0551203d8.text: 闪光附魔咒语。当你施放此结界时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点寒冷伤害。对于 30 秒，“持续”和“30”秒之间有一个额外的空格，你的攻击技能会移除被击倒的敌人的结界。当此结界结束时，附近的敌人会受到裂甲的影响，持续 1…8…10 秒。

46fe152f36c1d38b048a2bbdaef03ab000a12b18.source: Scythe Attack. You deal +5…17…20 and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was lost, you remove an enchantment from each foe you hit.
46fe152f36c1d38b048a2bbdaef03ab000a12b18.text: 镰刀攻击。你交易 +5…17…20 并失去 1 苦行僧结界。如果结界丢失，你会从你击中的每个敌人身上移除一个结界。

a7a16d981cac3c4c1de01a3c08278395b793e42f.source: Spell. Deals 15…55…65 cold damage to target foe. You lose one Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
a7a16d981cac3c4c1de01a3c08278395b793e42f.text: 咒语。对目标敌人造成 15…55…65 点寒冷伤害。你失去了一项苦行僧结界。如果结界被移除，目标敌人会失去 1 点结界，而你获得 2 次肾上腺素打击。

1651ada62033e96f33efc054dd543324a1a04541.source: Spell. Resurrect target touched dead target party member with 50% Health and 5…17…20% Energy. That party member and all allies within earshot are healed for 55…115…130 Health.
1651ada62033e96f33efc054dd543324a1a04541.text: 咒语。复活目标使死亡目标队员获得 50% 点生命值和 5…17…20% 点能量。该队员和所有听力范围内的盟友都获得了 55…115…130 点生命值的治疗。

8c8b16ce79a168da4e743282d5e402dbfa22b79f.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, while holding an item, any weapon and item Spells you cast cost 5…29…35% less Energy.
8c8b16ce79a168da4e743282d5e402dbfa22b79f.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，持有物品时，你施放的任何武器和物品法术都会减少 5…29…35% 点能量。

27186449dabd24dc90cd4df39b41a86feb88ba40.source: Elite Spell. You Ride the Lightning to target. All adjacent foes are Blinded for 1…4…5 seconds. If your target is a foe, it is struck for 10…58…70 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
27186449dabd24dc90cd4df39b41a86feb88ba40.text: 精英法术。你骑着闪电到达目标。所有相邻的敌人都会被致盲 1…4…5 秒。如果你的目标是敌人，它会受到 10…58…70 点闪电伤害。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

7c69218a6263370950b6b02af95211ea6743e287.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, target foe cannot block.
7c69218a6263370950b6b02af95211ea6743e287.text: 降咒魔法。 8…18…20秒内，目标敌人无法格挡。

20e746893895594decf881353b49abfa902c6427.source: Spell. Remove 1 enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment was removed, that foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…21…25 seconds.
20e746893895594decf881353b49abfa902c6427.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人 1 点结界。如果结界被移除，该敌人会流血 5…21…25 秒。

ef504634d6b13acc3e10fce8c4ac0de66ce1d0b7.source: Skill. For 8 seconds, while you have a sword equipped, you block the next melee attack against you and your attacker is struck for 20…68…80 damage.
ef504634d6b13acc3e10fce8c4ac0de66ce1d0b7.text: 技能。在 8 秒内，当你装备剑时，你会阻挡对你的下一次近战攻击，并且你的攻击者会受到 20…68…80 点伤害。

d42ba848349908800d0186869c8375b4a7eab823.source: Hex Spell. For 20 seconds, this hex does nothing. When Rising Bile ends, that foe and all foes in the area take 1…5…6 damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect.
d42ba848349908800d0186869c8375b4a7eab823.text: 降咒魔法。在 20 秒内，这个降咒没有任何作用。当胆汁涌动结束时，每第二次胆汁涌动生效，该敌人以及该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 1…5…6 点伤害。

f094e62849107c3b7f729aff921d6c74e1d19124.source: Elite Skill. For 5…29…35 seconds, your Ritualist attributes are boosted by 2…4…4 for your next skill. If that skill is a Binding Ritual, it recharges 10…50…60% faster and Ritual Lord recharges instantly.
f094e62849107c3b7f729aff921d6c74e1d19124.text: 精英技能。在 5…29…35 秒内，你的仪式属性为你的下一个技能提升 2…4…4。如果该技能是束缚仪式，则其充能速度将加快 10…50…60%，并且仪式领主会立即充能。

6e41001b2775a02509bd6a9a9e66292f94686f40.source: Hammer Attack. If Renewing Smash hits, it deals +10…34…40 damage. If you hit a knocked-down foe, you gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly.
6e41001b2775a02509bd6a9a9e66292f94686f40.text: 锤子攻击。如果重生猛击击中，则会造成 +10…34…40 伤害。如果您击中被击倒的敌人，您将获得 3 点能量，并且此攻击会立即恢复。

5339b9ed5faccf3df95b036ca76582b4b6ab9075.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Chants and shouts cost 1…4…5 more Energy. This spirit dies after 30…150…180 seconds.
5339b9ed5faccf3df95b036ca76582b4b6ab9075.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。口号和呼喊会额外消耗 1…4…5 能量。该灵魂会在 30…150…180 秒后死亡。

2314fdbe668776e029ae983e8d3e059d78209616.source: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes are struck for 15…99…120 fire damage and set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds.
2314fdbe668776e029ae983e8d3e059d78209616.text: 咒语。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会受到 15…99…120 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…3…3 秒。

eb96bfb3a525961116576adf9d57fc3fbe18a52e.source: Hammer Attack. If Renewing Smash hits, it deals +5…17…20 damage. If it hits a knocked-down foe, you gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly.
eb96bfb3a525961116576adf9d57fc3fbe18a52e.text: 锤子攻击。如果重生猛击击中，则会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果击中被击倒的敌人，您将获得 3 点能量，并且此攻击会立即恢复。

5e01401ff7cc5ac24f0498aa485e30c173d13806.source: Hex Spell. For 8 seconds, target foe suffers 2…10…12 damage each second. When this hex ends, you gain 1…7…8 Energy.
5e01401ff7cc5ac24f0498aa485e30c173d13806.text: 降咒魔法。 8 秒内，目标敌人每秒受到 2…10…12 点伤害。当这个降咒结束时，你获得 1…7…8 能量。

ba7006607a6fd811cb1e6dba9de99c8f102ef4fa.source: Spell. Target fleshy foe becomes Diseased for 10…22…25 seconds, slowly losing Health.
ba7006607a6fd811cb1e6dba9de99c8f102ef4fa.text: 咒文。目标肉质敌人会患病 10…22…25 秒，慢慢失去生命值。

f25d68d2518d0b3d801a7508fe3acbaf37d1e003.source: Stance. For 5…13…15 seconds, you and your pet run 25% faster.
f25d68d2518d0b3d801a7508fe3acbaf37d1e003.text: 立场。在 5…13…15 秒内，您和您的宠物跑得快了 25%。

00859838f31179fec2d3a48afb71766701306046.source: Spell. Target allied spirit is destroyed. All nearby enemies are struck for 50…122…140 lightning damage and become blinded for 3…10…12 seconds.
00859838f31179fec2d3a48afb71766701306046.text: 咒语。目标友方战魂被破坏。附近所有敌人都会受到 50…122…140 点闪电伤害，并失明 3…10…12 秒。

c318f78dc746c1e638440860028bdfcf8de961b2.source: Stance. For 8…18…20 seconds, you move 25% faster.
c318f78dc746c1e638440860028bdfcf8de961b2.text: 立场。在 8…18…20 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。

369b43baf818711e42272616a57e61aecd88c1f3.source: Hex Spell. Deals 10…70…85 cold damage to target and adjacent foes. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to activate signets. If you are Overcast, foes struck with Rust have their signets interrupted and disabled for 1…8…10 seconds.
369b43baf818711e42272616a57e61aecd88c1f3.text: 降咒魔法。对目标及其邻近敌人造成 10…70…85 点冰冷伤害。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人需要两倍的时间来激活印章。如果你是阴天，被铁锈击中的敌人的图章会被打断并禁用1…8…10秒。

855cd58aae033579c22df419d1fb24d00a37e27b.source: Signet. You gain 10…38…45 Health for each condition on target foe.
855cd58aae033579c22df419d1fb24d00a37e27b.text: 印章。目标敌人的每种状况你都会获得 10…38…45 点生命值。

2264b6930601d43807b99a93c8d701c0fdd654d0.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, the next 1…4…5 times you hit with a scythe, all other adjacent foes take 10…50…60 earth damage.
2264b6930601d43807b99a93c8d701c0fdd654d0.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 30 秒内，接下来你用镰刀击中 1…4…5 次，所有其他相邻敌人都会受到 10…50…60 点土系伤害。

b2d55767d66541b4eed2ca4e79f1fce4aafd9290.source: Elite Spell. Create a Sandstorm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, nearby foes are struck for 20…36…40 earth damage each second and attacking foes are struck for an additional 10…26…30 earth damage each second.
b2d55767d66541b4eed2ca4e79f1fce4aafd9290.text: 精英法术。在目标敌人的位置制造沙尘暴。持续 10 秒，附近的敌人每秒受到 20…36…40 点土属性伤害，攻击敌人每秒受到额外 10…26…30 点土属性伤害。

4cd870b5be33e04eb281c664ca262c2b2340fce1.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Savage Pounce that deals +5…17…20 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is casting a spell, that foe is knocked down.
4cd870b5be33e04eb281c664ca262c2b2340fce1.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行野蛮猛扑，造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果攻击击中正在施法的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

875fef8cb56757cea77389ce861ac8099ef46bce.source: Bow Attack. If Savage Shot hits, your target's action is interrupted. If that action was a spell, you strike for +13…25…28 damage.
875fef8cb56757cea77389ce861ac8099ef46bce.text: 弓攻击。如果野蛮射击命中，目标的行动就会被打断。如果该动作是咒语，则你会造成 +13…25…28 点伤害。

73130119a3f4bc04c26c5ca0703eb0ff8d6fb317.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, you deal 1…32…40 extra damage.
73130119a3f4bc04c26c5ca0703eb0ff8d6fb317.text: 剑攻击。如果此攻击命中，则会打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是法术，你会造成 1…32…40 点额外伤害。

0734463860a802dae1dc8a55ecf7c773a272bf45.source: Elite Spell. You create Savannah Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, all nearby foes take 5…17…20 fire damage for each second this spell has been in effect.
0734463860a802dae1dc8a55ecf7c773a272bf45.text: 精英法术。你在目标敌人的位置制造萨凡纳热火。在 5 秒内，该法术生效的每一秒，所有附近的敌人都会受到 5…17…20 点火焰伤害。

f8d6aaf558b747060b2c0686b2c419d08a627525.source: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Scavenger Strike that deals +10…22…25 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is suffering a condition, you gain 3…13…15 Energy.
f8d6aaf558b747060b2c0686b2c419d08a627525.text: 宠物攻击。你的动物伙伴尝试进行清道夫打击，造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果攻击击中患有某种疾病的敌人，你将获得 3…13…15 点能量。

7e428cb932ef89565827e76114f0ea764ad4cadf.source: Elite Skill. For 10 seconds if you strike a foe who is suffering from a condition you gain 3…10…12 Energy.
7e428cb932ef89565827e76114f0ea764ad4cadf.text: 精英技能。在 10 秒内，如果你攻击患有某种疾病的敌人，你将获得 3…10…12 点能量。

1c4f5dbc1e0bccbb3ca207bb09e1bfe5a37e3367.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, the next time you and target foe are more than 75' apart, you Shadow Step to that foe and that foe is knocked down. This spell has half the normal range.
1c4f5dbc1e0bccbb3ca207bb09e1bfe5a37e3367.text: 降咒魔法。在 8…18…20 秒内，下一次你和目标敌人相距超过 75 英尺时，你向该敌人施以暗影步，并且该敌人被击倒。该法术的射程只有正常范围的一半。

05e117f852ab7a7f601b47e0fab75930a83e9e38.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, each time target foe is the target of an enchantment, the caster of that enchantment takes 15…63…75 damage.
05e117f852ab7a7f601b47e0fab75930a83e9e38.text: 降咒魔法。在 30 秒内，每当目标敌人成为结界的目标时，该结界的施法者就会受到 15…63…75 点伤害。

bbb4a1c46c1a6ab9b066bfe969d22ce5f4fce2eb.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 15…67…80 holy damage.
bbb4a1c46c1a6ab9b066bfe969d22ce5f4fce2eb.text: 降咒魔法。 30秒内，每当目标敌人被治愈时，治疗者就会受到15…67…80点神圣伤害。

a8cb820c7eec4532d537460c2e508d436f193fed.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10…26…30 damage. If it misses, it takes an additional 15 seconds to recharge.
a8cb820c7eec4532d537460c2e508d436f193fed.text: 副手攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，该攻击会造成 +10…26…30 伤害。如果未命中，则需要额外 15 秒的时间来重新充电。

4df0efb97e2db9e62f07b1cfbfdfe632de1e4147.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, every time target foe and adjacent foes sacrifice life, they sacrifice twice the normal amount.
4df0efb97e2db9e62f07b1cfbfdfe632de1e4147.text: 降咒魔法。在 8…18…20 秒内，每次目标敌人和邻近敌人牺牲生命，他们牺牲的生命量是正常数量的两倍。

9879f33c4435d568b9bdc5db44d8fdb96bb67a48.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…22…25 damage. If your target is within earshot, that foe begins Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds.
9879f33c4435d568b9bdc5db44d8fdb96bb67a48.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果你的目标在听力范围内，该敌人就会开始流血 5…17…20 秒。

223b466deb37032286581800fbce362ddff5c104.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy whenever you use a Signet.
223b466deb37032286581800fbce362ddff5c104.text: 精英结界法术。在 10…30…35 秒内，每当您使用徽记时，您都会获得 3 能量。

27416e622098414ac2671a2014cd0b755a89ffdc.source: Elite Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes are struck with Searing Flames. Foes already on fire when this skill is cast are struck for 10…82…100 fire damage. Foes not already on fire begin Burning for 1…6…7 seconds.
27416e622098414ac2671a2014cd0b755a89ffdc.text: 精英法术。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人都会受到灼热火焰的攻击。施放该技能时，已经着火的敌人会受到 10…82…100 点火焰伤害。尚未着火的敌人开始燃烧 1…6…7 秒。

9f7ec934aa80f878a5a8aafce35f270e481da04e.source: Spell. Cause Searing Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10…34…40 fire damage each second. When Searing Heat ends, foes in the area of effect are set on fire for 3 seconds.
9f7ec934aa80f878a5a8aafce35f270e481da04e.text: 咒语。在目标敌人所在位置造成灼热。在 5 秒内，该位置附近的敌人每秒受到 10…34…40 点火焰伤害。当灼热之热结束时，效果区域内的敌人会着火 3 秒。

a6ab5f1e2646a2bd88e57a3ea1f50add26437bec.source: Elite Spell. You gain 1 Energy and 5 Health for each point of Energy restricted by Overcast. You lose all enchantments.
a6ab5f1e2646a2bd88e57a3ea1f50add26437bec.text: 精英法术。受阴天限制的每点能量，你将获得 1 点能量和 5 点生命值。你会失去所有的魅力。

f3146e24f2e6ce3700c6c5d707e5e0ed50cd5657.source: Enchantment Spell. For 2…5 seconds, whenever target other ally takes damage, all party members are healed for 2 Health for each rank in Divine Favor.
f3146e24f2e6ce3700c6c5d707e5e0ed50cd5657.text: 结界咒语。在 2…5 秒内，每当目标其他盟友受到伤害时，所有小队成员都会在神圣恩惠中每等级恢复 2 点生命值。

021ed6f425035f7f8f0fcea4a59099740e4d2324.source: Preparation. For 3…12…14 seconds, your arrows cannot be blocked. Seeking Arrows ends if you fail to hit.
021ed6f425035f7f8f0fcea4a59099740e4d2324.text: 准备。 3…12…14秒内，你的箭无法被阻挡。如果未能击中，寻找箭头就会结束。

8cd871446d58fccedb65058c2a5438bfb5f339e4.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits you strike for +1…16…20 damage. If Seeking Blade is blocked, your target begins Bleeding for 25 seconds and takes 1…16…20 damage.
8cd871446d58fccedb65058c2a5438bfb5f339e4.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击击中你，则会造成 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果“寻剑”被格挡，你的目标将开始流血 25 秒并受到 1…16…20 点伤害。

44a7ba979cc82e6c235ef264fb36c4a1ab004720.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…6…7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5…21…25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
44a7ba979cc82e6c235ef264fb36c4a1ab004720.text: 精英六角咒语。在 1…6…7 秒内，目标敌人的移动速度减慢 33%。该敌人在患有某种病症时每秒受到 5…21…25 点伤害。

b26725c71bb192d260a4a8bff374fc0a31e55c91.source: Enchantment Spell. For 15…20 seconds, spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less energy.
b26725c71bb192d260a4a8bff374fc0a31e55c91.text: 结界咒语。在 15…20 秒内，你对另一个盟友施展的法术消耗的能量减少 3。

f618888bbf244ac09d668b47cde98ac2ae2b0760.source: Item Spell. Hold Xiko's ashes for up to 5…17…20 seconds. For each hex or condition you are suffering from while holding her ashes, you gain +3 Health regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you lose 1…3…4 conditions.
f618888bbf244ac09d668b47cde98ac2ae2b0760.text: 物品法术。保留 Xiko 的骨灰最多 5…17…20 秒。对于你在持有她的骨灰时所遭受的每一种巫术或状况，你都会获得 +3 生命恢复。当你撒下她的骨灰时，你会失去 1…3…4 个条件。

a20fb874fe47a584a23944b5272e69866dbcfe58.source: Weapon Spell. For 3…10…12 seconds, target ally has a Resilient Weapon. While suffering from a hex or condition, that ally gains +1…5…6 Health regeneration and +24 armor.
a20fb874fe47a584a23944b5272e69866dbcfe58.text: 武器咒语。 3…10…12秒内，目标盟友拥有弹性武器。当遭受巫术或病症时，该盟友获得 +1…5…6 点生命恢复和 +24 点护甲。

ac589bd9bc031e08a4c142937563e4ad07fb002e.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…16…18 seconds, target ally has +10 Health regeneration. This enchantment ends if that ally attacks or uses a skill.
ac589bd9bc031e08a4c142937563e4ad07fb002e.text: 结界咒语。 8…16…18 秒内，目标盟友恢复 +10 生命值。如果该盟友攻击或使用技能，该结界就会结束。

14e5c45534fe9015f8521bb2ca34c920d4222267.source: Stance. For 15…27…30 seconds, recharge times for your skills are reduced by 33%. Serpent's Quickness ends if your Health drops below 50%.
14e5c45534fe9015f8521bb2ca34c920d4222267.text: 立场。在 15…27…30 秒内，你的技能充能时间减少 33%。如果你的生命值低于 50%，蛇的敏捷就会结束。

10d2cd9d9d0ca33d538a52f8d01d5ca74c7fa0e6.source: Elite Stance. For 3…17…20 seconds, your weapon attributes are increased by +1…12…15 and you attack 33% faster. PvE Skill
10d2cd9d9d0ca33d538a52f8d01d5ca74c7fa0e6.text: 精英姿态。 3…17…20秒内，你的武器属性增加+1…12…15，攻击速度加快33%。 PvE技能

82d3d3507eaf0a6c6e21ad248c5e9bba033acb83.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…11…14 spirit. When this spirit dies, all party members in the area are resurrected with 5…41…50% Health and zero Energy. This spirit dies after 30 seconds.
82d3d3507eaf0a6c6e21ad248c5e9bba033acb83.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…11…14级武魂。当这个灵魂死亡时，该地区的所有队员都会以 5…41…50% 生命值和零能量复活。该灵魂会在 30 秒后死亡。

0ddceffb623289c43ae60d01a13f00a86c69fbc1.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, the opponent begins Bleeding for 5…21…25 seconds, losing Health over time.
0ddceffb623289c43ae60d01a13f00a86c69fbc1.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击命中，对手会开始流血 5…21…25 秒，并随着时间的推移失去生命值。

e62e45c3ab10ba4fdd4f02db6915e214ed1906c3.source: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. For 10 seconds, this hex does nothing. When this hex ends, you return to your original location and that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
e62e45c3ab10ba4fdd4f02db6915e214ed1906c3.text: 降咒魔法。暗影步瞄准敌人。在 10 秒内，这个降咒没有任何作用。当这个六角形结束时，你会回到原来的位置，而那个敌人会受到深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

153ea38a0b328c93c4ae70430376bace59c02919.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…18…21 seconds, you cannot be the target of enemy spells, and you gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. You cannot deal more than 5…21…25 damage with a single skill or attack.

7b063edd05377a9087259acee0dd62b8a4767e76.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, anyone striking target ally with an attack is knocked down and suffers 5…41…50 holy damage.
7b063edd05377a9087259acee0dd62b8a4767e76.text: 精英结界法术。在 8…18…20 秒内，任何攻击目标盟友的人都会被击倒并遭受 5…41…50 点神圣伤害。

0dd3a42a9ccfdc8683cd4d9424ab53d9470b8008.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…11…13 seconds, target ally gains +3…9…10 Health regeneration and 20…40…45 armor.
0dd3a42a9ccfdc8683cd4d9424ab53d9470b8008.text: 精英结界法术。 5…11…13秒内，目标盟友获得+3…9…10点生命恢复和20…40…45点护甲。

fd6259725ba417c508fba633c3087cf0cafff2b8.source: Signet. If target foe is casting a spell, the spell is interrupted and that foe suffers 10…43…51 damage. If that foe is hexed, Signet of Disruption can interrupt any non-spell skills.
fd6259725ba417c508fba633c3087cf0cafff2b8.text: 印章。如果目标敌人正在施展法术，该法术就会被打断，并且该敌人会受到 10…43…51 点伤害。如果该敌人被施咒，干扰徽记可以打断任何非法术技能。

9b8c34565108a01ecc43eecbcade450f2e8f092b.source: Signet. If target foe is casting a spell, that spell is interrupted and disabled for 1…4…5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.
9b8c34565108a01ecc43eecbcade450f2e8f092b.text: 印章。如果目标敌人正在施展法术，则对于你装备的每个印章，该法术会被打断并禁用 1…4…5 秒。

6609e25d969b8684c9f8d75ac8ad146b6e21e869.source: Elite Signet. For 5…17…20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5…9…10 additional damage.
6609e25d969b8684c9f8d75ac8ad146b6e21e869.text: 精英图章。持续 5…17…20 秒，你控制的所有精魂攻击速度提高 33% 点，并造成 5…9…10 点额外伤害。

3dd89f76563d9946f7ea0d7b873164ccd269105c.source: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature's attacks deal 5…29…35 more damage. After 10 seconds, that creature is destroyed.
3dd89f76563d9946f7ea0d7b873164ccd269105c.text: 精英图章。目标盟方召唤生物的攻击造成 5…29…35 点以上伤害。 10秒后，该生物被消灭。

a834bcc28bc823b101ed66c4bae17398a1c3827c.source: Signet. Target foe's elite skill is disabled for 1…13…16 seconds. Your non-Mesmer skills are disabled for 4 seconds.
a834bcc28bc823b101ed66c4bae17398a1c3827c.text: 印章。目标敌人的精英技能失效1…13…16秒。你的非幻术师技能将被禁用 4 秒。

bcb220789bc86cff556df6dfabd99f44467842a3.source: Elite Signet. Your next 1…3…3 non-Illusion spells use your Illusion attribute instead of its normal attribute.
bcb220789bc86cff556df6dfabd99f44467842a3.text: 精英图章。你接下来的 1…3…3 个非幻象法术将使用你的幻象属性而不是普通属性。

614f34587c588c93fc39fd32cfeda9e3d7b5055d.source: Signet. If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13…20 seconds.
614f34587c588c93fc39fd32cfeda9e3d7b5055d.text: 印章。如果目标敌人处于流血状态，则该敌人处于疾病状态 13…20 秒。

b79b2619d4b148f0f4a1ff143956e6ac38fbbc31.source: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 15…63…75 holy damage.
b79b2619d4b148f0f4a1ff143956e6ac38fbbc31.text: 精英图章。目标敌人被击倒。该敌人和所有邻近的敌人受到 15…63…75 点神圣伤害。

efdc7e180839b49e2c6cf68d4722a0ef542e40f3.source: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 5…41…50 holy damage. This signet has half the normal range.
efdc7e180839b49e2c6cf68d4722a0ef542e40f3.text: 精英图章。目标敌人被击倒。该敌人和所有邻近的敌人受到 5…41…50 点神圣伤害。此图章的范围是正常范围的一半。

35af3ad6cd06b3214532021b1fa95c9676c3ed46.source: Signet. If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 10…82…100 Health and 1…8…10 Energy.
35af3ad6cd06b3214532021b1fa95c9676c3ed46.text: 印章。如果目标敌人的生命值低于 50% 点，你将获得 10…82…100 点生命值和 1…8…10 点能量。

f912c45728ecb037eea01a15a8e9412794c687c9.source: Signet. For each condition suffered by target foe, you lose one condition.
f912c45728ecb037eea01a15a8e9412794c687c9.text: 印章。对于目标敌人遭受的每一种状况，你都会失去一种状况。

8753e9eece5c2ebe4f55b12606d914c16151411b.source: Elite Signet. You and target touched foe become Blinded for 15 seconds.
8753e9eece5c2ebe4f55b12606d914c16151411b.text: 精英图章。你和目标所接触的敌人会被致盲 15 秒。

4620bd34498773506d7a1b9aed411e39d16f417a.source: Signet. For 30 seconds, your next 1…3…3 self-targeting enchantments cast instantly. Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.
4620bd34498773506d7a1b9aed411e39d16f417a.text: 印章。在 30 秒内，你的下一个 1…3…3 个自瞄准结界会立即施放。闪光附魔不会消耗该技能的使用。

708ca257ec4cc45c8b9791140287a4d970ab70bf.source: Signet. Target foe takes 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30…102…120 holy damage).
708ca257ec4cc45c8b9791140287a4d970ab70bf.text: 印章。你身上的每个结界都会对目标敌人造成 25 点神圣伤害（最多 30…102…120 点神圣伤害）。

22b991632bdbaa28128f8d13799c7f38e05c1cc4.source: Signet. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target ally is healed for 30…126…150 Health. If an enchantment was removed in this way, this signet recharges 75% faster.
22b991632bdbaa28128f8d13799c7f38e05c1cc4.text: 印章。移除 1 苦行僧结界。目标盟友已治愈 30…126…150 点生命值。如果以这种方式移除结界，此图章的充能速度会加快 75%。

4c63c502dcd832ab97f482c180fa13c737d61754.source: Signet. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target foe is Crippled for 5…13…15 seconds. If an enchantment was removed, all foes in the area of your target are also Crippled and this signet recharges 75% faster.
4c63c502dcd832ab97f482c180fa13c737d61754.text: 印章。移除 1 苦行僧结界。目标敌人瘫痪 5…13…15 秒。如果结界被移除，目标区域内的所有敌人也会被削弱，并且此印章的充能速度会加快 75%。

99321c2e52ad412d97657da1447a99bc2ac4d5e8.source: Signet. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment and Cripple target foe 5…13…15 seconds. If an enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 50% faster.
99321c2e52ad412d97657da1447a99bc2ac4d5e8.text: 印章。失去 1 苦行僧结界并削弱目标敌人 5…13…15 秒。如果结界被移除，该技能的充能速度会加快 50%。

f0cd12d92fb0e65714b412aeae3e89ef7785ad76.source: Signet. Target foe takes 5…41…50 holy damage and +5…9…10 holy damage for each adrenaline skill that foe has.
f0cd12d92fb0e65714b412aeae3e89ef7785ad76.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 5…41…50 点神圣伤害，并且敌人每拥有一项肾上腺素技能就会受到 +5…9…10 点神圣伤害。

2eab0891c7bfbb2cdd08ad2cca05527027faf596.source: Signet. For 6 seconds, you have -4 Energy regeneration. When this effect ends, you gain 13…19…20 Energy.
2eab0891c7bfbb2cdd08ad2cca05527027faf596.text: 印章。 6 秒，你有 -4 能量再生。当该效果结束时，你获得 13…19…20 点能量。

7a1cf14e8c7a5300dcd72055f82d366b70da5311.source: Signet. Heal target ally for 15…63…75. If target ally is casting a spell or attacking, that ally is healed for an additional 15…63…75 Health.
7a1cf14e8c7a5300dcd72055f82d366b70da5311.text: 印章。治疗目标盟友 15…63…75 点。如果目标盟友正在施法或攻击，则该盟友会额外获得 15…63…75 点生命值治疗。

ab2ce1191801bbfb65f68287471d79ae21d6c6fa.source: Elite Signet. If target ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally loses one hex and one condition.
ab2ce1191801bbfb65f68287471d79ae21d6c6fa.text: 精英图章。如果目标盟友受到结界的影响，则该盟友会失去一个降咒和一个状态。

348387cbe0dd3c714e0056498535e5b3b0b07025.source: Signet. Resurrect target party member with 5…17…20% Health and 1…3…4% Energy for each party member within earshot.
348387cbe0dd3c714e0056498535e5b3b0b07025.text: 印章。复活目标队员，为听力范围内的每个队员提供 5…17…20% 点生命值和 1…3…4% 点能量。

f2257076f7511d117ea6b2f7b03b79773683aac1.source: Spell. Send out a shocking arrow that flies swiftly toward target foe, striking for 5…41…50 lightning damage. If Shock Arrow strikes a foe suffering from Cracked Armor, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage. Shock Arrow has 25% armor penetration.
f2257076f7511d117ea6b2f7b03b79773683aac1.text: 咒文。射出令人震惊的箭矢，迅速飞向目标敌人，攻击敌人5…41…50雷击损坏。如果震击箭击中遭受盔甲破裂的敌人，你将获得5能量加1为每个人提供能源2储能排名。冲击箭有25%装甲穿透力。

54b9f34a9633981326d92630ec3173a1eb6d67ff.source: Elite Spell. All foes in the area take 15…51…60 earth damage and are Weakened for 1…8…10 seconds. Nearby foes also take +15…51…60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor for 1…8…10 seconds. Adjacent foes suffer the previous effects, take +15…51…60 earth damage, and are Blinded for 1…8…10 seconds.
54b9f34a9633981326d92630ec3173a1eb6d67ff.text: 精英法术。该区域内的所有敌人受到 15…51…60 点土系伤害并被削弱 1…8…10 秒。附近的敌人也会受到 +15…51…60 点土系伤害，并且装甲破裂，持续 1…8…10 秒。相邻敌人受到之前的效果，受到 +15…51…60 点土系伤害，并致盲 1…8…10 秒。

02ac41b0fc4f751c004993342d4709794dc68217.source: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 15…63…75 damage, their stance ends, and they are knocked down.
02ac41b0fc4f751c004993342d4709794dc68217.text: 精英技能。目标接触的敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害，他们的姿态结束，他们被击倒。

92eb9ce8f2de2f2e39ffc650bb44eab7e5aae2bd.source: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe suffers from -1…3…4 Health degeneration. When this hex ends, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds.
92eb9ce8f2de2f2e39ffc650bb44eab7e5aae2bd.text: 降咒魔法。 10 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…4 点生命值退化。当这个六角结束时，该敌人的护甲破裂持续 5…17…20 秒。

b435e9b1107150919670d27e98b162684520e977.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30…54…60 seconds, if you are below 50% Health, you have +3…7…8 health regeneration and a 75% chance to block attacks.
b435e9b1107150919670d27e98b162684520e977.text: 结界咒语。在 30…54…60 秒内，如果你的生命值低于 50%，你将有 +3…7…8 点生命恢复，并有 75% 的机会阻止攻击。

cb6c37d796b3d19025ff48b29838f48130000c9b.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30…54…60 seconds, if you are below 50% Health, you have a 75% chance to block attacks.
cb6c37d796b3d19025ff48b29838f48130000c9b.text: 结界咒语。在 30…54…60 秒内，如果你的生命值低于 50%，你有 75% 的机会阻止攻击。

67ebd47e563cb0627ac0bf89bfec486922f727fc.source: Elite Hex Spell. All of your spells are disabled for 15 seconds. For 1…5…6 seconds, target touched foe cannot cast spells.
67ebd47e563cb0627ac0bf89bfec486922f727fc.text: 精英六角咒语。你的所有法术都会被禁用 15 秒。在 1…5…6 秒内，目标接触的敌人无法施展法术。

9dade5e4bd9deacfbd5230a96f6a6eb1b5defa83.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, you cannot be Blinded.
9dade5e4bd9deacfbd5230a96f6a6eb1b5defa83.text: 结界咒语。在 8…18…20 秒内，你不会被致盲。

cdb633b0ea7b23e62c9bcfaf885ea127dfbbcf8f.source: Signet. Target foe takes 5…29…35 damage. If your target was Blinded, that foe suffers an additional 15…51…60 damage.
cdb633b0ea7b23e62c9bcfaf885ea127dfbbcf8f.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 5…29…35 点伤害。如果你的目标被致盲，则该敌人会受到额外 15…51…60 点伤害。

0a18ab6e9e152fd3b847bddcaa88ffeefee95d43.source: Signet. If you are under the effects of a shout or chant, you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
0a18ab6e9e152fd3b847bddcaa88ffeefee95d43.text: 印章。如果你受到喊叫或圣歌的影响，你的肾上腺素会增加 2 次。

4fd4fd8456e8ad8f5d3c82785514352e1da02cee.source: Signet. Target foe takes 15…63…75 damage. If target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet, this skill recharges instantly.
4fd4fd8456e8ad8f5d3c82785514352e1da02cee.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害。如果目标敌人靠近尸体或有死去的宠物，该技能会立即恢复。

f254d10a2c190afaa946352882678234f803a3a1.source: Signet. You suffer from Bleeding for 25 seconds. All nearby foes take 10…58…70 damage.
f254d10a2c190afaa946352882678234f803a3a1.text: 印章。你会流血25秒。附近的所有敌人都会受到 10…58…70 点伤害。

25d36dfec1be612dcbf573b7c2e39a08f122d212.source: Signet. You lose 200…80…50 Health and take control of target enemy-controlled spirit. (50% failure chance with Spawning Power 4 or less.)
25d36dfec1be612dcbf573b7c2e39a08f122d212.text: 印章。你失去 200…80…50 点生命值并控制目标敌人控制的灵魂。 （产卵力 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）

7291ec8f903cfa6c50947c031590bd0963fe2b6a.source: Signet. Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.
7291ec8f903cfa6c50947c031590bd0963fe2b6a.text: 印章。从附近死去的你职业的 Boss 中选择一项技能。捕获徽记将永久被该技能取代。如果该技能是精英技能，则每升一级即可获得 250 XP。

17487f5636552bdc782e7630b6209bf50c0509d3.source: Signet. If target foe is attacking, that foe and all adjacent foes are interrupted and take 15…51…60 damage. Any foes using attack skills are knocked down.
17487f5636552bdc782e7630b6209bf50c0509d3.text: 印章。如果目标敌人正在攻击，该敌人和所有邻近的敌人都会被打断并受到 15…51…60 点伤害。任何使用攻击技能的敌人都会被击倒。

f9de26ac9d1548239811b8083d25bc4bc91f4b88.source: Signet. Target foe and all nearby foes take 20…30 damage. For each affected foe suffering from a condition or hex, you gain 2 Energy (maximum 12…20 Energy).
f9de26ac9d1548239811b8083d25bc4bc91f4b88.text: 印章。目标敌人和所有附近的敌人受到 20…30 点伤害。对于每个患有某种状况或妖术的受影响敌人，你将获得 2 点能量（最多 12…20 点能量）。

e626596a76f5b2594f9dd603ab910ef6720ec592.source: Signet. You gain 4 Energy for every summoned creature you control within earshot (maximum 3…10…12 Energy).
e626596a76f5b2594f9dd603ab910ef6720ec592.text: 印章。在听力范围内，每有一个由你操控的召唤生物，你就会获得 4 点能量（最多 3…10…12 点能量）。

519e0952aac4dde211d39ae30b7622064be41fca.source: Signet. Target foe takes 5…29…35 damage for each condition on that foe (maximum 130 damage).
519e0952aac4dde211d39ae30b7622064be41fca.text: 印章。目标敌人因该敌人的每种状况而受到 5…29…35 点伤害（最大 130 点伤害）。

e0b98af64748cd9043fc8f2d262b521639718676.source: Signet. Must follow a dual attack. Target foe takes 5…29…35 damage for each condition on that foe (maximum 130 damage).
e0b98af64748cd9043fc8f2d262b521639718676.text: 印章。必须遵循双重攻击。目标敌人因该敌人的每种状况而受到 5…29…35 点伤害（最大 130 点伤害）。

20ff8107520b3e44521d01caaa27f808a04325b1.source: Signet. Heal target ally for 20…100…120 Health.
20ff8107520b3e44521d01caaa27f808a04325b1.text: 印章。治疗目标盟友 20…100…120 生命值。

9f4b36668bd9ae176be1cb5e7c99fb752391b86e.source: Signet. Lose all Energy. Target foe loses one enchantment.
9f4b36668bd9ae176be1cb5e7c99fb752391b86e.text: 印章。失去所有能量。目标敌人失去一项结界。

3b583cccad3ebe7a86e2070e58d3c791700fac78.source: Signet. You have +50…250…300 maximum Health. This signet ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
3b583cccad3ebe7a86e2070e58d3c791700fac78.text: 印章。您的最大生命值为 +50…250…300。如果你成功攻击，此印章就会结束。

4508e9cde8943eb6a620846c4ebc15c946c3894e.source: Signet. Your next 1…13…16 attacks deal +5 damage.
4508e9cde8943eb6a620846c4ebc15c946c3894e.text: 印章。你接下来的 1…13…16 次攻击会造成 +5 点伤害。

be06e8a42bdbc66975679a9a85b61801cf03da0c.source: Elite Signet. Create 3 level 1…10…12 spirits. These spirits deal 5…17…20 damage with attacks and die after 60 seconds.
be06e8a42bdbc66975679a9a85b61801cf03da0c.text: 精英图章。创建 3 个 1…10…12 级灵魂。这些灵魂的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害，并在 60 秒后死亡。

5622eb90e429086831c2c3e70fbcf7e8afffabb0.source: Elite Signet. You gain 3…10…12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.
5622eb90e429086831c2c3e70fbcf7e8afffabb0.text: 精英图章。如果您处于灵魂的听力范围内，您将获得 3…10…12 能量。

3d0b5e1d199a96e0de17065b69bf7442138e0a25.source: Elite Signet. You suffer from Bleeding for 6 seconds. The next Necromancer skill that targets a foe causes Bleeding for 2…13…16 seconds.
3d0b5e1d199a96e0de17065b69bf7442138e0a25.text: 精英图章。你会流血 6 秒。下一个针对敌人的死灵法师技能会导致流血 2…13…16 秒。

be36529799ad8e3152c1bd529a5cc75753a91ba6.source: Signet. Target other ally is healed for 40…88…100 Health. If you are not under the effects of an enchantment, you are also healed for 40…88…100 Health.
be36529799ad8e3152c1bd529a5cc75753a91ba6.text: 印章。目标其他盟友获得 40…88…100 点生命值治疗。如果你没有受到结界的影响，你也会获得 40…88…100 点生命值的治疗。

2edb69f8e3841ff05b1bebfc6f632b8f40925c02.source: Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10…58…70 fire damage. If you are Overcast, that foe is hexed with Smoldering Embers for 3 seconds and takes 5…21…25 additional fire damage each second.
2edb69f8e3841ff05b1bebfc6f632b8f40925c02.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人受到 10…58…70 点火焰伤害。如果你处于阴暗状态，该敌人会被闷燃余烬施咒 3 秒，并每秒受到 5…21…25 点额外火焰伤害。

e95b45177b1142d929e99b1adb133063e85a3909.source: Spell. For 10…20 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Smooth Criminal is replaced by that spell. You gain 5…10 Energy.
e95b45177b1142d929e99b1adb133063e85a3909.text: 咒语。在 10…20 秒内，目标敌人的一个随机法术被禁用，并且犯罪高手被该法术取代。您获得 5…10 能量。

f35d1b22c2fa87ae6e1c40bf67666fd2ea213711.source: Trap. When Snare is triggered, all nearby foes become Crippled for 3…13…15 seconds. Snare ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
f35d1b22c2fa87ae6e1c40bf67666fd2ea213711.text: 陷阱。当陷阱被触发时，所有附近的敌人都会变得残废，持续 3…13…15 秒。军鼓在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

55e6c0a071413554f6f0867245a3a123e467e858.source: Signet. If target foe is suffering from Poison, that foe takes 10…82…100 damage.
55e6c0a071413554f6f0867245a3a123e467e858.text: 印章。如果目标敌人正在遭受中毒，则该敌人会受到 10…82…100 点伤害。

61a3ad1a3d78956c03b83979ded396ccbfe4c3dd.source: Signet. For each hex on target foe, that foe loses one enchantment.
61a3ad1a3d78956c03b83979ded396ccbfe4c3dd.text: 印章。目标敌人身上每有一个六角形，该敌人就会失去一个结界。

1b2cede36c24265477fbfb0cc40641ce5c74e872.source: Signet. Target foe and all nearby foes lose 3…7…8 Energy and suffer from Weakness for 1…10…12 seconds.
1b2cede36c24265477fbfb0cc40641ce5c74e872.text: 印章。目标敌人和附近的所有敌人损失 3…7…8 点能量并遭受虚弱 1…10…12 秒。

25b027e860579b8016efa2317cded4baad71dc7e.source: Elite Spell. Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a skill, that skill is disabled for 5…17…20 seconds, and Simple Thievery is replaced by that skill.
25b027e860579b8016efa2317cded4baad71dc7e.text: 精英法术。打断目标敌人的行动。如果该动作是一项技能，则该技能将被禁用 5…17…20 秒，并且简单盗窃将被该技能取代。

2fbabbf7c9f40c9beb161d9f0ea9038f420714e0.source: Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. This spell recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.
2fbabbf7c9f40c9beb161d9f0ea9038f420714e0.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…13…15 秒内，目标敌人移动速度慢 33%，你移动速度快 33%。如果对移动的敌人施放该法术，则其充能速度会加快 50%。

5f53b8ab24d74aa664e83319c5f763cfa6b5ee3a.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe deals 5…41…50 less damage with attacks and all of your attacks against that foe have an additional 50% chance of being a critical hit.
5f53b8ab24d74aa664e83319c5f763cfa6b5ee3a.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人的攻击造成的伤害减少 5…41…50，并且你对该敌人的所有攻击都有额外 50% 的几率造成暴击。

9969fc7fc57e6695924d6f1e0c61485bc007ed95.source: Elite Melee Attack. If it hits, this attack interrupts the target's current action. If that foe was casting a spell, that foe is Dazed for 15 seconds.
9969fc7fc57e6695924d6f1e0c61485bc007ed95.text: 精英近战攻击。如果击中，该攻击会打断目标当前的行动。如果该敌人正在施展法术，则该敌人会晕眩 15 秒。

61d95210e27a872d22ab2b857deba913815449bd.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…21…25 damage. If that foe has more Health than you, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
61d95210e27a872d22ab2b857deba913815449bd.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。如果该敌人的生命值比你多，则该敌人会受到深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

18a7eae07cc7692487336af82344184ada7c7f32.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Blinded for 5…8 seconds. This attack counts as a lead attack.
18a7eae07cc7692487336af82344184ada7c7f32.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，目标敌人将被致盲 5…8 秒。这次攻击算作主导攻击。

445183a8f74b758baf40f7ab14f9d7450de134d7.source: Spell. Create a Snow Storm at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 30…40 cold damage each second.
445183a8f74b758baf40f7ab14f9d7450de134d7.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置制造暴风雪。持续 5 秒，该位置附近的敌人每秒受到 30…40 点寒冷伤害。

c61adc3aedfca5c9139332a16c8996cc8b64b5e5.source: Stance. For 1…5…6 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block attacks while under the effects of a shout or chant. You gain 1 strike of adrenaline for each blocked attack.
c61adc3aedfca5c9139332a16c8996cc8b64b5e5.text: 立场。在 1…5…6 秒内，你在喊叫或圣歌的效果下有 75% 次机会格挡攻击。每次被阻止的攻击你都会获得 1 点肾上腺素打击。

740533d1340fcb4840cd1daf05440ad140540320.source: Elite Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, if you are under the effects of a chant or a shout, you attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline, but you have -20 armor.
740533d1340fcb4840cd1daf05440ad140540320.text: 精英回声。在 10…30…35 秒内，如果你受到圣歌或喊叫的影响，你的攻击速度会加快 33%，并获得更多的肾上腺素 33%，但你的护甲值会增加 -20。

7e01a22ed572689cdf516af5d57407737c541604.source: Stance. For 3…15…18 seconds, you move 15% faster. You move an additional 15% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.
7e01a22ed572689cdf516af5d57407737c541604.text: 立场。在 3…15…18 秒内，您移动速度加快 15%。在圣歌或喊叫的影响下，你的移动速度额外加快 15%。

f32a5afac51656e222b19af18167007ab5ee8ac9.source: Elite Stance. For 5…13…15 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
f32a5afac51656e222b19af18167007ab5ee8ac9.text: 精英姿态。在 5…13…15 秒内，你有 75% 次阻挡机会。在喊叫或圣歌的影响下，你的攻击速度更快 33%。

653a4cfe09711f69e99dee2ed464a597e519a2a4.source: Elite Stance. For 4…9…10 seconds, you attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
653a4cfe09711f69e99dee2ed464a597e519a2a4.text: 精英姿态。在 4…9…10 秒内，你在喊叫或圣歌的影响下攻击速度提高 33%。

cc5a12633e0902fb5b64c2697c2cdc01e7b54465.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…34…40 more damage. If you are under the effects of a chant or shout, this attack cannot be blocked.
cc5a12633e0902fb5b64c2697c2cdc01e7b54465.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将额外造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。如果你受到吟唱或呼喊的影响，则无法阻挡该攻击。

78f2a06975e4672ddeed5048609e00b5e63bc812.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next skill used by each ally within earshot cannot be interrupted.
78f2a06975e4672ddeed5048609e00b5e63bc812.text: 呗。 10秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个技能不会被打断。

5daadfb6f6fa0fa20b772cc0b0318d8e44e00e4d.source: Chant. For 5…17…20 seconds, each ally within earshot gains 4 Energy regeneration until that ally uses a Skill.
5daadfb6f6fa0fa20b772cc0b0318d8e44e00e4d.text: 吟诵。在 5…17…20 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友都会获得 4 点能量回复，直到该盟友使用技能。

3fd094fb664c29944fc434d58f5f72e8ab90f701.source: Elite Chant. For 20 seconds, the next 1…5…6 skills used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
3fd094fb664c29944fc434d58f5f72e8ab90f701.text: 精英圣歌。在 20 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个 1…5…6 技能会消除该盟友的 1 状态。

edaf1c26b7bde5e5e12ddd6e98f95d4e032df49c.source: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a skill, that party member gains 45…97…110 Health.
edaf1c26b7bde5e5e12ddd6e98f95d4e032df49c.text: 精英圣歌。在 10 秒内，每次听到范围内的每个队员下一次使用技能时，该队员都会获得 45…97…110 点生命值。

456e0725b66e94d4ec0b09f3552389f4508962a4.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit. All foes within its range take twice as long to build adrenaline. This spirit dies after 15…39…45 seconds.
456e0725b66e94d4ec0b09f3552389f4508962a4.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…10…12级武魂。其范围内的所有敌人都需要两倍的时间来产生肾上腺素。该灵魂会在 15…39…45 秒后死亡。

926c8f8d5a90f7a70010d4079a28b0aa6763047a.source: Spell. If target or adjacent foes are Blind or moving, these foes are knocked down. There is a 50% chance of failure with Water Magic less than 5.
926c8f8d5a90f7a70010d4079a28b0aa6763047a.text: 咒文。如果目标或邻近的敌人失明或移动，这些敌人就会被击倒。有一个50%水魔法失败的几率小于5。

4429d57af84ffba89840128686f770f095d1866d.source: Spell. If target foe is Blind or moving, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Water Magic 4 or less.)
4429d57af84ffba89840128686f770f095d1866d.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人是盲人或正在移动，则该敌人会被击倒。 (水魔法4以下时失败率50%。)

1a4ab27751fae48bda26730e36fc7d29a4a3ddaa.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…10…11 seconds, you have 25…45…50% chance to block attacks and whenever you are the target of a hostile spell or attack one nearby foe is struck for 5…29…35 earth damage.
1a4ab27751fae48bda26730e36fc7d29a4a3ddaa.text: 结界咒语。在 5…10…11 秒内，你有 25…45…50% 次机会阻挡攻击，并且每当你成为敌对法术的目标或攻击时，附近的一个敌人就会受到 5…29…35 点地球伤害。

beb011af5cf38593a98a85375893e44828652e94.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes +10…22…25 damage. If that foe is not using a skill, Sloth Hunter's Shot does an additional +10…30…35 damage.
beb011af5cf38593a98a85375893e44828652e94.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，目标敌人会受到 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果该敌人没有使用技能，树懒猎人的射击会造成额外 +10…30…35 点伤害。

b3e4ef22ec1f70c32a784702363e8fd1186ecbda.source: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes +5…13…15 damage. If that foe is not using a skill, Sloth Hunter's Shot does an additional +5…17…20 damage.
b3e4ef22ec1f70c32a784702363e8fd1186ecbda.text: 弓攻击。如果这次攻击命中，目标敌人会受到 +5…13…15 点伤害。如果该敌人没有使用技能，树懒猎人的射击会造成额外 +5…17…20 点伤害。

26b876132436e6d9af68457bd1ce2aa63c980c6c.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. All foes within its range take twice as long to build adrenaline. This spirit dies after 15…39…45 seconds.
26b876132436e6d9af68457bd1ce2aa63c980c6c.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…7…8级武魂。其范围内的所有敌人都需要两倍的时间来产生肾上腺素。该灵魂会在 15…39…45 秒后死亡。

330d23efb637b5f957dc19e966b6708955dd64d3.source: Hex Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot gain adrenaline.
330d23efb637b5f957dc19e966b6708955dd64d3.text: 降咒魔法。在 8…18…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有邻近敌人无法获得肾上腺素。

6b8e37568d90e67ca3e183e14c35c3167f17930f.source: Spell. Target ally is healed for 10…82…100 Health. If you are holding an item, you gain 3 Energy.
6b8e37568d90e67ca3e183e14c35c3167f17930f.text: 咒语。目标盟友已治愈 10…82…100 点生命值。如果你持有一件物品，你将获得 3 能量。

ca96ed12396dee36294247186d1492cea980589e.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe takes 15…27…30 damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on that target.
ca96ed12396dee36294247186d1492cea980589e.text: 降咒魔法。在 30 秒内，当对目标敌人施放结界或妖术时，目标敌人会受到 15…27…30 点伤害。

2105191a8ceeb4a279bdeaebb1f89bbda83a4aaf.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 20…68…80 damage. This hex ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.
2105191a8ceeb4a279bdeaebb1f89bbda83a4aaf.text: 精英六角咒语。在 30 秒内，每当目标敌人被治愈时，治疗者就会受到 20…68…80 点伤害。如果目标遭受重击祈祷咒语的折磨，则该咒语结束。

1a77aa0be7f272611b965ee5b53b9366fa7b5e8f.source: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to gain 50…234…280 Health.
1a77aa0be7f272611b965ee5b53b9366fa7b5e8f.text: 咒语。利用最近的尸体来获得 50…234…280 生命值。

33799e6ff6b478f97ac2f75963a504bd27582859.source: Spell. This attack deals 10…46…55 Holy Unlike other descriptions with "holy damage" in it, "holy" is capitalized here damage. If attacking, your target takes an additional 10…30…35 Holy damage.
33799e6ff6b478f97ac2f75963a504bd27582859.text: 咒文。这次攻击造成 10…46…55 点神圣伤害 与其他带有“神圣伤害”的描述不同，“神圣”在这里是大写的伤害。如果进行攻击，你的目标会受到额外 10…30…35 点神圣伤害。

d88f5e0627e518632d03d9c0f760a06c3bb8793a.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, reduce overcast at a rate of 1…2…2 per second. You and all adjacent foes are afflicted with burning while this enchantment is active.
d88f5e0627e518632d03d9c0f760a06c3bb8793a.text: 结界咒语。当你保持此结界时，以每秒 1…2…2 的速度减少阴暗。当此结界激活时，你和所有邻近的敌人都会受到燃烧的折磨。

1ba6d2c79e8fc90bd9d1c1aa7b9b10f95fbc97cf.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, you steal up to 16…67…80 Health from that foe.
1ba6d2c79e8fc90bd9d1c1aa7b9b10f95fbc97cf.text: 精英六角咒语。在 10 秒内，每当目标敌人施展法术时，你会从该敌人身上窃取最多 16…67…80 点生命值。

6a1c055d66bf4a52714d43a75ef97662d3d3587c.source: Spell. Remove one condition from target ally. If a condition was removed, foes in the area take 10…50…60 holy damage.
6a1c055d66bf4a52714d43a75ef97662d3d3587c.text: 咒文。移除目标盟友的一项条件。如果某个条件被移除，该区域内的敌人会受到 10…50…60 点神圣伤害。

e70aeae63b3f32a1a624940ff607766f26a3c814.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3…25…30 seconds, your attacks sacrifice 15…19…20 health and deal 15…19…20 more damage. PvE Skill
e70aeae63b3f32a1a624940ff607766f26a3c814.text: 精英结界法术。在 3…25…30 秒内，你的攻击牺牲 15…19…20 点生命值并造成 15…19…20 点额外伤害。 PvE技能

ec6ee1e4df92b020878ace5407c18ea3e585b7a3.source: Elite Skill. For 5…37…45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge instantly. Soul Twisting ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.
ec6ee1e4df92b020878ace5407c18ea3e585b7a3.text: 精英技能。在 5…37…45 秒内，你的束缚仪式会减少 15 能量（最少 5）并立即充能。灵魂扭曲在1…3…3次束缚仪式后结束。

7112baa9a47fe3a9ef4f1dfedb9fed235ec8d901.source: Elite Skill. For 5…37…45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25…45…50% faster. Soul Twisting ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.
7112baa9a47fe3a9ef4f1dfedb9fed235ec8d901.text: 精英技能。在 5…37…45 秒内，你的绑定仪式消耗的能量减少 15 点（最少 5），充能速度加快 25…45…50% 点。灵魂扭曲在1…3…3次束缚仪式后结束。

6ed0a0f31ef247c065683b49d5f4a54145df9cb6.source: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed, foes in the area suffer 10…70…85 holy damage.
6ed0a0f31ef247c065683b49d5f4a54145df9cb6.text: 咒文。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。如果移除了六角形，该区域内的敌人会受到 10…70…85 点神圣伤害。

d1fe58a3a45d8760226b932cc7279075a1eba0b0.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your Smiting Prayers have double the Divine Favor bonus.
d1fe58a3a45d8760226b932cc7279075a1eba0b0.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，你的重击祈祷拥有双倍的神圣恩惠加值。

2d3d73a25c91403b888817eb502a42107eaca13a.source: Enchantment Spell. For 4 seconds, your Smiting Prayers have double the Divine Favor bonus.
2d3d73a25c91403b888817eb502a42107eaca13a.text: 结界咒语。在 4 秒内，你的重击祈祷拥有双倍的神圣恩惠加值。

c7d5cf1240b4e8c02381bd285c95e226eac908ac.source: Stance. For 8 seconds, the next time you are struck, you take half damage and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 2…5…6 seconds.
c7d5cf1240b4e8c02381bd285c95e226eac908ac.text: 立场。在 8 秒内，下次你被击中时，你会受到一半伤害，并且所有相邻敌人都会被致盲 2…5…6 秒。

100a05a43f5556f1184d5b0280c6fe012f0d3611.source: Elite Trap. When Smoke Trap is triggered, nearby foes are Blinded and Dazed for 5…9…10 seconds. Smoke Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
100a05a43f5556f1184d5b0280c6fe012f0d3611.text: 精英陷阱。当烟雾陷阱被触发时，附近的敌人会被致盲和眩晕 5…9…10 秒。烟雾陷阱在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

53219293b891a8fd4201d742ec8481acfd3fb3ec.source: Spear Attack. This attack deals +30…40 damage. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you gain 3…6 strikes of adrenaline.
53219293b891a8fd4201d742ec8481acfd3fb3ec.text: 长矛攻击。该攻击造成 +30…40 伤害。如果此攻击击中患有某种病症的敌人，您将获得 3…6 次肾上腺素攻击。

fddf60be511c1bb2c63b13ba9fc4c56aaa8fa2b2.source: Spell. Spear of Light flies toward target foe and deals 26…50…56 holy damage if it hits. Spear of Light deals +15…51…60 damage if it hits an attacking foe.
fddf60be511c1bb2c63b13ba9fc4c56aaa8fa2b2.text: 咒语。光之矛飞向目标敌人，击中时造成 26…50…56 点神圣伤害。光之矛击中攻击敌人时会造成 +15…51…60 点伤害。

494916db5b22f03d571feadb57a4f8dadcec002f.source: Spell. Target touched allied spirit is destroyed. All nearby allies are healed for 30…198…240.
494916db5b22f03d571feadb57a4f8dadcec002f.text: 咒语。触及的目标友军精魂被摧毁。附近所有盟友的治疗量为 30…198…240。

5cbbd297298d132f5765f6895e57f825a5434382.source: Spear Attack. Strikes all foes between you and your target. If this attack hits, it deals +10…18…20 lightning damage. This attack has 25% armor penetration.
5cbbd297298d132f5765f6895e57f825a5434382.text: 长矛攻击。攻击你和目标之间的所有敌人。如果这次攻击击中，则会造成 +10…18…20 闪电伤害。该攻击有 25% 的护甲穿透。

c601e1a8d618eec4f2ad90782dd902a6032e1c00.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.
c601e1a8d618eec4f2ad90782dd902a6032e1c00.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果它没有击中，你就会失去一个条件。

8f4108bfbb06b0d300239631406dd7337c629381.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage and target foe is Dazed for 4…9…10 seconds. This attack has melee range.
8f4108bfbb06b0d300239631406dd7337c629381.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击击中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害，并且目标敌人陷入眩晕状态 4…9…10 秒。此攻击具有近战范围。

32d1c4e4e6008aa420eb8f8f1f4fd1017f357e28.source: Spell. The spirit nearest you loses 5…41…50 Health. Target ally is healed for 5 for each point of Health lost.
32d1c4e4e6008aa420eb8f8f1f4fd1017f357e28.text: 咒文。最近的灵魂失去 5…41…50 点生命值。每失去一点生命值，目标盟友就会得到 5 点治疗。

bcf1b5e6adf14acee9b7cb6a6fa9f000ff7d3a98.source: Spell. Shadow Step to target spirit.

00f5859a161c95f536d0d339033ecd16b17d128a.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, all allies near that creature gain 5…41…50 Health and lose 1 condition.
00f5859a161c95f536d0d339033ecd16b17d128a.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，每当你创造一个生物时，该生物附近的所有盟友都会获得 5…41…50 点生命值并失去 1 点状态。

0f5084e7f7022ca6a2dcb70bdf86822fc79b4359.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15…51…60 seconds, your attacks deal 5…29…35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.
0f5084e7f7022ca6a2dcb70bdf86822fc79b4359.text: 精英结界法术。在 15…51…60 秒内，你的攻击在武器法术效果下造成的伤害增加 5…29…35 点。

efa572b56c5df41c1b7fde5c9ff00cd3e77e49b5.source: Skill. For 5…17…20 seconds, all of your spirits within earshot deal 5…17…20 less damage and steal 5…17…20 Health when they attack.
efa572b56c5df41c1b7fde5c9ff00cd3e77e49b5.text: 技能。在 5…17…20 秒内，你所有听力范围内的灵魂在攻击时造成的伤害减少 5…17…20 点，并窃取 5…17…20 点生命值。

412be773eb8f1462215f70f442f54c50c3a022ed.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…15…17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.
412be773eb8f1462215f70f442f54c50c3a022ed.text: 精英结界法术。在 5…15…17 秒内，目标盟友不能成为敌方法术的目标。

05a97e5798f6fefb61e415a05537e7c461992507.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, while you are casting spells, foes cannot target you with spells. When Spell Shield ends, all your skills are disabled for 8…5…4 seconds.
05a97e5798f6fefb61e415a05537e7c461992507.text: 结界咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，当你施展法术时，敌人无法用法术瞄准你。当法术护盾结束时，你的所有技能将被禁用8…5…4秒。

32c6a06e075d8d9500ceae34680903086c4d23eb.source: Elite Trap. When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3…21…25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
32c6a06e075d8d9500ceae34680903086c4d23eb.text: 精英陷阱。当尖刺陷阱被触发时，每秒（持续 2 秒），所有附近的敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点穿刺伤害，瘫痪 3…21…25 秒，并被击倒。尖刺陷阱在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

46b0d4ac3004a0ba83d94cb4f86cf4588cb93d82.source: Hex Spell. For 10…34…40 seconds, whenever target foe is struck for cold damage while using a skill, that foe is interrupted, and you lose 8…4…3 Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.
46b0d4ac3004a0ba83d94cb4f86cf4588cb93d82.text: 降咒魔法。在 10…34…40 秒内，每当目标敌人在使用技能时受到寒冷伤害时，该敌人就会被打断，并且你会损失 8…4…3 点能量或脊椎颤抖结束。

b0bd0b49a881c40d5277496b80c9b345deb0440d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health.
b0bd0b49a881c40d5277496b80c9b345deb0440d.text: 结界咒语。在 8 秒内，每当目标盟友在接下来的 10 次攻击或法术中受到超过 50 点伤害时，该盟友就会获得 30…78…90 点生命值治疗。

e874d9cddcbcff84762c17cb8ba67a7e3986b8d0.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20…56…65 lightning damage, and all spirits you control within earshot gain 20…56…65 Health.
e874d9cddcbcff84762c17cb8ba67a7e3986b8d0.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 20…56…65 点闪电伤害，并且在听力范围内由你控制的所有灵魂获得 20…56…65 点生命值。

ae3973ed5084e09e84b56b5ccbc75b38a9a5af8c.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5…41…50 lightning damage. If any spirits are within earshot, Spirit Burn causes Burning for 1…4…5 seconds.
ae3973ed5084e09e84b56b5ccbc75b38a9a5af8c.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 5…41…50 点闪电伤害。如果听力范围内有任何灵魂，灵魂燃烧会导致燃烧 1…4…5 秒。

23b9f69005a98471807b6461a0295e9d8252f8c0.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 12 seconds, you have +1…5…6 Energy regeneration. When you cast this spell, you gain 3…10…12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.
23b9f69005a98471807b6461a0295e9d8252f8c0.text: 精英结界法术。 12 秒，你有 +1…5…6 能量再生。当你施放此法术时，如果你在灵魂的听力范围内，你将获得 3…10…12 点能量。

a76c4a514a46e409e0bd120e747bf53ef45512be.source: Spell. Target ally is healed for 60…156…180. If any spirits are within earshot, you don't sacrifice Health.
a76c4a514a46e409e0bd120e747bf53ef45512be.text: 咒语。目标盟友的治疗量为 60…156…180。如果有任何灵魂在听力范围内，你不会牺牲生命值。

e1d6ff19462084afe5d52f19f927f99d7d9bc91e.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains 5…21…25 Health per second and an additional 5…21…25 Health per second if that ally is within earshot of a spirit.
e1d6ff19462084afe5d52f19f927f99d7d9bc91e.text: 精英武器法术。在 10 秒内，目标盟友每秒获得 5…21…25 点生命值，如果目标盟友位于精魂的听力范围内，则每秒额外获得 5…21…25 点生命值。

26ee57c967d133fff0857fbb8e985093df26840f.source: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks. You gain 1…3…3 Energy whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.
26ee57c967d133fff0857fbb8e985093df26840f.text: 降咒魔法。在 30 秒内，目标敌人有 25% 次攻击失败的机会。每当敌人在战斗中未能击中时，你就会获得 1…3…3 点能量。

d6330c34a8cac249c81fe44ff8bd4c0ecec23ff0.source: Spell. Open a Spirit Rift at target foe's location. After 3 seconds, all adjacent foes are struck for 25…105…125 lightning damage and suffer from Cracked Armor for 1…16…20 seconds.
d6330c34a8cac249c81fe44ff8bd4c0ecec23ff0.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置打开灵魂裂缝。 3秒后，所有相邻敌人受到25…105…125点闪电伤害，并遭受装甲破裂1…16…20秒。

3a8e464179429d136f78254e05fc2e80d19b4dee.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe loses 5 Energy whenever that foe attacks.
3a8e464179429d136f78254e05fc2e80d19b4dee.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人每次攻击都会损失 5 点能量。

ec5f6a0a6d82679834c61b7a5c61a74d3caff9d5.source: Spell. The spirit nearest you loses all Energy. You gain 30…54…60% of that Energy.
ec5f6a0a6d82679834c61b7a5c61a74d3caff9d5.text: 咒语。最靠近你的灵魂失去了所有能量。您获得 30…54…60% 的能量。

2e7cf2764a2e8d8b28dc80ef714238ae350553af.source: Spell. Target foe takes 15…63…75 damage. All hostile summoned creatures in the area of that foe take 25…105…125 damage.
2e7cf2764a2e8d8b28dc80ef714238ae350553af.text: 咒文。目标敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害。该敌人区域内的所有敌对召唤生物都会受到 25…105…125 点伤害。

5d1d3820eb5d7c75fc1600dd1599712aee027382.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…8…10 seconds, spells cast by the target foe and all adjacent foes take 100% longer to cast. Spells targeting these foes that are cast by you or your allies take 50% less time to cast.
5d1d3820eb5d7c75fc1600dd1599712aee027382.text: 精英六角咒语。在 1…8…10 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人施放的法术需要花费 100% 的时间来施放。由你或你的盟友施放的针对这些敌人的法术需要花费 50% 的施法时间。

66fc27742199703ac23f365e07d751ee15f5ec3b.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…8…10 seconds, spells cast by the target foe and all adjacent foes take 100% longer to cast. Spells you cast that target these foes take 50% less time to cast.
66fc27742199703ac23f365e07d751ee15f5ec3b.text: 精英六角咒语。在 1…8…10 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人施放的法术需要花费 100% 的时间来施放。你针对这些敌人施展的法术需要花费 50% 的施法时间。

923e4b41049527640b5df18fa18c07b663aadc1f.source: Spell. Send out two Stone Daggers. Each Stone Dagger strikes target foe for 8…28…33 earth damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, each projectile inflicts Bleeding for 1…4…5 seconds.
923e4b41049527640b5df18fa18c07b663aadc1f.text: 咒语。发出两把石匕。每把石匕首击中目标敌人时都会造成 8…28…33 点土属性伤害。如果你是阴天，每个射弹都会造成流血 1…4…5 秒。

d7a475414eca60084796fad53aacec4be3099e1f.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, you and target ally have +1…24…30 armor and are immune to critical hits. When you cast this spell, all foes near you and your target take 15…59…70 earth damage and are Weakened for 5…17…20 seconds.
d7a475414eca60084796fad53aacec4be3099e1f.text: 精英结界法术。在 5…17…20 秒内，你和目标盟友拥有 +1…24…30 点护甲并且免疫重击。当你施放此法术时，你和你的目标附近的所有敌人都会受到 15…59…70 点土系伤害，并被削弱 5…17…20 秒。

432900712fe2d2c0e8d51156c89c37d3899b094a.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…25…30 seconds, whenever you take or deal elemental or physical damage, that damage is converted to earth damage.
432900712fe2d2c0e8d51156c89c37d3899b094a.text: 结界咒语。在 5…25…30 秒内，每当你受到或造成元素或物理伤害时，该伤害都会转换为土属性伤害。

a1a5f8a2bed635c3b563bf9271786063f87a63a6.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, damage you receive is reduced by 1…25…31, and you are immune to critical attacks.
a1a5f8a2bed635c3b563bf9271786063f87a63a6.text: 结界咒语。在 5…13…15 秒内，你受到的伤害减少 1…25…31，并且你免疫致命攻击。

d37dc93d95cc79fe4c6acca364bad20a14b680b3.source: Spell. Target foe takes 5…33…40 damage. All hostile summoned creatures in the area of that foe take 25…105…125 damage.
d37dc93d95cc79fe4c6acca364bad20a14b680b3.text: 咒文。目标敌人受到 5…33…40 点伤害。该敌人区域内的所有敌对召唤生物都会受到 25…105…125 点伤害。

b474ab24416f49821b34e5984c220d9deef83613.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10…22…25 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or uses a skill, Spiteful Spirit deals 15…39…45 shadow damage to that foe and all adjacent allies of that foe.
b474ab24416f49821b34e5984c220d9deef83613.text: 精英六角咒语。 10…22…25秒内，每当目标敌人攻击或使用技能时，恶毒之灵对该敌人及其所有相邻盟友造成15…39…45点暗影伤害。

dfb732e6eec1028fc26b0e3aab730a8d84548550.source: Bow Attack. If Splinter Shot hits, you deal +3…13…15 damage. If Splinter Shot is blocked, all foes in the area to your target take 5…53…65 damage.
dfb732e6eec1028fc26b0e3aab730a8d84548550.text: 弓攻击。如果碎片射击击中，你会造成 +3…13…15 点伤害。如果碎片射击被格挡，目标区域内的所有敌人都会受到 5…53…65 点伤害。

bc9abb648741eb007166442ce633382c45058586.source: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1…4…5 attacks deal 5…41…50 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
bc9abb648741eb007166442ce633382c45058586.text: 武器咒语。 20 秒内，目标盟友拥有碎片武器。目标盟友接下来的 1…4…5 次攻击会对最多 4 个相邻敌人造成 5…41…50 点伤害。

aa93e77b6fd96af1b9813845d1f4ca4d8305ffde.source: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1…4…5 attacks deal 5…33…40 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
aa93e77b6fd96af1b9813845d1f4ca4d8305ffde.text: 武器咒语。 20 秒内，目标盟友拥有碎片武器。目标盟友接下来的 1…4…5 次攻击会对最多 4 个相邻敌人造成 5…33…40 点伤害。
