33e18d244ee1a6973ce7a352442f823c90559e7f.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or casts a spell on a creature with less Health, that foe loses 25…85…100 Health.
33e18d244ee1a6973ce7a352442f823c90559e7f.text: 精英六角咒语。在 3…13…15 秒内，每当目标敌人攻击或对生命值较低的生物施展法术时，该敌人就会损失 25…85…100 点生命值。

a10786af54aec26332ccf65ee4a8f10661df746d.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or casts a spell on a creature with less Health that foe loses 15…63…75 Health.
a10786af54aec26332ccf65ee4a8f10661df746d.text: 精英六角咒语。在 3…13…15 秒内，每当目标敌人攻击或对生命值较低的生物施展法术时，敌人就会损失 15…63…75 点生命值。

9cc4b734c3e52ae1d90acf2a7ec39a1d3238eee9.source: Enchantment Spell. For 1…12…15 seconds, target other ally loses a hex every 5 seconds.
9cc4b734c3e52ae1d90acf2a7ec39a1d3238eee9.text: 结界咒语。在 1…12…15 秒内，目标其他盟友每 5 秒失去一个降咒。

4e33be6fd0d65583f9ab4a5f7877ca2f5065790c.source: Enchantment Spell. For 1…12…15 seconds, target other ally loses a condition every 3 seconds.
4e33be6fd0d65583f9ab4a5f7877ca2f5065790c.text: 结界咒语。在 1…12…15 秒内，目标其他盟友每 3 秒失去一个状态。

1072dc3b1fbba4ec3f08cc3a275656bf189deaf1.source: Stance. For 8…13…14 seconds, you move 25% faster.
1072dc3b1fbba4ec3f08cc3a275656bf189deaf1.text: 立场。在 8…13…14 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。

9bcbd4211da61c334295387323b8a951da9e4bf8.source: Spell. Send out a large stone, striking target foe for 45…93…105 earth damage if it hits. If Stoning hits a foe suffering from Weakness, that foe is knocked down.
9bcbd4211da61c334295387323b8a951da9e4bf8.text: 咒文。发射一块大石头，攻击目标敌人，如果击中，将造成 45…93…105 点土属性伤害。如果石刑击中了虚弱的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

e34fead4ec2a4eee31668ad2bdee73f7b4727295.source: Stance. For 8…18…20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and you gain 1…4…5 Energy whenever you take elemental damage.
e34fead4ec2a4eee31668ad2bdee73f7b4727295.text: 立场。在 8…18…20 秒内，你的移动速度加快 25%，每当你受到元素伤害时，你就会获得 1…4…5 点能量。

bca354560029cc9920e5258b3623cbc70932688e.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…22…25 seconds, you move 25% faster. Each second that you are moving, you lose 1 Energy.
bca354560029cc9920e5258b3623cbc70932688e.text: 结界咒语。在 10…22…25 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。你每移动一秒，就会损失 1 能量。

0e78868df91adbb6a98913d51097e50a4ed1e826.source: Stance. For 10 seconds, you move 25% faster. This stance is refreshed whenever you take Elemental damage.
0e78868df91adbb6a98913d51097e50a4ed1e826.text: 立场。在 10 秒内，您移动速度加快 25%。每当你受到元素伤害时，这个姿势就会刷新。

3d3e30a035c5250ef5ee698c39f936a03f72dd8e.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 5…21…25 more damage in melee.
3d3e30a035c5250ef5ee698c39f936a03f72dd8e.text: 结界咒语。当你保持此结界时，目标盟友在近战中造成 5…21…25 点额外伤害。

ae1891a55286256ff0b2cd8ca430838d195bcc03.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 1…4…5 more damage in melee.
ae1891a55286256ff0b2cd8ca430838d195bcc03.text: 结界咒语。当你保持此结界时，目标盟友在近战中造成 1…4…5 点额外伤害。

cd07bd081a9dbbc287323cbde054c5c7e37d4381.source: Hammer Attack. If this hammer blow hits, your target will suffer from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
cd07bd081a9dbbc287323cbde054c5c7e37d4381.text: 锤子攻击。如果此锤击中，你的目标将遭受虚弱 5…17…20 秒。

0e24b9efbdb450142844a035f65dc36596958b0d.source: Elite Shout. Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and causes Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, target foe is Crippled for 5…13…15 seconds.
0e24b9efbdb450142844a035f65dc36596958b0d.text: 精英呐喊。你的动物伙伴立即移动到你的目标并在下次攻击时造成流血 5…13…15 秒。下次你攻击时，目标敌人会瘫痪 5…13…15 秒。

b2f94cf6da249c27296cc7d537340e2a3337a3ef.source: Spell. Remove 0…2…2 enchantments from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you steal 5…53…65 Health.
b2f94cf6da249c27296cc7d537340e2a3337a3ef.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人 0…2…2 个结界。如果结界被移除，你会窃取 5…53…65 点生命值。

4203243c33fe9bcd7ce1b3dc6a4d062580dc9ef8.source: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…42…50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4…9…10 seconds.
4203243c33fe9bcd7ce1b3dc6a4d062580dc9ef8.text: 精英长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +10…42…50 点伤害。如果它击中患有某种病症的敌人，该敌人也会晕眩 4…9…10 秒。

9ffb733da9e20a03ab9e55b8b6551925d451d11f.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this Enchantment, target other ally gains +1 Health and +1 Energy regeneration, but you lose 1 Energy each time that ally casts a Spell.
9ffb733da9e20a03ab9e55b8b6551925d451d11f.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，目标其他盟友获得 +1 点生命值和 +1 点能量再生，但每次该盟友施展法术时，你会损失 1 点能量。

75fd96c407c1e7a9bbd9fe570453492256f0cd4e.source: Hex Spell. For 6…25…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -0…2…3 Health degeneration.
75fd96c407c1e7a9bbd9fe570453492256f0cd4e.text: 降咒魔法。在 6…25…30 秒内，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人遭受 -0…2…3 点生命值退化。

510cae4e361df2c6edab5ff5a1378f1a647b8772.source: Hex Spell. For 4…10…12 seconds, target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.
510cae4e361df2c6edab5ff5a1378f1a647b8772.text: 降咒魔法。在 4…10…12 秒内，目标敌人的移动、攻击和施法速度减慢 33%。

1e7297038a86107ff53bd6e3004da556f0bbe14e.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ice Imp that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
1e7297038a86107ff53bd6e3004da556f0bbe14e.text: 咒语。召唤一个等级为 14…20 的冰小恶魔，其寿命为 40…60 秒并拥有冰刺。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

ff27dcb89a2019c2cd3b5f74ab99d7de8e49869b.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Mursaat that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
ff27dcb89a2019c2cd3b5f74ab99d7de8e49869b.text: 咒语。召唤一只等级为 14…20 的穆萨特，其寿命为 40…60 秒，并具有精力充沛。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

a43b3292412fc5f263059d99bd4f70dcb3a1b6ef.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Naga Shaman that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
a43b3292412fc5f263059d99bd4f70dcb3a1b6ef.text: 咒语。召唤一个等级为 14…20 的纳迦萨满，寿命为 40…60 秒，并具有石击能力。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

b80f2793f8566228b4a0e9743f49f5d2fc0c1195.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ruby Djinn that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
b80f2793f8566228b4a0e9743f49f5d2fc0c1195.text: 咒语。召唤一个等级为 14…20 的红宝石巨灵，其寿命为 40…60 秒并具有献祭能力。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

b1073d0bbb2cb4b894f3193699ce852654e4f263.source: Spell. All spirits you control Shadow Step to your location, and gain 60…100 Health.
b1073d0bbb2cb4b894f3193699ce852654e4f263.text: 咒语。所有你控制的灵魂暗影步到达你的位置，并获得 60…100 点生命值。

845afeea03751bc70b86b0c1018a96e3fef6217c.source: Sword Attack. Attack target foe twice. These attacks cannot be blocked.
845afeea03751bc70b86b0c1018a96e3fef6217c.text: 剑攻击。攻击目标敌人两次。这些攻击无法被阻止。

8d7d2702fc70f67a8e3b2bb1f7d0a457176726b8.source: Bow Attack. If Sundering Attack hits, you strike for +5…21…25 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
8d7d2702fc70f67a8e3b2bb1f7d0a457176726b8.text: 弓攻击。如果破甲攻击命中，你将受到 +5…21…25 点伤害，并且该攻击具有 10% 点护甲穿透。

0c455b44e84565847f8f6453aa1f481d1257771a.source: Bow Attack. If Sundering Attack hits, you strike for +5…13…15 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
0c455b44e84565847f8f6453aa1f481d1257771a.text: 弓攻击。如果破甲攻击命中，你将受到 +5…13…15 点伤害，并且该攻击具有 10% 点护甲穿透。

3f0813630d285d8b9e0f7428203e761d39f377b3.source: Weapon Spell. For 4…9…10 seconds, target ally's next 3 attacks have 10% armor penetration and cause Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds.
3f0813630d285d8b9e0f7428203e761d39f377b3.text: 武器咒语。 4…9…10秒内，目标友军接下来的3次攻击有10%点护甲穿透，并造成护甲破裂，持续5…17…20秒。

469450cfb08be51e05e7cb80e2cebb06c0c30055.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…19…23 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage while knocked down, that ally is healed for 5…41…50 Health.
469450cfb08be51e05e7cb80e2cebb06c0c30055.text: 结界咒语。在 5…19…23 秒内，每当目标盟友在被击倒时受到伤害，该盟友就会获得 5…41…50 点生命值治疗。

7708ff034b98244cd8f7abc84f5f9616f66c834e.source: Spell. You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's location.
7708ff034b98244cd8f7abc84f5f9616f66c834e.text: 咒语。你和目标召唤生物暗影步到达对方的位置。

3cee68f9473f724004d98c2765aa0d3c2c263e9d.source: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +1…16…20 damage. If Swift Chop is blocked, target foe takes 1…16…20 damage and suffers a Deep Wound for 20 seconds.
3cee68f9473f724004d98c2765aa0d3c2c263e9d.text: 斧头攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果迅猛斩被格挡，目标敌人会受到 1…16…20 点伤害并受到深度伤害，持续 20 秒。

96be85e9fb568fb380af42929049838b0d7dd1ad.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If you are under the effects of an enchantment, this spear flies twice as fast and cannot be blocked.
96be85e9fb568fb380af42929049838b0d7dd1ad.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果你受到结界的影响，这支矛的飞行速度会加倍，并且无法被阻挡。

9df7e9969bb738c297f80f2cefb76b0892f5fb63.source: Enchantment Spell. For 3…6…7 seconds, you are enchanted with Swirling Aura and have 1…5…6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If you are Overcast when you cast this spell, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.
9df7e9969bb738c297f80f2cefb76b0892f5fb63.text: 结界咒语。持续 3…6…7 秒，你被漩涡光环迷住，并且有 1…5…6 点生命恢复和 50% 几率阻挡射弹。如果你在施展此法术时处于阴暗状态，则听力范围内的所有小队成员也会被附魔。

44716fd2d5e4c2da8b64639e4c459d42803752c5.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1…8…10 seconds.
44716fd2d5e4c2da8b64639e4c459d42803752c5.text: 闪光附魔咒语。附近的所有敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点土属性伤害。在 30 秒内，你的攻击会造成土属性伤害。当此结界结束时，附近所有敌人的护甲都会破裂，持续 1…8…10 秒。

639e2d5367b57e94b0cf58ed6cdafa7ed65f6496.source: Sword Attack. If it hits, Standing Slash deals +5…17…20 damage plus an additional 5…17…20 damage if you are in a stance.
639e2d5367b57e94b0cf58ed6cdafa7ed65f6496.text: 剑攻击。如果击中，立斩会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害，如果你处于姿态，还会额外造成 5…17…20 点伤害。

23e19afba391adc5038958570a965cfa6114e3f3.source: Elite Spell. Target touched foe and all foes in the area are struck for 7…91…112 fire damage and set on fire for 1…3…4 seconds. For each foe you hit, gain 2 Energy.
23e19afba391adc5038958570a965cfa6114e3f3.text: 精英法术。目标触及敌人，该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 7…91…112 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…3…4 秒。每击中一个敌人，就会获得 2 点能量。

9145db69be0592faf42c3e2357d04acf1a0493ce.source: Elite Stance. For 10 seconds, the next time you would be knocked down, you gain 1…3…4 strikes of adrenaline and 1…6…7 Energy instead.
9145db69be0592faf42c3e2357d04acf1a0493ce.text: 精英姿态。在 10 秒内，下次你被击倒时，你会获得 1…3…4 次肾上腺素打击和 1…6…7 点能量。

eb2d7302d6cce6924888293d6ac6e34a0015db5e.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20…52…60 cold damage. If target foe is on fire, Steam Blinds that foe for 5…9…10 seconds and they take an additional 20…52…60 fire damage.
eb2d7302d6cce6924888293d6ac6e34a0015db5e.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 20…52…60 点寒冷伤害。如果目标敌人着火，蒸汽会致盲该敌人 5…9…10 秒，并额外承受 20…52…60 点火焰伤害。

879a7d649a916cc6fee164a170e8f9071433918c.source: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +1…25…31 damage. If you hit a foe that is knocked down, you gain 1…4…5 adrenaline.
879a7d649a916cc6fee164a170e8f9071433918c.text: 剑攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +1…25…31 点伤害。如果你击中的敌人被击倒，你将获得 1…4…5 肾上腺素。

9eb811258606198b6f78cae1a2fc50be0b807a3f.source: Hex Spell. For 1…7…8 seconds, target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower. If that foe has Cracked Armor, the chill seeps through causing 5…8…9 Health degeneration.
9eb811258606198b6f78cae1a2fc50be0b807a3f.text: 降咒魔法。持续 1…7…8 秒，目标敌人的腿部被冰包裹，导致敌人移动速度减慢 66%。如果该敌人的护甲破裂，寒气会渗透进去，造成 5…8…9 点生命值退化。

7e6590244575480e6cb07e2c9ca07e4c0134e46c.source: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes take 10…34…40 cold damage. Burning foes struck by Teinai's Wind take an additional 40…72…80 damage and are interrupted.
7e6590244575480e6cb07e2c9ca07e4c0134e46c.text: 咒语。目标敌人和所有邻近敌人受到 10…34…40 点寒冷伤害。被手内之风击中的燃烧敌人会额外受到 40…72…80 点伤害并被打断。

a8b34ae88cffd1bdc6bfb2663b2f57bef904b449.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For each enchantment on a non-spirit creature within range, that creature has +27…125…150 maximum Health. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
a8b34ae88cffd1bdc6bfb2663b2f57bef904b449.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。对于范围内的非灵体生物的每个结界，该生物的最大生命值 +27…125…150。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

e3984ce90a5badfd9d14eda66aaf2516359ecfcd.source: Shout. For 120…264…300 seconds, your animal companion gains 1…3…3 Health regeneration, and half of all damage dealt to your animal companion is redirected to you.
e3984ce90a5badfd9d14eda66aaf2516359ecfcd.text: 喊叫。在 120…264…300 秒内，你的动物伙伴获得 1…3…3 点生命恢复，并且对你的动物伙伴造成的所有伤害的一半会转移到你身上。

bb31e5814452429b9b0f11676f60f1e0607cd7a2.source: Spell. Create a Symbol of Wrath at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, adjacent foes are struck for 10…34…40 holy damage each second.
bb31e5814452429b9b0f11676f60f1e0607cd7a2.text: 咒语。在目标敌人的位置创建一个愤怒符号。持续 5 秒，每秒对相邻敌人造成 10…34…40 点神圣伤害。

5f668d8df8f45a8f95c881650325ccfdc8929167.source: Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, all of your signets use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
5f668d8df8f45a8f95c881650325ccfdc8929167.text: 结界咒语。在 36…55…60 秒内，你的所有印章都使用你的快速施法属性而不是普通属性。

bdda6327815f67bfcc8bfede9a094a4ae07c280f.source: Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, the next signet you activate recharges 20…68…80% faster.
bdda6327815f67bfcc8bfede9a094a4ae07c280f.text: 立场。在 5…17…20 秒内，您激活的下一个印章充电速度会加快 20…68…80%。

058373db8f5c408c38c0f1a34a526b9de60414b5.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +12 damage for each signet you have equipped (maximum 70 damage).
058373db8f5c408c38c0f1a34a526b9de60414b5.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你装备的每个印章都会造成 +12 点伤害（最多 70 点伤害）。

642a79431bc65d62d043beaa63de284f8d3960dc.source: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Dazed and Blinded for 1…8…10 seconds, and if target foe is casting a spell, that foe is interrupted.
642a79431bc65d62d043beaa63de284f8d3960dc.text: 精英副手攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。如果这次攻击击中，目标敌人会陷入眩晕和失明状态，持续 1…8…10 秒，如果目标敌人正在施展法术，则该敌人会被打断。

6baf36ca1b9865c555f064f4b1d6a584a947717c.source: Spell. Deals 15…63…75 cold damage and takes 1 enchantment from target foe. If that foe was not enchanted, that foe is Dazed for 2…5…6 seconds.
6baf36ca1b9865c555f064f4b1d6a584a947717c.text: 咒语。造成 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害，并从目标敌人身上承受 1 点结界。如果该敌人没有被附魔，则该敌人会晕眩 2…5…6 秒。

40b63d5d7ed1cd398221534bedf7b069fa934fc8.source: Melee Attack. If this blow hits, you deal +20…36…40 damage. If you have more Health than target foe, you gain 1…2…2 strikes of adrenaline.
40b63d5d7ed1cd398221534bedf7b069fa934fc8.text: 近战攻击。如果这一击击中，你将造成 +20…36…40 点伤害。如果你的生命值高于目标敌人，你将获得 1…2…2 次肾上腺素打击。

25ce277190c64863f6bddfd895613fb0fd04d282.source: Skill. Target touched foe and foes adjacent to your target become Blinded for 3…13…15 seconds.
25ce277190c64863f6bddfd895613fb0fd04d282.text: 技能。目标所触及的敌人以及与目标相邻的敌人将被致盲 3…13…15 秒。

d6f0bf12af2424e51e3dc0ad616af93d66c51a5c.source: Elite Skill. For 6…33…40 seconds, this skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
d6f0bf12af2424e51e3dc0ad616af93d66c51a5c.text: 精英技能。持续6…33…40秒，该技能成为目标敌人的精英。您施放的精英技能使用您的快速施法属性而不是普通属性。

770269471c5041acddb19150ed7acb5fe22fbaa4.source: Elite Spell. Create a massive shockwave at target foe's location. Deals 10…42…50 lightning damage to target and all nearby foes. Struck foes are interrupted and suffer from Cracked Armor and Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
770269471c5041acddb19150ed7acb5fe22fbaa4.text: 精英法术。在目标敌人的位置产生巨大的冲击波。对目标和附近所有敌人造成 10…42…50 点闪电伤害。被击中的敌人会被打断，并遭受装甲破裂和虚弱的影响，持续 5…17…20 秒。该法术有25%的护甲穿透力。

d6cdca791811c6d06045ccb97c6713dda3adc038.source: Stance. For 4…9…10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. Tiger Stance ends if any of your attacks fail to hit.
d6cdca791811c6d06045ccb97c6713dda3adc038.text: 立场。在 4…9…10 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 33%。如果你的任何攻击未能命中，虎式就会结束。

c89e53c40e1eba5c47e8668b398bf1b6773c13be.source: Elite Ward Spell. You create a Time Ward at your location. For 6…17…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area cast spells 15…19…20% faster and recharge skills 15…19…20% faster. PvE Skill
c89e53c40e1eba5c47e8668b398bf1b6773c13be.text: 精英守卫法术。您在您所在的位置创建一个时间守卫。 6…17…20秒内，该区域的非精神盟友施法速度加快15…19…20%，技能恢复速度加快15…19…20%。 PvE技能

5ec2eec27df2e84d792a83e251e9fb6b807043a3.source: Skill. Target touched foe takes 20…50…58 shadow damage.
5ec2eec27df2e84d792a83e251e9fb6b807043a3.text: 技能。目标接触的敌人受到 20…50…58 点暗影伤害。

a9f6bbf5334b0aabcd6802bb0dab272ae8bdfb22.source: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…63…75 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, that foe becomes Poisoned for 10…22…25 seconds.
a9f6bbf5334b0aabcd6802bb0dab272ae8bdfb22.text: 精英法术。目标敌人受到 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害。如果该敌人受到妖术或结界的影响，则该敌人会中毒 10…22…25 秒。

2d35ecc0ffa15f7b87e9e4237745d8f29e681579.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20…39…44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3…13…15 seconds.
2d35ecc0ffa15f7b87e9e4237745d8f29e681579.text: 精英结界法术。在 20…39…44 秒内，该区域内的盟友对疾病免疫，任何在近战中攻击这些盟友的人都会陷入疾病状态，持续 3…13…15 秒。

823329687ffb28834e5a41fb08736c76dce25ff2.source: Spell. Steal up to 100…340…400 Health from target animated undead ally.
823329687ffb28834e5a41fb08736c76dce25ff2.text: 咒语。从目标动画不死盟友身上窃取最多 100…340…400 点生命值。

6c70b3313693e76c56c49c6b7d22788c16c81939.source: Spell. If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 30…126…150 Health.
6c70b3313693e76c56c49c6b7d22788c16c81939.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人的生命值低于 50% 点，你将获得 30…126…150 点生命值。

a8512cb14284bfa6a85c2facf8553a30dc036d05.source: Elite Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and other foes in the area are interrupted and you steal 0…4…5 Energy from all foes in the area.
a8512cb14284bfa6a85c2facf8553a30dc036d05.text: 精英法术。如果目标敌人正在使用技能，则该敌人和该区域中的其他敌人会被打断，并且您会从该区域中的所有敌人身上窃取 0…4…5 点能量。

f14a9b4093af4a3e2416cc9f328238cbcaf1b18f.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Poisoned or Diseased creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. This spirit dies after 30…150…180 seconds.
f14a9b4093af4a3e2416cc9f328238cbcaf1b18f.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。其范围内的中毒或患病生物会遭受 -2 生命值退化。该灵魂会在 30…150…180 秒后死亡。

bc9a583f8f929fd931940e1b9a2ad936c693e025.source: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30…40 damage. If target foe is not a boss, that foe and all adjacent foes are Dazed for 3…5 seconds.
bc9a583f8f929fd931940e1b9a2ad936c693e025.text: 咒文。目标敌人和所有邻近敌人都会受到 30…40 点伤害。如果目标敌人不是 Boss，则该敌人和所有相邻敌人会晕眩 3…5 秒。

02636d03d291e6dd5ad7a88c1b16828d9f143437.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If you a hit a Crippled foe, that foe is knocked down.
02636d03d291e6dd5ad7a88c1b16828d9f143437.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，你会造成 +5…17…20 伤害。如果你击中了残废的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

3716500f7bc43222507f4445fcd37864876ffb92.source: Spell. Target foe takes 20…36…40 damage. If target foe has a Water Magic hex, this spell strikes target and nearby foes for an additional 20…36…40 damage, and nearby foes also suffer Cracked Armor for 5…13…15 seconds.
3716500f7bc43222507f4445fcd37864876ffb92.text: 咒文。目标敌人受到 20…36…40 点伤害。如果目标敌人拥有水魔法六角形，该法术会对目标和附近的敌人造成额外 20…36…40 点伤害，并且附近的敌人还会遭受护甲破裂，持续 5…13…15 秒。

9cc99676d8866739e979d32e89cfa00932fc5c9c.source: Ward Spell. Place a ward of Teinai's Heat at your location for 10…14…15 seconds. Foes within the ward suffer 2…4…5 health Unlike most other descriptions "Health" is lowercase here degeneration. Weakened foes attack 33% slower. This skill is disabled for 20 seconds.
9cc99676d8866739e979d32e89cfa00932fc5c9c.text: 守卫咒语。在你的位置放置一个手内热力结界，持续 10…14…15 秒。病房内的敌人承受 2…4…5 生命值 与大多数其他描述不同，“健康”在这里是小写的退化。被削弱的敌人攻击速度 33% 变慢。该技能失效20秒。

bbffc5269352d0c549e19461072aafed1250640d.source: Signet. For 14…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23…40% slower.
bbffc5269352d0c549e19461072aafed1250640d.text: 印章。在 14…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有邻近敌人的移动和攻击速度减慢 23…40%。

c8e595dcd768769c8ffbe6cf40236b5757ef645c.source: Melee Attack. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment and gain 10…42…50 Health. If an enchantment is lost in this way, you cannot be blocked, you strike twice, and you gain an additional 10…58…70 Health.
c8e595dcd768769c8ffbe6cf40236b5757ef645c.text: 近战攻击。你失去 1 苦行僧结界并获得 10…42…50 点生命值。如果以这种方式失去结界，你不会被阻挡，你会攻击两次，并且你会额外获得 10…58…70 点生命值。

682b44fbadaaa47227e21a2f8e4b859dd0ff9d23.source: Melee Attack. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment and gain 10…18…20 Health. If an enchantment is lost in this way, you cannot be blocked, you strike twice, with each strike doing 25% less damage than normal, and you gain an additional 10…26…30 Health.
682b44fbadaaa47227e21a2f8e4b859dd0ff9d23.text: 近战攻击。你失去 1 苦行僧结界并获得 10…18…20 点生命值。如果结界以这种方式丢失，你将无法被阻挡，你会进行两次攻击，每次攻击造成的伤害比正常情况下少 25% 点，并且你会额外获得 10…26…30 点生命值。

1d500b63f78369d73082e53a5ff36e7395224b67.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Twisting Fangs strikes for +10…18…20 damage and struck foe suffers from Bleeding and Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
1d500b63f78369d73082e53a5ff36e7395224b67.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果击中，扭曲尖牙会造成 +10…18…20 点伤害，并使被击中的敌人受到流血和深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

adbe5077c5ef99c73d8b6f39d224ea23cc8526dc.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Tanasen's ashes for up to 5…17…20 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you have +10…22…25 armor and cannot be interrupted.
adbe5077c5ef99c73d8b6f39d224ea23cc8526dc.text: 精英物品法术。保留塔纳森的骨灰最多 5…17…20 秒。当你持有他的骨灰时，你的护甲值+10…22…25并且不会被打断。

ba1d1d05a4ac66f6e3987c8b307af14ec98e599c.source: Hex Spell. For 10…26…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer from -4 Health degeneration when Bleeding, and whenever they use a shout or chant, they Bleed for 5…17…20 seconds.
ba1d1d05a4ac66f6e3987c8b307af14ec98e599c.text: 降咒魔法。在 10…26…30 秒内，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人在流血时会遭受 -4 生命值退化，每当他们使用喊叫或圣歌时，他们就会流血 5…17…20 秒。

f550e6d97fc3ec222349898d0387e1dc71a5c829.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…34…40 damage. This attack cannot be blocked.
f550e6d97fc3ec222349898d0387e1dc71a5c829.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。此攻击无法被阻止。

a820198055e2019ee89102ab8377c01178fde896.source: Spell. Steal up to 10…54…65 Health from up to 1…3…4 foes incorrectly displays "1 foes" with Blood Magic rank 2 or below in the area.
a820198055e2019ee89102ab8377c01178fde896.text: 咒语。从最多 1…3…4 个敌人身上窃取最多 10…54…65 点生命值错误地显示该区域内血魔法等级为 2 或以下的“1 个敌人”。

73dd620006f1d71a8869d8bf765cd841ae8b9b0e.source: Spell. Steal up to 10…54…65 Health from up to 1…3…4 foes in the area.
73dd620006f1d71a8869d8bf765cd841ae8b9b0e.text: 咒语。从该地区多达 1…3…4 名敌人身上窃取多达 10…54…65 点生命值。

991f3badfa9dca1feae9898491ca20063d98c6ff.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 20…44…50% faster. This spirit dies after 15…99…120 seconds.
991f3badfa9dca1feae9898491ca20063d98c6ff.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。非灵体生物在其范围内施展的结界失效速度加快 20…44…50%。该灵魂会在 15…99…120 秒后死亡。

93602b4df42b1bdb0492f8452cdb598c434601b4.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit ally in its range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
93602b4df42b1bdb0492f8452cdb598c434601b4.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…10…12级武魂。每当其范围内的非精神盟友受到伤害或生命偷取时，其伤害就会减少 15 点，精神也会受到 15 点伤害。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

8e4aeabc3f970e3bb63a90e1d9ae92f83895bd58.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 10…26…30% faster. This spirit dies after 15…99…120 seconds.
8e4aeabc3f970e3bb63a90e1d9ae92f83895bd58.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。非灵体生物在其范围内施展的结界失效速度加快 10…26…30%。该灵魂会在 15…99…120 秒后死亡。

d541c3da503a211d4f7e68f5c0ec990d0729609d.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit ally in its range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
d541c3da503a211d4f7e68f5c0ec990d0729609d.text: 缚灵仪式。创造1…7…8级武魂。每当其范围内的非精神盟友受到伤害或生命偷取时，其伤害就会减少 15 点，精神也会受到 15 点伤害。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

1cdc0c1dab8a168927a4c2c74cc24cdd63bc953c.source: Elite Preparation. For 12…31…36 seconds, your trap skills are not easily interruptible and your Wilderness Survival attribute is increased by +0…3…4.
1cdc0c1dab8a168927a4c2c74cc24cdd63bc953c.text: 精英准备。持续12…31…36秒，你的陷阱技能不易被打断，并且你的荒野生存属性增加+0…3…4。

0c01ccb4e1271aacad99a2a3b4e7fcd38030fa3d.source: Stance. For 5…25…30 seconds, your Traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. This Stance ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
0c01ccb4e1271aacad99a2a3b4e7fcd38030fa3d.text: 立场。在 5…25…30 秒内，你的陷阱充电速度加快 25%，激活速度加快 25%。如果你成功攻击，此姿势就会结束。

9aef0b950d512cb2d08d02d080651d8f5e892cf9.source: Elite Axe Attack. Attack target foe and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +10…34…40 damage.
9aef0b950d512cb2d08d02d080651d8f5e892cf9.text: 精英斧头攻击。攻击目标敌人和邻近的敌人。每次攻击造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。

9cc5ee784c62c8ed8ebb1929fcecb12bf3658cbc.source: Bow Attack. Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40…25% less damage.
9cc5ee784c62c8ed8ebb1929fcecb12bf3658cbc.text: 弓攻击。同时向目标敌人发射 3 支箭。这些箭造成的伤害减少 40…25%。

5f8e152c9ca8839314d3e8ead3fb89a63ba8ea65.source: Trap. When Tripwire is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5…17…20 piercing damage. Any Crippled foes are knocked down. Tripwire ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
5f8e152c9ca8839314d3e8ead3fb89a63ba8ea65.text: 陷阱。当绊线被触发时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 5…17…20 点穿刺伤害。任何残废的敌人都会被击倒。 Tripwire 在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

d09699844e60289ecdebf7c8d282291753999783.source: Skill. For 13 seconds, you gain +3…9…10 Health regeneration.
d09699844e60289ecdebf7c8d282291753999783.text: 技能。在 13 秒内，你获得 +3…9…10 点生命恢复。

14a2d8aa1950b8c0b7923733c5977308da435d10.source: Signet. Target foe takes 15…63…75 damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, foes adjacent to your target take 5…41…50 damage.
14a2d8aa1950b8c0b7923733c5977308da435d10.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害。如果该敌人受到妖术或结界的影响，则与你的目标相邻的敌人会受到 5…41…50 点伤害。

8fd09be2b15afeee8a149cb025a99f5d8c9fcd71.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Steal up to 15…51…60 Health from target foe. For 10 seconds, you have +5…9…10 Health regeneration.
8fd09be2b15afeee8a149cb025a99f5d8c9fcd71.text: 精英结界法术。从目标敌人处窃取最多 15…51…60 点生命值。在 10 秒内，您可以恢复 +5…9…10 点生命值。

1498d980c78d653528bb6bbbc6eb9cf5ab6bb29e.source: Signet. Target foe takes 10…50…60 damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, foes adjacent to your target take 10…50…60 damage. All your non-Mesmer skills except signets are disabled for 10 seconds.
1498d980c78d653528bb6bbbc6eb9cf5ab6bb29e.text: 印章。目标敌人受到 10…50…60 点伤害。如果该敌人受到妖术或结界的影响，则与你的目标相邻的敌人会受到 10…50…60 点伤害。除图章外，你所有的非幻术师技能都会被禁用 10 秒。

29b9e63e86a84fdaa0b279669f78d91a5c667cda.source: Stance. All adjacent foes are Blinded for 3…9…10 seconds. For 10…26…30 seconds, you cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.
29b9e63e86a84fdaa0b279669f78d91a5c667cda.text: 立场。所有邻近的敌人都会被致盲 3…9…10 秒。在 10…26…30 秒内，你无法被致盲的敌人阻挡。

3d0af8619ca900bb0c2b5530e4a0e1ee004ccc93.source: Stance. For 15…51…60 seconds, you cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.
3d0af8619ca900bb0c2b5530e4a0e1ee004ccc93.text: 立场。在 15…51…60 秒内，你无法被致盲的敌人阻挡。

4883ad46e9cffe222be2a2120a981a7dba50b3e6.source: Elite Spell. You create Unsteady Ground at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, nearby foes take 10…34…40 earth damage each second. Attacking foes struck by Unsteady Ground are knocked down.
4883ad46e9cffe222be2a2120a981a7dba50b3e6.text: 精英法术。你在目标敌人的位置制造不稳定地面。在 5 秒内，附近的敌人每秒受到 10…34…40 点土系伤害。被不稳定地面击中的攻击敌人会被击倒。

ead27345554e7f102c462780786c6111cea3d3f9.source: Lead Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +19…29…31 damage. If your target was above 90% Health you deal an additional 15…63…75 damage.
ead27345554e7f102c462780786c6111cea3d3f9.text: 引导攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你将受到 +19…29…31 点伤害。如果你的目标生命值高于 90%，你会额外造成 15…63…75 点伤害。

084129c3c4ee98f110749f65186dfbc1478c2a5b.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. If you stop maintaining this enchantment or if this enchantment is removed, that party member dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Deaths while enchanted with Unyielding Aura do not incur a death penalty. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
084129c3c4ee98f110749f65186dfbc1478c2a5b.text: 精英结界法术。让目标死去的队员以完整的生命值和完整的能量复活。如果你停止维持这个结界或者如果这个结界被移除，该队员就会死亡并留下一具被剥削的尸体。被不屈光环附魔时死亡不会受到死刑。 （50% 失败几率，神圣恩惠 4 或更少。）

4d7cc482f7095574f2ea7935c263abb0c6446476.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear. For 60 seconds, you have 100 armor and 750…790…800 Health. All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills.
4d7cc482f7095574f2ea7935c263abb0c6446476.text: 精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现出熊的样子。在 60 秒内，你拥有 100 点护甲和 750…790…800 点生命值。你的所有属性都设置为0，熊攻击取代了你的技能。

43fde7d654d721c4dee4cd89b8e705c711f7568e.source: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If this attack hits, you steal 10…34…40 Health.
43fde7d654d721c4dee4cd89b8e705c711f7568e.text: 双重攻击。必须跟随副手攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会窃取 10…34…40 点生命值。

9a0c5842d6a3efb4ae0ba75919c833da3a5326e2.source: Skill. Touch target foe to steal up to 29…65…74 Health.
9a0c5842d6a3efb4ae0ba75919c833da3a5326e2.text: 技能。触摸目标敌人可窃取最多 29…65…74 点生命值。

85785e4047828e3af5bc8caa594991a407b556c5.source: Spell. Steal up to 18…52…60 Health from target foe.
85785e4047828e3af5bc8caa594991a407b556c5.text: 咒语。从目标敌人处窃取最多 18…52…60 点生命值。

3e9fa898ef5823ac2eaa654349f2b200abfef303.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes take 10…26…30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…33…40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
3e9fa898ef5823ac2eaa654349f2b200abfef303.text: 精英六角咒语。在 10 秒内，目标敌人和邻近敌人在使用技能时会受到 10…26…30 点伤害，如果没有受到另一个幻术师咒语的影响，则会受到 5…33…40 点额外伤害。

092bef51cdc8815081fdca270f3d04d4e5fceb68.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally has +40…168…200 maximum Health.
092bef51cdc8815081fdca270f3d04d4e5fceb68.text: 结界咒语。当你保持此结界时，目标盟友的最大生命值为 +40…168…200。

09509ee41682a3e84bccff6ed5cfc87707669be0.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have +40…88…100 maximum Health. When this enchantment ends, you are healed for 75…175…200 Health.
09509ee41682a3e84bccff6ed5cfc87707669be0.text: 结界咒语。在 20 秒内，您的最大生命值为 +40…88…100。当此结界结束时，你将恢复 75…175…200 点生命值。

f5765dea575b1625c43edf68687bf2e5b9710d83.source: Weapon Spell. For 5…25…30 seconds, target ally has a Vital Weapon and has +40…148…175 maximum Health.
f5765dea575b1625c43edf68687bf2e5b9710d83.text: 武器咒语。持续 5…25…30 秒，目标盟友拥有重要武器并拥有 +40…148…175 最大生命值。

2818e396acc3daf79073c3ff2f366952ac678b3b.source: Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes cannot use shouts or chants.
2818e396acc3daf79073c3ff2f366952ac678b3b.text: 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有附近的敌人无法使用喊叫或吟唱。

65f3e14b063c60cfb6d0a7f8a081645e03b3358a.source: Item Spell. For 60 seconds, all shouts and chants you use last 20…44…50% longer.
65f3e14b063c60cfb6d0a7f8a081645e03b3358a.text: 物品法术。在 60 秒内，您使用的所有呼喊和口号持续时间延长 20…44…50%。

8e3d08cc5278b119e768f137e546e84f4b655b42.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and 2…4 Health regeneration. All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills.
8e3d08cc5278b119e768f137e546e84f4b655b42.text: 精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现出狼的样子。在 60 秒内，你拥有 80 点护甲、660…700 点生命值和 2…4 点生命恢复。你的所有属性都设置为0，狼攻击取代了你的技能。

7aaa407df5b776fa84cc7d5661ea540962c0b6dd.source: Bow Attack. All your Preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +1…8…10 damage if they hit.
7aaa407df5b776fa84cc7d5661ea540962c0b6dd.text: 弓攻击。您所有的准备工作都已删除。向目标敌人以及目标附近最多 3 个敌人射箭。这些箭一旦击中就会造成 +1…8…10 点伤害。

e716005b5c06a73cb352fe2ba20f00290cae6058.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have +24 armor and +1…3…4 Health regeneration. Vow of Piety renews whenever an enchantment on you ends.
e716005b5c06a73cb352fe2ba20f00290cae6058.text: 结界咒语。在 20 秒内，你拥有 +24 点护甲和 +1…3…4 点生命恢复。每当你身上的结界结束时，虔诚誓言就会更新。

7fb7745fbe60667bf828475b3a695bfce8f5f6d5.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3…9…10 seconds, you have +1…5…6 energy regeneration. This skill reapplies itself every time you use a non-Dervish skill. PvE Skill
7fb7745fbe60667bf828475b3a695bfce8f5f6d5.text: 精英结界法术。 3…9…10 秒，你有 +1…5…6 能量再生。每次您使用非苦行僧技能时，该技能都会重新应用。 PvE技能

306d1cd79169060c28a406bac6b3ac0a598a41ae.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…9…10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.
306d1cd79169060c28a406bac6b3ac0a598a41ae.text: 精英结界法术。 5…9…10秒内，你不能成为法术的目标，也不能施展法术。

ed28eaefa51df9258bef6fe24ce2eb7f7f34cd61.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10…22…25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.
ed28eaefa51df9258bef6fe24ce2eb7f7f34cd61.text: 精英结界法术。在 15 秒内，每当你用镰刀攻击敌人时，你会对所有相邻敌人造成 10…22…25 点切割伤害。

0ce77f707e2f457ce11e92d42c390ccaf0ccdaa7.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 2…5…6 seconds, all of target foe's attributes are set to 0.
0ce77f707e2f457ce11e92d42c390ccaf0ccdaa7.text: 精英六角咒语。 2…5…6秒内，目标敌人的所有属性都设置为0。

31858dc2ebf2607387c8b72f43333895ad774c2c.source: Weapon Spell. For 3…12…14 seconds, target ally has a Wailing Weapon. Whenever the Wailing Weapon strikes an attacking foe, that foe is interrupted.
31858dc2ebf2607387c8b72f43333895ad774c2c.text: 武器咒语。 3…12…14秒内，目标盟友拥有哀嚎武器。每当哀嚎武器击中攻击敌人时，该敌人就会被打断。

9165184779e8725b78c9cfed6951c230a8bd1f59.source: Skill. Target touched foe takes 20…50…58 damage.
9165184779e8725b78c9cfed6951c230a8bd1f59.text: 技能。目标接触的敌人受到 20…50…58 点伤害。

2f8908fad5d75242d1d8699c63c47b74eeccea7b.source: Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, the next time target foe attacks, that attack is interrupted and all nearby foes take 30…94…110 damage.
2f8908fad5d75242d1d8699c63c47b74eeccea7b.text: 降咒魔法。 4 秒内，下次目标敌人攻击时，该攻击会被打断，并且附近所有敌人受到 30…94…110 点伤害。

14191e05e6d25e3e22f52bb71f0b730fabd03254.source: Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, the next time target foe attacks, that attack is interrupted and all nearby foes take 10…76…92 damage.
14191e05e6d25e3e22f52bb71f0b730fabd03254.text: 降咒魔法。 4 秒内，下次目标敌人攻击时，该攻击会被打断，并且附近所有敌人受到 10…76…92 点伤害。

00264d1c6b67663f5fad3e98f33d54f0ba849bd1.source: Spell. Vampiric Swarm steals up to 15…51…60 Health from up to three foes in the area.
00264d1c6b67663f5fad3e98f33d54f0ba849bd1.text: 咒文。吸血鬼群从该区域内最多三个敌人处窃取最多 15…51…60 点生命值。

76ada81400241d87421d31dcbb0cbb249ff8e596.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 4…14 spirit that dies after 75…150 seconds. Attacks by this spirit steal up to 10…20 Health, and you are healed for 10…20 Health.
76ada81400241d87421d31dcbb0cbb249ff8e596.text: 缚灵仪式。创造一个等级为 4…14 的灵魂，在 75…150 秒后死亡。这种灵魂的攻击会窃取最多 10…20 点生命值，并且你会被治愈 10…20 点生命值。

0840a447dae916c481f6cd909856413aefe5a81f.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15…111…135 cold damage. Vapor Blade deals half damage if that foe has any enchantments on them.
0840a447dae916c481f6cd909856413aefe5a81f.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 15…111…135 点寒冷伤害。如果敌人身上有任何结界，蒸汽之刃会造成一半伤害。

5c67836274783ee8a112418880b35d4ea0605a97.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 5…41…50 piercing damage. For 5…21…25 seconds you take 5…29…35% less damage from spells.
5c67836274783ee8a112418880b35d4ea0605a97.text: 闪光附魔咒语。当你施放此结界时，附近的所有敌人都会受到 5…41…50 点穿刺伤害。在 5…21…25 秒内，你受到的法术伤害减少 5…29…35% 点。

2b264e92c424b299a0a3311f3229647907501b1b.source: Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. For 30 seconds, that party member deals 25% more damage. When this enchantment ends, target party member dies. Deaths while under the effects of this enchantment do not incur a death penalty.
2b264e92c424b299a0a3311f3229647907501b1b.text: 结界咒语。让目标死去的队员以完整的生命值和完整的能量复活。在 30 秒内，该队员造成额外 25% 点伤害。当此结界结束时，目标队伍成员死亡。在此结界的影响下死亡不会受到死刑。

54698cf369e3a050618f2d50472ce52e194da5d4.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…10…12 spirit. Whenever this spirit's attack hits a stationary foe, that foe is knocked down and the spirit loses 70…54…50 Health. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
54698cf369e3a050618f2d50472ce52e194da5d4.text: 精英束缚仪式。创造1…10…12级武魂。每当这个精魂的攻击击中静止的敌人时，该敌人就会被击倒，并且该精魂会失去 70…54…50 点生命值。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

12e092253413b312fb72a1324db2679cd0ca23b7.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Khanhei's ashes for 5…10…11 seconds. Whenever a foe strikes you in combat while you are holding Khanhei's ashes, you steal 10…38…45 Health from that foe.
12e092253413b312fb72a1324db2679cd0ca23b7.text: 精英物品法术。按住 Khanhei 的骨灰 5…10…11 秒。当你拿着 Khanhei 的骨灰时，每当敌人在战斗中攻击你时，你就会从该敌人那里窃取 10…38…45 点生命值。

f7e51cfee976ad40194f0f0609f2e324352c44b4.source: Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 15…51…60 Health from that foe.
f7e51cfee976ad40194f0f0609f2e324352c44b4.text: 武器咒语。在 8 秒内，下次目标盟友受到敌人伤害或生命窃取时，该盟友会从该敌人那里窃取最多 15…51…60 点生命值。

b2db53206fc68f71cf596f898c6b93a4c31a5909.source: Enchantment Spell. All hostile animated undead in the area become bound to you. Verata's Aura ends after 120…264…300 seconds. When Verata's Aura ends, you lose your bond with any undead bound to you. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
b2db53206fc68f71cf596f898c6b93a4c31a5909.text: 结界咒语。该地区所有敌对的动画不死生物都会与你绑定。 Verata 的光环在 120…264…300 秒后结束。当维拉塔的光环结束时，你会失去与任何束缚在你身上的不死生物的联系。 (死亡魔法4以下时失败率50%。)

754b310ec155d7d57a8835393fdf2650f39a893b.source: Spell. If target hostile animated undead has a master, its bond to its master is broken, making it hostile to all other creatures. If it had no master, you become its master and heal it for 60…76…80. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
754b310ec155d7d57a8835393fdf2650f39a893b.text: 咒语。如果目标敌对动画不死生物有主人，它与主人的联系就会被打破，使其对所有其他生物充满敌意。如果它没有主人，你成为它的主人并治愈它 60…76…80。（死亡魔法 4 或更少时失败几率为 50%。）

136fde48229ffaa3ea483ec024b339283fc290e2.source: Spell. For 5…9…10 seconds, your undead allies gain +10 Health regeneration. All conditions are removed from those allies and transferred to you. If this spell is successful and you have control of 3 or fewer minions, Verata's Sacrifice instantly recharges.
136fde48229ffaa3ea483ec024b339283fc290e2.text: 咒语。在 5…9…10 秒内，你的亡灵盟友获得 +10 点生命恢复。所有条件都从这些盟友身上移除并转移给你。如果此法术成功并且你控制了 3 个或更少的随从，维拉塔的牺牲会立即充能。

621ad2033d125820c55abcfc2f51186b3725158a.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. If you land a critical hit with this attack, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…13…15 seconds.
621ad2033d125820c55abcfc2f51186b3725158a.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果你用这次攻击造成重击，目标敌人会受到深度伤害，持续 5…13…15 秒。

80c6c1adcaa83020276234f261aa28d24b19f79a.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…21…25 damage. If target foe has less Health than you, you gain 30…70…80 Health.
80c6c1adcaa83020276234f261aa28d24b19f79a.text: 近战攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。如果目标敌人的生命值低于你，你将获得 30…70…80 生命值。

a4f0e776ea8cb7a14fb54596a85d19895b58ddd5.source: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, each time target ally attacks or casts a spell, that ally is healed for 5…17…20 Health.
a4f0e776ea8cb7a14fb54596a85d19895b58ddd5.text: 结界咒语。在 30 秒内，每次目标盟友攻击或施展法术时，该盟友就会恢复 5…17…20 点生命值。

96611cb738a5d8cdc466d8d6e27012cd703786ca.source: Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10…54…65 cold damage. If suffering from a condition, that foe is hexed with Vile Miasma and suffers -1…4…5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
96611cb738a5d8cdc466d8d6e27012cd703786ca.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人受到 10…54…65 点寒冷伤害。如果患有某种病症，该敌人会受到邪恶瘴气的诅咒，并遭受 -1…4…5 生命值退化，持续 10 秒。

c9df88885e594bf794e81bc1ad030cb07f860e46.source: Skill. Touch target foe to deal 20…56…65 damage.
c9df88885e594bf794e81bc1ad030cb07f860e46.text: 技能。触摸目标敌人造成 20…56…65 点伤害。

b244e271e67dd9856aea1fe2fbd8ab4009d4c162.source: Spell. All adjacent foes are Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
b244e271e67dd9856aea1fe2fbd8ab4009d4c162.text: 咒语。所有邻近的敌人都会中毒 5…17…20 秒。暗影步到直接远离目标的附近位置。

78745968a28a258311f9808ad0d82f11e1aeff79.source: Trap. Create a Viper's Nest. When it is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5…29…35 piercing damage and become Poisoned for 5…17…20 seconds. Viper's Nest expires after 90 seconds. This Trap is easily interrupted.
78745968a28a258311f9808ad0d82f11e1aeff79.text: 陷阱。创建一个毒蛇巢穴。触发时，附近所有敌人都会受到 5…29…35 点穿刺伤害，并中毒 5…17…20 秒。 Viper's Nest 将在 90 秒后过期。这个陷阱很容易被打断。

6dbd6cb006e81fd278d05a040d3adf7a9fba9ca1.source: Elite Spell. If target foe was already suffering from a condition, that foe suffers from Disease, Poison, and Weakness for 3…13…15 seconds.
6dbd6cb006e81fd278d05a040d3adf7a9fba9ca1.text: 精英法术。如果目标敌人已经患有某种病症，则该敌人将遭受疾病、毒药和虚弱的影响，持续 3…13…150 秒。

85d9c4bf0a1c3349e61b349f60db97a2acd4b91b.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes take 15…39…45 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…41…50 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
85d9c4bf0a1c3349e61b349f60db97a2acd4b91b.text: 精英六角咒语。在 10 秒内，目标敌人和邻近敌人在使用技能时会受到 15…39…45 点伤害，如果没有受到另一个幻术师咒语的影响，则会受到 5…41…50 点额外伤害。

181fcc47cb97ab516c8badd84f6b2881eb538533.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. Whenever this spirit's attack hits a stationary foe, that foe is knocked down and the spirit loses 70…54…50 Health. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
181fcc47cb97ab516c8badd84f6b2881eb538533.text: 精英束缚仪式。创造1…7…8级武魂。每当这个精魂的攻击击中静止的敌人时，该敌人就会被击倒，并且该精魂会失去 70…54…50 点生命值。该灵魂会在 30…54…60 秒后死亡。

d9c483e58d92ea97f35b1749369a7979a3d73bb4.source: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Elements at your current location. For 8…18…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor against elemental damage.
d9c483e58d92ea97f35b1749369a7979a3d73bb4.text: 守卫咒语。您在当前位置创建了一个元素防御结界。持续 8…18…20 秒，该区域的非灵体盟友获得 +24 点元素伤害护甲值。

63e1467b2e5291fd6ce74530eee2bb38c49a7e00.source: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Foes at your current location. For 8…18…20 seconds, non-spirit foes in this area move 50% slower.
63e1467b2e5291fd6ce74530eee2bb38c49a7e00.text: 守卫咒语。您在当前位置创建了一个对抗敌人的结界。在 8…18…20 秒内，该区域的非灵体敌人移动速度减慢 50%。

56f8a27d8941bf56a6e0e69062f2f2df95005db9.source: Elite Ward Spell. Create a Ward Against Harm at this location. For 5…13…15 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have +1…3…3 health regeneration, +12…22…24 armor, and an additional +12…22…24 armor against elemental damage. This spell is disabled for 20 seconds.
56f8a27d8941bf56a6e0e69062f2f2df95005db9.text: 精英守卫法术。在此位置创建一个防御伤害结界。持续 5…13…15 秒，该区域的非灵魂盟友拥有 +1…3…3 生命恢复、+12…22…24 护甲，以及针对元素伤害的额外 +12…22…24 护甲。该法术会被禁用 20 秒。

31c1846b9183934b7dfa8f20320cf1e6f94320ac.source: Elite Ward Spell. Create a Ward Against Harm at this location. For 5…13…15 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have +1…3…3 health regeneration, +12…22…24 armor, and an additional +12…22…24 armor against elemental damage. This spell is disabled for 30 seconds.
31c1846b9183934b7dfa8f20320cf1e6f94320ac.text: 精英守卫法术。在此位置创建一个防御伤害结界。持续 5…13…15 秒，该区域的非灵魂盟友拥有 +1…3…3 生命恢复、+12…22…24 护甲，以及针对元素伤害的额外 +12…22…24 护甲。该法术会失效 30 秒。

516248806db6286f053d03026a314df32b966778.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…30…35 seconds, your next 1…5…6 attacks cannot be blocked.
516248806db6286f053d03026a314df32b966778.text: 结界咒语。 10…30…35秒内，你接下来的1…5…6次攻击无法被阻挡。

d183685ae5a7e1a8a3031294b3ccadfd582fea5a.source: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, the next time you hit with a dual attack skill, you gain 5…17…20 Energy.
d183685ae5a7e1a8a3031294b3ccadfd582fea5a.text: 结界咒语。 20秒内，下次使用双攻击技能时，你将获得5…17…20点能量。

9b452676edc401521193c565001a3376100c0ab7.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, while holding a non-dagger weapon, you have an additional 3…27…33% chance to land a critical hit.
9b452676edc401521193c565001a3376100c0ab7.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，持有非匕首武器时，你有额外 3…27…33% 次机会造成暴击。

8f2596cc1a0adfc40dd31a6828714633460a388f.source: Spell. Target foe and foes adjacent to your target have Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds.
8f2596cc1a0adfc40dd31a6828714633460a388f.text: 咒语。目标敌人和与目标相邻的敌人的护甲破裂，持续 5…17…20 秒。

8350080875c0378a8f14d5a3990c1d9f4772e85b.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…13…16 seconds, target foe suffers -1…3…4 Health degeneration and takes 5…17…20 damage while moving.
8350080875c0378a8f14d5a3990c1d9f4772e85b.text: 精英六角咒语。持续 1…13…16 秒，目标敌人遭受 -1…3…4 点生命值退化，并在移动时受到 5…17…20 点伤害。

85f49948b8db3e0be73cdbed010a133a14cdebb7.source: Trap. When Weakness Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are Weakened for 10…20 seconds and take 24…50 lightning damage. All Charr are knocked down. Weakness Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
85f49948b8db3e0be73cdbed010a133a14cdebb7.text: 陷阱。当虚弱陷阱被触发时，附近所有敌人都会被虚弱10…20秒，并受到24…50点闪电伤害。所有夏尔都被击倒了。弱点陷阱在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

f636423c49befba6381bb2a3c0a235592a2a85ea.source: Weapon Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, you attack 25% faster.
f636423c49befba6381bb2a3c0a235592a2a85ea.text: 武器咒语。在 5…13…15 秒内，你的攻击速度加快 25%。

3044b7cb1ead75bda661fee6efdd59854732be71.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.
3044b7cb1ead75bda661fee6efdd59854732be71.text: 精英武器法术。在 5…17…20 秒内，每当目标盟友成功攻击时，该盟友就会获得 100% 点肾上腺素和 1 点能量。

26ee4791b2917a9571b3d06c31d12c8c444d3e3a.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5…21…25 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Quickening, and spells and binding rituals recharge 33% faster.
26ee4791b2917a9571b3d06c31d12c8c444d3e3a.text: 精英武器法术。在 5…21…25 秒内，目标盟友拥有加速武器，并且法术和绑定仪式的充能速度加快 33%。

1814fc5cafadb221a178586641ae566034f67588.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 20…68…80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.
1814fc5cafadb221a178586641ae566034f67588.text: 精英武器法术。在 8 秒内，下次目标盟友受到敌人伤害或生命窃取时，该盟友会从该敌人窃取最多 20…68…80 点生命值并失去 2 点状态。

10351d2602753b0e8002cc98a0beb8d745cb78cb.source: Weapon Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, the next time target ally hits with an attack skill, that ally gains 1…6…7 Energy.
10351d2602753b0e8002cc98a0beb8d745cb78cb.text: 武器咒语。在 5…17…20 秒内，下次目标盟友使用攻击技能命中时，该盟友获得 1…6…7 点能量。

c8f92a6d8feb40ed1eeb1fd1ece92695afa42c63.source: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Melee at your current location. For 5…17…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 50% chance to block melee attacks.
c8f92a6d8feb40ed1eeb1fd1ece92695afa42c63.text: 守卫咒语。您在当前位置创建了一个反近战结界。 5…17…20秒内，该区域内的非灵体盟友有50%的几率格挡近战攻击。

438c623743977579f48996a17b123cb0c9880948.source: Weapon Spell. For 1…6…7 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Shadow. Whenever that ally is struck by an attack, that ally's attacker becomes Blinded for 5 seconds. The next 1…3…3 times "Times" appears instead of "time" when it is only "1" that ally hits with an attack, his target is Blinded for 5 seconds.
438c623743977579f48996a17b123cb0c9880948.text: 武器咒语。持续 1…6…7 秒，目标盟友拥有暗影武器。每当该盟友受到攻击时，该盟友的攻击者就会失明 5 秒。接下来的 1…3…3 次出现“Times”而不是“time”时，当盟友攻击只有“1”时，他的目标会被致盲 5 秒。

986bb21e95c5d365bd94590a2146a99786ab9628.source: Weapon Spell. For 3…7…8 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Warding that grants target ally +2…4…4 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block.
986bb21e95c5d365bd94590a2146a99786ab9628.text: 武器咒语。在 3…7…8 秒内，目标盟友拥有守护武器，为目标盟友提供 +2…4…4 点生命恢复和 50% 次格挡机会。

1172471b87ad83f20a6776ce4f62fecb1562f3da.source: Weapon Spell. For 3…7…8 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Warding that grants target ally +2…4…4 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block. Weapon of Warding ends if that ally attacks.
1172471b87ad83f20a6776ce4f62fecb1562f3da.text: 武器咒语。在 3…7…8 秒内，目标盟友拥有守护武器，为目标盟友提供 +2…4…4 点生命恢复和 50% 次格挡机会。如果该盟友发起攻击，守护武器就会结束。

75205a7642e56574dacf3e5e949c00688197e253.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 3…17…20 seconds, each non-spirit ally in earshot gains the effect of a random Weapon Spell. PvE Skill
75205a7642e56574dacf3e5e949c00688197e253.text: 精英武器法术。在 3…17…20 秒内，听力范围内的每个非精神盟友都会获得随机武器法术的效果。 PvE技能

3296e92d3fee84c078d8704a5587f2e2fdbe8055.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…34…40 damage. You are Weakened for 5 seconds.
3296e92d3fee84c078d8704a5587f2e2fdbe8055.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。你被削弱了 5 秒。

df8bc3c34674bfebc3d6438508db612c4d47bc79.source: Scythe Attack. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, you inflict a Deep Wound for 3…9…10 seconds. You suffer from Weakness for 10 seconds if an enchantment is not removed.
df8bc3c34674bfebc3d6438508db612c4d47bc79.text: 镰刀攻击。你移除了 1 苦行僧结界。如果结界被移除，你会造成深度伤害，持续 3…9…10 秒。如果结界未被移除，你将遭受虚弱 10 秒。

b9139322e2e705d2161a3513b2cbaa30fdeb2ee9.source: Hex Spell. Interrupt target foe. For 10 seconds, target foe is hexed with Web of Disruption. When this hex ends, that foe is interrupted again.
b9139322e2e705d2161a3513b2cbaa30fdeb2ee9.text: 降咒魔法。打断目标敌人。目标敌人被破坏之网施咒，持续 10 秒。当这个六角形结束时，那个敌人会再次被打断。

318f422d9a95c05a7f43eb2076da5dc8426432e5.source: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Blood at its location. For 8…18…20 seconds, allies in that area receive +1…5…6 Health regeneration.
318f422d9a95c05a7f43eb2076da5dc8426432e5.text: 好吧，拼写。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值在其位置创建一口血井。在 8…18…20 秒内，该区域的盟友获得 +1…5…6 点生命恢复。

b8af64d9f257bf532c8cb885387593aa55e70839.source: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Darkness for 5…41…50 seconds. Hexed foes within the Well of Darkness miss 50% of the time.
b8af64d9f257bf532c8cb885387593aa55e70839.text: 好吧，拼写。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值来创建持续 5…41…50 秒的黑暗之井。黑暗之井内的施咒敌人错过了 50% 次。

da593176ca2559a1dcbcd06e0a058697ac3bb3a1.source: Elite Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Power at that location. For 10…26…30 seconds, allies within the area of Well of Power gain +1…5…6 Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration.
da593176ca2559a1dcbcd06e0a058697ac3bb3a1.text: 精英井法术。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 生命值在该位置创建能量之井。在 10…26…30 秒内，能量之井区域内的盟友获得 +1…5…6 点生命恢复和 +2 点能量恢复。

d6ecb389ee8172b4752ac2d85dc2545456c562cb.source: Ward Spell. Create a Ward of Stability at your current location. For 10…22…25 seconds, non-spirit allies cannot be knocked down.
d6ecb389ee8172b4752ac2d85dc2545456c562cb.text: 守卫咒语。在你当前的位置创建一个稳定结界。 10…22…25秒内，非灵魂盟友无法被击倒。

b17e04bcad26aecbbdf303b54e2e78f9e98c548a.source: Ward Spell. You create a Ward of Weakness at your current location. For 5…17…20 seconds, foes in this area become Weakened for 5…17…20 seconds whenever they take elemental damage.
b17e04bcad26aecbbdf303b54e2e78f9e98c548a.text: 守卫咒语。你在当前位置创建了一个虚弱结界。在 5…17…20 秒内，该区域内的敌人每当受到元素伤害时就会变得虚弱 5…17…20 秒。

fb317518e4ca72d9987af25bf95ef7b4f3c06cd2.source: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Ruin at its location. For 5…25…30 seconds, whenever a foe in the well takes physical damage, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds.
fb317518e4ca72d9987af25bf95ef7b4f3c06cd2.text: 好吧，拼写。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值在其位置创建一口毁灭之井。在 5…25…30 秒内，每当井中的敌人受到物理伤害时，该敌人的护甲就会破裂，持续 5…17…20 秒。

87fe23d9f44b24c2924bfa209a600cce28062ee7.source: Well Spell. Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Silence for 10…26…30 seconds. Foes within the well cannot use shouts or chants and suffer -1…3…4 Health degeneration.
87fe23d9f44b24c2924bfa209a600cce28062ee7.text: 好吧，拼写。利用目标尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值来创造一个持续 10…26…30 秒的沉默之井。井内的敌人无法使用喊叫或吟唱，并遭受 -1…3…4 生命值退化。

aa1e84cf023b12db3d0c6256ea549bbd906b7201.source: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Suffering at its location. For 10…26…30 seconds, foes in that area suffer -1…5…6 Health degeneration.
aa1e84cf023b12db3d0c6256ea549bbd906b7201.text: 好吧，拼写。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值在其位置创建一口痛苦之井。在 10…26…30 秒内，该区域的敌人会遭受 -1…5…6 点生命值退化。

9dc7aecb86f7a33f47adf0cdf00107ffa22df525.source: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of the Profane at its location. For 8…18…20 seconds, foes in that area are stripped of all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
9dc7aecb86f7a33f47adf0cdf00107ffa22df525.text: 好吧，拼写。利用最近的尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值在其位置创建一口亵渎之井。在 8…18…20 秒内，该区域的敌人将被剥夺所有结界，并且不能成为进一步结界的目标。 （死亡魔法4以下时失败率50%。）

7da803435780708020c5ba482a5926457376aa94.source: Well Spell. Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Weariness for 10…46…55 seconds. Enemies within the Well of Weariness suffer -1 Energy degeneration.
7da803435780708020c5ba482a5926457376aa94.text: 好吧，拼写。利用目标尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值来创建持续 10…46…55 秒的疲倦之井。疲倦之井内的敌人遭受 -1 点能量衰退。

b830c7644c7f9c30e5ebd3d8341c5fb6dff77b42.source: Elite Axe Attack. If Whirling Axe hits, you strike for +5…17…20 damage and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
b830c7644c7f9c30e5ebd3d8341c5fb6dff77b42.text: 精英斧头攻击。如果旋风斧击中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害，并且目标所使用的任何姿态都会结束。此攻击无法被阻止。

4f5042559e87d6b4ab754ba316ad812e350f0192.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1…5…6 seconds, you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10…50…60 cold damage and this enchantment ends.
4f5042559e87d6b4ab754ba316ad812e350f0192.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 1…5…6 秒内，您的移动速度比正常速度快 33%。下次你攻击敌人时，附近所有其他敌人都会受到 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害，并且此结界结束。

753212702c94999b1cf5184570803f7d17660b89.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1…5…6 seconds, you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10…42…50 cold damage and this enchantment ends.
753212702c94999b1cf5184570803f7d17660b89.text: 闪光附魔咒语。在 1…5…6 秒内，您的移动速度比正常速度快 33%。下次你攻击敌人时，附近所有其他敌人都会受到 10…42…50 点寒冷伤害，并且此结界结束。

60081df129726a85768769050d891885ca99319d.source: Stance. For 8…18…20 seconds, you have 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block a projectile in this way, adjacent foes take 5…10…11 damage.
60081df129726a85768769050d891885ca99319d.text: 立场。在 8…18…20 秒内，你有 75% 次机会阻止攻击。每当你以这种方式阻挡射弹时，邻近的敌人就会受到 5…10…11 点伤害。

fefbf4d4122059e0fb0981fadc0191a821ac6c3f.source: Spell. All adjacent foes take 15…63…75 cold damage. Attacking foes struck by Whirlwind are knocked down. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby instead of adjacent.
fefbf4d4122059e0fb0981fadc0191a821ac6c3f.text: 咒语。所有邻近敌人受到 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害。被旋风击中的攻击敌人会被击倒。如果你是阴天，这个法术会攻击附近而不是邻近的地方。

6c6e63a158cea9277ce9d230b81d5ed1a7c3a468.source: Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13…20 damage.
6c6e63a158cea9277ce9d230b81d5ed1a7c3a468.text: 近战攻击。攻击目标和邻近的敌人。每次攻击造成 +13…20 点伤害。

8da20aa78129e9bc1e01bcced1201c636f44be07.source: Weapon Spell. For 3…11…13 seconds, if target ally attacks a foe who is not attacking, that foe is interrupted.
8da20aa78129e9bc1e01bcced1201c636f44be07.text: 武器咒语。在 3…11…13 秒内，如果目标盟友攻击未攻击的敌人，则该敌人会被打断。

6f4cb46f93d3cf34d3bec94b960aa0020d84270a.source: Skill. For 5…10…11 seconds, your melee attacks cannot be blocked.
6f4cb46f93d3cf34d3bec94b960aa0020d84270a.text: 技能。 5…10…11秒内，你的近战攻击无法被格挡。

752e5cc2b4f10c0771e363615668435b7838d53f.source: Elite Skill. For 5…29…35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10…22…25.
752e5cc2b4f10c0771e363615668435b7838d53f.text: 精英技能。在 5…29…35 秒内，每次近战攻击都会获得 3 点能量。战士的耐力无法将你的能量提高到 10…22…25 以上。

85ecb6e947517593acab39e6dbd57028e3aa3350.source: Elite Stance. For 5…29…35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10…22…25.
85ecb6e947517593acab39e6dbd57028e3aa3350.text: 精英姿态。在 5…29…35 秒内，每次近战攻击都会获得 3 点能量。战士的耐力无法将你的能量提高到 10…22…25 以上。

46e9b18937c179e13c430efb4c1da104167341cc.source: Stance. For 1…5…6 seconds, you block any attack skills used against you. For each successful block, you gain adrenaline and 5 Energy. Wary Stance ends if you use a skill.
46e9b18937c179e13c430efb4c1da104167341cc.text: 立场。在 1…5…6 秒内，你格挡任何针对你的攻击技能。每成功阻止一次，您就会获得肾上腺素和 5 能量。如果您使用技能，警惕姿态就会结束。

0dec1ea48d404a45648885314765045ae2f9f66a.source: Spell. If target foe is not casting a spell or attacking, you gain 8…12…13 Energy.
0dec1ea48d404a45648885314765045ae2f9f66a.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人没有施法或攻击，你将获得 8…12…13 点能量。

09854e63105491b9a271c2ea9d1140197b5b6975.source: Spell. Heal target ally for 15…51…60 points. If that ally is under the effects of a weapon spell, Wielder's Boon heals for an additional 15…63…75 Health.
09854e63105491b9a271c2ea9d1140197b5b6975.text: 咒文。治疗目标盟友 15…51…60 点。如果该盟友受到武器法术的影响，持用者的恩赐会额外治疗 15…63…75 点生命值。

6be62b2fa244277be05a32b85865ea08e3cdc79d.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…26…30 seconds, whenever you cast a weapon spell on an ally, that ally loses 2 conditions.
6be62b2fa244277be05a32b85865ea08e3cdc79d.text: 结界咒语。在 10…26…30 秒内，每当你对盟友施放武器法术时，该盟友就会失去 2 点条件。

13b9f49090f3b6552277d19a1ebefa4bf2c567a1.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10…50…60 lightning damage. If you are under the effects of a weapon spell, you deal an additional 10…42…50 lightning damage.
13b9f49090f3b6552277d19a1ebefa4bf2c567a1.text: 咒语。目标敌人受到 10…50…60 点闪电伤害。如果你受到武器法术的影响，你会额外造成 10…42…50 点闪电伤害。

a7980abba64e777207de0c1648915d7b28078af8.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…34…40 seconds, whenever you cast a Weapon Spell on an ally, you gain 1…4…5 Energy.
a7980abba64e777207de0c1648915d7b28078af8.text: 精英结界法术。在 10…34…40 秒内，每当你对盟友施放武器法术时，你都会获得 1…4…5 点能量。

eb1a69dea4550f05e7bf23f5e5d123efea537efa.source: Melee Attack. Lose all adrenaline. If it hits, this attack will result in a critical hit and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
eb1a69dea4550f05e7bf23f5e5d123efea537efa.text: 近战攻击。失去所有肾上腺素。如果击中，这次攻击将造成致命一击，并且目标所使用的任何姿势都会结束。此攻击无法被阻止。

13c49eb0e571cab7e4d7dc7b18a3a90b88b0d13d.source: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.
13c49eb0e571cab7e4d7dc7b18a3a90b88b0d13d.text: 精英技能。暗影步瞄准敌人。如果目标敌人没有使用技能，该敌人就会被击倒。你的所有非匕首攻击技能都会被禁用 10 秒。

c74ec6998e278b4c90e4dd725e55cf9a68d1440d.source: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe is hexed with Wastrel's Demise. Each second while hexed, target foe and all foes adjacent to that foe take 1…8…10 damage and an additional 1…8…10 damage for each second this spell is in effect. This hex ends prematurely if target foe uses a skill.
c74ec6998e278b4c90e4dd725e55cf9a68d1440d.text: 降咒魔法。 5 秒内，目标敌人受到黄鼠之死的诅咒。施咒期间，目标敌人以及与该敌人相邻的所有敌人每秒受到 1…8…10 点伤害，并且该法术生效时每秒会额外受到 1…8…10 点伤害。如果目标敌人使用技能，则该降咒会提前结束。

81c6cf57365025334a736f11b4d21cfae77e736d.source: Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe takes 20…84…100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage. If that foe successfully uses a skill, Wastrel's Worry ends prematurely and does no damage.
81c6cf57365025334a736f11b4d21cfae77e736d.text: 降咒魔法。 3 秒后，目标敌人受到 20…84…100 点伤害，所有相邻敌人受到 75% 点伤害。如果该敌人成功使用技能，黄蜂之忧会提前结束并且不会造成任何伤害。

5b87a68b04fd5a7834c7a31d642027426b4b37ce.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains +1…3…4 Health regeneration. If this skill ends prematurely, that ally gains 30…102…120 Health.
5b87a68b04fd5a7834c7a31d642027426b4b37ce.text: 结界咒语。 10 秒内，目标盟友获得 +1…3…4 点生命恢复。如果该技能提前结束，该盟友将获得 30…102…120 点生命值。

511ab27fe3f3c7f32d1b6d056f9121c734f0cce3.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%, that ally is healed for 50…170…200 Health.
511ab27fe3f3c7f32d1b6d056f9121c734f0cce3.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，下次伤害使目标盟友的生命值降至 25% 以下时，该盟友将获得 50…170…200 点生命值治疗。

0e36b963df963d235190e411fd6e048195fc75e2.source: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains +2 Health regeneration. That ally is healed for 30…150…180 Health when Watchful Spirit ends.
0e36b963df963d235190e411fd6e048195fc75e2.text: 结界咒语。当你维持此结界时，目标盟友获得 +2 点生命恢复。当警惕之魂结束时，该盟友将获得 30…150…180 点生命值的治疗。

d205781acb8cedd8730377b317dc3799713fcb13.source: Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, you are attuned to Water. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Water Magic.
d205781acb8cedd8730377b317dc3799713fcb13.text: 结界咒语。在 36…55…60 秒内，你与水协调。每次使用水系魔法时，你将获得 1 点能量加上该技能的基础能量消耗 30% 点。

e83ba7023f041c103ad341356069bedfbbb60a0f.source: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10…30…35 damage and any stance being used by target foe ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
e83ba7023f041c103ad341356069bedfbbb60a0f.text: 副手攻击。必须跟随主导攻击。如果击中，此攻击会造成 +10…30…35 伤害，并且目标敌人所使用的任何姿态都会结束。此攻击无法被阻止。

bd61b03a693cb5f2aae429832f63bd18227dec27.source: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +5…17…20 damage, and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked. All of your non-spear attack skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
bd61b03a693cb5f2aae429832f63bd18227dec27.text: 长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，则会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害，并且目标所使用的任何姿态都会结束。此攻击无法被阻止。你所有的非矛攻击技能都会被禁用3秒。

38aee15509a5bd5f1e60d67e1f645241e193e444.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…11…13 seconds, target ally moves 33% faster.
38aee15509a5bd5f1e60d67e1f645241e193e444.text: 结界咒语。在 5…11…13 秒内，目标盟友的移动速度加快 33%。

8758fb4a1d4bbc8491870bf30bbc1b8c56ff066f.source: Elite Spell. Send out a fast-moving Water Trident, striking target foe and up to 2 adjacent foes for 10…74…90 cold damage if it hits. If it hits a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.
8758fb4a1d4bbc8491870bf30bbc1b8c56ff066f.text: 精英法术。发出快速移动的水三叉戟，攻击目标敌人和最多 2 个相邻敌人，命中后造成 10…74…90 冰冷伤害。如果它击中移动的敌人，该敌人就会被击倒。

a25587226ca08ff81601a371bfeba7ddb542cfcb.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you successfully land a critical hit, you gain 10…34…40 Health.
a25587226ca08ff81601a371bfeba7ddb542cfcb.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，每当你成功击中致命一击时，你都会获得 10…34…40 点生命值。

689699d94493b70bec59b984f16dec91c7a3e2eb.source: Elite Stance. For the next 20 seconds while wielding daggers, you attack 5…17…20% faster and have a +5…29…35% chance to land a critical hit.
689699d94493b70bec59b984f16dec91c7a3e2eb.text: 精英姿态。在接下来的 20 秒内，当你挥舞匕首时，你的攻击速度会加快 5…17…20% 倍，并且有 +5…29…35% 的几率造成暴击。

54b890d2c357a7509c32333f36e3ee9d315a8bd1.source: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Create a level 4…10 Spirit. All foes within its range have 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks. This spirit dies after 54…90 seconds.
54b890d2c357a7509c32333f36e3ee9d315a8bd1.text: 黑檀先锋仪式。创建一个4…10级的灵魂。其范围内的所有敌人都有 15% 的几率远程攻击失手。该灵魂会在 54…90 秒后死亡。

334eadc8d470aa4738f09b5df57c0d8292f2d4e6.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, off-hand and dual attacks cost no Energy and recharge 25…45…50% faster.
334eadc8d470aa4738f09b5df57c0d8292f2d4e6.text: 精英结界法术。在 5…13…15 秒内，副手和双重攻击不消耗能量，并且充电速度加快 25…45…50%。

af77eb001e9fcde6be0a01b4bd7070bf5b8eaf0e.source: Spell. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed in this way, all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20…68…80 cold damage.
af77eb001e9fcde6be0a01b4bd7070bf5b8eaf0e.text: 咒语。失去1苦行僧结界。如果以这种方式移除苦行僧结界，所有附近的敌人都会失去 1 点结界并受到 20…68…80 点寒冷伤害。

af49c8d572dc5cf5fabf638fa812b7963be999b9.source: Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 27…65…75% chance to block incoming projectiles. Zojun's Haste ends if you attack.
af49c8d572dc5cf5fabf638fa812b7963be999b9.text: 立场。在 5…10…11 秒内，你的移动速度加快 33%，并且有 27…65…75% 的机会阻挡传入的射弹。如果你攻击，佐君的急速就会结束。

71733f850cab12e23cd9b556cd4512057b236aa4.source: Shout. (5…13…15 seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals 15…63…75 damage to all foes near target ally. Cannot self-target.
71733f850cab12e23cd9b556cd4512057b236aa4.text: 喊叫。 （5…13…15 秒。）防止下一次击倒并对目标盟友附近的所有敌人造成 15…63…75 点伤害。无法自我定位。

f945760a39f841253bc625bbe69cd91475d0b6b4.source: Shout. (5…13…15 seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals 15…75…90 damage to one foe near target ally. Cannot self-target.
f945760a39f841253bc625bbe69cd91475d0b6b4.text: 喊叫。 （5…13…15 秒。）防止下一次击倒并对目标盟友附近的一名敌人造成 15…75…90 点伤害。无法自我定位。

9bfd89963ba583fc653dddfa8a5f934bb988247c.source: Shout. (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal 25…33% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.
9bfd89963ba583fc653dddfa8a5f934bb988247c.text: 喊叫。 （30 秒。） 复活所有在听力范围内死亡的队员，并充满生命值和能量。受影响的队伍成员造成 25…33% 点额外伤害。受影响的队员在结束时死亡，但不会被判处死刑。

fc19084eb4d235f5a86cb719690c6284d3fb0b59.source: Shout. (20 seconds.) The next 1…4…5 touch-range skills used against allies within earshot fails.
fc19084eb4d235f5a86cb719690c6284d3fb0b59.text: 喊叫。 （20 秒。）接下来对听力范围内的盟友使用的 1…4…5 接触范围技能失败。

e4b63e785f5014fc1f56dbe02ab23a7a4f3452b4.source: Shout. (20 seconds.) The next 1…4…5 touch-range skills used against you fails.
e4b63e785f5014fc1f56dbe02ab23a7a4f3452b4.text: 喊叫。 （20秒。）接下来对你使用的1…4…5个接触范围技能失败了。

9ba8c447ba352818b838ad058fcf1f4f791856da.source: Elite Shout. (5…11…13 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 33% faster. Initial effect: these allies lose the Crippled condition.
9ba8c447ba352818b838ad058fcf1f4f791856da.text: 精英呐喊。 （5…11…13 秒。）听力范围内的盟友移动速度加快 33%。初始效果：这些盟友失去残废状态。

b5db1fa3e6c97406ad31dd1a605673ca5812ead5.source: Elite Shout. Causes knock-down if target foe is moving.
b5db1fa3e6c97406ad31dd1a605673ca5812ead5.text: 精英呐喊。如果目标敌人正在移动，则会导致击倒。

a2a161fdecfb22514edb9832a69322342c30298e.source: Shout. (16…20 seconds.) Your next attack is unblockable and deals +14…20 damage.
a2a161fdecfb22514edb9832a69322342c30298e.text: 喊叫。 （16…20秒。）你的下一次攻击不可阻挡并造成+14…20点伤害。

cb99071f08d869ce65211f665cffd07f4e12c8b2.source: Shout. (3…5 seconds.) Prevents knock-down; affects party members within earshot.
cb99071f08d869ce65211f665cffd07f4e12c8b2.text: 喊叫。 （3…5 秒。）防止击倒；影响到听得见的队员。

b6e2c8544ef0fde44786a5a795a6223b0985ce0d.source: Shout. (4…9…10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 5…13…15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. Ends for an ally if that ally hits with an attack.
b6e2c8544ef0fde44786a5a795a6223b0985ce0d.text: 喊叫。 （4…9…10 秒。） 听力范围内的盟友移动时每秒获得 5…13…15 点生命值，移动速度加快 33% 点。如果盟友受到攻击，则该盟友结束。

9d2057216368ea92fd1e98a30017ff7d2177b936.source: Shout. (1…12…15 seconds.) You have +5…25…30% chance of a critical hit with melee attacks against stationary foes. Initial effect: nearby foes lose 2…5…6 Energy.
9d2057216368ea92fd1e98a30017ff7d2177b936.text: 喊叫。 （1…12…15 秒。）你对静止的敌人进行近战攻击时有 +5…25…30% 几率造成致命一击。初始效果：附近敌人损失2…5…6点能量。

5a844839e4598ab36098cae52ebd752d65f62f33.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) Target ally deals +5…41…50 damage and inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) with the next attack.
5a844839e4598ab36098cae52ebd752d65f62f33.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20秒。）目标盟友在下次攻击中造成+5…41…50点伤害并造成深度受伤状态（5…17…20秒）。

8a2f5e1ddece86173400bf68d06ccbc94867e059.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) Target ally inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) with the next critical hit.
8a2f5e1ddece86173400bf68d06ccbc94867e059.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20 秒。）目标盟友在下一次暴击时造成深度受伤状态（5…17…20 秒）。

e314121c660d0245a6e5b1f85855f8b62ee48e8b.source: Shout. Deals 44…80 damage and inflicts Cracked Armor and Deep Wound conditions (12…20 seconds). No effect unless target foe has less than 50% Health.
e314121c660d0245a6e5b1f85855f8b62ee48e8b.text: 喊叫。造成 44…80 点伤害并造成盔甲破裂和深度伤口状态（12…20 秒）。除非目标敌人的生命值低于 50%，否则无效。

53b954022f08628011795e5eb104bea933bbbbe0.source: Shout. (20 seconds.) You gain 100% more adrenaline.
53b954022f08628011795e5eb104bea933bbbbe0.text: 喊叫。 （20 秒。）您获得了 100% 的更多肾上腺素。

b8e5d89ccef30f6d2e464de7f2289b4cb53e5d7a.source: Shout. (8 seconds.) You gain 1 extra strike of adrenaline whenever you hit with an attack.
b8e5d89ccef30f6d2e464de7f2289b4cb53e5d7a.text: 喊叫。 （8秒。）每当你受到攻击时，你都会获得1额外的肾上腺素打击。

d72471463e256a4c0e784359f842fec86da894e4.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +30…86…100% to land a critical hit with their next attack.
d72471463e256a4c0e784359f842fec86da894e4.text: 喊叫。 （10 秒。） 听得见的盟友有 +30…86…100% 秒的时间在下次攻击中造成致命一击。

8aed2be8caf4021e9a071083f13cea81c8cf1740.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +30…66…75% to land a critical hit with their next attack.
8aed2be8caf4021e9a071083f13cea81c8cf1740.text: 喊叫。 （10 秒。） 听得见的盟友有 +30…66…75% 秒的时间在下次攻击中造成致命一击。

30d99396f4a46335b5c10898a344f567b09b90e1.source: Shout. (1…8…10 seconds.) Target non-spirit ally gains 15…75…90 health, allied spells targeting them cast 50% faster.
30d99396f4a46335b5c10898a344f567b09b90e1.text: 喊叫。 （1…8…10秒。）目标非精神盟友获得15…75…90点生命值，针对他们的盟友法术施放速度加快50%点。

01370fee8cc86fe49b036cde786929a18d71c6e9.source: Shout. (1…8…10 seconds.) Target non-spirit ally gains 5…41…50 health, allied spells targeting them cast 50% faster.
01370fee8cc86fe49b036cde786929a18d71c6e9.text: 喊叫。 （1…8…10秒。）目标非精神盟友获得5…41…50点生命值，针对他们的盟友法术施放速度加快50%点。

e752001de023ec12f6424db611878740e549dadf.source: Shout. Your next 5…8 attacks deal +14…20 damage.
e752001de023ec12f6424db611878740e549dadf.text: 喊叫。你接下来的 5…8 次攻击会造成 +14…20 点伤害。

013b835a4c7870ce42c17a372b20e08c0aa7f44a.source: Shout. (16…20 seconds.) You have +24 armor and cannot be knocked-down or Crippled.
013b835a4c7870ce42c17a372b20e08c0aa7f44a.text: 喊叫。 （16…20 秒。）你有 +24 点护甲，不会被击倒或致残。

bf20267c7a672a8db587d05893e9704953e44c36.source: Shout. You gain 1…5…6 strikes of adrenaline if you are knocked-down.
bf20267c7a672a8db587d05893e9704953e44c36.text: 喊叫。如果你被击倒，你会获得 1…5…6 次肾上腺素打击。

b68e1b4ba165d5b43c92c617c6f39188edc63d4f.source: Shout. You have +3…6…7 Health regeneration and attack 25% faster (10 seconds for each dead ally).
b68e1b4ba165d5b43c92c617c6f39188edc63d4f.text: 喊叫。你有 +3…6…7 点生命恢复，攻击速度加快 25%（每个死亡盟友 10 秒）。

4c71cc1b97d7a0ec010c869ee2e5944261b1b49b.source: Shout. (5…10…11 seconds.) You have +3 Health regeneration for each condition on you.
4c71cc1b97d7a0ec010c869ee2e5944261b1b49b.text: 喊叫。 （5…10…11 秒。）你的每种情况都会恢复 +3 点生命值。

b693389b77058f1b892ccaf54a6885ca1f7a6ed4.source: Elite Shout. (4…9…10 seconds) Allies in earshot move 33% faster and gain 5…13…15 Health while moving.
b693389b77058f1b892ccaf54a6885ca1f7a6ed4.text: 精英呐喊。 （4…9…10 秒）听力范围内的盟友移动速度加快 33%，移动时获得 5…13…15 生命值。

7285c3e644b29fe8ee84a811e26ad385b7d7a9af.source: Elite Shout. Remove all conditions from target ally. That ally moves 25% faster (1…8…10 seconds) if a condition was removed. Cannot self-target.
7285c3e644b29fe8ee84a811e26ad385b7d7a9af.text: 精英呐喊。移除目标盟友的所有条件。如果条件被移除，该盟友的移动速度将加快 25% 倍（1…8…10 秒）。无法自我定位。

d2005f4d9401b3408874bf1196045972c2954e2b.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range take 4 additional damage whenever they take physical damage. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
d2005f4d9401b3408874bf1196045972c2954e2b.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。范围内的非灵体生物在受到物理伤害时会受到 4 点额外伤害。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

60965b93b7ff32d87aa51b7a982ebeddc82a439f.source: Shout. Target ally moves 25% faster for 1…4…5 seconds (maximum of 30 seconds) for each ally in earshot.
60965b93b7ff32d87aa51b7a982ebeddc82a439f.text: 喊。每听到一个盟友，目标盟友的移动速度就会加快 25%，持续 1…4…5 秒（最多 30 秒）。

f04aeea69df2d369fca89681f751a8f821fda3f2.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) Target ally moves 33% faster. Ends if target ally hits with an attack. Cannot self-target.
f04aeea69df2d369fca89681f751a8f821fda3f2.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20 秒。）目标盟友移动速度加快 33%。如果目标盟友受到攻击则结束。无法自我定位。

f8e5931c0002049e4ed6d5be1b4dec6f9f47d820.source: Shout. You gain two adrenaline (maximum 1…7…8) for each party member in earshot.
f8e5931c0002049e4ed6d5be1b4dec6f9f47d820.text: 喊叫。听力范围内的每个队员都会获得两份肾上腺素（最多 1…7…8）。

f49b5ac2715fffb70af8eb024c315b9bb5bd85aa.source: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. For creatures within its range, all elemental damage is cold damage instead. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
f49b5ac2715fffb70af8eb024c315b9bb5bd85aa.text: 自然仪式。创造1…8…10级武魂。对于其范围内的生物，所有元素伤害都改为冰冷伤害。该灵魂会在 30…198…240 秒后死亡。

e6b07020ce2eb4f3fadc80afd0f798f025c64828.source: Hex Spell. For 2…5…6 seconds, target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5…13…15 damage while moving.
e6b07020ce2eb4f3fadc80afd0f798f025c64828.text: 降咒魔法。在 2…5…6 秒内，目标敌人的移动速度减慢 66%，并在移动时受到 5…13…15 点伤害。

a0855e5e65ec0778e2ba87e39d0e08cc18d71b77.source: Elite Spell. Remove all hexes from target ally and all adjacent allies. This spell takes an additional 2 seconds to recharge for each hex removed in this way. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
a0855e5e65ec0778e2ba87e39d0e08cc18d71b77.text: 精英法术。移除目标盟友和所有相邻盟友的所有六角形。以这种方式移除每个六角形，该法术需要额外 2 秒的时间来重新充电。 （50% 神圣恩惠的失败几率为 4 或更少。）

dc2570fc39ff8397f80a8286dd62899f983dac11.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…29…35 seconds, target foe suffers -2…4…4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. If target foe's Energy reaches 0, that foe takes 15…63…75 damage and Wither ends.
dc2570fc39ff8397f80a8286dd62899f983dac11.text: 精英六角咒语。在 5…29…35 秒内，目标敌人遭受 -2…4…4 点生命值退化和 -1 点能量退化。如果目标敌人的能量达到 0，则该敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害，凋零结束。

0bb71954da7ec1aa81891709fade5744b8c5fda8.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
0bb71954da7ec1aa81891709fade5744b8c5fda8.text: 结界咒语。 5…17…20秒内，目标盟友的近战攻击造成虚弱5…17…20秒。

a5dbbd98e7d1a399e81c8fbebc0c688899eab36a.source: Elite Spell. Target foe takes 30…110…130 holy damage. If your target was below 50% Health, Word of Censure takes 20 additional seconds to recharge.
a5dbbd98e7d1a399e81c8fbebc0c688899eab36a.text: 精英法术。目标敌人受到 30…110…130 点神圣伤害。如果你的目标生命值低于 50%，谴责之言需要额外 20 秒的时间来充电。

6a7041b8d4a04029d25fe22b575238069cc280bf.source: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.
6a7041b8d4a04029d25fe22b575238069cc280bf.text: 精英法术。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 生命值。如果该盟友的生命值低于 50% 点，则额外治疗 30…98…115 点生命值。

02a13d3bd46abec498edef731e1c4b278c53b861.source: Spell. Target ally is healed for 20…56…65 Health and an additional 20…44…50 Health if that ally is suffering from a condition.
02a13d3bd46abec498edef731e1c4b278c53b861.text: 咒语。目标盟友将被治愈 20…56…65 点生命值，如果该盟友患有某种疾病，则还会额外获得 20…44…50 点生命值。

574e28238b73b15c01e69988e5903e352349db00.source: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you do +5…17…20 damage, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
574e28238b73b15c01e69988e5903e352349db00.text: 精英镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害，目标敌人会流血 5…17…20 秒，并且你会失去 1 点苦行僧结界。如果结界被移除，目标敌人也会受到深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

69eff312f49d600c3fa3ae7cd2ad996c7d47a2ef.source: Shout. Allies in earshot gain 1…8…10 Energy. Only affects allies below 75% Health.
69eff312f49d600c3fa3ae7cd2ad996c7d47a2ef.text: 喊。听力范围内的盟友获得 1…8…10 能量。只影响生命值低于 75% 的盟友。

7fd92da946c00905ccbd49c6a5ab5b2491d820e7.source: Shout. (15 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +1…4…5 Health regeneration. Only affects party members below 75% Health.
7fd92da946c00905ccbd49c6a5ab5b2491d820e7.text: 喊叫。 （15 秒。） 听得见的队员获得 +1…4…5 生命值回复。只影响生命值低于75%的队员。

b1f5d7a233dd9a2e61953c53f6a825bade04660d.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +1…4…5 Health regeneration. Only affects party members below 75% Health.
b1f5d7a233dd9a2e61953c53f6a825bade04660d.text: 喊叫。 （10 秒。） 听得见的队员获得 +1…4…5 生命值回复。只影响生命值低于75%的队员。

fdcb622f84b8c4df96ef6b47db2d2def6ef5726d.source: Shout. Knocks down all nearby moving foes. Recharges 1…7…8 seconds faster for each affected foe (maximum 25 seconds).
fdcb622f84b8c4df96ef6b47db2d2def6ef5726d.text: 喊叫。击倒附近所有移动的敌人。每个受影响的敌人的充电速度加快 1…7…8 秒（最多 25 秒）。

769e2d560781b88522b22d481430131f0a20ad8b.source: Shout. Recharges all your stances if you are adjacent to a knocked-down foe. You lose all adrenaline.
769e2d560781b88522b22d481430131f0a20ad8b.text: 喊叫。如果您与被击倒的敌人相邻，则可以为您的所有姿态重新充电。你失去了所有的肾上腺素。

8528be627a527d429915951cd87bd9a808f2b939.source: Shout. (5…10…11 seconds.) Party members in earshot move 33% faster. No effect unless there are dead allies within earshot.
8528be627a527d429915951cd87bd9a808f2b939.text: 喊叫。 （5…10…11秒。）听得见的队员移动速度加快了33%。除非在听力范围内有死去的盟友，否则没有效果。

60279eeaad1168fdeab24da722995bfa393832ef.source: Shout. (4…6 seconds.) All other party members gain +100 armor.
60279eeaad1168fdeab24da722995bfa393832ef.text: 喊叫。 （4…6秒。）所有其他队伍成员获得+100点护甲。

81a3e99f66b415b36989135ea20bdc0173ce2c6e.source: Shout. (5…10…11 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +60 armor against projectile attacks.
81a3e99f66b415b36989135ea20bdc0173ce2c6e.text: 喊叫。 （5…10…11 秒。） 听得见的队员拥有 +60 的装甲来抵御投射物攻击。

2a667ab8305032634cb99b0f5ea1cd0c4075c134.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving.
2a667ab8305032634cb99b0f5ea1cd0c4075c134.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20秒。）听得见的队员在不移动时获得+24点护甲。

27a2a10f4e3e184d7617a18c3d42ef2bd400149d.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving. Ends for an ally if that ally attacks.
27a2a10f4e3e184d7617a18c3d42ef2bd400149d.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20秒。）听得见的队员在不移动时获得+24点护甲。如果盟友发起攻击，则该盟友结束。

4016ebace4a7094a25c0f413f14f813a61a75387.source: Elite Shout. (2…4…4 seconds.) Allies within earshot gain 1…2…2 Energy regeneration.
4016ebace4a7094a25c0f413f14f813a61a75387.text: 精英呐喊。 （2…4…4 秒。）听力范围内的盟友获得 1…2…2 能量再生。

bdfc861d51ac125cfb22e0ae910da9374dfb0229.source: Shout. (4 seconds plus 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership.) Reduces damage by 20…35% for party members in earshot. End effect: heals for 35…60 Health.
bdfc861d51ac125cfb22e0ae910da9374dfb0229.text: 喊叫。 （4 秒加上领导力每 2 级增加 1 秒。）对听力范围内的队员减少 20…35% 点伤害。最终效果：治愈 35…60 点生命值。

254519371c569c6a4af137afe61db0f6e557a090.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot take 5…29…35% less damage from Burning foes.
254519371c569c6a4af137afe61db0f6e557a090.text: 喊叫。 （10 秒。） 听力范围内的队员受到燃烧敌人的伤害减少 5…29…35%。

d4e0b01b4526cf19abc6ada4722c0dde4ad3bec0.source: Shout. (10…18…20 seconds.) You have +10…50…60 maximum Health. Initial effect: you gain one strike of adrenaline for each foe within earshot (maximum 1…5…6).
d4e0b01b4526cf19abc6ada4722c0dde4ad3bec0.text: 喊叫。 （10…18…20 秒。）您的最大生命值为 +10…50…60。初始效果：每听到一个敌人，你就会获得一次肾上腺素打击（最多 1…5…6）。

13783293c3946216cbf8363b7d874c2a6caecc79.source: Elite Shout. (3…13…15 seconds.) All party members near you or your pet deal +5…13…15 damage Additional damage only applies to attacks and gain +1…6…7 Health regeneration. PvE Skill
13783293c3946216cbf8363b7d874c2a6caecc79.text: 精英呐喊。 （3…13…15秒。）你或你的宠物附近的所有队伍成员造成+5…13…15点伤害额外伤害仅适用于攻击并获得+1…6…7点生命恢复。 PvE技能

70dbd91f5d759551556fea03e0e5a2e2b8d2b06d.source: Elite Shout. You gain 10…56…68 Health and 3…6…7 Energy for each condition on target foe.
70dbd91f5d759551556fea03e0e5a2e2b8d2b06d.text: 精英呐喊。对于目标敌人的每种情况，你都会获得 10…56…68 点生命值和 3…6…7 点能量。

6ee1b061eedf177ed51f1f9407b8ed41d657120b.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +5…21…25 armor. Ends after 10 incoming attacks.
6ee1b061eedf177ed51f1f9407b8ed41d657120b.text: 喊叫。 （10 秒。） 听得见的队员拥有 +5…21…25 护甲。在 10 次传入攻击后结束。

f5e5a50a9969867ef6a001c6377844f2e427739c.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +5…21…25 armor. Ends after 1…3…3 incoming attacks.
f5e5a50a9969867ef6a001c6377844f2e427739c.text: 喊叫。 （10 秒。） 听得见的队员拥有 +5…21…25 护甲。在 1…3…3 次传入攻击后结束。

fcc47d6a0907b132cbe213f926f3e8d50f96f71d.source: Shout. All party members in earshot are resurrected (25…45…50% Health and 5…17…20% Energy).
fcc47d6a0907b132cbe213f926f3e8d50f96f71d.text: 喊叫。听力范围内的所有队员均已复活（25…45…50% 生命值和 5…17…20% 能量）。

53cbe0e4f67d6a28654ef95ba95f0b745f788368.source: Shout. (10 seconds.) Whenever party members in earshot use a resurrection skill, their fallen allies return with 10…62…75% more Health and 5…41…50% more Energy.
53cbe0e4f67d6a28654ef95ba95f0b745f788368.text: 喊叫。 （10秒。）每当听得见的队员使用复活技能时，他们阵亡的盟友就会带着10…62…75%点生命值和5…41…50%点能量回归。

aca4cb53bf19e8e5f3c5f2dce1cca25fa3863fec.source: Shout. Inflicts Weakness condition (8…12 seconds). Also affects adjacent foes.
aca4cb53bf19e8e5f3c5f2dce1cca25fa3863fec.text: 喊叫。造成虚弱状态（8…12秒）。也会影响邻近的敌人。

16e28ace41e8e278430ac5a5a6531414e28a156a.source: Shout. Deals 44…80 damage, causes knock-down, and inflicts Crippled condition (8…15 seconds).
16e28ace41e8e278430ac5a5a6531414e28a156a.text: 喊叫。造成 44…80 点伤害，造成击倒，并造成瘫痪状态（8…15 秒）。

34ac6a9b745b30e297f7dc85acea455bb0db4544.source: Shout. You gain 1…3…3 strikes of adrenaline. No effect unless target foe is under 90% Health.
34ac6a9b745b30e297f7dc85acea455bb0db4544.text: 喊叫。你获得 1…3…3 次肾上腺素冲击。除非目标敌人的生命值低于 90%，否则无效。

7ae5d84696415982f795531f749619e7853f9b0c.source: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
7ae5d84696415982f795531f749619e7853f9b0c.text: 精英镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，目标敌人会流血 5…17…20 秒，并且你失去 1 个苦行僧结界。如果结界被移除，目标敌人也会受到深度伤害，持续 5…17…20 秒。

e1ed8bb5a3de174acf3bf85c229a32a09bf17519.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage from a foe that damage is limited to 5% of that ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20…68…80 Health from that foe.
e1ed8bb5a3de174acf3bf85c229a32a09bf17519.text: 精英武器法术。在 8 秒内，下次目标盟友受到敌人伤害时，该伤害将限制为该盟友最大生命值的 5% 点，并且该盟友会从该敌人处窃取最多 20…68…80 点生命值。

484a806b7153e8295ddeb206549b4d816cc0abb8.source: Hammer Attack. Lose all adrenaline. Attack all adjacent foes. If this attack strikes a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
484a806b7153e8295ddeb206549b4d816cc0abb8.text: 锤子攻击。失去所有肾上腺素。攻击所有邻近的敌人。如果此攻击击中患有某种病症的敌人，则该敌人会被击倒。 （锤子精通 4 或更少时，失败几率为 50%。）
