d4d8c478b9fca647c169eebe1adbdbd1934b8f74.source: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you use a skill that targets an ally, all foes adjacent to that target are struck for 5…29…35 fire damage and you lose 1 Energy.
d4d8c478b9fca647c169eebe1adbdbd1934b8f74.text: 结界咒语。在 60 秒内，每当你使用针对盟友的技能时，与该目标相邻的所有敌人都会受到 5…29…35 点火焰伤害，并且你会损失 1 点能量。

c04c08aa482a044a56664068e9541d837fd8320e.source: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses an attack skill, that ally gains 1…7…8 Energy.
c04c08aa482a044a56664068e9541d837fd8320e.text: 吟诵。在 10 秒内，每次听力范围内的盟友下次使用攻击技能时，该盟友获得 1…7…8 点能量。

779c747cb8d765c0b12145892b9590d086c6d234.source: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 30…150…180 Health. If target was below 50% Health, you gain 7 Energy.
779c747cb8d765c0b12145892b9590d086c6d234.text: 精英法术。治疗目标盟友 30…150…180 生命值。如果目标低于 50% 生命值，您将获得 7 能量。

4d18b96d4d06dfdea740605a652e4e8d646feb73.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes take 5…25…30 holy damage. For 5…21…25 seconds, you have -1 Energy regeneration, and gain 1 Energy whenever you hit a foe. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you gain 1…4…5 Energy.
4d18b96d4d06dfdea740605a652e4e8d646feb73.text: 闪光附魔咒语。所有附近的敌人都会受到 5…25…30 点神圣伤害。在 5…21…25 秒内，你有 -1 点能量再生，每当你击中敌人时就会获得 1 点能量。如果此结界提前结束，你将获得 1…4…5 点能量。

9e4d2cb4a370d1c8e541b56a9af518989a80ae14.source: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5…17…20 damage. You gain 3 Energy and 1 adrenaline for each foe you hit.
9e4d2cb4a370d1c8e541b56a9af518989a80ae14.text: 镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。每击中一个敌人，你就会获得 3 点能量和 1 点肾上腺素。

154ef9cf1b31f5ae1d9c1129d1c3e3c91fe7f288.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have -2 Energy regeneration, and you gain 1…5…6 Energy every time you hit with an attack.
154ef9cf1b31f5ae1d9c1129d1c3e3c91fe7f288.text: 精英结界法术。在 20 秒内，你有 -2 点能量再生，每次攻击时你都会获得 1…5…6 点能量。

56db66d9069a4814c12bbf4d5a650419122593bd.source: Elite Shout. Inflicts Cripple and Weakness conditions (8 seconds). No effect if target foe is near one of its allies.
56db66d9069a4814c12bbf4d5a650419122593bd.text: 精英呐喊。造成瘫痪和虚弱状态（8 秒）。如果目标敌人靠近其盟友之一，则无效。

4d7194f2b68c0b07613f0412c82154f8d13381fb.source: Touch Hex Spell. Deals 44…80 damage. Target foe cannot attack (5…7…8 seconds) if it was knocked-down.
4d7194f2b68c0b07613f0412c82154f8d13381fb.text: 触摸降咒魔法。造成 44…80 点伤害。如果目标敌人被击倒，则无法攻击（5…7…8 秒）。

4e5d3c360afa9285936924a87a1253c7ef631c6a.source: Spell. Deals 15…63…75 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.
4e5d3c360afa9285936924a87a1253c7ef631c6a.text: 咒语。造成 15…63…75 点伤害。如果目标敌人有 2 个或更多的六角形，则造成深度伤害状态（5…17…20 秒）。

31f545c36317c1c25355cb06984a1aaf1c1505dc.source: Spell. Deals 10…30…35 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.
31f545c36317c1c25355cb06984a1aaf1c1505dc.text: 咒语。造成 10…30…35 点伤害。如果目标敌人有 2 个或更多的六角形，则造成深度伤害状态（5…17…20 秒）。

3ef50b5c22171cc06ef0603e2a3030f44d071c9c.source: Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members within earshot (6…13…15 seconds). 50% chance to block.
3ef50b5c22171cc06ef0603e2a3030f44d071c9c.text: 结界咒语。使听力范围内的所有队伍成员着迷（6…13…15 秒）。 50% 次格挡机会。

ff84bbd657ede0479eba54a7cc8fa731ef6e0810.source: Enchantment Spell. (1…3…3 seconds). Target party member cannot be targeted by hostile spells. Attacks against this party member fail. Cannot self-target.
ff84bbd657ede0479eba54a7cc8fa731ef6e0810.text: 结界咒语。 （1…3…3 秒）。目标队伍成员不能成为敌对法术的目标。针对该队员的攻击失败。无法自我定位。

12c5465a1c223e216c1602961fd3fe883b467380.source: Spell. Deals 15…71…85 earth damage to nearby foes. Deals 15…71…85 more earth damage to knocked down foes.
12c5465a1c223e216c1602961fd3fe883b467380.text: 咒语。对附近的敌人造成 15…71…85 点土属性伤害。对被击倒的敌人造成额外 15…71…85 点土系伤害。

f113d2d8d62f176843c21b4f6e2fc7ff961e9f51.source: Echo. (5…21…25 seconds.) You attack 25% faster. Renewal: whenever a chant or shout ends on you. You have -20 armor.
f113d2d8d62f176843c21b4f6e2fc7ff961e9f51.text: 回声。 （5…21…25秒。）你攻击25%的速度更快。更新：每当圣歌或喊叫声在你身上结束时。你有-20护甲。

31e6033db56f5fbaceb43443880fce4f3c16b4e8.source: Axe Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. Interrupts an action if target foe has a Deep Wound.
31e6033db56f5fbaceb43443880fce4f3c16b4e8.text: 斧头攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人伤口较深，则中断行动。

294ce2959d33277cb3bf425b496054cab4004493.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (30…78…90 second lifespan). Causes 3…9…10 Health loss each second to foes in earshot. This spirit loses 3…9…10 Health for each foe that loses Health.
294ce2959d33277cb3bf425b496054cab4004493.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命30…78…90）。每秒对听力范围内的敌人造成 3…9…10 点生命值损失。每失去一个敌人生命值，该精魂就会失去 3…9…10 点生命值。

c2f30d7fa5ec1af7474399a113a3860181cf7dca.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (30…78…90 second lifespan). Causes 3…9…10 Health loss each second to foes in earshot. This spirit loses 3…9…10 Health for each foe that loses Health.
c2f30d7fa5ec1af7474399a113a3860181cf7dca.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命30…78…90）。每秒对听力范围内的敌人造成 3…9…10 点生命值损失。每失去一个敌人生命值，该精魂就会失去 3…9…10 点生命值。

fa1706f4220079132cb85be68f4995a37b267a87.source: Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost whenever you use an Air Magic skill.
fa1706f4220079132cb85be68f4995a37b267a87.text: 结界咒语。 （36…55…60秒。）每当你使用空气魔法技能时，你都会获得1点能量加上30%点能量消耗。

73af17cef1e83f5bfd70d3ac04f22f5aa63d1adf.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (5…17…20 seconds). Remove one enchantment from target and nearby foes. Enchantments expire 150…270…300% faster on those foes.
73af17cef1e83f5bfd70d3ac04f22f5aa63d1adf.text: 精英六角咒语。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（5…17…20 秒）。移除目标和附近敌人的一项结界。这些敌人的结界会更快失效 150…270…300%。

bd255a4076a3870d36bccf7eab7500cb10cfbd74.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (4…9…10 seconds.) Enchantments cast on target ally cost 10 less Energy (minimum 1 Energy). Cannot self-target.
bd255a4076a3870d36bccf7eab7500cb10cfbd74.text: 精英结界法术。 （4…9…10 秒。）对目标盟友施展的结界消耗的能量减少 10 点（最少 1 点能量）。无法自我定位。

0f151959151351302c61ff3bc5a26014c771067f.source: Skill. (20…30 seconds). Gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.
0f151959151351302c61ff3bc5a26014c771067f.text: 技能。 （20…30 秒）。每次杀死敌人获得经验时，都会获得随机的阿修罗好处。

83f51b1939120624e1e9abc3fc91f3e77b723cb5.source: Spell. Projectile: deals 40…50 damage to target and adjacent foes. Deals 45…70 more damage and inflicts Cracked Armor condition (14…20 seconds) to Destroyers.
83f51b1939120624e1e9abc3fc91f3e77b723cb5.text: 咒语。投射物：对目标和邻近敌人造成 40…50 点伤害。对驱逐舰造成额外 45…70 点伤害并造成装甲破裂状态（14…20 秒）。

ad6701816864c9a10a85f4901330b75090049845.source: Elite Hex Spell. (4…10…12 seconds.) Foes adjacent to you cannot attack. Ends on any foes that take damage.
ad6701816864c9a10a85f4901330b75090049845.text: 精英六角咒语。 （4…10…12 秒。）与你相邻的敌人无法攻击。结束于任何受到伤害的敌人。

90203b5008ff719091c5ecbabd2009e2e3addabf.source: Enchantment Spell. (4…9…10 seconds.) All adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy whenever a melee attack hits target ally.
90203b5008ff719091c5ecbabd2009e2e3addabf.text: 结界咒语。 （4…9…10 秒。）每当近战攻击击中目标盟友时，所有相邻敌人都会失去所有肾上腺素和 3 能量。

aa206b0b337b4798a399054cbca7cb0c45e90870.source: Skill. (1 second.) End Effect: deals 5…89…110 lightning damage to foes adjacent to target ally.
aa206b0b337b4798a399054cbca7cb0c45e90870.text: 技能。 （1 秒。） 最终效果：对目标盟友附近的敌人造成 5…89…110 点闪电伤害。

91d3fa8e6ca909ac2adfd381172ebf3c44f74b8a.source: Skill. (3 seconds.) Deals 4…41…50 lightning damage to foes adjacent to target ally each second.
91d3fa8e6ca909ac2adfd381172ebf3c44f74b8a.text: 技能。 （3 秒。）每秒对目标盟友附近的敌人造成 4…41…50 点闪电伤害。

287800feb08f46a6fd4f4f4d21311710d453c517.source: Spell. Target foe regains all Energy. For each point of Energy gained, target takes 1…3…3 damage and all adjacent foes lose 1 Energy (maximum 1…24…30).
287800feb08f46a6fd4f4f4d21311710d453c517.text: 咒语。目标敌人恢复所有能量。每获得一点能量，目标就会受到 1…3…3 点伤害，所有相邻敌人都会损失 1 点能量（最多 1…24…30 点）。

81a872eb807b38cbc2792852dd8b52007ecdefa7.source: Elite Skill. (10 seconds.) The next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20…164…200. Ends on other allies.
81a872eb807b38cbc2792852dd8b52007ecdefa7.text: 精英技能。 （10 秒。）下次在听力范围内的盟友受到致命伤害时，该伤害将被抵消，并且该盟友将获得 20…164…200 点治疗。在其他盟友上结束。

003eb75c777b0d55ebf73b1ab27155b6b49e963b.source: Skill. (10 seconds.) Each second that target ally takes damage over 250…114…80, that ally is healed for any damage over that amount. Cannot self target.
003eb75c777b0d55ebf73b1ab27155b6b49e963b.text: 技能。 （10 秒。）目标盟友受到超过 250…114…80 点伤害的每一秒，该盟友就会因超过该数量的任何伤害而受到治疗。无法自我瞄准。

487a33efa585b751faf379fff5095b435098a84a.source: Spell. Steals 10…42…50 Health. You gain 3…10…12 Energy if you have a condition.
487a33efa585b751faf379fff5095b435098a84a.text: 咒语。窃取 10…42…50 点生命值。如果您有病症，您将获得 3…10…12 能量。

8654fd421c81608949598b3b5c2ff1852175cef1.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…9…11 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage. Double damage to hexed foes.
8654fd421c81608949598b3b5c2ff1852175cef1.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…9…11级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害。对施咒的敌人造成双倍伤害。

f15fa3d8b44660a2af52baa897b975daf935118b.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…6…7 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage. Double damage to hexed foes.
f15fa3d8b44660a2af52baa897b975daf935118b.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…6…7级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害。对施咒的敌人造成双倍伤害。

354630c233d3a2a8eab955bea26cf0b8aa95b07a.source: Item Spell. (10…50…60 seconds.) Your Ritualist hexes cost 1…4…5 less energy and last 50% longer. Drop effect: all your Ritualist hexes are recharged.
354630c233d3a2a8eab955bea26cf0b8aa95b07a.text: 物品法术。 （10…50…60 秒。）你的仪式六角形消耗的能量减少 1…4…5，持续时间延长 50%。掉落效果：你所有的仪式者六角形都已充能。

eadfb56ecd146a60e2e3edb476396ca0d22385d3.source: Spell. Creates a level 1…14…17 bone fiend that can attack at range. Exploits a fresh corpse.
eadfb56ecd146a60e2e3edb476396ca0d22385d3.text: 咒语。创建一个等级 1…14…17 的骨魔，可以进行远程攻击。利用新鲜尸体。

9a5788c5954190b33c6e387ef95c588ee44a281c.source: Spell. Creates a level 1…14…17 bone horror. Exploits a fresh corpse.
9a5788c5954190b33c6e387ef95c588ee44a281c.text: 咒语。创造出1…14…17级的骸骨恐怖。利用新鲜尸体。

07df7ae1186d1da2eee0e0e6903cd703c296f417.source: Spell. Creates two level 0…10…12 bone minions. Exploits a fresh corpse.
07df7ae1186d1da2eee0e0e6903cd703c296f417.text: 咒语。创建两个等级 0…10…12 的骨仆。利用新鲜尸体。

1dc3dbc917e638edba16b82a3732e5d03106fb83.source: Elite Spell. Creates a level 3…21…25 flesh golem which leaves 1…3…4 fresh corpse(s) when it dies. Exploits a fresh corpse. You can have only one flesh golem at a time.
1dc3dbc917e638edba16b82a3732e5d03106fb83.text: 精英法术。创建一个等级 3…21…25 的肉傀儡，死亡时留下 1…3…4 具新鲜尸体。利用新鲜尸体。你一次只能拥有一个血肉傀儡。

e42933da5175e0f1363a557f9b0afef6be6c85da.source: Spell. Creates a level 1…14…17 shambling horror. When the shambling horror dies, it is replaced by a level 0…12…15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks. Exploits a fresh corpse.
e42933da5175e0f1363a557f9b0afef6be6c85da.text: 咒语。创建 1…14…17 级的蹒跚恐怖。当步履蹒跚的恐怖生物死亡时，它会被等级 0…12…15 的锯齿状恐怖生物取代，每次攻击都会导致流血。利用新鲜尸体。

8f6e762be84d3eb2c1a3e0bea35d4c5090d271b2.source: Spell. Creates a level 1…14…17 vampiric horror. You gain Health equal to the damage it deals. Exploits a fresh corpse.
8f6e762be84d3eb2c1a3e0bea35d4c5090d271b2.text: 咒语。创造出1…14…17级的吸血鬼恐怖。您获得的生命值等于其造成的伤害。利用新鲜尸体。

7d65df59d19fe06bb170db5585f8fe314a34132b.source: Chant. (1…8…10 seconds.) Allies in earshot interrupt an action with their next attack skill.
7d65df59d19fe06bb170db5585f8fe314a34132b.text: 吟诵。 （1…8…10 秒。）听力范围内的盟友用下一个攻击技能打断一个动作。

fcef373d93579c64909fabe01d88839bf76630ab.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot do +10…22…25 damage with their next attack skill. Damage bonus only applies to foes with more than 50% Health.
fcef373d93579c64909fabe01d88839bf76630ab.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）听力范围内的盟友的下一个攻击技能会造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。伤害加成仅适用于生命值超过 50% 的敌人。

fcf35aeaa50fa218ea7726ca358a2660450d6e67.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot do +10…18…20 damage with their next attack skill. Damage bonus only applies to foes with more than 50% Health.
fcf35aeaa50fa218ea7726ca358a2660450d6e67.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）听力范围内的盟友的下一个攻击技能会造成 +10…18…20 点伤害。伤害加成仅适用于生命值超过 50% 的敌人。

25d8cd9b115b963db20638b7725df3aa8fcb43f6.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot inflict Burning condition (1…4…5 seconds) with their next attack skill.
25d8cd9b115b963db20638b7725df3aa8fcb43f6.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。） 听力范围内的队员用下一个攻击技能造成燃烧状态（1…4…5 秒）。

5ccdc43119473201c0a9a81f822e07619afdd9d0.source: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 2…4…5 adrenaline with their next attack skill.
5ccdc43119473201c0a9a81f822e07619afdd9d0.text: 精英圣歌。 （10 秒。） 听力范围内的队员通过下一个攻击技能获得 2…4…5 肾上腺素。

ae0b9e5441d1f2da339cf910ee5f2fe90472c998.source: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot are unblockable with their next attack skill.
ae0b9e5441d1f2da339cf910ee5f2fe90472c998.text: 精英圣歌。 （10 秒。）在听力范围内的队员可以使用下一个攻击技能来解锁。

25bd3949ab8bbbcbbe22a5ee93d859c3c4b961c7.source: Chant. (8 seconds.) Allies in earshot inflict Weakness (1…13…16 seconds) with their next attack skill.
25bd3949ab8bbbcbbe22a5ee93d859c3c4b961c7.text: 吟诵。 （8 秒。） 听力范围内的盟友使用下一个攻击技能造成虚弱（1…13…16 秒）。

8bab7c3dec2b196623dcd042e1c10ae8cece56d4.source: Signet. Remove Poison, Disease, and Blindness from yourself, and one additional condition.
8bab7c3dec2b196623dcd042e1c10ae8cece56d4.text: 印章。消除你身上的毒、疾病和失明，以及一种额外的状况。

38da094cb6b34d6674e40ec08aae59fe48ff5495.source: Preparation. (24 seconds.) Your physical attacks inflict Poisoned condition (3…13…15 seconds).
38da094cb6b34d6674e40ec08aae59fe48ff5495.text: 准备。 （24 秒。）你的物理攻击造成中毒状态（3…13…15 秒）。

758c5b70aa9eec21dd617595c7de6496d451c5c2.source: Spell. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage. Deals 15…71…85 lightning damage to two nearby foes if you are Overcast. 25% armor penetration.
758c5b70aa9eec21dd617595c7de6496d451c5c2.text: 咒语。造成 5…33…40 点闪电伤害。如果你处于阴暗状态，会对附近的两个敌人造成 15…71…85 点闪电伤害。 25% 护甲穿透。

2c8f95a6b569d253c84589b47dd7d1fceb3e8a66.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (5…13…15 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. End effect: you gain 1…6…7 energy. Unlike other skill descriptions, "energy" is lowercase here
2c8f95a6b569d253c84589b47dd7d1fceb3e8a66.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（5…13…15 秒）。施法时间加倍。最终效果：你获得 1…6…7 能量。与其他技能描述不同的是，这里的“能量”是小写的

2c484b1cb5ff4bf83726d4f7df30536c398f5f89.source: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Arcane Echo becomes the next spell you use (20 seconds). This enchantment ends if you use any skill that is not a spell.
2c484b1cb5ff4bf83726d4f7df30536c398f5f89.text: 结界咒语。 （20 秒。）奥术回响成为你使用的下一个法术（20 秒）。如果你使用任何非咒语的技能，该结界就会结束。

7f26776fd072547b3f5b8feebe5fcc3eb52aea03.source: Elite Hex Spell. (1…8…10 seconds.) Target foe's spells cause 10 Overcast.
7f26776fd072547b3f5b8feebe5fcc3eb52aea03.text: 精英六角咒语。 （1…8…10 秒。）目标敌人的法术造成 10 阴暗。

09b0bfec7381ae3178890ca12c82b88307d21319.source: Spell. (5…29…35 seconds.) Disables one random spell. This skill becomes that spell.
09b0bfec7381ae3178890ca12c82b88307d21319.text: 咒语。 （5…29…35 秒。）禁用一个随机法术。这个技能变成了那个咒语。

c8c0c2a628a32753e376a0615281042c37f23e18.source: Spell. This skill becomes target ally's elite skill (20 seconds). Cannot self-target. No effect if target's elite skill is a form.
c8c0c2a628a32753e376a0615281042c37f23e18.text: 咒语。该技能成为目标盟友的精英技能（20秒）。无法自我定位。如果目标的精英技能是形态，则没有效果。

b369bc6a3d728e3fa0afdfd5ce683ae79d746785.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) You gain 2 Energy (maximum 2…6…7) for each enchantment on you whenever you cast a spell.
b369bc6a3d728e3fa0afdfd5ce683ae79d746785.text: 精英结界法术。 （10 秒。）每当你施展法术时，你身上的每个结界都会获得 2 点能量（最多 2…6…7 点）。

a9669984e70e94f92b3d957e325e34937c7efe9d.source: Elite Signet. (1…19…24 seconds.) Conditions you apply while wielding a bow last 150% longer.
a9669984e70e94f92b3d957e325e34937c7efe9d.text: 精英图章。 （1…19…24 秒。）你在使用弓时施加的条件会持续 150% 秒。

f8d02bfe48429f94e096722c45555d88abc7486b.source: Bow Attack. Deals +10…30…35 damage. Unblockable. This arrow moves 50% slower.
f8d02bfe48429f94e096722c45555d88abc7486b.text: 弓攻击。造成 +10…30…35 点伤害。不可封锁。该箭头移动 50% 较慢。

bdb5d9e11d9a3c1e76a32790f56b578debc59004.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 30…78…90 Health with their next spell.
bdb5d9e11d9a3c1e76a32790f56b578debc59004.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）听得见的队员在下一个咒语中获得 30…78…90 点生命值。

a2ac7a820a7ccff9919a50418bbf2a2d99711358.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1…5…6 Energy with their next spell.
a2ac7a820a7ccff9919a50418bbf2a2d99711358.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）听力范围内的盟友在下一个咒语中获得 1…5…6 点能量。

d37b946cb16fc7e8fe60e65ef6d45861a819af99.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) You have +24…53…60 armor. You move 50…21…14% slower.

b5c4646cbf438884988807eee6a41b2e7cb2d0dd.source: Enchantment Spell. (10…29…34 seconds.) You have +40 armor against physical damage and have +1 Water Magic.
b5c4646cbf438884988807eee6a41b2e7cb2d0dd.text: 结界咒语。 （10…29…34 秒。）你有 +40 点物理伤害护甲值和 +1 水系魔法值。

ee2da40d4f04e4e70aecbe7f88ddc0e509d58214.source: Enchantment Spell. (8…18…20 seconds.) You have +10…34…40 armor and move 33% faster.
ee2da40d4f04e4e70aecbe7f88ddc0e509d58214.text: 结界咒语。 （8…18…20 秒。）你有 +10…34…40 点护甲，移动速度加快 33% 点。

089da3335d367838b82906ca731a1119d5277542.source: Enchantment Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition on all adjacent foes (5…13…15). You take 5…17…20 less damage from foes with a condition. (15 seconds.)
089da3335d367838b82906ca731a1119d5277542.text: 结界咒语。对所有邻近敌人造成虚弱状态 (5…13…15)。你受到有病症的敌人造成的伤害减少 5…17…20 点。 （15 秒。）

ecb457627daa4d63f89aec0aec10af71b1e1d6a0.source: Skill. (10…30…35 seconds.) Your spirits within earshot take 50% less damage and are immune to critical attacks.
ecb457627daa4d63f89aec0aec10af71b1e1d6a0.text: 技能。 （10…30…35 秒。）在听力范围内，你的灵魂受到的伤害减少 50% 点，并且免疫致命攻击。

b60fe056745e51cb34dd09e1fd6c45c75c8cc3c0.source: Enchantment Spell. (10…30…35 seconds.) You have 10 base damage reduction while casting binding rituals.
b60fe056745e51cb34dd09e1fd6c45c75c8cc3c0.text: 结界咒语。 （10…30…35 秒。）施展束缚仪式时，你的基础伤害减免 10 点。

0d8f4131745b126c35a688d14ec99d222d42a5d7.source: Hex Spell. Deals 35…59…65 earth damage. Burning foes are hexed for 5 seconds and miss 20…64…75% of attacks. Also strikes adjacent.
0d8f4131745b126c35a688d14ec99d222d42a5d7.text: 降咒魔法。造成 35…59…65 点地球伤害。燃烧的敌人会被施咒 5 秒并错过 20…64…75% 次攻击。亦击邻近。

090922dac804c961bd245cea017132747edee6e5.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) You gain 5…17…20 Energy and all your skills recharge if target foe dies.
090922dac804c961bd245cea017132747edee6e5.text: 精英六角咒语。 （5…13…15 秒。）如果目标敌人死亡，你将获得 5…17…20 点能量，并且所有技能都会恢复。

4d346cb6d1726da465602a7c776725810f5307f3.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your next 1…8…10 attack skills each remove one condition.
4d346cb6d1726da465602a7c776725810f5307f3.text: 结界咒语。 （30 秒。）你的下一个 1…8…10 攻击技能每次都会消除一个条件。

50ff08d1f16e0e48cbcb7674fab189450ceec2e8.source: Elite Skill. Removes all enchantments. Must follow a dual attack.
50ff08d1f16e0e48cbcb7674fab189450ceec2e8.text: 精英技能。移除所有结界。必须遵循双重攻击。

7189e7296e1b8047ad0a5ed58946b8bb7fc95f68.source: Hex Spell. (9…12 seconds.) You cannot miss target foe. If you kill this foe, you lose 5% Death Penalty.
7189e7296e1b8047ad0a5ed58946b8bb7fc95f68.text: 降咒魔法。 （9…12 秒。）你不能错过目标敌人。如果你杀死了这个敌人，你将失去 5% 点死刑。

3b11a559e859f8bbc6dfddab57b8e762dd0990b6.source: Hex Spell. (3…6…7 seconds.) Reduces this foe's primary attribute to 0.
3b11a559e859f8bbc6dfddab57b8e762dd0990b6.text: 降咒魔法。 （3…6…7秒。）将该敌人的主要属性降低至0。

857143e8f9b5e1c6819d9a7107ec2ca11418c24d.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (3…9…10 seconds.) Gives 50% block chance while attacking. End Effect: Causes Weakness 3…13…15 seconds to adjacent foes.
857143e8f9b5e1c6819d9a7107ec2ca11418c24d.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （3…9…10 秒。）攻击时提供 50% 格挡几率。最终效果：对邻近敌人造成 3…13…15 秒虚弱。

45cf06e4f96c486bce47ecbd1fb03c2b0e6e90a8.source: Elite Item Spell. (45 seconds.) Your spells and binding rituals cost -5…41…50% of the base Energy.
45cf06e4f96c486bce47ecbd1fb03c2b0e6e90a8.text: 精英物品法术。 （45 秒。）你的咒语和束缚仪式消耗 -5…41…50% 的基础能量。

ff29e2cc3b422718cdf66ccaf32be9cd7b5381b7.source: Half Range Hex Spell. (5…29…35 seconds.) Inflict Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) and Shadow Step to target foe the next time damage would drop this foe's Health below 50%.
ff29e2cc3b422718cdf66ccaf32be9cd7b5381b7.text: 半程六角法术。 （5…29…35 秒。） 造成深度伤害状态（5…17…20 秒），并在下次伤害时对目标敌人施以暗影步，使该敌人的生命值降至 50% 以下。

03d8bcc1585d8126571316497d2cc8de46f296d3.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location.
03d8bcc1585d8126571316497d2cc8de46f296d3.text: 精英结界法术。暗影步瞄准敌人。最终效果：回到原来的位置。

892f2948ac8c4dd42df4840d8965953b3593ea8c.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3 seconds.) Target ally gains 50…90…100% more Health when healed and takes 5…41…50% less damage.
892f2948ac8c4dd42df4840d8965953b3593ea8c.text: 精英结界法术。 （3 秒。）目标盟友在治疗时获得的生命值增加 50…90…100% 点，受到的伤害减少 5…41…50% 点。

ca377e7c575857dd69253a0f530d8edb2502ce0e.source: Enchantment Spell. (45 seconds.) Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, adjacent foes take 20…25 holy damage.
ca377e7c575857dd69253a0f530d8edb2502ce0e.text: 结界咒语。 （45 秒。）每当你失去苦行僧结界时，邻近的敌人就会受到 20…25 点神圣伤害。

61863f459f9f2fcee9dffa6fa25a6049636f5dd9.source: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) You gain 0…1…1 Energy and are healed for 200…440…500% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.
61863f459f9f2fcee9dffa6fa25a6049636f5dd9.text: 结界咒语。 （60 秒。）你获得 0…1…1 点能量，并且每次施展法术时都会受到 200…440…500% 点能量消耗的治疗。

f56132398fd85dc36992ed537605b248eb349a98.source: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) You gain 0…1…1 Energy and are healed for 200…360…400% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.
f56132398fd85dc36992ed537605b248eb349a98.text: 结界咒语。 （60 秒。）你获得 0…1…1 点能量，并且每次施展法术时都会受到 200…360…400% 点能量消耗的治疗。

422d81d659b934331d157f1d12fc664cd14d352a.source: Enchantment Spell. (3…7…8 seconds.) Target ally cannot be knocked-down. Cannot self-target.
422d81d659b934331d157f1d12fc664cd14d352a.text: 结界咒语。 （3…7…8 秒。）目标盟友无法被击倒。无法自我定位。

a5fdc672d354ff6731410a63fb50604abc950609.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Exploit all corpses in earshot. Animates a level 1…14…17 bone horror, plus one for each exploited corpse. You have +1 Death Magic (5…37…45 seconds).
a5fdc672d354ff6731410a63fb50604abc950609.text: 精英结界法术。利用听力范围内的所有尸体。激活等级 1…14…17 的骸骨恐怖，每具被剥削的尸体加一。你有 +1 个死亡魔法（5…37…45 秒）。

b3ff4c02a6a3d17f50eec797be4ba5a40ecca630.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Initial effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5…13…15 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (3…7…8 seconds) on nearby foes.
b3ff4c02a6a3d17f50eec797be4ba5a40ecca630.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （30秒。）初始效果：对附近的敌人造成流血状态（5…13…15秒）。最终效果：对附近的敌人造成残废状态（3…7…8秒）。

e5b3a8a87149bad78e926785dd6f40be22c475eb.source: Melee Attack. (5…13…15 seconds.)Inflicts No space between the bracket and 'Inflicts' Bleeding condition. Also inflicts Cracked Armor (1…8…10 seconds) if you are enchanted.
e5b3a8a87149bad78e926785dd6f40be22c475eb.text: 近战攻击。 （5…13…15 秒。）造成支架之间没有空间并“造成”出血状况。如果您被附魔，还会造成护甲破裂（1…8…10 秒）。

aa2a90111a50b96f842987eb0890de354baa5bce.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage and you gain 3…7…8 Energy. Unblockable if target foe is Weakened.
aa2a90111a50b96f842987eb0890de354baa5bce.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害并获得 3…7…8 点能量。如果目标敌人被削弱则无法阻挡。

6f6000f96adea71acff10fbdb662512e9ff224ad.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage and you gain 2…4…4 Energy. Unblockable if target foe is Weakened.
6f6000f96adea71acff10fbdb662512e9ff224ad.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害并获得 2…4…4 点能量。如果目标敌人被削弱则无法阻挡。

bb0e2dde6984654f83b6ef1707b08b58ae3b047b.source: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Your next spell gives you 110…182…200% of its Energy cost. That spell takes 10…6…5 seconds longer to recharge.

You gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, you inflict Burning (1…3…3 seconds) on nearby foes whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. 6dbf7e893314b0ec90835e7ff68c4e6981b1dbd1.text: 精英形态。 （10…74…90 秒。）你的镰刀攻击会造成黑暗伤害并窃取 0…10…12 点生命值。你对疾病免疫。当你失去苦行僧结界时，对所有邻近的敌人施加疾病（3 秒）。该技能无效时间为45秒。

2bd86ef6647933bfb28430e7379cbc123c2215a2.source: Echo. (10…30…35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1…4…5 seconds) to adjacent foes whenever a chant or shout ends on target ally. Cannot target spirits.
2bd86ef6647933bfb28430e7379cbc123c2215a2.text: 回声。 （10…30…35 秒。）每当目标盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，就会对邻近的敌人造成燃烧状态（1…4…5 秒）。无法瞄准灵体。

f3ff99a08387b6bf66af2dc937e89f453bcc212a.source: Spear Attack. Deals +5…21…25 damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1…3…3 seconds).
f3ff99a08387b6bf66af2dc937e89f453bcc212a.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。造成燃烧状态（1…3…3 秒）。

67034083088bd4cae5faf8e8f60c4e06ac5a837f.source: Enchantment Spell. Monk enchantments you cast last 10…30…35% longer.
67034083088bd4cae5faf8e8f60c4e06ac5a837f.text: 结界咒语。你施展的武僧结界持续时间延长 10…30…35% 点。

879f2c571fe7dde290b24280539d753b083ca509.source: Elite Spell. Heals for 10…98…120. Removes one condition and one hex.
879f2c571fe7dde290b24280539d753b083ca509.text: 精英法术。治愈 10…98…120 点。移除一种状况和一种降咒。

649494253210ec9887820aa8b2b146f4f1974a77.source: Signet. You gain 3 Energy for each enchantment you are maintaining. You cannot gain more than 3…20…24 Energy in this way.
649494253210ec9887820aa8b2b146f4f1974a77.text: 印章。每维持一个结界，你就会获得 3 点能量。通过这种方式你无法获得超过 3…20…24 的能量。

1bb708d74dcf20441c59a2ec249c67e30f83036e.source: Item Spell. (15…51…60 seconds.) Drop effect: inflicts Blindness condition (3…7…8 seconds) on all nearby foes.
1bb708d74dcf20441c59a2ec249c67e30f83036e.text: 物品法术。 （15…51…60秒。）掉落效果：对附近所有敌人造成失明状态（3…7…8秒）。

62fce932e36fc7bcab3c95bdd07777671aca7b5c.text: 咒语。造成失明状态（3…7…8 秒）。

26f7fd58e172c77a0ed9bc8ce4edeae7facad2c6.source: Spell. Inflicts Blindness condition (3…13…15 seconds) on target and adjacent foes. Must follow an off-hand attack.
26f7fd58e172c77a0ed9bc8ce4edeae7facad2c6.text: 咒语。对目标和邻近敌人造成失明状态（3…13…15秒）。必须跟随副手攻击。

8206e3cd2c0102d1e0f2d5ce77bb62bc7ce1cfd9.source: Elite Spell. Deals 5…41…50 lightning damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (3…7…8 seconds) on target and adjacent foes. 25% armor penetration. If target was attacking, also hits adjacent foes and deals 50% more damage.
8206e3cd2c0102d1e0f2d5ce77bb62bc7ce1cfd9.text: 精英法术。造成 5…41…50 点闪电伤害。对目标和邻近敌人造成失明状态（3…7…8秒）。 25% 护甲穿透。如果目标正在攻击，也会击中相邻的敌人并造成 50% 点额外伤害。

1c20e7a9055c80c9e5afa95375aeb2c747196cc7.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (3…10…12 seconds). Allies hitting these foes gain 5…17…20 health. If any of these foes dies while hexed, adjacent allies are healed for 20…84…100.
1c20e7a9055c80c9e5afa95375aeb2c747196cc7.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（3…10…12 秒）。击中这些敌人的盟友可获得 5…17…20 点生命值。如果这些敌人中的任何一个在被施咒时死亡，则相邻盟友将获得 20…84…100 点治疗。

5b3994cd608ee15d83a7e4d180334ac53a310a4b.source: Spell. Steals 20…56…65 Health. You begin Bleeding (6 seconds) if your Health is above 90%.
5b3994cd608ee15d83a7e4d180334ac53a310a4b.text: 咒语。窃取 20…56…65 点生命值。如果您的生命值高于 90%，您就会开始流血（6 秒）。

3deca6ccb8b0d03ea6e096df9abd829e64576a62.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) +3…5…6 Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.
3deca6ccb8b0d03ea6e096df9abd829e64576a62.text: 精英结界法术。 （10 秒。） +3…5…6 能量再生。无法自我定位。

7a4afc8dd01bfd752a403ea36d1081e708fa3f4a.source: Spell. Steal 5…37…45 Health. Inflicts Weakness (3…10…12 seconds) if target foe was attacking.
7a4afc8dd01bfd752a403ea36d1081e708fa3f4a.text: 咒语。窃取 5…37…45 生命值。如果目标敌人正在攻击，则造成虚弱（3…10…12 秒）。

44a6282a9575e3f7782321dcc5f62aede98e0986.source: Spell. Heals your undead servants for 30…99…116. Healing cost: +2% Health sacrifice per servant healed.
44a6282a9575e3f7782321dcc5f62aede98e0986.text: 咒语。治愈你的不死仆人 30…99…116。治疗成本：每个治愈的仆人 +2% 生命牺牲。

7f09ba924010592325011378c75b3b01e291bece.source: Enchantment Spell. (7 seconds.) You have +3…5…6 Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for 40…160…190.
7f09ba924010592325011378c75b3b01e291bece.text: 结界咒语。 （7 秒。）你有 +3…5…6 点生命恢复。最终效果：治愈你 40…160…190 点。

9afa49bb9161069e8277fd711fbb3af55681d926.source: Enchantment Spell. (8…13…14 seconds.) +3 Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.
9afa49bb9161069e8277fd711fbb3af55681d926.text: 结界咒语。 （8…13…14 秒。） +3 能量再生。无法自我定位。

0bc23c467c92bbaf94f18be5638ad6cd68021f35.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命30…126…150）。它的攻击窃取了 5…21…25 点生命值。

bcf2b1698b86883dc4d462222610f13a57bff9e1.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (30…126…150 second lifespan). Its attacks steal 5…21…25 Health.
bcf2b1698b86883dc4d462222610f13a57bff9e1.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命30…126…150）。它的攻击窃取了 5…21…25 点生命值。

513d558270d2df6476289952269fdd891885a6d8.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（4…9…10 秒）。他们有 50% 次机会错过。

b74d6942e1573db962ac702fd9396ea56ba172a3.source: Bow Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. You gain 5…9…10 Energy if target foe has Cracked Armor.
b74d6942e1573db962ac702fd9396ea56ba172a3.text: 弓攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人的护甲破裂，你将获得 5…9…10 点能量。

175c01aea9071365e0f3f26cba6c6156c3a18542.source: Stance. (5…10…11 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Gain 5 Energy for each melee attack blocked. Ends if you use a skill.

2828544f0cd990f32e5a19f755bd920bfaa9c1b3.source: Enchantment Spell. (15…51…60 seconds.) You gain 5…41…50 Health and 1…5…6 Energy whenever you create a creature.
2828544f0cd990f32e5a19f755bd920bfaa9c1b3.text: 结界咒语。 （15…51…60 秒。）每当你创造一个生物时，你就会获得 5…41…50 点生命值和 1…5…6 点能量。

277bdd98513049b4fc7253fd07bc792b45b18d3d.source: Elite Signet. Heals for 20…68…80. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer spell that targets an ally heals for +20…84…100 Health.
277bdd98513049b4fc7253fd07bc792b45b18d3d.text: 精英图章。治疗 20…68…80 点。你的下一个针对盟友的治疗或保护祈祷法术会治疗 +20…84…100 点生命值。

e13c5c931ca47b3395066b48854ab88836c763cd.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Knocked-down creatures take 5 damage and begin Bleeding (5…17…20 seconds). Does not affect spirits.
e13c5c931ca47b3395066b48854ab88836c763cd.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。被击倒的生物会受到 5 点伤害并开始流血（5…17…20 秒）。不影响精神。

3f2d67f893319315d8cf6fe6870c4bb6a6aab6f7.source: Touch Skill. Deals 45…70 damage; causes knock-down.
3f2d67f893319315d8cf6fe6870c4bb6a6aab6f7.text: 触摸技能。造成 45…70 点伤害；导致击倒。

c8f8f2bde9493d5dcd3057103c9cb0bacb21d130.source: Spell. Deals 10…34…40 fire damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
c8f8f2bde9493d5dcd3057103c9cb0bacb21d130.text: 咒语。每秒造成 10…34…40 点火焰伤害（5 秒）。击中目标初始位置附近的敌人。

e4bc35e318ff4c844cb4585631fee70505b07e1f.source: Spell. Removes burning and heals for 50…60 Health. Affects party members.
e4bc35e318ff4c844cb4585631fee70505b07e1f.text: 咒语。消除灼烧感并治愈 50…60 点生命值。影响队员。

1aeb5c132dc911548597c7799e95609af150d51e.source: Elite Bow Attack. Slow moving arrow. Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed condition (5…17…20 seconds).
1aeb5c132dc911548597c7799e95609af150d51e.text: 精英弓攻击。缓慢移动的箭头。打断一个咒语。造成茫然状态（5…17…20 秒）。

b556b7e9b870502b4e0ae6e8e358ab39d775b688.source: Pet Attack. Deals +5…29…35 damage. Deals +5…29…35 more damage if target foe is under 50% health.
b556b7e9b870502b4e0ae6e8e358ab39d775b688.text: 宠物攻击。造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。如果目标敌人生命值低于 50% 点，则额外造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。

e0ade22b50d76679e7538187666f0f8ceaed7d04.source: Weapon Spell. (10…34…40 seconds.) Attacks deal +5…13…15 damage. No effect while target ally is enchanted.
e0ade22b50d76679e7538187666f0f8ceaed7d04.text: 武器咒语。 （10…34…40 秒。）攻击造成 +5…13…15 点伤害。当目标盟友被附魔时没有效果。

c7c69a47a2db306d40e4f48e3ad80c17dc1330f7.source: Elite Stance. (1…6…7 seconds.) You move 50% faster. Causes knock-down if you hit a moving foe in melee. Ends if you use a skill.
c7c69a47a2db306d40e4f48e3ad80c17dc1330f7.text: 精英姿态。 （1…6…7 秒。）你移动速度加快了 50%。如果你在近战中击中移动的敌人，则会导致击倒。如果使用技能则结束。

13c0434d77c715bc323aa59551ca66ebc033e3d2.source: Melee Attack. Deals +5…25…30 damage and causes knock-down if target foe is moving.
13c0434d77c715bc323aa59551ca66ebc033e3d2.text: 近战攻击。如果目标敌人正在移动，则会造成 +5…25…30 点伤害并导致击倒。

381d53181160c72ba8e0872cfb8b47725524d33e.source: Elite Bow Attack. Deals +10…26…30 damage. Inflicts Burning condition (2…7…8 seconds).
381d53181160c72ba8e0872cfb8b47725524d33e.text: 精英弓攻击。造成 +10…26…30 点伤害。造成燃烧状态（2…7…8 秒）。

d9a645fb8e09853314ec753752621e97d528bb9b.source: Echo. (20 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1…3…3 seconds) if target ally hits a foe with more Health. Renewal: Whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. Cannot target spirits.
d9a645fb8e09853314ec753752621e97d528bb9b.text: 回声。 （20 秒。）如果目标盟友击中生命值更高的敌人，则会造成燃烧状态（1…3…3 秒）。更新：每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时。无法瞄准灵体。

1e4380bef7193a27bc73312e0e556efdfecda246.source: Skill. (3…8…9 seconds.) Blocks the next attack skill against you. Inflicts Burning condition (1…5…6 seconds) if it was a melee attack. No effect unless you are wielding a shield.
1e4380bef7193a27bc73312e0e556efdfecda246.text: 技能。 （3…8…9 秒。）阻止对你的下一个攻击技能。如果是近战攻击，则会造成燃烧状态（1…5…6 秒）。除非你拿着盾牌，否则没有任何效果。

2eb2a3217beb2ed227c6c8a2bead8f7dd5b242bf.source: Enchantment Spell. (7 seconds.) You move 30…42…45% faster. You suffer from Burning (7 seconds). End effect: inflicts Burning condition (3…8…9 seconds) on adjacent foes.
2eb2a3217beb2ed227c6c8a2bead8f7dd5b242bf.text: 结界咒语。 （7 秒。）你移动速度加快了 30…42…45%。你遭受燃烧（7 秒）。最终效果：对相邻敌人造成燃烧状态（3…8…9秒）。

3fa240c9db3b589a64a381bf3d40f411d34020ce.source: Stance. (2…8…10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. End effect: lose all adrenaline.
3fa240c9db3b589a64a381bf3d40f411d34020ce.text: 立场。 （2…8…10秒。）你攻击33%的速度更快。最终效果：失去所有肾上腺素。

a962a2dc7c9ef2dae2380192b752d18556c33228.source: Hex Spell. (15 seconds.) Deals 30…90…105 damage whenever target foe uses a shout or chant.
a962a2dc7c9ef2dae2380192b752d18556c33228.text: 降咒魔法。 （15 秒。）每当目标敌人使用喊叫或圣歌时，就会造成 30…90…105 点伤害。

2496547b61c341eaef96d0957cd6c21827eb62bc.source: Hex Spell. Target foe does +10 damage with attacks (3…20…24 seconds). There is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack (maximum 15…83…100) will be done to that foe instead.
2496547b61c341eaef96d0957cd6c21827eb62bc.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人的攻击造成 +10 点伤害（3…20…24 秒）。每次攻击有 50% 的几率（最大 15…83…100）对该敌人造成伤害。

1f7fd780bd8d76ba6dddbd235a801edff3804b0e.source: Hex Spell. Target foe does +10 damage with attacks (3…10…12 seconds). There is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack (maximum 15…51…60) will be done to that foe instead.
1f7fd780bd8d76ba6dddbd235a801edff3804b0e.text: 降咒魔法。目标敌人的攻击造成 +10 点伤害（3…10…12 秒）。每次攻击有 50% 的几率（最大 15…51…60）对该敌人造成伤害。

4b796e0c07de1f6783b950f5589a4d22936dd633.source: Shout. (30 seconds.) Your pet moves and attacks 33% faster.
4b796e0c07de1f6783b950f5589a4d22936dd633.text: 喊叫。 （30 秒。）你的宠物移动和攻击速度加快 33%。

dc489705eddd9243d821936516383f5800e0b85c.source: Shout. (30 seconds.) Your pet moves and attacks 25% faster.
dc489705eddd9243d821936516383f5800e0b85c.text: 喊叫。 （30 秒。）你的宠物移动和攻击速度加快 25%。

96781ec4351e59d737ada5648a9527d3ff4aec3d.source: Shout. (120 seconds.) Your pet has 5…17…20 damage reduction.
96781ec4351e59d737ada5648a9527d3ff4aec3d.text: 喊叫。 （120 秒。）你的宠物有 5…17…20 点伤害减免。

a4752a42ee42dbb2f069f9c987be54073d959c38.source: Bow Attack. You shoot an arrow that moves 3 times faster. Unblockable.
a4752a42ee42dbb2f069f9c987be54073d959c38.text: 弓攻击。你射出一支移动速度快 3 倍的箭。不可封锁。

210f419ac56d9c6a1bb4921bd3d32fdb8c34f178.source: Half Range Spell. Inflicts Crippled and Bleeding condition (5…13…15 seconds) on target and adjacent foes.
210f419ac56d9c6a1bb4921bd3d32fdb8c34f178.text: 半范围法术。对目标和邻近敌人造成残废和流血状态（5…13…15 秒）。

018c9ea528712bd730795459d7cd1bd383370c47.source: Elite Spell. Deals 20…72…85 lightning damage. You gain 7 Energy and 5…41…50 Health if you are holding an item.
018c9ea528712bd730795459d7cd1bd383370c47.text: 精英法术。造成 20…72…85 点闪电伤害。如果您持有物品，您将获得 7 点能量和 5…41…50 点生命值。

1e413449ec233bc6170b90b4f5193d45cf5cbeff.source: Signet. Deals 26…50…56 holy damage. You gain 4…12…14 Energy if target foe is attacking.
1e413449ec233bc6170b90b4f5193d45cf5cbeff.text: 印章。造成 26…50…56 点神圣伤害。如果目标敌人正在攻击，你将获得 4…12…14 点能量。

0177acffa663576da318d4a5ec6b5514a8933c33.source: Elite Signet. All party members lose all conditions. You begin Burning (one second for each condition removed).
0177acffa663576da318d4a5ec6b5514a8933c33.text: 精英图章。所有队员失去一切条件。您开始燃烧（每个条件移除一秒钟）。

12d39a0c0dd25c75361fd98feb14edf0078c2a6a.source: Spell. Deals 10…70…85 lightning damage. Also hits two foes near your target. 25% armor penetration.
12d39a0c0dd25c75361fd98feb14edf0078c2a6a.text: 咒语。造成 10…70…85 点闪电伤害。还会击中目标附近的两个敌人。 25% 护甲穿透。

19d631d4432d036500688e415eb832fbac74e1b1.source: Spell. Deals 5…77…95 lightning damage. Deals 5…29…35 additional lightning damage if you are holding an item.
19d631d4432d036500688e415eb832fbac74e1b1.text: 咒语。造成 5…77…95 点闪电伤害。如果您持有物品，则会造成 5…29…35 点额外闪电伤害。

657f02aaae49cb8e437e4016f5c3b914fb7fb0af.source: Enchantment Spell. (8…46…56 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy for each foe in the area whenever you cast a spell.
657f02aaae49cb8e437e4016f5c3b914fb7fb0af.text: 结界咒语。 （8…46…56 秒。）每当你施展法术时，区域内的每个敌人都会获得 1 点能量。

2b85463e4a16b78f142713c5e6713a069b8c4f47.source: Spell. Deals 5…21…25 damage and causes 0…2…2 Energy loss each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
2b85463e4a16b78f142713c5e6713a069b8c4f47.text: 咒语。每秒（10 秒）造成 5…21…25 点伤害并造成 0…2…2 点能量损失。击中目标初始位置附近的敌人。

c0e4fce5120cb159309ca33c65be2a48af36facf.source: Elite Stance. (1…8…10 seconds.) You move 33% faster and deal +10…66…80 damage with your next melee hit. Ends when you hit or if you use a skill.
c0e4fce5120cb159309ca33c65be2a48af36facf.text: 精英姿态。 （1…8…10 秒。）你的移动速度加快了 33%，下一次近战攻击造成 +10…66…80 点伤害。当你击中或使用技能时结束。

3dfb24ccb01e6f8fcbd64d5c4329fc2d6dc9118e.source: Skill. Your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped. Failure unless Beast Mastery 8 or higher.
3dfb24ccb01e6f8fcbd64d5c4329fc2d6dc9118e.text: 技能。只要您装备了魅力动物，您的动物伙伴就会与您同行。除非野兽掌握达到 8 或更高，否则失败。

81e3e7bfaaa83cc2c3d8fad838392a9cb030e80b.source: Spear Attack. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.
81e3e7bfaaa83cc2c3d8fad838392a9cb030e80b.text: 长矛攻击。如果目标敌人的护甲破裂，则会造成深度受伤状态（5…17…20 秒）。

ea71a4a9c246c5d26ed7673c22d583033f8f312d.source: Spell. Deals 10…37…44 cold damage to foes in the area around your target; removes 1…2…2 enchantments from these foes. You are Poisoned (10 seconds).
ea71a4a9c246c5d26ed7673c22d583033f8f312d.text: 咒语。对目标周围区域的敌人造成 10…37…44 点冰冷伤害；移除这些敌人的 1…2…2 个结界。你中毒了（10 秒）。

02dc6cc20dac05e74073b2f3a603ef06e7eda33b.source: Scythe Attack. Deals +3…13…15 damage. Deals 10…26…30 cold damage to each foe hit who has less Health than you and foes adjacent to those targets.

10794555ba892eb3246d0baf390420830dafe0a4.source: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) The next water hex on target foe lasts 25…85…100% longer. Initial effect: 30…54…60 cold damage. Also strikes adjacent.

87ed8d2e229c0bd5379682454c088502ba81b9ad.text: 技能。你的宠物获得 40…104…120 点生命值。复活你的宠物（10…48…58% 生命值）。如果你装备了舒适动物，你的动物伙伴将与你同行。

a9266e1207fa40837ab07bfd0979afa6b970b42a.source: Skill. Heals you for 30…102…120 if you have less Health than your pet. Heals your pet for 30…102…120 if it has less Health than you.

9ba5ae8cd30128bccb56798a753fe65f4bf149db.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +1…16…20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition if target foe is knocked-down (5…17…20 seconds).
9ba5ae8cd30128bccb56798a753fe65f4bf149db.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人被击倒（5…17…20 秒），则会造成深度受伤状态。

00eb69ea243262d91af9b72a6705b5bbdfea0ccc.source: Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted. Foe suffers 15…63…75 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.
00eb69ea243262d91af9b72a6705b5bbdfea0ccc.text: 咒语。如果目标敌人正在使用技能，则该敌人和该区域内的所有敌人都会被打断。敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害，该区域内的敌人受到 75% 点伤害。

b9c0ae3587d589d8aa52e375544b601444158c86.source: Spell. Interrupts a skill. If target foe had a Mesmer hex, deals 25…50 damage to target and foes in the area and causes 3…5 Health degeneration (10 seconds).
b9c0ae3587d589d8aa52e375544b601444158c86.text: 咒语。打断技能。如果目标敌人拥有催眠咒，则对该区域内的目标和敌人造成 25…50 点伤害，并造成 3…5 点生命值退化（10 秒）。

fc384a40883798761c453e562a7eaae3bee150b7.source: Spell. Deals 10…58…70 damage to all foes adjacent to you. Those foes lose all conditions and take 5…13…15 damage for each condition removed.
fc384a40883798761c453e562a7eaae3bee150b7.text: 咒语。对你周围的所有敌人造成 10…58…70 点伤害。这些敌人会失去所有条件，并且每移除一个条件就会受到 5…13…15 点伤害。

86fe6fd80fc2aa6ad7a6bbc61af21f59c79409fc.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5 seconds plus 3 seconds more for every rank of Soul Reaping.) Your Necromancer spells cost 1…5…6 less Energy. You suffer from Bleeding (10 seconds) each time you cast a Necromancer spell.
86fe6fd80fc2aa6ad7a6bbc61af21f59c79409fc.text: 精英结界法术。 （5 秒加上每级灵魂收割额外 3 秒。）你的死灵法师法术消耗的能量减少 1…5…6。每次施展死灵法师法术时，你都会遭受流血（10 秒）。

b6b318bc76dcbcaca78526f139e8c1cd84daa551.source: Spell. Removes a Hex. Removal effect: Heals for 30…86…100.
b6b318bc76dcbcaca78526f139e8c1cd84daa551.text: 咒语。删除降咒。去除效果：治疗30…86…100。

b1b391b050d542873a67bb805879ab502a78c37b.source: Axe Attack. Deals +4…10…12 damage to all foes adjacent to you.
b1b391b050d542873a67bb805879ab502a78c37b.text: 斧头攻击。对你周围的所有敌人造成 +4…10…12 点伤害。

22ccb7fcea6c0e47df4eeb9a0c9cf658b7d28b01.source: Half Range Spell. Three projectiles: each deals 5…29…35 earth damage. Counts as a lead attack.
22ccb7fcea6c0e47df4eeb9a0c9cf658b7d28b01.text: 半范围法术。三枚射弹：每枚造成 5…29…35 点地球伤害。算作主导攻击。

74c6dadbdcf108feb3bd61375226ada5dee841d4.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3…14…17 seconds.) Your critical hits remove an enchantment. Removal cost: lose 10…4…3 Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.
74c6dadbdcf108feb3bd61375226ada5dee841d4.text: 精英结界法术。 （3…14…17 秒。）你的重击会移除结界。移除成本：失去 10…4…3 点能量或黑暗叛教结束。

d499d4ea3b45402572d3d2944e5297f2e169df4b.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds). Deals 5…41…50 damage to adjacent foes whenever target ally sacrifices Health. Damage cost: you lose 5…17…20 Health.
d499d4ea3b45402572d3d2944e5297f2e169df4b.text: 结界咒语。 （30 秒）。每当目标盟友牺牲生命值时，就会对邻近敌人造成 5…41…50 点伤害。伤害成本：你失去 5…17…20 点生命值。

f8f3902c4b11bb60b8ff301f05dcb51a9b4d0a04.source: Enchantment Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) Transfers 75% of incoming damage from you to your nearest servant.
f8f3902c4b11bb60b8ff301f05dcb51a9b4d0a04.text: 结界咒语。 （30…54…60 秒。）将 75% 点来自你的伤害转移给你最近的仆人。

728edc8b9363f0bae103c71a4c26b0c9c629abe8.source: Stance. (5…13…15 seconds.) You move 25% faster and take half damage. Ends if you hit with an attack.
728edc8b9363f0bae103c71a4c26b0c9c629abe8.text: 立场。 （5…13…15 秒。）你移动速度加快 25%，受到的伤害减半。如果你受到攻击就会结束。

4504276ff92df26cb8cd480bf62ec208e16c8d8b.source: Enchantment Spell. Enchants party members (5 seconds). These party members gain one strike of adrenaline each time they hit with an attack. 50% failure chance unless Blood Magic 5 or more.
4504276ff92df26cb8cd480bf62ec208e16c8d8b.text: 结界咒语。使队员附魔（5 秒）。这些队员每次发起攻击都会获得一次肾上腺素激增。 50%失败几率除非血魔法5以上。

be6bfa99addee6f8ac22009c60ffa2999da19472.source: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 33% slower (1…5…6 seconds).
be6bfa99addee6f8ac22009c60ffa2999da19472.text: 降咒魔法。暗影步瞄准敌人。该敌人移动速度慢 33%（1…5…6 秒）。

d2b031215a629cb409bb19b08fe0cf236d0fcfb3.text: 立场。 （3 秒。）你移动速度加快了 50%。

aec18da8027e904527b1a010e1e1fe8cd173a0c2.source: Stance. (3 seconds.) You move 50% faster. Every 2 points in Shadow Arts lowers recharge by 1 second (max 6 seconds).
aec18da8027e904527b1a010e1e1fe8cd173a0c2.text: 立场。 （3 秒。）你移动速度加快了 50%。暗影艺术每 2 点就会减少 1 秒的充能时间（最多 6 秒）。

484ca2b6c3c9ea7f65b91c042d01fa65552ae139.source: Enchantment Spell. (10…30…35 seconds.) Your half-ranged spells cast 5…41…50% faster and recharge 5…49…60% faster.
484ca2b6c3c9ea7f65b91c042d01fa65552ae139.text: 结界咒语。 （10…30…35 秒。）你的半远程法术施放速度更快 5…41…50%，充能速度更快 5…49…60%。

f522e31fff63b9e5625da1e3076501e5f3736bab.source: Stance. (5…13…15 seconds.) Your Assassin skills activate and recharge 33% faster. Disables your attack skills (10 seconds).
f522e31fff63b9e5625da1e3076501e5f3736bab.text: 立场。 （5…13…15 秒。）你的刺客技能激活和充能速度加快 33%。禁用你的攻击技能（10秒）。

40ca30dac29d46ba699813df9f19fa3bded9a844.source: Skill. (8 seconds). You block the next melee attack and your attacker takes 15…75…90 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition. (3…21…25 seconds). No effect unless you have a sword equipped.
40ca30dac29d46ba699813df9f19fa3bded9a844.text: 技能。 （8 秒）。你格挡了下一次近战攻击，攻击者受到 15…75…90 点伤害。造成流血状态。 （3…21…25 秒）。除非你装备了剑，否则没有效果。

5f3fe39dcb240c4e29bb18a98b3a265601d2c6c1.source: Dual Attack. Deals +20…40…45 damage. Also affects foes adjacent to target foe. Must follow an off-hand attack.
5f3fe39dcb240c4e29bb18a98b3a265601d2c6c1.text: 双重攻击。造成 +20…40…45 点伤害。也会影响与目标敌人相邻的敌人。必须跟随副手攻击。

9c8cdb978e3da5ae6ababe30ae4f92ac4dfbaa5d.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 26…85…100 damage and inflicts Poisoned condition (15 seconds) on adjacent foes if target ally dies.
9c8cdb978e3da5ae6ababe30ae4f92ac4dfbaa5d.text: 结界咒语。 （30 秒。）如果目标盟友死亡，则对相邻敌人造成 26…85…100 点伤害并造成中毒状态（15 秒）。

b82e2a8929d72d00e6b2476f0676f99b6c6225f6.source: Signet. Resurrects target party member with your current Health and 15…83…100% maximum Energy. For 120 seconds, you die the next time this party member dies.
b82e2a8929d72d00e6b2476f0676f99b6c6225f6.text: 印章。以您当前的生命值和 15…83…100% 最大能量复活目标队员。在 120 秒内，下次该队员死亡时，你也会死亡。

9a9c2dfe8d27f9ca7c2474d16edb77511c3d673a.source: Spell. You Shadow Step to target foe. You are healed for 65…173…200 if this foe has more Health than you.
9a9c2dfe8d27f9ca7c2474d16edb77511c3d673a.text: 咒语。你用暗影步来瞄准敌人。如果这个敌人的生命值比你多，你将获得 65…173…200 点治疗。

2fdc704309cb7cd24cd3c009bafca4eaaf0a80d6.source: Spell. Gain 40…112…130 Health if you have less Health than target ally. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. Cannot self-target.
2fdc704309cb7cd24cd3c009bafca4eaaf0a80d6.text: 咒语。如果您的生命值低于目标盟友，则获得 40…112…130 点生命值。初始效果：暗影步攻击该盟友。无法自我定位。

5d900e01ea4893c97e7f1144d0ffefcadf32179d.source: Spell. Deals 5…41…50 cold damage. Deals 5…41…50 more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.
5d900e01ea4893c97e7f1144d0ffefcadf32179d.text: 咒语。造成 5…41…50 点寒冷伤害。如果目标敌人生命值高于 50% 点，则额外造成 5…41…50 点伤害。

39f942aa63a53b494cb1b80fad3be886262bcef8.source: Spell. Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and deals 30…78…90 cold damage. Hits two additional foes in the area.
39f942aa63a53b494cb1b80fad3be886262bcef8.text: 咒语。死亡虫群缓慢飞出，造成 30…78…90 点冰冷伤害。击中该区域的另外两个敌人。

a14f3fddf549efaa835cc2b03cec5d46bb369d0e.text: 弓攻击。造成 1…8…10 能量损失。

2a2825d20b911b8326d6fc6abb44e13f9e82e7e9.source: Elite Axe Attack. Deals +5…65…80 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds). Automatic critical hit. If foe is killed, nearby foes are Weakened (8 seconds). You lose all adrenaline and Energy.
2a2825d20b911b8326d6fc6abb44e13f9e82e7e9.text: 精英斧头攻击。造成 +5…65…80 点伤害。造成深度伤口状态（5…17…20 秒）。自动暴击。如果敌人被杀死，附近的敌人就会被削弱（8 秒）。你失去了所有的肾上腺素和能量。

866c09565918a869ea7d03b304073039aebb4f1d.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of your target (10 seconds). These foes move 66% slower. Initial effect: deals 10…70…85 cold damage.
866c09565918a869ea7d03b304073039aebb4f1d.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标区域内的敌人施咒（10 秒）。这些敌人的移动速度较慢 66%。初始效果：造成10…70…85点寒冷伤害。

28aa45e63ac75276ee3b44ca4ebec7e815406e8a.source: Elite Hex Spell. (10…26…30 seconds.) You gain 2 Energy whenever target foe hits with an attack.
28aa45e63ac75276ee3b44ca4ebec7e815406e8a.text: 精英六角咒语。 （10…26…30 秒。）每当目标敌人受到攻击时，你就会获得 2 点能量。

9262b76f83d9e4a4ee9c7af43ddb06be7f5691ca.source: Elite Chant. (4…9…10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have 50% chance to block. Ends when hitting with an attack skill.
9262b76f83d9e4a4ee9c7af43ddb06be7f5691ca.text: 精英圣歌。 （4…9…10 秒。）听得见的队员有 50% 次阻挡机会。使用攻击技能击中时结束。

2cb87e4d663b5edd9803c6ae4399e3f202f5c27e.source: Stance. (1…4…5 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. End effect: gain one adrenaline for each melee attack skill you have (maximum 0…3…4).
2cb87e4d663b5edd9803c6ae4399e3f202f5c27e.text: 立场。 （1…4…5 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。最终效果：每拥有一项近战攻击技能，就会获得 1 点肾上腺素（最多 0…3…4）。

2a68144be4b21dba2b867ee354f89b8477bff67d.source: Elite Item Spell. (15…51…60 seconds.) You cannot lose more than 20% of your max Health from a single hit. Drop effect: steal 5…41…50 Health from nearby foes.
2a68144be4b21dba2b867ee354f89b8477bff67d.text: 精英物品法术。 （15…51…60 秒。）一次击中你损失的最大生命值不能超过 20%。掉落效果：窃取附近敌人 5…41…50 点生命值。

6b7cf1b66fd354483f6114430069ed74ef4e51b8.source: Hex Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Deals 30…102…120 damage the next time target foe blocks.
6b7cf1b66fd354483f6114430069ed74ef4e51b8.text: 降咒魔法。 （5…17…20 秒。）下次目标敌人阻挡时造成 30…102…120 点伤害。

9b5e92bc6056f2ab37ea8bf4bca5d6bc965d2d8e.source: Spell. Deals 6…49…60 damage to target and nearby foes. Deals 4…17…20 more damage for each enchantment on them.
9b5e92bc6056f2ab37ea8bf4bca5d6bc965d2d8e.text: 咒语。对目标和附近的敌人造成 6…49…60 点伤害。每个附魔对它们造成额外 4…17…20 点伤害。

420efce816eb1be181a8f9cf0cefa1e0f22fc48a.source: Hex Spell. (5…29…35 seconds.) Reduces healing target foe receives by 33%. Only skills with the word "heal" in the description are affected.
420efce816eb1be181a8f9cf0cefa1e0f22fc48a.text: 降咒魔法。 （5…29…35 秒。）减少目标敌人受到的治疗量 33%。只有描述中带有“治疗”一词的技能才会受到影响。

ccd72d1cf626ab1ba60899d68a07d7db0323b960.source: Stance. (1…5…6 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block attacks. Adjacent foes suffer Bleeding (5…13…15 seconds) when you block a projectile attack.
ccd72d1cf626ab1ba60899d68a07d7db0323b960.text: 立场。 （1…5…6 秒。）你有 75% 次机会阻止攻击。当您格挡射弹攻击时，相邻敌人会遭受流血（5…13…15 秒）。

d34d2a56e9f32d5904f35ed84031a2e1eab84a36.source: Ranged Attack. Deals 18…30 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (18…30 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.
d34d2a56e9f32d5904f35ed84031a2e1eab84a36.text: 远程攻击。造成 18…30 点伤害。如果目标敌人的护甲破裂，则会造成流血状态（18…30 秒）。

85d73c6c2fcb7b15fb9d51950bc3af619de969c2.source: Elite Skill. (20 seconds.) You have +90…258…300 maximum Health, +20 armor, and take 1…8…10 less damage.
85d73c6c2fcb7b15fb9d51950bc3af619de969c2.text: 精英技能。 （20 秒。）你有 +90…258…300 最大生命值，+20 护甲值，并减少 1…8…10 点伤害。

a9c0e90cf0d004ccd31651981a4f07ee569e342e.source: Elite Stance. (20 seconds.) You have +90…258…300 maximum Health and +20 armor.
a9c0e90cf0d004ccd31651981a4f07ee569e342e.text: 精英姿态。 （20 秒。）你有 +90…258…300 最大生命值和 +20 护甲值。

4e0c66a9cb9a5f8fbdbf0ebe29bd5bffccf3e896.source: Enchantment Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) When using a skill on a foe, deal 5…17…20 shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.
4e0c66a9cb9a5f8fbdbf0ebe29bd5bffccf3e896.text: 结界咒语。 （30…54…60 秒。）对敌人使用技能时，对与你相邻的所有其他敌人造成 5…17…20 点暗影伤害。

46f6da20694ac35bef49867abace8909550052af.source: Spell. Removes one hex from target ally and one additional hex for each recharging Divine Favor skill you have.
46f6da20694ac35bef49867abace8909550052af.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形，并为你拥有的每个充电神圣恩惠技能额外移除一个六角形。

b8cfba74cab6a10c0555df122fe8126671624c8a.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Causes 1…4…5 Energy loss whenever target foe casts a spell. One foe near your target also loses Energy.
b8cfba74cab6a10c0555df122fe8126671624c8a.text: 精英六角咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）每当目标敌人施展法术时都会造成 1…4…5 点能量损失。目标附近的一名敌人也会失去能量。

7416ada2a82f997083df1009ba1bf7610aaf5080.source: Lead Attack. Deals +15…51…60 damage if you have less than 50…74…80% Health.
7416ada2a82f997083df1009ba1bf7610aaf5080.text: 引导攻击。如果您的生命值低于 50…74…80%，则会造成 +15…51…60 点伤害。

dbb0479517b3d9927e2932c1b3c03caae97b43b4.source: Melee Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage. Inflicts one of the following random conditions: Deep Wound (20 seconds), Weakness (20 seconds), Bleeding (25 seconds), or Crippled (15 seconds). You are knocked-down.
dbb0479517b3d9927e2932c1b3c03caae97b43b4.text: 近战攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。造成以下随机状况之一：深度伤口（20 秒）、虚弱（20 秒）、流血（25 秒）或残废（15 秒）。你被击倒了。

5846ab7688e0bdbac83343b1c078d2e672390d63.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30 second lifespan). On death, it deals 1…8…10 damage for each second it was alive to all foes in the area (maximum 150 damage).
5846ab7688e0bdbac83343b1c078d2e672390d63.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30）。死亡时，它每存活一秒，就会对该区域内的所有敌人造成 1…8…10 点伤害（最大 150 点伤害）。

08ef8be7d5ababd5847292b82d026b8c745ef605.source: Elite Item Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15…71…85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.
08ef8be7d5ababd5847292b82d026b8c745ef605.text: 精英物品法术。 （30…54…60 秒。）你的仪式技能有 20% 护甲穿透力。掉落效果：对区域内所有敌人造成15…71…85点闪电伤害。

6df892941bed7bb4d1ae998393a52adc2dfa4f24.source: Elite Item Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15…71…85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.
6df892941bed7bb4d1ae998393a52adc2dfa4f24.text: 精英物品法术。 （30…54…60 秒。）你的仪式技能有 10% 护甲穿透力。掉落效果：对区域内所有敌人造成15…71…85点闪电伤害。

585fadd3a75c4437f5359eff17a62c7eae08dd9d.source: Bow Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. Recharges your attack skills if it fails to hit.
585fadd3a75c4437f5359eff17a62c7eae08dd9d.text: 弓攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果未能击中，则为你的攻击技能重新充电。

9480e3e2454b78d11018a105653a753d55c38dcc.source: Elite Hammer Attack. Causes knock-down. Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds).
9480e3e2454b78d11018a105653a753d55c38dcc.text: 精英锤攻击。导致击倒。造成虚弱状态（5…17…20 秒）。

3f1e3191eee32958aa72ee76b764dfb29ca15de8.source: Sword Attack. Interrupts target foe. Interruption effect: disables this foe's attack skills (0…2…3 seconds) if that action was an attack.
3f1e3191eee32958aa72ee76b764dfb29ca15de8.text: 剑攻击。打断目标敌人。打断效果：如果该动作是攻击，则禁用该敌人的攻击技能（0…2…3秒）。

fbaedbc4c11cddd4a0b361e6358b349c93ce77d2.source: Spell. Removes one enchantment from target foe. 20…44…50% faster recharge if that foe was hexed.
fbaedbc4c11cddd4a0b361e6358b349c93ce77d2.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的一项结界。如果敌人被施咒，充电速度将加快 20…44…50%。

1c9698edabeb486368477103624259753b0a399f.source: Stance. (1…3…4 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block and +10 armor. Ends if you use an adrenal skill.
1c9698edabeb486368477103624259753b0a399f.text: 立场。 （1…3…4 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会和 +10 护甲值。如果您使用肾上腺技能则结束。

df6d8be1d74d771d48d96303b6a79b5e3273da8c.source: Elite Spell. Deals 30…94…110 damage. No effect unless target foe has a condition and is either hexed or enchanted.
df6d8be1d74d771d48d96303b6a79b5e3273da8c.text: 精英法术。造成 30…94…110 点伤害。除非目标敌人有某种状况并且被施咒或附魔，否则没有效果。

bf4f5270244d13ee48377aa645f2011a3fba228a.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (10…30…35 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and remove one enchantment.
bf4f5270244d13ee48377aa645f2011a3fba228a.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命10…30…35）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并移除 1 个结界。

44d9cff6de12b695f4b31f6492617e4d21f8420d.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (15…35…40 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and remove one enchantment.
44d9cff6de12b695f4b31f6492617e4d21f8420d.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命15…35…40）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并移除 1 个结界。

3585e0953960d1952adc7efcce40a815dd3cb661.source: Axe Attack. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).
3585e0953960d1952adc7efcce40a815dd3cb661.text: 斧头攻击。造成深度伤口状态（5…17…20 秒）。

dbeb562aaa4a98aee416265d9e3425ba9bbf6542.source: Spell. Removes one condition. Heals for 15…63…75 if target ally is enchanted.
dbeb562aaa4a98aee416265d9e3425ba9bbf6542.text: 咒语。删除一个条件。如果目标盟友被附魔，治疗量为 15…63…75。

d215e702316c71a111edd69c88df31e766faacfc.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have 75% chance to block. Block effect: this spirit takes 60 damage.
d215e702316c71a111edd69c88df31e766faacfc.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。范围内的非精神盟友有 75% 次格挡机会。格挡效果：该战魂受到60点伤害。

d7fd553559eeda22895cbd90d8ae2244a61af292.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have 75% chance to block. Block effect: this spirit takes 60 damage.
d7fd553559eeda22895cbd90d8ae2244a61af292.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。范围内的非精神盟友有 75% 次格挡机会。格挡效果：该战魂受到60点伤害。

684b0cc4831999e751f5958b6bb7245cf09cc74e.source: Preparation. (36 seconds.) Interrupts an action whenever your arrows critical.
684b0cc4831999e751f5958b6bb7245cf09cc74e.text: 准备。 （36 秒。）每当你的箭危急时就会中断动作。

2b0e39b089eebbcc9920fcfd152363b2c7e1a393.source: Axe Attack. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: interrupted skill is disabled for +20 seconds.
2b0e39b089eebbcc9920fcfd152363b2c7e1a393.text: 斧头攻击。打断一个动作。打断效果：打断技能无效+20秒。

eacfb0bd3afee1bacf185cb3140b4f34254fe267.source: Half Range Spell. Projectile: deals 10…30…35 earth damage. Interrupts a skill.
eacfb0bd3afee1bacf185cb3140b4f34254fe267.text: 半范围法术。射弹：造成 10…30…35 点地球伤害。打断技能。

845575968962bb0144eabb97d3ddf37c12874eae.source: Pet Attack. Deals +1…10…12 damage. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: interrupted skill is disabled for +20 seconds.
845575968962bb0144eabb97d3ddf37c12874eae.text: 宠物攻击。造成 +1…10…12 点伤害。打断技能。打断效果：打断技能无效+20秒。

04de1b7b421ee61c29a61c791af0eb6c1221661d.source: Bow Attack. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: +10…34…40 damage if you interrupt a skill.
04de1b7b421ee61c29a61c791af0eb6c1221661d.text: 弓攻击。打断一个动作。打断效果：打断技能时造成+10…34…40点伤害。

7f7e40b59afbd9e6adcb5cd3dee3bbe2d8fb241f.source: Lead Attack. Interrupts an action. If the interrupted action was a spell, it is disabled (3…9…10 seconds).
7f7e40b59afbd9e6adcb5cd3dee3bbe2d8fb241f.text: 引导攻击。打断一个动作。如果被打断的动作是咒语，则该咒语会被禁用（3…9…10 秒）。

1b5cdcc58f254468e71e66ea086ad9bf2b64db50.source: Spear Attack. Interrupts actions. No effect unless target has a condition.
1b5cdcc58f254468e71e66ea086ad9bf2b64db50.text: 长矛攻击。打断动作。除非目标有条件，否则没有效果。

b7655d1925fe8710922f1e5605304cd8ddbc73aa.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (10…22…25 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and interrupt actions.
b7655d1925fe8710922f1e5605304cd8ddbc73aa.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命10…22…25）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并中断行动。

7696853d87331c05d10eae84a5af0cb914c017cf.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (10…22…25 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and interrupt actions.
7696853d87331c05d10eae84a5af0cb914c017cf.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命10…22…25）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并中断行动。

7b5153bd4f4c791f2ba0de3208165179fb861180.source: Stance. (1…4…5 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Block cost: you lose 2 Energy or Distortion ends.
7b5153bd4f4c791f2ba0de3208165179fb861180.text: 立场。 （1…4…5 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。区块成本：你损失 2 点能量或扭曲结束。

9041d0dbdecdf59bf4d58d5bbea3202ac3e41dc8.source: Melee Attack. Also attacks foes adjacent to your target. Interrupts an action. Hits for no damage.
9041d0dbdecdf59bf4d58d5bbea3202ac3e41dc8.text: 近战攻击。还会攻击目标附近的敌人。打断一个动作。命中无伤害。

56e92e3b9fa1fbeea6d26912894a8b63c58fbb98.source: Bow Attack. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: interrupted skill is disabled for +20 seconds. Hits for only 1…13…16 damage.
56e92e3b9fa1fbeea6d26912894a8b63c58fbb98.text: 弓攻击。打断一个动作。打断效果：打断技能无效+20秒。仅造成 1…13…16 点伤害。

202583e78f86c0de03dc13fdcaeb8ed712622976.source: Melee Attack. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: Disables interrupted skill (30 seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor. Deals no damage.
202583e78f86c0de03dc13fdcaeb8ed712622976.text: 近战攻击。打断一个动作。打断效果：如果目标敌人的护甲破裂，则禁用打断技能（30秒）。不造成任何伤害。

38565e1478b8aa68b75dec5a4dc67e5c02cc2b26.source: Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next skill takes +10…47…56 seconds to recharge.
38565e1478b8aa68b75dec5a4dc67e5c02cc2b26.text: 降咒魔法。 （6 秒。）目标敌人的下一个技能需要 +10…47…56 秒才能恢复。

fffbbaaf9ed8b5d9e283456e7997ac6b5ce250b3.source: Elite Spell. Removes 1…3…3 hex[es]. For each hex removed, target ally loses one condition and gains 15…63…75 Health.
fffbbaaf9ed8b5d9e283456e7997ac6b5ce250b3.text: 精英法术。删除 1…3…3 降咒。每移除一个六角形，目标盟友就会失去一个条件并获得 15…63…75 点生命值。

51528aaea97d44370cdb8f8a2227262e6b4604b4.source: Enchantment Spell. Whenever you cast a Protection Prayer or Divine Favor spell on an ally, that ally is healed for 15…51…60. Heal cost: you lose 1 Energy.
51528aaea97d44370cdb8f8a2227262e6b4604b4.text: 结界咒语。每当你对盟友施展保护祈祷或神圣恩惠法术时，该盟友就会得到 15…51…60 点治疗。治疗费用：你失去 1 点能量。

893c6e6c00a530f04ed0aa19948dcfd864f90d61.source: Spell. Heals you and party members within earshot for 15…51…60.
893c6e6c00a530f04ed0aa19948dcfd864f90d61.text: 咒语。治愈你和听力范围内的队友，花费 15…51…60。

5be7c6a14b74c342a79f0c0626e505b078c0f04f.source: Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) Negates the next fatal damage target ally takes. Negation effect: heals for 26…197…240.
5be7c6a14b74c342a79f0c0626e505b078c0f04f.text: 结界咒语。 （10 秒。）使目标盟友受到的下一个致命伤害无效。负面效果：治愈 26…197…240 点。

1145c492aeaad8c8fdcfcb8e33fb6f0c8b1dc4e0.source: Enchantment Spell. (1…11…14 seconds.) Monk spells cost you 5 less Energy. Minimum cost: 1 Energy.
1145c492aeaad8c8fdcfcb8e33fb6f0c8b1dc4e0.text: 结界咒语。 （1…11…14 秒。）武僧法术消耗你 5 点能量。最低成本：1 能源。

471306fbf96dd9690891048b91b25e8bf8c04af8.source: Stance. (5…10…11 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 27…65…75% chance to block projectile attacks. Ends if you attack.
471306fbf96dd9690891048b91b25e8bf8c04af8.text: 立场。 （5…10…11 秒。）你移动速度加快 33%，并且有 27…65…75% 几率格挡射弹攻击。如果你攻击就结束。

0cf939adf1e0780177ac7df161c8b6296ed4734c.source: Signet. (8…18…20 seconds.) You have +10…34…40 armor and cannot be knocked-down. You move 75% slower.
0cf939adf1e0780177ac7df161c8b6296ed4734c.text: 印章。 （8…18…20 秒。）你有 +10…34…40 点护甲并且无法被击倒。你移动75%的速度较慢。

12f9a92c8818b0f0cffd6f05fdf9d29cecaca2cd.source: Spell. Deals 10…50…60 lightning damage (maximum 135) for each of your recharging binding rituals.
12f9a92c8818b0f0cffd6f05fdf9d29cecaca2cd.text: 咒语。每次充电绑定仪式都会造成 10…50…60 点闪电伤害（最多 135 点）。

443ff05124625428ca6ff4cdbbb14f1bb5f703b9.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Enchants you and target ally. Adjacent foes take 10…34…40 fire damage each second. Skills that target a foe also inflict Burning (1…3…4 seconds).
443ff05124625428ca6ff4cdbbb14f1bb5f703b9.text: 精英结界法术。 （8 秒。）使你和目标盟友着迷。相邻敌人每秒受到 10…34…40 点火焰伤害。以敌人为目标的技能也会造成燃烧（1…3…4 秒）。

413808799d5d824c55e3ecc81f717741e826b53c.source: Elite Sword Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage. You gain 1…4…5 strikes of adrenaline if it hits.
413808799d5d824c55e3ecc81f717741e826b53c.text: 精英剑攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。如果击中，你将获得 1…4…5 次肾上腺素打击。

4ef1ff178a38b58b7e1011b8a8fe8ce5f3fc632b.source: Spell. Deals 26…85…100 earth damage. Causes knock-down. Also hits foes near this foe.
4ef1ff178a38b58b7e1011b8a8fe8ce5f3fc632b.text: 咒语。造成 26…85…100 点地球伤害。导致击倒。也会攻击该敌人附近的敌人。

25e0e9ae7bd11e1171ef8964233cb0271b6aec54.source: Spell. Removes one Mesmer hex from target foe. Causes 1…4…5 Energy loss. You gain 4 Energy for each point lost. No effect unless a hex was removed.
25e0e9ae7bd11e1171ef8964233cb0271b6aec54.text: 咒语。从目标敌人身上移除一个幻术师六角形。造成 1…4…5 能量损失。每损失一分，您将获得 4 点能量。除非移除六角形，否则不会产生任何效果。

0453ae24dc64972e7c7a3a134678eac6e304c775.source: Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: you gain 8…15…17 Energy and 40…104…120 Health.
0453ae24dc64972e7c7a3a134678eac6e304c775.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的结界。移除效果：你获得 8…15…17 点能量和 40…104…120 点生命值。

bfcbf11c3a3b88e910279c489725e25f6a294660.source: Spell. Transfers all conditions from target ally to yourself. Transfer effect: you gain 6…22…26 Health for each condition. Cannot self-target.
bfcbf11c3a3b88e910279c489725e25f6a294660.text: 咒语。将所有条件从目标盟友转移到自己身上。转移效果：每种情况你都会获得 6…22…26 点生命值。无法自我定位。

6b6b39c275dca20138f86c297d6d75b5df13ae06.source: Spell. Teleports target allied spirit to your location.
6b6b39c275dca20138f86c297d6d75b5df13ae06.text: 咒语。将目标盟友精神传送到您所在的位置。

93302dc46968e8933f8bd5cb6014b7b0569f1265.source: Stance. (72…90 seconds.) You move and attack 10…15% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack 25…33% faster if you are drunk.
93302dc46968e8933f8bd5cb6014b7b0569f1265.text: 立场。 （72…90秒。）如果你没有喝醉，你的移动和攻击速度会更快10…15%。如果你喝醉了，你会更快地移动和攻击 25…33%。

59ca2744c469d5842c30fe3e8860c381c2e85015.source: Stance. (5…10…11 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block and +34…55…60 armor against elemental damage.
59ca2744c469d5842c30fe3e8860c381c2e85015.text: 立场。 （5…10…11 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡几率和 +34…55…60 点护甲值来抵御元素伤害。

785c29cd92817973e73baf504d4a4320a58cfd3f.source: Bow Attack. You shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 25% less damage
785c29cd92817973e73baf504d4a4320a58cfd3f.text: 弓攻击。你同时向目标敌人射出两支箭。这些箭造成的伤害减少 25%

7042a0d988f902611ce03f480c79be3dded24bf8.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (5…17…20 seconds). Removes ability to land a critical hit. Reduces damage by 3…17…20.
7042a0d988f902611ce03f480c79be3dded24bf8.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（5…17…20 秒）。消除致命一击的能力。伤害减少 3…17…20。

b6d6e9018c6acc54371ca2f606b6b1a9a736a223.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10…34…40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Blindness condition (1…3…4 seconds) on nearby foes.
b6d6e9018c6acc54371ca2f606b6b1a9a736a223.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （30 秒。）你的攻击造成地球伤害。初始效果：对附近敌人造成 10…34…40 点土属性伤害。最终效果：对附近的敌人造成失明状态（1…3…4秒）。

36580f06e7d5601b0dcc1fd0a1a880be93ca4bc6.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10…34…40 earth damage to adjacent foes. End effect: inflicts Blindness condition (1…3…4 seconds) on adjacent foes.
36580f06e7d5601b0dcc1fd0a1a880be93ca4bc6.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （30 秒。）你的攻击造成地球伤害。初始效果：对邻近敌人造成 10…34…40 点土属性伤害。最终效果：对邻近敌人造成失明状态（1…3…4秒）。

54abffc0626115dabd80f23931d784e31b14619e.source: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 10…22…25 damage every second (5 seconds). Inflicts Blindness condition (3…7…8 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Easily interrupted.
54abffc0626115dabd80f23931d784e31b14619e.text: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影响附近的敌人。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…22…25 点伤害。每秒（5 秒）造成失明状态（3…7…8 秒）。很容易被打断。

4c1cbb831f0f8f6e3cbd55711a41fd91cd88087c.source: Elite Stance. (5…10…11 seconds.) You attack 33% faster, you gain +40 armor, and your attack skills interrupt actions. No effect unless you have a hammer equipped.
4c1cbb831f0f8f6e3cbd55711a41fd91cd88087c.text: 精英姿态。 （5…10…11秒。）你的攻击速度加快了33%，你获得了+40点护甲，并且你的攻击技能会打断行动。除非你装备了锤子，否则没有效果。

09a72a7a121df3611af9ca0492a21261301d244f.source: Enchantment Spell. (24…30 seconds.) Your stances last 55…100% longer. You cannot be knocked-down if you activated this skill while drunk . There's a space between 'drunk' and the period
09a72a7a121df3611af9ca0492a21261301d244f.text: 结界咒语。 （24…30 秒。）你的姿势可以持续 55…100% 秒。醉酒状态下发动该技能，不会被击倒。 “醉”和句号之间有一个空格

3467488504297d28b8ef6351086d42ce7baaf34c.source: Spell. Heals for 20…56…65. Heals for 15…35…40 more for each enchantment and hex on target ally. Cannot self-target.
3467488504297d28b8ef6351086d42ce7baaf34c.text: 咒语。治疗 20…56…65 点。目标盟友的每个结界和妖术都会额外治疗 15…35…40 点。无法自我定位。

80b5d595b465e1680536762655e7412a492bb09d.source: Enchantment Spell. Enchants allies near your target (30 seconds). Your party is healed for 5…41…50 whenever one of these allies dies.
80b5d595b465e1680536762655e7412a492bb09d.text: 结界咒语。为目标附近的盟友附魔（30 秒）。每当这些盟友之一死亡时，你的队伍就会得到 5…41…50 点治疗。

4731f1b4243f5533314437f22dc335b88a47be42.source: Touch Spell. Heals for 60 (maximum 60…204…240) for each enchantment on you.
4731f1b4243f5533314437f22dc335b88a47be42.text: Touch Spell.你身上的每一个结界都会治疗 60 点（最多 60…204…240 点）。

0fadb48dcb0650f9858821d58afc903d5e340c1e.source: Touch Skill. Deals 50…70 piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (15…25 seconds).
0fadb48dcb0650f9858821d58afc903d5e340c1e.text: 触摸技能。造成 50…70 点穿刺伤害并造成流血状态（15…25 秒）。

795b9123a3819e2acb136cacda22d3363de50b30.source: Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the Energy cost when you use an Earth Magic skill.
795b9123a3819e2acb136cacda22d3363de50b30.text: 结界咒语。 （36…55…60秒。）当你使用土系魔法技能时，你获得1点能量加上30%点能量消耗。

c983a911d72238383d751ef2c9f5c609ab3fea56.source: Elite Hammer Attack. Knocks down target and adjacent foes. 50% failure chance unless Hammer Mastery is 5 or more.
c983a911d72238383d751ef2c9f5c609ab3fea56.text: 精英锤攻击。击倒目标和邻近的敌人。 50% 失败几率，除非锤子精通达到 5 或更高。

7ea2862599e2b9d4a6ceca07e261f26552186ba3.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Any time non-spirit foes within range are knocked down, they are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 50…30…25 Health.
7ea2862599e2b9d4a6ceca07e261f26552186ba3.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。每当范围内的非精神敌人被击倒时，他们都会被击倒至少 3 秒。击倒成本：该精魂失去 50…30…25 点生命值。

2cf873f0825dcca06be22fb6c5b6aa7f50ab8882.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Any time non-spirit foes within range are knocked down, they are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 50…30…25 Health.
2cf873f0825dcca06be22fb6c5b6aa7f50ab8882.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。每当范围内的非精神敌人被击倒时，他们都会被击倒至少 3 秒。击倒成本：该精魂失去 50…30…25 点生命值。

d6b88c1a1308c21c86ee61ae5662d578b5ca005a.source: Hex Spell. (3 seconds.) Target and nearby foes move 90% slower. Applies Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds when it ends.
d6b88c1a1308c21c86ee61ae5662d578b5ca005a.text: 降咒魔法。 （3 秒。）目标和附近的敌人移动速度减慢 90%。结束时施加弱点 5…17…20 秒。

54d354742d3655e3b25f72fd6fc85790f8000149.source: Spell. Deals 26…85…100 earth damage. Also hits foes near target. Causes knock-down.
54d354742d3655e3b25f72fd6fc85790f8000149.text: 咒语。造成 26…85…100 点地球伤害。也会击中目标附近的敌人。导致击倒。

45f7a15c0b9a56e7065493b3afd266c21ba98e63.source: Ward Spell. (14…20 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +24 armor and +24 more armor against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.
45f7a15c0b9a56e7065493b3afd266c21ba98e63.text: 守卫咒语。 （14…20 秒。）该病房中的盟友拥有 +24 点护甲，并且对抗夏尔时还有 +24 点护甲。 Spirits are unaffected.

75ca3179adfba65ac3e29c913d2eb7f15a8585b9.source: Ward Spell. (14…20 seconds.) Allies in this ward deal +8…15 damage and +7…10 more damage against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.
75ca3179adfba65ac3e29c913d2eb7f15a8585b9.text: 守卫咒语。 （14…20 秒。）该守卫内的盟友对夏尔造成 +8…15 点伤害，并额外造成 +7…10 点伤害。 Spirits are unaffected.

9e4b9c27f7d7b669efb3e7756849f59c2a5d04cd.source: Ward Spell. (14…20 seconds.) Spells that allies in this ward cast have a 44…60% chance to recharge 50% faster. Spirits are unaffected.
9e4b9c27f7d7b669efb3e7756849f59c2a5d04cd.text: 守卫咒语。 （14…20 秒。）该病房中的盟友施展的法术有 44…60% 几率更快地充能 50%。 Spirits are unaffected.

dda4bb03a3ad6ea4cf4a4aec15a84992f48f244d.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deal +3…25…30 earth damage with your melee attacks. Initial Effect: Blinds nearby foes for 1…6…7 seconds. End Effect: removes Blindness. No effect unless wielding an earth weapon.
dda4bb03a3ad6ea4cf4a4aec15a84992f48f244d.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。 （30 秒。）你的近战攻击造成 +3…25…30 点地球伤害。初始效果：使附近敌人致盲 1…6…7 秒。最终效果：消除失明。除非使用地球武器，否则没有效果。

6007a62895d2e8764aa0775bc6bf50a64c91cad1.source: Spell. Heals you and target ally for 70…110. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. Cannot self-target.
6007a62895d2e8764aa0775bc6bf50a64c91cad1.text: 咒语。治疗你和目标盟友 70…110 点。初始效果：暗影步到该盟友。无法自我定位。

f662940f41d4524ce5b88a74f107d0eaf6002c59.source: Spell. Projectile: deals 10…70…85 earth damage and inflicts Weakness condition (5…13…15 seconds).
f662940f41d4524ce5b88a74f107d0eaf6002c59.text: 咒语。投射物：造成 10…70…85 点地球伤害并造成虚弱状态（5…13…15 秒）。

f91a482df7af49c72de0983c705d2bd4a58cc84b.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike; it Shadow Steps to this foe. If this foe is a Charr, the assassin lives for 24…30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12…15 seconds.
f91a482df7af49c72de0983c705d2bd4a58cc84b.text: 咒语。召唤14…20级刺客，拥有铁掌、狐牙、九尾击；它向这个敌人施展暗影步。如果这个敌人是夏尔，那么刺客的生命为 24…30 秒。如果目标敌人不是夏尔，刺客的生命时间为 12…15 秒。

5b31ac2cbcd8e81754c5bde86ee24d75783e95a0.source: Spell. Deals 54…90 piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5…25 seconds). 10% chance of +540…900 piercing damage. 25% chance of +540…900 piercing damage if target foe is a Charr.
5b31ac2cbcd8e81754c5bde86ee24d75783e95a0.text: 咒语。造成 54…90 点穿刺伤害并造成流血状态（5…25 秒）。 10% 几率造成 +540…900 穿刺伤害。如果目标敌人是夏尔，则有 25% 几率造成 +540…900 点穿刺伤害。

a5249ae72cc2abd4ef15648c198c090acd466b6b.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Echo becomes the next skill you use (30 seconds).
a5249ae72cc2abd4ef15648c198c090acd466b6b.text: 精英结界法术。 （30 秒。）回声成为你使用的下一个技能（30 秒）。

175c20609b05ef3e48ef564bdf58e4ad824ce6ca.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Deals 14…43…50 damage to creatures in its range whenever a creature of the same type dies. Does not affect spirits. No damage to creatures above 90% Health.
175c20609b05ef3e48ef564bdf58e4ad824ce6ca.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。每当同一类型的生物死亡时，对其范围内的生物造成 14…43…50 点伤害。不影响精神。对生命值高于 90% 的生物不会造成伤害。

325ff52b4978b64a26c0891dade71aefdc34e4da.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (25…53…60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are increased by +1…2…2. You gain 1 plus 50% of the Energy cost of any Air, Earth, Fire, and Water Magic skills you use.
325ff52b4978b64a26c0891dade71aefdc34e4da.text: 精英结界法术。 （25…53…60秒。）你的元素属性增加+1…2…2。你获得1加上你使用的任何风、土、火和水魔法技能的能量消耗50%。

2b23cf9b78e66c59c5a47f85ef527ba02c37c194.source: Enchantment Spell. (10…30…35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1…4…5 seconds) whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a target.
2b23cf9b78e66c59c5a47f85ef527ba02c37c194.text: 结界咒语。 （10…30…35 秒。）每当您对目标应用元素六角形时，都会造成燃烧状态（1…4…5 秒）。

12bf86a5737bcf8c733222aa1162de5029977381.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1…2…2 seconds) whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a target.
12bf86a5737bcf8c733222aa1162de5029977381.text: 结界咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）每当您对目标应用元素六角形时，都会造成燃烧状态（1…2…2 秒）。

21060b4d3a02f001c388645a06028ffa363edde6.source: Enchantment Spell. (40…60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
21060b4d3a02f001c388645a06028ffa363edde6.text: 结界咒语。 （40…60 秒。）你的元素属性提升 1 点。每次你施展法术时，每 10 级能量储存，你就会获得 1 点能量，并获得法术能量消耗 100…300% 点的治疗效果。

226189556bcb922dfcda02e686fa9b91748ba0ec.source: Stance. (30…78…90 seconds.) You have +40 armor against elemental damage. You have -24…14…12 armor against physical damage.
226189556bcb922dfcda02e686fa9b91748ba0ec.text: 立场。 （30…78…90 秒。）你有 +40 点护甲值来抵抗元素伤害。 You have -24…14…12 armor against physical damage.

ffeb1a2dd8cc4eeb45ef498a0c91593cacc12a9a.source: Elite Spell. Removes one condition and hex from target ally and yourself, and heals for 50. Cannot self-target.
ffeb1a2dd8cc4eeb45ef498a0c91593cacc12a9a.text: 精英法术。移除目标盟友和你自己的一种状况和咒语，并治疗 50 点。无法自我定位。

0adf8324e26eae97e237ebda785b08fb83ed7873.source: Hex Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Target foe's attacks deal 1…12…15 less damage, and that foe takes 10…46…55 damage with each attack.
0adf8324e26eae97e237ebda785b08fb83ed7873.text: 降咒魔法。 （5…13…15 秒。）目标敌人的攻击造成的伤害减少 1…12…15，并且该敌人每次攻击都会受到 10…46…55 点伤害。

55df6e18846ef072a50dbb02dc83dea4797c9a03.source: Hex Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Target foe takes 15…39…45 damage whenever it attacks.
55df6e18846ef072a50dbb02dc83dea4797c9a03.text: 降咒魔法。 （5…13…15 秒。）目标敌人每次攻击都会受到 15…39…45 点伤害。

ce02e30f933a6f43386e81b40400e02033367edf.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (15…51…60 second lifespan). Allies in range holding an item gain 15…39…45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy.
ce02e30f933a6f43386e81b40400e02033367edf.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命15…51…60）。范围内持有物品的盟友获得 15…39…45 最大生命值和 10 最大能量。

587abf16366034d2eda00878ab9674f9e38a4cf5.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (15…51…60 second lifespan). Allies in range holding an item gain 15…39…45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy.
587abf16366034d2eda00878ab9674f9e38a4cf5.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命15…51…60）。范围内持有物品的盟友获得 15…39…45 最大生命值和 10 最大能量。

067539202515ddcdfa35b6ab12260d57b47c2b4d.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (7 seconds). You move 25% faster. Lose 1 condition if this enchantment ends prematurely.
067539202515ddcdfa35b6ab12260d57b47c2b4d.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （7 秒）。你移动25%的速度更快。如果此结界提前结束，则失去 1 条件。

07a560f72f042d46a8ec46421b79e37298f91651.source: Elite Hex Spell. Causes 100…180…200% slower enchantment casting (10 seconds). Initial effect: if target foe is not enchanted deals 10…82…100 damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes.
07a560f72f042d46a8ec46421b79e37298f91651.text: 精英六角咒语。造成 100…180…200% 次结界施法变慢（10 秒）。初始效果：如果目标敌人未附魔，则对目标造成 10…82…100 点伤害，并对邻近敌人造成 75% 点伤害。

998051042dd1b61a90d9ac5a2f8b11b88a5d9521.source: Skill. (7…16…18 seconds.) You have +90…258…300 maximum Health.
998051042dd1b61a90d9ac5a2f8b11b88a5d9521.text: 技能。 (7…16…18 seconds.) You have +90…258…300 maximum Health.

80de4343fd5ea344bda225c181779c4d90ffce09.source: Echo. (10…30…35 seconds.) Chants and shouts last 50% longer on target ally. Cannot target spirits.
80de4343fd5ea344bda225c181779c4d90ffce09.text: 回声。 （10…30…35 秒。）对目标盟友的吟唱和呼喊持续时间延长 50%。无法瞄准灵体。

a540a8e2368e801731037c121e478b1f643b6498.source: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -1…4…5 Health degeneration. Renewal: if the target foe is moving when this hex ends.
a540a8e2368e801731037c121e478b1f643b6498.text: 降咒魔法。 （5 秒。）导致 -1…4…5 健康退化。更新：如果目标敌人在该六角形结束时正在移动。

c1a6cfced64e143e678136e0e985c47e4c71c16d.source: Item Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) You have +2 Energy regeneration. Drop effect: you gain +1…8…10 Energy.
c1a6cfced64e143e678136e0e985c47e4c71c16d.text: 物品法术。 （5…13…15 秒。）你有 +2 能量再生。掉落效果：你获得+1…8…10点能量。

a0ceafe3c6f76cc04145cfcbaa358fea0e2b288c.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) The next shout or chant costs 3…6…7 less Energy for allies within earshot.
a0ceafe3c6f76cc04145cfcbaa358fea0e2b288c.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）对于听力范围内的盟友来说，下一次喊叫或吟唱会减少 3…6…7 点能量。

6bdf3d7c3711d02cd43d22b1fe2e0112c2c259c2.source: Echo. (10…30…35 seconds.) Target ally gains 1…2…2 Energy whenever a shout or chant ends on that ally. Cannot target spirits.
6bdf3d7c3711d02cd43d22b1fe2e0112c2c259c2.text: 回声。 （10…30…35 秒。）每当目标盟友的喊叫或吟唱结束时，该盟友就会获得 1…2…2 点能量。无法瞄准灵体。

d388a94215111fccd04856e37cc6b36d4ede0d99.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…5…6 spirit (1…48…60 seconds lifespan). Skills cost 15 less energy (minimum cost 10 energy) and recharge 25% slower for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
d388a94215111fccd04856e37cc6b36d4ede0d99.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…5…6级武魂（寿命1…48…60秒）。技能消耗的能量减少 15 点（最低消耗 10 点能量），范围内的生物充电速度慢 25% 点。不影响精神。

c27f6605e2281953167e23fd5e0c8a31b9c43b46.source: Spell. Deals 1…2…2 damage (maximum 130) for each point of Energy you have.
c27f6605e2281953167e23fd5e0c8a31b9c43b46.text: 咒语。你拥有的每点能量都会造成 1…2…2 点伤害（最多 130 点）。

f83e52cddf1e791b72b6ab2d8b99cd5f96b77611.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) Maximum Health for you and target ally is increased by 1…3…3 for each point of maximum Energy. Initial effect: Both gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain +1 Energy for every 2 points of Energy Storage.
f83e52cddf1e791b72b6ab2d8b99cd5f96b77611.text: 精英结界法术。 （36…55…60 秒。）每点最大能量，你和目标盟友的最大生命值就会增加 1…3…3。初始效果：双方获得 1…10…12 点能量。每 2 点能量存储，您将获得 +1 点能量。

c3cf330582259e8dc80ae7f7734d470ae15c2dd3.source: Spell. Causes 1…8…10 Energy loss. Deals 9 damage for each point of Energy lost.
c3cf330582259e8dc80ae7f7734d470ae15c2dd3.text: 咒语。造成 1…8…10 能量损失。每损失一点能量就会造成 9 点伤害。

c61b39171897f8fc38b761f933ac37be79edbead.source: Elite Spell. Causes 2…8…9 Energy loss. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
c61b39171897f8fc38b761f933ac37be79edbead.text: 精英法术。造成 2…8…9 能量损失。每损失一点能量，你就会获得 3 点能量。

83dc36eb01b3b36c4f919e81bfd382e5e7dc1dcd.source: Elite Spell. Causes 1…8…10 Energy loss. Deals 7 damage to target for each point of Energy lost and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.
83dc36eb01b3b36c4f919e81bfd382e5e7dc1dcd.text: 精英法术。造成 1…8…10 能量损失。每损失一点能量，就会对目标造成 7 点伤害，并对附近的敌人造成 75% 点伤害。

4e6dc295794e58d89a2e7654693722846b875586.source: Spell. Causes 4…6…7 Energy loss. You gain 2 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
4e6dc295794e58d89a2e7654693722846b875586.text: 咒语。造成 4…6…7 能量损失。每损失一点能量，你就会获得 2 点能量。

f3ec019620533a8d9f81f77638b7f12b1302c5ab.source: Spell. Deals 25…45…50 lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds). 25% armor penetration.
f3ec019620533a8d9f81f77638b7f12b1302c5ab.text: 咒语。造成 25…45…50 点闪电伤害。 Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds). 25% 护甲穿透。

9aa445f613aaa5392e780d5725e4cd2de76ccb42.text: 咒语。造成虚弱状态（10…26…30 秒）。

c1e1dc62313ec04658bfb3e624ee58ac104fb7db.source: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds) on this foe and nearby foes.
c1e1dc62313ec04658bfb3e624ee58ac104fb7db.text: 咒语。对该敌人和附近的敌人造成虚弱状态（5…17…20秒）。

3902c159f06d1a6a8bf646ea835fcefbf8d70668.source: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition (1…13…16 seconds) on this foe and nearby foes.
3902c159f06d1a6a8bf646ea835fcefbf8d70668.text: 咒语。对该敌人和附近的敌人造成虚弱状态（1…13…16秒）。

e83a5ff1bf598f60c8ebe2e9c81c73d331da7b5c.source: Touch Skill. Causes 5…53…65 Health loss. Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds).
e83a5ff1bf598f60c8ebe2e9c81c73d331da7b5c.text: 触摸技能。造成 5…53…65 人生命值损失。 Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds).

1c6b538a92cc34558c0a428d7906d5988be64ba2.source: Elite Pet Attack. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) and deals +10…42…50 damage.
1c6b538a92cc34558c0a428d7906d5988be64ba2.text: 精英宠物攻击。造成深度伤口状态（5…17…20 秒）并造成 +10…42…50 点伤害。

11b544fea45d09fc5f01bbe0224e02faf348556b.source: Elite Pet Attack. Deals +3…19…23 damage (maximum 60) for each of your recharging Beast Mastery skills.
11b544fea45d09fc5f01bbe0224e02faf348556b.text: 精英宠物攻击。每项充能的野兽掌握技能都会造成 +3…19…23 点伤害（最多 60 点）。

bebd0344b5e04e904dee228b1a1fc1636198ae40.source: Elite Hammer Attack. Gives you 1…3…4 strikes of adrenaline if you hit. Deals +10…34…40 damage and causes knockdown if target foe was moving.
bebd0344b5e04e904dee228b1a1fc1636198ae40.text: 精英锤攻击。如果你击中，会给你 1…3…4 次肾上腺素冲击。如果目标敌人正在移动，则会造成 +10…34…40 点伤害并导致击倒。
