601074ba7103d1f634c4b7d5a568891641c10b9b.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
601074ba7103d1f634c4b7d5a568891641c10b9b.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害并获得 2 次肾上腺素攻击。

f3669f076dfff8cd6c554df50b39e8ae2ce0d641.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 second lifespan). Creatures in range have 10% slower movement: also negates speed boosts. Does not affect spirits.
f3669f076dfff8cd6c554df50b39e8ae2ce0d641.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…150…180）。范围内的生物移动速度减慢 10%：同时也会抵消速度提升。不影响精神。

9d3f1d5389f08fbce3af98617f178e860b2a6113.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: all adjacent foes are Diseased (1…8…10 seconds.) Double duration if you are already enchanted. End Effect: party members in earshot lose Disease.
9d3f1d5389f08fbce3af98617f178e860b2a6113.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （20 秒。） 初始效果：所有相邻的敌人都患病（1…8…10 秒。） 如果你已经被附魔，则持续时间加倍。最终效果：听力范围内的队员失去疾病。

cf2505e3a8bd9c8e5b1a6bd8759fd684bc8c9aff.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: all adjacent foes are Diseased (2…5…6 seconds.) Double duration if you are already enchanted. End Effect: party members in earshot lose Disease.
cf2505e3a8bd9c8e5b1a6bd8759fd684bc8c9aff.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （20 秒。） 初始效果：所有相邻的敌人都患病（2…5…6 秒。） 如果你已经被附魔，则持续时间加倍。最终效果：听力范围内的队员失去疾病。

72be76c7409e2117ef5031b11818185f414fa6d0.source: Spell. Heals you for 5…53…65. Heals all enchanted party members for 5…53…65 Health.
72be76c7409e2117ef5031b11818185f414fa6d0.text: 咒语。治愈你 5…53…65 点生命值。治愈所有被施魔法的小队成员 5…53…65 点生命值。

5dc378800b7b77e7442bce0567f5584898f9554b.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) You have +1…3…4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.
5dc378800b7b77e7442bce0567f5584898f9554b.text: 结界咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）你身上的每个结界（最多 8）可以恢复 +1…3…4 点生命值。

88197b13bcec23b9e44631f2a89738834c9ea072.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) You have +1…3…4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 3) on you.
88197b13bcec23b9e44631f2a89738834c9ea072.text: 结界咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）你身上的每个结界（最多 3）可以恢复 +1…3…4 点生命值。

7cc40285dd4f1dda1a940e05481c3d192db7e5d0.source: Spell. (3 seconds.) Deals 10…34…40 earth damage each second. Deals an additional 10…18…20 damage to attacking foes. Hits foes nearby your initial location. Lasts twice as long if you are enchanted.
7cc40285dd4f1dda1a940e05481c3d192db7e5d0.text: 咒语。 （3 秒。）每秒造成 10…34…40 点地球伤害。对攻击的敌人造成额外 10…18…20 点伤害。攻击您初始位置附近的敌人。如果你着魔的话，持续时间会是原来的两倍。

3f828e099854463364a008397d35fe899b2e2f3b.source: Melee Attack. Deals +3…10…12 damage. Deals an additional +3…10…12 damage if you are enchanted.
3f828e099854463364a008397d35fe899b2e2f3b.text: 近战攻击。造成 +3…10…12 点伤害。如果您被附魔，则会造成额外 +3…10…12 点伤害。

8318892753a072624b3e06d272b622e25a2ebacb.source: Spell. Deals 10…50…60 cold damage to all nearby foes. Deals 10…50…60 more cold damage if you are enchanted.
8318892753a072624b3e06d272b622e25a2ebacb.text: 咒语。对附近所有敌人造成 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害。如果您被附魔，则会额外造成 10…50…60 点寒冷伤害。

9f84ab9727ab61c42a9769dafb9e929b8fb5ffec.source: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) You gain 3…13…15 Health (maximum 25) for each enchantment on you whenever you hit with an attack.
9f84ab9727ab61c42a9769dafb9e929b8fb5ffec.text: 结界咒语。 （20 秒。）每当你受到攻击时，你身上的每个结界都会获得 3…13…15 点生命值（最多 25 点）。

56bd12dec3fd0b6d04f66fc8d11398fc11724e72.source: Spell. Heals you for 50…146…170. This skill activates 50% faster if you are not enchanted.
56bd12dec3fd0b6d04f66fc8d11398fc11724e72.text: 咒语。治疗你 50…146…170 点。如果你没有附魔，该技能会更快地激活 50% 点。

dc9f3482c275cf5464aff69bb65f58169bb1fdb9.source: Stance. (1…7…8 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 50% chance to block. Ends if you become hexed or enchanted.
dc9f3482c275cf5464aff69bb65f58169bb1fdb9.text: 立场。 （1…7…8 秒。）你移动速度更快 33% 并且有 50% 机会阻挡。如果你被施咒或着魔，则结束。

f50572e0425e38b1fe82d1926dc66c8d9276ab7e.source: Skill. (4…13…15 seconds.) You gain 33% more adrenaline. No effect if you are enchanted.
f50572e0425e38b1fe82d1926dc66c8d9276ab7e.text: 技能。 （4…13…15 秒。）你的肾上腺素增加了 33%。如果你被迷住了，则没有效果。

a88d1ddc052f781135fffe27570c71dd70e3fc58.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). For creatures in range, enchantments and Hexes unlike other descriptions with "hex" or "hexes" in it, it is capitalized here take twice as long to cast and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. Does not affect spirits.
a88d1ddc052f781135fffe27570c71dd70e3fc58.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。对于范围内的生物，结界和六角形与其他带有“六角形”或“六角形”的描述不同，这里大写，需要两倍的时间来施放，并且需要两倍的能量来维持结界。不影响精神。

79ae87153268e3eecd2954462f1a7ee71a6b7171.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). For creatures in range, enchantments and Hexes unlike other descriptions with "hex" or "hexes" in it, it is capitalized here take 50…70…75% as long to cast and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. Does not affect spirits.
79ae87153268e3eecd2954462f1a7ee71a6b7171.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。对于范围内的生物，结界和降咒，与其他带有“降咒”或“降咒”的描述不同，这里大写，需要 50…70…75% 的时间来施放，并且需要两倍的能量来维持结界。不影响精神。

5ad1be2c3971961a74adde285c15944f8cb92977.source: Skill. Deals 60…90 damage if target foe has a condition or hex.
5ad1be2c3971961a74adde285c15944f8cb92977.text: 技能。如果目标敌人有状况或妖术，则造成 60…90 点伤害。

a43c4525ea9140fb627ebab46471beeac40d258d.source: Bow Attack. Fast-moving arrow. Deals 10…26…30 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is below 50% Health. Your other attack skills are disabled (2 seconds).
a43c4525ea9140fb627ebab46471beeac40d258d.text: 弓攻击。快速移动的箭头。造成 10…26…30 点伤害。如果目标敌人生命值低于 50%，则立即充能。你的其他攻击技能被禁用（2秒）。

e9d59349686a88377c5101988ee5dbc7cdfc5aaf.source: Skill. (18…25 seconds.) You and your pet attack 25% faster and have +1…3 Health regeneration.
e9d59349686a88377c5101988ee5dbc7cdfc5aaf.text: 技能。 （18…25 秒。）你和你的宠物攻击速度加快 25%，生命恢复速度达到 +1…3。

85d996693e662b7bc7b729d3fa99fc27645d46d0.source: Weapon Spell. (12 seconds.) Target ally's attacks steal 10…42…50 Health but deal 10…42…50 less damage. Ends after 3 attacks.
85d996693e662b7bc7b729d3fa99fc27645d46d0.text: 武器咒语。 （12 秒。）目标盟友的攻击窃取 10…42…50 点生命值，但造成的伤害减少 10…42…50 点。 3次攻击后结束。

85d3d5e4469bd0e1ad9ea12ee01cf7cf60c5964e.source: Dual Attack. Deals +15…35…40 damage. Unblockable. Must follow an off-hand attack.
85d3d5e4469bd0e1ad9ea12ee01cf7cf60c5964e.text: 双重攻击。造成 +15…35…40 点伤害。不可封锁。必须跟随副手攻击。

57b15a59910d25155962968e5552ed7e0cf63ee3.source: Elite Bow Attack. Recharges all skills except Oath Shot if it hits. Disables all skills if it misses (10…5…4 seconds). 50% miss chance unless Expertise 8 or higher.
57b15a59910d25155962968e5552ed7e0cf63ee3.text: 精英弓攻击。如果击中的话，会为除誓言射击之外的所有技能进行充能。如果未命中（10…5…4 秒），则禁用所有技能。除非专长 8 或更高，否则 50% 会错失机会。

2a82308b753a1450993fd7b26c78fdc51d023319.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (8…18…20 seconds.) You have +20 armor and enemy spells cannot target you. You cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.
2a82308b753a1450993fd7b26c78fdc51d023319.text: 精英结界法术。 （8…18…20 秒。）你有 +20 点护甲，敌人的法术无法瞄准你。你无法攻击并且能量退化为 -2。

405557c6c6d5b6e1200a1591938ef11150b758af.source: Elite Spell. You gain 8…15…17 Energy. You do not sacrifice Health if any spirits are within earshot.
405557c6c6d5b6e1200a1591938ef11150b758af.text: 精英法术。您获得 8…15…17 能量。如果有任何灵魂在听力范围内，你就不会牺牲生命值。

bd526911d09f659b3f4ee8dd30dce79282f476b4.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (3…13…15 seconds.) You attack, move and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
bd526911d09f659b3f4ee8dd30dce79282f476b4.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。 （3…13…15 秒。）你的攻击、移动和获得肾上腺素的速度加快了 25%。

63c481810606f55ffb6ec9b08c160312e14d25b6.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (2…7…8 seconds.) You attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
63c481810606f55ffb6ec9b08c160312e14d25b6.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。 （2…7…8 秒。）你攻击并获得肾上腺素的速度加快了 25%。

826d96c1411d99f20d230d4b8963043f675060ba.source: Spell. Deals 10…26…30 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Poison and Weakness (3…10…12 second) on foes suffering from a condition.
826d96c1411d99f20d230d4b8963043f675060ba.text: 咒语。对目标和邻近敌人造成 10…26…30 点伤害。对患有某种疾病的敌人造成中毒和虚弱（3…10…12秒）。

bbbabf6ee6397e7a65567886b3786d8a81934e8e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds). These party members remove one enchantment when they deal physical damage. Removal cost: for each Monk enchantment, you lose 10…4…3% maximum Health.
bbbabf6ee6397e7a65567886b3786d8a81934e8e.text: 精英结界法术。使所有队伍成员着迷（5 秒）。这些小队成员在造成物理伤害时会移除一项结界。移除成本：对于每个武僧结界，你会损失 10…4…3% 点最大生命值。

c9d5ec414293b6b595066639259557bb3d183831.source: Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds). 3…13…16 more damage whenever these party members hit with physical damage.
c9d5ec414293b6b595066639259557bb3d183831.text: 结界咒语。使所有队伍成员着迷（5 秒）。每当这些队员受到物理伤害时，伤害就会增加 3…13…16 点。

3ae53cf53aa6cef1dbe289050a9f11190561e0b2.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds.) These party members steal 3…13…16 Health with each physical damage attack. Party members under another Necromancer enchantment are not affected.
3ae53cf53aa6cef1dbe289050a9f11190561e0b2.text: 精英结界法术。为所有小队成员附魔（5 秒）。这些小队成员每次物理伤害攻击都会窃取 3…13…16 点生命值。处于另一个死灵法师结界下的小队成员不受影响。

712ae016948195bafa40f1aea6896ef4b5721853.source: Elite Spell. (5 seconds.) Your undead servants deal +3…13…16 damage. You lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever your servants hit.
712ae016948195bafa40f1aea6896ef4b5721853.text: 精英法术。 （5 秒。）你的不死仆从造成 +3…13…16 点伤害。每当你的仆人攻击时，你就会失去 2% 点最大生命值。

da6de1a40315ae051de94c191cd9b48f265b5e36.source: Shout. (10…22…25 seconds.) Your pet has +24 armor and is unblockable.
da6de1a40315ae051de94c191cd9b48f265b5e36.text: 喊叫。 （10…22…25 秒。）你的宠物有 +24 点护甲并且不可阻挡。

2cea27d687a4abfd44803ca9ea7b1f9217dc8fd5.source: Shout. (5…13…15 seconds.) Your pet has +24 armor and is unblockable.
2cea27d687a4abfd44803ca9ea7b1f9217dc8fd5.text: 喊叫。 （5…13…15 秒。）你的宠物有 +24 点护甲并且不可阻挡。

9abeaf10d0df050c02444cabdfcf4ceadadd8a85.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Spells cast 20…44…50% faster and recharge 40…72…80% faster. Continuously gain Overcast while active. PvE Skill
9abeaf10d0df050c02444cabdfcf4ceadadd8a85.text: 精英结界法术。法术施放速度更快 20…44…50%，充能速度更快 40…72…80%。活跃时持续获得阴天。 PvE技能

5c7886f09b77192e245c90f99e5cb2f5e75b78af.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +1…16…20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, they are Dazed (1…7…8 seconds).
5c7886f09b77192e245c90f99e5cb2f5e75b78af.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人被击倒，他们会陷入茫然（1…7…8 秒）。

b84cf49bb7bd57c0cccf7bc250d9da8d6496c9b3.source: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -1…3…3 Health degeneration. If target foe is using a skill, that foe takes 15…63…75 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.
b84cf49bb7bd57c0cccf7bc250d9da8d6496c9b3.text: 降咒魔法。 （5 秒。）导致 -1…3…3 健康退化。如果目标敌人正在使用技能，则该敌人将受到 15…63…75 点伤害，所有相邻敌人将受到 75% 点伤害。

16c31becfacb6ea495383d338cc395c387f31d4d.source: Hex Spell. (4…7…8 seconds.) Target foe cannot attack. Ends if this foe takes damage.
16c31becfacb6ea495383d338cc395c387f31d4d.text: 降咒魔法。 （4…7…8 秒。）目标敌人无法攻击。如果该敌人受到伤害则结束。

b4dfc150c1105412d09295053981cbbf0ea07a05.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (30…126…150 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…25…30 damage.
b4dfc150c1105412d09295053981cbbf0ea07a05.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命30…126…150）。它的攻击造成 5…25…30 点伤害。

c96c2acbf858b867b4d63633e64dcbe607a2729f.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (30…126…150 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…25…30 damage.
c96c2acbf858b867b4d63633e64dcbe607a2729f.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命30…126…150）。它的攻击造成 5…25…30 点伤害。

e911bcb489557ef216797cf944a34e5074f9aee3.source: Hex Spell. (6…10 seconds.) Deals 100…140% of the damage (maximum 80) back to target foe every time it does damage.
e911bcb489557ef216797cf944a34e5074f9aee3.text: 降咒魔法。 （6…10 秒。）每次造成伤害时，都会对目标敌人造成 100…140% 点伤害（最多 80 点）。

a9acf4519ade2d33edfcc789aa98a81d7893506c.source: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…3…3 enchantments. Removal effect: that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10…82…100 Health.
a9acf4519ade2d33edfcc789aa98a81d7893506c.text: 精英法术。目标敌人失去 1…3…3 个结界。移除效果：该敌人及所有邻近敌人失去 10…82…100 点生命值。

0f006ec20421071224ea8a87f8ddb71eceae7b99.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (10…18…20 seconds). Spirits do 8…18…20 more damage against these foes.
0f006ec20421071224ea8a87f8ddb71eceae7b99.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（10…18…20 秒）。灵魂对这些敌人造成 8…18…20 点额外伤害。

c56d4f6ec9628f756cae66981f56b3562c2a7f73.source: Elite Touch Skill. Deals 10…54…65 damage and inflicts Crippled condition (1…4…5 seconds). This skill counts as an off-hand attack.
c56d4f6ec9628f756cae66981f56b3562c2a7f73.text: 精英触摸技能。造成 10…54…65 点伤害并造成瘫痪状态（1…4…5 秒）。该技能算作副手攻击。

6d90f2d41d9a1f3e56a82d89e749b8f3b47fb359.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (1…8…10 seconds). Interrupts all other nearby foes whenever a hexed foe successfully activates a skill.
6d90f2d41d9a1f3e56a82d89e749b8f3b47fb359.text: 精英六角咒语。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（1…8…10 秒）。每当被施咒的敌人成功激活技能时，就会打断附近所有其他敌人。

08d0bf1f6f28c5601574cc1d903e49ee5fedd2d7.source: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) Causes -1 Health degeneration. End effect: you are healed for 30…102…120 Health.
08d0bf1f6f28c5601574cc1d903e49ee5fedd2d7.text: 降咒魔法。 （20 秒。）导致 -1 健康退化。最终效果：你的生命值被治愈 30…102…120 点。

7e570ea919b4d9407081c96ed0391351e9381b29.source: Enchantment Spell. (2 seconds.) End effect: heals for 30…102…120. No effect if ends early.
7e570ea919b4d9407081c96ed0391351e9381b29.text: 结界咒语。 （2秒。）结束效果：治疗30…102…120。如果提前结束则没有效果。

a9ffdcc3cc14850247e73b09afad60f2b1dab18c.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…7…9 conditions and hex[es]. Conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally (1…3…3 seconds). Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).
a9ffdcc3cc14850247e73b09afad60f2b1dab18c.text: 精英结界法术。目标盟友失去 0…7…9 个条件和咒语。该盟友的条件和咒语到期速度快 90%（1…3…3 秒）。禁用你的重击祈祷（20 秒）。

b9c31b12170bc9e602b37af6fd87e76dd5cc3554.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…3…4 conditions and hex[es]. Conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally (1…3…3 seconds). Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).
b9c31b12170bc9e602b37af6fd87e76dd5cc3554.text: 精英结界法术。目标盟友失去 0…3…4 个条件和咒语。该盟友的条件和咒语到期速度快 90%（1…3…3 秒）。禁用你的重击祈祷（20 秒）。

b0df26d67f6a51f7006bfbc877579611299c1275.source: Bow Attack. Deals +5…21…25 damage. 10% armor penetration.
b0df26d67f6a51f7006bfbc877579611299c1275.text: 弓攻击。造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。 10% 护甲穿透。

63792081fe473f1c51b6232a5285d326f3562459.source: Bow Attack. Deals +5…13…15 damage. 10% armor penetration.
63792081fe473f1c51b6232a5285d326f3562459.text: 弓攻击。造成 +5…13…15 点伤害。 10% 护甲穿透。

0329dc8dd2f6370652be4ae9b9706027ad2d3793.source: Axe Attack. Deals +10…22…25 damage. 20% armor penetration.
0329dc8dd2f6370652be4ae9b9706027ad2d3793.text: 斧头攻击。造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。 20% 护甲穿透。

565e053b65cb8b37bf7b93f1b26d91a2d29789f7.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…10…11 seconds.) 50% chance to block enchanted foes.
565e053b65cb8b37bf7b93f1b26d91a2d29789f7.text: 结界咒语。 （5…10…11 秒。）50% 次有机会阻挡被施魔法的敌人。

251695cd9b8def7d2d591716b11da11cd9b7df2b.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Your interrupted spells recharge instantly.
251695cd9b8def7d2d591716b11da11cd9b7df2b.text: 结界咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）你被打断的法术会立即恢复。

eb7804ccf246708fc6a1ac279e8b707f62ce1434.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 second lifespan). When any creature in range dies, conditions on this creature spread to any creature in the area with a condition. Spirits are not affected.
eb7804ccf246708fc6a1ac279e8b707f62ce1434.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…150…180）。当范围内的任何生物死亡时，该生物的状况会传播到该区域内任何有状况的生物。精神不受影响。

93049af190e6c84afa667c2c8650b7d4c271949b.source: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Causes -1…3…4 Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).
93049af190e6c84afa667c2c8650b7d4c271949b.text: 降咒魔法。 （10 秒。）导致 -1…3…4 健康退化。最终效果：造成深度伤口状态（5…17…20秒）。

292f549f42c271eba679c23a90c1f9b009fecb54.source: Spell. Projectile: deals 10…50…60 fire damage to target and nearby foes. Heals allies for 20…68…80 if you are Overcast.
292f549f42c271eba679c23a90c1f9b009fecb54.text: 咒语。投射物：对目标和附近的敌人造成 10…50…60 点火焰伤害。如果你处于阴天，可以为盟友治疗 20…68…80 点。

8c5ecdeee897b6d5d225ed621df11438ba0f28ca.source: Stance. (30…78…90 seconds.) You have +40 armor against physical damage. You have -24…14…12 armor against elemental damage.
8c5ecdeee897b6d5d225ed621df11438ba0f28ca.text: 立场。 （30…78…90 秒。）你有 +40 点物理伤害护甲。你有 -24…14…12 点护甲来抵御元素伤害。

d213d7b6244b90f013cf40abd844736d922bd48f.source: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 5…41…50 piercing damage. Deals 15…51…60 more damage to any foes with Cracked Armor. Easily interrupted.
d213d7b6244b90f013cf40abd844736d922bd48f.text: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影响附近的敌人。造成 5…41…50 点穿刺伤害。对任何拥有裂纹护甲的敌人造成 15…51…60 点额外伤害。很容易被打断。

3df7aa699122aa441d3a7cc2d309db25f0d570c6.source: Bow Attack. Inflicts Crippled condition (3…13…15 seconds).
3df7aa699122aa441d3a7cc2d309db25f0d570c6.text: 弓攻击。造成残废状态（3…13…15 秒）。

e1586b1a63e03d12c30e9c227555810611ebdecf.source: Melee Attack. Deals +10…18…20 damage. Removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal Effect: this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15…35…40 damage.
e1586b1a63e03d12c30e9c227555810611ebdecf.text: 近战攻击。造成 +10…18…20 点伤害。移除 1 个苦行僧结界。移除效果：该技能可以更快地恢复 75% 点，并且相邻敌人受到 15…35…40 点伤害。

29777aacfe9ca21a2aa762b6ab999af776f63902.source: Melee Attack. Removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15…35…40 damage.
29777aacfe9ca21a2aa762b6ab999af776f63902.text: 近战攻击。移除 1 个苦行僧结界。去除效果：该技能可以更快地恢复 75% 点，并且相邻敌人受到 15…35…40 点伤害。

f9d0de70fb948e7d76b76b6661e2543096dc7388.source: Stance. (5…17…20 seconds.) Prevents interrupts. Prevention cost: you lose one Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.
f9d0de70fb948e7d76b76b6661e2543096dc7388.text: 立场。 （5…17…20 秒。）防止中断。预防成本：你失去一个苦行僧结界或虔诚专注结束。

9ca8fff9fef9100773a79156db61290a91378782.source: Stance. (1…6…7 seconds.)You No space between the closing bracket and 'You' attack 25% faster and remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: this stance lasts twice as long.
9ca8fff9fef9100773a79156db61290a91378782.text: 立场。 （1…6…7 秒。）你 结束括号和“你”之间没有空格，攻击速度更快 25% 并移除 1 的苦行僧结界。去除效果：该姿势的持续时间延长一倍。

b0559cb9568b398c268387170f6a58b4404c6374.source: Stance. (1…4…5 seconds.)You No space between the closing bracket and 'You' attack 25% faster and remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: this stance lasts twice as long.
b0559cb9568b398c268387170f6a58b4404c6374.text: 立场。 （1…4…5 秒。）你 结束括号和“你”之间没有空格，攻击速度更快 25% 并移除 1 的苦行僧结界。去除效果：该姿势的持续时间延长一倍。

b61258ab60f5ec7c67c00fb8d7128c18312c91d5.source: Stance. (1…6…7 seconds.) Lose 1 Dervish enchantment and move 25% faster. Removal Effect: Run 50% faster instead.
b61258ab60f5ec7c67c00fb8d7128c18312c91d5.text: 立场。 （1…6…7 秒。）失去 1 苦行僧结界并移动 25% 更快。去除效果：改为运行50%更快。

028db589e97090cd2df033c0ea55a8dc2ac53276.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) End Effect: recharges itself and you gain 0…4…5 Energy and 0…24…30 Health.
028db589e97090cd2df033c0ea55a8dc2ac53276.text: 精英闪光附魔法术。 （8 秒。）最终效果：自行充电，你获得 0…4…5 点能量和 0…24…30 点生命值。

65965719bb8668c2f79dc7e74ead4007e19eee6e.source: Spell. Gain 80…136…150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: lose 1…3…3 hex[es].
65965719bb8668c2f79dc7e74ead4007e19eee6e.text: 咒语。获得 80…136…150 点生命值并移除 1 苦行僧结界。去除效果：丢失1…3…3 hex[es]。

01fd62cb549d957f326db7c7f3a8e911214ece26.source: Elite Stance. (1…7…9 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and move 33% faster. You take 150…130…125% damage.
01fd62cb549d957f326db7c7f3a8e911214ece26.text: 精英姿态。 （1…7…9秒。）你攻击33%的速度更快，移动33%的速度更快。你受到 150…130…125% 点伤害。

93a14ff0d3b993590864fd03116ddf88dca4d861.source: Elite Stance. (1…7…9 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and move 33% faster. You take 200…160…150% damage.
93a14ff0d3b993590864fd03116ddf88dca4d861.text: 精英姿态。 （1…7…9秒。）你攻击33%的速度更快，移动33%的速度更快。你受到 200…160…150% 点伤害。

e59dd3dec5124d8a6d62dc90fa909cb20c9b6e6f.source: Enchantment Spell. Target ally cannot lose more than 5% max Health from a single attack or spell. Each time damage is reduced you lose 6…4…3 Energy or this spell ends.
e59dd3dec5124d8a6d62dc90fa909cb20c9b6e6f.text: 结界咒语。目标盟友在单次攻击或法术中损失的最大生命值不能超过 5% 点。每次伤害减少，你就会损失 6…4…3 点能量，否则该法术就会结束。

41bec208f8e22fa5d97288f6e119d3532699ed1c.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…19…23 seconds.) Incoming damage is reduced to 10% of target ally's maximum Health.
41bec208f8e22fa5d97288f6e119d3532699ed1c.text: 结界咒语。 （5…19…23 秒。）传入伤害减少至目标盟友最大生命值的 10%。

78510290d1e9cfd4339f70d8e26c2a524512ccc3.source: Item Spell. (15…51…60 seconds.) You have +20 armor. Drop effect: all party members are healed for 20…80…95.
78510290d1e9cfd4339f70d8e26c2a524512ccc3.text: 物品法术。 （15…51…60 秒。）你有 +20 护甲。掉落效果：所有队员恢复20…80…95点生命值。

23115bc4e833e511ed51fb130be5de1e790791c3.source: Skill. (5…10…11 seconds.) Allies adjacent to you have 75% chance to block. Ends if you move.
23115bc4e833e511ed51fb130be5de1e790791c3.text: 技能。 （5…10…11 秒。）与你相邻的盟友有 75% 次格挡机会。如果你移动就结束。

c4aa099b308760152677aa6ec82e4042e691e0a1.source: Skill. (4…7…8 seconds.) Allies adjacent to you have 75% chance to block. Ends if you move.
c4aa099b308760152677aa6ec82e4042e691e0a1.text: 技能。 （4…7…8 秒。）与你相邻的盟友有 75% 次格挡机会。如果你移动就结束。

caed641b5bf9209af5c06b9cfe069cc32a57637a.source: Melee Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage if target is moving.
caed641b5bf9209af5c06b9cfe069cc32a57637a.text: 近战攻击。如果目标移动，则造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。

b6d4cf5ab803e1b2b726ba589e0ed570f6960cae.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: disables interrupted skill (+5…11…12 seconds). Your other skills are disabled (8 seconds).
b6d4cf5ab803e1b2b726ba589e0ed570f6960cae.text: 精英法术。打断技能。打断效果：禁用打断技能（+5…11…12秒）。你的其他技能被禁用（8秒）。

59185e3591ba5173735dd6399147057e162e9da0.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: if the action is a skill, cause knockdown for 2…4…4 seconds on target foe and all nearby foes. 50% failure chance unless Fast Casting 5 or higher.
59185e3591ba5173735dd6399147057e162e9da0.text: 精英法术。打断一个动作。打断效果：如果该动作是技能，则对目标敌人和附近所有敌人造成2…4…4秒的击倒。 50% 失败几率，除非快速施法 5 或更高。

731132e8ad8c8446a92a0ea7d15bc53fbb3c4f58.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: if the action is a skill, causes knockdown for 2…3…3 seconds on target foe and all adjacent foes. 50% failure chance unless Fast Casting 5 or higher.
731132e8ad8c8446a92a0ea7d15bc53fbb3c4f58.text: 精英法术。打断一个动作。打断效果：如果该动作是技能，则对目标敌人和所有相邻敌人造成2…3…3秒的击倒。 50% 失败几率，除非快速施法 5 或更高。

ca7b70b66cb0a91bb676ba1cbed17e540afc8c46.source: Hammer Attack. Inflicts Weakness and Deep Wound conditions (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.
ca7b70b66cb0a91bb676ba1cbed17e540afc8c46.text: 锤子攻击。如果目标敌人被击倒，则会造成虚弱和深度伤害（5…17…20 秒）。

9f23698666dcf54e6f4ca2343a4ac41dff12e5e1.source: Elite Bow Attack. Deals +10…18…20 damage. Interrupts an action.
9f23698666dcf54e6f4ca2343a4ac41dff12e5e1.text: 精英弓攻击。造成 +10…18…20 点伤害。打断一个动作。

71288320e906a01975da786e3fa567f1506759be.source: Item Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Conditions on you expire 10…42…50% faster. Drop effect: removes 1…3…4 conditions from allies in earshot.
71288320e906a01975da786e3fa567f1506759be.text: 物品法术。 （5…17…20 秒。）你的条件到期时间快了 10…42…50%。掉落效果：消除听力范围内盟友的 1…3…4 种状况。

1d03a0166c1b4806cbdc19d24b77886d9ab06100.source: Signet. Removes all hexes and conditions. Removal cost: 10 Energy each.
1d03a0166c1b4806cbdc19d24b77886d9ab06100.text: 印章。删除所有六角形和条件。移除成本：每个 10 能量。

12859c9fa9257151e1dd26147fd0f3e9c1a29e2f.source: Echo. (10…30…35 seconds.) Target ally loses one condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. Cannot target spirits.
12859c9fa9257151e1dd26147fd0f3e9c1a29e2f.text: 回声。 （10…30…35 秒。）只要目标盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束，该盟友就会失去一个条件。无法瞄准灵体。

7841422e2fe3215d2e60b4d270af9593efd057e6.source: Enchantment Spell. Conditions expire 5…41…50% faster on target ally. End effect: removes a condition.
7841422e2fe3215d2e60b4d270af9593efd057e6.text: 结界咒语。目标盟友的条件到期速度加快 5…41…50%。最终效果：删除条件。

f904dcb678545442acc15879954cf1861fb6aae4.source: Hex Spell. (5…21…25 seconds.) Causes -1…3…3 Health degeneration. Deals 25…73…85 damage to all nearby foes if target foe dies.
f904dcb678545442acc15879954cf1861fb6aae4.text: 降咒魔法。 （5…21…25 秒。）导致 -1…3…3 健康退化。如果目标敌人死亡，会对附近所有敌人造成 25…73…85 点伤害。

b0b2dea922855c12d7aaffc32c8df67f184a440b.source: Spell. Explodes a corpse, dealing 24…101…120 damage to foes near it. Exploits a fresh corpse.
b0b2dea922855c12d7aaffc32c8df67f184a440b.text: 咒语。引爆一具尸体，对其附近的敌人造成 24…101…120 点伤害。利用新鲜尸体。

f0b2129fe7717fcadc25979d6ff284340dfbe260.source: Spell. Destroys one of your undead servants. Inflicts Diseased condition (5…13…15 seconds) to foes near this servant.
f0b2129fe7717fcadc25979d6ff284340dfbe260.text: 咒语。消灭你的一名不死仆从。对该仆人附近的敌人造成疾病状态（5…13…15 秒）。

836511e397cdbbb3aace31b6325f9f5bcd45ff82.source: Elite Bow Attack. You shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.
836511e397cdbbb3aace31b6325f9f5bcd45ff82.text: 精英弓攻击。你射出的箭的移动速度是原来的两倍。

78609aa1ba3f4c6d532f66022661e260ee047dbf.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (15…75…90 second lifespan). Skills cost 30% more Energy and recharge twice as fast for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
78609aa1ba3f4c6d532f66022661e260ee047dbf.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命15…75…90）。对于范围内的生物，技能会额外花费 30% 点能量，并且恢复速度会加快两倍。不影响精神。

a353303cf34ad0870d1ad16fd462ca83e227be0d.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 second lifespan). Creatures lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. Does not affect spirits.
a353303cf34ad0870d1ad16fd462ca83e227be0d.text: 精英自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…150…180）。生物每次攻击或使用技能都会损失 1 点能量。不影响精神。

7992889ca07ddea34e93ff31535e44c4384338b1.source: Elite Sword Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (10 seconds) if target foe was moving.
7992889ca07ddea34e93ff31535e44c4384338b1.text: 精英剑攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。如果目标敌人正在移动，则会造成茫然状态（10 秒）。

eb2a56480b4b64a20b0e95ee3a7137b1fb0b7bfc.source: Scythe Attack. Deals +1 damage (maximum 5…25…30) for each point of Energy you have. Gain 1…6…7 Energy.
eb2a56480b4b64a20b0e95ee3a7137b1fb0b7bfc.text: 镰刀攻击。你拥有的每点能量都会造成 +1 点伤害（最多 5…25…30 点）。获得 1…6…7 能量。

7740afdbcc6a8687fafd5dfb4dbe6e073ee9de81.source: Ward Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -4…6 Health degeneration to foes in the area. End effect: inflicts Disease condition (12…20 seconds) to foes in the area.
7740afdbcc6a8687fafd5dfb4dbe6e073ee9de81.text: 守卫咒语。 （5 秒。）造成该区域敌人 -4…6 生命值下降。最终效果：对该区域内的敌人造成疾病状态（12…20秒）。

f6d8376d62092c64451495568812adc750d846ea.source: Elite Skill. You gain 1…6…7 adrenaline. For 8 seconds, adrenal skills have a 3 second recharge when used.
f6d8376d62092c64451495568812adc750d846ea.text: 精英技能。您获得 1…6…7 肾上腺素。 8秒，肾上腺技能使用时有3秒的充能时间。

1a6416d822f791cb220b4bbaa5e13a68d16c2e23.source: Elite Skill. (3…13…15 seconds.) You and your pet attack 33% faster and move 25% faster. No effect unless your pet is alive.
1a6416d822f791cb220b4bbaa5e13a68d16c2e23.text: 精英技能。 （3…13…15 秒。）你和你的宠物攻击速度加快 33%，移动速度加快 25%。除非你的宠物还活着，否则没有任何影响。

7973ab192be203818437c32478e23b36fee78eee.source: Spell. Gain 80…136…150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: lose 1 hex.
7973ab192be203818437c32478e23b36fee78eee.text: 咒语。获得 80…136…150 点生命值并移除 1 苦行僧结界。去除效果：丢失1 hex。

185973c6e5e25946d0a17c7b857a814e2b168108.source: Spell. Transfer 1…3…3 conditions and [its/their] remaining durations from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.
185973c6e5e25946d0a17c7b857a814e2b168108.text: 咒语。将 1…3…3 个条件和[其/他们的]剩余持续时间从自己转移到目标敌人和所有相邻敌人。

41c0d5e5e30e0e41227458d3b90bf52753eb8abd.source: Elite Signet. Transfers all conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. 50% failure chance unless Curses 5 or more.
41c0d5e5e30e0e41227458d3b90bf52753eb8abd.text: 精英图章。将剩余持续时间为 100…180…200% 的所有状况从自己转移到目标敌人。 50% 失败机会除非诅咒 5 或更多。

b4ff42fa27b14a6aaeca0dac84e4a5645eef83e7.source: Touch Skill. Transfers 1…3…3 conditions from yourself to target foe.
b4ff42fa27b14a6aaeca0dac84e4a5645eef83e7.text: 触摸技能。将 1…3…3 个状况从自己转移到目标敌人。

afb3415fcafca1494e19b32847227c8dfddbb396.source: Half Range Bow Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage.
afb3415fcafca1494e19b32847227c8dfddbb396.text: 半程弓攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。

317895f0f697ff8ef3bc611de5fd5210e6454e0b.source: Elite Bow Attack. Inflicts Poisoned condition. (5…17…20)
317895f0f697ff8ef3bc611de5fd5210e6454e0b.text: 精英弓攻击。造成中毒状态。 (5…17…20)

e6cae126e55b6da91ba1dd542e253377d5f6a977.source: Signet. (60 seconds.) Inflicts Poisoned condition (8…14…15 seconds) with your next attack.
e6cae126e55b6da91ba1dd542e253377d5f6a977.text: 印章。 （60 秒。）下次攻击造成中毒状态（8…14…15 秒）。

be40c25cfd4150314e5ad51b3a1ce1a7c61c07b5.source: Spell. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5…13…15 seconds) to adjacent foes. You are also Poisoned.
be40c25cfd4150314e5ad51b3a1ce1a7c61c07b5.text: 咒语。对邻近敌人造成中毒状态（5…13…15 秒）。你也中毒了。

cbacb3413fd7a21730c0b1e1693da54ff888d254.source: Pet Attack. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5…17…20 seconds).
cbacb3413fd7a21730c0b1e1693da54ff888d254.text: 宠物攻击。造成中毒状态（5…17…20 秒）。

ac93d619872953aa9d4e23bcf10da7c1fe71d2a0.source: Pet Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is moving.
ac93d619872953aa9d4e23bcf10da7c1fe71d2a0.text: 宠物攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果目标敌人正在移动，则会导致击倒。

29dc95a1f24c065762fec7a9fea59db952abd213.text: 近战攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。

ec3a436452c3ede449d88e0789673c6a1aac20ff.source: Elite Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled (1…10…12 seconds) and that skill is interrupted.
ec3a436452c3ede449d88e0789673c6a1aac20ff.text: 精英法术。如果目标敌人正在施展法术或吟唱，则该技能和所有相同属性的技能都会被禁用（1…10…12秒），并且该技能会被打断。

75ca51e7592932c2b102c524dfcb613346831a58.source: Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: you gain 1…25…31 Energy.
75ca51e7592932c2b102c524dfcb613346831a58.text: 咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。打断效果：你获得1…25…31点能量。

6daa99a398bc6d1ea9fe47591a2d3db3d8486ea9.source: Elite Hex Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: -2 Energy degeneration (4…9…10 seconds).
6daa99a398bc6d1ea9fe47591a2d3db3d8486ea9.text: 精英六角咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。打断效果：-2能量衰退（4…9…10秒）。

1f60fb75ee1cff464fd4130180fe56d02c4e1976.source: Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: causes 3…14…17 Energy loss.
1f60fb75ee1cff464fd4130180fe56d02c4e1976.text: 咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。中断效果：造成3…14…17点能量损失。

3db061c9f66d42bced22534beddf4f3550947048.source: Elite Hex Spell. Interrupt a spell or a chant. Interruption effect: steal 5…13…15 Energy whenever target foe casts a spell (10 seconds).
3db061c9f66d42bced22534beddf4f3550947048.text: 精英六角咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。打断效果：每当目标敌人施展法术时（10秒）窃取5…13…15点能量。

07741009898fcc337f58b5b83925b6fa97432775.source: Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: interrupted spell or chant is disabled for +5…11…13 seconds.
07741009898fcc337f58b5b83925b6fa97432775.text: 咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。打断效果：打断的法术或吟唱无效+5…11…13秒。

5d0859265a2912d53f8f0637bd5164fa283f0440.source: Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: target foe gains 10…6…5 Energy.
5d0859265a2912d53f8f0637bd5164fa283f0440.text: 咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。打断效果：目标敌人获得10…6…5点能量。

9ecef09f2ef2981db7b5a7aa34053c3823dac542.source: Bow Attack. Target foe takes 25…45…50 damage.
9ecef09f2ef2981db7b5a7aa34053c3823dac542.text: 弓攻击。目标敌人受到 25…45…50 点伤害。

2a56ce640d3683d40d8fa0d33824433cdc43c311.source: Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: deals 30…102…120 damage.
2a56ce640d3683d40d8fa0d33824433cdc43c311.text: 咒语。打断咒语或吟唱。打断效果：造成30…102…120点伤害。

7364e45a3b12cda9f0ed9f29688cb066305f170e.source: Elite Stance. (20…32…35 seconds.) Your preparations recharge 50% faster and last 30…246…300% longer.
7364e45a3b12cda9f0ed9f29688cb066305f170e.text: 精英姿态。 （20…32…35 秒。）您的准备工作充电速度更快 50%，持续时间更长 30…246…300%。

e1d50fc6eb3d90f0cb5e72452911cacf7776f0b3.source: Bow Attack. Deals +3…9…10 damage. Unblockable. Easily Interrupted.
e1d50fc6eb3d90f0cb5e72452911cacf7776f0b3.text: 弓攻击。造成 +3…9…10 点伤害。不可封锁。容易被打断。

97e5940e66d6fd0abe19f27065325f9c65b258ee.source: Pet Attack. Deals +5…29…35 damage. Your pet gains 5…41…50 Health if this attack hits.
97e5940e66d6fd0abe19f27065325f9c65b258ee.text: 宠物攻击。造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。如果这次攻击命中，你的宠物将获得 5…41…50 点生命值。

7911dd67d6ad0aab90ca80cc3e740192a9061c04.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) Your pet attacks 25% faster and you gain 1…25…31 Health whenever your pet makes a successful attack.
7911dd67d6ad0aab90ca80cc3e740192a9061c04.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20 秒。）你的宠物攻击速度加快 25%，每当你的宠物成功攻击时，你就会获得 1…25…31 点生命值。

6a2d80c0d9d6f5d9fca54a4d6cdb473d9b905513.source: Shout. (5…17…20 seconds.) You gain 1…25…31 Health whenever your pet makes a successful attack.
6a2d80c0d9d6f5d9fca54a4d6cdb473d9b905513.text: 喊叫。 （5…17…20 秒。）每当你的宠物成功攻击时，你就会获得 1…25…31 点生命值。

f960ddf6dbb8cd48498f868c155092d704994488.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Creatures in range receive 20% less from healing. Creatures gain 5 health each time they hit with an attack. Does not affect spirits.
f960ddf6dbb8cd48498f868c155092d704994488.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。范围内的生物获得的治疗效果减少 20%。生物每次受到攻击时都会获得 5 点生命值。不影响精神。

3965d4df67f6d634791581f0539b50f7001a2e49.source: Elite Bow Attack. Deals +10…22…25 damage. You gain 1…7…9 Energy if you have a preparation active.
3965d4df67f6d634791581f0539b50f7001a2e49.text: 精英弓攻击。造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果您有活动准备，您将获得 1…7…9 能量。

2971a0180aeb4da72afb1a85ae0d3a426b0abcd8.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10…94…115.
2971a0180aeb4da72afb1a85ae0d3a426b0abcd8.text: 精英束缚仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命90）。每 4 秒，该精魂会治愈一名非精魂盟友 10…94…115 点。

097218ee8830d77a8803f99586c144dceea4186e.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 Spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10…94…115.
097218ee8830d77a8803f99586c144dceea4186e.text: 精英束缚仪式。创造出等级1…8…10级的精灵（90秒寿命）。每 4 秒，该精魂会治愈一名非精魂盟友 10…94…115 点。

3471b72438478993a2d50dc304bc902fdd232868.source: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) 25% chance to miss. Target foe takes 1…37…46 damage whenever it fails to hit.
3471b72438478993a2d50dc304bc902fdd232868.text: 降咒魔法。 （30 秒。） 25% 个错过的机会。目标敌人在未能击中时会受到 1…37…46 点伤害。

1b7b134f77dd3e72fff0fc9f003175444c7546dc.source: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes 3…13…15 Energy loss the next time target foe uses an elite skill.
1b7b134f77dd3e72fff0fc9f003175444c7546dc.text: 降咒魔法。 （5 秒。）目标敌人下次使用精英技能时造成 3…13…15 点能量损失。

6fd7f1ef9e6381e0ed5270ae8951b527483846cb.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Signets cost 10 energy for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
6fd7f1ef9e6381e0ed5270ae8951b527483846cb.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。印记对于范围内的生物需要花费 10 点能量。不影响精神。

c0687f509cda960e8f889db8022788f3e40800ed.source: Preparation. (5…21…25 seconds.) You attack 33% faster while wielding a bow.
c0687f509cda960e8f889db8022788f3e40800ed.text: 准备。 （5…21…25 秒。）你挥舞弓时攻击速度更快 33%。

cd1abf25f5de4b232727d26b9e000baad4c74f2c.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the Raven (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and a 20…30% block chance.
cd1abf25f5de4b232727d26b9e000baad4c74f2c.text: 精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现乌鸦形象（60 秒）。你的所有属性都设置为 0，乌鸦攻击取代了你的技能，你有 80 点护甲、660…700 点生命值和 20…30% 点格挡几率。

7d27f12079c40129a638357cacb833b5ce13b783.source: Elite Spell. Deals 20…36…40 damage and steals 20…36…40 Health from target and nearby foes.
7d27f12079c40129a638357cacb833b5ce13b783.text: 精英法术。造成 20…36…40 点伤害并从目标和附近敌人身上窃取 20…36…40 点生命值。

f753ccec0a8235a26848a98b3e26cb6f727df6ca.source: Elite Spell. Deals 10…42…50 holy damage and inflicts Burning (1…3…3 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
f753ccec0a8235a26848a98b3e26cb6f727df6ca.text: 精英法术。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…42…50 点神圣伤害并造成燃烧（1…3…3 秒）。击中目标初始位置附近的敌人。

109e72df325a11cd30218b4551d9f4aba49c5183.source: Preparation. (24 seconds). +3…9…10 damage. Your arrows move twice as fast.
109e72df325a11cd30218b4551d9f4aba49c5183.text: 准备。 （24 秒）。 +3…9…10 伤害。你的箭头移动速度是原来的两倍。

000f00d304ad932e726a4b44ec03e9468608e188.source: Preparation. (24 seconds). Your arrows move twice as fast.
000f00d304ad932e726a4b44ec03e9468608e188.text: 准备。 （24 秒）。你的箭头移动速度是原来的两倍。

a5bb1e73350ed4de3b9d85f45b80a7140e623253.source: Melee Attack. Deals +3…13…15 damage. Struck foes lose 1 condition. Removal Effect: all foes adjacent to those struck take 10…34…40 holy damage.
a5bb1e73350ed4de3b9d85f45b80a7140e623253.text: 近战攻击。造成 +3…13…15 点伤害。被击中的敌人会失去 1 状态。移除效果：所有与被击中者相邻的敌人都会受到 10…34…40 点神圣伤害。

fced9b3a1d83cad247723dcee807d9a2280fd5c9.source: Elite Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Causes -1…4…5 Health degeneration. You gain 5…13…15 Energy if target foe dies while suffering from this hex.
fced9b3a1d83cad247723dcee807d9a2280fd5c9.text: 精英六角咒语。 （30 秒。）导致 -1…4…5 健康退化。如果目标敌人在受到此咒术影响时死亡，你将获得 5…13…15 点能量。

ba730f2c2dfcfad9508d36bffd6fb35b6f80459b.source: Elite Scythe Attack. (3…13…15 seconds.) Cause Cripple. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: cause knockdown for 2…3…3 seconds.
ba730f2c2dfcfad9508d36bffd6fb35b6f80459b.text: 精英镰刀攻击。 （3…13…15 秒。）导致瘫痪。失去 1 苦行僧结界。移除效果：造成击倒2…3…3秒。

801a7368430641aec60e3cd485fad5041179323a.source: Spell. Resurrects target party member (25% Health, 0 Energy). Teleports target to you. Disables target's skills (10…4…3 seconds). You lose all Energy.
801a7368430641aec60e3cd485fad5041179323a.text: 咒语。复活目标队员（25% 生命值，0 能量）。将目标传送给你。禁用目标的技能（10…4…3 秒）。你失去了所有能量。

aa439d83985d5972298e53fbecdafc2a48e1baaa.source: Enchantment Spell. End effect: Shadow Step to target ally. Cannot self-target and disables all of your skills for 3 seconds when it ends.
aa439d83985d5972298e53fbecdafc2a48e1baaa.text: 结界咒语。最终效果：暗影步攻击目标盟友。结束时无法自我瞄准并禁用所有技能 3 秒。

19ce13dda94f470a85a4b5545ed77a1f5aa37bc4.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to your target (6…11…12 seconds). These foes have 50% chance to miss, but attack 25% faster.
19ce13dda94f470a85a4b5545ed77a1f5aa37bc4.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（6…11…12 秒）。这些敌人有 50% 次失手机会，但攻击速度更快 25% 次。

5a31bcf197b9c5c0e86240eedb623ea3d7b3e747.source: Elite Spell. All of your Spirits die. If a Spirit dies in this way, you gain 5…17…20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged.
5a31bcf197b9c5c0e86240eedb623ea3d7b3e747.text: 精英法术。你所有的灵魂都会死去。如果灵魂以这种方式死亡，你将获得 5…17…20 点能量，并且你所有的束缚仪式都会被恢复。

8a76b33e4a413688137b12b11701ac512ca2d6df.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire 20…44…50% faster.
8a76b33e4a413688137b12b11701ac512ca2d6df.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。范围内盟友的条件会更快到期 20…44…50%。

63225583110bc2c76241be4fd95f0226e5010f51.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire 20…44…50% faster.
63225583110bc2c76241be4fd95f0226e5010f51.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。范围内盟友的条件会更快到期 20…44…50%。

fef7d6568bfef9594789ad9068dbf7332d39a3e7.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have +1…3…3 Health regeneration.
fef7d6568bfef9594789ad9068dbf7332d39a3e7.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。范围内的非精神盟友有 +1…3…3 点生命恢复。

3fda53ff56c3cfb8a990ca721f51818beed24932.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have +1…3…3 Health regeneration.
3fda53ff56c3cfb8a990ca721f51818beed24932.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。范围内的非精神盟友有 +1…3…3 点生命恢复。

b9ae0f9931a45d9df2a9431229729aea55da7ff0.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -1…5…6 Health degeneration. Renewal: if target foe has another hex when Recurring Insecurity would end.
b9ae0f9931a45d9df2a9431229729aea55da7ff0.text: 精英六角咒语。 （5 秒。）导致 -1…5…6 健康退化。更新：如果目标敌人在反复不安全状态结束时有另一个降咒。

95cf6233bfff4d4aebe2db53c08de96d667dde16.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…16…20 spirit (30…78…90 second lifespan). Heals party members in earshot for 3…9…10 each second. Healing cost: this spirit loses 3…9…10 Health.
95cf6233bfff4d4aebe2db53c08de96d667dde16.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…16…20级灵体（第二寿命30…78…90）。每秒治疗听力范围内的队员 3…9…10 点。治疗费用：该灵魂失去 3…9…10 点生命值。

b7babfc66886374b75deff7365f7e710c6f076df.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…13…16 spirit (30…78…90 second lifespan). Heals party members in earshot for 3…9…10 each second. Healing cost: this spirit loses 3…9…10 Health.
b7babfc66886374b75deff7365f7e710c6f076df.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…13…16级灵体（第二寿命30…78…90）。每秒治疗听力范围内的队员 3…9…10 点。治疗费用：该灵魂失去 3…9…10 点生命值。

55ce7490f907bd0f3851c377c5155078b3aca4e3.source: Spell. Removes all of your enchantments. Heals all party members for 5…29…35 for each Monk Enchantment removed.
55ce7490f907bd0f3851c377c5155078b3aca4e3.text: 咒语。消除你所有的结界。每移除一个武僧结界，即可治愈所有队员 5…29…35 点。

346fe1f947710530418633c9579f0a6a6c473705.text: 印章。你失去了一个条件。

e92a31e375b6c0cc8759f9b71445f974266a01a7.source: Spell. Removes a hex from target ally.
e92a31e375b6c0cc8759f9b71445f974266a01a7.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。

afc4f11954bf0ff302fe161c12427433ab480b79.source: Spell. Removes 5…8…9 enchantments from target foe. Removal cost: you lose 55…31…25 Health for each Monk enchantment removed.
afc4f11954bf0ff302fe161c12427433ab480b79.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人 5…8…9 个结界。移除成本：每移除一个武僧结界，你就会损失 55…31…25 点生命值。

d34a4d8309fe3c1b2878900bd04fdf6586ea9935.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your attack skills remove enchantments from knocked-down foes. Initial effect: deals 10…34…40 cold damage to all nearby foes. End effect: nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1…8…10 seconds.
d34a4d8309fe3c1b2878900bd04fdf6586ea9935.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （30秒。）你的攻击技能可以消除被击倒的敌人的结界。初始效果：对附近所有敌人造成 10…34…40 点冰冷伤害。最终效果：附近敌人的护甲破裂，持续 1…8…10 秒。

eec67839120e6730051a6376358676b9228da395.source: Scythe Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: struck foes lose an enchantment.
eec67839120e6730051a6376358676b9228da395.text: 镰刀攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。你失去了 1 苦行僧结界。移除效果：被击中的敌人失去结界。

94fa06d34a7e72f69281ae3bcfacff7346eb6a32.source: Touch Spell. Deals 15…55…65 cold damage. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
94fa06d34a7e72f69281ae3bcfacff7346eb6a32.text: 触摸咒语。造成 15…55…65 点寒冷伤害。失去 1 苦行僧结界。移除效果：目标敌人失去 1 点结界，你获得 2 次肾上腺素打击。

2718ed838219cd3f26fe24b2edaddf2ef04846ad.source: Touch Spell. Resurrects target party member (50% Health and 5…17…20% Energy). Heals allies within earshot for 55…115…130.
2718ed838219cd3f26fe24b2edaddf2ef04846ad.text: 触摸咒语。复活目标队员（50% 生命值和 5…17…20% 能量）。治愈听力范围内的盟友 55…115…130。

5bf06834b7ec31318c8ea3e1f31bf98f869e8706.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Your weapon and item spells cost 5…29…35% less Energy. No effect unless holding an item.
5bf06834b7ec31318c8ea3e1f31bf98f869e8706.text: 结界咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）你的武器和物品法术消耗的能量减少 5…29…35%。除非持有物品，否则没有任何效果。

56a913b676f5c26fd66ce2045d79413a4d70a57a.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage. You gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly if target foe was knocked down.
56a913b676f5c26fd66ce2045d79413a4d70a57a.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。你获得 3 点能量，如果目标敌人被击倒，此攻击会立即恢复。

34ce3a732068748776ce152dba8998ef413df574.source: Hammer Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. You gain 3 energy and this attack recharges instantly if target foe was knocked down.
34ce3a732068748776ce152dba8998ef413df574.text: 锤子攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。你获得 3 点能量，如果目标敌人被击倒，此攻击会立即恢复。

2e3946673b79eadc82eac10dc4008c26d7e7ceb1.source: Hex Spell. (8 seconds.) Deals 2…10…12 damage each second. End effect: You gain 1…7…8 energy.
2e3946673b79eadc82eac10dc4008c26d7e7ceb1.text: 降咒魔法。 （8 秒。）每秒造成 2…10…12 点伤害。最终效果：你获得 1…7…8 点能量。

db953c01229affe482395e2f383299a41c2bdfaa.source: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10…26…30 damage. This skill has +15 second recharge time if it misses. Must follow an off-hand attack.
db953c01229affe482395e2f383299a41c2bdfaa.text: 副手攻击。造成 +10…26…30 点伤害。如果未命中，该技能的充能时间为 +15 秒。必须跟随副手攻击。

48a14b7d27ae42f7f6b465a6fd59dde79ba9c66b.source: Item Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) You have +3 Health regeneration for each hex or condition on you. Drop effect: you lose 1…3…4 conditions.
48a14b7d27ae42f7f6b465a6fd59dde79ba9c66b.text: 物品法术。 （5…17…20 秒。）对于你身上的每个六角形或状况，你可以恢复 +3 点生命值。掉落效果：你失去1…3…4个条件。

a0323edcddc5f8dba1ded911ee810a90bf7cca63.source: Weapon Spell. (3…10…12 seconds.) +1…5…6 Health regeneration and +24 armor. No effect unless target ally is hexed or has a condition.
a0323edcddc5f8dba1ded911ee810a90bf7cca63.text: 武器咒语。 （3…10…12 秒。）+1…5…6 生命恢复和 +24 护甲。除非目标盟友被施咒或有状况，否则无效。

8c4360c63b238e9b62708a246eab293d49073587.source: Enchantment Spell. (8…16…18 seconds.) +10 Health regeneration. Ends if target ally attacks or uses a skill.
8c4360c63b238e9b62708a246eab293d49073587.text: 结界咒语。 （8…16…18 秒。） +10 生命恢复。如果目标盟友攻击或使用技能则结束。

7ce84764d8a4fee6ab43400b63434e983162a09e.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…11…14 spirit (30 second lifespan). End effect: resurrects party members in the area with 5…41…50% Health and zero Energy.
7ce84764d8a4fee6ab43400b63434e983162a09e.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…11…14级灵体（第二寿命30）。最终效果：以 5…41…50% 点生命值和零能量复活该区域的队员。

9bf0957eb6975fd2ec11364106a93a43174a7f96.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30 second lifespan). End effect: resurrects party members in the area with 5…41…50% Health and zero Energy.
9bf0957eb6975fd2ec11364106a93a43174a7f96.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30）。最终效果：以 5…41…50% 点生命值和零能量复活该区域的队员。

6fae9cc08c8870ed671aec01aa9ac575238c3242.source: Elite Spell. Removes all conditions. Removal effect: heals for 10…58…70 for each condition removed. Cannot self-target.
6fae9cc08c8870ed671aec01aa9ac575238c3242.text: 精英法术。删除所有条件。移除效果：每移除一个状况即可治疗 10…58…70 点。无法自我定位。

41d17f55671fd31247cf223260458fd3a8a3e694.source: Touch Spell. Resurrects target party member (20…56…65% Health, 42…80…90% Energy).

3242ced8649235125a8c96bb9ea96d32e0e61175.source: Spell. Resurrects target party member (25% Health, 0 Energy).
3242ced8649235125a8c96bb9ea96d32e0e61175.text: 咒语。复活目标队员（25% 生命值，0 能量）。

d4badc53a4dc66e248fb1f7461a83dd7f843f642.source: Signet. Resurrects target party member (100% Health, 25% Energy). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.
d4badc53a4dc66e248fb1f7461a83dd7f843f642.text: 印章。复活目标队员（100% 生命值，25% 能量）。只有当你士气提升时，这个印章才会重新充电。

a26e0f38fd05904a056bd4be78505a79de4ed07e.source: Enchantment Spell. Deals 33% of each attack's damage (maximum 5…17…20) back to the source.
a26e0f38fd05904a056bd4be78505a79de4ed07e.text: 结界咒语。将每次攻击造成的 33% 点伤害（最多 5…17…20 点）返还给来源。

73cf23f0934d382586238aa53b273954cfa4acfe.source: Spell. Inflicts Crippled condition (3…7…8 seconds) on all foes adjacent to you. You Shadow Step to target ally's location. Cannot self-target.
73cf23f0934d382586238aa53b273954cfa4acfe.text: 咒语。对与你相邻的所有敌人造成瘫痪状态（3…7…8 秒）。你用暗影步瞄准盟友的位置。无法自我定位。

7a580497198da6a465e09a19a98f78d906415b99.source: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Negates the next damage and hits the source for that same amount (maximum 5…61…75).
7a580497198da6a465e09a19a98f78d906415b99.text: 结界咒语。 （8 秒。）抵消下一次伤害并对源造成相同数量的伤害（最大 5…61…75）。

b7775a7e999e7b1e0be479a9f021d2480d2033cf.source: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Converts the next incoming damage or life steal (maximum 15…67…80) to healing.
b7775a7e999e7b1e0be479a9f021d2480d2033cf.text: 结界咒语。 （8 秒。）将下一次传入的伤害或生命偷取（最大 15…67…80）转换为治疗。

36a9032ed5217cac742fbaed929e5e1869a6b485.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…9…10 seconds.) Removes one hex from target ally. The next damage this ally takes is reduced by 5…41…50. No effect unless this ally is hexed.
36a9032ed5217cac742fbaed929e5e1869a6b485.text: 结界咒语。 （5…9…10 秒。）从目标盟友身上移除一个降咒。该盟友受到的下一次伤害减少 5…41…50。除非该盟友被施咒，否则没有效果。

3156d765243dcbaa65f39b99ba3cf60b6af85b35.source: Skill. Resurrects all allied pets in the area (10…77…94% Health).
3156d765243dcbaa65f39b99ba3cf60b6af85b35.text: 技能。复活该地区所有友军宠物（10…77…94% 生命值）。

717a3ce37f12dfefa4b067bf30a504b075c56ee2.source: Elite Spell. Deals 10…58…70 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Blinds all adjacent foes (1…4…5 seconds). You instantly move to your target. May target allies.
717a3ce37f12dfefa4b067bf30a504b075c56ee2.text: 精英法术。造成 10…58…70 点闪电伤害。 25% 护甲穿透。致盲所有相邻敌人（1…4…5 秒）。您立即移动到目标。可能会瞄准盟友。

ef8c69030462f524c4e0f1cc3ebb66c2ed15494e.source: Hex Spell. (8…18…20 seconds.) Target foe cannot block.
ef8c69030462f524c4e0f1cc3ebb66c2ed15494e.text: 降咒魔法。 （8…18…20 秒。）目标敌人无法阻挡。

7bf5033a3d84a42005503a0b004b156e705ef81a.source: Spell. Removes 1 enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Bleeding (5…21…25 seconds).
7bf5033a3d84a42005503a0b004b156e705ef81a.text: 咒语。移除 1 结界。去除效果：造成流血（5…21…25秒）。

b849b9613d79a2bcc1ea42d4ca78a1b045a0004f.source: Skill. (8 seconds). You block the next melee attack and your attacker takes 20…68…80 damage. No effect unless you have a sword equipped.
b849b9613d79a2bcc1ea42d4ca78a1b045a0004f.text: 技能。 （8 秒）。你格挡了下一次近战攻击，攻击者受到 20…68…80 点伤害。除非你装备了剑，否则没有效果。

ce408cd47b65ebae866c9a9f086ec82d634ffe92.source: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) End effect: deals 1…5…6 damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect. Also damages other foes in the area.
ce408cd47b65ebae866c9a9f086ec82d634ffe92.text: 降咒魔法。 （20 秒。）最终效果：每次上升胆汁生效都会造成 1…5…6 点伤害。也会伤害该地区的其他敌人。

2d2713fbb32177c03c0ed537411fb5c9a3a33777.source: Elite Skill. (5…29…35 seconds.) You have +2…4…4 to all Ritualist attributes for your next skill. If that skill is a Binding Ritual, it recharges 10…50…60% faster and Ritual Lord recharges instantly.
2d2713fbb32177c03c0ed537411fb5c9a3a33777.text: 精英技能。 （5…29…35 秒。）你的下一个技能的所有仪式属性有 +2…4…4。如果该技能是绑定仪式，则其充能速度会更快 10…50…60%，并且仪式领主会立即充能。

31ee8a84133513598497a6a3df3b91a55de91ad8.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 second lifespan). Chants and shouts cost 1…4…5 more Energy for creatures in range.
31ee8a84133513598497a6a3df3b91a55de91ad8.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…150…180）。吟唱和喊叫对范围内的生物额外消耗 1…4…5 点能量。

0a2f3c7a9a12361d2afd1184e1639cd65e0982c4.source: Spell. Deals 15…99…120 fire damage. Also affects foes near your target. Inflicts Burning condition (1…3…3 seconds).
0a2f3c7a9a12361d2afd1184e1639cd65e0982c4.text: 咒语。造成 15…99…120 点火焰伤害。也会影响目标附近的敌人。造成燃烧状态（1…3…3 秒）。

a16970ada97823398adb07e845b2243c72cb6709.text: 咒语。造成疾病状态（10…22…25 秒）。

d20bad22fd12e247e4ebe84f2dcb45e7c39573a4.source: Stance. (5…13…15 seconds.) You and your pet move 25% faster.
d20bad22fd12e247e4ebe84f2dcb45e7c39573a4.text: 立场。 （5…13…15 秒。）您和您的宠物移动速度加快了 25%。

caca03c6f45fc342a4505aeaedff2681b73f2c42.source: Spell. Destroys target allied spirit. Deals 50…122…140 lightning damage and inflicts Blindness condition (3…10…12 seconds) to nearby foes.
caca03c6f45fc342a4505aeaedff2681b73f2c42.text: 咒语。摧毁目标友军精魂。对附近的敌人造成 50…122…140 点闪电伤害并造成失明状态（3…10…12 秒）。

75914cd3263208a32d5d61d332635d764d141aaf.text: 立场。 （8…18…20 秒。）你移动速度加快了 25%。

c92911c7c62751c799f82f601195b89b3872b3a6.source: Hex Spell. Deals 10…70…85 cold damage to target and adjacent foes. Hexes target and adjacent foes (5…17…20 seconds). Doubles signet activation time. Interrupts and disables signets for 1…8…10 seconds if you are Overcast.
c92911c7c62751c799f82f601195b89b3872b3a6.text: 降咒魔法。对目标和邻近敌人造成 10…70…85 点冰冷伤害。对目标和邻近敌人进行六角形攻击（5…17…20 秒）。印章激活时间加倍。如果您处于阴天状态，则会中断并禁用图章 1…8…10 秒。

569cd605933e676cc7cae65530c72f8cf8b4ed45.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deal 10…50…60 earth damage to all other adjacent foes whenever you hit with your scythe. Ends after 1…4…5 hits.
569cd605933e676cc7cae65530c72f8cf8b4ed45.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （30 秒。）每当你用镰刀击中时，都会对所有其他相邻敌人造成 10…50…60 点土系伤害。点击 1…4…5 次后结束。

e4f9d4b5285fc8182d8c92f95c2504af2bed6c7e.source: Elite Spell. Deals 20…36…40 earth damage each second (10 seconds). Hits foes near target foe's initial location. Hits attacking foes for 10…26…30 more earth damage each second.
e4f9d4b5285fc8182d8c92f95c2504af2bed6c7e.text: 精英法术。每秒（10 秒）造成 20…36…40 点地球伤害。攻击目标敌人初始位置附近的敌人。每秒对攻击的敌人造成 10…26…30 点土属性伤害。

86a9cc8e085ddc0953f88dc3e72f070382b0a6de.source: Bow Attack. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: deals +13…25…28 damage if action was a spell.
86a9cc8e085ddc0953f88dc3e72f070382b0a6de.text: 弓攻击。打断一个动作。打断效果：如果行动是法术，则造成 +13…25…28 点伤害。

228998db12fda76698b79decf43aa9bed8753696.source: Sword Attack. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: deals +1…32…40 damage if action was a spell.
228998db12fda76698b79decf43aa9bed8753696.text: 剑攻击。打断一个动作。打断效果：如果行动是法术，则造成 +1…32…40 点伤害。

00d0d65d62050f197736c03682854a400f5a25ec.source: Elite Spell. Deals 5…17…20 fire damage for each second since casting this spell (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location.
00d0d65d62050f197736c03682854a400f5a25ec.text: 精英法术。自施放此法术后每秒造成 5…17…20 点火焰伤害（5 秒）。攻击目标初始位置附近的敌人。

fdbd486c5dd52c3b053b4925a80363741462065c.source: Pet Attack. Deals +10…22…25 damage. You gain 3…13…15 Energy if target foe has a condition.
fdbd486c5dd52c3b053b4925a80363741462065c.text: 宠物攻击。造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果目标敌人有病症，你将获得 3…13…15 点能量。

9dd5f490714b8636c0d726056c2c5da195321c06.source: Elite Skill. (10 seconds). You gain 3…10…12 Energy if you strike a foe who has a condition.
9dd5f490714b8636c0d726056c2c5da195321c06.text: 精英技能。 （10 秒）。如果你攻击患有某种疾病的敌人，你将获得 3…10…12 点能量。

0a7d6b910739c2d3ece776e0c3f9a37691962ed0.source: Half Range Hex Spell. (8…18…20 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe and cause knock-down the next time this foe is more than 75' away from you.
0a7d6b910739c2d3ece776e0c3f9a37691962ed0.text: 半程六角法术。 （8…18…20 秒。）暗影步瞄准敌人，并在下次该敌人距离您超过 75 英尺时造成击倒。

3f53cde49771cc53d33c8a609bb75f97c36d778c.source: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 15…63…75 damage to anyone casting an enchantment on target foe.
3f53cde49771cc53d33c8a609bb75f97c36d778c.text: 降咒魔法。 （30 秒。）对任何对目标敌人施展结界的人造成 15…63…75 点伤害。

fdffcc21db557cf09264023792730358e4e73c46.source: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Whenever target foe is healed, the healer takes 15…67…80 holy damage.
fdffcc21db557cf09264023792730358e4e73c46.text: 降咒魔法。 （30 秒。）每当目标敌人被治愈时，治疗者就会受到 15…67…80 点神圣伤害。

37ae8550d3f2eaf3689ed3c5a305869fab38a702.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (8…18…20 seconds). Doubles Health sacrifice.
37ae8550d3f2eaf3689ed3c5a305869fab38a702.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（8…18…20 秒）。双倍健康牺牲。

98b7f04472e2f54a5379ee20fc936c8e6dfff059.source: Bow Attack. Deals +10…22…25 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe is within earshot.
98b7f04472e2f54a5379ee20fc936c8e6dfff059.text: 弓攻击。造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果目标敌人在听力范围内，则会造成流血状态（5…17…20 秒）。

219a0627453eed8ba029348265a50f8845246a25.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10…30…35 seconds.) You gain 3 Energy whenever you use a signet.
219a0627453eed8ba029348265a50f8845246a25.text: 精英结界法术。 （10…30…35 秒。）每当您使用图章时，您都会获得 3 能量。

f186a4e7910e28efda707e7848f4017ef6a5da7b.source: Elite Spell. Hits foes near your target. Deals 10…82…100 fire damage to foes already Burning. Inflicts Burning condition (1…6…7 seconds) to foes not Burning.
f186a4e7910e28efda707e7848f4017ef6a5da7b.text: 精英法术。攻击目标附近的敌人。对已经燃烧的敌人造成 10…82…100 点火焰伤害。对未燃烧的敌人造成燃烧状态（1…6…7秒）。

7c53ea029e083ef254007a0d6a495a456e0c2013.source: Spell. Deals 10…34…40 fire damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location. End effect: inflicts Burning condition (3 seconds).
7c53ea029e083ef254007a0d6a495a456e0c2013.text: 咒语。每秒造成 10…34…40 点火焰伤害（5 秒）。攻击目标初始位置附近的敌人。最终效果：造成燃烧状态（3秒）。

8e39a8343db088767e3f1f535737973b5136107c.source: Elite Spell. You gain 1 Energy and 5 Health for each point of Overcast. You lose all enchantments.
8e39a8343db088767e3f1f535737973b5136107c.text: 精英法术。每点阴天，你都会获得 1 点能量和 5 点生命值。你会失去所有的魅力。

75bc86a0d915a7b66153c5d5eb2d86adfc5e535a.source: Enchantment Spell. (2…5) seconds. Heals party members for 2 for each rank in Divine Favor whenever target takes damage. Cannot self target.
75bc86a0d915a7b66153c5d5eb2d86adfc5e535a.text: 结界咒语。 (2…5) 秒。每当目标受到伤害时，为每个等级的队友治疗 2 点神圣恩惠。无法自我瞄准。

23fff74f94371da218465efc87071014538a89be.source: Preparation. (3…12…14 seconds.) Your arrows are unblockable. Ends if you fail to hit.
23fff74f94371da218465efc87071014538a89be.text: 准备。 （3…12…14 秒。）你的箭无法阻挡。如果未能击中则结束。

8fe94cfba2d61a1879119465f4ffa5bfdd442af3.source: Sword Attack. Deals +1…16…20 damage. Deals 1…16…20 damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (25 seconds) if blocked.
8fe94cfba2d61a1879119465f4ffa5bfdd442af3.text: 剑攻击。造成 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果被阻挡，会造成 1…16…20 点伤害并造成流血状态（25 秒）。

6ed56f552faeba8d2602db0e02153fcbe10b14b5.source: Elite Hex Spell. (1…6…7 seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower. This foe takes 5…21…25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
6ed56f552faeba8d2602db0e02153fcbe10b14b5.text: 精英六角咒语。 （1…6…7 秒。）目标敌人移动速度慢 33%。该敌人在患有某种病症时每秒会受到 5…21…25 点伤害。

f972a15e341d00e993ea2d0f61fe18e65caa2be3.source: Enchantment Spell. (15…20 seconds.) Spells you cast that target another ally cost 3 less Energy.
f972a15e341d00e993ea2d0f61fe18e65caa2be3.text: 结界咒语。 （15…20 秒。）你对另一个盟友施放的法术会减少 3 点能量。

54faaf36cf70a5d15e8e06e7931434c33ca4ec3a.source: Stance. (15…27…30 seconds.) Your skills recharge 33% faster. Ends if your Health drops below 50%.
54faaf36cf70a5d15e8e06e7931434c33ca4ec3a.text: 立场。 （15…27…30 秒。）你的技能恢复速度更快 33%。如果您的生命值低于 50%，则结束。

07d314b8f4d1484a1772d82d4146d5bf52cd1938.source: Elite Stance. (3…17…20 seconds.) Weapon attributes are increased by +1…12…15. You attack 33% faster. PvE Skill
07d314b8f4d1484a1772d82d4146d5bf52cd1938.text: 精英姿态。 （3…17…20秒。）武器属性增加+1…12…15。你的攻击速度加快33%。 PvE技能

1ede48603c5874457d0c2fb3d7b717fb2392f3e5.source: Sword Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…21…25 seconds).
1ede48603c5874457d0c2fb3d7b717fb2392f3e5.text: 剑攻击。造成流血状态（5…21…25 秒）。

c000e929de8cd5882173d7b86af694de667fd725.source: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. End effect after 10 seconds: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds); you return to your original location.
c000e929de8cd5882173d7b86af694de667fd725.text: 降咒魔法。暗影步瞄准敌人。 10秒后结束效果：造成深伤状态（5…17…20秒）；您返回原来的位置。

ea77e0021294f85b5107f78ce9c525ed2eab75a0.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…18…21 seconds.) Enemy spells cannot target you. Gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. You cannot deal more than 5…21…25 damage with a single skill or attack.
ea77e0021294f85b5107f78ce9c525ed2eab75a0.text: 精英结界法术。 （5…18…21 秒。）敌人的法术不能以你为目标。你身上的每一个刺客结界都会获得 5 点伤害减免。单个技能或攻击造成的伤害不能超过 5…21…25。

349cef0296aab8f898444b52f255a856faa4b989.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Hostile spells targeting you fail, and attacks against you miss. End effect: lose all but 5…41…50 Health.
349cef0296aab8f898444b52f255a856faa4b989.text: 精英结界法术。 （5…13…15 秒。）针对你的敌对法术失败，针对你的攻击也失败。最终效果：失去除 5…41…50 点生命值外的所有生命值。

0a1d11f55a5872db73bc417f1e4939929bbf19ca.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target ally. End effect: return to your original location. Cannot self-target.
0a1d11f55a5872db73bc417f1e4939929bbf19ca.text: 精英结界法术。暗影步瞄准盟友。最终效果：回到原来的位置。无法自我定位。

0ff111304d11438c67b933676ea34d7420663dc1.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (5…25…30 seconds). They attack 50% slower.
0ff111304d11438c67b933676ea34d7420663dc1.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（5…25…30 秒）。他们攻击50%的速度较慢。

33167078db282fd91fb527de8af0639e64053a6a.source: Stance. (10…34…40 seconds.) You move 15% faster. End effect: return to your original location.
33167078db282fd91fb527de8af0639e64053a6a.text: 立场。 （10…34…40 秒。）你移动速度加快了 15%。最终效果：回到原来的位置。

a561e3cc7c97b829cea6265c6b2c9e59640cef6a.source: Elite Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 66% slower (1…6…7 seconds).
a561e3cc7c97b829cea6265c6b2c9e59640cef6a.text: 精英六角咒语。暗影步瞄准敌人。该敌人移动速度慢 66%（1…6…7 秒）。

03e86c9164503fd44e3cff93416a098ad649e6e4.source: Enchantment Spell. (6 seconds.) You have +5…9…10 Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for 40…88…100 if you are attacking.
03e86c9164503fd44e3cff93416a098ad649e6e4.text: 结界咒语。 （6 秒。）你有 +5…9…10 点生命恢复。最终效果：如果你正在攻击，治疗你 40…88…100 点。

3b86d3aaea987b9425e3e09a647dcd8cdb30546f.source: Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) You gain +7…10 Health regeneration and +40 armor. You are Blind (5 seconds).
3b86d3aaea987b9425e3e09a647dcd8cdb30546f.text: 结界咒语。 （10 秒。）你获得 +7…10 点生命恢复和 +40 点护甲。你是盲人（5 秒）。

26f2ea1a8f92f78dae5e722efeaa3c51e2dd1482.source: Elite Hex Spell. (3…8…9 seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
26f2ea1a8f92f78dae5e722efeaa3c51e2dd1482.text: 精英六角咒语。 （3…8…9 秒。）目标敌人不能成为结界的目标。

fe2b78e2bec14ec5ab493ff999c26a374362b16b.source: Elite Hex Spell. (2…6…7 seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
fe2b78e2bec14ec5ab493ff999c26a374362b16b.text: 精英六角咒语。 （2…6…7 秒。）目标敌人不能成为结界的目标。

c80a0bed6409d255dde33697c9e12b328d09bcc6.source: Spell. Deals 12…41…48 damage. Steal up to 12…41…48 Health if this foe was above 50% Health.
c80a0bed6409d255dde33697c9e12b328d09bcc6.text: 咒语。造成 12…41…48 点伤害。如果该敌人的生命值高于 50% 点，则窃取最多 12…41…48 点生命值。

6824aaab7898c3f07826ffd50279ed807b72621b.source: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. For 5…17…20 seconds that foe's attributes are reduced by 1…4…5 and your attributes are increased by 1…4…5. Counts as a Lead Attack. PvE Skill
6824aaab7898c3f07826ffd50279ed807b72621b.text: 精英技能。暗影步瞄准敌人。 5…17…20秒内，敌方属性减少1…4…5，己方属性增加1…4…5，算主攻。 PvE技能

7eb3295d657e19a3431da0e25d1a878ea8163e99.source: Stance. (15 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location. Disables your attack skills for 1 second. Disables your stances and enchantments for 10 seconds.
7eb3295d657e19a3431da0e25d1a878ea8163e99.text: 立场。 （15 秒。）暗影步瞄准敌人。最终效果：回到原来的位置。使你的攻击技能失效 1 秒。使你的姿态和结界失效 10 秒。

532be0dc8bfdb868fca74f811ba846a26a57bbba.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30-second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and inflict Blindness condition (1…5…6 seconds).
532be0dc8bfdb868fca74f811ba846a26a57bbba.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…8…10级武魂（寿命30秒）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并造成失明状态（1…5…6 秒）。

45e5f0920c5df494192d9ffc9fa0a933a1364924.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…5…6 spirit (30-second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5…17…20 damage and inflict Blindness condition (1…5…6 seconds).
45e5f0920c5df494192d9ffc9fa0a933a1364924.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…5…6级武魂（寿命30秒）。它的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害并造成失明状态（1…5…6 秒）。

a8a97ab69488b09fa6881858f0b361126aebf476.source: Hex Spell. (3…13…15 seconds.) Target foe moves 25% slower and has 20…28…30 less armor against your attacks. Armor reduction only affects this foe while it has no other hexes.
a8a97ab69488b09fa6881858f0b361126aebf476.text: 降咒魔法。 （3…13…15 秒。）目标敌人的移动速度减慢 25%，并且针对你的攻击的护甲值减少 20…28…30。护甲减少仅影响该敌人，而没有其他六角形。

48f3d7afebf04a01f990ede64c372e044691793d.source: Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal 5…12…14 Energy. No effect unless this foe's spell targeted one of its allies.
48f3d7afebf04a01f990ede64c372e044691793d.text: 降咒魔法。 （6 秒。）目标敌人的下一个法术失败，你窃取 5…12…14 能量。除非该敌人的法术瞄准其盟友之一，否则不会产生任何效果。

dae1b31f053dd707dd5213fcf2505db3a3504366.source: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Target foe takes 5…17…20 damage each second while moving, but moves 10% faster.
dae1b31f053dd707dd5213fcf2505db3a3504366.text: 降咒魔法。 （10 秒。）目标敌人在移动时每秒受到 5…17…20 点伤害，但移动速度加快 10% 点。

e99412f73a69408524bbf09c0aab103fa93de834.source: Hex Spell. Projectile: deals 10…70…85 cold damage. Target foe moves 66% slower (2…5…6 seconds).
e99412f73a69408524bbf09c0aab103fa93de834.text: 降咒魔法。投射物：造成 10…70…85 点寒冷伤害。目标敌人移动速度慢 66%（2…5…6 秒）。

dd0ad8c92a9de66206234b566dcc0a54cb8ff50b.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of your target (5…17…20 seconds). These foes attack, cast spells, and move 50% slower.
dd0ad8c92a9de66206234b566dcc0a54cb8ff50b.text: 精英六角咒语。还会对目标区域内的敌人施咒（5…17…20 秒）。这些敌人攻击、施法和移动速度较慢 50%。

b4c7dd8504b6bffd256b08dedbc64d9690ea75de.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of your target (5…17…20 seconds). These foes attack, cast spells, and move 33% slower.
b4c7dd8504b6bffd256b08dedbc64d9690ea75de.text: 精英六角咒语。还会对目标区域内的敌人施咒（5…17…20 秒）。这些敌人攻击、施法和移动速度较慢 33%。

19a81d1299cc01873c34023fc792a1791da07aa8.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…25…30 seconds.) Your dagger attacks inflict the Bleeding condition (5…13…15 seconds).
19a81d1299cc01873c34023fc792a1791da07aa8.text: 结界咒语。 （5…25…30 秒。）你的匕首攻击造成流血状态（5…13…15 秒）。

233492288f349149486ac27d57509fb925481976.source: Spell. Removes a Mesmer hex from target foe. Removal effect: 15…63…75 damage to target and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.
233492288f349149486ac27d57509fb925481976.text: 咒语。从目标敌人身上移除催眠术。移除效果：对目标造成 15…63…75 点伤害，并对所有邻近敌人造成 75% 点伤害。

fb9177c7ed460a907a23b00175d067b000b9576a.source: Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: deals 14…83…100 damage.
fb9177c7ed460a907a23b00175d067b000b9576a.text: 咒语。移除目标敌人的结界。去除效果：造成14…83…100点伤害。

146e681fabba2b042134e49eab471c298818494a.source: Spell. Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effect: deals 30…102…120 damage to foes near this ally.
146e681fabba2b042134e49eab471c298818494a.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。移除效果：对该盟友附近的敌人造成 30…102…120 点伤害。

b6d6025efaa4cd93efaaf1ca490c3f789bed15a9.source: Elite Spell. Removes all enchantments. Removal cost: Shatter Storm is disabled for +7 seconds for each enchantment removed.
b6d6025efaa4cd93efaaf1ca490c3f789bed15a9.text: 精英法术。移除所有结界。移除成本：每移除一个结界，破碎风暴就会被禁用 +7 秒。

cfd2a80a798ae4cc074fb90cc14780e469ca2640.source: Elite Dual Attack. Deals 5…41…50 damage. Removes one enchantment. Unblockable. Must follow an off-hand attack.
cfd2a80a798ae4cc074fb90cc14780e469ca2640.text: 精英双重攻击。造成 5…41…50 点伤害。移除一项结界。不可封锁。必须跟随副手攻击。

cd0dd98719c57035f4bfa465db94869004d6f372.source: Elite Hex Spell. (3 seconds.) Initial effect: deals 25…85…100 cold damage and target moves 66% slower. End effect: deals 25…85…100 cold damage to target and all nearby foes.
cd0dd98719c57035f4bfa465db94869004d6f372.text: 精英六角咒语。 （3秒。）初始效果：造成25…85…100点寒冷伤害，目标移动速度减慢66%点。最终效果：对目标及其附近所有敌人造成 25…85…100 点寒冷伤害。

58a27eea31651726306316a9515df8ab83ff6887.source: Spell. Deals 10…26…30 lightning damage. Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5…17…20 seconds). 25% armor penetration. If Overcast, strikes adjacent.
58a27eea31651726306316a9515df8ab83ff6887.text: 咒语。造成 10…26…30 点闪电伤害。造成装甲破裂状态（5…17…20 秒）。 25% 护甲穿透。如果是阴天，则打击邻近地区。

f82eb040f6437a4a3254896dc053745192e60dd2.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses 75…51…45 Health.
f82eb040f6437a4a3254896dc053745192e60dd2.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。范围内的非精神盟友在单次攻击中损失的最大生命值不能超过 10% 点。伤害预防成本：该精魂损失 75…51…45 点生命值。

ba13d67134ea3c2470acb6c0ef6211aa360827ba.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses 75…51…45 Health.
ba13d67134ea3c2470acb6c0ef6211aa360827ba.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。范围内的非精神盟友在单次攻击中损失的最大生命值不能超过 10% 点。伤害预防成本：该精魂损失 75…51…45 点生命值。

44d44cae52ad20f873eace12d713308e15c1533c.source: Skill. (5…10…11 seconds.) You block the next melee attack skill. Causes knock-down and +15 second recharge. No effect unless you are wielding a shield.
44d44cae52ad20f873eace12d713308e15c1533c.text: 技能。 （5…10…11秒。）你格挡下一个近战攻击技能。造成击倒和 +15 二次充能。除非你拿着盾牌，否则没有任何效果。

669c3af09f42d346babd3d6a294a5e1d477a2f54.source: Enchantment Spell. (2…5…6 seconds). Party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. Block effect: Allies in earshot are healed for 10…34…40, and Shield Guardian ends.
669c3af09f42d346babd3d6a294a5e1d477a2f54.text: 结界咒语。 （2…5…6 秒）。听力范围内的队员有 75% 次机会阻止攻击。格挡效果：听力范围内的盟友治疗 10…34…40 点，盾卫结束。

58cf354f6c97cd1962d6fc8e6cdee5c804b4a614.source: Enchantment Spell. (1…3…4 seconds). Party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. Block effect: Allies in earshot are healed for 10…30…35, and Shield Guardian ends.
58cf354f6c97cd1962d6fc8e6cdee5c804b4a614.text: 结界咒语。 （1…3…4 秒）。听力范围内的队员有 75% 次机会阻止攻击。格挡效果：听力范围内的盟友治疗 10…30…35 点，盾卫结束。

79996668fbec018aaa8806fe507ad1745bed7b7a.source: Enchantment Spell. (3…6…7 seconds.) Reduces incoming damage by 5 each time target ally takes damage.
79996668fbec018aaa8806fe507ad1745bed7b7a.text: 结界咒语。 （3…6…7 秒。）每当目标盟友受到伤害时，所受到的伤害就会减少 5。

6677618ac8b213babb195e286b87741dcbd5e7d5.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3…9…10 seconds.) 75% chance to block. +15…27…30 armor.

e61644a6adf62e0f98b435d8314d9fd8714a5f2f.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1…13…16 seconds.) Blocks the next 1 attack against you. Knocks down and inflicts Weakness (5…17…20 seconds) on all adjacent attacking foes.
e61644a6adf62e0f98b435d8314d9fd8714a5f2f.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （1…13…16 秒。）阻止下一次针对您的 1 次攻击。击倒所有相邻的攻击敌人并造成虚弱（5…17…20 秒）。

760668e0f74267d516cc3611ef9034a2e8544e2c.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (8…18…20 seconds.) Deals 5…41…50 holy damage to foes attacking target ally. Causes knock-down.
760668e0f74267d516cc3611ef9034a2e8544e2c.text: 精英结界法术。 （8…18…20 秒。）对攻击目标盟友的敌人造成 5…41…50 点神圣伤害。导致击倒。

e0b24fdfc55a33d0be9b41af5dfee28473e1b9e0.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…11…13 seconds.) +3…9…10 Health regeneration and +20…40…45 armor.

b4f926d42d94f5681a4fa28bd4dfcaacf0371eda.source: Stance. (1…5…6 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Damage is reduced by 2 for each rank of Strength (maximum 15 damage reduction). No effect unless you have a shield equipped.
b4f926d42d94f5681a4fa28bd4dfcaacf0371eda.text: 立场。 （1…5…6 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。力量每提升一级，伤害减少 2（最大伤害减少 15）。除非装备了盾牌，否则没有效果。

0a3eba79087c89168543060aa6b7a90f4aaaf093.source: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Reduces incoming damage andthere are two blanks between 'damage' and 'and' life steal by 3…15…18. End effect: heals for 5…41…50
0a3eba79087c89168543060aa6b7a90f4aaaf093.text: 结界咒语。 （8 秒。）减少传入伤害，并且“伤害”和“生命偷取”之间有两个空白 3…15…18。最终效果：治愈 5…41…50

375c4ff266fa11764c0842a0f687f945738ab84c.source: Hex Spell. (10…34…40 seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. Interruption cost: you lose 8…4…3 Energy or this hex ends.
375c4ff266fa11764c0842a0f687f945738ab84c.text: 降咒魔法。 （10…34…40 秒。）寒冷伤害会打断目标敌人的技能。中断成本：你损失 8…4…3 点能量或此降咒结束。

056e6ba7047109118fa9e2281e12efc18eefc7dc.source: Touch Skill. Deals 10…50…60 lightning damage. Causes knock-down. 25% armor penetration.
056e6ba7047109118fa9e2281e12efc18eefc7dc.text: 触摸技能。造成 10…50…60 点闪电伤害。导致击倒。 25% 护甲穿透。

02309e10badf32ff305cc0580b25ea59ee203e5f.source: Spell. Rapid projectile: deals 5…41…50 lightning damage. Gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if you hit a foe suffering from Cracked Armor. 25% armor penetration.
02309e10badf32ff305cc0580b25ea59ee203e5f.text: 咒语。快速投射物：造成 5…41…50 点闪电伤害。如果你击中患有裂纹护甲的敌人，则获得 5 能量，再加上每 2 级能量储存获得 1 能量。 25% 护甲穿透。

c7761326ce73e056f78aef8c8688519973ecd237.source: Elite Spell. Foes in the area take 15…51…60 earth damage and are Weakened (1…8…10 seconds). Nearby foes also take +15…51…60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor (1…8…10 seconds). Adjacent foes also take +15…51…60 earth damage and are Blinded (1…8…10 seconds).
c7761326ce73e056f78aef8c8688519973ecd237.text: 精英法术。该区域内的敌人会受到 15…51…60 点土系伤害并被削弱（1…8…10 秒）。附近的敌人也会受到 +15…51…60 点土系伤害，并且护甲破裂（1…8…10 秒）。邻近的敌人也会受到 +15…51…60 点土系伤害并被致盲（1…8…10 秒）。

57f4546d460b0dddf0ea33440801420d8f98fe6d.source: Elite Touch Skill. Target touched foe takes 15…63…75 damage, their stance ends, and they are knocked down.
57f4546d460b0dddf0ea33440801420d8f98fe6d.text: 精英触摸技能。目标接触的敌人受到 15…63…75 点伤害，他们的姿态结束，并且被击倒。

e4a705c3c8e98093d459e8fa6d7bf658fd3d2543.source: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Causes -1…3…4 Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5…17…20 seconds).
e4a705c3c8e98093d459e8fa6d7bf658fd3d2543.text: 降咒魔法。 （10 秒。）导致 -1…3…4 健康退化。最终效果：造成装甲破裂状态（5…17…20秒）。

7d5646399d858f523d2ded9a488399300782260d.source: Enchantment Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) You have +3…7…8 health regeneration and a 75% chance to block. No effect unless your Health is below 50%.
7d5646399d858f523d2ded9a488399300782260d.text: 结界咒语。 （30…54…60 秒。）你有 +3…7…8 点生命恢复和 75% 次格挡机会。除非您的生命值低于 50%，否则没有影响。

2f53844347b004a03828ac144473937756fca65b.source: Enchantment Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. No effect unless your Health is below 50%.
2f53844347b004a03828ac144473937756fca65b.text: 结界咒语。 （30…54…60 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。除非您的生命值低于 50%，否则没有影响。

bbd9e23dafea43a9603dd40f836e63ed84227326.source: Elite Touch Hex Spell. (1…5…6 seconds.) Target foe cannot cast spells. Your spells are disabled for 15 seconds.
bbd9e23dafea43a9603dd40f836e63ed84227326.text: 精英接触六角咒语。 （1…5…6 秒。）目标敌人无法施展法术。你的法术将被禁用 15 秒。

c5908eafbe1f52d132ab758b6d080d366ea6860e.source: Enchantment Spell. (8…18…20 seconds). You are immune to Blindness.
c5908eafbe1f52d132ab758b6d080d366ea6860e.text: 结界咒语。 （8…18…20 秒）。你对失明免疫。

8b5e943f9f84fd33a53a86a1ca17edaf234f9857.source: Signet. You gain 2 adrenaline if you are under the effects of a shout or chant.
8b5e943f9f84fd33a53a86a1ca17edaf234f9857.text: 印章。如果您受到喊叫或圣歌的影响，您会获得 2 肾上腺素。

7776e14b4f43cc567459afd701e58cee6d72f1f7.source: Signet. Deals 10…58…70 damage to foes near you. You begin Bleeding (25 seconds).
7776e14b4f43cc567459afd701e58cee6d72f1f7.text: 印章。对你附近的敌人造成 10…58…70 点伤害。你开始流血（25 秒）。

27ef5d1619cde672e475609cbe410a0661bddf18.source: Signet. You lose 200…80…50 Health. Gain control of target enemy-controlled spirit. 50% failure chance unless Spawning Power 5 or more.
27ef5d1619cde672e475609cbe410a0661bddf18.text: 印章。您失去 200…80…50 点生命值。获得对目标敌人控制的精神的控制权。 50% 失败几率，除非产卵力 5 或更高。

eefd31cd65d6e9f4cf8e84e85b68a14ecbf3666b.source: Signet. Interrupts an attack for target foe and all adjacent foes. Interruption effect: deals 15…51…60 damage; knocks down foes using attack skills.
eefd31cd65d6e9f4cf8e84e85b68a14ecbf3666b.text: 印章。打断目标敌人和所有邻近敌人的攻击。打断效果：造成15…51…60点伤害；使用攻击技能击倒敌人。

f22e842be2a9a8edb7b23ac2565628177ea42e35.source: Signet. Deals 20…30 damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 2 Energy (maximum 12…20) for each of these foes with a condition or hex.
f22e842be2a9a8edb7b23ac2565628177ea42e35.text: 印章。对目标和附近的敌人造成 20…30 点伤害。对于每个具有条件或妖术的敌人，你都会获得 2 点能量（最多 12…20 点）。

3970cf3a42b5254fa2b0f9f51c7763ae2a00e964.source: Signet. Gain 4 Energy (maximum 3…10…12 Energy) for each summoned creature you control within earshot.
3970cf3a42b5254fa2b0f9f51c7763ae2a00e964.text: 印章。为你控制的每个在听力范围内的召唤生物获得 4 点能量（最多 3…10…12 点能量）。

df0ddb8063299233565518ee8d08bb758bcc9796.source: Signet. Deals 5…29…35 damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe.
df0ddb8063299233565518ee8d08bb758bcc9796.text: 印章。对目标敌人的每种情况造成 5…29…35 点伤害（最大 130 点）。

704f549b6ef703b2be4309e34c4b8e96c672f282.source: Signet. Deals 5…29…35 damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe. Must follow a dual attack.
704f549b6ef703b2be4309e34c4b8e96c672f282.text: 印章。对目标敌人的每种情况造成 5…29…35 点伤害（最大 130 点）。必须遵循双重攻击。

3c032e694fdad12a7ecba84ea611268614735b33.source: Signet. Removes one enchantment. You lose all Energy.
3c032e694fdad12a7ecba84ea611268614735b33.text: 印章。移除一项结界。你失去了所有能量。

575c167ba861c78e18714c00f7d06e280a4fd821.source: Signet. Interrupts a spell. Can interrupt any skill if target foe is hexed. Interruption effect: deals 10…43…51 damage.
575c167ba861c78e18714c00f7d06e280a4fd821.text: 印章。打断一个咒语。如果目标敌人被施咒，可以打断任何技能。打断效果：造成10…43…51点伤害。

4d2115fbf0ba352ed650df4220abf0d05a2e97fe.source: Signet. Interrupts a spell. Interruption effect: target foe's spell is disabled for 1…4…5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.
4d2115fbf0ba352ed650df4220abf0d05a2e97fe.text: 印章。打断一个咒语。打断效果：每装备一个印章，目标敌人的法术就会被禁用 1…4…5 秒。

b638012851cbb65b88162022e1bb5ca77ffc11e4.source: Elite Signet. (5…17…20 seconds.) All spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal +5…9…10 damage.
b638012851cbb65b88162022e1bb5ca77ffc11e4.text: 精英图章。 （5…17…20 秒。）在听力范围内由你控制的所有灵魂的攻击速度加快 33% 并造成 +5…9…10 点伤害。

0d9843b2854c1d9b9789a733fbb32af8d1504155.source: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature deals +5…29…35 damage. That creature is destroyed after 10 seconds.
0d9843b2854c1d9b9789a733fbb32af8d1504155.text: 精英图章。目标友军召唤生物造成 +5…29…35 点伤害。该生物在 10 秒后被消灭。

a8445fb9eae1a43f5555b52401177b2f7518bdfa.source: Signet. Disables elite skill (1…13…16 seconds). Disables your non-Mesmer skills (4 seconds).
a8445fb9eae1a43f5555b52401177b2f7518bdfa.text: 印章。禁用精英技能（1…13…16秒）。禁用你的非催眠技能（4 秒）。

7c9fb19c91deb4557f99bc3811cb1f6568871202.source: Signet. Inflicts Diseased condition 13…20 seconds if target foe is Bleeding.
7c9fb19c91deb4557f99bc3811cb1f6568871202.text: 印章。如果目标敌人流血，则造成疾病状态 13…20 秒。

41ffd29419b836615f234f4f520a15cf96919b4a.source: Elite Signet. Knocks down target. Deals 15…63…75 holy damage to target and adjacent foes.
41ffd29419b836615f234f4f520a15cf96919b4a.text: 精英图章。击倒目标。对目标和邻近敌人造成 15…63…75 点神圣伤害。

321dcabead761efa3bf347f56f76622ce1047635.source: Elite Half Range Signet. Knocks down target. Deals 5…41…50 holy damage to target and adjacent foes.
321dcabead761efa3bf347f56f76622ce1047635.text: 精英半程徽记。击倒目标。对目标和邻近敌人造成 5…41…50 点神圣伤害。

6947b76c5b63977d4a4c0bd30e74b5cb198afc65.source: Signet. You gain 10…82…100 Health and 1…8…10 Energy if target foe is below 50% Health.
6947b76c5b63977d4a4c0bd30e74b5cb198afc65.text: 印章。如果目标敌人的生命值低于 50% 点，您将获得 10…82…100 点生命值和 1…8…10 点能量。

4c307b563d274330e3ed9d26f9b7c74a7b0ea6fb.source: Signet. You lose one condition for each condition on target foe.
4c307b563d274330e3ed9d26f9b7c74a7b0ea6fb.text: 印章。目标敌人每有一个状况，你就会失去一个状况。

3b2fbed2a215f5332cee339e8c68533f6c9759b1.source: Elite Touch Signet. (15 seconds.) Inflicts Blindness condition. You suffer from Blindness (15 seconds).
3b2fbed2a215f5332cee339e8c68533f6c9759b1.text: 精英触摸图章。 （15 秒。）造成失明状态。你失明了（15秒）。

d7f15ad8586c0ab5aeba3e6bc3a80f7f46437fc8.source: Signet. (30 seconds.) Your next 1…3…3 self-targeted enchantments cast instantly. Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.
d7f15ad8586c0ab5aeba3e6bc3a80f7f46437fc8.text: 印章。 （30 秒。）你的下一个 1…3…3 个自我瞄准结界立即施放。闪光附魔不会消耗该技能的使用。

10c6609703bed350179e1f6ed7655b14c80dec5c.source: Signet. Deals 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30…102…120 holy damage).
10c6609703bed350179e1f6ed7655b14c80dec5c.text: 印章。对你的每个结界造成 25 点神圣伤害（最多 30…102…120 点神圣伤害）。

707079e8a1de6a931d0a737d26202bdb54ffb1bd.source: Signet. Heals for 30…126…150. Removes one of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: recharges 75% faster.
707079e8a1de6a931d0a737d26202bdb54ffb1bd.text: 印章。治疗 30…126…150 点。移除你的一个苦行僧结界。去除效果：充能75%更快。

10798873388fb1728436d46dc29df1bca882b472.source: Signet. Inflicts Crippled condition (5…13…15 seconds). Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: also causes Cripple to foes in the area of your target and recharges 75% faster.
10798873388fb1728436d46dc29df1bca882b472.text: 印章。造成残废状态（5…13…15 秒）。移除 1 个苦行僧结界。移除效果：还会对目标区域内的敌人造成瘫痪，并更快地充能75%。

163684074dcf150a43114287b007bca62110fc42.source: Signet. (5…13…15 seconds.) Cripples target foe and removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: recharges 50% faster.
163684074dcf150a43114287b007bca62110fc42.text: 印章。 （5…13…15 秒。）削弱目标敌人并移除 1 个苦行僧结界。去除效果：充能50%速度更快。

b457db59f26ecd869ffd23df7875aec9726e5657.source: Signet. Deals 5…41…50 holy damage. Deals 5…9…10 more holy damage for each of target foe's adrenaline skills.
b457db59f26ecd869ffd23df7875aec9726e5657.text: 印章。造成 5…41…50 点神圣伤害。每个目标敌人的肾上腺素技能都会额外造成 5…9…10 点神圣伤害。

7ee1425792411054db959869ed18959a765e18c7.source: Signet. (6 seconds.) You have -4 Energy regeneration. End effect: you gain 13…19…20 Energy.
7ee1425792411054db959869ed18959a765e18c7.text: 印章。 （6 秒。）你有 -4 能量再生。最终效果：你获得 13…19…20 点能量。

e8835a89b7561c382c8243e025ca0cab9334043c.source: Signet. Heals for 15…63…75. Heals for 15…63…75 more if target ally is casting a spell or attacking.
e8835a89b7561c382c8243e025ca0cab9334043c.text: 印章。治疗 15…63…75 点。如果目标盟友正在施法或攻击，则可额外治疗 15…63…75 点。

0d4f130aec68474c33a34d9b1fe3ff8d26461d04.source: Elite Signet. Removes one hex and one condition. No effect unless target ally is enchanted.
0d4f130aec68474c33a34d9b1fe3ff8d26461d04.text: 精英图章。删除一个降咒和一个条件。除非目标盟友被附魔，否则没有效果。

b37de942d3d128fb482584004c290c578758a7d2.source: Signet. Resurrects target party member (5…17…20% Health and 1…3…4% Energy for each party member in earshot).
b37de942d3d128fb482584004c290c578758a7d2.text: 印章。复活目标队员（每个能听到的队员有 5…17…20% 点生命值和 1…3…4% 点能量）。

6d164d96e499abb3f7e6d5de8c1e43398233e246.source: Signet. Deals 5…29…35 damage. Deals 15…51…60 more damage if target foe is Blinded.
6d164d96e499abb3f7e6d5de8c1e43398233e246.text: 印章。造成 5…29…35 点伤害。如果目标敌人被致盲，则额外造成 15…51…60 点伤害。

7d53d43c74d09299ebfd51d4182ad9b5fa775cb1.source: Signet. Deals 15…63…75 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet.
7d53d43c74d09299ebfd51d4182ad9b5fa775cb1.text: 印章。造成 15…63…75 点伤害。如果目标敌人靠近尸体或有死去的宠物，则会立即充电。

1257cc79df57fe56285e5ac711843d577d4e58a4.source: Elite Signet. Creates 3 level 1…10…12 spirits (60 second lifespan). These spirits deal 5…17…20 damage with attacks.
1257cc79df57fe56285e5ac711843d577d4e58a4.text: 精英图章。创造3级1…10…12精神（60第二寿命）。这些灵魂的攻击造成 5…17…20 点伤害。

8b81beb1ea7160f15ae5f513dc7305a4fe0cdf34.source: Elite Signet. You gain 3…10…12 Energy. No effect unless you are within earshot of a spirit.
8b81beb1ea7160f15ae5f513dc7305a4fe0cdf34.text: 精英图章。您获得 3…10…12 能量。除非你在灵魂的听力范围内，否则没有任何效果。
