7b8097be779d17c457cec5b897c61b03af628f5e.source: Signet. You have +50…250…300 maximum Health. Ends if you hit with an attack.
7b8097be779d17c457cec5b897c61b03af628f5e.text: 印章。您的最大生命值为 +50…250…300。如果你受到攻击就会结束。

adc8fadf994d3162e6d14a16520e9dd61ccc2b53.source: Signet. Your attacks deal +5 damage. Ends after 1…13…16 attacks.
adc8fadf994d3162e6d14a16520e9dd61ccc2b53.text: 印章。你的攻击造成 +5 点伤害。 1…13…16 次攻击后结束。

7ec1c919a74cf3eb37d471bcdba0fe92cf99a831.source: Elite Signet. You Bleed for 6 seconds. Applies Bleeding (2…13…16 seconds) to the target of your next Necromancer skill.
7ec1c919a74cf3eb37d471bcdba0fe92cf99a831.text: 精英图章。你流血了 6 秒。对你的下一个死灵法师技能的目标施加流血（2…13…16 秒）。

f4c9f0d83fcc83da016fa16974f4f70ac7618c44.source: Signet. Heal target ally for 40…88…100. You are also healed for 40…88…100 if you are not enchanted. Cannot self-target.
f4c9f0d83fcc83da016fa16974f4f70ac7618c44.text: 印章。治疗目标盟友 40…88…100 点。如果您没有附魔，您也会获得 40…88…100 点治疗。无法自我定位。

8d8de4d2d7b87f075eedef0d5a6e1a932a8f33f8.source: Signet. Deals 10…82…100 damage. No effect unless target foe is Poisoned
8d8de4d2d7b87f075eedef0d5a6e1a932a8f33f8.text: 印章。造成 10…82…100 点伤害。除非目标敌人中毒，否则无效

f2c2d85c4b15b902eb7802f4011de27b02fd4cfd.source: Signet. Removes one enchantment for each hex on target foe.
f2c2d85c4b15b902eb7802f4011de27b02fd4cfd.text: 印章。为目标敌人身上的每个六角形移除一个结界。

528a4a606732db9352c2fde5d613231eb1668b8c.source: Signet. Also affects foes near your target. Causes 3…7…8 Energy loss and inflicts Weakness (1…10…12 seconds).
528a4a606732db9352c2fde5d613231eb1668b8c.text: 印章。也会影响目标附近的敌人。造成 3…7…8 点能量损失并造成虚弱（1…10…12 秒）。

a4b6ef2906c84e68a910fe265cfda638a9ef36d7.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: If a skill was interrupted, that skill is disabled and Simple Thievery becomes that skill (5…17…20 seconds).
a4b6ef2906c84e68a910fe265cfda638a9ef36d7.text: 精英法术。打断一个动作。打断效果：如果某个技能被打断，则该技能被禁用，简单盗窃将成为该技能（5…17…20秒）。

10e49b9f0bbf39f6eae28a19c233e71c00776a00.source: Hex Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. Recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.
10e49b9f0bbf39f6eae28a19c233e71c00776a00.text: 降咒魔法。 （5…13…15 秒。）目标敌人移动速度慢 33%，你移动速度快 33%。如果对移动的敌人施放，则可以更快地充能 50%。

f97b81e33cb011aa0120010474866ecebffef840.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Target foe deals -5…41…50 attack damage. You have +50% chance to land a critical hit on this foe.
f97b81e33cb011aa0120010474866ecebffef840.text: 精英六角咒语。 （5…17…20 秒。）目标敌人造成 -5…41…50 点攻击伤害。你有 +50% 次机会对这个敌人造成致命一击。

3407eea62bfcea0a050d1a8ad3c12dce2c28b100.source: Elite Melee Attack. Interrupts an action. Inflicts Dazed condition (15 seconds) if target is casting a spell.
3407eea62bfcea0a050d1a8ad3c12dce2c28b100.text: 精英近战攻击。打断一个动作。如果目标正在施法，则会造成茫然状态（15 秒）。

20e0fb8cd5bb3a254d5041abdb015f0ee2408566.source: Spear Attack. Deals +5…21…25 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target has more Health than you.
20e0fb8cd5bb3a254d5041abdb015f0ee2408566.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。如果目标的生命值比你多，则会造成深度伤害（5…17…20 秒）。

087a7608be641a0d729ed6eeac0d1ff9098cccb3.source: Spell. Causes knock-down if this foe is Blind or moving. Affects foes adjacent to your target. 50% failure chance unless Water Magic greater than 4.
087a7608be641a0d729ed6eeac0d1ff9098cccb3.text: 咒语。如果该敌人是盲人或正在移动，则会导致击倒。影响与你的目标相邻的敌人。 50% 失败几率，除非水系魔法大于 4。

1f2ad514a9168724572b5f5a486500181d85ca44.source: Spell. Causes knock-down if this foe is Blind or moving. 50% failure chance unless Water Magic 5 or higher.
1f2ad514a9168724572b5f5a486500181d85ca44.text: 咒语。如果该敌人是盲人或正在移动，则会导致击倒。 50% 失败几率，除非水魔法 5 或更高。

ef8a4e11c5f2ead6af7749a7bf2435d30d3b9f3b.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…10…11 seconds.) You have 25…45…50% chance to block. Deals 5…29…35 earth damage to one nearby foe whenever you are the target of a hostile spell or attack.
ef8a4e11c5f2ead6af7749a7bf2435d30d3b9f3b.text: 结界咒语。 （5…10…11 秒。）你有 25…45…50% 次格挡机会。当你成为敌对法术或攻击的目标时，会对附近的一名敌人造成 5…29…35 点土属性伤害。

6fce1c48069baf3571d22af9c7836f1f8252aca3.source: Bow Attack. Deals +10…22…25 damage. Deals +10…30…35 more damage if target foe is not using a skill.
6fce1c48069baf3571d22af9c7836f1f8252aca3.text: 弓攻击。造成 +10…22…25 点伤害。如果目标敌人未使用技能，则额外造成 +10…30…35 点伤害。

63f72c60838bc991e24468defde9f942fb6e5b49.source: Bow Attack. Deals +5…13…15 damage. Deals +5…17…20 more damage if target foe is not using a skill.
63f72c60838bc991e24468defde9f942fb6e5b49.text: 弓攻击。造成 +5…13…15 点伤害。如果目标敌人未使用技能，则额外造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。

e3c973f6833e9c03a3d50cb922d611038a5634bc.source: Spell. Deals 10…46…55 holy damage. Deals 10…30…35 more holy damage if target is attacking.
e3c973f6833e9c03a3d50cb922d611038a5634bc.text: 咒语。造成 10…46…55 点神圣伤害。如果目标正在攻击，则额外造成 10…30…35 点神圣伤害。

7c8974914c909000b4f71879742a00a1454c7cf9.source: Spell. Removes a condition. Removal effect: deals 10…50…60 holy damage to foes in the area of target ally.
7c8974914c909000b4f71879742a00a1454c7cf9.text: 咒语。删除一个条件。去除效果：对目标友方区域内的敌人造成10…50…60点神圣伤害。

205762b0839b2e8a2992c8d54e9d7c06f887729f.source: Spell. Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effect: deals 10…70…85 holy damage to foes in the area of target ally.
205762b0839b2e8a2992c8d54e9d7c06f887729f.text: 咒语。从目标盟友身上移除一个六角形。去除效果：对目标友方区域内的敌人造成10…70…85点神圣伤害。

b9b8e022c79ef1ac36613841fae055d366322b1a.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your Smiting Prayers have double Divine Favor healing bonus.
b9b8e022c79ef1ac36613841fae055d366322b1a.text: 结界咒语。 （30 秒。）你的重击祈祷有双倍神圣恩惠治疗加成。

91cca3bfa04d5919c0375537d4044a7469dd44d7.source: Enchantment Spell. (4 seconds.) Your Smiting Prayers have double Divine Favor healing bonus.
91cca3bfa04d5919c0375537d4044a7469dd44d7.text: 结界咒语。 （4 秒。）你的重击祈祷有双倍神圣恩惠治疗加成。

802adc33eae4a7c2d0de23d9ee7370cb81c8f232.source: Stance. (8 seconds.) The next time you are struck, you take half damage and inflict Blindness condition (2…5…6 seconds) on adjacent foes.
802adc33eae4a7c2d0de23d9ee7370cb81c8f232.text: 立场。 （8 秒。）下次你被击中时，你会受到一半伤害并对相邻敌人造成失明状态（2…5…6 秒）。

7d921ac4527c4f8aaedb60f8f738bdb3fcf62029.source: Elite Trap. (90 seconds.) Inflicts Blinded and Dazed conditions (5…9…10 seconds) to nearby foes. Easily interrupted.
7d921ac4527c4f8aaedb60f8f738bdb3fcf62029.text: 精英陷阱。 （90 秒。）对附近的敌人造成失明和眩晕状态（5…9…10 秒）。很容易被打断。

fb6f391a7debc30626f365dba0285858f85a3c04.source: Hex Spell. Deals 10…58…70 fire damage to target. If you are Overcast, foe is hexed for 3 seconds, taking 5…21…25 fire damage each second.
fb6f391a7debc30626f365dba0285858f85a3c04.text: 降咒魔法。对目标造成 10…58…70 点火焰伤害。如果你是阴天，敌人会被施咒 3 秒，每秒受到 5…21…25 点火焰伤害。

90325a0622d7d252ac18d32f4193862835444bcd.source: Spell. (10…20 seconds.) Disables one Spell. This skill becomes that Spell. You gain 5…10 Energy.
90325a0622d7d252ac18d32f4193862835444bcd.text: 咒语。 （10…20 秒。）禁用一个法术。该技能成为该法术。您获得 5…10 能量。

7540b0d967a8107f01a96b60a1e5d6222f0283e8.source: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Inflicts Crippled condition (3…13…15 seconds). Easily interrupted.
7540b0d967a8107f01a96b60a1e5d6222f0283e8.text: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影响附近的敌人。造成残废状态（3…13…15 秒）。很容易被打断。

85019f6b0b3b2dc51f21e7f287161bcefd19d6bf.source: Melee Attack. Inflicts Blindness (5…8 seconds). Counts as a lead attack.
85019f6b0b3b2dc51f21e7f287161bcefd19d6bf.text: 近战攻击。造成失明（5…8 秒）。算作主导攻击。

35bfecf2acd53dfd1571bb34e716fd98405d8eff.source: Spell. Deals 30…40 cold damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.
35bfecf2acd53dfd1571bb34e716fd98405d8eff.text: 咒语。每秒造成 30…40 点寒冷伤害（5 秒）。击中目标敌人初始位置附近的敌人。

52327e6b175a8f99e923953002c5b0f53c7cbdb6.source: Stance. (1…5…6 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block while under the effects of a shout or chant. Block effect: gain 1 adrenaline.
52327e6b175a8f99e923953002c5b0f53c7cbdb6.text: 立场。 （1…5…6 秒。）在喊叫或圣歌的影响下，你有 75% 次格挡机会。格挡效果：获得1肾上腺素。

d773bb85aeeebdeb444b5d58a138832ca927bba7.source: Elite Echo. (10…30…35 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline if under the effects of a shout or chant. You have -20 armor.
d773bb85aeeebdeb444b5d58a138832ca927bba7.text: 精英回声。 （10…30…35 秒。）如果在喊叫或圣歌的作用下，你的攻击速度会更快 33%，并会获得更多的肾上腺素 33%。你有-20护甲。

e758b37761b72ef4218878f552d94ed631cd6335.source: Stance. (3…15…18 seconds.) You move 15% faster and an additional 15% while affected by a chant or shout.
e758b37761b72ef4218878f552d94ed631cd6335.text: 立场。 （3…15…18 秒。）当你受到圣歌或喊叫的影响时，你移动速度加快了 15% 并额外移动了 15%。

086248358a92b2e51e8327afa62db71bdec86072.source: Elite Stance. (5…13…15 seconds.) You have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.
086248358a92b2e51e8327afa62db71bdec86072.text: 精英姿态。 （5…13…15 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。在圣歌或呼喊的影响下，你可以更快地攻击 33%。

402404ae3514e663f37108667c0709034972f8cb.source: Elite Stance. (4…9…10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
402404ae3514e663f37108667c0709034972f8cb.text: 精英姿态。 （4…9…10 秒。）在喊叫或圣歌的影响下，你可以更快地攻击 33%。

d778ee8c71fb2a213db7ff62b70b3e4eb0a703b3.source: Melee Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage. Unblockable if you are under the effects of a chant or shout.
d778ee8c71fb2a213db7ff62b70b3e4eb0a703b3.text: 近战攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。如果您受到圣歌或喊叫的影响，则无法阻止。

7d7f56ef8ca211eebdbfabd41e6b30224be47438.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot are uninterruptible with their next skill.
7d7f56ef8ca211eebdbfabd41e6b30224be47438.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）听力范围内的盟友不会被打断他们的下一个技能。

3e4e7877313263f45ba4ac7adef24dea4d158933.source: Chant. (5…17…20 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain +4 Energy regeneration. Ends when using a skill.
3e4e7877313263f45ba4ac7adef24dea4d158933.text: 吟诵。 （5…17…20 秒。）听力范围内的盟友获得 +4 点能量回复。使用技能时结束。

250d0f0a3a4e76502ac236f0ede6a3295718627a.source: Elite Chant. (20 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one condition with their next 1…5…6 skills.
250d0f0a3a4e76502ac236f0ede6a3295718627a.text: 精英圣歌。 （20 秒。）在听力范围内的盟友会在​​下一个 1…5…6 技能中失去一个条件。

04a806c8df2fddc3c803311ee79095b4f335c74f.source: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 45…97…110 Health with their next skill.
04a806c8df2fddc3c803311ee79095b4f335c74f.text: 精英圣歌。 （10 秒。）听力范围内的队员通过下一个技能获得 45…97…110 点生命值。

2f44aadacafc57b1038d2cab6873886797532ca6.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Building adrenaline takes twice as long for foes within range.
2f44aadacafc57b1038d2cab6873886797532ca6.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。对于范围内的敌人来说，产生肾上腺素需要两倍的时间。

5f7b875cc37f830d855d5dd45d18aa78e2abe561.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (15…39…45 second lifespan). Building adrenaline takes twice as long for foes within range.
5f7b875cc37f830d855d5dd45d18aa78e2abe561.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命15…39…45）。对于范围内的敌人来说，产生肾上腺素需要两倍的时间。

cf72b51a96a1da9f1f124c38830bda36cafdfe19.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foe adjacent to target. (8…18…20 seconds). These foes cannot gain adrenaline.
cf72b51a96a1da9f1f124c38830bda36cafdfe19.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒。 （8…18…20 秒）。这些敌人无法获得肾上腺素。

a36bc6d55ec9829eb92a82f8523e53e4b54ac8cd.source: Spell. Heals for 10…82…100. You gain 3 Energy if you are holding an item.
a36bc6d55ec9829eb92a82f8523e53e4b54ac8cd.text: 咒语。治疗 10…82…100 点。如果您持有物品，您将获得 3 点能量。

a95c605aad8388e545ff4ab8bffb4b50e73f8e89.source: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 15…27…30 damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on target foe.
a95c605aad8388e545ff4ab8bffb4b50e73f8e89.text: 降咒魔法。 （30 秒。）当对目标敌人施放结界或妖术时，造成 15…27…30 点伤害。

49170cc4a067ae815967023f2ee319a367e8b57f.source: Elite Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 20…68…80 damage. Ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.
49170cc4a067ae815967023f2ee319a367e8b57f.text: 精英六角咒语。 （30 秒。）每次治疗目标敌人时，治疗者都会受到 20…68…80 点伤害。如果目标遭受重击祈祷咒的折磨，则结束。

6f7cf514dad36215e8ae97dd814c3739ff2d8fe0.source: Spell. You gain 50…234…280 Health. Exploits a fresh corpse.
6f7cf514dad36215e8ae97dd814c3739ff2d8fe0.text: 咒语。您获得 50…234…280 点生命值。利用新鲜尸体。

dab39abb18b4a91df84da0e67ba10cd83b75a76b.source: Enchantment Spell. Reduce overcast at a rate of 1…2…2 per second. You and all adjacent foes are afflicted with burning.
dab39abb18b4a91df84da0e67ba10cd83b75a76b.text: 结界咒语。以每秒 1…2…2 次的速度减少阴天。你和所有邻近的敌人都受到燃烧的折磨。

716385172735631fd1e2b737715b462f160a975e.source: Elite Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Steal 16…67…80 Health whenever target foe casts a spell.
716385172735631fd1e2b737715b462f160a975e.text: 精英六角咒语。 （10 秒。）每当目标敌人施展法术时，窃取 16…67…80 点生命值。

6ab1093b511bc0a949aed2692e9ad3be8e060fe3.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3…25…30 seconds.) Attacks deal +15…19…20 damage and sacrifice 15…19…20 health. PvE Skill
6ab1093b511bc0a949aed2692e9ad3be8e060fe3.text: 精英结界法术。 （3…25…30 秒。）攻击造成 +15…19…20 点伤害并牺牲 15…19…20 点生命值。 PvE技能

52cbbc042cdd17ed548db7abf7996d3c284b492b.source: Elite Skill. (5…37…45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge instantly. Ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.
52cbbc042cdd17ed548db7abf7996d3c284b492b.text: 精英技能。 （5…37…45 秒。）你的束缚仪式消耗 15 能量（最少 5）并立即充电。 1…3…3 束缚仪式后结束。

93e97df92039469ec575784bec73cd5eae527493.source: Elite Skill. (5…37…45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25…45…50% faster. Ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.
93e97df92039469ec575784bec73cd5eae527493.text: 精英技能。 （5…37…45 秒。）你的束缚仪式消耗的能量减少 15 点（最少 5 点），并且充电速度更快 25…45…50% 点。 1…3…3 束缚仪式后结束。

4dd8f5191c404c26c2b41688b28c65dd910e9bb5.source: Spear Attack. Deals +30…40 damage. Gain 3…6 strikes of adrenaline if you hit a foe with a condition.
4dd8f5191c404c26c2b41688b28c65dd910e9bb5.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +30…40 点伤害。如果你击中患有某种疾病的敌人，就会获得 3…6 次肾上腺素打击。

c2733504c039d674ade5b7cc74c45aa1e9646c8e.source: Spell. Projectile: deals 26…50…56 holy damage. Deals 15…51…60 more damage if target foe is attacking.
c2733504c039d674ade5b7cc74c45aa1e9646c8e.text: 咒语。投射物：造成 26…50…56 点神圣伤害。如果目标敌人正在攻击，则额外造成 15…51…60 点伤害。

b4fa7d58eabc13ab8621bf5661f0acdd1b0287fd.source: Spear Attack. Deals +10…18…20 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Strikes all foes between you and your target.
b4fa7d58eabc13ab8621bf5661f0acdd1b0287fd.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +10…18…20 点闪电伤害。 25% 护甲穿透。攻击你和目标之间的所有敌人。

f7c6912a45892b9e6ba97f60461ba08198e0308b.source: Spear Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.
f7c6912a45892b9e6ba97f60461ba08198e0308b.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。如果它没有击中，你就会失去一个条件。

67b13d18e688d662d2b0f49c0132ac22f7cb1174.source: Spear Melee Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage and inflicts Dazed condition (4…9…10 seconds). This attack has melee range.
67b13d18e688d662d2b0f49c0132ac22f7cb1174.text: 长矛近战攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害并造成茫然状态（4…9…10 秒）。此攻击具有近战范围。

f4f3aee4efab2b14f42b83a6d2a6e22dea5089dd.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…15…17 seconds.) Target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.

4d9876c81701be0a6ba768d13affa192aa4c44fe.text: 咒语。召唤一个等级 14…20 的冰小恶魔（40…60 寿命），拥有冰刺。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

88d9b8698181ada309330262f1597d9b3bcdc15a.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Mursaat (40…60 lifespan) that has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
88d9b8698181ada309330262f1597d9b3bcdc15a.text: 咒语。召唤一只等级为 14…20 的穆尔萨特（40…60 寿命），拥有精力充沛。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

03181ed6bd8082892611c92870a87ddf0e62fada.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Naga Shaman (40…60 lifespan) that has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
03181ed6bd8082892611c92870a87ddf0e62fada.text: 咒语。召唤一个等级 14…20 的娜迦萨满（40…60 寿命），具有石击能力。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

ef48da690d4d5743364e95fa2629859704c981e0.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ruby Djinn (40…60 lifespan) that has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
ef48da690d4d5743364e95fa2629859704c981e0.text: 咒语。召唤一个具有献祭等级的 14…20 级红宝石巨灵（40…60 寿命）。一次只能激活1个修罗召唤。

b449e3653efbb0432236ce2e706133bf4ab21f4b.source: Spell. Spirits you control Shadow Step to your location and gain 60…100 Health.
b449e3653efbb0432236ce2e706133bf4ab21f4b.text: 咒语。你控制暗影步的灵魂到达你的位置并获得 60…100 点生命值。

d6a4339d9b702e33f881d6fe1e030b5380c31e7c.source: Sword Attack. You attack target foe twice. Unblockable.
d6a4339d9b702e33f881d6fe1e030b5380c31e7c.text: 剑攻击。你攻击目标敌人两次。不可封锁。

51ed7ae124e04464dfb047a9d95acccd884711d8.source: Weapon Spell. (4…9…10 seconds.) Target ally's next 3 attacks inflict Cracked Armor condition (5…17…20 seconds) and have 10% armor penetration.
51ed7ae124e04464dfb047a9d95acccd884711d8.text: 武器咒语。 （4…9…10 秒。）目标盟友接下来的 3 次攻击会造成护甲破裂状态（5…17…20 秒）并具有 10% 护甲穿透力。

6cef78bbffff6138e855dcf1c416c012949a7c46.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…19…23 seconds.) Heals for 5…41…50 whenever target ally takes damage while knocked-down.
6cef78bbffff6138e855dcf1c416c012949a7c46.text: 结界咒语。 （5…19…23 秒。）每当目标盟友在被击倒时受到伤害时，治疗量为 5…41…50。

8e1c64cad9bd456d4d6ea657863eca74d1627c1d.source: Hex Spell. (1…7…8 seconds.) Target foe moves 66% slower. Foes with Cracked Armor have 5…8…9 Health degeneration.
8e1c64cad9bd456d4d6ea657863eca74d1627c1d.text: 降咒魔法。 （1…7…8 秒。）目标敌人移动速度慢 66%。盔甲破裂的敌人生命值下降 5…8…9 点。

f70d921a43e543ef15b3dd68273c1d51f7ab9d2b.source: Spell. Deals 10…34…40 cold damage. Burning foes take +40…72…80 damage and are interrupted. Also strikes adjacent.
f70d921a43e543ef15b3dd68273c1d51f7ab9d2b.text: 咒语。造成 10…34…40 点寒冷伤害。燃烧的敌人受到 +40…72…80 点伤害并被打断。亦击邻近。

875f94acd6abadfa5ce7dd6b8573b23c47d65bee.source: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed and Blindness conditions (1…8…10 seconds). Must follow a lead attack.
875f94acd6abadfa5ce7dd6b8573b23c47d65bee.text: 精英副手攻击。打断一个咒语。造成茫然和失明状态（1…8…10 秒）。必须跟随主导攻击。

ef4bd7c8d7410fe29046fbdf942d702d9ac7337c.source: Touch Spell. Deals 15…63…75 cold damage and removes 1 enchantment. Target foe is Dazed for 2…5…6 seconds if that foe was not enchanted.
ef4bd7c8d7410fe29046fbdf942d702d9ac7337c.text: 触摸咒语。造成 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害并移除 1 点结界。如果目标敌人没有被附魔，则该敌人会茫然 2…5…6 秒。

44e5fa7c29fe35c5c838404f05845ad41a0e1606.source: Melee Attack. Deals +20…36…40 damage. If you have more Health than your target, you gain 1…2…2 adrenaline.
44e5fa7c29fe35c5c838404f05845ad41a0e1606.text: 近战攻击。造成 +20…36…40 点伤害。如果您的生命值高于目标值，您将获得 1…2…2 肾上腺素。

ad705944757f757620aee4393f546372a0dcadc2.source: Touch Skill. Inflicts Blindness condition (3…13…15 seconds). Also affects foes adjacent to target foe.
ad705944757f757620aee4393f546372a0dcadc2.text: 触摸技能。造成失明状态（3…13…15 秒）。也会影响与目标敌人相邻的敌人。

85b972029933403df9cfd3ec1c08fd50d35cdcac.source: Elite Spell. Deals 10…42…50 lightning damage. Also strikes nearby foes. Inflicts Cracked Armor and Weakness (5…17…20 seconds). Causes interrupt. 25% armor penetration.
85b972029933403df9cfd3ec1c08fd50d35cdcac.text: 精英法术。造成 10…42…50 点闪电伤害。 Also strikes nearby foes.造成护甲破裂和虚弱（5…17…20 秒）。造成中断。 25% 护甲穿透。

25fff76f5ec16273ff0a630565c2decb60d144aa.source: Stance. (4…9…10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. Ends if you fail to hit.
25fff76f5ec16273ff0a630565c2decb60d144aa.text: 立场。 （4…9…10秒。）你攻击33%的速度更快。如果未能击中则结束。

9fbffd37fa4e796b9b1d6c5af041fcc8c40bb63e.source: Stance. (5…10…11 seconds.) You attack 25% faster. Disables your non-attack skills (5 seconds).
9fbffd37fa4e796b9b1d6c5af041fcc8c40bb63e.text: 立场。 （5…10…11秒。）你攻击25%的速度更快。 Disables your non-attack skills (5 seconds).

63ef8159cd8b51e91ca3a822cd40d1980f41f771.source: Elite Ward Spell. (6…17…20 seconds.) Allies in this ward cast spells 15…19…20% faster and recharge skills 15…19…20% faster. Allied spirits are not affected. PvE Skill
63ef8159cd8b51e91ca3a822cd40d1980f41f771.text: 精英守卫法术。 （6…17…20 秒。）此病房中的盟友施放法术的速度加快 15…19…20%，恢复技能的速度加快 15…19…20%。 Allied spirits are not affected. PvE技能

ffe93d3cb53cd95e65fa42d8ec1dee3ffd4c34c2.text: 触摸技能。造成 20…50…58 点伤害。

d6904bbff849ce153137be5e9afc6c95c8da655d.source: Elite Spell. Deals 15…63…75 cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (10…22…25 seconds) if target foe is hexed or enchanted.
d6904bbff849ce153137be5e9afc6c95c8da655d.text: 精英法术。造成 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害。如果目标敌人被施咒或附魔，则造成中毒状态（10…22…25秒）。

56a9adbd8b024941505f2cd34ed5e1ef85fe6f7e.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 second lifespan.) Poisoned or Diseased creatures within range have -2 Health degeneration.
56a9adbd8b024941505f2cd34ed5e1ef85fe6f7e.text: 自然仪式。创造出等级 1…8…10 的精魂（30…150…180 秒寿命）。范围内的中毒或患病生物会造成 -2 点生命值退化。

c274aa32e47e5273f02df48499f6d2f2d6fd7bb9.source: Dual Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage; causes knock-down if target foe is Crippled. Must follow an off-hand attack.
c274aa32e47e5273f02df48499f6d2f2d6fd7bb9.text: 双重攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害； causes knock-down if target foe is Crippled.必须跟随副手攻击。

7a3a787f4eb43c5f0fe7ced742218714dc7560ad.source: Elite Item Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) You have +10…22…25 armor. You cannot be interrupted.
7a3a787f4eb43c5f0fe7ced742218714dc7560ad.text: 精英物品法术。 （5…17…20 秒。）你有 +10…22…25 护甲。 You cannot be interrupted.

06f1d2e1b40b9084b582feb8f636e124b344144d.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (15…99…120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 20…44…50% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
06f1d2e1b40b9084b582feb8f636e124b344144d.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命15…99…120）。对于范围内的生物，结界的失效速度会加快 20…44…50%。不影响精神。

e07e3a26922e11a634aac789f0f8422da1d61daf.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (15…99…120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 10…26…30% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
e07e3a26922e11a634aac789f0f8422da1d61daf.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命15…99…120）。对于范围内的生物，结界的失效速度会加快 10…26…30%。不影响精神。

b4e12a046ff8140548f274b338322ed1dbe17f9f.source: Elite Preparation. (12…31…36 seconds.) Your trap skills are no longer easy to interrupt. You gain +0…3…4 to your Wilderness Survival attribute.
b4e12a046ff8140548f274b338322ed1dbe17f9f.text: 精英准备。 （12…31…36秒。）你的陷阱技能不再容易被打断。你的荒野生存属性获得 +0…3…4 点。

2ffda9ea2814daa91d4480c8c58dd41db12e6786.source: Stance. (5…25…30 seconds.) Your traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. Ends if you hit with an attack.
2ffda9ea2814daa91d4480c8c58dd41db12e6786.text: 立场。 （5…25…30 秒。）你的陷阱充电速度更快 25%，激活速度更快 25%。如果你受到攻击就会结束。

891ec1c484af58323957d1003866466bb0c694e6.source: Elite Axe Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage. Also hits adjacent foes.
891ec1c484af58323957d1003866466bb0c694e6.text: 精英斧头攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。也会攻击邻近的敌人。

539aee57ed475c52e50b2aa0b97348ec8741853e.source: Bow Attack. Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40…25% less damage
539aee57ed475c52e50b2aa0b97348ec8741853e.text: 弓攻击。同时向目标敌人发射 3 支箭。 These arrows deal 40…25% less damage

52120e45afb6f51d0e38b58dd25f3af04fd334d9.source: Trap. (90 seconds.) Deals 5…17…20 piercing damage to nearby foes. Causes knock-down to Crippled foes. Easily interrupted.
52120e45afb6f51d0e38b58dd25f3af04fd334d9.text: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）对附近的敌人造成 5…17…20 点穿刺伤害。导致残废敌人被击倒。很容易被打断。

6b300f776641b433ade7623ceb8723bf7d878c58.source: Skill. (13 seconds.) You have +3…9…10 Health regeneration.
6b300f776641b433ade7623ceb8723bf7d878c58.text: 技能。 （13 秒。）你有 +3…9…10 点生命恢复。

a06db449d6f77d7d051c05e96f2033c6d55f4d20.source: Signet. (14…20 seconds.) Target and adjacent foes move and attack 23…40% slower.
a06db449d6f77d7d051c05e96f2033c6d55f4d20.text: 印章。 （14…20 秒。）目标和邻近敌人的移动和攻击速度减慢 23…40%。

ea6dd211e8c967ee3c3fea8566de709153b4f3f3.source: Melee Attack. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Gain 10…42…50 Health. Removal effect: unblockable, attack twice, and gain 10…58…70 more Health.
ea6dd211e8c967ee3c3fea8566de709153b4f3f3.text: 近战攻击。 Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments.获得 10…42…50 生命值。去除效果：不可阻挡，攻击两次，额外获得10…58…70点生命值。

884cf580966a0e6525eb962751ea027830123859.source: Melee Attack. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Gain 10…18…20 Health. Removal effect: Unblockable, attack twice, each strike doing 25% less damage, and gain 10…26…30 more Health.
884cf580966a0e6525eb962751ea027830123859.text: 近战攻击。移除 1 个苦行僧结界。获得 10…18…20 生命值。去除效果：不可阻挡，攻击两次，每次攻击减少 25% 点伤害，并增加 10…26…30 点生命值。

0cade7c4f88707a5b2f81ce53776743e377eb42b.source: Dual Attack. Deals +10…18…20 damage. Inflicts Bleeding and Deep Wound conditions (5…17…20 seconds). Must follow an off-hand attack.
0cade7c4f88707a5b2f81ce53776743e377eb42b.text: 双重攻击。造成 +10…18…20 点伤害。造成流血和深度伤口状况（5…17…20 秒）。必须跟随副手攻击。

3fc0d5e558e957d4ba89ec80f4ec486c0ec50d3d.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (10…26…30 seconds). Causes -4 Health degeneration to any of these foes that are Bleeding. Inflicts Bleeding (5…17…20 seconds) whenever these foes use a shout or chant.
3fc0d5e558e957d4ba89ec80f4ec486c0ec50d3d.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（10…26…30 秒）。对任何正在流血的敌人造成 -4 生命值退化。每当这些敌人使用喊叫或圣歌时，就会造成流血（5…17…20 秒）。

81d094b427e4fe74ebf6f5c8a9ffc5210bd449cc.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +10…34…40 点伤害。不可封锁。

adc67a266f4a170c3b224d483f26d492e3561d85.source: Spell. Steals 10…54…65 Health from 1…3…4 foes in the area around you.
adc67a266f4a170c3b224d483f26d492e3561d85.text: 咒语。从你周围区域的 1…3…4 名敌人身上窃取 10…54…65 点生命值。

76e03a91c2ddc0df23f36c39f8ad6138c400d138.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Whenever a non-spirit ally within range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage.
76e03a91c2ddc0df23f36c39f8ad6138c400d138.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…10…12级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。每当范围内的非精神盟友受到伤害或生命偷取时，减少 15 点，精神受到 15 点伤害。

dfefa0610d8d92d4a506d3d846f1de8891a64fdf.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Whenever a non-spirit ally within range takes damage or life steal, that damage is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage.
dfefa0610d8d92d4a506d3d846f1de8891a64fdf.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出1…7…8级灵体（第二寿命30…54…60）。每当范围内的非精神盟友受到伤害或生命偷取时，该伤害就会减少 15 点，而精神会受到 15 点伤害。

bcbf8de82e001e7da5e7073c5ff1a567359ea15d.source: Signet. Deals 15…63…75 damage. Deals 5…41…50 damage to other adjacent foes if the target is hexed or enchanted.
bcbf8de82e001e7da5e7073c5ff1a567359ea15d.text: 印章。造成 15…63…75 点伤害。如果目标被施咒或附魔，会对其他相邻敌人造成 5…41…50 点伤害。

4734851a71e0a9fca1bff8e43b2a51097f0b7756.source: Signet. Deals 10…50…60 damage. Deals 10…50…60 damage to other adjacent foes if the target is hexed or enchanted. Your non-Mesmer skills except signets are disabled (10 seconds).
4734851a71e0a9fca1bff8e43b2a51097f0b7756.text: 印章。造成 10…50…60 点伤害。如果目标被施咒或附魔，会对其他相邻敌人造成 10…50…60 点伤害。除图章外，你的非幻术师技能将被禁用（10 秒）。

f1f99cf84ffd29a0e0496bd32808617d25de819b.source: Stance. Inflicts Blindness condition on adjacent foes (3…9…10). You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes for 10…26…30 seconds.
f1f99cf84ffd29a0e0496bd32808617d25de819b.text: 立场。对邻近敌人造成失明状态 (3…9…10)。你不能被致盲的敌人阻挡 10…26…30 秒。

4a974b20590c3f931a6003488e8fd232de942989.source: Stance. (15…51…60 seconds.) You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.
4a974b20590c3f931a6003488e8fd232de942989.text: 立场。 （15…51…60 秒。）你无法被致盲的敌人阻挡。

a086a9709d424af2b83bd5836a4b4ef3c2439ca1.source: Elite Spell. Deals 10…34…40 earth damage each second (5 seconds) and causes knock-down to attacking foes. Hits foes near target's initial location.
a086a9709d424af2b83bd5836a4b4ef3c2439ca1.text: 精英法术。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…34…40 点土属性伤害，并对攻击的敌人造成击倒。攻击目标初始位置附近的敌人。

8901a1f9b8cc62f71e176b31d397a4eb9d16741d.source: Lead Attack. Deals +19…29…31 damage. Deals 15…63…75 more damage if target foe's Health is above 90%.
8901a1f9b8cc62f71e176b31d397a4eb9d16741d.text: 引导攻击。造成 +19…29…31 点伤害。如果目标敌人的生命值高于 90%，则额外造成 15…63…75 点伤害。

16ed370984ac42331c6a600ff46ed05b32238224.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Resurrects target party member (full Health, full Energy). End effect: this ally dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Does not incur a death penalty. 50% failure chance unless Divine Favor 5 or more.
16ed370984ac42331c6a600ff46ed05b32238224.text: 精英结界法术。复活目标队员（生命值满、能量满）。最终效果：该盟友死亡并留下一具被剥削的尸体。不会判处死刑。 50% 失败几率除非神恩 5 或更多。

872f2002e9c6654234f85a5302f9ba2dd011c3f7.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills, and you have 100 armor and 750…790…800 Health.
872f2002e9c6654234f85a5302f9ba2dd011c3f7.text: 精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现出熊的样子（60 秒）。你的所有属性都设置为 0，熊攻击取代了你的技能，你有 100 护甲和 750…790…800 生命值。

0f0e1440dd86f7d531660a09394e1a4f85d58fd1.source: Dual Attack. Steals 10…34…40 Health if this attack hits. Must follow an off-hand attack.
0f0e1440dd86f7d531660a09394e1a4f85d58fd1.text: 双重攻击。如果这次攻击命中，窃取 10…34…40 点生命值。必须跟随副手攻击。

51367e9918701e5f398547209790d3a78e8317b3.text: 触摸技能。窃取 29…65…74 点生命值。

1418e9b7e27b7dff983c1c9e94827530052db35a.text: 咒语。窃取 18…52…60 点生命值。

369a49a90cf4481bc0453eb4bab9256bbe2e48df.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Steal 15…51…60 Health from target foe. You have +5…9…10 Health regeneration (10 seconds).
369a49a90cf4481bc0453eb4bab9256bbe2e48df.text: 精英结界法术。从目标敌人身上窃取 15…51…60 点生命值。你有 +5…9…10 点生命恢复（10 秒）。

e59f175ffe27603307731b19c450211fd22ad2f0.source: Spell. Steals 15…51…60 Health. Hits 2 additional foes in the area.
e59f175ffe27603307731b19c450211fd22ad2f0.text: 咒语。窃取 15…51…60 点生命值。击中该区域内的 2 个额外敌人。

d0d194f351e957a557936880a3bb531dc0500a3b.source: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 4…14 spirit (lifespan 75…150 seconds). Its attacks steal 10…20 Health, and you are healed for 10…20.
d0d194f351e957a557936880a3bb531dc0500a3b.text: 缚灵仪式。创造出等级4…14级的武魂（寿命75…150秒）。它的攻击会窃取 10…20 点生命值，并且你会得到 10…20 点生命值的治疗。

4d79c19b61aded254e778c4609c99d364fa51bfa.source: Spell. Deals 15…111…135 cold damage. Half damage if target foe is enchanted.
4d79c19b61aded254e778c4609c99d364fa51bfa.text: 咒语。造成 15…111…135 点寒冷伤害。如果目标敌人被附魔，伤害减半。

e48b03ae0b1e8bc04c6392f654ed74ab6e2f3a1b.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (5…21…25 seconds.) Spell damage is reduced by 5…29…35%. Initial Effect: nearby foes are struck for 5…41…50 piercing damage.
e48b03ae0b1e8bc04c6392f654ed74ab6e2f3a1b.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （5…21…25 秒。）法术伤害减少 5…29…35% 点。初始效果：附近的敌人受到 5…41…50 点穿刺伤害。

ef6cada13d0f9fd2add730fa550e329b1642b327.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Resurrects target party member (full Health, full Energy). This ally deals 25% more damage and does not incur death penalty. End effect: this ally dies.
ef6cada13d0f9fd2add730fa550e329b1642b327.text: 结界咒语。 （30 秒。）复活目标队员（生命值满、能量满）。该盟友额外造成 25% 点伤害并且不会受到死刑。最终效果：该盟友死亡。

2201355404383136f8eb33fdf975d4c41c0d8057.source: Elite Item Spell. (5…10…11 seconds.) You steal 10…38…45 Health from every foe that hits you with an attack.
2201355404383136f8eb33fdf975d4c41c0d8057.text: 精英物品法术。 （5…10…11 秒。）你从每一个攻击你的敌人身上窃取 10…38…45 点生命值。

ebc07dccba0608a5d92118e67362dd64f56368e4.source: Weapon Spell. (8 seconds.) Steals 15…51…60 Health from the next foe that deals damage or life steal to target ally.
ebc07dccba0608a5d92118e67362dd64f56368e4.text: 武器咒语。 （8 秒。）从下一个敌人身上窃取 15…51…60 点生命值，对目标盟友造成伤害或生命窃取。

c0ef4b8609fdf0aee86a668064e67f947a61ebef.source: Enchantment Spell. (120…264…300 seconds.) Become master of all hostile undead servants in the area. End effect: your undead servants become masterless. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.
c0ef4b8609fdf0aee86a668064e67f947a61ebef.text: 结界咒语。 （120…264…300 秒。）成为该地区所有敌对不死仆从的主人。最终效果：你的不死仆从变得无主。 50% 失败几率除非死亡魔法 5 或更多。

7890ed8845a74098fb92452a5cb4b89d54f8341f.source: Spell. Make target undead servant masterless. If it is already masterless, you become its master and heal it for 60…76…80. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.
7890ed8845a74098fb92452a5cb4b89d54f8341f.text: 咒语。使目标不死仆人失去主人。如果它已经无主，你就成为它的主人并治愈它 60…76…80。 50% 失败机会，除非死亡魔法 5 或更多。

b3afba3efed722ad956b738c90dbe9d290872455.source: Spell. (5…9…10 seconds.) 10 undead allied servants gain +10 Health regeneration. Instantly recharges if you have control of 3 or fewer servants. Transfers all conditions from those servants to you.
b3afba3efed722ad956b738c90dbe9d290872455.text: 咒语。 （5…9…10 秒。）10 名不死盟友仆人获得 +10 点生命再生。如果您控制 3 个或更少的仆人，则立即充值。将所有条件从那些仆人转移给你。

516e763db730a9a758ece0ad1110bef72add530b.source: Spear Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…13…15 seconds) with a critical hit.
516e763db730a9a758ece0ad1110bef72add530b.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。致命一击造成深度伤口状态（5…13…15 秒）。

bcfcdf893840f7f1097b61374f86cd7d15b44aa5.source: Spell. You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's locations.
bcfcdf893840f7f1097b61374f86cd7d15b44aa5.text: 咒文。你和目标召唤生物暗影步到达对方的位置。

f8580114a65601adb91593ceec5d80eaa0b495f8.source: Axe Attack. Deals +1…16…20 damage. Deals 1…16…20 damage and inflicts Deep Wound condition (20 seconds) if blocked.
f8580114a65601adb91593ceec5d80eaa0b495f8.text: 斧头攻击。造成 +1…16…20 点伤害。如果被阻挡，会造成 1…16…20 点伤害并造成深度伤口状态（20 秒）。

ac64304dd56b5040a5e75c42c162507803ce7fa0.source: Spear Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. This spear moves twice as fast and is unblockable if you are enchanted.
ac64304dd56b5040a5e75c42c162507803ce7fa0.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。这把矛的移动速度是原来的两倍，并且如果你被附魔的话，它是不可阻挡的。

8e01c941542d28efce36511895b71934c6936fa8.source: Enchantment Spell. (3…6…7 seconds.) Gives 1…5…6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If Overcast, also enchants party members in earshot.
8e01c941542d28efce36511895b71934c6936fa8.text: 结界咒语。 （3…6…7 秒。）提供 1…5…6 点生命恢复和 50% 次阻挡射弹的机会。如果是阴天，也会让耳边的队友着迷。

5bf7a123fa2515157c61613e4f168633fbb057c0.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Creatures in range have +27…125…150 maximum health for each enchantment on them. Does not affect spirits.
5bf7a123fa2515157c61613e4f168633fbb057c0.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。范围内的生物的每个结界都有 +27…125…150 最大生命值。不影响精神。

62b363230954b6eb3aaa48b7a291bcd388bb78ac.source: Shout. (120…264…300 seconds.) Your pet has +1…3…3 Health regeneration. Half of all damage dealt to your pet is redirected to you.
62b363230954b6eb3aaa48b7a291bcd388bb78ac.text: 喊叫。 （120…264…300 秒。）你的宠物恢复了 +1…3…3 点生命值。对你的宠物造成的所有伤害的一半会转移到你身上。

bc341532e7a129a026b9438250618dd86402c1d4.source: Spell. Deals 10…34…40 holy damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.
bc341532e7a129a026b9438250618dd86402c1d4.text: 咒语。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…34…40 点神圣伤害。击中目标敌人初始位置附近的敌人。

e5c7bfb855a6fb2dc38a1a4a9e4b470b540d019e.source: Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) Your signets use your Fast Casting attribute.
e5c7bfb855a6fb2dc38a1a4a9e4b470b540d019e.text: 结界咒语。 （36…55…60 秒。）您的图章使用您的快速施法属性。

75404a481dc850bbdc17f20d929fcbed9d9323fc.source: Stance. (5…17…20 seconds.) Your next signet recharges 20…68…80% faster.
75404a481dc850bbdc17f20d929fcbed9d9323fc.text: 立场。 （5…17…20 秒。）您的下一个印章充电速度会更快 20…68…80%。

f5241baaed5c5204998d9dc7c4110d2a038e31a5.source: Melee Attack. Deals +12 damage (maximum 70) for each signet you have equipped.
f5241baaed5c5204998d9dc7c4110d2a038e31a5.text: 近战攻击。您装备的每个图章都会造成 +12 点伤害（最多 70 点）。

ba0a53ca4ae8943ef4a22bdc1b70acd265c1723e.source: Elite Skill. (6…33…40 seconds.) This skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
ba0a53ca4ae8943ef4a22bdc1b70acd265c1723e.text: 精英技能。 （6…33…40秒。）该技能成为目标敌人的精英。您施放的精英技能使用您的快速施法属性而不是普通属性。

fe4977ff29bc7bd871c4853feeb0ef7f887bef6e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (20…39…44 seconds.) Foes who hit allies in the area in melee become Diseased (3…13…15 seconds); this ally is immune to Disease.
fe4977ff29bc7bd871c4853feeb0ef7f887bef6e.text: 精英结界法术。 （20…39…44 秒。）在近战中击中该区域盟友的敌人会变得患病（3…13…15 秒）；该盟友对疾病免疫。

e3d23e22c84f79678f4de62db9eaf270067d0745.source: Spell. Steals 100…340…400 Health from allied undead servant.
e3d23e22c84f79678f4de62db9eaf270067d0745.text: 咒语。从盟军不死仆从那里窃取 100…340…400 点生命值。

1958dde0a1a6d2d02499151d12f2ef2e2b77b6f8.source: Spell. Heals you for 30…126…150. No effect unless target foe is below 50% Health.
1958dde0a1a6d2d02499151d12f2ef2e2b77b6f8.text: 咒语。治疗你 30…126…150 点。除非目标敌人生命值低于 50% 点，否则没有效果。

6a480efe66b0edaf6f3e03821a3c2b124ffa1636.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: also interrupts other foes in the area, and you steal 0…4…5 Energy from all foes in the area.
6a480efe66b0edaf6f3e03821a3c2b124ffa1636.text: 精英法术。打断技能。打断效果：同时打断区域内的其他敌人，并窃取区域内所有敌人 0…4…5 点能量。

379925231478e168d8e1b8e2844b7f16e8eeb3f5.source: Spell. Deals 30…40 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Dazed condition (3…5 seconds) on these foes if target was not a boss.
379925231478e168d8e1b8e2844b7f16e8eeb3f5.text: 咒语。对目标和邻近敌人造成 30…40 点伤害。如果目标不是 Boss，则对这些敌人造成茫然状态（3…5 秒）。

d42fa413ca805eee136a24beada2bd0c49b6aa40.source: Spell. Deals 20…36…40 damage to target. Deals +20…36…40 more Descriptions usually don't display '+ [number] more damage'. It's either '+ [number] damage' or '[number] more damage'. damage and causes Cracked Armor (5…13…15 seconds) nearby if that foe had a Water Magic hex.
d42fa413ca805eee136a24beada2bd0c49b6aa40.text: 咒语。对目标造成 20…36…40 点伤害。额外造成 +20…36…40 点描述通常不会显示“+ [number] 更多伤害”。要么是“+ [number] 伤害”，要么是“[number] 更多伤害”。如果该敌人拥有水魔法咒语，则在附近造成伤害并造成护甲破裂（5…13…15 秒）。

396e4b742f533f1809d8505d9aa0541c1765164b.source: Ward Spell. (10…14…15 seconds.) Causes -2…4…5 health degeneration. Weakened foes in the ward attack 33% slower. Disabled for 20 seconds.
396e4b742f533f1809d8505d9aa0541c1765164b.text: 守卫咒语。 （10…14…15 秒。）导致 -2…4…5 健康退化。被削弱的守卫内的敌人攻击速度变慢33%。禁用 20 秒。

84c8be96ce7d22f3e93856783e14d1bce69f12eb.source: Melee Attack. Deals +5…21…25 damage. You gain 30…70…80 Health for each foe you hit that has less Health than you.
84c8be96ce7d22f3e93856783e14d1bce69f12eb.text: 近战攻击。造成 +5…21…25 点伤害。每击中一个生命值比你少的敌人，你就会获得 30…70…80 点生命值。

0d9f6bdf4c8cd6777f845bc82a5b559d595ecfca.source: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Heals for 5…17…20 each time target ally attacks or casts a spell.
0d9f6bdf4c8cd6777f845bc82a5b559d595ecfca.text: 结界咒语。 （30 秒。）每次目标盟友攻击或施法时，治疗量为 5…17…20。

dcf3b3c329922feea068d426f2667fa86d5db3d8.source: Hex Spell. Causes -1…4…5 Health degeneration (10 seconds). Initial effect: deals 10…54…65 cold damage. Hex is only applied if target foe has a condition.
dcf3b3c329922feea068d426f2667fa86d5db3d8.text: 降咒魔法。导致 -1…4…5 生命值退化（10 秒）。初始效果：造成10…54…65点寒冷伤害。仅当目标敌人有条件时才应用降咒。

93be85d0bae56b6708bc3bfb629771921ad50eba.text: 触摸技能。造成 20…56…65 点伤害。

a72eea96c4aff5550ee014ce8650cc313331211f.source: Spell. Inflict Poisoned condition (5…17…20 seconds) on all adjacent foes and Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
a72eea96c4aff5550ee014ce8650cc313331211f.text: 咒语。对所有邻近的敌人造成中毒状态（5…17…20 秒），并使用暗影步到直接远离目标的附近位置。

f503a64159fd5b8c915cdc46cfbdd9c66d98d37c.source: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 5…29…35 piercing damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5…17…20 seconds). Easily interrupted.
f503a64159fd5b8c915cdc46cfbdd9c66d98d37c.text: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影响附近的敌人。造成 5…29…35 点穿刺伤害。造成中毒状态（5…17…20 秒）。很容易被打断。

97eaf617cd12c6550f9d1b3f866fe6a84f2cca5b.source: Elite Spell. Inflicts Disease, Poison, and Weakness conditions (3…13…15 seconds). No effect unless this foe already had a condition.
97eaf617cd12c6550f9d1b3f866fe6a84f2cca5b.text: 精英法术。造成疾病、中毒和虚弱状态（3…13…15 秒）。除非这个敌人已经患有某种疾病，否则没有效果。

cfd7f5001c062a835e3dfcce2060ab0499b7c5a3.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 15…39…45 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…41…50 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
cfd7f5001c062a835e3dfcce2060ab0499b7c5a3.text: 精英六角咒语。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（10 秒）。这些敌人在使用技能时会受到 15…39…45 点伤害，如果没有受到另一个幻术师咒语的影响，则会受到 5…41…50 点额外伤害。

67a5465e3f7b5da132ed8b82446cd4fd3c8fb184.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 10…26…30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…33…40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
67a5465e3f7b5da132ed8b82446cd4fd3c8fb184.text: 精英六角咒语。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（10 秒）。这些敌人每次使用技能时都会受到 10…26…30 点伤害，如果没有受到另一个幻术师六角形的影响，则会受到 5…33…40 点额外伤害。

7f3a883a825551cfdb2b901c0c4f7a34fa55e6ed.text: 结界咒语。 +40…168…200 最大生命值。

9f3662cf8f6eee7471ad87376ffa63645a71c0b5.source: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) You have +40…88…100 maximum Health. End effect: Heals you for 75…175…200.
9f3662cf8f6eee7471ad87376ffa63645a71c0b5.text: 结界咒语。 （20 秒。）您的最大生命值为 +40…88…100。最终效果：治愈你 75…175…200 点。

1d0ef30b13f6be715a509a2a4f14cd8fc407dea1.source: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near target (5…17…20 seconds). These foes cannot use shouts or chants.
1d0ef30b13f6be715a509a2a4f14cd8fc407dea1.text: 降咒魔法。还会对目标附近的敌人施咒（5…17…20 秒）。这些敌人不能使用喊叫或口号。

e55485d762ef1eb2f50906fa0ae2f9422c2b2f6f.source: Item Spell. (60 seconds.) Shouts and chants you use last 20…44…50% longer.
e55485d762ef1eb2f50906fa0ae2f9422c2b2f6f.text: 物品法术。 （60 秒。）您使用的呼喊和口号可以持续 20…44…50% 更长的时间。

d50f1636164bcec767327d4483180a6cdc75a581.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health and 2…4 Health regeneration.
d50f1636164bcec767327d4483180a6cdc75a581.text: 精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现出狼的样子（60 秒）。你的所有属性都设置为0，狼攻击取代了你的技能，你有80护甲，660…700生命值和2…4生命恢复。

aade87d530e33022f90e3924e80a8ab55d9e3f63.source: Bow Attack. Deals +1…8…10 damage. Hits up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. All your preparations are removed.
aade87d530e33022f90e3924e80a8ab55d9e3f63.text: 弓攻击。造成 +1…8…10 点伤害。最多可击中目标附近的 3 个敌人。你所有的准备工作都被删除了。

cc720e20746d66be982ec0d5096260d12f7f2fb3.source: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds) +24 armor and +1…3…4 Health regeneration. Renewal: Whenever an enchantment on you ends.
cc720e20746d66be982ec0d5096260d12f7f2fb3.text: 结界咒语。 （20 秒）+24 护甲和 +1…3…4 生命恢复。更新：每当你身上的结界结束时。

68b7bfde1825d127eb7203c2e20269f07068d23e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3…9…10 seconds.) Gain +1…5…6 energy regeneration. Renewal: whenever you use a non-Dervish skill. PvE Skill
68b7bfde1825d127eb7203c2e20269f07068d23e.text: 精英结界法术。 （3…9…10秒。）获得+1…5…6能量再生。更新：每当您使用非苦行僧技能时。 PvE技能

f3f02d317b36e4e72b9674c4149e4c6101e085d1.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…9…10 seconds.) Spells cannot target you. You cannot cast spells.
f3f02d317b36e4e72b9674c4149e4c6101e085d1.text: 精英结界法术。 （5…9…10 秒。）法术不能以你为目标。你不能施展法术。

c1b4e42adff223454d544b1d764c54779660ea65.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (15 seconds.) When you attack with a scythe, deals 10…22…25 slashing damage to adjacent foes.
c1b4e42adff223454d544b1d764c54779660ea65.text: 精英结界法术。 （15 秒。）当你用镰刀攻击时，对相邻敌人造成 10…22…25 点切割伤害。

69aaa7fec5c74663b6e542cc69333f926831e397.source: Elite Hex Spell. (2…5…6 seconds.) Target foe's attributes are 0.
69aaa7fec5c74663b6e542cc69333f926831e397.text: 精英六角咒语。 （2…5…6秒。）目标敌人的属性为0。

5c9a7a72f7c84bbb461fef2960a94bca1a07158f.source: Weapon Spell. (3…12…14 seconds.) Attacks interrupt attacking foes.
5c9a7a72f7c84bbb461fef2960a94bca1a07158f.text: 武器咒语。 （3…12…14 秒。）攻击打断敌人的攻击。

d0edb0bb775307032a05ff140be8a27b4580e231.source: Hex Spell. (4 seconds.) Interrupts target foe's next attack. Interruption effect: 30…94…110 damage to nearby foes.
d0edb0bb775307032a05ff140be8a27b4580e231.text: 降咒魔法。 （4 秒。）打断目标敌人的下一次攻击。打断效果：对附近敌人造成30…94…110点伤害。

99d9957fe51fa0a4cf7ad3be45ca4b78add9685e.source: Hex Spell. (4 seconds.) Interrupts target foe's next attack. Interruption effect: 10…76…92 damage to nearby foes.
99d9957fe51fa0a4cf7ad3be45ca4b78add9685e.text: 降咒魔法。 （4 秒。）打断目标敌人的下一次攻击。打断效果：对附近敌人造成10…76…92点伤害。

c10734ba279ae256e3c812a6ac34d0b22bf244fa.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…10…12 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Its attacks against stationary foes cause knock-down. Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 70…54…50 Health.

6c567a9732cb8d4642d9c5764b9c2575f1b86e91.text: 好吧，拼写。 （8…18…20秒。）这口井中的敌人会失去所有结界，并且不能成为进一步结界的目标。利用新鲜尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值。 50% 失败几率除非死亡魔法 5 或更多。

d568f40bff9eb61abbdcc9dcc8e03ebb84c862e9.source: Well Spell. (10…46…55 seconds.) Foes in this well have -1 Energy degeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.
d568f40bff9eb61abbdcc9dcc8e03ebb84c862e9.text: 好吧，拼写。 （10…46…55 秒。）这口井中的敌人有 -1 点能量退化。利用新鲜尸体或牺牲 66% 点生命值。

226eeabd9c9ebecc25d5dad23a56f71e1ad96302.source: Elite Axe Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage and removes a stance. Unblockable.
226eeabd9c9ebecc25d5dad23a56f71e1ad96302.text: 精英斧头攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害并移除姿态。不可封锁。

3c15b43775e10ee73a046f3fbd59be604537dbeb.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1…5…6 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Deal 10…50…60 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.
3c15b43775e10ee73a046f3fbd59be604537dbeb.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （1…5…6 秒。）你移动速度加快了 33%。下次你击中敌人时，会对附近所有其他敌人造成 10…50…60 点冰冷伤害，并且此结界结束。

56c1862fa535f335cd0cad718cd8ffb8dfd28a6d.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1…5…6 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Deal 10…42…50 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.
56c1862fa535f335cd0cad718cd8ffb8dfd28a6d.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （1…5…6 秒。）你移动速度加快了 33%。下次你击中敌人时，会对附近所有其他敌人造成 10…42…50 点冰冷伤害，并且此结界结束。

aaad9884ad41b0888e74a08e9912a324fb9a1b9c.source: Stance. (8…18…20 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. Deals 5…10…11 damage to adjacent foes whenever you block a projectile attack.
aaad9884ad41b0888e74a08e9912a324fb9a1b9c.text: 立场。 （8…18…20 秒。）你有 75% 次格挡机会。每当你格挡射弹攻击时，就会对邻近的敌人造成 5…10…11 点伤害。

0a5af9edc18bbc0f4690ed9e9089d82d383fbe20.source: Spell. Hits foes adjacent to you. Deals 15…63…75 cold damage. Causes knock-down to attacking foes. Strikes nearby instead of adjacent if Overcast.
0a5af9edc18bbc0f4690ed9e9089d82d383fbe20.text: 咒语。攻击与你相邻的敌人。造成 15…63…75 点寒冷伤害。造成攻击敌人的击倒。如果阴天，则攻击附近而不是邻近。

3e8c0e92839092160a535b0da7c3c1496521bc1a.source: Melee Attack. Deals +13…20 damage to target and adjacent foes.
3e8c0e92839092160a535b0da7c3c1496521bc1a.text: 近战攻击。对目标和邻近敌人造成 +13…20 点伤害。

af36f79b806b7c98c3471d722348969f8d2e12d4.source: Spell. Heals for 15…51…60. Heals for 15…63…75 more if this ally is under a Weapon spell.
af36f79b806b7c98c3471d722348969f8d2e12d4.text: 咒语。治疗 15…51…60 点。如果该盟友处于武器法术下，则可额外治疗 15…63…75 点。

a1ecd6d1909ab50ba480d125139dd1ec7bc11a19.source: Enchantment Spell. (10…26…30 seconds.) Whenever you cast a weapon spell, the targeted ally loses two conditions.
a1ecd6d1909ab50ba480d125139dd1ec7bc11a19.text: 结界咒语。 （10…26…30 秒。）每当你施展武器法术时，目标盟友都会失去两个条件。

5dd8728704de6831190f15176f47b66a4e1f7faf.source: Spell. Deals 10…50…60 lightning damage. Deals 10…42…50 more lightning damage if you are under a weapon spell.
5dd8728704de6831190f15176f47b66a4e1f7faf.text: 咒语。造成 10…50…60 点闪电伤害。如果您处于武器法术下，则额外造成 10…42…50 点闪电伤害。

bbe579f7f2862b19d45fe509746d6272d3fd20a2.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10…34…40 seconds.) You gain 1…4…5 Energy whenever you cast a weapon spell.
bbe579f7f2862b19d45fe509746d6272d3fd20a2.text: 精英结界法术。 （10…34…40 秒。）每当你施展武器法术时，你都会获得 1…4…5 点能量。

acf403b10853e5d45a3f4d63242904012a92d96c.source: Melee Attack. Always a critical hit. Removes a stance. Unblockable. Lose all adrenaline.
acf403b10853e5d45a3f4d63242904012a92d96c.text: 近战攻击。总是致命一击。移除一个立场。不可封锁。失去所有肾上腺素。

ceb2ffec5db41cb7e12580ecc06fba1d3c753531.source: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10…30…35 damage. Removes target foe's stance. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.
ceb2ffec5db41cb7e12580ecc06fba1d3c753531.text: 副手攻击。造成 +10…30…35 点伤害。移除目标敌人的姿态。不可封锁。必须跟随主导攻击。

a08e287c462e2467f2852636f367e5ebd20a1547.source: Spear Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. Unblockable. Ends target's stance.Disables No space between the period and "Disables" your non-spear attack skills for 3 seconds.
a08e287c462e2467f2852636f367e5ebd20a1547.text: 长矛攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。不可封锁。结束目标的姿态。禁用句点之间没有空格，并“禁用”你的非矛攻击技能 3 秒。

55564929fde2cd44f855ef92521b86d41e9c54ad.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…11…13 seconds.) Target ally moves 33% faster.
55564929fde2cd44f855ef92521b86d41e9c54ad.text: 结界咒语。 （5…11…13 秒。）目标盟友移动速度加快 33%。

83badac416d997073356b44cc21df6f29d6d627b.source: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Creates a level 4…10 spirit (54…90 second lifespan.) Affects foes within range. 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks.
83badac416d997073356b44cc21df6f29d6d627b.text: 黑檀先锋仪式。产生等级 4…10 的精魂（54…90 秒寿命）。影响范围内的敌人。远程攻击有 15% 次失手机会。

18997bfcbec2c068b752c9ad185e8e2ae89db836.source: Spell. Remove one of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20…68…80 cold damage.
18997bfcbec2c068b752c9ad185e8e2ae89db836.text: 咒语。移除你的一项苦行僧结界。移除效果：附近所有敌人失去 1 点结界并受到 20…68…80 点冰冷伤害。

f6a26b18e7daa4d35f8cee7bde3b5a00c89f47d0.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Increases physical damage by +4 for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
f6a26b18e7daa4d35f8cee7bde3b5a00c89f47d0.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。对范围内的生物增加 +4 点物理伤害。不影响精神。

8490cd80895a71e86b94b64149914f508da84495.source: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Converts elemental damage to cold damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.
8490cd80895a71e86b94b64149914f508da84495.text: 自然仪式。创造出1…8…10级灵体（第二寿命30…198…240）。对范围内的生物将元素伤害转化为寒冷伤害。不影响精神。

d3460d0a300bcc351080eebb248defa51e3d30ad.source: Hex Spell. (2…5…6 seconds.) Target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5…13…15 damage while moving.
d3460d0a300bcc351080eebb248defa51e3d30ad.text: 降咒魔法。 （2…5…6 秒。）目标敌人移动速度减慢 66% 并在移动时受到 5…13…15 点伤害。

fc6668ca35e3bf0bc9e83edb5ee0e8f49e63a7d0.source: Elite Spell. Removes all hexes. Also affects adjacent allies. Removal cost: +2 seconds recharge for each hex removed. 50% failure chance unless Divine Favor 5 or more.
fc6668ca35e3bf0bc9e83edb5ee0e8f49e63a7d0.text: 精英法术。删除所有六角形。也会影响邻近的盟友。移除成本：移除每个六角形需要 +2 秒充电。 50% 失败几率除非神恩 5 或更多。

bd80420fb2a0e9ad84187dc4525af9dff3a3bffc.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5…29…35 seconds.) Causes -2…4…4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. Deals 15…63…75 damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.
bd80420fb2a0e9ad84187dc4525af9dff3a3bffc.text: 精英六角咒语。 （5…29…35 秒。）导致 -2…4…4 健康退化和 -1 能量退化。如果目标敌人的能量降至 0，则造成 15…63…75 点伤害。如果该敌人的能量降至 0，则结束。

06bfeeb9f0466bc94f1cd9ed2155d70f79418abd.source: Enchantment Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds.)
06bfeeb9f0466bc94f1cd9ed2155d70f79418abd.text: 结界咒语。 （5…17…20秒。）目标盟友的近战攻击导致虚弱状态（5…17…20秒。）

40af7e1cc38bbbeddf00167bcd5839c973777a81.source: Elite Spell. Deals 30…110…130 holy damage. +20 recharge time if target foe is below 50% Health.
40af7e1cc38bbbeddf00167bcd5839c973777a81.text: 精英法术。造成 30…110…130 点神圣伤害。如果目标敌人生命值低于 50%，则需要 +20 充能时间。

12fc0921309e7a29f980424a6897ab45ac0207da.source: Elite Spell. Heals for 5…81…100. Heals for 30…98…115 more if target ally is below 50% Health.
12fc0921309e7a29f980424a6897ab45ac0207da.text: 精英法术。治疗 5…81…100 点。如果目标盟友生命值低于 50% 点，则可额外治疗 30…98…115 点。

a72dfdde87132909b0cebdcf1be52477d748a774.source: Spell. Heals for 20…56…65. Heals for 20…44…50 more if target ally has a condition.
a72dfdde87132909b0cebdcf1be52477d748a774.text: 咒语。治疗 20…56…65 点。如果目标盟友有病症，则可额外治疗 20…44…50 点。

324f17f41eab6b50b5003201a4a713293b5bc881.source: Elite Scythe Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5…17…20 seconds). Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).
324f17f41eab6b50b5003201a4a713293b5bc881.text: 精英镰刀攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害并造成流血状态（5…17…20 秒）。移除 1 苦行僧结界。移除效果：造成深度伤口状态（5…17…20秒）。

87030dc8ef6ce157158cf705544c7dcaf8e4b9ba.source: Elite Scythe Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…17…20 seconds). Removes 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).
87030dc8ef6ce157158cf705544c7dcaf8e4b9ba.text: 精英镰刀攻击。造成流血状态（5…17…20 秒）。移除 1 苦行僧结界。去除效果：造成深度伤口状态（5…17…20秒）。

552a5a3c7ce1cca02cc10633649695ade0c505c1.source: Elite Weapon Spell. (8 seconds). The next time target ally takes damage from a foe, that damage is limited to 5% of target ally's max Health and that ally steals 20…68…80 Health from that foe.
552a5a3c7ce1cca02cc10633649695ade0c505c1.text: 精英武器法术。 （8 秒）。下次目标盟友受到敌人伤害时，该伤害将限制为目标盟友最大生命值的 5% 点，并且该盟友会从该敌人那里窃取 20…68…80 点生命值。

8bec22bb5ff781480ff80ddd915b208256f8c32b.source: Hammer Attack. Attack all adjacent foes. Knocks down foes suffering from a condition. You lose all adrenaline. 50% failure chance unless Hammer Mastery is 5 or more.
8bec22bb5ff781480ff80ddd915b208256f8c32b.text: 锤子攻击。攻击所有邻近的敌人。击倒患有某种疾病的敌人。你失去了所有的肾上腺素。 50% 失败几率，除非锤子精通达到 5 或更高。

30f0764c06f7f12a6065a0f5a33fff36665400ec.source: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Whenever you use a skill on an ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are hit for 5…29…35 fire damage. Damage cost: you lose 1 Energy.
30f0764c06f7f12a6065a0f5a33fff36665400ec.text: 结界咒语。 （60 秒。）每当你对盟友使用技能时，该盟友附近的所有敌人都会受到 5…29…35 点火焰伤害。伤害成本：你损失 1 点能量。

7d6581ef90f8452aef580248674a6dbe687b9405.source: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1…7…8 Energy with their next attack skill.
7d6581ef90f8452aef580248674a6dbe687b9405.text: 吟诵。 （10 秒。）听力范围内的盟友通过下一个攻击技能获得 1…7…8 能量。

baf9cb054f51f9fdf7662cb499ab8b22ac4eb696.source: Elite Spell. Heals for 30…150…180. You gain 7 Energy if target ally was below 50% Health.
baf9cb054f51f9fdf7662cb499ab8b22ac4eb696.text: 精英法术。治疗 30…150…180 点。如果目标盟友生命值低于 50% 点，您将获得 7 点能量。

49d004de5d778065eb5f6af85eb231ac35399253.source: Flash Enchantment Spell. (5…21…25 seconds.) Initial effect: deals 5…25…30 holy damage to nearby foes. You have -1 Energy regeneration and gain 1 Energy when you hit. Gain 1…4…5 Energy if this enchantment ends early.
49d004de5d778065eb5f6af85eb231ac35399253.text: 闪光附魔咒语。 （5…21…25秒。）初始效果：对附近的敌人造成5…25…30点神圣伤害。你有 -1 点能量再生，击中时获得 1 点能量。如果此结界提前结束，则获得 1…4…5 能量。

38d529b181dfa5f9274629747a082cee6d478ad4.source: Scythe Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. You gain 3 Energy and 1 adrenaline for each foe you hit.
38d529b181dfa5f9274629747a082cee6d478ad4.text: 镰刀攻击。造成 +5…17…20 点伤害。每击中一个敌人，你就会获得 3 点能量和 1 点肾上腺素。

87892e57182b178944d7e8bf60125f64cf03b0d6.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) You gain 1…5…6 Energy each time you hit with an attack. You have -2 Energy regeneration.
87892e57182b178944d7e8bf60125f64cf03b0d6.text: 精英结界法术。 （20 秒。）每次攻击击中时，你都会获得 1…5…6 点能量。你有 -2 点能量再生。

1e181ddbcd238ee5dc8231080afe32a03d4abd5a.source: Stance. (5…10…11 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 27…65…75% chance to block projectiles. Ends if you attack.
1e181ddbcd238ee5dc8231080afe32a03d4abd5a.text: 立场。 （5…10…11 秒。）你移动速度加快 33%，并且有 27…65…75% 机会阻挡射弹。如果你攻击就结束。

3e2700905299d72f999e0ae3b4eb22e4205295e3.source: Shout. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, the next time target other ally would be knocked down, all nearby foes take [[MO:growth:0:var2]] damage instead.
3e2700905299d72f999e0ae3b4eb22e4205295e3.text: 喊叫。在 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒内，下一次目标其他盟友被击倒时，所有附近的敌人都会受到 [[MO:growth:0:var2]] 点伤害。

f578f0e2be5a8a3500a209219c555a8755f4db97.source: Shout. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, the next time target other ally would be knocked down, 1 nearby foe takes 15…75…90 damage instead.
f578f0e2be5a8a3500a209219c555a8755f4db97.text: 喊叫。在 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒内，下次目标其他盟友被击倒时，附近的 1 名敌人会受到 15…75…90 点伤害。

e65214a546506763e45ce573e0ee7eadaaca3062.source: Shout. For 30 seconds, all dead party members in earshot are resurrected with full Health and Energy. Resurrected party members deal [[MO:growth:0:var1]] % more damage. When this effect ends, affected party members die. This skill does not incur a death penalty.
e65214a546506763e45ce573e0ee7eadaaca3062.text: 喊叫。在 30 秒内，所有在听力范围内死亡的队员都会复活并充满生命值和能量。复活的队员造成的伤害增加 [[MO:growth:0:var1]]%。当该效果结束时，受影响的队伍成员就会死亡。该技能不会导致死刑。

4b9438df16853050792742d8459dcf70bb7acffc.source: Shout. For 20 seconds, the next [[MO:growth:0:var1]] touch skills used against allies within earshot fails.
4b9438df16853050792742d8459dcf70bb7acffc.text: 喊叫。在 20 秒内，对听力范围内的盟友使用的下一个 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 接触技能会失败。

66b9a9c6a7fe561c5c49785624fafbe7fb7c7553.source: Shout. For 20 seconds, the next [[MO:growth:0:var1]] touch skills used against you fails.
66b9a9c6a7fe561c5c49785624fafbe7fb7c7553.text: 喊叫。在 20 秒内，接下来对你使用的 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 接触技能会失败。

acf18dc432ee2c56bc5576d6b75b094586edee5f.source: Elite Shout. Allies in earshot lose the Crippled condition. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, these allies move 33% faster.
acf18dc432ee2c56bc5576d6b75b094586edee5f.text: 精英呐喊。听力范围内的盟友会失去残废状态。在 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒内，这些盟友的移动速度加快了 33%。

b78d76027911f51c4d48e07e7fb026d133c978ee.source: Shout. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does [[MO:growth:0:var2]] damage.
b78d76027911f51c4d48e07e7fb026d133c978ee.text: 喊叫。在 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒内，你的下一次攻击无法被格挡并造成 [[MO:growth:0:var2]] 点伤害。

2ad54f4bdfb58daf99c39aa90e73205a31080807.source: Shout. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, party members within earshot cannot be knocked down.
2ad54f4bdfb58daf99c39aa90e73205a31080807.text: 喊叫。在 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒内，听力范围内的队员无法被击倒。

3836321725f72dd582275187b4f7daa9a3be3e13.source: Shout. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, all allies within earshot gain [[MO:growth:0:var2]] Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. "Fall Back!" ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally successfully hits with an attack.
3836321725f72dd582275187b4f7daa9a3be3e13.text: 喊叫。在 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒内，听力范围内的所有盟友在移动时每秒获得 [[MO:growth:0:var2]] 点生命值，并且移动速度加快 33% 点。 “倒退！”当受此呼喊影响的盟友成功攻击时，该盟友就会结束。

ea233d541edc53ae51e59f61b51552b84705a1e2.source: Shout. All nearby foes lose [[MO:growth:0:var1]] Energy. For [[MO:growth:0:var2]] seconds, your melee attacks gain [[MO:growth:0:var3]] chance of a critical hit against stationary foes.

eb17f9b820a7d11aec6b3c393cb64802b9b805d2.source:
* Works with self inflicted knock down (i.e. Grapple, Desperation Blow, and Drunken Blow).
* If a single effect knocks down the affected ally multiple times (e.g. hitting multiple enemies with the skills above using a scythe), the shout will inflict its damage, but will not prevent the ally from being knocked down.
* Damage is inflicted even if the knock down would be prevented by other effects, such as "I Am Unstoppable!" or Balanced Stance.
eb17f9b820a7d11aec6b3c393cb64802b9b805d2.text:
* 适用于自残击倒（即擒抱、绝望打击和醉酒打击）。
* 如果单一效果多次击倒受影响的盟友（例如使用镰刀以上述技能击中多个敌人），则呼喊会对其造成伤害，但不会阻止盟友被击倒。
* 即使被其他效果（例如“我势不可挡！”）阻止击倒，也会造成伤害。或平衡的立场。

2d976f7fb8191b1e7b51086544da762d8e030bfa.source:
* This is the only skill that prevents touch skills; however, it does not work against Touch of Dhuum nor Smash of the Titans.
* This skill will not prevent friendly touch skills and does not count them toward ending the shout's effect.
Unlike most shouts, "Can't Touch This!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of echoes.
"Can't Touch This!" is applied to party members only.
2d976f7fb8191b1e7b51086544da762d8e030bfa.text:
* 这是唯一阻止接触技能的技能；然而，它不适用于《德姆之触》和《泰坦粉碎》。
* 该技能不会阻止友好的接触技能，并且不会将其计入结束喊叫效果的范围内。
与大多数喊叫不同的是，“不能碰这个！”如果在过期之前重新应用，则会结束，从而触发回声效果。
“这个不能碰！”只适用于队员。

31fcf5008dd903067ef0b84525b92f051e983a39.source:
* In the case of attacks which strike more than one foe, only the target will have the damage and deep wound applied.
* A character affected by this shout successfully hitting with Agonizing Chop will interrupt the target, which suggest that Deep Wound is applied first.
* Heroes use this skill on party members wielding a sword, axe, hammer, daggers, scythe, spear or shortbow, with an attribute level of at least 1 in the corresponding weapon mastery.
** Attribute bonuses, such as runes, are taken into account.
** Anniversary weapons are treated as though they have a regular attribute requirement.
The exact description should be "the next time target ally successfully hits with an attack", as this skill will not be removed and its effects won't be applied if the next attack misses (due to blind), is blocked or if there is no line of sight.
{{DEFAULTSORT:Find Their Weakness!}}
31fcf5008dd903067ef0b84525b92f051e983a39.text:
* 如果攻击攻击多个敌人，则只有目标会受到伤害和深度伤害。
* 受此喊叫影响的角色成功用痛苦斩击中时会打断目标，这表明首先应用深度伤口。
*英雄对使用剑、斧头、锤子、匕首、镰刀、矛或短弓的队员使用该技能，且相应武器掌握属性等级至少为1。
** 考虑了属性加成，例如符文。
** 周年纪念武器被视为具有常规属性要求。
准确的描述应该是“下次攻击成功击中目标盟友时”，因为如果下次攻击未击中（由于盲）、被阻挡或没有视线，则该技能不会被移除，也不会应用其效果。
{{DEFAULTSORT：找出他们的弱点！}}

28467a60aaca9253427417c10dbe0f6f868bc7cb.source: bug: The exact description should be "the next time target ally successfully hits with an attack", as this skill will not be removed and its effects won't be applied if the next attack misses (due to blind), is blocked or if there is no line of sight.
28467a60aaca9253427417c10dbe0f6f868bc7cb.text: bug：准确的描述应该是“下次攻击成功击中目标友军时”，因为如果下次攻击未击中（由于盲）、被阻挡或没有视线，则该技能不会被移除，并且不会应用其效果。

* In the case of attacks which strike more than one foe, only the target will have the deep wound applied.
{{DEFAULTSORT:Find Their Weakness!}}

* 与“Go for the Eyes!”有一定的协同作用
* 与暴击等级较高的刺客配合良好，可轻松造成深度伤害。
* 如果攻击攻击多个敌人，则只有目标会受到较深的伤害。
{{DEFAULTSORT：找出他们的弱点！}}

a7238337cfa8e1e0c7a73689eee8e48bfea621c5.source:
* Unlike all other skills that inflict Deep Wound, the damage is dealt after Deep Wound is applied, so using "Finish Him!" on a near-death target will usually kill it.
*Cracked armor covers deep wound. 
This skill ignores the effects of skills that provide health bonuses, such as Endure Pain, when calculating 50% of the health; the target's health needs to be 50% of what it would be without the bonus.
a7238337cfa8e1e0c7a73689eee8e48bfea621c5.text:

127b219116e0b32c689c0a2cfee7fd95cc07e685.source:
Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this doubles all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.
* Enduring Harmony extends the duration of this shout to 30 seconds, even at 0 Leadership.
* Often used to fuel and maintain "Save Yourselves!".

;Warrior / Paragon
"For Great Justice!" is a staple skill for Paragons and Warriors, as these professions tend to rely on adrenaline skills to compensate for their low energy regeneration. 
* This skill can function as an indirect energy management tool for Paragons by allowing an increased use of adrenaline-based shouts and chants to trigger Leadership's energy gain more often. 
** The shouts "Go for the Eyes!" and "The Power Is Yours!" are in particular effective, as they have low adrenaline costs, no activation time and no recharge time. 
* Combines very well with Dragon Slash at 10 or higher Swordsmanship, as the doubled adrenaline gain equals the cost of Dragon Slash itself. This allows the attack skill to be used repeatedly, while also rapidly fueling all other equipped adrenaline skills.
127b219116e0b32c689c0a2cfee7fd95cc07e685.text:
与大多数通过乘数增加肾上腺素增益率的技能不同，这会使所有非乘数来源的肾上腺素加倍，而不仅仅是攻击时的基本 1 击。
* 持久和谐将这种喊叫的持续时间延长至 30 秒，即使在 0 领导力下也是如此。
* 经常用于补充和维持“拯救自己！”。

;战士/典范
“为了大正义！”是典范和战士的主要技能，因为这些职业往往依赖肾上腺素技能来弥补他们的低能量再生。 
* 该技能可以作为典范的间接能量管理工具，通过允许更多地使用基于肾上腺素的喊叫和口号来更频繁地触发领导力的能量增益。 
** 喊声“为眼睛而战！”和“力量是你的！”特别有效，因为它们的肾上腺素成本低，没有激活时间，也没有充电时间。 
* 与 10 或更高剑术的龙斩结合得很好，因为双倍的肾上腺素增益等于龙斩本身的成本。这使得攻击技能可以重复使用，同时也可以快速补充所有其他装备的肾上腺素技能。

1ca800f3ed3aa40cffc57a879954ea4ecb021679.source:
* This skill is a staple energy management skill for primary paragons, even at 0 command, as it allows to trigger the Leadership's energy gain effect frequently and without halting attacks.
** It can also indirectly help primary Assassins via Critical Strikes.
* This skill can help party members to meet the critical hit-dependent effects of skills such as Keen Arrow.
* As with most skills affecting the next attack, this shout will affect attacks already in-flight when used.
* The shout seems to end before the attack hits, triggering relevant Finales before the attack connects, but Soldier's Strike is still unblockable.
* Synergizes with a minion master since:
** It affects allies, so the more minions the party has, the more damage will be added by this skill.
** Unlike party members and pets that gain bonus damage from attack skills, generally all of the damage of minions is their base damage, causing them to benefit disproportionally from landing critical hits.

Contrary to what the description suggests, this skill triggers on hit rather than on attack. For instance, if Cyclone Axe hits several foes, only one of them has increased chance to be critically hit.
1ca800f3ed3aa40cffc57a879954ea4ecb021679.text:
* 该技能是初级典范的主要能量管理技能，即使在 0 命令下也是如此，因为它可以频繁触发领导力的能量增益效果，并且不会停止攻击。
** 它还可以通过暴击间接帮助初级刺客。
* 该技能可以帮助队员满足利箭等技能的暴击依赖效果。
* 与大多数影响下一次攻击的技能一样，这种喊叫会影响使用时已经在飞行中的攻击。
* 喊叫似乎在攻击到来之前就结束了，在攻击连接之前触发相关的结局，但士兵的打击仍然无法阻挡。
* 与仆从大师协同作用，因为：
** 它影响盟友，所以队伍的随从越多，该技能所造成的伤害就越大。
** 与从攻击技能中获得额外伤害的队伍成员和宠物不同，一般来说，小兵的所有伤害都是其基础伤害，导致他们从致命一击中获得不成比例的好处。

与描述相反，该技能在击中而不是攻击时触发。例如，如果旋风斧击中了多个敌人，则只有其中一个会增加受到暴击的几率。

* Good adrenaline management is essential to quickly refill the adrenaline pool of this skill to make up for its short duration. 
** "For Great Justice!" works well in that regard, as it is also a warrior skill and does not require any investment. 
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.

677d59acd9d79ce2c500895eb3f444578eb80403.text:
* 良好的肾上腺素管理对于快速补充该技能的肾上腺素池以弥补其短暂的持续时间至关重要。 
**“为了伟大的正义！”在这方面效果很好，因为它也是一种战士技能，不需要任何投资。 
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* +100 护甲可减少 82.3% 的非无护甲伤害。
* Imbagon 是一个典范构建，同时保留了“拯救自己！”和“没什么好害怕的！”对其他队伍成员的总伤害减少最多 88.5% 点。
技能描述忽略了只有在听力范围内的队员才会受到影响。

4e68b7095239efdd4ce3481a023162358111006f.source: anomaly: The skill descriptions omit that only party members within earshot are affected.

d38ac3a6abae15440fab6fbefd49780a16518063.source: * +60 armor rating is about 65% damage reduction from projectile attacks.
d38ac3a6abae15440fab6fbefd49780a16518063.text: * +60 护甲等级约为 65% 射弹攻击伤害减免。

437e143d98d94baa70255c80bf21ef2a726a170f.source:
See: Battery
* 2 energy regeneration for 4 seconds essentially gives each affected ally 2.67 energy.
* Due to its very short duration and spammability, this skill is exceptionally good for triggering echoes.
437e143d98d94baa70255c80bf21ef2a726a170f.text:
请参阅：电池
* 4 秒的 2 能量再生本质上为每个受影响的盟友提供 2.67 能量。
* 由于其持续时间非常短且具有垃圾邮件性，该技能非常适合触发回声。

fded2f6b6ecf936e2b5fa4135483d7e30610ef23.source:
*If you recast this skill while it is still active, the healing effect will not happen.
*To determine the total damage reduction when combining skills like "They're on Fire!", multiply the % of damage not reduced of each skill by each other, and the result is the % of damage your affected party takes (provided all conditions are met). 
**Example (assuming all conditions are met, i.e. burning, in earshot, etc.):
***"They're on Fire!" at Leadership 12 = 29% reduction / 71% damage
***"There's Nothing to Fear!" at Sunspear rank 5 to 10 = 35% reduction / 65% damage
***(ToF) .71 x (TNtF) .65 = .46 (or 46% damage is received / 54% reduction)
When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.
fded2f6b6ecf936e2b5fa4135483d7e30610ef23.text:
*如果在该技能仍然有效时重新施放该技能，则不会产生治疗效果。
*要确定组合技能（例如“他们着火了！”）时的总伤害减少量，请将每个技能未减少的伤害百分比相乘，结果就是受影响方受到的伤害百分比（前提是满足所有条件）。 
**示例（假设满足所有条件，即燃烧、在听力范围内等）：
***“他们着火了！”领导力 12 = 29% 减少 / 71% 伤害
***“没什么好害怕的！”阳矛等级 5 至 10 = 35% 减少 / 65% 伤害
***(ToF) .71 x (TNtF) .65 = .46 （或受到 46% 点伤害/减少 54% 点伤害）
当按战役对技能进行排序时，尽管它是夜幕降临技能，但它仍列在核心下。

e02bfca72b3f60949a01247efd9cd0158cf8c30b.source: bug: When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.
e02bfca72b3f60949a01247efd9cd0158cf8c30b.text: bug：当按战役对技能进行排序时，尽管它是夜幕降临技能，但它列在核心下。

bafd74ac295568e0475706b1a8a39b4767eedf15.source: * Occasionally, when using this skill, the user will shout, "Everybody, to the limit!"
bafd74ac295568e0475706b1a8a39b4767eedf15.text: * 有时，使用该技能时，使用者会大喊“大家，极限了！”

d903f73000ce35c2a30ecb696ca39739fb4d1eb0.source:
*This is a core skill, but Guild Wars Eye of the North is required to obtain the skill.
*Party members only need to be nearby the Ranger or the pet for the initial application of the skill; once it is acquired, they may leave nearby range without losing its effect.
*The player does not need an active pet to use this skill.
The description omits to mention that all pets in the party are affected as well. 
The concise description omits that the additional damage only applies to attacks. 
The actual range is in the area.
d903f73000ce35c2a30ecb696ca39739fb4d1eb0.text:
*这是核心技能，但需要激战北方之眼才能获得该技能。
*初次使用技能时，队员只需在游侠或宠物附近即可；一旦获得，他们可能会离开附近的范围而不会失去其效果。
*玩家不需要活跃的宠物来使用该技能。
描述中没有提及队伍中的所有宠物也会受到影响。 
简洁的描述省略了额外伤害仅适用于攻击。 
实际范围是在该区域内。

60b5b2a776a8dfd259b9c1e521751b5e8cbbf474.source: anomaly: The description omits to mention that all pets in the party are affected as well.

00465e587308fd0bf73e1fa546d08448fd97f3f8.source: anomaly: The concise description omits that the additional damage only applies to attacks.
00465e587308fd0bf73e1fa546d08448fd97f3f8.text: 异常：简洁的描述省略了附加伤害仅适用于攻击。

2be5eca8887ab81ad30f5aad5635db26a078249b.source: bug: The actual range is in the area.

22ef20177fa09adfbac708bac11b63613e195a5b.source: anomaly: Instead of ending on attacks as stated, it ends after an ally takes armor-respecting damage 10 times.
22ef20177fa09adfbac708bac11b63613e195a5b.text: 异常：它不是按照规定的攻击结束，而是在盟友受到 10 次护甲伤害后结束。

fb90baa7edf51c1e1af9e4ef12448edbddc763db.source: anomaly: Instead of ending on attacks as stated, it ends after an ally takes armor-respecting damage 1…3…3 times.
fb90baa7edf51c1e1af9e4ef12448edbddc763db.text: 异常：它不是按照规定的攻击结束，而是在盟友受到 1…3…3 次护甲伤害后结束。

b00e15a79bf3234992aeddfa61dbe317a996b1ad.source:
* This skill, Eternal Aura, "By Ural's Hammer!", and Unyielding Aura are the fastest resurrection skills.
* "Never Surrender!" and "Never Give Up!" are useful follow-up skills, since they share the same attribute and have a low energy cost.
"We Shall Return!" does not return energy from Leadership.
b00e15a79bf3234992aeddfa61dbe317a996b1ad.text:
* 该技能与永恒光环、“乌拉尔之锤！”、不屈光环是最快的复活技能。
*“永不投降！”和“永不放弃！”是有用的后续技能，因为它们具有相同的属性并且能量成本较低。
“我们会回来的！”不会从领导力中返回能量。

60adbb674d9cf18531c2c8a9d5013f3c6c66af94.source: bug: "We Shall Return!" does not return energy from Leadership.
60adbb674d9cf18531c2c8a9d5013f3c6c66af94.text: bug：“我们会回来的！”不会从领导力中返回能量。

8ec408be71f2f323aaead7a8f105f4e0e57c03e6.source:
*The bonus percentage is added to resurrection skills' levels of health and energy, rather than modifying these levels by a factor.
**For example, a rank 15 "We Shall Return!" (PvP) used with Resurrection Signet will give the target 75% energy, not 37.5%.
*To use this skill with Lively Was Naomei, it needs to be active when you drop the ashes.
*This skill does not affect Restoration (PvP).
{{DEFAULTSORT:We Shall Return!}}
8ec408be71f2f323aaead7a8f105f4e0e57c03e6.text:
*奖励百分比会添加到复活技能的生命值和能量水平上，而不是按一个系数修改这些水平。
**例如，等级15“我们会回来的！” (PvP) 与复活徽记一起使用将为目标提供 75% 能量，而不是 37.5%。
*要与Lively Was Naomei一起使用此技能，需要在掉落骨灰时激活该技能。
*该技能不影响恢复（PvP）。
{{DEFAULTSORT：我们会回来的！}}

594adf7fefea2dd4b3cbadfbede333277afd5b5f.source: *The duration of the weakness condition will be extended by 33% if using a weapon with a Heavy upgrade, making it possible to maintain weakness at rank 1.
594adf7fefea2dd4b3cbadfbede333277afd5b5f.text: *如果使用重型升级武器，弱点状态的持续时间将延长33%，从而可以将弱点维持在1级。

df57a3f2d08f2e85280296a493487fb00a904d6d.source:
* As shouts can be used while activating other skills, this allows for useful tactics:
** It can always be timed to hit at the right moment when another skill would benefit from its knockdown, such as Bed of Coals.
** It can be used to interrupt enemies before they can use skills that would prevent the currently channeled skill from activating, such as Spellbreaker. 
* Often shortened to YMLAD.
df57a3f2d08f2e85280296a493487fb00a904d6d.text:
* 由于可以在激活其他技能时使用喊叫，因此可以使用有用的战术：
** 当其他技能可以从其击倒中受益时，它总是可以选择在正确的时刻进行攻击，例如煤炭床。
** 它可用于在敌人使用阻止当前引导技能激活的技能（例如破法者）之前打断他们。 
* 通常缩写为 YMLAD。

9021abd4b3a50d6b3c9b301f6db4ac6051763cbf.source:
* Weakness covers cripple.
* In PvE, you can prevent this skill from having an effect on you by having a miniature out.
9021abd4b3a50d6b3c9b301f6db4ac6051763cbf.text:
* 弱点涵盖残废。
* 在PvE中，你可以通过迷你出局来防止该技能对你产生影响。

3b0b72a902f629e0337eef7a9458d8deb9b155d4.source: *Synergy with touch or attack skills causing knockdown, such as Hammer Bash, Shock or Brawling Headbutt.
3b0b72a902f629e0337eef7a9458d8deb9b155d4.text: *与接触或攻击技能协同造成击倒，例如锤击、电击或争吵头撞。

c1c87f82615a94fab7cb4e9915804f9bc758d213.source: * Use with skills that can knock down multiple foes, such as Whirlwind.
c1c87f82615a94fab7cb4e9915804f9bc758d213.text: * 使用可以击倒多个敌人的技能，例如旋风斩。

3527da7fe3106ad537f0bc8ff36082108eeaaac3.source:
* Anthem of Flame helps the AI renew this skill.

Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Aggressive Refrain's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
3527da7fe3106ad537f0bc8ff36082108eeaaac3.text:
* 火焰之歌帮助AI更新此技能。

类似于裂甲，该技能不会将你的护甲等级降低到60以下，或者如果你的“核心”护甲等级低于60，则你的“核心”护甲等级不会降低。
如果您使用授予 +46 或更高护甲等级的技能或技能和效果组合，则侵略性副歌的护甲惩罚将不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

bd3c55e3edfcbcc5978a008f4e65ff2e240929ff.source: bug: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
