88d489792ab7f496a037f9828c4471e25c703ec6.source: bug: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Aggressive Refrain's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
88d489792ab7f496a037f9828c4471e25c703ec6.text: bug：如果你使用授予 +46 或更高护甲等级的技能或技能和效果组合，则“侵略性副歌”的护甲惩罚将不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

b10e4bb5a37b10ceda25866fa5de19a48ccab494.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Agony.
This spirit causes health loss to passive charmable animals; however, this does not turn them hostile.
b10e4bb5a37b10ceda25866fa5de19a48ccab494.text:
* 该技能会创造痛苦之魂。
这种精神会导致被动迷人动物的健康损失；然而，这并不会让他们产生敌意。

8890d4fca717c3e9c288fa8526e3068f2870ffa3.source: anomaly: This spirit causes health loss to passive charmable animals; however, this does not turn them hostile.
8890d4fca717c3e9c288fa8526e3068f2870ffa3.text: 异常：这种精神会导致被动迷人动物的健康损失；然而，这并不会让他们产生敌意。

29380c5da5d93262ad7f90bb3e407c5f33f57487.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Agony.
29380c5da5d93262ad7f90bb3e407c5f33f57487.text: * 该技能会创造痛苦之魂。

2efc3ef61f4cde04787797818827b7f23ee481b5.source: * The amount of energy regained is rounded; for example, a 5 energy spell returns 3 energy instead of 2.5 energy, and a 15 energy spell returns 6 energy instead of 5.5 energy.
2efc3ef61f4cde04787797818827b7f23ee481b5.text: * 恢复的能量数量四舍五入；例如，5能量咒语返回3能量而不是2.5能量，15能量咒语返回6能量而不是5.5能量。

e8b08694acca19473dc10f878c60b2122fcd3df5.source:
* Contrary to Mark of Insecurity, this hex actually makes enchantments expire faster.
* This hex only affects the length of enchantments used on the target after the hex is applied; previously applied enchantments are not affected, nor will removing the hex restore the original length of effects already shortened.
* The enchantment is removed before this hex is applied. This is relevant for Holy Veil.
If an enchantment duration is reduced below 1 second, it behaves as if it was not applied.
Although the description says "150…270…300% faster", the actual behavior is "at 150…270…300% the normal rate", which is only 50…170…200% faster.
e8b08694acca19473dc10f878c60b2122fcd3df5.text:
* 与不安全印记相反，这个六角形实际上使结界失效得更快。
* 该降咒仅影响应用该降咒后对目标使用的结界的长度；先前应用的结界不受影响，移除六角形也不会恢复已缩短的效果的原始长度。
* 在应用此六角形之前，结界将被移除。这与圣面纱有关。
如果结界持续时间减少到 1 秒以下，则其行为就像未应用一样。
尽管描述说“150…270…300% 更快”，但实际行为是“150…270…300% 正常速率”，仅快 50…170…200%。

96101ef585130bfc8f5800857a663cb00e41b13d.source: anomaly: If an enchantment duration is reduced below 1 second, it behaves as if it was not applied.
96101ef585130bfc8f5800857a663cb00e41b13d.text: 异常：如果结界持续时间减少到 1 秒以下，则其行为就像未应用一样。

aff043ecc1a160abd7c251e38d41107b9bdd0fe3.source: bug: Although the description says "150…270…300% faster", the actual behavior is "at 150…270…300% the normal rate", which is only 50…170…200% faster.

c6c51a41946afe44301a6269e71a51f7a4fe4c0d.source:
* Air of Enchantment reduces the energy cost of all enchantments, both targeted and self-targeting.
** This includes self-targeting enchantments such as Flash Enchantments and Attunements.
** Party wide enchantments that do not target an ally (such as Aegis and Orders enchantments) will have their energy cost reduced if used by the recipient of Air of Enchantment.
** Doublecast Enchantment Spells are affected only if the target is under Air of Enchantment, not the caster, even though the caster also becomes enchanted when the skill activation completes.
** The cost of enchantments that target a foe is reduced if the target is under Air of Enchantment, not the caster.
c6c51a41946afe44301a6269e71a51f7a4fe4c0d.text:
* 结界之气降低了所有结界的能量消耗，包括定向结界和自我结界。
** 这包括自我瞄准附魔，例如闪光附魔和调谐。
** 不针对盟友的队伍范围的结界（例如神盾和命令结界）如果由结界之气的接受者使用，其能量消耗将会降低。
** 双重结界法术只有在目标处于结界之气之下时才会受到影响，而施法者则不会受到影响，即使施法者在技能激活完成后也会被结界。
** 如果目标处于结界之气之下，而非施法者，则以敌人为目标的结界成本会降低。

772f546038a99962de0933e5b5e0247d145b1979.source:
* This skill only activates if you receive at least 1 XP from a foe death.
* The benefits gained can be identified by the dialogue bubbles above the character's head:
::{| {{STDT|#6A3}}
|- align="center" valign="top"
|- style="background:#ADA;"
! Boast !! Benefit || Activation chance (%)
|- align="center"
| "Buwahahaha!" || All conditions removed from self || 30%
|- align="center"
| "Kneel Before Your Master!" || Double XP gained || 20% 
|- align="center"
| "Knowledge is Power!" || Healed for 50 health || 20%
|- align="center"
| "You're No Match for My Brains!" || Gain 5 energy || 20%
|- align="center"
| "Is There Anything I Can't Do?" || Recharge all skills || 10%
|}

* Skills that require a morale boost, such as Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet, and Celestial skills, are not recharged by "Is There Anything I Can't Do?".
* Experience scrolls stack with "Kneel Before Your Master".

Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.
772f546038a99962de0933e5b5e0247d145b1979.text:
* 只有当你从敌人死亡中获得至少 1 XP 时，此技能才会激活。
* 获得的好处可以通过角色头顶的对话气泡来识别：
::{| {{STDT|#6A3}}
|-align=“中心”valign=“顶部”
|- 风格=“背景：#ADA;”
！夸！！效益 ||激活几率(%)
|- 对齐=“中心”
| “布哇哈哈哈！” ||所有条件均已从 self || 中删除30%
|- 对齐=“中心”
| “跪在你的主人面前！” ||获得双倍 XP || 20% 
|- 对齐=“中心”
| “知识就是力量！” ||治愈 50 点健康 || 20%
|- 对齐=“中心”
| “你根本不是我脑子的对手！” ||获得5能量|| 20%
|- 对齐=“中心”
| “还有什么是我做不到的吗？” ||充值所有技能|| 10%
|}

* 需要士气提升的技能，如复活徽记、阳矛重生徽记、天界技能，不会通过“还有什么我做不到的吗？”来补充。
* 经验卷轴与“跪在你的主人面前”叠加。

与其他没有启动时间的技能不同，该技能的标准施法延迟时间为 0.75 秒，并且无法在移动或启动其他技能时使用。

0a4d2dad036340a1b7be42e0d105ea096e90f083.source: anomaly: Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.
0a4d2dad036340a1b7be42e0d105ea096e90f083.text: 异常：与其他没有启动时间的技能不同，该技能的标准施法延迟时间为 0.75 秒，并且无法在移动或启动其他技能时使用。

2ee7d0026d2a34ae6052900cf2aa7a90cee27d5f.source: *Useful in A Time for Heroes and Glint's Challenge, as all foes are Destroyers.
2ee7d0026d2a34ae6052900cf2aa7a90cee27d5f.text: *在英雄时代和格林特挑战中很有用，因为所有敌人都是毁灭者。

f0864a9d17aa9d2fb14568f2db13f86cb94c4dd5.source:
* Ancestor's Visage coupled with Famine (and, to a lesser extent, Mind Wrack) is extremely powerful when used on a single tank who is absorbing damage. It is one of the combinations that becomes more and more powerful as the number of enemies (particularly melee enemies) increases.
* Can be effectively used as a prot against adrenaline-using builds, hampering their ability to pressure/spike effectively.
f0864a9d17aa9d2fb14568f2db13f86cb94c4dd5.text:
*祖先的容貌与饥荒（以及较小程度的心灵毁灭）相结合，当用于吸收伤害的单个坦克时非常强大。它是随着敌人（特别是近战敌人）数量的增加而变得越来越强大的组合之一。
* 可以有效地用作对抗使用肾上腺素的构建的保护，从而阻碍他们有效施加压力/峰值的能力。

32ceac2f22a077b304e076e65dbfafa26cf0a09c.source:
*If a shadow step skill with a 0.25 activation time is in the target's skill queue after Ancestors' Rage is used on that target, it will deal damage just after the shadow step. Attempting this with a shadow step with a cast time longer than 0.25 second will cause the damage to occur before teleportation.
*Similar to other skills with an end effect, if the target dies before this skill ends, the end effect will trigger upon death.
*Can be used on allied spirits.
32ceac2f22a077b304e076e65dbfafa26cf0a09c.text:
*如果在对目标使用先祖之怒后，目标的技能队列中存在激活时间为 0.25 的暗影步技能，则会在暗影步之后立即造成伤害。尝试使用施法时间超过 0.25 秒的暗影步进行此操作将导致伤害在传送之前发生。
*与其他带有终结效果的技能类似，如果目标在该技能结束前死亡，则死亡时会触发终结效果。
*可用于友军精魂。

98d166e1701100419f25a169fd3a05fe6ea9835d.source:
* Consider using Mind Wrack in order to give you a visual cue when the target is out of energy while adding damage to the spike.
* Can be extremely effective against Elementalists due to the high energy total that Energy Storage can give them.
* Consider using this skill on newly resurrected foes, as they may have low energy and/or low health.

Aneurysm does not take overcast into account when calculating how much energy to generate; as such, it combines well with skills that force overcast (such as Arcane Languor or Exhausting Assault) as it will deal high damage without actually returning energy.
98d166e1701100419f25a169fd3a05fe6ea9835d.text:
* 考虑使用Mind Wrack，以便在目标能量耗尽时给你一个视觉提示，同时增加尖刺的伤害。
* 由于能量储存可以为元素师提供高能量总量，因此对元素师非常有效。
* 考虑对新复活的敌人使用此技能，因为他们的能量和/或生命值可能较低。

动脉瘤在计算产生多少能量时不考虑阴天；因此，它与强制阴沉的技能（例如奥术倦怠或疲惫攻击）很好地结合在一起，因为它会造成高伤害而实际上不会返回能量。

24f9362d336fda98cbcf6f18b82cc0c9c4821583.source: anomaly: Aneurysm does not take overcast into account when calculating how much energy to generate; as such, it combines well with skills that force overcast (such as Arcane Languor or Exhausting Assault) as it will deal high damage without actually returning energy.
24f9362d336fda98cbcf6f18b82cc0c9c4821583.text: 异常：动脉瘤在计算产生多少能量时没有考虑阴天；因此，它与强制阴沉的技能（例如奥术倦怠或疲惫攻击）很好地结合在一起，因为它会造成高伤害而实际上不会返回能量。

c9004b047efae664b35a91026144303b5c4b0eb6.source:
The skill states it will end on all other allies, however, it will only end on party members of the ally that it triggers on, not all allies.
Despite the skill descriptions, this skill triggers with health degeneration, health loss, life stealing, and health sacrifice, not just damage.
c9004b047efae664b35a91026144303b5c4b0eb6.text:
该技能声明它将在所有其他盟友上结束，但是，它只会在其触发的盟友的队员上结束，而不是在所有盟友上结束。
尽管有技能描述，但该技能会触发健康退化、健康损失、生命窃取和健康牺牲，而不仅仅是伤害。

159fc4e7e643384e8cb4aedec841ac257f0f6d02.source: bug: The skill states it will end on all other allies, however, it will only end on party members of the ally that it triggers on, not all allies.
159fc4e7e643384e8cb4aedec841ac257f0f6d02.text: bug：该技能声明它将在所有其他盟友上结束，但是，它只会在其触发的盟友的队员上结束，而不是在所有盟友上结束。

8f0e6b7dae483ec6152ff8520cf4ab30b4ba2acd.source: anomaly: Despite the skill descriptions, this skill triggers with health degeneration, health loss, life stealing, and health sacrifice, not just damage.
8f0e6b7dae483ec6152ff8520cf4ab30b4ba2acd.text: 异常：尽管有技能描述，但该技能会触发生命值退化、生命值损失、生命窃取和生命值牺牲，而不仅仅是伤害。

a1b7cc8233a94f45903169f2214b05adccd20fd3.source:
*This skill mimics the effect of the Guild Lord's Amulet of Protection.
*Under Angelic Protection, you take the damage first and then are healed. If you take more damage than you have health remaining, you will die.
*Unlike Protective Spirit, this skill will protect even against small damage packets if there are enough of them. An example would be the large mobs of Avicara Fierce in Mineral Springs who use Ignite Arrows and Dual Shot.
*The effect of this skill isn't triggered by sacrificing health from skills such as Blood is Power.
{{Skill change}}
Unlike most typeless skills with no activation time, this skill cannot be activated in the middle of another action and has a slight aftercast delay.
a1b7cc8233a94f45903169f2214b05adccd20fd3.text:
*该技能模仿公会领主的保护护身符的效果。
*在天使保护下，你会先受到伤害，然后才会被治愈。如果你受到的伤害超过了剩余的生命值，你就会死亡。
*与保护精神不同，如果有足够的伤害包，该技能甚至可以保护小伤害包。一个例子是矿泉中的 Avicara Fierce 的大型暴徒，他们使用点燃箭和双重射击。
*该技能的效果不是通过牺牲血量就是力量等技能的生命值来触发的。
{{技能改变}}
与大多数没有激活时间的无类型技能不同，该技能无法在另一个动作中间激活，并且有轻微的施法延迟。

1c6cc1ffc04800c844b7b69fcae9b92fca0084da.source: anomaly: Unlike most typeless skills with no activation time, this skill cannot be activated in the middle of another action and has a slight aftercast delay.
1c6cc1ffc04800c844b7b69fcae9b92fca0084da.text: 异常：与大多数没有激活时间的无类型技能不同，该技能无法在另一个动作中间激活，并且有轻微的施法延迟。

ef1c07340b0e947cb7dee6c130ac618e8632b47e.source:
* Useful for gaining energy when combined with skills that inflict conditions on oneself, e.g. Cultist's Fervor or Foul Feast.
* Heroes will use this even when they do not have a condition.
ef1c07340b0e947cb7dee6c130ac618e8632b47e.text:
* 当与给自己带来条件的技能结合使用时，对于获得能量很有用，例如邪教徒的狂热或肮脏的盛宴。
* 英雄即使没有条件也会使用这个。

81a7c89bfb3ef47dfb619d41fdb640cd63bf2ef2.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Anguish that uses the Anguish attack skill.
* Synergizes with Painful Bond.
* Synergizes well with Blood Bond which grants healing to the spirit while also fulfilling the requirement for a hexed target. 
* On hexed foes, Anguish also doubles the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might and Anthem of Envy.
* Spiritleech Aura combines poorly with Anguish, as the damage reduction penalty significantly reduces the effectiveness of this spirit.
81a7c89bfb3ef47dfb619d41fdb640cd63bf2ef2.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用痛苦攻击技能的痛苦之魂。
* 与痛苦的纽带协同作用。
* 与血缘纽带有很好的协同作用，可以治愈灵魂，同时满足诅咒目标的要求。 
* 对于被施咒的敌人，痛苦还会使幽灵力量徽记和嫉妒圣歌的伤害加倍。
* Spiritleech光环与痛苦结合得很差，因为伤害减免惩罚显着降低了这种精神的有效性。

09233fe379db14603860e817aad445bf26fa6cb0.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Anguish that uses the Anguish attack skill.
* Synergizes with Painful Bond and Signet of Ghostly Might.
09233fe379db14603860e817aad445bf26fa6cb0.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用痛苦攻击技能的痛苦之魂。
* 与痛苦纽带和幽灵力量徽记协同作用。

09763b67b2051d9cd6dbebca6b7f62954078dad8.source:
* This is one of a handful of skills that specifically increase the duration of hexes.
No hexes are recharged if the user drops the ashes upon death.

=== Ritualist hex spells ===
*Binding Chains
*Dulled Weapon
*Lamentation - already maintainable
*Painful Bond - already maintainable and requires offensive binding spirits
*Renewing Surge
09763b67b2051d9cd6dbebca6b7f62954078dad8.text:
* 这是专门增加六角形持续时间的少数技能之一。
如果用户在死亡时掉落骨灰，则不会重新充电。

=== 仪式降咒魔法 ===
*束缚链
*钝化武器
*哀叹 - 已经可以维护了
*痛苦的束缚 - 已经可以维持并且需要进攻性的束缚精神
*更新激增

79f4f585a24ec71fc21cf1da833c8335fa56773b.source: bug: No hexes are recharged if the user drops the ashes upon death.
79f4f585a24ec71fc21cf1da833c8335fa56773b.text: bug：如果用户在死亡时掉落骨灰，则不会重新充电。

c47bb091ae347537362a813472dbd7363c1c4a00.source:
* Bone Fiends attack faster than other minions and at range; however, they have lower armor rating.
* They are more vulnerable than other minions to AoE damage because they remain stationary.
c47bb091ae347537362a813472dbd7363c1c4a00.text:
* 骨魔的攻击速度比其他小兵更快并且攻击距离更远；然而，它们的装甲等级较低。
* 他们比其他小兵更容易受到 AoE 伤害，因为他们保持静止。

2d4d8c3f71cb80c6ab7686d5eab7f2f2731c0a39.source:
* Bone Horrors are melee attackers, and as such are very useful for blocking choke points, or preventing/slowing enemy movement.
* Like all minions, they are very susceptible to AoE damage.
2d4d8c3f71cb80c6ab7686d5eab7f2f2731c0a39.text:
* 骨怪是近战攻击者，因此对于阻挡阻塞点或阻止/减缓敌人的移动非常有用。
* 像所有小兵一样，他们非常容易受到 AoE 伤害。

bf1e14aa1fdfdd715aa5e235e4bf5cd1db7e4dc2.source:
* Bone Minions are useful with skill combinations that rely on the minions dying, such as Jagged Bones, Death Nova or cause them to die, such as Putrid Flesh or Feast for the Dead. It is generally useful with builds that rely on Soul Reaping for energy management.
* This spell will trigger Explosive Growth, Boon of Creation, and Spirit's Gift twice.
bf1e14aa1fdfdd715aa5e235e4bf5cd1db7e4dc2.text:
* 骨头小兵对于依赖小兵死亡的技能组合非常有用，例如锯齿状骨头、死亡新星或导致它们死亡，例如腐肉或死者盛宴。它通常对于依赖灵魂收割进行能量管理的构建很有用。
* 该法术将触发两次爆发性生长、创造恩赐和灵魂礼物。

b3f4d0bf9710dcb09bedf7e84f75b058993db134.source:
* This skill is the only player skill that can spawn exploitable corpses. 
* The corpses created by this skill will count as dead allies for the purpose of "I Will Avenge You!".
* Multiple additional exploitable corpses have a few notable consequences:
** Taste of Death or Feast for the Dead can be used more effectively, for instance, to respectively make Blood of the Master safer or keep the minion army alive longer.
** Allows a team to carry multiple corpse exploitation skills without worrying about running out of corpses. 
** Allows a minion master to always have one Flesh Golem and a few other minions alive, even in areas where exploitable corpses are scarce, as long as the team can find at least one corpse to animate the first golem.
*** A player or hero bringing sacrifice skills, such as a saccer or a Blood is Power build, can kill themselves to provide this initial corpse.
* A Flesh Golem's size is determined by its level; the higher the level, the larger the minion.
On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.
b3f4d0bf9710dcb09bedf7e84f75b058993db134.text:
* 该技能是唯一可以生成可利用尸体的玩家技能。 
* 该技能产生的尸体将被视为“我将为你报仇！”目的的死亡盟友。
* 多个额外的可利用尸体会产生一些显着的后果：
** 死亡之味或亡灵盛宴可以更有效地使用，例如，分别使主人之血更安全或让小兵军队活得更久。
** 允许团队携带多种尸体开发技能，而不用担心尸体耗尽。 
** 允许小兵大师始终拥有一个血肉傀儡和其他一些小兵活着，即使在可利用尸体稀缺的地区，只要团队可以找到至少一具尸体来激活第一个傀儡。
*** 具有牺牲技能的玩家或英雄，例如saccer或Blood is Power构建，可以自杀来提供这个初始尸体。
* 血肉傀儡的大小由其等级决定；等级越高，小兵越大。
在一些非常罕见的情况下，当傀儡死亡时，会生成活着的 NPC 而不是尸体。

e3b718f283c9395a200c3ca757d15cafa3341ca2.source: bug: On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.
e3b718f283c9395a200c3ca757d15cafa3341ca2.text: bug：在某些非常罕见的情况下，当傀儡死亡时，会生成活着的 NPC 而不是尸体。

6fcedc9c8f5011f389c07c67e9743812e0f03e5c.source:
* When the Shambling Horror dies, the spawned Jagged Horror will trigger Explosive Growth, Boon of Creation, and Spirit's Gift.
* Shambling Horrors are good targets for Taste of Death and Feast for the Dead, since it leaves a Jagged Horror when it dies.
* When combined with Jagged Bones, two Jagged Horrors are produced.
* The level of the Jagged Horror is determined by the Death Magic rank of the caster when the Shambling Horror was created.
* Masterless Shambling Horrors do not spawn a Jagged Horror when they die.
* This skill has a much longer recharge when compared to most animation skills, and thus cannot be relied upon alone to create a full army of minions.
* The bleeding lasts for 25 seconds.
The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.
6fcedc9c8f5011f389c07c67e9743812e0f03e5c.text:
* 当蹒跚恐怖者死亡时，生成的锯齿恐怖者将触发爆炸性生长、创造恩赐和灵魂的礼物。
* 蹒跚恐魔是死亡之味和死者盛宴的好目标，因为它死后会留下锯齿状恐魔。
* 与锯齿状骨头结合时，会产生两种锯齿状恐怖物。
* 锯齿恐魔的等级由蹒跚恐魔创建时施法者的死亡魔法等级决定。
* 无主的蹒跚恐怖者死亡时不会生成锯齿恐怖者。
* 与大多数动画技能相比，该技能的充电时间要长得多，因此不能单独依靠它来创建一支完整的小兵军队。
* 出血持续25秒。
描述中没有提及锯齿恐怖造成的流血持续时间。

56ee5f3b95cedd14bd2673e681553c83de248c18.source: anomaly: The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.
56ee5f3b95cedd14bd2673e681553c83de248c18.text: 异常：描述中没有提及锯齿恐怖造成的流血持续时间。

cae3c2707158b41ba66b2f3c0c323203d4550339.source: * Consider using Splinter Weapon on this creature as the damage caused by Splinter Weapon will also increase the health you gain.
cae3c2707158b41ba66b2f3c0c323203d4550339.text: * 考虑对这个生物使用裂片武器，因为裂片武器造成的伤害也会增加你获得的生命值。

ec25db2990cfffecb589e15e8e5975b562112e6a.source: *This chant is triggered for the first target of the next attack skill, regardless if it hits, misses, is blocked, or obstructed.
ec25db2990cfffecb589e15e8e5975b562112e6a.text: *此咏唱会在下一个攻击技能的第一个目标上触发，无论它是否击中、未击中、被格挡或阻碍。

df0e446f3ed32d21bed96e664513f029fc3aade0.source:
* This can be very useful if you have a spirit spammer in your party.
* This chant triggers and ends the next time an attack skill successfully hits a foe with more than 50% health. If the same attack skill hits multiple foes, only one foe takes the bonus damage.
df0e446f3ed32d21bed96e664513f029fc3aade0.text:
* 如果您的队伍中有精神垃圾邮件发送者，这会非常有用。
* 下次攻击技能成功击中生命值超过 50% 的敌人时，此吟唱会触发并结束。如果同一攻击技能击中多个敌人，则只有一名敌人受到额外伤害。

49b07a5a8cfae7503e589b2a8ef032dd466e1a4b.source:
* This chant is very useful to trigger Echo finales and renew refrains, because it is one of the non-adrenaline chants that have the shortest activation and recharge times.
In the case of an attack skill that hits several foes, such as Whirlwind Attack, only one will be inflicted with burning, and not necessarily the one targeted by the attack.
49b07a5a8cfae7503e589b2a8ef032dd466e1a4b.text:
* 此圣歌对于触发回声结局和更新副歌非常有用，因为它是激活和充电时间最短的非肾上腺素圣歌之一。
当攻击技能攻击多个敌人时，例如旋风攻击，只会对其中一个敌人造成燃烧，而不一定是攻击目标。

ed269e587eca2f87fcdfbaa177fda1415c4e9805.source: bug: In the case of an attack skill that hits several foes, such as Whirlwind Attack, only one will be inflicted with burning, and not necessarily the one targeted by the attack.
ed269e587eca2f87fcdfbaa177fda1415c4e9805.text: bug：旋风攻击等攻击多个敌人的技能时，只有其中一个会被燃烧，而不一定是攻击目标。

5d0421c9a4c726545e96dcc157a64622c1596564.source:
See: Battery
* This chant is triggered the next time an attack skill is successfully activated.
* Primary PvP-only Paragons will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on their account.
5d0421c9a4c726545e96dcc157a64622c1596564.text:
请参阅：电池
* 下次成功发动攻击技能时会触发此咏唱。
* 仅初级 PvP 精英将能够使用此技能，即使其帐户未解锁。

3705493298e887fa88485afc12f7603fe3f4ee12.source:
*This skill does not scale with points in the Command attribute.
*This chant ends the next time an attack skill hits or misses.
3705493298e887fa88485afc12f7603fe3f4ee12.text:
*该技能不随命令属性中的点数而变化。
*下次攻击技能命中或未击中时，此吟唱结束。

7f4d019123a1fc3e2c544f1fccd026bd625ed621.source:
* This chant is triggered the next time an attack skill is successfully activated.
* The condition is applied before the attack hits.
* If used with area of effect attack skills, such as Whirlwind Attack, the condition will only apply to your target, not every foe you hit with it.
7f4d019123a1fc3e2c544f1fccd026bd625ed621.text:
* 下次成功发动攻击技能时会触发此咏唱。
* 该条件在攻击发生之前应用。
* 如果与范围攻击技能（例如旋风攻击）一起使用，该条件将仅适用于您的目标，而不是您用它击中的每个敌人。

406aa41599853f4b0c6b6979c283d63e2e94a11e.source:
* This is the only preparation that affects weapons besides bows. 
* The condition is applied after the strike, making it valuable as a cover condition for skills such as Crippling Shot and Broad Head Arrow.
* Physical attacks refers to attacks made by a martial weapon, even those that deal non-physical damage.
406aa41599853f4b0c6b6979c283d63e2e94a11e.text:
* 这是唯一影响除弓箭之外的武器的准备工作。 
* 该条件在攻击后应用，使其成为诸如致残射击和宽头箭等技能的掩护条件。
* 物理攻击是指使用武术武器进行的攻击，甚至是造成非物理伤害的攻击。

ebd309b794d23e353885fcacffcfe1af5d877333.source: bug: Heroes wielding a ranged weapon will target swap to new unpoisoned targets, but will not attack already poisoned ones.
ebd309b794d23e353885fcacffcfe1af5d877333.text: bug：使用远程武器的英雄会将目标切换到新的未中毒目标，但不会攻击已经中毒的目标。

6361d287d8549c26767b80c80cb42d776bc75ec4.source:
When this skill's functionality changed, the Polish description was updated incorrectly. It mentions too little additional damage while Overcast:
Spell. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage to two nearby foes if you are Overcast. 25% armor penetration.
6361d287d8549c26767b80c80cb42d776bc75ec4.text:
当该技能的功能发生变化时，波兰语描述被错误地更新。它提到阴天时的额外伤害太少：
咒语。造成 5…33…40 点闪电伤害。如果你处于阴暗状态，会对附近的两个敌人造成 5…33…40 点闪电伤害。 25% 护甲穿透。

c53c7f47ea243f8603eaaa7f99aecc3ff9ad6c70.source:
bug: When this skill's functionality changed, the Polish description was updated incorrectly. It mentions too little additional damage while Overcast:
Spell. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage to two nearby foes if you are Overcast. 25% armor penetration.
c53c7f47ea243f8603eaaa7f99aecc3ff9ad6c70.text:
bug：当该技能的功能发生变化时，波兰语描述更新错误。它提到阴天时的额外伤害太少：
咒语。造成 5…33…40 点闪电伤害。如果你处于阴暗状态，会对附近的两个敌人造成 5…33…40 点闪电伤害。 25% 护甲穿透。

84ce354725d99d5921f6a096875d2ea7f32c1647.source:
* The caster gains energy from each foe affected by the hex.
* No energy gain happens when the hex is renewed.
Unlike other hexes that affect the caster, this one doesn't end if the caster dies.
84ce354725d99d5921f6a096875d2ea7f32c1647.text:
* 施法者从每个受妖术影响的敌人那里获得能量。
* 更新六角形时不会发生能量增益。
与影响施法者的其他六角形不同，如果施法者死亡，这一六角形不会结束。

1f5f2340aa985689fd8fbf85112e59f155e14f5d.source: anomaly: Unlike other hexes that affect the caster, this one doesn't end if the caster dies.
1f5f2340aa985689fd8fbf85112e59f155e14f5d.text: 异常：与影响施法者的其他六角形不同，如果施法者死亡，该六角形不会结束。

0f41a33826e53c66a710af9049cd59589977fa0c.source:
* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create echo chains, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is disabled for 20 seconds.
** Consider using Auspicious Incantation before Arcane Echo for energy management, since the recharge time will not be increased.
* If used to copy a spell that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Gift of Health, the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
0f41a33826e53c66a710af9049cd59589977fa0c.text:
* 结合回声和奥术回声来创建回声链，允许您使用任何单一技能的三个副本。
* 如果奥术回响之后的下一个技能不是法术，则该结界将结束且没有任何效果。
* 奥术回响只有在没有复制法术的情况下才会正常充电。如果法术被复制，则该副本会保留 20 秒，之后奥术回响将被禁用 20 秒。
** 考虑在奥术回响之前使用吉祥咒进行能量管理，因为充能时间不会增加。
* 如果用于复制可以复制其他技能或法术的法术，则使用该法术的复制持续时间，并将绕过奥术回响的 20 秒复制持续时间。
** 例如，如果用于复制回声，则奥术回声版本的回声所复制的任何技能都将保留为该技能 30 秒，然后恢复为奥术回声。
*奥术回响的复制效果首先触发，然后才是触发它的法术效果。例如，当用于复制健康之礼时，该复制会因健康之礼的效果而失效。
奥术回响的描述忽略了它无法复制自身的事实。
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。

79502d6f2ed704f4b11633e68a1e0d8264eb111b.text: 异常：奥术回响的描述忽略了它无法复制自身的事实。

ab6dfa111a9078657bdcf4b14a4ad43f29f17bbc.source:
* Targets hexed by Arcane Languor will suffer a total 20 additional overcast after successfully casting a spell that normally has overcast in the presence of Equinox.
* Overcast occurs after the spell completes casting.
ab6dfa111a9078657bdcf4b14a4ad43f29f17bbc.text:
* 被奥术疲倦施咒的目标在成功施放通常在春分存在时会阴暗的法术后，将遭受总共 20 点额外的阴暗。
* 阴天发生在法术施法完成后。

a6690ea3871437cbc6cfaa0dea59f49d814f88be.source:
* Arcane Larceny does not distinguish between spells that are already disabled or recharging. It can steal a spell that was already disabled by the effects of another skill, such as Diversion, or a recharging spell whose recharge exceeds the duration of Arcane Larceny's disabling effect, such as Meteor Shower.
* This cannot be activated on a target with no spells. "That target has no spells to steal." appears when you attempt to.
* If you die when the duration of Arcane Larceny has not ended, the stolen spell on your skill bar will revert back to Arcane Larceny (similar to other skills that can copy skills); however, the target's spell will remain disabled for the full duration. This allows you to use Arcane Larceny to disable two spells at the same time if you are resurrected before the disable duration of the prior use of Arcane Larceny has ended.
* This can be used to interfere with skill chains on professions that tend to use only a few spells, e.g. primary Assassins.
a6690ea3871437cbc6cfaa0dea59f49d814f88be.text:
*奥术盗窃不区分已经禁用或正在充电的法术。它可以窃取一个已经被其他技能的效果禁用的法术，例如转移，或者一个充电法术，其充电时间超过了奥术盗窃的禁用效果的持续时间，例如流星雨。
* 这无法对没有法术的目标激活。 “那个目标没有法术可以窃取。”当您尝试这样做时会出现。
* 如果你在奥术盗窃持续时间未结束时死亡，技能栏上被盗的法术将恢复为奥术盗窃（类似于其他可以复制技能的技能）；然而，目标的法术将在整个持续时间内保持禁用状态。如果您在之前使用奥术盗窃的禁用持续时间结束之前复活，这允许您使用奥术盗窃同时禁用两个法术。
* 这可以用来干扰那些倾向于只使用少数法术的职业的技能链，例如初级刺客。

cfec6a9c103eed49bf6727f634af7c8f5a781e41.source:
* When using Arcane Mimicry on an ally that has more than one elite skill, the first elite skill from the left on their skill bar is copied. Accordingly, keep Arcane Mimicry to the right of any intended elite skill(s) if the team build requires mutual mimicry.
* If used on an ally without a non-form elite skill, Arcane Mimicry recharges instead.
**Heroes (and presumably other NPCs) cannot use this skill to copy any PvE-only skill.
* A successful Arcane Mimicry does not recharge like other skills: after the copy effect ends, the skill is disabled for 60 seconds.
* Maintained enchantments, skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep or skills that renew themselves copied with Arcane Mimicry will continue to be maintained, active or renewable even after expiration of Arcane Mimicry copy effect.
* Signet of Illusions or Symbols of Inspiration can be used to boost the attribute rank of a relevant copied elite.
* Players are able to copy elite skills which are not available from their skill list, but use them only when certain conditions are met:
** if the skill is a core skill or belongs to a campaign available on the account, the player (and their heroes) can use it even if it has not been unlocked.
** if the skill belongs to a campaign unavailable to the account, it will be copied to the skill bar but cannot be used by the playable character (remaining locked like PvE-only skills are in a PvP area).
** heroes are able to copy and use skills from any campaigns available and unavailable to an account, but the player cannot force the use of skills from campaigns unavailable to them.
cfec6a9c103eed49bf6727f634af7c8f5a781e41.text:
* 当对拥有多个精英技能的盟友使用奥术拟态时，其技能栏左侧的第一个精英技能将被复制。因此，如果团队建设需要相互模仿，请将奥术模仿放在任何预期精英技能的右侧。
* 如果对没有非形态精英技能的盟友使用，则奥术拟态会重新充电。
**英雄（大概还有其他 NPC）不能使用此技能复制任何仅限 PvE 的技能。
* 成功的奥术拟态不会像其他技能那样进行充能：复制效果结束后，该技能会被禁用60秒。
* 维持的结界、无需维护即可无限期持续的技能或通过奥术拟态复制的自我更新技能将继续保持、活跃或可更新，即使在奥术拟态复制效果到期后也是如此。
* 幻象徽记或灵感符号可用于提升相关复制精英的属性等级。
* 玩家可以复制技能列表中没有的精英技能，但只有在满足一定条件时才能使用：
** 如果该技能是核心技能或属于帐户上可用的战役，则即使尚未解锁，玩家（及其英雄）也可以使用它。
** 如果该技能属于该帐户无法使用的战役，它将被复制到技能栏，但不能由可玩角色使用（保持锁定，就像 PvE 专用技能在 PvP 区域中一样）。
** 英雄可以复制和使用帐户可用和不可用的任何战役中的技能，但玩家不能强制使用他们不可用的战役中的技能。

bceef642ae1b40cef22fb1091ecb10d6fb131a4e.source:
* Arcane Thievery does not distinguish between spells that are already disabled or recharging. It can steal a spell that was already disabled by the effects of another skill, such as Diversion, or a recharging spell whose recharge exceeds the duration of Arcane Thievery's disabling effect, such as Meteor Shower.
* This cannot be activated on a target with no spells. "That target has no spells to steal." appears when you attempt to. 
* If you die when the duration of Arcane Thievery has not ended, the stolen spell on your skill bar will revert back to Arcane Thievery (similar to other skills that can copy skills); however, the target's spell will remain disabled for the full duration. This allows you to use Arcane Thievery to disable two spells at the same time if you are resurrected before the disable duration of the prior use of Arcane Thievery has ended.
* This can be used to interfere with skill chains on professions that tend to use only a few spells, e.g. primary Assassins.
bceef642ae1b40cef22fb1091ecb10d6fb131a4e.text:
* 奥术盗窃不区分已经禁用或正在充电的法术。它可以窃取一个已经被其他技能的效果禁用的法术，例如转移，或者一个充电法术，其充电时间超过奥术窃贼的禁用效果的持续时间，例如流星雨。
* 这无法对没有法术的目标激活。 “那个目标没有法术可以窃取。”当您尝试这样做时会出现。 
* 如果你在奥术窃贼持续时间未结束时死亡，技能栏上被盗的法术将恢复为奥术窃贼（类似于其他可以复制技能的技能）；然而，目标的法术将在整个持续时间内保持禁用状态。如果您在之前使用奥术窃贼的禁用持续时间结束之前复活，这允许您使用奥术窃贼同时禁用两个法术。
* 这可以用来干扰那些倾向于只使用少数法术的职业的技能链，例如初级刺客。

0c5ba6c9bee21aa371e9e0dbd8e22fa298152ab5.source:
* Combines well with both long-lasting and spammable enchantments, e.g. flash enchantment, Orders builds, or several Wind Prayers skills that rely on multiple enchantments (e.g. Mystic Healing and Dwayna's Touch).
* This spell counts the number of enchantments you have before you finish casting your current spell. For example, if your only enchantment is Arcane Zeal, casting Featherfoot Grace only returns 2 energy.
0c5ba6c9bee21aa371e9e0dbd8e22fa298152ab5.text:
* 与持久和垃圾邮件附魔完美结合，例如闪光附魔、命令构建或依赖于多种附魔的风之祈祷技能（例如神秘治疗和德薇娜之触）。
* 此法术会计算你施展当前法术之前所拥有的结界数量。例如，如果你唯一的结界是奥术狂热，施放羽足恩典只会返回 2 点能量。

a26118150b614ef6fc151e659a63ea705546245d.source: bug: This skill currently only grants 1 energy per enchantment
a26118150b614ef6fc151e659a63ea705546245d.text: bug：此技能目前每个结界仅提供 1 点能量

d562ddf009ec12be971858636e4203bdea5abeed.source:
* This skill extends any conditions you inflict as long as you are wielding a bow, including conditions from traps, spells, and skills like Throw Dirt. 
*Can be used with Technobabble to keep a group of enemies dazed
* The burning caused by Blazing Finale is also increased, no matter who cast it on the ranger.
* Does not increase the duration of conditions spread using Pestilence, however it does increase those transferred using Epidemic or Hypochondria.
This skill does not increase the amount of time a target is burning from Glyph of Immolation nor Mark of Rodgort.
d562ddf009ec12be971858636e4203bdea5abeed.text:
* 只要你挥舞着弓，该技能就会延伸你所造成的任何状况，包括来自陷阱、法术和投掷泥土等技能的状况。 
*可以与Technobabble一起使用来迷惑一群敌人
* 无论是谁对游侠施展炽热终章造成的燃烧也会增加。
* 不会增加使用瘟疫传播疾病的持续时间，但会增加使用流行病或疑病症传播的疾病的持续时间。
该技能不会增加目标被献祭雕文或罗德戈特印记燃烧的时间。

2f8f890fde57459aa742213f00c38cd620babe2a.source: bug: This skill does not increase the amount of time a target is burning from Glyph of Immolation nor Mark of Rodgort.
2f8f890fde57459aa742213f00c38cd620babe2a.text: bug：此技能不会增加目标被献祭雕文或罗德戈特印记燃烧的时间。

87dbb47135a7d1e269bdac94bd18c001cfb898ea.source: *Synergises well with Read the Wind or Favourable Winds, as both increase arrow speed.
87dbb47135a7d1e269bdac94bd18c001cfb898ea.text: *与“读风”或“顺风”很好地协同作用，因为两者都会增加箭头速度。

4a5e434d18bd744c87674d5271f5426e09d00f09.source: * Heroes do not use this skill unless in combat below 80 % health.
4a5e434d18bd744c87674d5271f5426e09d00f09.text: * 除非在战斗中生命值低于 80 %，否则英雄不会使用此技能。

d98640d860ad4e05635f00f3ef230ce58c7fc453.source:
*Incoming damage is reduced with this skill before Protective Spirit reduces damage.
*This skill is on the restricted list for Codex Arena.
d98640d860ad4e05635f00f3ef230ce58c7fc453.text:
*在防护精神减少伤害之前，该技能会减少传入的伤害。
*该技能在Codex Arena的限制列表中。

537bb7488cdba996d04b6f88c2555662c13786e2.source:
* The effect is applied on skill activation to spirits within range; it does not affect spirits summoned and/or brought within earshot afterward. 
* Damage reduction is applied after all other calculations. 
* Armor-ignoring damage will also be halved. 
* Integral part of the https://gwpvx.fandom.com/wiki/Build:Rt/any_Soul_Twisting_Prot_Hero PvX Wiki ST build, as the spirits lose half the health when their defensive benefits activate.
* The critical hit-prevention feature is important against martial attackers, since spirits are especially vulnerable to criticals, due to their inherently low levels.

This skill reduces the health loss of Shelter and Earthbind, but not that of Wanderlust or Agony.
537bb7488cdba996d04b6f88c2555662c13786e2.text:
* 该效果适用于范围内的精灵的技能发动；它不会影响随后被召唤和/或带到听力范围内的灵魂。 
* 伤害减免是在所有其他计算之后应用的。 
* 无视护甲的伤害也将减半。 
* https://gwpvx.fandom.com/wiki/Build:Rt/any_Soul_Twisting_Prot_Hero PvX Wiki ST 构建的组成部分，因为当灵魂的防御优势激活时，他们会失去一半的生命值。
* 致命一击预防功能对于武术攻击者来说非常重要，因为灵魂由于其固有的低等级而特别容易受到致命一击。

该技能可以减少“庇护所”和“地缚”的生命值损失，但不会减少“流浪癖”或“痛苦”的生命值损失。

009ed89badf2a9251bac6f2cdce74ea89661a69f.source: anomaly: This skill reduces the health loss of Shelter and Earthbind, but not that of Wanderlust or Agony.
009ed89badf2a9251bac6f2cdce74ea89661a69f.text: 异常：该技能可以减少庇护所和地缚的生命值损失，但不会减少流浪癖或痛苦的生命值损失。

6947aea56592eba5bcab227f8a94820c62d549c8.source:
* Ash Blast does not count as a hex spell unless it hits a burning foe. Skills that check for hexed foes (e.g. Soul Barbs) or skills that trigger when the user casts a hex spell (e.g. Elemental Flame) do not trigger if Ash Blast does not hit a burning foe.
* If used with Glyph of Immolation, the burning triggers first, thus meeting the requirement to apply the hex spell on the target.
6947aea56592eba5bcab227f8a94820c62d549c8.text:
* 灰烬冲击不算是降咒法术，除非它击中了正在燃烧的敌人。如果灰烬冲击没有击中燃烧的敌人，则检查降咒敌人的技能（例如灵魂倒刺）或在用户施放降咒法术时触发的技能（例如元素火焰）不会触发。
* 如果与献祭雕文一起使用，燃烧会首先触发，从而满足对目标施加降咒法术的要求。

18111e326c0cb4277b69165ea618c92f5c1133db.source:
* This skill only recharges Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet or Celestial skills if they were disabled by another skill (e.g. by Distracting Shot); it will not recharge them if they were used successfully.
* Assassin's Promise stacks and recharges itself.
** Synergizes well with Glyph of Sacrifice and skills with a long recharge time such as Meteor Shower.
* Heroes will not cast this skill on targets already hexed with Assassin's Promise, even though it can be stacked (i.e. each caster will receive the energy gain and skill recharge when the foe dies).
18111e326c0cb4277b69165ea618c92f5c1133db.text:
* 此技能仅在复活徽记、阳矛重生徽记或天界技能被其他技能（例如分散射击）禁用时才对其进行充能；如果使用成功，则不会为其充电。
* 刺客的承诺会自行堆叠和充电。
** 与牺牲雕文和流星雨等蓄能时间较长的技能有很好的协同作用。
*英雄不会对已经被刺客承诺诅咒的目标施放此技能，即使它可以叠加（即每个施法者在敌人死亡时都会获得能量增益和技能回复）。

1d4163006df33b88c011ccd6aead987b43cedcd6.source:
* Unlike Grenth's Grasp, Assassin's Remedy does not require you to hit with an attack skill.
* Conditions are removed before the attack skill connects. This is useful for preventing blind from stopping your combo. This means the enchantment will be removed before your last attack skill hits.
Using a pet attack while enchanted with Assassin's Remedy doesn't remove a condition, unlike Zealous Anthem and Anthem of Fury.
1d4163006df33b88c011ccd6aead987b43cedcd6.text:
* 与古兰斯之握不同，刺客的补救措施不需要你使用攻击技能进行攻击。
* 攻击技能连接前条件被解除。这对于防止盲人停止你的连击很有用。这意味着结界将在你最后一次攻击技能命中之前被移除。
与《热忱赞歌》和《狂怒赞歌》不同，在附魔刺客药剂时使用宠物攻击不会消除某种状况。

3b96bff82e9a9a345a0cb43edee5980a25ceef01.source: anomaly: Using a pet attack while enchanted with Assassin's Remedy doesn't remove a condition, unlike Zealous Anthem and Anthem of Fury.
3b96bff82e9a9a345a0cb43edee5980a25ceef01.text: 异常：与《热忱赞歌》和《狂怒赞歌》不同，在被刺客药剂附魔时使用宠物攻击不会消除某种状况。

7220028077bc5f2065086993634c7bf1c3b78b37.source:
* The caster receives the Death Penalty reduction when the hexed foe dies, regardless of who delivered the killing blow.
* If you kill a boss hexed with Asuran Scan, the order of effects is to your favor. You will first lose 5% Death Penalty and then gain the morale boost.
* This hex only applies to attacks that would be blocked and attacks affected by Blindness or skill effects that cause attacks to miss; it does not prevent hits from straying, being obstructed, or being dodged. It also does not prevent failure due to unmet requirements, e.g. Oath Shot will still fail 50% of the time if Expertise is below 8, and lead, off-hand, and dual attacks must still be executed in the correct sequence.
* This is the only hex without a specified activation time. It casts instantly, but it has an aftercast delay and cannot be used in mid-action.

Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.

While target foe is hexed, you cannot miss other foes.

This hex also prevents the target from blocking your attacks.
7220028077bc5f2065086993634c7bf1c3b78b37.text:
* 当施咒的敌人死亡时，无论是谁造成了致命一击，施法者都会获得死刑减免。
* 如果你杀死了一个被阿苏兰扫描诅咒的 Boss，效果的顺序对你有利。你将首先失去5%死刑，然后获得士气提升。
* 此降咒仅适用于会被格挡的攻击以及受失明或技能效果影响而导致攻击失败的攻击；它不能防止命中偏离、被阻挡或被躲避。它也不能防止由于未满足要求而导致的失败，例如如果专长低于8，誓言射击仍有50%次失败，并且主攻、副手和双重攻击仍然必须以正确的顺序执行。
* 这是唯一没有指定激活时间的降咒。它会立即施法，但有施法后的延迟，无法在行动中使用。

受此技能影响的敌人不会失手。

当目标敌人被施咒时，你不会错过其他敌人。

这个六角形还可以防止目标阻挡你的攻击。

abdaa38774de06bf9ff9116ada0cf10b43732980.source: bug: Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.

ac8e7446eda7ad972a40479e7eadea68f5861c32.source:

* Unlike other maintained enchantments, heroes will use this skill on their own, but will not dismiss it or recast it once enchanted.
Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.
ac8e7446eda7ad972a40479e7eadea68f5861c32.text:
* 与所有法术一样，该技能有 0.75 秒的施法延迟。

* 与其他维护的结界不同，英雄会自己使用该技能，但结界后不会将其解除或重铸。
与其他针对敌人的结界类似，受到亵渎之井或灵魂影响的敌人不能成为该结界的目标。

55af1d2778f61af1cc7347917906a4d706f14645.source:
* This skill can only be captured from Mursaat monk bosses.

;Game mechanics
* Unlike Healer's Boon and Unyielding Aura, this skill also affects other healing sources, including Divine Favor and Divine Boon. 
** Aura of Faith increases the Divine Favor healing of itself.
* If you cast Spirit Bond first and then Aura of Faith, it will increase Spirit Bond's healing and then decrease the damage. But if you cast Aura of Faith first, it will reduce the incoming damage before Spirit Bond checks if it is over 50 (resulting in fewer heals from Spirit Bond).
55af1d2778f61af1cc7347917906a4d706f14645.text:
* 该技能只能从Mursaat 武僧 Boss 处获得。

；游戏机制
* 与治疗者恩惠和不屈光环不同，该技能还会影响其他治疗源，包括神圣恩惠和神圣恩赐。 
** 信仰光环增加神圣恩惠自身的治疗效果。
* 如果先施放灵魂羁绊，然后施放信仰光环，则会增加灵魂羁绊的治疗效果，然后减少伤害。但如果你先施放信仰光环，如果超过 50，它会在灵魂羁绊检查之前减少传入的伤害（导致灵魂羁绊的治疗量减少）。

cd9af4bccf7c6a9aee7c1236feddd3193faf89e1.source:
With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).
*After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
*The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*This skill triggers itself when it ends.
*Pious Renewal synergizes with this skill because of its "recharge on end" effect.
cd9af4bccf7c6a9aee7c1236feddd3193faf89e1.text:
对于移除“所有结界”的技能（例如纯洁沉思），除了永恒光环、力量之盾、古兰斯光环或革命誓言之外，每个苦行僧结界都会触发该技能的伤害实例。相比之下，如果特定数量的结界被移除（例如通过撕裂结界或苦行僧拆解），则对于哪些苦行僧结界将触发伤害没有限制，只要它们覆盖了神圣力量光环（加上神圣力量光环本身）。
*达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
*Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
*该技能结束时会自行触发。
*虔诚的更新因其“结束充电”效果而与该技能产生协同作用。

edea46d390d91f42b555fa225f0884fc02b0f674.source:
* Due to its short cast time and low energy cost, Aura of Restoration makes a good cover enchantment.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
edea46d390d91f42b555fa225f0884fc02b0f674.text:
* 由于其施法时间短和能量消耗低，恢复光环是一个很好的覆盖结界。
* 此结界的治疗效果仅考虑法术的基本消耗，没有任何修饰符，例如弱能雕文或加速和风。

79429dc622f114f6c3bf936530746aa04ab64148.source:
* Aura of the Lich does not target a corpse, and is unaffected by equipping a Bloodstained Insignia.
* This skill is the only way to raise a minion without any corpses being available. Malign Intervention creates a masterless minion when the foe dies.
* The +1 Death Magic buff activates after any minions are summoned.
* The skill indeed exploits all corpses in range regardless of how many minions the caster's allowed to control, in this case the extra minions will die immediately.
** This will often replenish the caster's energy provided they have points in Soul Reaping.
79429dc622f114f6c3bf936530746aa04ab64148.text:
* 巫妖光环不以尸体为目标，并且不受装备血污徽章的影响。
* 此技能是在没有任何尸体的情况下养育随从的唯一方法。当敌人死亡时，恶意干预会创造出一个无主的仆从。
* +1 死亡魔法增益会在召唤任何小兵后激活。
* 该技能确实会利用范围内的所有尸体，无论施法者允许控制多少小兵，在这种情况下，多余的小兵将立即死亡。
** 如果施法者在灵魂收割中拥有积分，这通常会补充施法者的能量。

c903a95010e98066c028e04ecd39486186dff1f1.source:

*Cracked armor is applied after the attack's damage.
c903a95010e98066c028e04ecd39486186dff1f1.text:

* The fastest way to capture this skill is to start the Raisu Palace mission, as Sword Ancient Kai is near the beginning of the mission.
* This is one of the few Factions elite skills that are obtainable in Nightfall; however, if you do not own Factions, you won't be able to capture it.
* This is one of the skills with the lowest adrenal cost, the others being the monster skills, Jadoth's Storm of Judgment and Ehzah from Above.
* The adrenaline is also gained on renew.
* Can fuel itself provided that at least 2 seconds lie between activation and the block. Can also maintain adrenaline outside combat if you have atleast 1 strike of adrenaline required to activate the stance, as adrenaline is gained when the stance ends.
5112b19c1577c425c54bdd33cd265c9e251e8bf6.text:
* 获取此技能的最快方法是开始赖寿宫任务，因为剑古凯即将开始任务。
* 这是在《夜幕降临》中可获得的少数派系精英技能之一；但是，如果您不拥有派系，您将无法占领它。
* 这是肾上腺消耗最低的技能之一，其他技能是怪物技能、贾多斯的审判风暴和伊扎从天而降。
* 更新时也会获得肾上腺素。
* 可以为自己提供燃料，前提是激活和阻止之间至少有 2 秒。如果您需要至少 1 次肾上腺素来激活姿势，则还可以在战斗外维持肾上腺素，因为姿势结束时会获得肾上腺素。

dfbc4a39b7156760ed795761c27df01e95a355ef.source:

dfbc4a39b7156760ed795761c27df01e95a355ef.text:

190f965645fd65feb326ef9374c8ecb1b39d34cd.text:

de9af6512c5d610ac9e0b017743cce20840ee301.source: * This skill requires exactly 220 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 8 strikes and 20 units.
de9af6512c5d610ac9e0b017743cce20840ee301.text: * 该技能正好需要 220 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 8 次打击和 20 单位。

f84213608395eb54a57d95b4330169bb5c700c1a.source:
* Wastrel's Worry and Demise can be used as cover hexes and to pressure the target to act prematurely.
* The damage is triggered by successful activation of a spell, but it is applied before the spell takes effect. Accordingly, targets will take damage if they use a spell to remove Backfire; they can also die by casting a healing spell.
* Similar to Chaos Storm, the AI in normal mode will only use this skill on a foe wielding a staff or wand, even if the potential target is a spellcaster-primary profession foe with 8 spells on their skill bar. [Source claim needs verification]
f84213608395eb54a57d95b4330169bb5c700c1a.text:
* 废物的忧虑和死亡可以用作掩护六角形并迫使目标过早采取行动。
* 伤害由法术成功激活而触发，但在法术生效之前应用。因此，如果目标使用法术消除逆火，就会受到伤害；他们也可以通过施放治疗咒语而死亡。
* 与混沌风暴类似，正常模式下的AI只会对挥舞着法杖或魔杖的敌人使用此技能，即使潜在目标是技能栏上有8个法术的施法者主要职业敌人。 [来源声明需要验证]

3587e98e84ce7a64ec30d1f58cc1f997ae7cec81.text:

* 从该法术中获得的肾上腺素以点数的形式存在（肾上腺素攻击的 1/25 次）。
* 即使你受到 0 点伤害，你仍然会获得能量。

2de1103282901b14a2e3c7bdcd651529f316a1b5.source: * Since holy damage is already doubled against undead creatures, minions take quadruple the listed damage from this skill.
2de1103282901b14a2e3c7bdcd651529f316a1b5.text: * 由于对不死生物的神圣伤害已经加倍，小兵会受到该技能所列伤害的四倍。

62089ee66186adc7d37e3d17b4017a8b62f1506c.source:
* This skill replaces your base attack damage with the stated armor ignoring holy damage; only that amount is doubled versus summoned creatures. Other sources of bonus damage (such as Strength of Honor) are still added, but will not be doubled.
* Minions take quadruple the listed damage from this skill, since holy damage is already doubled against undead creatures.
62089ee66186adc7d37e3d17b4017a8b62f1506c.text:
* 该技能将你的基础攻击伤害替换为指定的护甲伤害，忽略神圣伤害；与召唤生物相比，只有该数量加倍。其他额外伤害来源（例如荣誉之力）仍然会增加，但不会加倍。
* 小兵受到该技能所列伤害的四倍，因为对不死生物的神圣伤害已经加倍。

2ddf91b90475abcc5073bc107c02a0a7fa65ed11.source:
*Like Sever Artery, it combines well with Gash.
*Stances that end on attack skills will not prevent Barbarous Slice from inflicting Bleeding.
2ddf91b90475abcc5073bc107c02a0a7fa65ed11.text:
*与 Sever Artery 一样，它与 Gash 结合得很好。
*以攻击技能结束的姿态不会阻止野蛮切片造成流血。

aaa067de9898316704ab743015fe75353adb1ea4.source:
* -40 armor results in double damage from skills that are affected by armor rating.
The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the armor cap and the effects of Cracked Armor and armor penetration.
aaa067de9898316704ab743015fe75353adb1ea4.text:
* -40 护甲会导致受护甲等级影响的技能造成双倍伤害。
该技能的护甲减值会在护甲上限以及护甲破裂和护甲穿透效果之后应用。

f4d3cdbcb33b4eb219c83caabcb63b0804c4479c.source: anomaly: The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the armor cap and the effects of Cracked Armor and armor penetration.
f4d3cdbcb33b4eb219c83caabcb63b0804c4479c.text: 异常：该技能的护甲减值是在护甲上限以及护甲破裂和护甲穿透效果之后应用的。

9dbec4d1f172ea61228af74e590aa69965bfa17a.source: *Good synergy with Disrupting Throw, Stunning Strike, and Maiming Spear.
9dbec4d1f172ea61228af74e590aa69965bfa17a.text: *与干扰投掷、眩晕打击和致残矛有良好的协同作用。

9b8408c2b2c3bc86403ae229e3d35cf1d99c2f27.source:
* This can be a very useful tool for taking down a powerful, single target when used with allies (e.g. minions) that deal physical damage.
* Damage from this skill is dealt as a separate packet from the damage which triggers it.
Causes skills such as Xinrae's Weapon and Vengeful Weapon to trigger twice.
9b8408c2b2c3bc86403ae229e3d35cf1d99c2f27.text:
* 当与造成物理伤害的盟友（例如小兵）一起使用时，这可能是一个非常有用的工具，可以用来击倒强大的单一目标。
* 该技能造成的伤害与触发该技能的伤害分开处理。
导致辛莱武器、复仇武器等技能触发两次。

17d4c7c8f6e289e2cc8501ce2219f769acb9a24e.source: bug: Causes skills such as Xinrae's Weapon and Vengeful Weapon to trigger twice.
17d4c7c8f6e289e2cc8501ce2219f769acb9a24e.text: bug：导致辛莱武器、复仇武器等技能触发两次。

e3c5ffcb9eca3ae8d554f8cbd8605ef341267e5f.source:
* Each of Barrage's arrows counts as a separate attack. Effects that trigger on attack/hit can trigger multiple times; however, some skills have no effect, or only affect the first arrow.
** If Barrage is combined with Paragon shouts or chants that apply conditions or damage boosts such as Anthem of Flame or "Find Their Weakness!", the condition and/or bonus damage will be applied randomly to one of the foes hit by Barrage rather than all of them.
* Barrage can be used to maintain adrenaline skills, since each arrow that hits will provide one strike of adrenaline. 
* Since the extra arrows are fired at foes adjacent to your target, always try to target an enemy in the middle of a large group.
* Combine with Splinter Weapon for a large area of effect spike.
e3c5ffcb9eca3ae8d554f8cbd8605ef341267e5f.text:
* 弹幕的每支箭都算作一次单独的攻击。攻击/击中时触发的效果可以多次触发；然而，有些技能没有任何效果，或者只影响第一支箭。
** 如果弹幕与应用条件或伤害提升（例如火焰圣歌或“找到他们的弱点！”）的Paragon呼喊或圣歌相结合，则条件和/或额外伤害将随机应用于弹幕击中的一个敌人，而不是全部。
* 弹幕可以用来维持肾上腺素技能，因为每击中的箭都会提供一次肾上腺素。 
* 由于额外的箭是向目标附近的敌人发射的，因此请始终尝试瞄准大群中间的敌人。
* 与裂片武器结合使用可产生大面积的效果峰值。

8a16562e1c9464c7cd0974c99c81ea3c920c3b17.source:
* This skill only increases the base adrenaline from hitting with an attack, not any other attack effects that grant adrenaline (such as Knee Cutter and Steelfang Slash).
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* Can be maintained even with rank 0 in Strength as long as the user continuously hits a foe successfully (i.e. not have all attacks be blocked, miss, be obstructed, etc.) while this stance is active.
* Due to effect stacking, this stance will not stack with other skills which increase adrenaline gain, such as "For Great Justice!".
8a16562e1c9464c7cd0974c99c81ea3c920c3b17.text:
* 该技能仅增加攻击击中时的基础肾上腺素，不会增加任何其他可提供肾上腺素的攻击效果（例如膝斩和钢牙斩）。
* 该技能恰好需要80单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此3次打击和5单位。
* 即使力量等级为 0，只要用户在该姿势处于活动状态时连续成功击中敌人（即没有所有攻击被格挡、未击中、被阻碍等），就可以保持。
* 由于效果叠加，该姿势不会与其他增加肾上腺素增益的技能叠加，例如“为了伟大的正义！”。

804421c5455e268db5e1de5094e36e28e5b165d9.source:
*When timed correctly this skill synergizes well with Meteor Shower in PvE, as enemies generally fail to spread out before the first packet of Meteor Shower damage (and knock down) hits.
*The animation for this skill was not changed since its area of effect size changed from nearby to adjacent. The AoE range of this ability therefore looks larger than it actually is.
804421c5455e268db5e1de5094e36e28e5b165d9.text:
*如果时机正确，该技能可以与 PvE 中的流星雨很好地协同作用，因为敌人通常无法在第一包流星雨伤害（和击倒）命中之前分散开来。
*该技能的动画没有改变，因为它的效果范围从附近变成了相邻。因此，该能力的 AoE 范围看起来比实际更大。

4a053be5e51961626d05bc193a6513347e26bc67.source:
* The AI will use this skill on targets without any equipped spells. [Source claim needs verification]
* The AI will sometimes use this skill only to interrupt.
4a053be5e51961626d05bc193a6513347e26bc67.text:
* AI将对没有任何装备法术的目标使用此技能。 [来源声明需要验证]
* AI有时只会使用此技能来打断。

eaefd172272b28f51fe7d74ddeda769ef0dfad64.source:
* Both the full and concise descriptions fail to note that the target is also blinded.
* Normal mode foe AI will use this skill on any target, including a target that is not knocked down; they will not wait to use this skill on a knocked down target even if they have a skill that can cause knock down (e.g. Grawl). Hero and hard mode foe AI will only use this skill on a knocked down target.
eaefd172272b28f51fe7d74ddeda769ef0dfad64.text:
* 完整和简洁的描述都没有注意到目标也是盲目的。
*普通模式敌人AI会对任何目标使用该技能，包括没有被击倒的目标；即使他们拥有可以导致击倒的技能（例如Grawl），他们也不会等待对被击倒的目标使用此技能。英雄和困难模式的敌人 AI 只会对被击倒的目标使用此技能。

598443ebb97c950d16747b2334d2d718827361bc.source:
*This stance ends as a skill finishes activation, apparently before the activation itself.
** Attack skills will benefit from the faster attack speed, but not from the 100% bonus adrenaline.
** Barbarous Slice will cause bleeding, Standing Slash and the "Dance with Death" inscription (with an attack skill) will not grant bonus damage, so you are not considered in a stance for related effects.
*Berserker Stance helps quickly build adrenaline for skills such as Brawling Headbutt and "On Your Knees!", which can in exchange recharge this stance.
598443ebb97c950d16747b2334d2d718827361bc.text:
*此姿势随着技能完成激活而结束，显然是在激活本身之前。
** 攻击技能会受益于更快的攻击速度，但不会受益于100%的肾上腺素加成。
** 野蛮切片会造成流血，立斩和“与死亡共舞”铭文（带有攻击技能）不会给予额外伤害，因此你不考虑处于姿态中的相关效果。
*狂战士姿态有助于快速增强肾上腺素，以提高诸如争吵头撞和“跪下！”等技能，这可以作为交换为该姿态充电。

640f9e328da8e58f6c9917757daa6a749bf84101.source: * Synergizes with Bestial Mauling to inflict Daze.
640f9e328da8e58f6c9917757daa6a749bf84101.text: * 与野兽猛击协同作用，造成眩晕。

206e4beb46c8910640619cacb768120210c20c85.source:
* This is the only Ritualist skill capable of snaring an opponent.
* This hex will last for a total of 5 seconds when used with Anguished Was Lingwah.
206e4beb46c8910640619cacb768120210c20c85.text:
* 这是唯一能够诱捕对手的仪式技能。
* 当与 Anguished Was Lingwah 一起使用时，该降咒将持续总共 5 秒。

18e34794534aa911a8fe94c108dd341262b890dc.source:
* The instant recharge of this skill ignores the effect of Diversion.
* Useful against bosses for sustained damage per second.
18e34794534aa911a8fe94c108dd341262b890dc.text:
* 该技能的瞬间充能无视牵制效果。
* 可用于对抗 Boss，每秒造成持续伤害。

a648da36ed04bfd0b437c2077c64f3e78368ebe4.source: * Like other attack skills, the attack occurs halfway through the activation, meaning it actually only takes 0.5 second.
a648da36ed04bfd0b437c2077c64f3e78368ebe4.text: * 与其他攻击技能一样，攻击发生在激活的一半，这意味着实际上只需要0.5秒。

eceac3be8e7c0ec97426428cd6a08bf728703954.source:
*Bleeding covers blind.
*There appears to be no animation for the activation of this skill; however, its triggering animation is similar to Spike Trap or Barbed Trap.
This skill deals fire damage that does not ignore armor.
eceac3be8e7c0ec97426428cd6a08bf728703954.text:
*流血掩盖了盲目。
*该技能似乎没有激活动画；然而，它的触发动画类似于尖刺陷阱或倒刺陷阱。
该技能造成的火焰伤害不忽略护甲。

5d85157aedb9262c71ed02b6e859d98b43e59bde.source: anomaly: This skill deals fire damage that does not ignore armor.
5d85157aedb9262c71ed02b6e859d98b43e59bde.text: 异常：该技能造成的火焰伤害不忽略护甲。

8f49108908ce55bfd2297269d11a8bcc5847300c.source: * You can use this skill as an interrupt, since any skill being activated by the target when he is blacked out will fail at the end of the skill's activation time. This has the advantage that the skill will be interrupted even when the target is using anti-interruption skills, such as Glyph of Concentration or Mantra of Concentration.
8f49108908ce55bfd2297269d11a8bcc5847300c.text: * 你可以使用该技能作为打断，因为目标在昏迷状态下激活的任何技能都会在技能激活时间结束时失败。这样做的好处是，即使目标使用反打断技能，例如专注雕文或专注咒语，技能也会被打断。

6ad05118ffcc342ab1f7c3b2786b9d206bb64f12.source:
Melee attacks also contribute to the bonus damage of this skill.
* This skill counts itself as recharging for the damage bonus. These are the number of recharging melee attack skills required for maximum damage:

近战攻击也会增加该技能的伤害加成。
* 该技能本身算作伤害加成的充能。这些是最大伤害所需的近战攻击技能充电次数：

8a0c061208da1131af62482f07c9b0308b653eeb.source: bug: Melee attacks also contribute to the bonus damage of this skill.
8a0c061208da1131af62482f07c9b0308b653eeb.text: bug：近战攻击也会增加该技能的伤害加成。

257bca42c78c2ee39dd89e69f01cd99584afa6c9.source:
*Skills such as "Dodge This!", "Go for the Eyes!" and "The Power Is Yours!" can allow to maintain burning on adjacent foes.

*Has synergy with "They're on Fire!".
257bca42c78c2ee39dd89e69f01cd99584afa6c9.text:
*诸如“躲避这个！”、“瞄准眼睛！”等技能和“力量是你的！”可以让邻近的敌人保持燃烧。

*与“他们着火了！”有协同作用。

39c374ebdc3dc64981caa6ea67ffc1c54bec37d5.source: *Good synergy with "Go for the Eyes!" and "The Power Is Yours!" when cast on melee allies.
39c374ebdc3dc64981caa6ea67ffc1c54bec37d5.text: *与“Go for the Eyes!”有良好的协同作用和“力量是你的！”当对近战盟友施放时。

05b79864b5626c48f0b18f54774302afeafe2bde.source: * The effect stacks with an "of Enchanting" weapon modifier, with the order depending on which effect was active on the character first (see of Enchanting for details). The duration is rounded after each effect.
05b79864b5626c48f0b18f54774302afeafe2bde.text: * 该效果与“附魔”武器修饰符叠加，顺序取决于角色上首先激活的效果（详细信息请参阅附魔）。每个效果后的持续时间都会四舍五入。

9eb6fbc6455f0d3443ce629783279dc1554ad792.source: *Very useful at providing a lot of utility in a single skill slot and with a short recharge.
9eb6fbc6455f0d3443ce629783279dc1554ad792.text: *非常有用，可以在单个技能槽中提供大量实用程序，并且只需短暂充电即可。

5391347f322ae9599fe16a0692c99078716bebbe.source:
* This skill is commonly used by bonder monks, with skills like Life Bond and Life Barrier. 
* Hero monks tend to spam this skill if they have less than maximum energy. This is at the expense of casting needed healing or protection prayers during heated battles. Consider disabling this skill before battling large mobs and activate the skill manually when energy is low.
5391347f322ae9599fe16a0692c99078716bebbe.text:
* 该技能为束缚僧常用，拥有生命束缚、生命屏障等技能。 
* 如果英雄武僧的能量低于最大能量，他们往往会使用该技能。这是以在激烈的战斗中施放所需的治疗或保护祈祷为代价的。考虑在与大怪战斗之前禁用该技能，并在能量较低时手动激活该技能。

370a419b7184544afbb33002685230ce06193450.source: *The AI maintains this skill out of combat. It doesn't move to the foe to drop the item, but rather waits for the foe to come. The AI also drops this item on any foe regardless of whether the foe is blinded or not nor whether it is a physical attacker or spellcaster.
370a419b7184544afbb33002685230ce06193450.text: *人工智能在战斗之外保留该技能。它不会移动到敌人身边掉落物品，而是等待敌人到来。 AI也会将此物品扔到任何敌人身上，无论敌人是否失明，也无论敌人是物理攻击者还是施法者。

69934495f8ffe3ebb0ae679a0f943ea09669b601.source:
* In Normal mode, the AI will only use this skill on a foe wielding a martial weapon (similar to Eruption and Signet of Midnight). In Hard mode, the AI will only use this skill on a martial primary profession foe wielding a martial weapon. This is similar to Throw Dirt. 
This skill can be used on a spirit but it will not inflict blindness.
69934495f8ffe3ebb0ae679a0f943ea09669b601.text:
* 在普通模式下，AI只会对使用军用武器的敌人使用此技能（类似于爆发和午夜徽记）。在困难模式下，AI只会对挥舞着武术武器的武术初级职业敌人使用此技能。这与扔污垢类似。 
该技能可以对灵魂使用，但不会造成失明。

1f97934cefc960fb9015224f1186ed9f08f0db15.source: anomaly: This skill can be used on a spirit but it will not inflict blindness.
1f97934cefc960fb9015224f1186ed9f08f0db15.text: 异常：该技能可以对灵魂使用，但不会造成失明。

47ea4c64caa60b5bb3e572ba374427a4a1c288c7.source: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Sandstorm and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
47ea4c64caa60b5bb3e572ba374427a4a1c288c7.text: 与所有其他既造成伤害又造成额外伤害的元素使技能（沙尘暴和手内之风除外）不同，该技能的额外伤害不会在单独的包中造成。

138a8164b6166d75661b1078073311ba2b39412d.source: anomaly: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Sandstorm and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
138a8164b6166d75661b1078073311ba2b39412d.text: 异常：与所有其他同时造成伤害和额外伤害的元素师技能（除了沙暴和手内之风）不同，该技能的额外伤害不会在单独的数据包中造成。

fc2c126e84ed96e7dd583eeecbfd0c4cc7c845ba.source:
* The deep wound is applied before the damage; if the deep wound brings the health of the target below zero, that foe will die without the need for a separate trigger.

Similar to Life Siphon and enchantments with upkeep, if a hexed foe moves out of compass range of the caster, Augury of Death will end.
fc2c126e84ed96e7dd583eeecbfd0c4cc7c845ba.text:
*深伤口在损伤前涂抹；如果深伤口使目标的生命值低于零，则该敌人将在不需要单独触发的情况下死亡。

与生命虹吸和维持结界类似，如果施咒的敌人移出施法者的罗盘范围，死亡预兆就会结束。

256e7834a43558791ea5385d3dd99d62a0443a06.source: anomaly: Similar to Life Siphon and enchantments with upkeep, if a hexed foe moves out of compass range of the caster, Augury of Death will end.
256e7834a43558791ea5385d3dd99d62a0443a06.text: 异常：与生命虹吸和维持结界类似，如果施咒的敌人移出施法者的罗盘范围，死亡预兆就会结束。

bbb92d4b835779476d94c363b2e0e76a0f19af65.source:
* Synergy with offensive spirits summoned by binding rituals, since spirits will gain health when attacking foes hexed with this spell.
* Foes attacking masterless minions hexed with this spell will gain health. 
* Consider casting this to counter the damage from Afflicted Soul Explosion and/or Death Nova.
bbb92d4b835779476d94c363b2e0e76a0f19af65.text:
* 与通过束缚仪式召唤的攻击性灵魂产生协同作用，因为灵魂在攻击被该法术咒语的敌人时会获得生命值。
* 攻击被该法术施咒的无主仆从的敌人将会获得生命值。 
* 考虑施放此技能来对抗受折磨的灵魂爆炸和/或死亡新星造成的伤害。

f3e1f78cea94610c97878ae65a013214e07aa883.text: * 与安戈罗顿的凝视协同作用。

bb5c7dd3b00df7c7c3ce6a90d637b0964f8dd435.source:
See: Battery
* The health sacrifice is rounded half to even and can be as low as 0 if the maximum health of the user is low enough, which makes it possible to continuously use the skill without actually losing health.
** To reach 1 health, a character can wear multiple armor pieces with superior attribute runes, stack Death Penalty and even wear some equipment such as the -50 health Grim Cesta or offhand items with a "Life is Pain" inscription.
** Awaken the Blood does not increase the health sacrifice to a lethal amount for a character with a maximum health of 1.
bb5c7dd3b00df7c7c3ce6a90d637b0964f8dd435.text:
请参阅：电池
* 生命值牺牲四舍五入到偶数，如果用户的最大生命值足够低，则可以低至 0，这使得可以连续使用该技能而不会实际失去生命值。
** 为了达到 1 生命值，角色可以穿戴多件具有高级属性符文的盔甲，叠加死刑，甚至穿戴一些装备，例如 -50 生命值的 Grim Cesta 或刻有“Life is Pain”字样的副手物品。
** 对于最大生命值为 1 的角色，唤醒热血不会将生命值牺牲增加至致命量。

eb7e8cb2614300ae06782437aae180466c68cda7.source: bug: Heroes will spam this skill on allies with heavy overcast, regardless of what percentage of energy the ally has.
eb7e8cb2614300ae06782437aae180466c68cda7.text: bug：英雄会向阴云密布的盟友发送该技能，无论该盟友的能量百分比是多少。

4d283a60c7a6f0060aafaee38f8b88354df21fe8.source:
* Where Verata's Sacrifice works on your own minions, Blood of the Master heals all allied minions, including those in separate parties. Be careful when using this skill if there is another minion master around.
* A minion master spamming this skill can often keep their minions alive for periods far exceeding their usual life span; however, such a player can be a large drain on their party's healer.
* If your party has multiple minion masters, heroes will kill themselves with this skill if not having access to strong self-healing. To counteract this, consider bringing Taste of Death on that hero, since this makes them much less likely to die. 
* It is even possible to kill yourself at full health by using this skill; with at least 48 minions, you will sacrifice 101% health.
The concise description is wrong regarding only healing your own minions.
4d283a60c7a6f0060aafaee38f8b88354df21fe8.text:
* 维拉塔的牺牲对你自己的小兵起作用，而大师之血则可以治疗所有盟友的小兵，包括单独队伍中的小兵。如果周围有其他随从大师，则使用此技能时要小心。
* 拥有此技能的小兵大师通常可以让他们的小兵存活的时间远远超过他们通常的寿命；然而，这样的玩家可能会对队伍的治疗造成很大的消耗。
* 如果你的队伍有多个小兵大师，英雄在没有强大的自我治疗能力的情况下会用这个技能自杀。为了解决这个问题，请考虑为该英雄带来死亡之味，因为这会大大降低他们死亡的可能性。 
* 使用该技能甚至可以在健康状态下自杀；拥有至少 48 个小兵，你将牺牲 101% 点生命值。
关于仅治疗自己的随从的简洁描述是错误的。

91e13015ff7c7335c5da44e26ac3ab1787fb1ac1.source: bug: The concise description is wrong regarding only healing your own minions.
91e13015ff7c7335c5da44e26ac3ab1787fb1ac1.text: bug：关于只治疗自己的小兵，简洁的描述是错误的。

3e8ba9296494bbcdca05b6af685a02e57b0b681d.source:
Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
Despite causing healing, this skill cannot trigger Scourge Healing.
3e8ba9296494bbcdca05b6af685a02e57b0b681d.text:
与完整描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。
尽管会造成治疗，但该技能无法触发天灾治疗。
