6a846fdeac6484a27ba83fa29f6ce9e3c0b6a994.text: bug：与完整描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

c02406ebb34b5ea2a9b7f5d0d0ec1f94479854de.source: bug: Despite causing healing, this skill cannot trigger Scourge Healing.
c02406ebb34b5ea2a9b7f5d0d0ec1f94479854de.text: bug：尽管会造成治疗，但该技能无法触发天灾治疗。

599707e393500da9aa75ce6fb380b6f76ea67803.source: The concise description omits that this is a touch-range skill.
599707e393500da9aa75ce6fb380b6f76ea67803.text: 简洁的描述省略了这是一个接触范围技能。

e66d45084d42e6a96ae4771d8d6d0bbe0dee562f.source: bug: Heroes use this skill on overcast targets that cannot gain any energy.
e66d45084d42e6a96ae4771d8d6d0bbe0dee562f.text: bug：英雄对无法获得任何能量的阴天目标使用此技能。

77fbe57d45d00c4d1a26fdde91c72f88116c3a41.source: bug: The concise description omits that this is a touch-range skill.
77fbe57d45d00c4d1a26fdde91c72f88116c3a41.text: bug：简洁的描述忽略了这是一个接触范围技能。

8093bd4a32dc55f675117b44ab2b82413aa9b138.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Blood Song that uses the Bloodsong attack skill.
* The attacks made by the Spirit of Blood Song steal health from its target for its own benefit, not for the benefit of the player who spawned the spirit.
** Since the Spirit of Blood Song heals itself, it is a prime candidate for use with Spirit Transfer.
* Combine with Spiritleech Aura to gain additional life stealing.
* The attacks used by this spirit steal health, so it does not receive the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might.
8093bd4a32dc55f675117b44ab2b82413aa9b138.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用血歌攻击技能的血歌之灵。
* 血歌之灵发起的攻击会为了自身利益而窃取目标的生命值，而不是为了生成该灵体的玩家的利益。
** 由于血歌之魂可以自我治愈，因此它是与精神转移一起使用的最佳候选者。
* 与Spiritleech Aura结合以获得额外的生命窃取。
* 该精魂使用的攻击会窃取生命值，因此不会受到鬼威徽记的额外伤害。

9a2dbf13923240f080de460009cd11f2e99f3a6b.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Blood Song that uses the Bloodsong (attack) skill.
* The attacks made by the Spirit of Blood Song steal health from its target for its own benefit, not for the benefit of the player who spawned the spirit.
** Since the Spirit of Blood Song heals itself, it is a prime candidate for use with Spirit Transfer.
* Combine with Spiritleech Aura to gain additional life stealing.
* The attacks used by this spirit steal health, so it does not receive the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might (PvP).
9a2dbf13923240f080de460009cd11f2e99f3a6b.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用血歌（攻击）技能的血歌之魂。
* 血歌之灵发起的攻击会为了自身利益而窃取目标的生命值，而不是为了生成该灵体的玩家的利益。
** 由于血歌之魂可以自我治愈，因此它是与精神转移一起使用的最佳候选者。
* 与Spiritleech Aura结合以获得额外的生命窃取。
* 该精魂使用的攻击会窃取生命值，因此不会受到幽灵力量徽记 (PvP) 的额外伤害。

bd4ba3fb7b4c7a76cd0ff443947e55c863bdfbc5.source: * The AI only uses this skill on a target equipped with a martial weapon.
bd4ba3fb7b4c7a76cd0ff443947e55c863bdfbc5.text: * AI仅对装备有军用武器的目标使用此技能。

9db82333433c94a795d44c203f093411c8b6cdd7.source:
* This skill requires exactly 160 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 6 strikes and 10 units.
*This skill works very well with Sundering Weapon, as the Cracked Armor from the weapon spell will apply first, thus applying the Deep Wound. 
* The skill also works well with Mark of Fury, as the hex helps build adrenaline and applies Cracked Armor.
9db82333433c94a795d44c203f093411c8b6cdd7.text:
* 该技能正好需要 160 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 6 次打击和 10 单位。
*此技能与破甲武器配合使用非常有效，因为武器法术中的裂甲将首先应用，从而应用深度伤口。 
* 该技能也适用于愤怒印记，因为六角形有助于增强肾上腺素并应用裂纹护甲。

210b35d5fb9be4eac3bc9152816da6967fad1e46.source:
*There are no Ranger skills which inflict Cracked Armor.
*Great synergy with Sundering Weapon.
210b35d5fb9be4eac3bc9152816da6967fad1e46.text:
*没有游侠技能会造成护甲破裂。
*与破甲武器有很好的协同作用。

16431d38b1a22234d9a1fd4acaf69d6125311342.source:
* "Create" includes spawning minions, Asura summons, and Ebon Vanguard Assassin.
* Synergy with skills that can create multiple summoned creatures, since this skill triggers when each creature is created.
** This skill will trigger simultaneously for each creature created when using Animate Bone Minions, Aura of the Lich, or Signet of Spirits.
** Using Animate Shambling Horror will trigger this skill two times eventually: once when the Shambling Horror is animated, and then once again when it dies and a Jagged Horror is spawned.
** Jagged Horrors created via Jagged Bones will trigger this skill.
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
16431d38b1a22234d9a1fd4acaf69d6125311342.text:
*“创造”包括生成小兵、阿修罗召唤和黑锋先锋刺客。
* 与可以创建多个召唤生物的技能协同作用，因为该技能会在创建每个生物时触发。
** 使用动画骨随从、巫妖光环或灵魂徽记时创建的每个生物都会同时触发该技能。
** 使用动画蹒跚恐怖最终会触发该技能两次：一次是在蹒跚恐怖被动画化时，另一次是在它死亡并生成锯齿恐怖时。
** 通过锯齿状骨头制造的锯齿状恐怖将触发该技能。
与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

adbeb593320f391d99b68958a1fcb04ced2e4525.source: bug: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
adbeb593320f391d99b68958a1fcb04ced2e4525.text: bug：与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

0c77576930e9650a8a94b92fa572ca69764ef8ef.source:
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
* Ends with no effect upon using a Healing Prayers resurrection spell.
* Skills such as Aegis, Heal Party, and Light of Deliverance that are not targetable will not trigger the healing effect and will not end Boon Signet.
* Although the skill's descriptions suggest an increase to a spell's base healing, the spell does not have to have an innate healing effect to gain the benefit of Boon Signet.
0c77576930e9650a8a94b92fa572ca69764ef8ef.text:
* 没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。
* 使用治愈祈祷复活法术后不会产生任何效果。
* 诸如神盾、治疗小队、拯救之光等不可指定的技能不会触发治疗效果，也不会结束恩赐徽记。
* 虽然该技能的描述表明该法术的基础治疗效果会有所提高，但该法术并不需要具有先天的治疗效果才能获得恩惠徽记的好处。

b09fe94702167d6a000d7cd79f5fc2fdbcef8b8f.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Brambles.
b09fe94702167d6a000d7cd79f5fc2fdbcef8b8f.text: * 该技能会创造出荆棘之魂。

356835621a048f2620ca4c3d5d5d4ef4cafcf463.source:
* When used by an Assassin who's not wielding a ranged weapon, the skill uses the falling attack animation similar to that of Falling Spider, instead of a normal skill activation animation. 
* This skill has excellent synergy with adrenaline gain increase skills and Stonefist Insignia. With Dragon Slash and "For Great Justice!" in the same build as this skill, one can keep a foe continuously knocked down for over 20 seconds. With the addition of an IAS, you don't even need "For Great Justice!", making it useful for shutting down high damage output bosses.
* This skill deals armor-ignoring physical damage.
This skill has no aftercast delay.
356835621a048f2620ca4c3d5d5d4ef4cafcf463.text:
* 当由不持有远程武器的刺客使用时，该技能使用类似于坠落蜘蛛的坠落攻击动画，而不是普通的技能激活动画。 
* 该技能与肾上腺素增益增加技能和石拳徽章有极好的协同作用。与龙斩和“为了大正义！”在与此技能相同的构建中，可以使敌人连续击倒超过 20 秒。加上 IAS，你甚至不需要“为了伟大的正义！”，这使得它对于关闭高伤害输出 Boss 非常有用。
* 该技能造成无视护甲的物理伤害。
该技能没有施法后延迟。

81c6a54aba23c6fff7a59dd1c525831c9d033fac.source: anomaly: This skill has no aftercast delay.
81c6a54aba23c6fff7a59dd1c525831c9d033fac.text: 异常：该技能没有施法延迟。

8a052c41f007a3ae40b28cc768460b7c7f5c5dc7.source:
* Use it to counter burning caused by environmental effects, especially in A Time for Heroes, on the Ring of Fire Islands, or during Dasha Vestibule.
* Party members are healed regardless of whether they are burning or not.
8a052c41f007a3ae40b28cc768460b7c7f5c5dc7.text:
* 用它来对抗环境影响引起的燃烧，特别是在英雄时代、火环群岛或达莎前庭期间。
* 队员无论是否被烧伤都会被治愈。

5d781325d94b61a1fe804a865de63a2effefd995.source:
* Its slow moving arrow always follows a high arc: it can be easily avoided at long distances and is unaffected by Read the Wind and Favorable Winds, which flatten the path of the arrow. This makes it more effective against nearby targets or those that are snared.
* Bow choice makes no difference on flight time for this particular skill.
* NPCs will use this skill on foes wielding a spellcasting weapon, but will only target those wielding a martial weapon if they are activating a spell.
5d781325d94b61a1fe804a865de63a2effefd995.text:
* 其缓慢移动的箭头始终遵循高弧线：可以在远距离轻松避开，并且不受“读风”和“顺风”的影响，使箭头的路径变得平坦。这使得它能够更有效地攻击附近的目标或被困住的目标。
* 对于该特定技能，弓的选择对飞行时间没有影响。
* NPC 会对挥舞施法武器的敌人使用此技能，但只会针对那些正在激活法术的挥舞军用武器的敌人。

a136df52ab715e8af3f785a9280428c818eae439.source: * Brutal Strike is the highest damage dealing Pet Attack in PvE and the second highest in PvP (the first being Enraged Lunge (PvP)) when the conditional requirement is met.
a136df52ab715e8af3f785a9280428c818eae439.text: * 当满足条件要求时，残酷打击是 PvE 中宠物攻击造成的最高伤害，也是 PvP 中第二高的伤害（第一是激怒冲刺 (PvP)）。

e1fa3f0ea013e9b3c9e1abf8f0b4fae73b9d4439.source:
* Works well with scythes or attack skills that can deal multiple attacks.
* Heroes will only cast Brutal Weapon on party members who are engaged in combat and are wielding a martial weapon. Heroes will not take the enchantment conditional into consideration, and will not cast Brutal Weapon on an ally outside of their party.
* Excellent for Rangers, Warriors, and Paragons, as they have no enchantments of their own to prevent Brutal Weapon's bonus.
* Dervishes are able to work around Brutal Weapon's enchantment restriction, since all teardowns trigger before the scythe attack hits, thereby granting Brutal Weapon's bonus.
e1fa3f0ea013e9b3c9e1abf8f0b4fae73b9d4439.text:
* 与镰刀或可造成多重攻击的攻击技能配合使用。
* 英雄只会对正在战斗并使用军用武器的队员施放残酷武器。英雄不会考虑结界条件，也不会向队伍之外的盟友施放残酷武器。
* 非常适合游骑兵、战士和典范，因为他们没有自己的魔咒来阻止残酷武器的奖励。
*苦行僧能够绕过残酷武器的附魔限制，因为所有拆卸都会在镰刀攻击命中之前触发，从而获得残酷武器的奖励。

42c54e5b305113b7adde5822aabe419ebd3391e9.source:
*Combine with Frigid Armor before using this skill to get the speed boost without the burning at the cost of an overall reduced average running speed.
*If the enchantment is renewed, enemies start burning at the time the original enchantment would have ended. For example, if you recast it three seconds after the original casting, foes will be set on fire after four seconds.
*This skill's visual effect is similar to being on fire and occurs even if the burning is prevented or removed.
*This enchantment's spammability makes it work well with Ether Renewal, which can offset both its energy cost and the health lost with burning. This combination is the cornerstone of Emo builds.
42c54e5b305113b7adde5822aabe419ebd3391e9.text:
*使用此技能之前与冰冷装甲组合，可以在不燃烧的情况下获得速度提升，但代价是总体平均运行速度降低。
*如果结界被更新，敌人会在原始结界结束时开始燃烧。例如，如果您在原始施法后三秒重新施法，敌人将在四秒后被点燃。
*该技能的视觉效果类似于着火，即使燃烧被阻止或消除也会发生。
*此结界的垃圾邮件能力使其能够与以太更新很好地配合，这可以抵消其能量成本和因燃烧而损失的生命值。这种组合是 Emo 构建的基石。

3e44034a654586df4faad19bb6e52848a9ce4dd5.source:
*Can be used to fuel skills that will drain all adrenaline anyway, such as Decapitate or Final Thrust.
*Synergizes well with Warrior's Endurance (in PvE) and an energy-only skill bar.
*If reapplied before it expires (for example with Dwarven Stability), adrenaline is still lost, since applying a stance always ends the previous one.
3e44034a654586df4faad19bb6e52848a9ce4dd5.text:
*可用于增强无论如何都会耗尽所有肾上腺素的技能，例如斩首或最终推力。
*与战士的耐力（PvE 中）和纯能量技能栏完美协同。
*如果在过期之前重新应用（例如使用矮人稳定性），肾上腺素仍然会丢失，因为应用一种姿势总是会结束前一个姿势。

428736f70d582602c9ab4d46ec3d8a5ebae1fe42.source:
* Unlike Reversal of Damage, when the 50% chance property triggers, the damage inflicted to the target of the foe hexed with Calculated Risk is always reduced to 0 even when the damage inflicted was more than the stated maximum.
* Only attacks that hit can trigger this hex's effects; effects that cause miss or block will result in fewer attacks backfiring.
428736f70d582602c9ab4d46ec3d8a5ebae1fe42.text:
* 与伤害逆转不同的是，当50%几率属性触发时，即使所造成的伤害超过了规定的最大值，被计算风险咒语的敌人目标所造成的伤害也始终会减少到0。
* 只有命中的攻击才能触发该六角的效果；造成失误或阻挡的效果将导致更少的攻击适得其反。

351aa73dbf308d2bc645f500eb055a874c46527d.source:
* Though pets move 25% faster than players, it is not counted against them when being given a movement speed bonus, effectively increasing them to be moving 66.2% faster than players
* The attack speed boost can help to land time sensitive pet attacks (Disrupting Lunge or Bestial Pounce, for example).
351aa73dbf308d2bc645f500eb055a874c46527d.text:
* 虽然宠物的移动速度比玩家快 25%，但在获得移动速度加成时，宠物的移动速度不会被计算在内，从而有效地使宠物的移动速度比玩家快 66.2%
* 攻击速度提升有助于对时间敏感的宠物进行攻击（例如破坏性突刺或野兽猛扑）。

6034132507e3de22bbb662b480c4b17ea293ac55.source: *Though pets move 25% faster than players, it is not counted against them when being given a movement speed bonus, effectively increasing them to be moving 56.2% faster than players, and conveniently helps to better place time sensitive pet attacks (Disrupting Lunge or Bestial Pounce, for example).
6034132507e3de22bbb662b480c4b17ea293ac55.text: *虽然宠物的移动速度比玩家快 25%，但在获得移动速度加成时并不计入宠物的移动速度，从而有效地使宠物的移动速度比玩家快 56.2%，并且方便地帮助更好地进行时间敏感的宠物攻击（例如扰乱冲刺或野兽突袭）。

89b8e599e81b8c09b6a1cf08f5e47dbbfc303e69.source:
* Because of the long recharge time, this skill synergizes well with Enraged Lunge (PvP).
* This skill cannot be activated unless you are traveling with a pet.
89b8e599e81b8c09b6a1cf08f5e47dbbfc303e69.text:
* 由于充能时间较长，该技能与狂怒冲刺（PvP）有很好的协同作用。
* 除非您携带宠物旅行，否则无法激活此技能。

fbb06a48fbdf1e28a20f37411e7c1d2de587b8d1.source: *The speed and arc of Called Shot are not altered by Read the Wind, Favorable Winds, and/or the type of bow.
fbb06a48fbdf1e28a20f37411e7c1d2de587b8d1.text: *“呼叫射击”的速度和弧度不会因“解读风向”、“顺风”和/或弓的类型而改变。

8be750e1fcbf2d726d4445114fef09b85178d778.source:
* Combine with a condition removal skill, e.g. Remedy Signet or Mending Touch.
* Unlike Martyr, this skill has infinite range.

Although the effect extends beyond party range, the AI only considers allies within the expected range.
8be750e1fcbf2d726d4445114fef09b85178d778.text:
* 结合条件消除技能，例如补救印章或修补之触。
* 与烈士不同，该技能的范围是无限的。

尽管效果超出了队伍范围，但人工智能仅考虑预期范围内的盟友。

66fdc9fbfd7f806e65de4c4686e883f2d0460389.source: anomaly: Although the effect extends beyond party range, the AI only considers allies within the expected range.
66fdc9fbfd7f806e65de4c4686e883f2d0460389.text: 异常：虽然效果超出了队伍范围，但AI只考虑预期范围内的盟友。

755c4684b3e3909f730906b0e2fa3aca830a9616.source: * Each of the targets struck will be in roughly a straight line compared to each other. This sometimes causes the third foe affected to be farther than nearby from the initial target (although it will still be near the second one); this also results in some closer foes avoiding damage altogether.
755c4684b3e3909f730906b0e2fa3aca830a9616.text: * 每个被击中的目标彼此之间大致呈一条直线。这有时会导致受影响的第三个敌人距离初始目标比附近更远（尽管它仍然靠近第二个目标）；这也导致一些更接近的敌人完全避免受到伤害。

0906232b837cd7d2354ba02c0ddc84342dc510bb.source: * Combines well with Destructive Was Glaive and, to a lesser extent, Cruel Was Daoshen.
0906232b837cd7d2354ba02c0ddc84342dc510bb.text: * 与毁灭之刃以及在较小程度上与残酷之道神结合得很好。

a5d5a284c18d427790c9f5e141cdc597eca59bdb.source: * Channeling is sometimes brought as an energy management method for Monks in Heroes' Ascent due to the high energy returns in small maps and altar matches. This has lead to a tactic known as Channel tanking.
a5d5a284c18d427790c9f5e141cdc597eca59bdb.text: * 由于小地图和祭坛比赛中的高能量回报，《英雄飞升》中有时会引入引导作为武僧的能量管理方法。这导致了一种称为“海峡坦克”的策略。

56791f562cc6b52d8cca314de0d0eb7bdff932a1.source:
* The AI in normal mode will only cast this spell on foes wielding caster weapons.
** The AI in hard mode will cast this spell on any foe.
56791f562cc6b52d8cca314de0d0eb7bdff932a1.text:
* 正常模式下的AI只会对使用施法者武器的敌人施放此法术。
** 困难模式下的 AI 会对任何敌人施放此法术。

eb4a4f14c2b1892991855c2cded62620807e8eea.source:
*Melee attack skills will cancel the stance before it would apply bonus damage.
* If attacking multiple enemies using a scythe, only one enemy (which will not be the target) takes the bonus damage from this skill.
eb4a4f14c2b1892991855c2cded62620807e8eea.text:
*近战攻击技能会在施加额外伤害之前取消姿态。
* 如果使用镰刀攻击多个敌人，则只有一名敌人（不是目标）会受到该技能的额外伤害。

0bec3dc1b2b41b5f7cf43f671098f47057a2c2e2.source:
* This skill will activate only if you do not have an animal companion and the target is a charmable animal. 
** It can target friendly and hostile creatures, but not allies nor animals already charmed to be pets.
** If you try to use it on an invalid target, it will fail to activate (and you will see the relevant error message in red text).
* Once an animal is charmed, there is no special value to bringing this skill over Comfort Animal or Heal as One in PvE.
* Although this skill is unaffected by your rank in Beast Mastery, your pet's attacks benefit from a higher rank and you recover more quickly if your pet dies.
* Even if you replace this skill with another (e.g. a mission-specific skill such as Disarm Trap), your pet will remain with you. If you rezone and retain the replacement skill, the pet will not zone with you.
* PvE characters and heroes have to charm their own pets; PvP players start off with an Elder Wolf.
* Be careful when charming a pet with nearby heroes or henchmen: the target will become hostile and could be killed. To prevent this, flag your allies farther away and/or set heroes to avoid combat. 
* There are six special versions of this skill, notably the one used in the Codex Arena.
Although technically considered a pet, occasionally a charmed animal will retain the red wording associated with a hostile enemy just after completing the charm animal skill.
0bec3dc1b2b41b5f7cf43f671098f47057a2c2e2.text:
* 只有当你没有动物伙伴并且目标是迷人的动物时，该技能才会激活。 
** 它可以瞄准友好和敌对的生物，但不能瞄准盟友或已经被魅惑成为宠物的动物。
** 如果您尝试在无效目标上使用它，它将无法激活（并且您将看到红色文本的相关错误消息）。
* 一旦动物被魅惑，在 PvE 中将此技能与“安慰动物”或“治愈一体”相比并没有什么特殊价值。
* 虽然此技能不受你的驯兽等级影响，但你的宠物的攻击会从更高的等级中受益，并且如果你的宠物死亡，你恢复得更快。
* 即使您将此技能替换为其他技能（例如解除陷阱等任务特定技能），您的宠物仍将留在您身边。如果您重新分区并保留替换技能，宠物将不会与您一起分区。
* PvE角色和英雄必须迷惑自己的宠物； PvP 玩家从老狼开始。
* 在用附近的英雄或追随者迷惑宠物时要小心：目标会变得充满敌意并可能被杀死。为了防止这种情况发生，请将你的盟友标记到更远的地方和/或设置英雄来避免战斗。 
* 该技能有六个特殊版本，特别是在 Codex Arena 中使用的版本。
虽然从技术上来说被视为宠物，但偶尔，在完成魅惑动物技能后，被魅惑的动物会保留与敌对敌人相关的红色文字。

fe6984688910f591bb9b34e219b1b2b080309909.source: anomaly: Although technically considered a pet, occasionally a charmed animal will retain the red wording associated with a hostile enemy just after completing the charm animal skill.
fe6984688910f591bb9b34e219b1b2b080309909.text: 异常：虽然从技术上讲被视为宠物，但偶尔，被迷惑的动物在完成迷惑动物技能后会保留与敌对敌人相关的红色文字。

2405d8499592c0f2d1ca4e74f45843fbd9b693a8.source:
* Consider combining with Auspicious Incantation due to its high energy cost and low recharge.
* Angorodon's Gaze can help with the energy cost of this skill, while the life stealing it provides can alleviate the health loss from the poison. 
* Consider using Plague Signet, Plague Sending or Plague Touch to transfer the Poison condition to your foes.
* AI will only use this skill on an enchanted foe.
2405d8499592c0f2d1ca4e74f45843fbd9b693a8.text:
* 考虑与吉祥咒结合使用，因为它的能量成本高且充能低。
* 安戈洛顿的凝视可以帮助减少该技能的能量消耗，而其提供的生命窃取可以减轻毒药造成的生命损失。 
* 考虑使用瘟疫徽记、瘟疫传送或瘟疫之触将中毒状态转移给你的敌人。
* AI只会对被施魔法的敌人使用此技能。

9ef80d5018122deeb04243daacad742189d88b8d.source:
* As described by the concise description, "a hexed foe" in the non-concise description implies a foe hexed with Chilling Winds.
Both descriptions fail to mention that the target and all adjacent foes also become hexed with Chilling Winds in addition to being struck with cold damage.
9ef80d5018122deeb04243daacad742189d88b8d.text:
* 如简明描述中所述，非简明描述中的“被施咒的敌人”意味着被寒风施咒的敌人。
两种描述都没有提到目标和所有邻近的敌人除了受到寒冷伤害外，还会受到寒风的咒语。

a8dc25c9adee3848edd029c92559842bc9d93309.source: bug: Both descriptions fail to mention that the target and all adjacent foes also become hexed with Chilling Winds in addition to being struck with cold damage.
a8dc25c9adee3848edd029c92559842bc9d93309.text: bug：两个描述都没有提到目标和所有邻近的敌人除了受到寒冷伤害外，还会受到寒风的咒语。

3ff2333710cce5224c1d06f54016da88ef04ace1.source:
* Attacks made under Choking Gas will interrupt foes regardless of whether the arrows hit or not, e.g. if the ranger is blind or the foe blocks.
* Practiced Stance can be used to lengthen the skill's short duration, which is, unlike most preparations, shorter than its recharge time.
* The concise description does not state that this preparation works only with a bow.
3ff2333710cce5224c1d06f54016da88ef04ace1.text:
* 无论箭是否击中，在窒息毒气下进行的攻击都会打断敌人，例如如果游侠失明或敌人阻挡。
* 练习姿势可用于延长技能的短暂持续时间，与大多数准备工作不同，它比其充电时间短。
* 简洁的描述并未表明该制剂仅适用于弓。

f187b4bf2e7aed22379a1293c5659841cc5e70de.source: *Unlike regular upkeeping, heroes use this on recharge, allowing it to trigger itself.
f187b4bf2e7aed22379a1293c5659841cc5e70de.text: *与常规维护不同，英雄在充能时使用此功能，使其可以自行触发。

66cb3a3bb656eee92e0d380dde951f88fe87b757.source:
* Shameful Fear can be used to increase the speed of a foe within this spell's area of effect and trigger its knock down.
* Particularly useful in Hard Mode due to enemy creatures gaining an inherent speed boost.
66cb3a3bb656eee92e0d380dde951f88fe87b757.text:
* 可耻的恐惧可以用来提高该法术影响范围内敌人的速度并触发其击倒。
* 在困难模式下特别有用，因为敌方生物获得了固有的速度提升。

c0e8626d7b4c6f0d8885ef2e77011081810042d0.source: * This spell fails if your target dies mid-cast.
c0e8626d7b4c6f0d8885ef2e77011081810042d0.text: * 如果你的目标在施法过程中死亡，该法术就会失败。

92553d217de4de935aead1ad61e2e274a72743a8.source:
* This attack exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* The damage dealt to adjacent targets does not trigger on-hit effects.
* The damage to adjacent targets is armor-ignoring physical damage: it benefits from Winnowing and triggers Mark of Pain and Barbs.
* Damages target foe and foes adjacent to target foe.
Contrary to the descriptions, damage is dealt to an additional 2…3…3 foes.
92553d217de4de935aead1ad61e2e274a72743a8.text:
* 这次攻击正好需要 80 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 3 次攻击和 5 单位。
* 对相邻目标造成的伤害不会触发命中效果。
* 对相邻目标的伤害是无视护甲的物理伤害：它受益于风选并触发痛苦印记和倒刺。
* 对目标敌人和与目标敌人相邻的敌人造成伤害。
与描述相反，对额外 2…3…3 名敌人造成伤害。

5a8b667bc24c0bd27ff5082ef34ea27432fc3c45.source: bug: Contrary to the descriptions, damage is dealt to an additional 2…3…3 foes.
5a8b667bc24c0bd27ff5082ef34ea27432fc3c45.text: bug：与描述相反，对额外 2…3…3 名敌人造成伤害。

14ba9d73852eeced85219b7691af4e4a3d1dc454.source:
*This attack will knock down a non-human target even if it is blocked or misses.
*Using this skill with a scythe does not knock down multiple enemies.
*Consider using skills that reduce the recharge time (such as Moebius Strike or Flourish).
14ba9d73852eeced85219b7691af4e4a3d1dc454.text:
*即使非人类目标被阻挡或未击中，此攻击也会将其击倒。
*使用镰刀使用此技能不会击倒多个敌人。
*考虑使用减少充电时间的技能（例如莫比斯打击或蓬勃发展）。

09652167a432ba1d04ca7dc26fa475cb19ef15de.source: Skills which prevent interruptions will trigger when hexed with Clumsiness but will not prevent their target from being interrupted nor from taking damage
09652167a432ba1d04ca7dc26fa475cb19ef15de.text: 防止打断的技能会在被笨拙施咒时触发，但不会阻止目标被打断或受到伤害

7d64c2f006c13ebd794a403dda08bb11eee24b27.source: anomaly: Skills which prevent interruptions will trigger when hexed with Clumsiness but will not prevent their target from being interrupted nor from taking damage
7d64c2f006c13ebd794a403dda08bb11eee24b27.text: 异常：防止被打扰的技能在被笨拙咒语时会触发，但不会阻止目标被打扰或受到伤害

60b72a50cf4c4791f2e61658ed732ede4eb16f9f.source:
* This skill's maximum range is slightly larger than compass range.

If this skill is cast at the exact moment of your pet's death, the pet will be resurrected without any of your skills being disabled.

Using this skill without a pet will still use the energy and return the message "Your pet is out of range."
This skill bypasses the effects of Frozen Soil
60b72a50cf4c4791f2e61658ed732ede4eb16f9f.text:
* 该技能的最大范围略大于罗盘范围。

如果该技能是在你的宠物死亡的那一刻施放的，那么宠物将会复活，而你的任何技能都不会被禁用。

在没有宠物的情况下使用此技能仍然会消耗能量并返回消息“您的宠物超出范围”。
该技能可以绕过冻土的效果

f9d192a8c82038252867f5715a9c2f83fa1bbf57.source: anomaly: If this skill is cast at the exact moment of your pet's death, the pet will be resurrected without any of your skills being disabled.
f9d192a8c82038252867f5715a9c2f83fa1bbf57.text: 异常：如果在你的宠物死亡的同时施放该技能，宠物将会复活，而你的任何技能都不会被禁用。

77d556c06a5aeec2717e9eb475e3a3750f71c373.source: anomaly: Using this skill without a pet will still use the energy and return the message "Your pet is out of range."
77d556c06a5aeec2717e9eb475e3a3750f71c373.text: 异常：在没有宠物的情况下使用该技能仍然会消耗能量并返回消息“您的宠物超出范围”。

2ee376e87834aadd55f81b727bc0a5ccf7c10785.source: anomaly: This skill bypasses the effects of Frozen Soil
2ee376e87834aadd55f81b727bc0a5ccf7c10785.text: 异常：该技能绕过冻土的效果

9e3a6d550d41c29ec748cd63f69347166b10fb1d.source: *Due to the short activation time, energy required, and amount of health healed upon use, you can often get more benefit from this skill if you wait for your pet to die before using it.
9e3a6d550d41c29ec748cd63f69347166b10fb1d.text: *由于激活时间短、需要能量以及使用时恢复的生命值，如果您等待宠物死亡后再使用该技能，通常可以从该技能中获得更多好处。

17d75b7073da7bd58f6eee59f8b7777df3d24f48.source:
* If pet and caster have the exact same health, the pet will be healed.
* This skill has no effect if the pet is dead.
17d75b7073da7bd58f6eee59f8b7777df3d24f48.text:
* 如果宠物和施法者的生命值完全相同，宠物就会被治愈。
* 如果宠物死亡，该技能无效。

8849ebf4809d8abc9c3be4dbe1ef816e1d00e3c6.source:
* Useful when a single interrupt can shutdown all or most of the enemy:
** In PvP arenas — to prevent the opposing team's use of Resurrection Signets.
** In areas such as The Battle for Lion's Arch, Urgoz's Warren, and The Deep — where 10-20 identically-skilled foes confront the party.
* When you successfully interrupt a skill, a visual effect similar to Blackout will activate on the target and foes carrying the same skill.
* Disables skills even if the interruption is prevented.
8849ebf4809d8abc9c3be4dbe1ef816e1d00e3c6.text:
* 当单个中断可以关闭所有或大部分敌人时很有用：
** 在 PvP 竞技场中 — 防止对方队伍使用复活徽记。
** 在狮子拱门之战、乌尔戈兹沃伦和深渊等地区，10-20 个技能相同的敌人与队伍对峙。
* 成功打断技能后，目标和拥有相同技能的敌人会出现类似于停电的视觉效果。
* 即使阻止了中断，也会禁用技能。

60490e654142b03b4cd3101ff2265c3080d0f426.source:
* If it is used to interrupt a spell on an already-dazed target, dazed will not be reapplied.
* This skill will inflict daze on a foe casting a spell even if that foe is using a skill that prevents interruption (i.e Mantra of Concentration).
This skill does not interrupt spells; the application of daze does: if the daze is not applied (i.e. if the target is enchanted by Infuse Condition and has a minion to transfer the daze to), no interrupt will occur.
60490e654142b03b4cd3101ff2265c3080d0f426.text:
* 如果它被用来打断对已经晕眩的目标施展的法术，晕眩将不会被重新应用。
*即使敌人正在使用防止中断的技能（即集中咒语），该技能也会对施法的敌人造成眩晕。
该技能不会打断法术；应用发呆的作用是：如果未应用发呆（即，如果目标被注入条件附魔并且有一个小兵可以将发呆转移到），则不会发生中断。

332b3d54583d43ba53856a941f0b4d9f8cad170c.source: bug: This skill does not interrupt spells; the application of daze does: if the daze is not applied (i.e. if the target is enchanted by Infuse Condition and has a minion to transfer the daze to), no interrupt will occur.

fed9c51936a2aefa624fd5f176521ed1725e4019.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Conflagration.
* Mechanically, this skill is vastly different than how Winter works:
** Winter will not allow you to trigger the requirement of Conjure Frost, as it changes the elemental damage received to cold, rather than change the damage output of an elemental weapon to cold. 
** Conflagration changes the damage type output to fire, like Kindle Arrows, which will allow you to trigger Conjure Flame with it on its own.
* Because of this, this skill can be used to replace fiery bowstring, and synergizes with Conjure Flame and/or Mark of Rodgort fire damage requirements.
** This allows you to use to use Zealous or Vampiric bowstrings along with a fire damage bow, which is an important benefit for buiilds focusing in multiple attack skills and Conjure Flame.
** However, beware that the skill's damage type change will also stop physical damage triggers such as Winnowing, Mark of Pain or Barbs from working when the effect is active.

This spirit also causes Bone Fiend attacks and spear attacks to strike with fire damage.
Unlike Winter, this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.
fed9c51936a2aefa624fd5f176521ed1725e4019.text:
* 该技能会产生火焰之灵。
*从机制上来说，这个技能与Winter的运作方式有很大不同：
** 冬天不会让你触发召唤冰霜的要求，因为它会将受到的元素伤害更改为寒冷，而不是将元素武器的伤害输出更改为寒冷。 
** 大火将伤害类型输出更改为火焰，就像 Kindle Arrows 一样，这将允许您单独触发召唤火焰。
* 正因为如此，该技能可以用来替代炽热弓弦，并与召唤火焰和/或罗格特印记火焰伤害要求相协同。
** 这允许您使用热心或吸血鬼弓弦以及火焰伤害弓，这对于专注于多种攻击技能和召唤火焰的建筑来说是一个重要的好处。
** 但是，请注意，该技能的伤害类型更改也会在效果激活时阻止物理伤害触发，例如风选、痛苦印记或倒刺。

该精魂还会使骨魔攻击和矛攻击造成火焰伤害。
与冬天不同的是，该技能要求攻击者处于精神效果范围内。

63e6dc671c2825a890ba068314cdbea356c9569e.source: anomaly: This spirit also causes Bone Fiend attacks and spear attacks to strike with fire damage.
63e6dc671c2825a890ba068314cdbea356c9569e.text: 异常：该精魂也会使骨魔攻击和矛攻击造成火焰伤害。

8e87ccba3a43309d34c0f0425f2fff202a4132d2.source: anomaly: Unlike Winter, this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.
8e87ccba3a43309d34c0f0425f2fff202a4132d2.text: 异常：与凛冬不同，该技能要求攻击者处于精神效果范围内。

697176897c9e4e394c0c25bcc1e2fc57a4f1d062.source:
* Greater Conflagration or Kindle Arrows negates the need for a fiery upgrade.
* The skill's armor-ignoring damage is added on every hit, including those from skills dealing multiple attacks, scythe attacks, and dual attacks.
697176897c9e4e394c0c25bcc1e2fc57a4f1d062.text:
* Great Conflagration 或 Kindle Arrows 无需激烈升级。
* 该技能的无视护甲伤害在每次攻击时都会增加，包括造成多重攻击、镰刀攻击和双重攻击的技能的伤害。

fc91c5fb0023d536476d9f8ebf9f3c4b63d64fed.source:
* In lieu of an icy weapon upgrade, consider using a skill that changes your damage to cold like Grenth's Fingers.
* The skill's armor-ignoring damage is added on every hit, including those from skills dealing multiple attacks, scythe attacks, and dual attacks.
fc91c5fb0023d536476d9f8ebf9f3c4b63d64fed.text:
* 代替冰冷武器升级，考虑使用像古兰斯手指那样将你的伤害改为寒冷的技能。
* 该技能的无视护甲伤害在每次攻击时都会增加，包括造成多重攻击、镰刀攻击和双重攻击的技能的伤害。

50a21091d941b2b31308b72bec4215940048485d.source: * The skill's armor-ignoring damage is added on every hit, including those from skills dealing multiple attacks, scythe attacks, and dual attacks.
50a21091d941b2b31308b72bec4215940048485d.text: * 该技能的无视护甲伤害在每次攻击时都会增加，包括造成多重攻击、镰刀攻击和双重攻击的技能的伤害。

6c83a8bf191df72780b635d84ea34f0097d860c6.source:
* Despite the full description, reapplying a condition you are already suffering from triggers Contagion again (except for the burning via Soul Ignition).
* Combines well with skills which inflict conditions on oneself.
* May be used with skills that benefit from sacrifice like Masochism (PvP) and Dark Aura.
* This skill is commonly used by Saccers to force-trigger Death Nova.
* The condition does not spread if it was transferred to your minion through Infuse Condition.
6c83a8bf191df72780b635d84ea34f0097d860c6.text:
* 尽管有完整的描述，重新应用您已经患有的病症会再次触发传染（通过灵魂点燃进行的燃烧除外）。
* 与给自己带来条件的技能完美结合。
* 可以与受益于牺牲的技能一起使用，例如受虐狂（PvP）和黑暗光环。
* 此技能常被射手用来强制触发死亡新星。
* 如果通过注入条件转移到你的随从身上，该条件不会传播。

e1f763b97ade9388fdcc02079faecf7fff87c846.source:
When Contemplation of Purity (or any skill that removes "all enchantments") triggers the damage effects of Mirage Cloak or Aura of Holy Might, it behaves inconsistently compared to skills that remove a specific number of enchantments:

Mirage Cloak: Damage will only trigger for a restricted list of Dervish enchantments (Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and itself).

Aura of Holy Might: Damage will trigger for all Dervish enchantments except Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, and Vow of Revolution.

Skills that remove a defined number of enchantments (like Rend Enchantments or standard Dervish teardowns) do not suffer from these restrictions.
* Synergizes with enchantments with a positive end effect.
**This includes most Dervish Enchantments, making this skill a potentially effective replacement for teardowns.
e1f763b97ade9388fdcc02079faecf7fff87c846.text:
当纯洁沉思（或任何移除“所有结界”的技能）触发幻影披风或圣能光环的伤害效果时，与移除特定数量结界的技能相比，其表现不一致：

幻影斗篷：伤害只会对有限的苦行僧结界触发（荆棘光环、巴尔萨泽之怒、虔诚更新、尘斗篷、惊人之力、古兰斯之指及其本身）。

圣力光环：除永恒光环、力量之盾、古兰斯光环和革命誓言之外的所有苦行僧结界都会触发伤害。

移除一定数量结界的技能（如撕裂结界或标准苦行僧拆卸）不受这些限制。
* 与结界协同作用，产生积极的最终效果。
**这包括大多数托钵僧附魔，使该技能成为拆卸的潜在有效替代品。

24850991ee8607963d1159e15d451e20d0944ce6.source:

fc472cf7009d5ba6cbc49fd0303bf98de3bab28a.source:
Convert Hexes only grants +10 armor, whether it removes one or more Necromancer hexes. 
* If this skill functioned as intended it could be used to achieve the highest armor rating possible for any profession. If all Necromancer hexes were used against you, you would gain an additional 430 armor rating.
fc472cf7009d5ba6cbc49fd0303bf98de3bab28a.text:
转换六角形仅授予 +10 点护甲，无论它移除一个还是多个死灵法师六角形。 
* 如果该技能按预期发挥作用，则可以用来实现任何职业的最高护甲等级。如果所有死灵法师六角形都用来对付你，你将获得额外的 430 护甲等级。

c0f0e97338420fbb645bfd1c5161e2c6ac579c62.source: bug: Convert Hexes only grants +10 armor, whether it removes one or more Necromancer hexes.
c0f0e97338420fbb645bfd1c5161e2c6ac579c62.text: bug：转换六角形仅授予 +10 点护甲，无论它移除一个还是多个死灵法师六角形。

766953ad4f16605945d033e70709d3a6da95ec1c.source:
* Heroes will maintain this skill in combat even when fighting enemies that don't apply any conditions. This is useful for triggering skills that trigger when an enchantment ends, such as forms. 
* When used in conjunction with an attack skill that removes an enchantment, conditions are cured before the hit lands.
* If the condition removal effect is unwanted (to keep Conviction's regeneration and armor increase effects), it can be worth considering using an enchanting upgrade component (or an effect reducing recharge time) to maintain this skill on yourself, as conditions are not removed if the enchantment is reapplied before it ends.
766953ad4f16605945d033e70709d3a6da95ec1c.text:
*即使与不适用任何条件的敌人战斗，英雄也会在战斗中保持此技能。这对于触发结界结束时触发的技能非常有用，例如形态。 
* 当与移除结界的攻击技能结合使用时，在击中之前状况会被治愈。
*如果不需要条件移除效果（以保持信念的再生和护甲增加效果），则值得考虑使用附魔升级组件（或减少充能时间的效果）来维持此技能，因为如果在结界结束之前重新应用条件，则不会移除条件。

43757077829d0b867498d5b7d790bd22d5cbbb10.source: * This is the only non-elite, non-PvE-only, adrenal skill that causes a knock down without causing the user to lose all adrenaline.
43757077829d0b867498d5b7d790bd22d5cbbb10.text: * 这是唯一一个非精英、非 PvE 的肾上腺技能，可以导致击倒而不导致用户失去所有肾上腺素。

84f20ad549b78fc504919d232cac57a89b9e58b8.source:
*You actually gain the energy bonus for each attacking foe you hit. This applies when you are using a scythe.
* If used against a target that is in the middle of casting a spell while they are under the effect of Daze, or if Dwarven Battle Stance is in effect, the interrupt will land before Counterattack activates. Making it possible to activate the energy gain effect if the enemy was set to an "attacking" state.
84f20ad549b78fc504919d232cac57a89b9e58b8.text:
*实际上，你击中的每个攻击敌人都会获得能量加成。当您使用镰刀时这适用。
* 如果对正在施展法术且处于眩晕效果的目标使用，或者如果矮人战斗姿态有效，则中断将在反击激活之前发生。如果敌人处于“攻击”状态，则可以激活能量增益效果。

036b8e0ffcb4a542c38d8bb524df6295ad90f2a1.source: * This skill functions similarly to Spectral Agony.
036b8e0ffcb4a542c38d8bb524df6295ad90f2a1.text: * 该技能的作用与幽灵痛苦类似。

e27ea108cbb021154635ff2bee1cc58ca8170f34.source: *This chant triggers and ends the next time an attack skill successfully hits.
e27ea108cbb021154635ff2bee1cc58ca8170f34.text: *下次攻击技能成功命中时，该咏唱会触发并结束。

5dba3802060628f02fb7bd3c5971bf9d2977deed.source: * Using with Apply Poison, Poison Tip Signet or Barbed Arrows will cover the crippled condition with the other one.
5dba3802060628f02fb7bd3c5971bf9d2977deed.text: * 与涂毒、毒尖印章或倒刺箭一起使用将用另一支覆盖残废状态。

af7acb21853ff78e43057c2aecf1c22e5cacdafa.source:
* This skill exactly requires 130 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 5 strikes and 5 units.
*Bleeding covers cripple.
*Synergy with Knee Cutter.
af7acb21853ff78e43057c2aecf1c22e5cacdafa.text:
* 该技能恰好需要130单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此5次打击和5单位。
*流血覆盖残废。
*与膝关节切割机协同作用。

be24532aea9bea5e67d6b3393664c3bcf015e92a.source: *Crippled is applied to each foe hit, despite what the concise description suggests.
be24532aea9bea5e67d6b3393664c3bcf015e92a.text: *尽管简明的描述表明了这一点，但残废适用于每个被击中的敌人。

c27f2677ddb245ce027cbcb646eab70211f22816.source:
* Every time this enchantment is refreshed, the duration is affected by enchantment extending modifications on your equipment.
* Unlike Seed of Life and "There's Nothing to Fear!", this can still be useful for secondary Assassins, as long as you are running a weapon build and have enough enchantment extending effects and/or critical strike chance to reliably maintain it.
** Consider using with an of the Assassin weapon upgrade to reduce the number of critical hits you need to maintain it.
c27f2677ddb245ce027cbcb646eab70211f22816.text:
* 每次刷新该附魔时，持续时间会受到装备上附魔延长修改的影响。
* 与生命之种和“没什么可害怕的！”不同，这对于二级刺客仍然有用，只要你正在运行武器构建并有足够的结界扩展效果和/或致命一击机会来可靠地维持它。
** 考虑与刺客武器升级一起使用，以减少维持它所需的暴击次数。

74508b2c48a08fea84d0f2ece9d562791c5dd67f.source: * In PvE, one may consider using an Axe Grip of the Assassin to increase the chance for a critical hit.
74508b2c48a08fea84d0f2ece9d562791c5dd67f.text: * 在PvE中，可以考虑使用刺客的斧握来增加暴击几率。

071336e3f41051c136d082a1b78dc204b85f1344.source: * Every time this enchantment is refreshed, the duration is affected by enchantment extending modifications on your equipment.
071336e3f41051c136d082a1b78dc204b85f1344.text: * 每次刷新该附魔时，持续时间会受到装备上附魔延长修改的影响。

a833bb012597780e30681c9f7b8b73f8a7ad5a69.source: * The energy you gain from this skill stacks on top of the energy you already gain from your Critical Strikes rank.
a833bb012597780e30681c9f7b8b73f8a7ad5a69.text: * 你从这个技能中获得的能量会叠加在你已经从暴击等级中获得的能量之上。

f9d5dea8b64bdb17e1c14299383e2d74fd40fc88.source: bug: The daggers will randomly trigger -2 physical damage mods on shields even though they cause earth damage.
f9d5dea8b64bdb17e1c14299383e2d74fd40fc88.text: bug：匕首会随机触发护盾上的 -2 点物理伤害，即使它们会造成土属性伤害。

57f520c068592375715719ce177b7a1d6d189256.source:
* At rank 14 in Critical Strikes and using Critical Eye, the energy loss can be negated (or alternatively at rank 13 with a zealous weapon).
* The enchantment removal happens before you successfully hit with an attack, which can negate enchantments that react with attacks such as Reversal of Damage or Judge's Intervention.
* Although Frostmaw the Kinslayer uses this skill, Dark Apostasy cannot be captured from it because it is not a boss.
57f520c068592375715719ce177b7a1d6d189256.text:
* 在致命一击中等级 14 并使用致命之眼时，能量损失可以被抵消（或者在等级 13 时使用狂热武器）。
* 结界移除发生在你成功攻击之前，这可以抵消与攻击反应的结界，例如伤害逆转或法官干预。
* 虽然弑亲者霜喉使用此技能，但黑暗叛教者无法从中捕获，因为它不是 Boss。

24cecbe79eed4842796ebb6bcf8c8f4850f7d927.source:
* You lose more health as Dark Aura deals more damage with each rank in Death Magic.

Does not cause charmable animals to turn hostile.

;Player builds
* This skill is frequently used by Saccers to forced-trigger Death Nova.
** Combine Dark Aura with touch or point-blank skills that require sacrifices such as Signet of Agony and Touch of Agony. Other sacrifice skills, touch skills, or point-blank skills may also work well.

;AI tactics
* If triggered too rapidly in PvE, creatures will flee the AoE.
24cecbe79eed4842796ebb6bcf8c8f4850f7d927.text:
*随着死亡魔法中每个等级的黑暗光环造成更多伤害，你会损失更多生命值。

不会导致可爱的动物变得充满敌意。

;玩家构建
* 此技能常被射手用来强制触发死亡新星。
** 将黑暗光环与需要牺牲的接触或直击技能相结合，例如痛苦徽记和痛苦之触。其他牺牲技能、接触技能或近距离技能也可能很有效。

;人工智能战术
* 如果在 PvE 中触发得太快，生物将会逃离 AoE。

935d0dc717126643e4cfc449043fcaa489196a4d.source: anomaly: Does not cause charmable animals to turn hostile.
935d0dc717126643e4cfc449043fcaa489196a4d.text: 异常：不会导致可爱的动物变得敌对。

922e8110ea551bd82e99597c7f8920a37957b2c8.source:
*Dark Bond only transfers damage to minions under the caster's control, not other allied minions.
*This skill can be easily maintained without assigning attribute points to Blood Magic.
922e8110ea551bd82e99597c7f8920a37957b2c8.text:
*黑暗羁绊只会将伤害转移到施法者控制下的小兵，而不是其他友方小兵。
*该技能无需给血魔法分配属性点即可轻松维持。

da6e01329c56e588b43dc2f5e30046a69bf80a5b.source:
* While this skill typically deals more damage to the user than the target, there are multiple situations where this can be useful: 
** The short recharge time allows it to trigger Dark Aura frequently. This can become even more frequent if combining it with Masochism. 
** Dark Pact has an energy cost of just 1, making it a very cost-efficient choice for damage. This can be useful if the user has a surplus of health from the many life-stealing skills associated with Blood Magic.
da6e01329c56e588b43dc2f5e30046a69bf80a5b.text:
* 虽然此技能通常对用户造成的伤害比对目标造成的伤害更大，但在多种情况下此技能会很有用： 
** 充能时间短，可以频繁触发黑暗光环。如果将其与受虐狂结合起来，这种情况会变得更加频繁。 
** 黑暗契约的能量消耗仅为 1，使其成为一种非常经济高效的伤害选择。如果用户从与血魔法相关的许多生命窃取技能中获得了剩余的生命值，这会很有用。

91e76f33e7516166ec839954f708b70450178e0b.source:
* The shadow step and the hex are considered separate effects:
**If the shadow step fails (i.e. if the target is in an inaccessible location), the target will still suffer the movement speed hex.
**If the hex fails (i.e. the target is under the effects of Hex Breaker), you will still shadow step to the target.
91e76f33e7516166ec839954f708b70450178e0b.text:
* 阴影步和六角形被视为独立的效果：
**如果暗影步失败（即如果目标位于无法到达的位置），目标仍将受到移动速度降咒的影响。
**如果降咒失败（即目标受到降咒破坏者的影响），你仍然会暗影步到目标。

2088d83ceb4648379a962dbd16058cf65593aab5.source:
* Dash boosts speed enough to allow a character to pass through and trigger a trap without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by 18.75% if used every time it recharges.
** Combine with Dwarven Stability for up to 6 seconds speed boost every 8 seconds and up to 37.5% average speed boost.
* Despite being linked to an Attribute, this skill does not benefit from that attribute in any way.
2088d83ceb4648379a962dbd16058cf65593aab5.text:
* 冲刺的速度提升足以让角色通过并触发陷阱而不受影响。
* 该技能每次充能时使用，平均速度增加18.75%。
** 与矮人稳定性结合，每 8 秒速度提升高达 6 秒，平均速度提升高达 37.5% 秒。
* 尽管与某个属性相关联，但该技能不会以任何方式从该属性中受益。

d35a3c0087e44d5bf7dd3a52fb817550e8a0adf3.source:
* Dash boosts speed enough to allow a character to pass through and trigger a trap without being affected.
Using this skill while hexed with Diversion will not increase its recharge time.
d35a3c0087e44d5bf7dd3a52fb817550e8a0adf3.text:
* 冲刺的速度提升足以让角色通过并触发陷阱而不受影响。
在使用转移咒语时使用此技能不会增加其充能时间。

13bf9c11c54e535ac68b51b2de9e6f0dea3b945f.source: bug: Using this skill while hexed with Diversion will not increase its recharge time.
13bf9c11c54e535ac68b51b2de9e6f0dea3b945f.text: bug：在使用转移咒语时使用该技能不会增加其充能时间。

ae7c4c028b5b60de010346bd38a43e6a1af58835.source: bug: Similar to Migraine, this skill does not decrease the activation time of dagger attack skills. Recharge time of dagger attack skills are affected as the skill describes.
ae7c4c028b5b60de010346bd38a43e6a1af58835.text: bug：与偏头痛类似，该技能不会减少匕首攻击技能的启动时间。匕首攻击技能的充能时间会受到技能描述的影响。

f44c50c97ab6f43e0e27f9ae38f13e6bd36e4a5c.source:
*The damage to adjacent foes is armor-ignoring.
*Can be rotated with Moebius Strike for constant area of effect damage.
*This skill is one of the three skills that form the basis of dagger spammer builds.
f44c50c97ab6f43e0e27f9ae38f13e6bd36e4a5c.text:
*对邻近敌人的伤害是无视护甲的。
*可以与莫比斯打击一起旋转以获得恒定的效果伤害范围。
*此技能是构成匕首垃圾邮件发送者构建基础的三种技能之一。

87aaba6e62252a6f5c6af117431429c95fa7cf9c.source:
*The damage is dealt by the caster, not the target, which means it can trigger skills such as Pain Inverter.
*Saccers are known to use Signet of Agony, Dark Aura, and Contagion to force trigger Death Nova by sacrificing oneself to death.
*Consider using this skill with Putrid Flesh on allied minions.
*This enchantment is also present as an environment effect in the fourth chamber of the Dragon's Lair. Both foes and allies are enchanted; however, the effect is quite weak (equal to 0 Death Magic).
87aaba6e62252a6f5c6af117431429c95fa7cf9c.text:
*伤害由施法者造成，而不是目标，这意味着它可以触发诸如疼痛反转器之类的技能。
*众所周知，萨克斯会使用痛苦徽记、黑暗光环和传染来通过牺牲自己来强制触发死亡新星。
*考虑在盟友小兵身上使用腐肉技能。
*此结界也作为环境效果出现在龙之巢穴的第四个房间中。敌人和盟友都被施了魔法；但效果相当微弱（相当于0死亡魔法）。

f0365bbc5c0b2be72e6cc8e53d8dd4f780b6a94a.source:
* Death from this skill will not cause the user to incur Death Penalty nor impede their Survivor title track progress.
* PvE foes that die from this skill do not yield Experience or Loot, unless they are resurrected and killed again normally.
f0365bbc5c0b2be72e6cc8e53d8dd4f780b6a94a.text:
* 因该技能而死亡不会导致用户受到死刑，也不会妨碍他们的幸存者标题曲目进度。
* 因该技能而死亡的 PvE 敌人不会产生经验或战利品，除非他们正常复活并再次被杀死。

92929096e087e2c193a197dd15096b0ba152a920.source: * The user of the skill does not incur a Death Penalty if they die because the target died.
92929096e087e2c193a197dd15096b0ba152a920.text: * 该技能的使用者如果因目标死亡而死亡，不会受到死刑。

afb7c5d965f03530a6d23ab8120748c8d3eb0c80.source:
* If you invoke this on a non-hostile target (e.g. a charmable animal), it will turn hostile.
* This skill can also be useful when running. You are healed and shadow step ahead, escaping from foes and getting closer to your destination.
* Like all spells, this skill has a 0.75 second aftercast delay.
* Heroes will use Death's Charge to close in on foes even if the heal effect isn't needed.
afb7c5d965f03530a6d23ab8120748c8d3eb0c80.text:
* 如果你对非敌对目标（例如迷人的动物）调用此功能，它将变成敌对目标。
* 这个技能在跑步时也很有用。你已经痊愈，暗影向前迈出一步，逃离敌人，离目的地越来越近。
* 与所有法术一样，该技能有 0.75 秒的施法延迟。
* 即使不需要治疗效果，英雄也会使用死亡冲锋来逼近敌人。

4adbb7857f1755a3e424f0e1a95ee166bc1863d3.source: Death's Retreat is one of the few spells that do not suffer from aftercast delay.
4adbb7857f1755a3e424f0e1a95ee166bc1863d3.text: 死亡撤退是少数不受施法延迟影响的法术之一。

7646a15395ebc5752497fb6da2373221dc2f289b.source: anomaly: Death's Retreat is one of the few spells that do not suffer from aftercast delay.
7646a15395ebc5752497fb6da2373221dc2f289b.text: 异常：死亡撤退是少数不受施法延迟影响的法术之一。

ca000fd5a86bb811fb62f75c271096e242385da9.source: *The concise description fails to mention that the bonus damage caused by this skill is shadow damage.
ca000fd5a86bb811fb62f75c271096e242385da9.text: *简洁的描述没有提及该技能造成的加成伤害是暗影伤害。

6de3831b7e6981a6dba830e09274fa3fba1d248c.source:
* Deathly Swarm is rather similar to Chain Lightning. It is a non-projectile spell with standard spell range. It does not immediately strike target foe (as most spells do), there is a delay before doing so.
:* 1 second after spell activation, the spell triggers on the target foe.
:* 2 seconds after spell activation, the spell triggers on a second foe in the area of the primary target.
:* 3 seconds after spell activation, the spell triggers on a third foe in the area of the secondary target.
*The casting animation resembles a pentagram around the target.
6de3831b7e6981a6dba830e09274fa3fba1d248c.text:
* 死亡群与闪电链非常相似。这是一个具有标准法术范围的非投射法术。它不会立即攻击目标敌人（就像大多数法术那样），在这样做之前会有一段延迟。
：* 法术激活后 1 秒，法术在目标敌人身上触发。
：* 法术激活后 2 秒，该法术会对主要目标区域内的第二个敌人触发。
：* 法术激活后 3 秒，该法术会在次要目标区域内的第三个敌人身上触发。
*施法动画类似于目标周围的五角星。

416e6ba6708b64ffe7407f437344611fba89efa5.source: * At Marksmanship rank 15, the energy loss equals ~2.3 pips of energy degeneration, assuming you hit every time Debilitating Shot recharges, use it as fast as you can(say 0.6secs counting lag and reflexes) and use a recurve bow.
416e6ba6708b64ffe7407f437344611fba89efa5.text: * 在射击技能等级 15 时，能量损失相当于约 2.3 点能量退化，假设你每次衰弱射击充电时都击中，尽可能快地使用它（比如计算延迟和反射 0.6 秒）并使用反曲弓。

35a37c748eb71be5ba35ac62b08e443e4a9cf1ba.source:
*The amount of energy loss can be lowered by energy hiding.
*The energy gain of skills such as Zealous Anthem, Weapon of Renewal and Critical Eye occurs before the energy loss.
*Even with the benefit of the auto-critical ignored, this skill has the highest damage increase of any axe attack.
The concise description fails to mention that the attack is unblockable
35a37c748eb71be5ba35ac62b08e443e4a9cf1ba.text:
*通过能量隐藏可以降低能量损失量。
*诸如《热忱圣歌》、《重生武器》和《批判之眼》等技能的能量增益发生在能量损失之前。
*即使忽略了自动暴击的好处，该技能的伤害增幅也是所有斧头攻击中最高的。
简洁的描述并没有提到攻击是不可阻挡的

d62512c8f1ec2ce3bf79dc326b855b06408e43bb.source: anomaly: The concise description fails to mention that the attack is unblockable
d62512c8f1ec2ce3bf79dc326b855b06408e43bb.text: 异常：简洁的描述没有提到攻击是不可阻挡的

0ca48e3209ebbfe29c1f8351008ffc5ce95145e4.source: * All other Water Magic skills that reduce the movement speed of multiple targets have a significantly shorter duration than Deep Freeze even on high Water Magic ranks. As such, Deep Freeze can be used effectively to hinder enemy movement even without any investment in Water Magic.
0ca48e3209ebbfe29c1f8351008ffc5ce95145e4.text: * 所有其他降低多个目标移动速度的水魔法技能，即使在高水魔法等级上，其持续时间也明显短于深度冻结。因此，即使没有任何水系魔法的投入，深度冷冻也可以有效地阻碍敌人的移动。

28871579c9cde00e1c330c1752d7502dab9cfd6d.source:
* General Bayel in Moddok Crevice uses this skill, but it cannot be captured from him because Bayel is not classified as a boss.
* Often more effective in Hard Mode, since foes attack 50% faster.
28871579c9cde00e1c330c1752d7502dab9cfd6d.text:
* 莫多克裂缝的巴耶尔将军使用此技能，但无法从他身上夺取该技能，因为巴耶尔不属于 Boss。
* 通常在困难模式下更有效，因为敌人攻击 50% 的速度更快。

40dd5ddc6ded87cc0fdb5f550f098a5338ad4b7c.source: * Heroes will only use this on foes with an enchantment.
40dd5ddc6ded87cc0fdb5f550f098a5338ad4b7c.text: *英雄只会对有结界的敌人使用此功能。

88bb952d915e42f62866041677b9999d4db95688.source:
*This skill also works with spellcasting weapons, not just bows and spears.
*This skill inflicts the longest bleeding duration amongst all player-useable skills in the game for attribute ranks below 19. 
*Amongst the ranged attacks with an activation time of 0.5 second or less, Deft Strike has a short recharge time. This can make the skill somewhat useful for skills that trigger on attacks or attack skills, such as Nightmare Weapon or preparations.
This attack is not affected by Favourable Winds extra damage even when used wielding a bow, unlike similar flat armor ignoring damage attack skills like Needling Shot or Power Shot.
88bb952d915e42f62866041677b9999d4db95688.text:
*此技能也适用于施法武器，而不仅仅是弓和矛。
*该技能在属性等级低于19的所有玩家可用技能中造成最长的流血持续时间。 
*在发动时间为0.5秒或更短的远程攻击中，灵巧打击的充能时间较短。这可以使该技能对于触发攻击或攻击技能的技能有些有用，例如梦魇武器或准备。
即使使用弓箭，此攻击也不会受到顺风额外伤害的影响，这与类似的平甲无视伤害攻击技能（如针刺射击或强力射击）不同。

462bc551440c8e4e187b698105706160ca03c062.source: anomaly: This attack is not affected by Favourable Winds extra damage even when used wielding a bow, unlike similar flat armor ignoring damage attack skills like Needling Shot or Power Shot.
462bc551440c8e4e187b698105706160ca03c062.text: 异常：即使使用弓箭，此攻击也不会受到顺风额外伤害，这与类似的平甲无视伤害攻击技能（如针刺射击或强力射击）不同。

16e1cf563e1d70025f2c40f596ce565183f6ceb6.source:
* The health and armor rating increase in addition to the stackable damage reduction make this a popular choice for use in tank builds.
* Defy Pain sometimes causes strange clipping issues with trimmed capes.
16e1cf563e1d70025f2c40f596ce565183f6ceb6.text:
* 除了可堆叠伤害减少之外，生命值和护甲等级的增加使其成为坦克建造中的流行选择。
* Defy Pain 有时会导致修剪过的斗篷出现奇怪的剪裁问题。

a386c50db77e3b904d643238e4b1f3e40a0b40f7.source:
* Great synergy with Dagger spammer builds.
* Does not trigger on failed dagger attack skills.
* Demonic Flesh does not damage the foe you used the triggering skill on, even if that foe is also adjacent to you.
a386c50db77e3b904d643238e4b1f3e40a0b40f7.text:
* 与 Dagger 垃圾邮件发送者构建的巨大协同作用。
* 匕首攻击技能失败时不会触发。
* 恶魔之肉不会对你使用触发技能的敌人造成伤害，即使该敌人也与你相邻。

2746c6bdfd60b1357cd2b376139a9ff278409aae.source: The description is misleading: this skill removes a hex for each recharging Divine Favor skill, including itself. However, if Deny Hexes recharges instantly (e.g. using Glyph of Renewal), it will not be included as a recharging skill thus it is possible that no hex will be removed.
2746c6bdfd60b1357cd2b376139a9ff278409aae.text: 该描述具有误导性：该技能会为每个充能神圣恩惠技能（包括其本身）移除一个降咒。然而，如果拒绝降咒立即充电（例如使用更新雕文），它将不会被包含为充电技能，因此可能不会删除任何降咒。

ff5a1d465007180813f610bef3382836638892e9.source: bug: The description is misleading: this skill removes a hex for each recharging Divine Favor skill, including itself. However, if Deny Hexes recharges instantly (e.g. using Glyph of Renewal), it will not be included as a recharging skill thus it is possible that no hex will be removed.
ff5a1d465007180813f610bef3382836638892e9.text: bug：描述具有误导性：该技能会为每个充电的神圣恩惠技能移除一个降咒，包括它本身。然而，如果拒绝降咒立即充电（例如使用更新雕文），它将不会被包含为充电技能，因此可能不会删除任何降咒。

fd1586c9db55414b7ef099b9ceb3c8a686918304.source:
* The energy loss happens after a spell has been cast. 
** This means that interrupted spells do not cause the caster to suffer the energy loss.
fd1586c9db55414b7ef099b9ceb3c8a686918304.text:
* 能量损失发生在施展法术之后。 
** 这意味着被打断的法术不会导致施法者遭受能量损失。

fff1c9437e04b56dcaeb30da452bd1a957cbb57a.source: * Requirement for bonus damage can be achieved by using skills such as Illusion of Weakness.
fff1c9437e04b56dcaeb30da452bd1a957cbb57a.text: * 额外伤害的要求可以通过使用虚弱幻象等技能来实现。

1b4db9f7cb68c11a99d8672928ab712af41013c7.source:
* Consider using with Steady Stance or Balanced Stance to bypass the knock down penalty.
* This skill will only knock you down if it hits.
* Contrary to Grapple, Stonefist Insignia does not prolong the time you are knocked down.
* If this attack hits multiple targets by using a scythe, the conditions are applied separately. You are also knocked down separately for each hit, which matters if preventing knock downs.
1b4db9f7cb68c11a99d8672928ab712af41013c7.text:
* 考虑使用稳定姿态或平衡姿态来绕过击倒惩罚。
* 这个技能只有击中才会把你击倒。
* 与格斗相反，石拳徽章不会延长你被击倒的时间。
* 如果此攻击使用镰刀击中多个目标，则条件分别适用。每次击中你也会被单独击倒，这对于防止击倒很重要。

d27b38493abc472f0ff7981237657e365d189d96.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Destruction.
* Use with skills that destroy spirits to control the damage spike, such as Rupture Soul.
* This skill deals armor-ignoring lightning damage.

This spirit deals no damage if the caster (or his corpse) is not in compass range.

6ca21205882a5ca70960f434c7fa9f75e9d85db6.source: bug: This spirit deals no damage if the caster (or his corpse) is not in compass range.
6ca21205882a5ca70960f434c7fa9f75e9d85db6.text: bug：如果施法者（或其尸体）不在罗盘范围内，该灵魂不会造成伤害。

52d65bf2409dc928f9681ddd736cddf7709c36fd.source: * The damage caused when the ashes are dropped benefits from the 20% armor penetration effect.
52d65bf2409dc928f9681ddd736cddf7709c36fd.text: * 骨灰掉落时造成的伤害受益于20%护甲穿透效果。

3fbc4507bdb019e3bc92a2b392680ec729560675.source: anomaly: When dropped, the chat log notes your dropping the ashes as "You drop a Destructive was Glaive." When most ashes from an item spell are dropped, the chat log notes this as "You drop an Ashes of..." followed by the name of the item spell. Example: "You drop an Ashes of Grasping Kuurong."
3fbc4507bdb019e3bc92a2b392680ec729560675.text: 异常：掉落时，聊天记录会记录你掉落的灰烬为“你掉落了一把毁灭性的剑”。当物品法术的大部分灰烬被掉落时，聊天日志会将此记录为“你掉落了……的灰烬”，后跟物品法术的名称。示例：“你掉落了抓握枯荣的灰烬。”

3e6aaf074c1866895b94f9c7f5710d0c768b3e3c.source:
* To get the recharge effect, consider using this attack while line of sight is blocked. Momentarily switching to attack a blocking opponent or attacking whilst blind can give a good chance of getting the effect too.
** The Luxon/Kurzick skill Shadow Sanctuary and Signet of Midnight can inflict blind on the user.
3e6aaf074c1866895b94f9c7f5710d0c768b3e3c.text:
* 为了获得充能效果，请考虑在视线被阻挡的情况下使用此攻击。瞬间切换到攻击阻挡的对手或在失明状态下攻击也有很好的机会获得效果。
** 卢克森/库兹克技能暗影庇护所和午夜徽记可以使使用者失明。

b4f71d77425281e2e3f008d043950694ed33c3a3.source:
* This skill requires exactly 160 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 6 strikes and 10 units.
* Combine with Heavy Blow to keep your target knocked down.
b4f71d77425281e2e3f008d043950694ed33c3a3.text:
* 该技能正好需要 160 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 6 次打击和 10 单位。
* 与重击相结合，让你的目标被击倒。

5c382fd67db1dc461345ee024dfb6c9c96f16bc9.source:
*The short duration of this skill makes it unsuitable for tanking and surviving pressure during longer periods of time; however, it can be effective for surviving spikes due to its short recharge time.
*Heroes use this skill in combat below 80% health.
5c382fd67db1dc461345ee024dfb6c9c96f16bc9.text:
*该技能持续时间较短，不适合长时间的坦克和求生；然而，由于其充电时间短，它可以有效地应对峰值。
*英雄在生命值低于80%的战斗中使用该技能。

3bb023d969291048a04859f077680ec1bd36d62c.source:
* When looking for skills to meet Discord's conditions, consider those that either inflict their hexes or conditions in an area (e.g. Barbed Signet, Blood Bond) or have low energy costs, cast times, and recharge times (e.g. Parasitic Bond, Enfeeble).
** Similarly, Glyph of Immolation (followed by any hex that targets a foe) will set up Discord by applying the condition and hex together. (If the foe has already been hexed, just casting Discord is sufficient; the damage triggers because the Glyph's condition is applied before Discord checks the target's status.)
* This is the backbone skill for the PvE team build Discordway.
3bb023d969291048a04859f077680ec1bd36d62c.text:
* 在寻找满足不和谐条件的技能时，请考虑那些在某个区域造成六角形或条件的技能（例如倒刺印章、血色羁绊）或具有低能量成本、施法时间和充电时间的技能（例如寄生羁绊、衰弱）。
** 同样，献祭雕文（后跟任何针对敌人的降咒）将通过同时应用条件和降咒来设置不和谐。 （如果敌人已经被施咒，只需施放不和谐就足够了；伤害会触发，因为雕文的条件在不和谐检查目标状态之前应用。）
* 这是PvE团队构建Discordway的骨干技能。

e737317fd5db660cea4bcf4a57ac91b07f07bc95.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Disenchantment that uses the Disenchantment attack skill.
* Like other spirits, this does not preferentially target foes against which its effect would be useful (in this case, enchanted foes).
e737317fd5db660cea4bcf4a57ac91b07f07bc95.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用“祛魅”攻击技能的“祛魅之魂”。
* 与其他精魂一样，它不会优先针对对其效果有用的敌人（在本例中为附魔敌人）。

6a855e6d163973b798db0a0dc5de4d431b7a0878.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Disenchantment.
* Like other spirits, this does not preferentially target foes against which its effect would be useful - in this case, enchanted foes.
6a855e6d163973b798db0a0dc5de4d431b7a0878.text:
* 该技能会产生祛魅之魂。
* 与其他精魂一样，它不会优先针对其效果有用的敌人 - 在这种情况下，是被附魔的敌人。

0eebc343ab1c22e3052e88ad358e53e2b9a9f190.source: * This skill requires exactly 120 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 4 strikes and 20 units.
0eebc343ab1c22e3052e88ad358e53e2b9a9f190.text: * 该技能正好需要 120 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 4 次打击和 20 单位。

1dec6352f4bc320c87f29d96f15f6ae0f35901d7.source:
* This skill removes the condition before applying any healing, which allows it to heal at full strength when removing Deep Wound.
* Dismiss Condition always heals enchanted targets, whether a condition is removed or not.

Unlike most other skills with a healing component, Dismiss Condition can target spirits.
1dec6352f4bc320c87f29d96f15f6ae0f35901d7.text:
* 该技能会在进行任何治疗之前消除病症，这使得它在消除深度伤口时可以全力治疗。
*解除条件总是可以治愈被结界的目标，无论条件是否被移除。

与大多数其他具有治疗成分的技能不同，解散条件可以针对精神。

9921423b462616e137726062f2c7a584951cd65e.source: anomaly: Unlike most other skills with a healing component, Dismiss Condition can target spirits.
9921423b462616e137726062f2c7a584951cd65e.text: 异常：与大多数其他具有治疗成分的技能不同，解散条件可以针对精神。

01f76108be127a718f536a2355018aff2bb45a1c.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Displacement.
* Often used with Shelter and Union to provide superior damage reduction.
* Since this spirit will usually die very quickly, it is best to use this skill before the fight starts so that when it actually does begin, this skill will be ready to use again.
* Armor of Unfeeling can be used to reduce the damage taken by this spirit due to its effect.
* Miss effects can reduce the damage taken by this spirit, since they are resolved before this spirit's block chance.
There is a delay of 2-3 seconds from the spirit's creation to its effect being applied, unlike other skills.
The spirit will take damage even for attacks blocked by another blocking source. 
The duration bar beneath the effects monitor skill icon does not shrink over time like other effects with durations.
01f76108be127a718f536a2355018aff2bb45a1c.text:
* 该技能会产生位移之灵。
* 经常与庇护所和联盟一起使用，以提供卓越的伤害减少效果。
* 由于该精神通常会很快死亡，因此最好在战斗开始前使用该技能，以便在战斗真正开始时可以再次使用该技能。
* 绝情之甲可以用来减少该战魂因效果而受到的伤害。
* 未击中的效果可以减少该战魂受到的伤害，因为它们会在该战魂的格挡几率之前解决。
与其他技能不同，从武魂生成到生效，有2-3秒的延迟。
即使攻击被其他阻挡源阻挡，精神也会受到伤害。 
效果监视器技能图标下方的持续时间栏不会像其他具有持续时间的效果那样随着时间的推移而缩小。

d3d00b9b160b4ba6e9ca7a0d5a7ea1caeb4d4573.source: anomaly: There is a delay of 2-3 seconds from the spirit's creation to its effect being applied, unlike other skills.
d3d00b9b160b4ba6e9ca7a0d5a7ea1caeb4d4573.text: 异常：与其他技能不同，从武魂生成到生效效果有2-3秒的延迟。

a641e4ff054d8a71148286c4386ea09076d7d55d.source: bug: The spirit will take damage even for attacks blocked by another blocking source.
a641e4ff054d8a71148286c4386ea09076d7d55d.text: bug：即使攻击被其他阻挡源阻挡，精神也会受到伤害。

8157b8da5120a20e16de73368b182386feeb207e.source: bug: The duration bar beneath the effects monitor skill icon does not shrink over time like other effects with durations.
8157b8da5120a20e16de73368b182386feeb207e.text: bug：效果监控技能图标下方的持续时间栏不会像其他有持续时间的效果那样随着时间的推移而缩小。

9861b5f5aa0b0181f1d5aec13ef8397a155488fe.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Displacement.
* Since this spirit will usually die very quickly, it is best to use this skill before the fight starts so that when it actually does begin, this skill will be ready to use again.
* Shielding Urn from the Alliance Battles in Saltspray Beach can take the damage taken by this spirit until it wears off.
There is a delay of 2-3 seconds from the spirit's creation to its effect being applied, unlike other skills.
The duration bar beneath the effects monitor skill icon does not shrink over time like other effects with durations.
9861b5f5aa0b0181f1d5aec13ef8397a155488fe.text:
* 该技能会产生位移之灵。
* 由于该精神通常会很快死亡，因此最好在战斗开始前使用该技能，以便在战斗真正开始时可以再次使用该技能。
* 盐雾海滩的联盟战斗中的护盾瓮可以承受该精神所造成的伤害，直到其消失。
与其他技能不同，从武魂生成到生效，有2-3秒的延迟。
效果监视器技能图标下方的持续时间栏不会像其他具有持续时间的效果那样随着时间的推移而缩小。

131fb3b1f2fa52bb3f92d3408e050c87cebf6e4f.source:
*Despite not scaling with Marksmanship, this skill benefits from the critical rate increase offered by the attribute.
*This skill works well with Incendiary Arrows to interrupt multiple foes.
*To increase the frequency of interrupts, consider skills that increase attack speed.
*To increase the reliability to interrupt, consider skills such as Dual Shot, Triple Shot and Forked Arrow. Primary assassins can utilize the skills Way of the Master and Critical Eye to raise their critical chance as well.
** Non-primary assassins may find the effect of these uninvested skills too weak to deserve a skill slot.
* In PvE, one may consider using a Bow Grip of the Assassin to increase the chance for critical hits.
131fb3b1f2fa52bb3f92d3408e050c87cebf6e4f.text:
*尽管不随射击技能缩放，但该技能受益于该属性提供的暴击率增加。
*此技能与燃烧箭配合使用可以打断多个敌人。
*要增加打断的频率，请考虑提高攻击速度的技能。
*为了提高打断的可靠性，可以考虑使用双箭、三箭和叉箭等技能。初级刺客也可以利用大师之道和批判之眼技能来提高暴击率。
** 非主要刺客可能会发现这些未投入技能的效果太弱，不值得拥有技能槽。
* 在PvE中，可以考虑使用刺客弓握来增加暴击几率。

13e9b2a6346bfe1ad3ae9e9bf62954eb12faeea8.source: * Combined with a +33% attack speed boost as well as an adrenaline boost, this skill alone can interrupt foes more frequently than almost any other skill; only Psychic Distraction is an exception.
13e9b2a6346bfe1ad3ae9e9bf62954eb12faeea8.text: * 结合+33%攻击速度提升和肾上腺素提升，仅此技能就可以比几乎任何其他技能更频繁地打断敌人；只有精神分心是一个例外。

030a43e639a66567e50860b1e70dd9b7ce044bb8.source: *Distracting Shot has the same energy cost, activation time and recharge time as this skill, in addition to disabling the interrupted skill for +20 seconds. As such, consider bringing Distracting Shot over this skill if you need the interrupt rather than the damage and are not worried about blocks.
030a43e639a66567e50860b1e70dd9b7ce044bb8.text: *分散射击与该技能具有相同的能量消耗、激活时间和充能时间，此外还能使被打断的技能失效+20秒。因此，如果您需要打断而不是伤害并且不担心格挡，请考虑在该技能上使用分散注意力射击。

9a50e51ac0a0e09675a3748574af7f168b553e60.source: * Pet attacks take effect on the animal companion's next attack, making it difficult to time the interrupt.
9a50e51ac0a0e09675a3748574af7f168b553e60.text: * 宠物的攻击会在动物伙伴的下一次攻击时生效，因此很难确定中断的时间。

0313c0cd1d1adb08687c4dd7a7160270c3190fb4.source:
* The arrow leaves the bow 0.25 seconds into this skill's activation, as attack skills hit halfway through their stated activation time.
* Deals additional damage even if skill interruption is prevented.
* If used to interrupt a target under the effect of Daze, the Daze will interrupt the target before the skill does, and no additional damage will be dealt.
0313c0cd1d1adb08687c4dd7a7160270c3190fb4.text:
* 箭在该技能激活后 0.25 秒离开弓，因为攻击技能在规定的激活时间中途击中。
* 即使技能中断被阻止，也会造成额外伤害。
* 如果用于打断处于迷惑效果的目标，迷惑会先于技能打断目标，并且不会造成额外伤害。

cd24ce1bf26d50a3a63830e562c2d93463fb82e4.source:
* The AI will use this skill to start an attack chain, without regard to its interruption effect.
* This skill will not disable spells that are prevented from being interrupted.
cd24ce1bf26d50a3a63830e562c2d93463fb82e4.text:
* AI会使用该技能启动攻击链，不考虑其打断效果。
* 该技能不会禁用被阻止被打断的法术。

1ec832f5cb857e7db495133eb162077315b7f3ae.source: *This attack will also interrupt if you are under the effect of a skill that will cause a condition on the next attack, such as Anthem of Flame, but not Apply Poison.
1ec832f5cb857e7db495133eb162077315b7f3ae.text: *如果你受到某种技能的影响，该技能会在下一次攻击中造成某种情况，例如火焰之歌，但不会使用毒药，那么这次攻击也会打断。

84f4c9b5c7fd5e613f38f0d35444102d315e1c8d.source:
* This skill is useful for maintaining Critical Defenses or Critical Agility since it's a guaranteed critical hit.
* This skill is effective for maintaining your energy because, in addition to restoring energy itself, the critical hits also restore energy with Critical Strikes. The following table shows the total energy gain (excluding skill cost):

* 该技能对于维持暴击防御或暴击敏捷很有用，因为它可以保证暴击。
* 该技能对于维持能量非常有效，因为除了恢复能量本身之外，暴击还会通过暴击来恢复能量。下表显示了总能量增益（不包括技能消耗）：

af4bbd72c16b6c2289b4398475b49ac476434c39.source: * An animal companion counts as an ally.

e841ecc2e0daa2c0edaf59db9cf99abc5cd08444.source:
* Crude Swing is a single attack that can hit multiple foes.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to attack kiting opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
e841ecc2e0daa2c0edaf59db9cf99abc5cd08444.text:
* 粗暴挥击是一次攻击，可以击中多个敌人。
* 该技能击中的敌人是与使用者相邻的敌人，而不是目标。
** 如果风筝对手（包括目标）在攻击连接时已移开，则此攻击将无法攻击他们。

2345f9375849ccc0c32995e91123e439343beec3.source: * The damage caused when the ashes are dropped benefits from the 10% armor penetration effect.
2345f9375849ccc0c32995e91123e439343beec3.text: * 骨灰掉落时造成的伤害受益于10%护甲穿透效果。

78bdc2295ea151728d815ca6e56051be171cd891.source: * Nearly universally used by Hammer Warriors to apply Deep Wound.
78bdc2295ea151728d815ca6e56051be171cd891.text: * 铁锤战士几乎普遍使用它来施加深度伤口。

f4e0726049e082a532bf63cdabb24dceddf8bacc.source:
*The interrupt effect that is applied as an area of effect affects all actions (including basic attacks) and occurs even if the interrupt on the initial target was prevented.
*Useful for interrupting a clumped group of spikers.
*In hard mode, multiple copies of this skill in the hands of foes can decimate an unsuspecting party in seconds. Especially parties of heroes and/or henchmen are at risk, due to their default formation being very close to one another.
*Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.
f4e0726049e082a532bf63cdabb24dceddf8bacc.text:
*作为效果范围应用的中断效果会影响所有动作（包括基本攻击），即使初始目标的中断被阻止，也会发生。
*对于打断一群聚集的进攻者很有用。
*在困难模式下，敌人手中的该技能的多个副本可以在几秒钟内消灭毫无戒心的队伍。特别是英雄和/或追随者的队伍处于危险之中，因为他们的默认阵型彼此非常接近。
*即使阻止中断，也会造成损坏。

abf8ca7046ad424480b63808cd53a9cbf4f2b33a.source:
* The health degeneration will affect spirits and cannot be removed (i.e. it is not a hex).
* The degeneration does not stack; if a foe is affected by a second Cry of Pain, the duration will be renewed.
* The damage and degeneration will be applied regardless of whether a skill was interrupted.
* The concise description is slightly unclear as to whom the health degeneration will be applied.
This is the only skill that has health degeneration shown with positive value in the description.
abf8ca7046ad424480b63808cd53a9cbf4f2b33a.text:
* 健康恶化会影响精神，且无法消除（即不是降咒）。
* 退化不叠加；如果敌人受到第二次痛苦怒吼的影响，持续时间将会延长。
* 无论技能是否被打断，都会施加伤害和退化。
* 简明的描述稍微不清楚健康退化将适用于谁。
这是描述中唯一显示健康退化并具有积极价值的技能。

82fd4367df974794d5d3a05ae3560947d6cc97ba.source: anomaly: This is the only skill that has health degeneration shown with positive value in the description.
82fd4367df974794d5d3a05ae3560947d6cc97ba.text: 异常：这是唯一在描述中显示生命值下降且具有正值的技能。

b7c2f3b3475795cdff727367e527bdc5e06b22a4.source:
*The non-concise description redundantly mentions "negative conditions" when there are no positive conditions.
*Synergizes with Shockwave and Fragility.
*The damage from removing conditions is not a separate packet of damage.
b7c2f3b3475795cdff727367e527bdc5e06b22a4.text:
*不简洁的描述在没有积极条件的情况下重复提及“消极条件”。
*与冲击波和脆弱性协同作用。
*移除条件造成的损坏不是单独的包损坏。

3dab8c4b8361c6231ad60f0b200d0b1cf0872c7d.source:
* Synergizes well with Angorodon's Gaze.
* Using Plague Sending while enchanted with Cultist's Fervor will instantly transfer the bleeding to the target.
Causes bleeding when non-fleshy creatures, such as Shadow Vaettirs, cast Necromancer spells.
3dab8c4b8361c6231ad60f0b200d0b1cf0872c7d.text:
* 与安戈洛顿的凝视有很好的协同作用。
* 在附魔邪教狂热时使用瘟疫传送会立即将流血转移到目标身上。
当非肉质生物（例如暗影维提尔）施放死灵法师法术时会导致流血。

ac71e16661a3ec2753205a3242523922a1a79548.source: anomaly: Causes bleeding when non-fleshy creatures, such as Shadow Vaettirs, cast Necromancer spells.
ac71e16661a3ec2753205a3242523922a1a79548.text: 异常：当非肉质生物（例如暗影维蒂尔斯）施放死灵法师法术时会导致流血。

42eb0c124741af2f9f38642b365ed2c84b94352c.source: * The healing occurs after hex removal, so the healing amount is not affected when this skill is used to remove a hex that decreases healing.
42eb0c124741af2f9f38642b365ed2c84b94352c.text: * 治疗发生在去除六角形之后，因此当使用该技能去除减少治疗效果的六角形时，治疗量不会受到影响。

1af0fd17cedd73fb20646d7a448b6f48abbaa14c.source:
* Cyclone Axe is a single attack that can hit multiple foes; the foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to hit kiting opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
1af0fd17cedd73fb20646d7a448b6f48abbaa14c.text:
* 旋风斧是一次攻击，可以击中多个敌人；该技能击中的敌人是与使用者相邻的敌人，而不是目标。
** 如果风筝对手（包括目标）在攻击连接时已经离开，则此攻击将无法击中。

69ed0fb0f19412dc53b65c3b2b9cde6228900a15.source:
*When the skill activates it will make a bell sound once per projectile.
The daggers will randomly trigger -2 physical damage mods on shields even though they cause earth damage.
69ed0fb0f19412dc53b65c3b2b9cde6228900a15.text:
*当技能激活时，每个弹丸都会发出一次铃声。
匕首会随机触发护盾上的 -2 点物理伤害，即使它们会造成土属性伤害。

5685dbf172c8599ba2d91fe7c46525b51d1058e6.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Dissonance that uses the Dissonance attack skill. 
* Consider using Signet of Ghostly Might to increase the chances of interrupts. 
This spirit will interrupt even when the target is using a skill like Mantra of Resolve.
5685dbf172c8599ba2d91fe7c46525b51d1058e6.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用不和谐攻击技能的不和谐之灵。 
* 考虑使用幽灵力量徽记来增加中断的机会。 
即使目标使用决心咒语等技能，该战魂也会打断。

32a85d04ba6e8054d706c33f906603a8a913ea3f.source: bug: This spirit will interrupt even when the target is using a skill like Mantra of Resolve.
32a85d04ba6e8054d706c33f906603a8a913ea3f.text: bug：即使目标使用决心咒等技能，该战魂也会打断。

6b7e5ac8aa9efd8c669e3087a5f42b7e7cdf3d13.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Dissonance.
This spirit will interrupt even when the target is using a skill like Mantra of Resolve (PvP)[Source claim needs verification].
6b7e5ac8aa9efd8c669e3087a5f42b7e7cdf3d13.text:
* 该技能会产生不和谐之魂。
即使目标使用决心咒语（PvP）等技能，该精神也会中断[来源声明需要验证]。

437c98f09b9fa95b42eedc00740967b3c0598d65.source: bug: This spirit will interrupt even when the target is using a skill like Mantra of Resolve (PvP)[Source claim needs verification].
437c98f09b9fa95b42eedc00740967b3c0598d65.text: bug：即使目标使用决心咒语（PvP）等技能，该精神也会打断[来源声明需要验证]。

de166e0e7eaba212f1c1416407b878a805cfc86e.source:
* Similarly to Mantra of Resolve or Pious Concentration, Distortion will trigger and allow to block once then end if the user can't afford the energy cost. 
* Consider combining with Spirit of Failure.
de166e0e7eaba212f1c1416407b878a805cfc86e.text:
* 与决心咒语或虔诚专注类似，如果用户无法承担能量成本，扭曲将触发并允许阻止一次然后结束。 
* 考虑与失败之灵结合。

62cfe46c6dc5ce42bee20dfb3957292ebc8b5dc4.source:
* Unlike Distracting Strike, no damage packet is displayed when hitting the target.
** Barbs, and the damage increase from Soul Taker, Order of Pain, Strength of Honor, and Conjures will not trigger.
* A hit is still registered on the target:
** Adrenaline (and energy if using a Zealous weapon modifier) is gained as usual. 
** Scythe attacks will hit up to two additional adjacent foes (interrupting them and foes adjacent to them).
** Adrenaline gain from Mark of Fury and Dark Fury, Blood Bond's healing, and Soul Taker's health sacrifice will occur.
** Life stealing from a Vampiric weapon modifier, Avatar of Grenth, Grenth's Aura and Order of the Vampire will occur.
** Splinter Weapon will trigger.
** Distracting Blow needs to hit for its interruption to occur. If Distracting Blow misses (due to blind for instance) or the user is under the effects of Illusionary Weaponry, the interruption will not occur. 
The concise description is incorrect: the adjacent foes are interrupted but not attacked. Notably, you won't gain adrenaline from them, and Illusionary Weaponry will not damage them (unless wielding a scythe).
62cfe46c6dc5ce42bee20dfb3957292ebc8b5dc4.text:
* 与分散打击不同，击中目标时不会显示伤害包。
** 倒刺，以及夺魂者、痛苦秩序、荣誉之力、召唤术的伤害增加不会触发。
* 目标上仍记录有命中：
** 肾上腺素（如果使用热心武器修饰符则还有能量）照常获得。 
** 镰刀攻击将额外击中最多两个相邻敌人（打断他们以及与他们相邻的敌人）。
** 狂怒印记和黑暗狂怒、血缘纽带的治疗以及灵魂吞噬者的健康牺牲将会带来肾上腺素的增加。
** 将会发生从吸血鬼武器修改器、古兰斯化身、古兰斯光环和吸血鬼秩序中窃取生命的情况。
** 碎片武器将会触发。
** 需要击中分散打击才能中断。如果分散打击未命中（例如由于失明）或使用者受到幻影武器的影响，则不会发生中断。 
简洁的描述是不正确的：相邻的敌人被打断但没有受到攻击。值得注意的是，你不会从它们身上获得肾上腺素，幻象武器也不会伤害它们（除非挥舞镰刀）。

c6814b3352b95099fe07a39dbc87d28721773492.source: anomaly: The concise description is incorrect: the adjacent foes are interrupted but not attacked. Notably, you won't gain adrenaline from them, and Illusionary Weaponry will not damage them (unless wielding a scythe).
c6814b3352b95099fe07a39dbc87d28721773492.text: 异常：简明描述不正确：相邻敌人被打断但未被攻击。值得注意的是，你不会从它们身上获得肾上腺素，幻象武器也不会伤害它们（除非挥舞镰刀）。

fe38b16329e2d3c9ff9590b0e40a263289fb0d93.source:
* In Nightfall this skill becomes unlocked after recruiting either Margrid the Sly or Acolyte Jin, then it can be learned using a skill tome.
* The arrow leaves the bow 0.25 seconds into this skill's activation, as attack skills hit halfway through their stated activation time.
* This skill has a 0.75 second aftercast delay.
* Skills will not be disabled if they are easily interrupted (including Dazed) or interrupted by an effect such as Choking Gas or Spinal Shivers, as those trigger before Distracting Shot takes effect.
* Distracting Shot will not disable a skill that is prevented from being interrupted.
fe38b16329e2d3c9ff9590b0e40a263289fb0d93.text:
* 在《夜幕降临》中，招募狡猾的玛格丽特或金侍僧后，该技能就会解锁，然后可以使用技能书来学习。
* 箭在该技能激活后 0.25 秒离开弓，因为攻击技能在规定的激活时间中途击中。
* 该技能有0.75秒的施法延迟。
* 如果技能很容易被打断（包括晕眩）或被诸如窒息气体或脊椎颤抖之类的效果打断，则不会被禁用，因为这些技能在分散射击生效之前触发。
* 分散射击不会禁用被阻止被打断的技能。

59091cccdda9b97fcef39d3ec876bb5727049710.source:
Unlike Distracting Blow, Distracting Strike deals a damage packet of zero rather than no damage.
* The interrupted skill will be disabled for 30 seconds if its recharge is less than that amount. If its normal recharge is longer than 30 seconds, there is no additional disabling effect.
* Unlike Distracting Blow, Order of Pain as well as Soul Taker will increase the damage dealt, and Barbs will trigger.
59091cccdda9b97fcef39d3ec876bb5727049710.text:
与分散打击不同，分散打击造成的伤害为零，而不是无伤害。
* 如果充能量低于该值，被打断的技能将被禁用30秒。如果其正常充能时间超过30秒，则不会产生额外的失效效果。
* 与分散打击不同，痛苦令和灵魂夺走者会增加造成的伤害，并且会触发倒刺。

26ba10a7602f7161266af782ebbc3b4f8dedc35a.source: anomaly: Unlike Distracting Blow, Distracting Strike deals a damage packet of zero rather than no damage.
26ba10a7602f7161266af782ebbc3b4f8dedc35a.text: 异常：与分散打击不同，分散打击造成的伤害为零，而不是没有伤害。

73457df5bb291942e8a4b3ee557d407aaf50033e.source:
* Using a skill with the property "recharges instantly" will end Diversion without increasing that skill's recharge time. This is also true of skills with a hidden instant recharge effect, such as Assassin chain attacks made without meeting the prerequisite.
* Inspired Hex/Revealed Hex will also end Diversion without increasing that skill's recharge time.
** If an affected target uses any other hex removal, Diversion will still activate and increase the recharge time of the hex removal skill.
* Preventing a skill from being diverted (especially in PvP) is one of the main uses of cancelling.
This skill has no effect on Dash (PvP).
73457df5bb291942e8a4b3ee557d407aaf50033e.text:
* 使用具有“立即充能”属性的技能将结束转移，而不会增加该技能的充能时间。具有隐藏即时充值效果的技能也是如此，例如在不满足条件的情况下进行的刺客连环攻击。
* Inspired Hex/Revealed Hex也将结束Diversion，而不会增加该技能的充能时间。
** 如果受影响的目标使用任何其他除妖术，转移仍然会激活并增加除妖术技能的充能时间。
* 防止技能被转移（尤其是在 PvP 中）是取消的主要用途之一。
该技能对冲刺（PvP）没有影响。

6c114eec88c6c99d15b95edb63b7c4e061e7d361.source: bug: This skill has no effect on Dash (PvP).
6c114eec88c6c99d15b95edb63b7c4e061e7d361.text: bug：该技能对冲刺（PvP）没有效果。

57a83cc58da9a3b46275345747ea2674546eec80.source:
* Divine Boon requires strong energy management, since it increases skill costs and decreases natural regeneration.
* Unlike the Divine Favor bonus, untargeted skills will neither heal the caster, nor cause the energy loss.
* Divine Boon's healing always takes effect first, before the effects of the spell that triggered it. For example, its healing will occur before Zealous Benediction checks its target's health. When using Mend Condition to remove a Deep Wound, Divine Boon's healing is still reduced by the Deep Wound.
57a83cc58da9a3b46275345747ea2674546eec80.text:
* 神圣恩惠需要强大的能量管理，因为它会增加技能成本并减少自然再生。
* 与神恩加成不同，无针对性的技能既不会治愈施法者，也不会造成能量损失。
* 神圣恩赐的治疗效果总是先于触发它的法术效果之前生效。例如，它的治疗会在热心祝福检查其目标的健康状况之前发生。当使用治愈状态移除深层伤口时，神圣恩惠的治疗效果仍会因深层伤口而减少。

72d449286689c139e7fef4770bf927a453710d27.source:
* Only the caster receives any bonus healing from Divine Favor.
* AI will use Divine Healing when 2 party members are below 75% health or as a self heal when below 50% health.
72d449286689c139e7fef4770bf927a453710d27.text:
* 只有施法者才能从神圣恩惠中获得额外的治疗效果。
* 当 2 名队员的生命值低于 75% 时，AI 将使用神圣治疗，或者当生命值低于 50% 时，AI 将使用神圣治疗。

43ba219e068a22395755fcd852520ab8701339aa.source:
This skill does not prevent damage; rather, it heals the enchanted target to the stated amount when they would die.
* The heal triggers from any damage, health degeneration, health loss, and health sacrifice that would otherwise kill you.
* Heroes seem to only use this skill when an ally is around 25% health.
* Heroes and henchmen will use this skill on minions at low health.
43ba219e068a22395755fcd852520ab8701339aa.text:
该技能不能防止伤害；相反，它会在被附魔的目标死亡时将其治愈至规定的数量。
* 任何伤害、健康退化、健康损失和健康牺牲都会触发治疗，否则这些都会杀死你。
* 英雄似乎只在盟友生命值约为 25% 时才使用此技能。
* 英雄和追随者会对生命值较低的小兵使用此技能。

27df046148c964330258822801280fa6d94365da.source: bug: This skill does not prevent damage; rather, it heals the enchanted target to the stated amount when they would die.
27df046148c964330258822801280fa6d94365da.text: bug：该技能不能防止伤害；相反，它会在被附魔的目标死亡时将其治愈至规定的数量。

9f2ba4388d1211089a3f3e44d08fea8cd077a15c.source:
* Combines well with Deny Hexes.
* Combined with the Elementalist Elite, Glyph of Renewal, this enchantment can be kept up permanently as an effective form of energy management.

;Hero AI
* Heroes do not use this very effectively, often casting it at inappropriate times (at the end of a battle or outside of a battle completely) and not bothering to use it when it's recharged and running low on energy.
9f2ba4388d1211089a3f3e44d08fea8cd077a15c.text:
* 与拒绝六角形完美结合。
* 与元素精英、更新雕文相结合，这种结界可以作为一种有效的能量管理形式永久保留。

;英雄人工智能
*英雄不会非常有效地使用它，经常在不适当的时间（在战斗结束或完全在战斗之外）施放它，并且在充电和能量不足时懒得使用它。

9f74c3d588b3d12e50a2ab1cc77a2834a86b6e82.source:
{{speed|5|11|33|30}}
* "Projectiles" means ranged attacks from weapons, not projectile spells.
9f74c3d588b3d12e50a2ab1cc77a2834a86b6e82.text:
{{速度|5|11|33|30}}
*“投射物”是指武器的远程攻击，而不是投射物法术。

9f4afeed057d2a890db694d6a180f08c3b2713a0.source: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Signet of Suffering) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
9f4afeed057d2a890db694d6a180f08c3b2713a0.text: 尽管没有激活时间，但该徽记（类似于痛苦徽记）在被击倒或执行动作时无法使用。

08447aca830f7c2613ceb96031b2e3e1de297ba7.source: anomaly: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Signet of Suffering) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
08447aca830f7c2613ceb96031b2e3e1de297ba7.text: 异常：尽管没有激活时间，但该徽记（类似于痛苦徽记）在被击倒或执行动作时无法使用。

cc2d95c1fb5eda4e7cfe03c6e241d8a051f8b1ae.source:
*As with any doublecast skill, NPCs will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's area of effect range of an ally.
*If a foe is targeted, the nearest ally (which can be the caster) will be enchanted instead. If nothing is targeted, Double Dragon will only be applied to the caster (the nearest ally).
**This is the only offensive doublecast skill that does not deal double damage when targeting yourself, because Double Dragon does not have an initial effect. This is due to game mechanics: you cannot be affected by two of the same enchantment.
*Burning is applied before the effect of skills, thus Double Dragon combines well with skills that require a condition (e.g. Virulence or Vile Miasma) or burning (e.g. Glowing Gaze or Searing Flames).
If a foe with a spell targeting prevention skill is targeted, Double Dragon will fail, despite the enchantment applying to the ally nearest to the target foe.
Whenever a target under the effects of Double Dragon is interrupted, the animation restarts.
Unlike most area damage over time skills, Double Dragon does not cause AI to scatter.
cc2d95c1fb5eda4e7cfe03c6e241d8a051f8b1ae.text:
*与任何双施技能一样，只要盟友的法术效果范围内有敌人，NPC 就会使用该技能。
*如果敌人成为目标，最近的盟友（可以是施法者）将被附魔。如果没有任何目标，双截龙将仅应用于施法者（最近的盟友）。
**这是唯一一个在以自己为目标时不会造成双倍伤害的进攻性双重施放技能，因为双龙没有初始效果。这是由于游戏机制所致：你不能受到两个相同结界的影响。
*燃烧是在技能效果之前施加的，因此双龙与需要条件（例如毒力或邪恶瘴气）或燃烧（例如灼热凝视或灼热火焰）的技能可以很好地结合。
如果以具有法术瞄准预防技能的敌人为目标，则双龙将会失败，尽管结界适用于距离目标敌人最近的盟友。
每当双龙效果下的目标被打断时，动画就会重新开始。
与大多数区域持续伤害技能不同，双龙不会导致 AI 分散。

839aa180187096d8c7a32ba4f4f8d953c2c81685.source: anomaly: If a foe with a spell targeting prevention skill is targeted, Double Dragon will fail, despite the enchantment applying to the ally nearest to the target foe.
839aa180187096d8c7a32ba4f4f8d953c2c81685.text: 异常：如果目标具有法术瞄准预防技能的敌人，双龙将会失败，尽管结界适用于距离目标敌人最近的盟友。

97cad9cf26c1f831247865b60e238d19acb60363.source: anomaly: Whenever a target under the effects of Double Dragon is interrupted, the animation restarts.
97cad9cf26c1f831247865b60e238d19acb60363.text: 异常：每当双龙效果下的目标被打断时，动画就会重新开始。
