003eb4d72e23c6b53eae9f05c0045f2e650f8f46.text: 异常：与大多数区域持续伤害技能不同，双龙不会导致AI分散。

061f8f7c2432a51168054fdc473d0227c87678d1.text:
* 该技能可以完全补充自身的肾上腺素消耗：
** 等级 6 或更高，具有任何使肾上腺素增益加倍的效果（即狂怒剑柄或 PvE 中的技能“为了伟大的正义！”）；
** 等级 14 或更高，具有至少给予一次肾上腺素额外打击的任何效果（例如黑暗之怒）；
** 等级 17 或更高，仅靠其自身效果。

84f511e6079313ed00b396636500d73c82689da5.source: * This is one of the few spells that makes full use of Glyph of Energy.
84f511e6079313ed00b396636500d73c82689da5.text: * 这是少数充分利用能量雕文的法术之一。

3338d33003b0387898bc382b1f206431bfa5dc03.source: * Combines well with mesmer hexes that have an effect upon ending, such as Ether Phantom or Web of Disruption.
3338d33003b0387898bc382b1f206431bfa5dc03.text: * 与对结束有影响的催眠术相结合，例如以太幻影或破坏之网。

abf9cf6262361b3a1c188a17b9e891d41f6bbad4.source: * The full description mentioning "negative conditions" is redundant, as every condition has a negative effect.
abf9cf6262361b3a1c188a17b9e891d41f6bbad4.text: * 提及“负面条件”的完整描述是多余的，因为每个条件都会产生负面影响。

5fa41daf49ab42b559df16de33e0090cd125be01.source:
* If not targeting a specific spirit, this causes nearest allied spirit to shadow step to your location.
* Teleporting a spirit to your location while another allied spirit of the same name is within spirit range will cause the shadow-stepped spirit to die.
5fa41daf49ab42b559df16de33e0090cd125be01.text:
* 如果不针对特定的精魂，这会导致最近的盟友精魂以暗影步的方式到达你的位置。
* 将一个灵魂传送到你的位置，而另一个同名的友方灵魂在灵魂范围内将会导致暗影步灵魂死亡。

1c0030718fe763fa6431ed8ca349366d5a5693fd.source: bug: Contrary to the description, this skill causes the spirit to shadow step rather than teleport.
1c0030718fe763fa6431ed8ca349366d5a5693fd.text: bug：与描述相反，该技能导致灵魂进行暗影步而不是瞬移。

5e11265970725b70ea8ccfd73a5bcc616d3358e5.source:
* Could be combined with "I Meant to Do That!".
* Consider using with Steady Stance or Balanced Stance to bypass the knock down penalty.
* This skill will only knock you down if it hits.
* Contrary to Grapple, Stonefist Insignia does not prolong the time you are knocked down.
* If this attack hits multiple targets by using a scythe, the conditions are applied separately. You are also knocked down separately for each hit, which matters if preventing knock downs.
5e11265970725b70ea8ccfd73a5bcc616d3358e5.text:
* 可以与“我打算这样做！”结合使用。
* 考虑使用稳定姿态或平衡姿态来绕过击倒惩罚。
* 这个技能只有击中才会把你击倒。
* 与格斗相反，石拳徽章不会延长你被击倒的时间。
* 如果此攻击使用镰刀击中多个目标，则条件分别适用。每次击中你也会被单独击倒，这对于防止击倒很重要。

45077f9bfc7d9181754cf354a00b44888bcec343.source:
* You cannot use this skill without being at least Deldrimor rank 1, because it is awarded along with 1,500 reputation points.
*If you would like to have the added benefits of Drunken Master without the screen effects of being drunk open the game options menu and on the graphics tab uncheck "Enable post process effects".
*The use of one 1 point alcohol just before you activate the skill is enough to trigger the bonus effects.
45077f9bfc7d9181754cf354a00b44888bcec343.text:
*除非Deldrimor等级至少为1，否则您无法使用此技能，因为它与1,500声望点一起授予。
*如果您想获得《醉拳》的额外好处，但又不想看到醉酒的屏幕效果，请打开游戏选项菜单，然后在图形选项卡上取消选中“启用后期处理效果”。
*在激活技能前使用一瓶1点酒精就足以触发奖励效果。

099c8cdff7e0aa8f77e728452a83001a350db69d.source:
* Combine with skills that trigger "on hit", as there are likely 2 hits.
* Bonus damage (i.e. from Conjure spells, Glass Arrows and certain weapon spells) is not reduced.
* This skill triggers Empathy only once, as it targets a single foe.
099c8cdff7e0aa8f77e728452a83001a350db69d.text:
* 结合“命中”触发的技能，因为可能有 2 次命中。
* 额外伤害（即来自召唤法术、玻璃箭和某些武器法术的伤害）不会减少。
* 该技能仅触发一次同理心，因为它针对的是单个敌人。

e2dcb41f1bec46d22714cae03b2c581c27eabc56.source: This hex only reduces damage from attacks.
e2dcb41f1bec46d22714cae03b2c581c27eabc56.text: 这个六角形只会减少攻击造成的伤害。

2e51de917606843b654ae5f8d88a886f4787192d.source: anomaly: This hex only reduces damage from attacks.
2e51de917606843b654ae5f8d88a886f4787192d.text: 异常：此六角形仅减少攻击造成的伤害。

830ac515f34129b36adf4487cd5f3f8a099bbb0e.source: The damage dealt is armor-ignoring earth damage.
830ac515f34129b36adf4487cd5f3f8a099bbb0e.text: 造成的伤害是无视护甲的大地伤害。

6b3c43225ceb6e293d4c49329a78b8f09ad23ef1.source:

* Combine this with Ritual Lord or Soul Twisting for faster recharge and damage output.
* Use with skills that destroy spirits to control the damage spike, such as Rupture Soul.

The damage dealt is armor-ignoring lightning damage.

* 将其与仪式领主或灵魂扭曲结合使用，可以更快地充电和输出伤害。

adbfb5accf772c2e8ccd66b695711914ef40a419.text: bug：造成的伤害是无视护甲的大地伤害。

c248da69a2fe4c472ab16039c14283b0963479e7.source:
* The fastest sure way to capture this skill is from Taskmaster Durgon with the quest Dredging the Depths entering from Vlox's Falls.
* Lieutenant Mahgma, found in Fronis Irontoe's Lair during Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!, also has Dwarven Battle Stance, but it cannot be captured from him as your skill bar is replaced with Dwarven brawling skills.
* This stance can be maintained indefinitely if used in combination with Dwarven Stability.
* The interrupt lands before the attack skill does. If the enemy is set to resume attacking after their action would complete, they will then transition into an "attacking" state after being interrupted. This will satisfy both Counter Blow and Counterattack's conditional bonuses against attacking foes. This significantly increases the reliability of these two skills in PvE, even against caster targets. This will not work if you hit them during Aftercast delay, as the interrupt will not apply to a target in that state.
c248da69a2fe4c472ab16039c14283b0963479e7.text:
* 获得此技能的最快可靠方法是从模仿大师杜尔贡那里获得从 Vlox's Falls 进入的任务 Dredging the Depths。
* Mahgma中尉，在Kilroy Stonekin的Punch-Out Extravaganza！期间在Fronis Irontoe的巢穴中找到，也有矮人战斗姿态，但无法从他身上夺取，因为你的技能栏被矮人争吵技能取代。
* 如果与矮人稳定性结合使用，该姿态可以无限期地保持。
* 打断先于攻击技能落地。如果敌人设置为在行动完成后继续攻击，那么他们会在被打断后转变为“攻击”状态。这将满足反击和反击对攻击敌人的条件加值。这显着提高了这两项技能在 PvE 中的可靠性，即使是针对施法者目标。如果您在 Aftercast 延迟期间击中它们，这将不起作用，因为中断不会应用于该状态下的目标。

a0b9cf491f0ed35ffc46e37544120bdf6b7429f0.source:
*Useful with stances that have a longer recharge time than duration. For example:
**Dash or Pious Haste as a speed boost
**Dark Escape, Dwarven Battle Stance, and Lightning Reflexes become more suitable for PvE.
*If you would like to have the added benefits of Dwarven Stability without the screen effects of being drunk open the game options menu and on the graphics tab uncheck "Enable post process effects".
*The use of one 1 point alcohol just before you activate the skill is enough to trigger the bonus effects.

If recast before the duration ends, Dwarven Stability will end before being reapplied, triggering Meditation and other relevant skills.
This skill has no aftercast delay.
a0b9cf491f0ed35ffc46e37544120bdf6b7429f0.text:
*对于充电时间长于持续时间的姿势很有用。例如：
**冲刺或虔诚急速作为速度提升
**黑暗逃脱、矮人战斗姿态和闪电反射变得更适合 PvE。
*如果您想获得矮人稳定性的额外好处，而又不想出现醉酒的屏幕效果，请打开游戏选项菜单，然后在图形选项卡上取消选中“启用后期处理效果”。
*在发动技能前饮用一瓶1点酒精即可触发奖励效果。

如果在持续时间结束之前重铸，矮人稳定性将在重新施加之前结束，触发冥想和其他相关技能。
该技能没有施法后延迟。

5674fe99f1776510fe87f545ba0c3f66674a77bb.source: anomaly: If recast before the duration ends, Dwarven Stability will end before being reapplied, triggering Meditation and other relevant skills.
5674fe99f1776510fe87f545ba0c3f66674a77bb.text: 异常：如果在持续时间结束之前重铸，矮人稳定性会在重新施加之前结束，触发冥想和其他相关技能。

959deca88203f9aea8358b1817f6614f5390c473.source: * The conditional healing is included with the base healing as a single packet.
959deca88203f9aea8358b1817f6614f5390c473.text: * 条件治疗包含在基础治疗中作为一个单独的包。

104992c768760d7c1f928d70a23f87affde996c8.source:
* The caster's party is healed, not the party of the dead ally.
* This skill can be remarkably effective when used on minions.
* Heroes use this skill on allies under 75% health.
** Heroes may roam far away from the party to use this skill on an ally even if set on guard.
104992c768760d7c1f928d70a23f87affde996c8.text:
*施法者的队伍被治愈，而不是死去盟友的队伍。
* 该技能对小兵使用时非常有效。
* 英雄对生命值低于 75% 的盟友使用此技能。
** 即使处于戒备状态，英雄也可能会远离队伍对盟友使用此技能。

be72982b7bdc954d6ba3868d1190f5531dbc272a.source:
* Ear Bite is a touch skill, not an attack. Therefore, you gain no adrenaline after use.
* The damage dealt is armor-ignoring.
be72982b7bdc954d6ba3868d1190f5531dbc272a.text:
* 咬耳是接触技能，不是攻击。因此，使用后您不会获得肾上腺素。
* 造成的伤害是无视护甲的。

7a49e6670d87d32d93cde8ef4a76ea8530dbfbe5.source:
* Only the target foe is hit with the attack; this skill must hit for the knockdown to take effect.
* Target foe and all foes adjacent to target foe are knocked down.
7a49e6670d87d32d93cde8ef4a76ea8530dbfbe5.text:
* 攻击仅击中目标敌人；该技能必须击中才能击倒生效。
* 目标敌人以及与目标敌人相邻的所有敌人都被击倒。

03281c62be4e821ee5cd63f547002a68565933fe.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Earthbind.
* This skill allows you to knock down foes who possess Stun Immunity. However, it has no effect against other knock down prevention skills, such as Dwarven Stability or Ward of Stability.
* The spirit loses health on every successful knock down, regardless of whether the length was affected.

Armor of Unfeeling will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its knock down effect.
03281c62be4e821ee5cd63f547002a68565933fe.text:
* 该技能会创造出地缚之灵。
* 此技能可以让你击倒拥有眩晕免疫的敌人。然而，它对其他击倒预防技能没有效果，例如矮人稳定或稳定结界。
* 每次成功击倒时，精神都会失去生命值，无论距离是否受到影响。

无情之甲会减少该精魂因击倒效果而造成的生命值损失。

5ef29e7cf92b13610c55a7f60ec54712b9392d7f.source: anomaly: Armor of Unfeeling will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its knock down effect.
5ef29e7cf92b13610c55a7f60ec54712b9392d7f.text: 异常：绝情之甲会减少该精魂因击倒效果而造成的生命值损失。

818e3cc2f6a61a99f95ac139fd457fb6d856b92e.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Earthbind.
* Useful to increase the knock downs caused by Wanderlust, since they both benefit from the Communing attribute.
* This skill allows you to knock down Juggernauts, Siege Turtles, Carrier Juggernauts, and Hauler Turtles.
818e3cc2f6a61a99f95ac139fd457fb6d856b92e.text:
* 该技能会创造出地缚之灵。
* 有助于增加流浪癖造成的击倒次数，因为它们都受益于交流属性。
* 此技能可以让你击倒主宰神龟、攻城海龟、运输主宰主宰和搬运海龟。

b269419f2b69fa14641e1cb135a918cbbe5ff516.source: * Because its snare duration does not scale and can affect nearby foes, Earthen Shackles has good synergy with spells that deal damage over time since it prevents foes from moving out of the area of those spells.
b269419f2b69fa14641e1cb135a918cbbe5ff516.text: * 因为它的圈套持续时间不会缩放并且会影响附近的敌人，所以大地枷锁与随时间造成伤害的法术具有良好的协同作用，因为它可以防止敌人移出这些法术的区域。

c20759218f2aef8498948df7c62c4cedec518df1.source: The armor bonus while fighting Charr is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Charr. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to effect stacking (giving a 35.2% damage reduction bonus).
c20759218f2aef8498948df7c62c4cedec518df1.text: 与夏尔战斗时的护甲加成有两个来源计算，最初的 +24 护甲，然后是对抗夏尔的 +24 护甲。因此，由于效果叠加，护甲加值上限为 +25 护甲（给予 35.2% 伤害减免加值）。

e0ed478b4e941c81f1a14b6135804c4a3f7d9fb2.source: bug: The armor bonus while fighting Charr is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Charr. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to effect stacking (giving a 35.2% damage reduction bonus).
e0ed478b4e941c81f1a14b6135804c4a3f7d9fb2.text: bug：与夏尔战斗时的护甲加成有两个来源计算，最初的 +24 护甲，然后是针对夏尔的 +24 护甲。因此，由于效果叠加，护甲加值上限为 +25 护甲（给予 35.2% 伤害减免加值）。

26fef29274cab583e97b1c2114a2098e94fad3d0.source:
* This skill does not only increase the damage from attacks. It increases all armor-respecting damage. For example: 
** It will increase the damage of Stoning but not Obsidian Flame. 
** It will increase the damage of skills that deal damage indirectly, such as Smoldering Embers, Spike Trap and Fire Storm, but not from similar skills inflicting armor ignoring damage such as Wastrel's Demise or Chaos Storm. 
** For non-attack skills, it will not increase typed armor-ignoring damage, such as Holy damage or Shadow damage. It also does not increase the physical damage from Splinter Weapon or Whirling Defense.
** Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.
* The bonus damage is Armor-ignoring. 
* The bonus damage is dealt as long as the damage dealer remains standing in the ward; damage from ranged physical attacks as well as from area damage over time skills, such as Fire Storm or Spike Trap, increases while the caster stands in the ward, and will decrease if they leave it.
* The bonus damage is part of the original damage packet (e. g. Barbs and Mark of Pain will not trigger again on physical attacks).
26fef29274cab583e97b1c2114a2098e94fad3d0.text:
* 该技能不仅仅增加攻击伤害。它会增加所有护甲方面的伤害。例如： 
** 它会增加石击的伤害，但不会增加黑曜石火焰的伤害。 
** 它会增加间接造成伤害的技能的伤害，例如闷烧余烬、尖刺陷阱和火焰风暴，但不会增加类似的造成护甲无视伤害的技能，例如黄蜂之灭亡或混沌风暴。 
** 对于非攻击技能，不会增加类型无护甲伤害，例如神圣伤害或暗影伤害。它也不会增加碎片武器或旋转防御的物理伤害。
** 造成完全无护甲伤害的攻击技能，例如驱逐打击，仍然增加。
* 额外伤害是无视护甲的。 
* 只要伤害造成者仍然站在守卫内，就会造成额外伤害；当施法者站在守卫中时，远程物理攻击以及区域持续伤害技能（例如火焰风暴或尖刺陷阱）造成的伤害会增加，而如果他们离开守卫，则会减少。
* 额外伤害是原始伤害包的一部分（例如倒刺和痛苦印记不会在物理攻击时再次触发）。

db9f1ccd91cf6287f3c4d4ba918492eee372c90f.source: anomaly: Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.
db9f1ccd91cf6287f3c4d4ba918492eee372c90f.text: 异常：造成完全无护甲伤害的攻击技能，例如驱逐打击，仍然增加。

6240cd446f096f77a204eac32cbed70a7ae40d81.source:
*The % chance to halve skill recharge stacks with other sources (e.g. from weapon mod), but the skill recharge is still capped at half. At max rank, with a 40/40 weapon set, this amounts to a 74% chance to halve spell recharge.
*The halve skill recharge applies to the reduced recharge time for Mesmer spells due to Fast Casting in PvE.
6240cd446f096f77a204eac32cbed70a7ae40d81.text:
*通过其他来源（例如武器模组）将技能充值叠加的几率减半，但技能充值仍上限为一半。在最高等级时，使用 40/40 武器套装，这相当于 74% 几率将法术充能减半。
*技能充能减半适用于因 PvE 中的快速施法而导致幻术师法术充能时间减少的情况。

2772129e7aa37c3ab3ae40b490459be15c8fdd2b.source:
* A skill that changes your weapon damage type to earth damage, like Staggering Force or Dust Cloak, will count as wielding an earth weapon.
* The added earth damage is armor-ignoring.
* Queue this skill while knocked down to avoid being quarterknocked by physical attacks.
2772129e7aa37c3ab3ae40b490459be15c8fdd2b.text:
* 将你的武器伤害类型更改为土系伤害的技能，例如惊人之力或尘土斗篷，将被视为使用土系武器。
* 增加的大地伤害是无视护甲的。
* 在被击倒时排队使用此技能，以避免被物理攻击击倒。

5b660e5aaa08d52e2d3ba64e7ee1fc3f074a4922.source:
* You and your target will both be healed even if the shadow step fails (e.g. if the target cannot be reached).
* Target spirits will not be healed.
* This skill does not cause an aftercast delay.
5b660e5aaa08d52e2d3ba64e7ee1fc3f074a4922.text:
* 即使暗影步失败（例如，如果无法到达目标），你和你的目标都会被治愈。
* 目标灵魂不会被治愈。
* 该技能不会造成施法延迟。

97d0f5d78198c080a79360b4a98b48a23a35a62e.source:
* This skill can serve as an opener for Stoning and/or Glowstone.
* Unlike Enervating Charge, Weakness is applied before calculating damage.
97d0f5d78198c080a79360b4a98b48a23a35a62e.text:
* 该技能可以作为石击和/或萤石的开场白。
* 与精力充沛不同，弱点是在计算伤害之前应用的。

11a270c16aac2966c25d5629535cf208f0d5fa34.source:
* When used against Charr, the Ebon Vanguard Assassin can survive long enough to complete up to two attack chains. When used against other foes, the Assassin only has enough time for a single attack chain.
** All its skills are unblockable
** His Iron Palm will knock down foes that are hexed or suffering from a condition.
* You can create multiple Assassins in an area.
* It is not infused nor does it leave an exploitable corpse.
* When its summoning period ends, it appears to Shadow Step into nothingness.
* It will be higher than level 20 if cast under the effects of Signet of Illusions with an Illusion Magic rank 17 or more.

The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.
The Assassin is counted as a created creature for Spirit's Gift, Explosive Growth, and Boon of Creation. However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.
Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.
The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.
Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created Restoration spirit, as by Reborn Irukandji.
11a270c16aac2966c25d5629535cf208f0d5fa34.text:
* 当用于对抗夏尔时，黑锋先锋刺客可以存活足够长的时间来完成最多两个攻击链。当用于对抗其他敌人时，刺客只有足够的时间进行单一攻击链。
** 所有技能均不可阻挡
** 他的铁掌会击倒被施咒或患有某种疾病的敌人。
* 你可以在一个区域创建多个刺客。
* 它不会被注入，也不会留下可利用的尸体。
* 当它的召唤期结束时，它会出现在暗影步虚无中。
* 如果在幻象魔法等级17以上的幻象徽记的效果下施展，等级将高于20。

刺客不会暗影步；它直接在目标旁边生成。
刺客被视为精神恩赐、爆炸性成长和创造恩赐的创造生物。然而，它不算是召唤生物，也不受产卵力影响。尽管有这样的分类，但它不受硫的影响。
虽然刺客不计入小兵上限，但召唤一名刺客会导致游戏检查玩家的小兵控制限制，可能会摧毁任何超过限制的小兵。
刺客并不总是以施法者所瞄准的敌人为目标，而是以最接近其创造点的敌人为目标。
极少数情况下，刺客可能会无限期地生存。如果被敌人创造的恢复精魂复活，比如重生的伊鲁坎吉，就会发生这种情况。

02d4c884df30182513449a98e78b50ee5e22a632.text: 异常：刺客没有暗影步；它直接在目标旁边生成。

However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.
c85faac904c28f907fb9c398db42cc64aa9cfbf8.text: 异常：刺客被视为精神恩赐、爆炸性成长和创造恩赐的创造生物。然而，它不算是召唤生物，也不受产卵力影响。尽管有这样的分类，但它不受硫的影响。

4aa29f85febea108ad1fefe6df24d82c04dabd04.source: bug: Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.

81708cabf2190057dedf40ab14ed6441ad3774ce.text: bug：极少数情况下，刺客可能会无限期地生存。如果被敌人创造的恢复精魂复活，比如重生的伊鲁坎吉，就会发生这种情况。

912a68a6d83d3d9515d17cea4de2bcd01565a87a.source: * When combined with skills which alter the type of damage dealt to elemental damage, such as Stone Striker, this skill synergizes with Intensity.
912a68a6d83d3d9515d17cea4de2bcd01565a87a.text: * 当与改变元素伤害造成的伤害类型的技能（例如石击）结合使用时，该技能与强度产生协同作用。

05bc1c61d0bee26078897d55aa5597d3ce23e295.source:
* Echo can copy powerful skills with long recharge times, doubling the rate at which they can be used.
* Use it to copy skills with short recharge times in order to spam them, e.g. adrenaline skills that have any recharge time.
* Combine Echo with Arcane Echo to create Echo chains, allowing you to have three copies of a skill at once. Add Arcane Mimicry to create multiple copies of a party member's elite.
* Echo will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, the copy remains for 30 seconds, after which Echo is disabled for 10 seconds.
* Use Auspicious Incantation to help manage energy costs (especially since Echo chains consume a lot of energy); the downside is mitigated since the disabled skill gets replaced shortly after.
* To capture Echo from a boss that has just copied a skill, wait 30 seconds (for the effect to wear off) before using your Signet of Capture.
* If used to copy a skill that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that skill is used and will bypass Echo's 30-second copy duration, but Echo will still be disabled for 10 seconds afterwards.
** E.g., if used to copy Arcane Larceny/Thievery with Domination Magic rank 15, whatever spell that is stolen from a foe by the Echo version of Arcane Larceny/Thievery will remain as that stolen spell for 35 seconds and then revert back to Echo.
** E.g., if used to copy Arcane Larceny/Thievery with Domination Magic rank 0, whatever spell that is stolen from a foe by the Echo version of Arcane Larceny/Thievery will remain as that stolen spell for 5 seconds and then revert back to Echo.
*Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the skill that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Blackout, the copy is disabled for 5 seconds.
Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy a Signet of Capture and itself.
05bc1c61d0bee26078897d55aa5597d3ce23e295.text:
* Echo可以复制强大的技能，并且充能时间长，使它们的使用率提高一倍。
* 用它来复制充电时间短的技能，以便向它们发送垃圾邮件，例如肾上腺素技能有任意充能时间。
* 将回声与奥术回声结合起来创建回声链，让您同时拥有一项技能的三个副本。添加奥术拟态来创建队员精英的多个副本。
* 只有在没有复制技能的情况下，Echo才会正常充能。如果技能被复制，该副本将保留 30 秒，之后回显将被禁用 10 秒。
* 使用吉祥咒来帮助管理能源成本（特别是因为 Echo 链消耗大量能源）；由于禁用的技能很快就会被替换，因此缺点得到了缓解。
* 要从刚刚复制技能的 Boss 处捕获回声，请等待 30 秒（效果消失），然后再使用捕获徽记。
* 如果用于复制一个可以复制另一个技能或法术的技能，则使用该技能的复制持续时间，并且将绕过回声的 30 秒复制持续时间，但回声之后仍将被禁用 10 秒。
** 例如，如果用于复制具有统治魔法等级 15 的奥术盗窃/盗窃，则回声版本的奥术盗窃/盗窃从敌人处窃取的任何法术都将保留为被盗法术 35 秒，然后恢复为回声。
** 例如，如果用于复制具有统治魔法等级 0 的奥术盗窃/盗窃，则回声版本的奥术盗窃/盗窃从敌人处窃取的任何法术都将保留为被盗法术 5 秒，然后恢复为回声。
*回声的复制效果先触发，然后再触发它的技能效果。例如，当用于复制 Blackout 时，复制将被禁用 5 秒。
Echo的描述忽略了一个事实，即它无法复制捕获徽记及其自身。

a775d833d9c9aecc638a7e2cf4e65a52b0433949.source: anomaly: Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy a Signet of Capture and itself.
a775d833d9c9aecc638a7e2cf4e65a52b0433949.text: 异常：回声的描述忽略了它无法复制捕获徽记及其自身的事实。

8ebc8e0a50f62ec780e2dce2e50182ec8c205be4.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Extinction.
* This skill does not affect creatures with no creature type, such as most Titans (with the exception of titans in the Domain of Anguish).
* Beware of the possible backfire of this skill on your party or allied NPCs.
** M.O.X., Jora, Pyre Fierceshot, Ogden Stonehealer, Vekk and Zhed Shadowhoof are respectively golem, norn, charr, dwarf, asura and centaur heroes. If using this skill, use those heroes rather than other human heroes of the same profession, as long as the area doesn't have other members of the same type (i.e. avoid using Pyre while in the Charr Homelands and Ascalon areas, Ogden while in the Southern and Northern Shiverpeaks, and Zhed when in the Maguuma Jungle; Jora is generally safe since Avarr the Fallen and Johon the Oxflinger are the only Norn foes you can kill).
** Not all allied human NPCs are considered the same creature type for the purposes of this ritual. For example, service NPCs (collectors, merchants, etc) and many non-hostile NPCs (including allies but not henchmen party members) each have their own species category separate from both each other and players.
* This skill is particularly lethal to minions, as most of them will already be below the 90% health requisite due to their innate health degeneration.
* Consider using with disease, as it also affects members of the same type and allows to reach the 90% requisite more easily.
* As with all nature rituals, being in range of 2 EoE spirits does not increase the damage - only the stronger EoE takes effect.
:* If 2 creatures are each in range of a different EoE (and each other), the EoE that deals damage will be the one in range of the creature that died.
8ebc8e0a50f62ec780e2dce2e50182ec8c205be4.text:
* 该技能会产生灭亡之魂。
* 该技能不会影响没有生物类型的生物，例如大多数泰坦（痛苦领域的泰坦除外）。
* 注意该技能可能对你的队伍或盟友 NPC 造成适得其反的效果。
** M.O.X.、Jora、Pyre Fierceshot、Ogden Stonehealer、Vekk 和 Zhed Shadowhoof 分别是魔像、诺恩、夏尔、矮人、阿苏拉和半人马英雄。如果使用此技能，请使用这些英雄而不是同一职业的其他人类英雄，只要该地区没有相同类型的其他成员（即，在夏尔家园和阿斯卡隆地区避免使用柴堆，在南部和北部席瓦山脉时避免使用奥格登，在迈古玛丛林时避免使用哲德；乔拉通常是安全的，因为堕落者阿瓦和牛人乔洪是你唯一可以杀死的诺恩敌人）。
** 就本仪式而言，并非所有人类 NPC 盟友都被视为相同的生物类型。例如，服务 NPC（收藏家、商人等）和许多非敌对 NPC（包括盟友但不包括党羽成员）各自拥有自己的物种类别，彼此之间和玩家之间都是分开的。
* 这项技能对小兵来说尤其致命，因为他们中的大多数人由于先天生命值退化而已经低于 90% 生命值要求。
* 考虑与疾病一起使用，因为它也会影响相同类型的成员，并且可以更容易地达到 90% 要求。
* 与所有自然仪式一样，处于 2 EoE 灵魂的范围内不会增加伤害 - 只有更强的 EoE 才会生效。
:* 如果 2 个生物各自位于不同 EoE 的范围内（并且彼此之间），则造成伤害的 EoE 将是死亡生物范围内的 EoE。

* When combined with one of the other attunements (e.g. Fire Attunement), 5 energy spells of the respective element can be cast for a net energy gain.
* When combined with Glyph of Lesser Energy, energy is still refunded causing a net energy gain. This also applies to Glyph of Energy, however as another elite it has less practical application.

11a6fde5bd7b848132de5b35fe9b4b32c615d3c8.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* The effect stacks with other skills that boost attributes.
* The Energy Storage-dependent gain is rounded down, i.e. you receive no energy unless you have at least rank 10 in the attribute and can receive at most 2 energy with rank 20 or higher.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
11a6fde5bd7b848132de5b35fe9b4b32c615d3c8.text:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 该效果可与其他提升属性的技能叠加。
* 取决于能量存储的增益向下取整，即除非您的属性等级至少为 10，否则您不会收到能量，并且等级 20 或更高时最多可以收到 2 能量。
* 此结界的治疗效果仅考虑法术的基本消耗，没有任何修饰符，例如弱能雕文或加速和风。

cbf9299b2dedc28c2ab234690d066c246dca1898.source:
* Greater Conflagration or Stone Striker can be used to eliminate the downside of this skill.
* Heroes do not maintain this stance and rarely use it, so it may require micromanagement. This differs from the otherwise similar stances Mantra of Flame, Mantra of Frost, Mantra of Earth, and Mantra of Lightning, which are all maintained permanently by heroes and hence easier to use against elemental damage.
Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Elemental Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against physical damage, Elemental Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
cbf9299b2dedc28c2ab234690d066c246dca1898.text:
* 强效火焰或石击可以用来消除该技能的缺点。
* 英雄不会保持这种姿态，也很少使用它，因此可能需要微观管理。这与其他类似的姿势“火焰咒语”、“冰霜咒语”、“大地咒语”和“闪电咒语”不同，这些姿势都由英雄永久保留，因此更容易用来对抗元素伤害。
类似于裂甲，该技能不会将你的护甲等级降低到60以下，或者如果你的“核心”护甲等级低于60，则你的“核心”护甲等级不会降低。
如果你使用的技能或技能和效果的组合，在减去元素抗性的减值后，仍然获得 +26 或更高的物理伤害护甲等级，则元素抗性的护甲减值不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

f27c2f50f3a35134256174de4bdb86799616c7a3.source: bug: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Elemental Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against physical damage, Elemental Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
f27c2f50f3a35134256174de4bdb86799616c7a3.text: bug：如果你使用的技能或技能和效果的组合，在减去元素抗性的惩罚后，仍然获得 +26 或更高的物理伤害护甲等级，则元素抗性的护甲惩罚不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

05890950c48a5f1d5bd3b9863d6b129aa0fbbacc.source:
* This skill removes a hex, removes a condition, and then heals. 
* Heroes use this skill properly, using it to cleanse themselves whether the target or themselves are afflicted.
** AI will just use this spell on allies for its healing aspect.
*The self healing and condition removal can help with skills with health sacrifice or that inflict conditions on oneself.
05890950c48a5f1d5bd3b9863d6b129aa0fbbacc.text:
* 此技能可移除咒语、移除病症，然后进行治疗。 
* 英雄正确使用此技能，无论目标还是自己受到折磨，都用它来净化自己。
** AI 只会对盟友使用此法术来治疗。
*自我治愈和状况消除可以帮助提高牺牲健康或给自己造成状况的技能。

fabbb62ae5779b8e31068c7ecdac34a4bdd0142b.source: anomaly: Unlike other healing skills, this spell can target spirits to remove burning. However, Empathic Removal will not heal the spirits.
fabbb62ae5779b8e31068c7ecdac34a4bdd0142b.text: 异常：与其他治疗技能不同，该法术可以针对灵魂来消除燃烧。然而，共情移除并不能治愈灵魂。

c195fdf0384ca5ac522358ca4b26aecd313a014b.source:
* Damage reduction is effective for as long as the target is hexed, i.e. if an attack lands after the hex ends (e.g. if the attacker dies while attacking), the attack will deal normal damage and if an attack iniated before the hex begins lands after the hex is applied, it'll deal less damage.
* Any attack triggers the damage, whether or not it hits; you are still affected even if missed, blocked, or enchanted with Illusionary Weaponry. Similarly, you are damaged for each attack made from attack skills that can deal multiple attacks and for each foe hit with a scythe.
* Combine with Reckless Haste in Normal mode to cause the damage to trigger more often.

;Hard mode
* This skill is more effective in Hard mode because foes (including spellcasters) attack faster.
* Hard Mode AI enemies will only cast this on a martial profession wielding a martial weapon.

Empathy triggers on failed attack skills, whereas Vigorous Spirit does not.
c195fdf0384ca5ac522358ca4b26aecd313a014b.text:
* 只要目标被施咒，伤害减免就有效，即，如果攻击在咒语结束后发生（例如，如果攻击者在攻击时死亡），则攻击将造成正常伤害，如果在咒语开始之前发起的攻击在咒语应用之后发生，则造成的伤害会减少。
* 任何攻击都会触发伤害，无论是否击中；即使错过、被阻挡或被幻影武器附魔，你仍然会受到影响。同样，每次使用可造成多次攻击的攻击技能进行的攻击以及每次用镰刀击中的敌人都会对你造成伤害。
* 与普通模式下的鲁莽急速结合使用，可以更频繁地触发伤害。

；困难模式
* 此技能在困难模式下更有效，因为敌人（包括施法者）攻击速度更快。
* 困难模式 AI 敌人只会对使用武术武器的武术职业施放此技能。

共情会在攻击技能失败时触发，而精气神则不会。

2e36ddd90dc9b399d59861687d998f207c688b60.source: anomaly: Empathy triggers on failed attack skills, whereas Vigorous Spirit does not.
2e36ddd90dc9b399d59861687d998f207c688b60.text: 异常：攻击技能失败会触发共情，而精气神则不会。

4702d362024c28088dc57282abde1165f307c9b7.source:
* Attacks only have to be made, not hit.
Unlike Vigorous Spirit, Empathy triggers on failed attack skills.
4702d362024c28088dc57282abde1165f307c9b7.text:
* 只需进行攻击，无需击中。
与元气之魂不同，共情会在攻击技能失败时触发。

50c7d85a31cb272acad3ab0432167255322c751b.source: anomaly: Unlike Vigorous Spirit, Empathy triggers on failed attack skills.
50c7d85a31cb272acad3ab0432167255322c751b.text: 异常：与元气不同，共情会在攻击技能失败时触发。

4a9a0ca80f43a777547e21de5900330bee520863.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Empowerment.
4a9a0ca80f43a777547e21de5900330bee520863.text: * 该技能创造出一种赋权之灵。

fa7ec48811444af80c48ffe9a20b09b26bcd34a2.source: *This skill creates a Spirit of Empowerment.

4eabdd353e14989b58090c371323105d0f81b105.source:
* This skill increases average speed by 11.67% if used every time it recharges. 
* This can be maintained indefinitely with Extend Enchantments at Mysticism 11 (or 9 when using a 20% of Enchanting weapon).
4eabdd353e14989b58090c371323105d0f81b105.text:
* 该技能每次充能时使用，平均速度增加11.67%。 
* 这可以通过延长附魔在神秘主义 11（或使用 20% 附魔武器时为 9）无限期地维持。

577fc4bb89aaf9e1581edf15237ed1e68f1693f2.source:
* This skill is best used when very low on health.
* The health gained is temporary; your health can drop below zero when this ends. However, if that happens, you won't always die. For example, if you have positive health regeneration, your health bar will show 1 health while you recover the negative health caused from this skill ending. But if you have health degeneration or take any damage, you will die. Healing may also be fatal if it does not bring your health above zero.
577fc4bb89aaf9e1581edf15237ed1e68f1693f2.text:
* 该技能最适合在生命值很低时使用。
* 获得的健康是暂时的；当这一切结束时，你的健康状况可能会降至零以下。然而，如果发生这种情况，你也不会总是死。例如，如果你有积极的生命恢复，你的生命条将显示1生命值，同时你恢复了该技能结束造成的负生命值。但如果你的健康恶化或受到任何伤害，你就会死亡。如果治疗不能使你的生命值高于零，那么它也可能是致命的。

845526da9d6afbaa5407b25977571bf98706bd8b.source:
* Only the shouts/chants you activate after activating Enduring Harmony are affected.
* Shouts/chants that you activate while under Enduring Harmony continue to have the extended duration if Enduring Harmony ends.
845526da9d6afbaa5407b25977571bf98706bd8b.text:
* 只有您在激活持久和谐后激活的呼喊/圣歌才会受到影响。
* 如果持久和谐结束，你在持久和谐下激活的喊叫/圣歌将继续具有延长的持续时间。

c62c88fe05f3337626c797df8e0371d6e652d0cb.source: Because this chant reduces cost at the beginning of skill activation and doesn't end until activation is completed, using a shout in the middle of a chant's activation will allow both skills to benefit from this chant.
c62c88fe05f3337626c797df8e0371d6e652d0cb.text: 由于该咏唱会在技能发动开始时降低成本，并且直到发动完成后才会结束，因此在咏唱发动过程中使用喊叫将使两个技能都从该咏唱中受益。

8399ea4fc7ef70af0f52b90b7f7504e73bcf626c.source: anomaly: Because this chant reduces cost at the beginning of skill activation and doesn't end until activation is completed, using a shout in the middle of a chant's activation will allow both skills to benefit from this chant.
8399ea4fc7ef70af0f52b90b7f7504e73bcf626c.text: 异常：由于该咏唱会在技能发动开始时降低成本，并且直到发动完成后才会结束，因此在咏唱发动过程中使用喊叫将使两个技能都从该咏唱中受益。

fa15c706a3ef6c301a219304d4475b3c1c044fcf.source: *Consider using "Dodge This!", "Go for the Eyes!" and "The Power Is Yours!" to trigger this echo's effect as they are all cheap spammable shouts with typically low durations.
fa15c706a3ef6c301a219304d4475b3c1c044fcf.text: *考虑使用“躲避这个！”、“瞄准眼睛！”和“力量是你的！”触发此回声的效果，因为它们都是廉价的垃圾邮件喊叫，持续时间通常很短。

0888aed57523028bd91a4c3aa71faa1502ecb5cc.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Energizing Wind.
* Can be combined with Quickening Zephyr to reduce the recharge cost introduced by this skill.
* If affected by both Energizing Wind and Quickening Zephyr, 10 and 15 energy skills are cheaper with Energizing Wind applied last, while 25 Energy skills are cheaper if Quickening Zephyr is applied last.
* The effects of Expertise are calculated after the effects of Energizing Wind.
0888aed57523028bd91a4c3aa71faa1502ecb5cc.text:
* 该技能会产生风风之灵。
* 可以与Quickening Zephyr结合使用，以减少该技能引入的充能成本。
* 如果同时受到风能和疾风之力的影响，则最后使用风能之力的 10 和 15 能量技能会更便宜，而如果最后应用疾风之风，则 25 能量技能会更便宜。
* 专长的效果是在风劲效果之后计算的。

26efba01555aae831ffb7b5eebbaf466d3768661.source: * The energy you have is calculated when the spell is finished casting, after you've spent the initial 5.
26efba01555aae831ffb7b5eebbaf466d3768661.text: * 你所拥有的能量是在你花费了最初的 5 点后，当法术施法完成时计算的。

d210b59c38c58d325e80f554480fc64b75fdfab8.source:
* Unlike some other doublecast skills, the effects are not doubled when you target yourself.
* This can increase a minion's health, presumably by 1…3…3 times its energy gain, which is visible to the caster.
* The concise description is more ambiguous than the complete description regarding maximum health increase.

Changing your maximum energy lower than what it was when this was cast on you, will lower your health bonus accordingly to your new energy, however swapping back to higher energy will not bring it back up and it will remain at the lower amount, even if recast on you at higher energy before its duration ends.
d210b59c38c58d325e80f554480fc64b75fdfab8.text:
* 与其他一些双重施放技能不同，当你以自己为目标时，效果不会加倍。
* 这可以增加小兵的生命值，大概是其能量增益的 1…3…3 倍，施法者可见。
* 关于最大生命值增加的简洁描述比完整描述更加模糊。

将你的最大能量更改为低于施放于你身上时的值，会根据你的新能量相应地降低你的健康加值，但是换回更高的能量不会将其恢复，并且它将保持在较低的数量，即使在其持续时间结束之前以更高的能量重新施放给你。

cab059cee839765f92f03c9edd345f883b4fdb6e.source: anomaly: Changing your maximum energy lower than what it was when this was cast on you, will lower your health bonus accordingly to your new energy, however swapping back to higher energy will not bring it back up and it will remain at the lower amount, even if recast on you at higher energy before its duration ends.
cab059cee839765f92f03c9edd345f883b4fdb6e.text: 异常：将你的最大能量更改为低于施放于你身上时的能量，将根据你的新能量相应地降低你的健康加值，但是交换回更高的能量不会使其恢复，并且它将保持较低的数量，即使在其持续时间结束之前以更高的能量重新施放给你。

3f8f450a69f5220ab7ad59d199dfef39a65b08ae.source:
* Works well with Mind Wrack and Aneurysm for massive, consistent AoE spike.
* Primary PvP-only Mesmers will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on your account.
3f8f450a69f5220ab7ad59d199dfef39a65b08ae.text:
* 与 Mind Wrack 和 Aneurysm 配合使用，可获得大量、一致的 AoE 峰值。
* 仅初级 PvP 幻术师将能够使用此技能，即使您的帐户未解锁该技能。

4b0bafcbdba8b1ded3763b727594c1a5c4c96f04.source:
* This skill is used by the Mursaat Elementalist created by Summon Mursaat.
* Weakness is applied after dealing damage.
4b0bafcbdba8b1ded3763b727594c1a5c4c96f04.text:
* 此技能由召唤穆萨特创造的穆萨特元素师使用。
* 造成伤害后会施加弱点。

d894985a98328bdc0dcb718506d2be3f3697ca45.source:
* Skills that disable non-attack skills (Tiger's Fury or Marauder's Shot for example) synergize well with this skill as it also deals extra damage for skills such as Charm Animal and Comfort Animal.
* Damage from this skill is calculated at the time of activation on the skill bar, not when the animal companion uses it.
* Enraged Lunge counts itself as a recharging Beast Mastery skill upon activation.
* These are the number of recharging Beast Mastery skills required for maximum damage:
:{| {{STDT}}
|- style="background:#ADA;"
! Beast Mastery !! Recharging Beast Mastery skills 
|- align="center"
| 0-6 || 8
|- align="center"
| 7 || 7
|- align="center"
| 8-9 || 6
|- align="center"
| 10-12 || 5
|- align="center"
| 13-17 || 4
|- align="center"
| 18+ || 3
|}
d894985a98328bdc0dcb718506d2be3f3697ca45.text:
* 禁用非攻击技能的技能（例如老虎之怒或掠夺者射击）与该技能可以很好地协同作用，因为它还可以对魅惑动物和舒适动物等技能造成额外伤害。
* 该技能的伤害是在技能栏上激活时计算的，而不是在动物伙伴使用该技能时计算的。
* 激怒冲刺在激活时将其自身视为一种充能的野兽掌握技能。
* 这些是达到最大伤害所需的恢复野兽掌握技能的数量：
:{| {{标准DT}}
|- 风格=“背景：#ADA;”
！御兽术！！恢复驯兽技能 
|- 对齐=“中心”
| 0-6 || 8
|- 对齐=“中心”
| 7 || 7
|- 对齐=“中心”
| 8-9 || 6
|- 对齐=“中心”
| 10-12 || 5
|- 对齐=“中心”
| 13-17 || 4
|- 对齐=“中心”
| 18+ || 3
|}

8656241d136aa9d49de1056c376298d765a8b094.source:
* After defeating Drinkmaster Tahnu as part of the quest The Drunken Master, he will walk slowly back towards the portal to Kaineng Center. If he does not get stuck on the way there, he will die and players will be able to capture this skill.
* Use with Auspicious Blow for easy spamming of this skill.
8656241d136aa9d49de1056c376298d765a8b094.text:
* 作为任务“醉酒大师”的一部分，击败酒大师塔努后，他将慢慢走回凯能中心的传送门。如果他没有被困在路上，他就会死亡，玩家将能够获得这个技能。
* 与吉祥一击一起使用，可以轻松地发送该技能。

5103f58ff4b3d71fdbe3919cb689c3a9fdb7c9ac.source: *This stance ends before your next successful hit, so attack skills affected by stances such as Standing Slash or Barbarous Slice will not consider you in a stance if they hit.
5103f58ff4b3d71fdbe3919cb689c3a9fdb7c9ac.text: *此姿势在您下一次成功击中之前结束，因此受姿势影响的攻击技能（例如站立斩或野蛮切片）在击中时不会将您视为姿势。

bb45b6387190285a1af1f45ee8acc35a8ee4fbf8.source:
* Even if the target foe cannot be knocked down, it still becomes poisoned.
* Synergizes with Iron Palm, as it counts as a lead attack and is also a Deadly Arts skill.
bb45b6387190285a1af1f45ee8acc35a8ee4fbf8.text:
* 即使目标敌人无法被击倒，它仍然会中毒。
* 与铁掌协同作用，因为它算作主攻，也是致命艺术技能。

565a285ef18c96fa82dd42b2d3a49f1424744207.source: * If the target has 4 or more enchantments, this skill can provide the longest-lasting poison condition. If the target has 3 enchantments or less, Toxic Chill will last longer.
565a285ef18c96fa82dd42b2d3a49f1424744207.text: * 如果目标拥有4个或更多结界，该技能可以提供持续时间最长的中毒状态。如果目标的结界数量为 3 或更少，剧毒寒冷将持续更长时间。

e91b9720a1a87949be5e7b53e3d0a06aedddd889.source: *Despite the concise description stating the conditions are transferred to adjacent foes, they are not removed from the target.
e91b9720a1a87949be5e7b53e3d0a06aedddd889.text: *尽管简明的描述表明这些条件会转移到邻近的敌人身上，但它们并没有从目标中移除。

fdf559762848919322120a25e4553be4e229ce94.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Equinox.
* The additional overcast caused by Equinox triggers only after the spell is cast successfully, whereas ordinary overcast occurs when activation begins.
* The additional overcast stacks with Arcane Languor, resulting in a total 20 additional overcast when using a spell that causes overcast.
fdf559762848919322120a25e4553be4e229ce94.text:
* 该技能创造出春分之灵。
* 春分造成的额外阴天只有在法术施放成功后才会触发，而普通阴天则在激活开始时发生。
* 额外的阴天会与奥术倦怠叠加，当使用导致阴天的法术时，总共会产生 20 点额外的阴天。

207b984e62efc6d4721b1b97e41efb48c0eecd60.source:
* Eremite's Attack is a single attack that can hit multiple foes.
** Each target will only be hit once.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attacks will fail to hit kiting opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
The full description is incorrect: a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
207b984e62efc6d4721b1b97e41efb48c0eecd60.text:
* Eremite的攻击是一次攻击，可以击中多个敌人。
** 每个目标只会被击中一次。
* 该技能击中的敌人是与使用者相邻的敌人，而不是目标。
** 如果风筝对手（包括目标）在攻击连接时已经离开，则此攻击将无法击中。
完整的描述是不正确的：即使这次攻击未能击中，苦行僧结界也会被移除。

ded8ffec848bf776bb35e1524fa870d4752f2ff6.source: bug: The full description is incorrect: a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
ded8ffec848bf776bb35e1524fa870d4752f2ff6.text: bug：完整描述不正确：即使此攻击未能命中，苦行僧结界也会被移除。

b0ec8afbeed793b881cfa193c074393a20aa659a.source:
* Heroes use this skill when below 50% energy, with at least one foe in earshot.
Heroes don't use this skill unless enchanted.
b0ec8afbeed793b881cfa193c074393a20aa659a.text:
* 英雄在能量低于 50% 且至少有一个敌人在听力范围内时使用此技能。
除非被附魔，否则英雄不会使用此技能。

18b4abb62e3dede525be59db856cdd7e768c47bf.source: bug: Heroes don't use this skill unless enchanted.
18b4abb62e3dede525be59db856cdd7e768c47bf.text: bug：除非被附魔，否则英雄不会使用此技能。

c25b002b3bb3cd5070ceae902cd4edbeba022424.source: * The AI will only use this skill on a foe wielding a martial weapon, regardless of it being Normal or Hard mode. This is similar to Signet of Midnight, but unlike Blinding Flash and Throw Dirt.
c25b002b3bb3cd5070ceae902cd4edbeba022424.text: * AI只会对使用军用武器的敌人使用此技能，无论是普通模式还是困难模式。这与午夜徽记相似，但与致盲闪光和投掷污垢不同。

49588b251e19d32ff31a12f97589a1c992434755.source: *This skill is initially usable on PvP-only primary Rangers, even if Escape is not unlocked.
49588b251e19d32ff31a12f97589a1c992434755.text: *即使未解锁逃生，该技能最初也可在仅限 PvP 的主要游骑兵上使用。

bfd1372bbd6b2a4ae00f43d91beaba25b94d1522.source:
* Essence Bond will not trigger unless damage is taken, so it might not trigger if the target is protected by skills such as Shielding Hands. However, it will trigger through Shield of Absorption.
* As with any maintained enchantment, heroes only use this skill during combat and stop maintaining it at other times.
** They will use it on any ally taking damage and will even maintain it on multiple allies (will stop maintaining when they are no longer taking damage).
* Essence Bond pays for its its own upkeep as long as the bonded ally suffers physical or elemental damage at least once every three seconds.
** Most martial foes attack fast enough to meet this requirement.
** The skill is frequently used for solo farming against multiple foes, since it can restore nearly all energy back to the caster. 
*** Balthazar's Spirit can be a better choice where foes deal other types of damage.
*** The two skills are combined for 55 monks and 600 builds.
** It is frequently used on tanks to help maintain the monk's energy.
bfd1372bbd6b2a4ae00f43d91beaba25b94d1522.text:
* 精华羁绊除非受到伤害才会触发，因此如果目标受到护盾之手等技能保护，则可能不会触发。然而，它会通过吸收护盾触发。
* 与任何维持的结界一样，英雄仅在战斗中使用此技能，并在其他时间停止维持它。
** 他们会对任何受到伤害的盟友使用它，甚至会在多个盟友上维持它（当他们不再受到伤害时将停止维持）。
* 只要被束缚的盟友每三秒至少遭受一次物理或元素伤害，精华束缚就会为其自身的维护费用付费。
** 大多数武术敌人的攻击速度足以满足此要求。
** 该技能经常用于单独对付多个敌人，因为它可以将几乎所有能量恢复给施法者。 
*** 当敌人造成其他类型的伤害时，巴尔萨泽之魂可能是更好的选择。
*** 这两种技能相结合可用于 55 个武僧和 600 个建筑。
** 它经常用于坦克，以帮助维持僧侣的能量。

9bde583c05621cb0f38c60008044f52cb807cead.source:
*Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
*If ended by the caster's death, this skill also resurrects the caster.
*Unlike Lively Was Naomei, Eternal Aura revives instantly and is the only skill that can prevent a wipe. 
*Equipping enchantment removal skills or teardown skills that do not rely on combat will allow the user to resurrect on command.
This enchantment can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
9bde583c05621cb0f38c60008044f52cb807cead.text:
*没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。
*如果因施法者死亡而结束，该技能也会使施法者复活。
*与活泼的直美不同，永恒光环会立即复活，并且是唯一可以防止抹除的技能。 
*装备不依赖战斗的结界移除技能或拆卸技能将允许用户根据命令复活。
该结界可以在冻土效果下施展。

ebf913562744e4a005a4464ccc6aaab54dda8de8.source: bug: This enchantment can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
ebf913562744e4a005a4464ccc6aaab54dda8de8.text: bug：该结界可以在冻土效果下施放。

20967246836420ffbdf1c6cfb5642e1225d859fd.source:
* This skill is one of the few which are always available in Codex Arena.

Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
20967246836420ffbdf1c6cfb5642e1225d859fd.text:
* 该技能是 Codex Arena 中为数不多的始终可用的技能之一。

与简洁的描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

e772a4a11e7755fd581804e369f4eca19570892a.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
e772a4a11e7755fd581804e369f4eca19570892a.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

b8d759631ac2b564d60716c5bca02d7a8026745e.source:
* The amount of energy lost as the caster of Ether Lord can be lowered through energy hiding, but not the amount of energy lost by the energy degeneration.
* Consider using before Ether Signet.
* Consider using just before Ether Prodigy ends- this way you will take minimal/no damage.
b8d759631ac2b564d60716c5bca02d7a8026745e.text:
* 以太领主施法者的能量损失量可以通过能量隐藏来降低，但不能降低因能量衰退而损失的能量量。
* 考虑在 Ether Signet 之前使用。
* 考虑在 Ether Prodigy 结束之前使用 - 这样你将受到最小/没有伤害。

0a166ef3ced47e74058c7c211ae95ff6772ace66.source:
Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* Consider combining with Signet of Illusions if your allegiance rank is low and your Illusion Magic rank is high.
0a166ef3ced47e74058c7c211ae95ff6772ace66.text:
与描述相反，无论能量损失多少，该技能都会在 10 秒内造成该区域 -5…8 点生命值退化。
* 达到第一效忠等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 如果你的忠诚等级较低而你的幻象魔法等级较高，请考虑与幻象徽记结合使用。

f1144878e2808aabae81bb42103917ad95e3df83.source: bug: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
f1144878e2808aabae81bb42103917ad95e3df83.text: bug：与描述相反，无论能量损失多少，该技能都会在 10 秒内造成该区域 -5…8 点生命值退化。

532ce9c16011d732f8fb6e0e5ddc2d90ad0efe6e.source:
Ether Phantom stacks with itself causing multiple energy loss when removed prematurely
* Energy loss can be applied earlier using Shatter Delusions or Drain Delusions.
532ce9c16011d732f8fb6e0e5ddc2d90ad0efe6e.text:
以太幻影与自身堆叠，过早移除时会造成多次能量损失
* 可以使用粉碎妄想或耗尽妄想提前应用能量损失。

3ce0de31758ede479b1c10b95239aa46e0798395.source: bug: Ether Phantom stacks with itself causing multiple energy loss when removed prematurely
3ce0de31758ede479b1c10b95239aa46e0798395.text: bug：以太幻影与自身堆叠，过早移除时会导致多次能量损失

0e9eb6f24464e2b0fb7ad2cecc23ebe813b7ed50.source:
* Re-applying this enchantment while it is active will cause you to lose all enchantments, including this one, thereby triggering the health loss.
* Consider Glyph of Essence or Ether Lord, or a low-energy weapon swap to hide energy, to counter the health loss.
0e9eb6f24464e2b0fb7ad2cecc23ebe813b7ed50.text:
* 在该结界处于活动状态时重新应用该结界将导致您失去所有结界，包括该结界，从而引发生命值损失。
* 考虑精华雕文或以太领主，或低能量武器交换来隐藏能量，以抵消健康损失。

11abbf444c63967ef1c0bcc409adba7ea02103e6.source:
* Works well with builds that have monk maintained enchantments (see Emo).
* The healing from Ether Renewal happens before the health loss from skills like Infuse Health and Illusion of Weakness.
* Can be maintained when used with Glyph of Swiftness and an of Enchanting weapon.
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
11abbf444c63967ef1c0bcc409adba7ea02103e6.text:
* 与僧侣维护结界的构建配合良好（参见 Emo）。
* 以太更新的治疗发生在生命注入和虚弱幻象等技能造成的生命损失之前。
* 与迅捷雕文和附魔武器一起使用时可以维持。
与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

f05d22aa05d07cd670d3dc738754ecd764b10c2d.source:
* When using this skill, energy can be hidden to meet the requirement for the energy gain. 
* Heroes cannot effectively use this skill as they will begin to use it when they are at the upper cap, thus overpassing it due to natural energy regeneration and receiving no energy.
* The energy gain from Scribe's Insight is applied before this skill checks your current energy.
f05d22aa05d07cd670d3dc738754ecd764b10c2d.text:
* 使用该技能时，可以隐藏能量，以满足能量增益的要求。 
* 英雄无法有效地使用该技能，因为他们会在到达上限时开始使用该技能，从而由于自然能量再生而超越该技能并且无法接收能量。
* 在该技能检查你当前的能量之前，会应用来自抄写员洞察力的能量增益。

f0d7b57cd706fece6dbe6ff7e2e8b70d23c76dcb.source:
* The energy gain does trigger upon the death of the hexed foe.
*If you cast this skill on a target which an ally has already put Ethereal Burden on, you will gain two packets of energy. One for when theirs would have normally ended, and one when yours ends
f0d7b57cd706fece6dbe6ff7e2e8b70d23c76dcb.text:
* 能量增益会在被施咒的敌人死亡时触发。
*如果你对盟友已经施加了空灵负担的目标施放此技能，你将获得两包能量。一种是在他们的正常结束时，另一种是在你的结束时

28f3a8ece1a9746404964773ec1f2d94c6c68996.source: * Consider using with Healer's Boon or Holy Haste to reduce the casting time and therefore interruptibility of this skill.
28f3a8ece1a9746404964773ec1f2d94c6c68996.text: * 考虑与Healer's Boon或Holy Haste一起使用来减少施法时间，从而减少该技能的可中断性。

cc5fc78aaf2f453087dd5bfcd035b0845d8f080c.source: * With a high enough attribute rank in Strength, also consider Body Blow, which costs less adrenaline and can inflict Deep Wound.
cc5fc78aaf2f453087dd5bfcd035b0845d8f080c.text: * 在力量属性等级足够高的情况下，还可以考虑身体打击，它消耗的肾上腺素较少，并且可以造成深度伤口。

a7822154bbd9816f470e3f600a43dcb43ffe8649.source:
*Exhausting Assault is the only dual attack skill that doesn't require an off-hand attack skill to precede it.
*This skill will inflict overcast on its target even if the interruption is prevented.
*As this is an attack skill, the activation time is actually 0.25 second.
*If the target is skill queuing, this attack can interrupt two skills. This way, it is possible to inflict 20 overcast with one attack.
*A target elementalist may actually benefit from the effects of this skill, as some of their skills gain additional effects while the caster is overcast.
a7822154bbd9816f470e3f600a43dcb43ffe8649.text:
*疲惫突击是唯一不需要副手攻击技能的双重攻击技能。
*即使中断被阻止，该技能也会对目标造成阴暗。
*由于这是攻击技能，所以激活时间实际上是0.25秒。
*如果目标是技能排队，该攻击可以打断两个技能。这样一来，一击就有可能造成20阴。
*目标元素师实际上可能会从该技能的效果中受益，因为他们的一些技能在施法者处于阴暗状态时会获得额外的效果。

3c44dd947b14743f7c1d9c9309b450b219b56866.source: * This skill is useful for Mesmer secondaries in PvP because it can remove both a cover hex and a covered hex without any attribute point investment.
3c44dd947b14743f7c1d9c9309b450b219b56866.text: * 此技能对于 PvP 中的幻术辅助非常有用，因为它可以移除覆盖六角形和覆盖六角形，而无需任何属性点投资。

3d8c2fed515609f7a5c39bc9e48bf900a97504f5.source: anomaly: Heroes only use Extinguish on allies within their aggro circle, even though the skill works within compass range.
3d8c2fed515609f7a5c39bc9e48bf900a97504f5.text: 异常：英雄仅对仇恨圈内的盟友使用熄灭，即使该技能在罗盘范围内起作用。

f215f1cf3f1e37c2e6618c0c9f7ded79b09e757e.source: * 50% slower attack speed means that the damage output of the hexed target (that deals damage with attacks and attack skills) is expected to decrease by 33%.
f215f1cf3f1e37c2e6618c0c9f7ded79b09e757e.text: * 50%较慢的攻击速度意味着降咒目标（通过攻击和攻击技能造成伤害）的伤害输出预计会减少33%。

7101f9a4b6824eafcbca7d7a3dade4c6987d16a1.source:
*Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes healing and not health gain. It also fails to mention that the healing is an end effect.
7101f9a4b6824eafcbca7d7a3dade4c6987d16a1.text:
*没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。
与简洁的描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。它也没有提到治愈是最终效果。

538fa7e67d6ae017777ec7a59429659b1f9f44e5.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes healing and not health gain. It also fails to mention that the healing is an end effect.
538fa7e67d6ae017777ec7a59429659b1f9f44e5.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。它也没有提到治愈是最终效果。

4de502030524c72ad746382b8dac809297881eab.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Famine.
* Famine coupled with Sympathetic Visage and/or Ancestor's Visage is extremely powerful when used on a single tank who is absorbing damage. It is one of the combinations that becomes more and more powerful as the number of enemies (particularly melee enemies) increases.
* Energy must be at least 1 before dropping to 0 in order for Famine to deal damage (losing fractional energy gained by energy regeneration does not count).
4de502030524c72ad746382b8dac809297881eab.text:
* 该技能会产生饥荒之灵。
* 饥荒与同情面貌和/或祖先面貌相结合，当用于吸收伤害的单个坦克时非常强大。它是随着敌人（特别是近战敌人）数量的增加而变得越来越强大的组合之一。
* 能量必须至少为 1，然后才降至 0，饥荒才会造成伤害（损失能量再生获得的部分能量不算在内）。

8084a5fb8829aa6f1f6a833848d304500c6e370f.source: The recharge effect will occur if you attack more than one foe; thus, this skill will recharge even if you miss or are blocked.
8084a5fb8829aa6f1f6a833848d304500c6e370f.text: 攻击多个敌人时，会产生充能效果；因此，即使您错过或被阻挡，该技能也会重新充电。

6dc59fc0913a2f5f6fca7133bc7e961cadda32c2.source: bug: The recharge effect will occur if you attack more than one foe; thus, this skill will recharge even if you miss or are blocked.
6dc59fc0913a2f5f6fca7133bc7e961cadda32c2.text: bug：攻击多个敌人时会出现充能效果；因此，即使您错过或被阻挡，该技能也会重新充电。

a61abf775be10272fcf3eaf25377936ffa58811e.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Favorable Winds.
* Favorable Winds also lowers the arrow arc, though less than Read the Wind.
* When used in conjunction with Read the Wind, the bonus damage stacks. Arrow arc reduction and speed increase only stack when Favorable Winds is applied last.
a61abf775be10272fcf3eaf25377936ffa58811e.text:
* 该技能会产生顺风之灵。
* 顺风也会降低箭矢弧度，但比“读风”要低。
* 当与读风结合使用时，额外伤害会叠加。箭弧减少和速度增加仅在最后应用顺风时叠加。

b4e72084d0d252fea77fecb756b150153149dd97.source:
* Combines well with Animate Flesh Golem, since you can simply use the corpse to create another Flesh Golem.
* Only the caster's own minions can be targeted or are healed (The concise description is accurate).
b4e72084d0d252fea77fecb756b150153149dd97.text:
* 与 Animate Flesh Golem 完美结合，因为您可以简单地使用尸体来创建另一个 Flesh Golem。
* 只有施法者自己的小兵才能成为目标或被治愈（简洁的描述是准确的）。

e0b8d45f538a5c3a9a775e91ea7720021e2b9562.source:
* This skill will not fail if the target dies while it is being activated.
* Combines well with hex spells that hex foes in an area of effect, such as Reckless Haste, Suffering or Meekness.
* Cannot be captured from some unique foes that use it:
** Rotscale, Selvetarm, and Fendi Nin are boss-like foes, not bosses.
** The death of the Inscribed Guardian at the end of Finding the Bloodstone triggers a cinematic, leaving no time to capture the skill.
e0b8d45f538a5c3a9a775e91ea7720021e2b9562.text:
* 如果目标在激活过程中死亡，该技能不会失败。
* 与在一定范围内对敌人施咒的咒语很好地结合，例如鲁莽急速、痛苦或温顺。
* 无法从使用它的某些独特敌人手中捕获：
** Rotscale、Selvetam 和 Fendi Nin 是类似 Boss 的敌人，而不是 Boss。
** 铭文守护者在寻找血石结束时死亡会触发过场动画，没有时间捕捉该技能。

f2b842400a093597b7c5d1f31c61d702727b299c.source:
*Can be combined with Life or Signet of Spirits for a larger healing burst.
*Healing occurs before spirits are destroyed.
**Synergizes very well with Lacerate, to trigger bleeding on foes but not allies.
**Destroying the spirit of Restoration will resurrect allies but they will not get the healing.
*Healing is caused by the caster and will trigger hexes like Scourge Healing.
*Be careful using this if you have more than one Ritualist in your party. While the healing will be greater, you may destroy their build by killing important spirits.

The plain text description says "nearby allies" spirits, instead of "nearby allied spirits". The skill works according to the concise description.
f2b842400a093597b7c5d1f31c61d702727b299c.text:
*可以与生命或灵魂印记结合使用以获得更大的治疗爆发。
*治愈发生在灵魂被摧毁之前。
**与撕裂有很好的协同作用，可以使敌人流血，但不会使盟友流血。
**摧毁恢复之魂会复活盟友，但他们不会得到治疗。
*治疗是由施法者引起的，会触发天灾治疗等咒语。
*如果您的队伍中有不止一名仪式师，请小心使用此功能。虽然治疗效果会更好，但你可能会通过杀死重要的灵魂来摧毁他们的构建。

纯文本描述说的是“附近的盟友”精神，而不是“附近的盟友精神”。该技能根据简洁的描述起作用。

b24c118cea723ed44da2e582007f919b12b941b1.source: bug: The plain text description says "nearby allies" spirits, instead of "nearby allied spirits". The skill works according to the concise description.
b24c118cea723ed44da2e582007f919b12b941b1.text: bug：纯文本描述说的是“附近的盟友”精神，而不是“附近的盟友精神”。该技能根据简洁的描述起作用。

32b0486c7fd03090dbd0751ebcdc6ea0189e2f6b.source:
*If you would like to have the added benefits of Feel No Pain without the screen effects of being drunk open the game options menu and on the graphics tab uncheck "Enable post process effects".
*The use of one 1 point alcohol just before you activate the skill is enough to trigger the bonus effects.
32b0486c7fd03090dbd0751ebcdc6ea0189e2f6b.text:
*如果您想获得《Feel No Pain》的额外好处，而没有醉酒的屏幕效果，请打开游戏选项菜单，然后在图形选项卡上取消选中“启用后期处理效果”。
*在发动技能前饮用一瓶1点酒精即可触发奖励效果。

77ea936f280beff7e0dd0100f4c6e3ca7b9d5801.source: * Attacking while under the effects of Illusionary Weaponry will not cause this enchantment to end.
77ea936f280beff7e0dd0100f4c6e3ca7b9d5801.text: * 在幻影武器效果下进行攻击不会导致该结界结束。

227f1b0aa5c84564f774abcd0e92ed4eed55b000.source:
* The attack speed boost can help to land time sensitive pet attacks (Disrupting Lunge or Bestial Pounce, for example).

Cannot be used while activating another skill.
227f1b0aa5c84564f774abcd0e92ed4eed55b000.text:
* 攻击速度提升有助于对时间敏感的宠物进行攻击（例如破坏性突刺或野兽猛扑）。

激活其他技能时无法使用。

4b84210acaa0b85080a94554064e53004550423b.source: anomaly: Cannot be used while activating another skill.
4b84210acaa0b85080a94554064e53004550423b.text: 异常：激活其他技能时无法使用。

247eafbbab99d49c426c28e1d29ce22cdb1310db.source: * This skill gives 1 strike of adrenaline regardless of Beast Mastery rank.
247eafbbab99d49c426c28e1d29ce22cdb1310db.text: * 无论野兽掌握等级如何，该技能都会产生 1 点肾上腺素打击。

ae18eddcc1ebb5d37cd80ed52a84a2f71cf85c5d.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Fertile Season.
* In PvE, this skill can be used before engaging groups of foes using armor-respecting damage (notably groups of elementalists and elementalist bosses), as it provides a minor anti-spike effect.
ae18eddcc1ebb5d37cd80ed52a84a2f71cf85c5d.text:
* 该技能创造丰收之魂。
* 在 PvE 中，该技能可以在使用护甲伤害攻击敌人群体（尤其是元素主义者和元素主义者 Boss）之前使用，因为它提供了轻微的反尖峰效果。

54c96e0843bba1c7b6e291e2ea76b256cf232840.source: *There are no Necromancer skills that cause knock down, so you will need to use either a PvE only skill or one from your other profession to take advantage of the second effect.
54c96e0843bba1c7b6e291e2ea76b256cf232840.text: *没有死灵法师技能会导致击倒，因此您需要使用仅限 PvE 的技能或其他职业的技能才能利用第二种效果。

6d35ca7cbab89878e64bc72c92d415ba3f80917a.source:
* Fevered Dreams will spread the Dazed it applies.
* Dazed will cover the new condition.
* Since the hex will not trigger when reapplying conditions, consider using Hypochondria or Crystal Wave to remove all conditions before reapplying them. Reap Impurities will remove one condition, likely Dazed. 
* Works well with shouts inflicting conditions, most notably "You Move Like a Dwarf!", "You Are All Weaklings!", and "Finish Him!". 
Applying or reapplying the hex on a target suffering from one or more condition(s) will trigger the Dazed effect.
The Dazed caused by this hex is always spread to foes in the area, even if the target was already Dazed.
The Dazed caused by this hex triggers Fragility twice upon application on the target (but not on surrounding foes).
If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.
6d35ca7cbab89878e64bc72c92d415ba3f80917a.text:
* 狂热的梦想会传播它所适用的茫然。
* Dazed 将涵盖新条件。
* 由于重新应用条件时不会触发六角形，请考虑使用疑病症或水晶波删除所有条件，然后再重新应用它们。收获杂质会消除一种状况，可能是茫然。 
* 与造成条件的喊叫配合得很好，最明显的是“你像个侏儒一样移动！”、“你们都是弱者！”和“干掉他！”。 
对患有一种或多种病症的目标应用或重新应用降咒将触发茫然效果。
即使目标已经处于眩晕状态，该降咒造成的眩晕状态也始终会传播到该区域内的敌人。
该咒语造成的茫然在目标身上（但不会对周围的敌人）施加两次时会触发脆弱性两次。
如果两个被狂热梦想咒语的敌人彼此相邻，并且其中一个开始患有新的病症，那么两人都会感到茫然。

cff07c8d0c5d888a36392607f7431fd58fe55020.source: bug: Applying or reapplying the hex on a target suffering from one or more condition(s) will trigger the Dazed effect.
cff07c8d0c5d888a36392607f7431fd58fe55020.text: bug：对患有一种或多种病症的目标应用或重新应用降咒将触发茫然效果。

de7579297319f44f7540845201e3b28610dea8f7.source: bug: The Dazed caused by this hex is always spread to foes in the area, even if the target was already Dazed.
de7579297319f44f7540845201e3b28610dea8f7.text: bug：由这个六角形造成的茫然总是会传播到该区域的敌人，即使目标已经陷入茫然。

b44310a3076c075b62a7c3769345146db4e071b7.source: bug: The Dazed caused by this hex triggers Fragility twice upon application on the target (but not on surrounding foes).
b44310a3076c075b62a7c3769345146db4e071b7.text: bug：此六角形造成的茫然在目标上应用时会触发两次脆弱性（但不会对周围的敌人）。

525e8d5c67cb172c07cfbac033bb46b58f0d975d.source: bug: If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.
525e8d5c67cb172c07cfbac033bb46b58f0d975d.text: bug：如果两个被狂热梦想施咒的敌人彼此相邻，并且其中一个开始患有新的病症，那么两人都会感到茫然。

38136cc3e20b43059cc31a439d9d8bf71d483eb2.source: * Only triggers on new conditions, re-applying a condition will not trigger the hex.
38136cc3e20b43059cc31a439d9d8bf71d483eb2.text: * 仅在新条件下触发，重新应用条件不会触发降咒。

4d850d5c682b93644d2ca673c428ffeacd42cb83.source: * This skill requires exactly 140 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 5 strikes and 15 units.
4d850d5c682b93644d2ca673c428ffeacd42cb83.text: * 该技能正好需要 140 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 5 次打击和 15 单位。

93116e19532f2a44d253e32c9d084e3342e9e6da.source:
* You lose all adrenaline after you hit (you won't get one adrenaline from the hit).
* You lose all adrenaline even if the attack misses.
* The conditional only doubles the additional damage this skill adds (it does not double base damage or buffs).

Aside from Renewing Smash, the longest recharge time is 20 seconds, which is the recharge time of Disarm, Overbearing Smash, Bestial Mauling, Disrupting Lunge, Pounce, and Spear Swipe.

*经常与基于能量的攻击技能一起使用，造成击倒，例如公牛打击，牛角或践踏牛（并且效果取决于击倒，例如落莲打击或坠落蜘蛛），以将对手保持在地面上。

*Because adrenal gain is done on a point system, with some units smaller than a strike, it can often be difficult to tell how much impact this skill will make when charging adrenaline skills. 
*Commonly used as the elite for Imbagons.

与大多数通过乘数增加肾上腺素增益率的技能不同，这会增加所有非乘数来源的肾上腺素，而不仅仅是攻击时的基本 1 击。

*因为肾上腺增益是在积分系统上完成的，有些单位比一次打击还要小，所以通常很难判断该技能在充能肾上腺素技能时会产生多大的影响。 
*通常用作伊姆巴贡斯的精英。

1c986b68930531beef7e52a5fca444f7ea095b8a.text:

2be7788f5e07758153fc4cb7de83c5f846842b4d.text: * 如果攻击未命中或匕首攻击因使用不当而失败，此结界将会结束。

af0931401d11f28488154c9d255f69db3d9c2206.source:
* Fragility deals no damage upon reapplying a condition.
** It's best to keep conditions on the target almost non-stop, letting conditions expire and directly afterwards re-apply the condition again.
* Shockwave and Virulence can apply three conditions in one skill.
* Synergizes well with Avatar of Balthazar and Reap Impurities in dealing large amounts of damage over a short period of time.
* With enough conditions, Epidemic, Crystal Wave or Hypochondria can cause a massive AoE spike.
af0931401d11f28488154c9d255f69db3d9c2206.text:
* 脆弱性在重新应用条件时不会造成任何伤害。
** 最好使目标上的条件几乎不间断，让条件过期，然后立即重新应用条件。
* 冲击波和毒力可以在一项技能中应用三种条件。
* 与巴尔萨扎的化身和收割杂质很好地协同作用，在短时间内造成大量伤害。
* 在足够的条件下，流行病、水晶波或疑病症可以引起巨大的 AoE 峰值。

6c5ca01825ba55aabe8a47598cff283e0c9d1577.source:
* Fragility only triggers when the target receives a new condition. Reapplying already applied conditions doesn't trigger Fragility.
* Casting Fragility while under the effect of Glyph of Immolation will cause the burning condition to be applied before Fragility, causing Fragility to not trigger. 
* Synergizes well with Virulence, even with low Death Magic attribute.
6c5ca01825ba55aabe8a47598cff283e0c9d1577.text:
* 脆弱性仅在目标出现新状况时才会触发。重新应用已经应用的条件不会触发脆弱性。
* Casting Fragility while under the effect of Glyph of Immolation will cause the burning condition to be applied before Fragility, causing Fragility to not trigger. 
* 即使死亡魔法属性较低，也能与毒力产生良好的协同作用。

a0634391b2c3613686e613efef5078174104b1c5.source: * Similarly to Ash Blast, Freezing Gust does not count as a hex spell if the target is hexed with a Water Magic hex. Skills that check for hexed foes (e.g. Soul Barbs) or skills that trigger when the user casts a hex spell (e.g. Elemental Flame) do not trigger if Freezing Gust hits a target hexed with a Water Magic hex.
a0634391b2c3613686e613efef5078174104b1c5.text: * 与灰烬爆炸类似，如果目标被水魔法咒语施咒，冰冻阵风不算作咒语。 Skills that check for hexed foes (e.g. Soul Barbs) or skills that trigger when the user casts a hex spell (e.g. Elemental Flame) do not trigger if Freezing Gust hits a target hexed with a Water Magic hex.

018c71367fb9a8de60186c30dc0ba935f733e62d.source:
*Can be effectively used by secondary warriors, since it is the only No Attribute skill that provides blocking.
*Damage reduction, such as Protective Spirit, will be taken into account after Frenzied Defense, therefore mitigating the double damage.
**If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, consider using a cancel stance.
*Used with Spirit Bond, the attacks that are not blocked are more likely to trigger the healing effect and can effectively negate all incoming damage from attacks.
018c71367fb9a8de60186c30dc0ba935f733e62d.text:
*可以被二级战士有效使用，因为它是唯一提供阻挡的无属性技能。

**如果不使用护魂等技能，可以考虑使用取消姿态。
*Used with Spirit Bond, the attacks that are not blocked are more likely to trigger the healing effect and can effectively negate all incoming damage from attacks.

0e28e0a30b948bf22dbabeae851b06e34344c3bd.source:
* Generally used by sword and axe warriors in PvP. Hammer warriors tend to use Flail instead, partly due to their lower armor rating and partly because Flail has less of a drawback when foes are knocked down. 
* Damage reduction, such as Protective Spirit, will be taken into account after Frenzy, therefore mitigating the additional damage.
** If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, the use of a cancel stance, such as Rush, is advisable.
* Frenzy is generally too risky to use on secondary warriors, as their lower armor rating combined with the Frenzy drawback makes them too vulnerable.
* It is the only stance available in pre-Searing.
0e28e0a30b948bf22dbabeae851b06e34344c3bd.text:

* Frenzy is generally too risky to use on secondary warriors, as their lower armor rating combined with the Frenzy drawback makes them too vulnerable.

与其他赋予某种状况免疫力的技能不同（例如，污染的肉体可以消除疾病），该技能不会消除现有的燃烧。

ac8aedc2589fdd76fa6dbdd6f3a8e3fbf8daae1c.source: anomaly: This skill does not remove existing Burning, unlike other skills that grant immunity to a condition (e.g. Tainted Flesh removes Disease).
ac8aedc2589fdd76fa6dbdd6f3a8e3fbf8daae1c.text: 异常：该技能不会消除现有的燃烧，这与其他赋予某种状况免疫力的技能不同（例如，污染的肉体可以消除疾病）。

2a7ac0c1371fc862e4d56e1a8e00ea90c6bf395d.source: Some foes (notably Ice Elementals in pre-Searing) will sometimes overestimate this skill's range and use it while foes are slightly out of it.
2a7ac0c1371fc862e4d56e1a8e00ea90c6bf395d.text: 有些敌人（特别是灼热前的冰元素）有时会高估该技能的范围，并在敌人稍微超出范围时使用它。

be0349063bafbac7df3c1040cfab7c341d80e332.source: bug: Some foes (notably Ice Elementals in pre-Searing) will sometimes overestimate this skill's range and use it while foes are slightly out of it.
be0349063bafbac7df3c1040cfab7c341d80e332.text: bug：一些敌人（特别是灼热前的冰元素）有时会高估该技能的范围，并在敌人稍微超出范围时使用它。

901746b44f59cff6013a998921722c4eee61f2cc.source:
*This skill creates a Spirit of Frozen Soil.
*This spirit prevents creatures in its range from using resurrection skills, not resurrection itself.
**A creature outside the range of the spirit can resurrect a character inside its range, while a character inside its range cannot resurrect a character outside its range.
**Unyielding Aura, Lively Was Naomei and Restoration will still resurrect when removed, dropped or destroyed respectively, but none of these can be cast while in range of this spirit.
**A Scroll of Resurrection will still work, as it is not a skill.
*Does not affect skills that resurrect pets.
*Can be combined with Gaze of Fury or Rupture Soul to kill the spirit on command, expediting party resurrection.
Eternal Aura can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
901746b44f59cff6013a998921722c4eee61f2cc.text:
*该技能会创造出冰土之灵。
*此精魂会阻止其范围内的生物使用复活技能，而不是复活本身。
**精神范围外的生物可以复活其范围内的角色，而其范围内的角色则无法复活其范围外的角色。
**不屈光环、活泼直美和恢复分别在被移除、掉落或摧毁时仍然会复活，但在该精神的范围内时，这些都不能施放。
**复活卷轴仍然有效，因为它不是技能。
*不影响复活宠物的技能。
*可与愤怒凝视或裂魂结合使用，杀死命令中的灵魂，加速队伍复活。
在冰冻土壤的效果下可以施放永恒光环。

6ad5f33f2519d1e568da82a02a027428999f13db.source: bug: Eternal Aura can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
6ad5f33f2519d1e568da82a02a027428999f13db.text: bug：在冻土效果下可以施放永恒光环。

8211670d3ed2510ee37cbf237463d300390417e5.source:
* Damage triggers when an interrupt is registered on the target. Unconditional interrupt effects will not trigger damage unless the target is also attacking or using a skill with an activation time.
* Damage will still trigger if auto attacks are interrupted (e.g. by Wailing Weapon, Clumsiness, Savage Shot or Leech Signet).

A target will still take damage even if an effect prevents interruption.
8211670d3ed2510ee37cbf237463d300390417e5.text:
* 当目标上注册中断时，损坏就会触发。无条件打断效果不会触发伤害，除非目标也在攻击或使用有激活时间的技能。
* 如果自动攻击被打断（例如被哀嚎武器、笨拙、野蛮射击或水蛭徽记），伤害仍然会触发。

即使效果阻止中断，目标仍会受到伤害。

8fde709263bee451e07ada84624ef89c56606f7a.source: bug: A target will still take damage even if an effect prevents interruption.
8fde709263bee451e07ada84624ef89c56606f7a.text: bug：即使有效果阻止中断，目标仍然会受到伤害。

ed3ba29c8d1f2eaa310534c43f867319d4e3c19a.source: * Contrary to the description, this skill deals damage whenever a target would be interrupted. This is relevant for effects such as Mantra of Concentration.
ed3ba29c8d1f2eaa310534c43f867319d4e3c19a.text: * 与描述相反，只要目标被打断，该技能就会造成伤害。这与集中咒语等效果相关。

13a692f6426622fa6308bd6fe1bfb21bc18ac007.source: * Works well with Sever Artery, Crippling Slash, Barbarous Slice, or Deadly Riposte.
13a692f6426622fa6308bd6fe1bfb21bc18ac007.text: * 与切断动脉、致残斩击、野蛮切片或致命还击配合使用。

bdeb61cad4f194fb2f7a82df06da063799edc62c.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Fury that uses the Gaze of Fury attack skill. 
* Can target and destroy enemy spirits as well.
** This is notably useful in Sunjiang District in Factions, and in the Domain of Anguish when facing Mallyx the Unyielding 
* Consider using with Destruction, Life, and Restoration.
* Use on spirits that will expire soon, and spirits that will die soon, notably from their own effect, such as Agony. 
* Can be recast on an already created Spirit of Fury, allowing one to recycle the spirit indefinitely.
Can be used on any target, not just spirits; can also be cast without a target. If the target is not an enemy spirit, it will destroy the spirit closest to the target. If cast without a target, it will destroy the spirit closest to the caster.
Using this skill while targeting an ally (including spirits) will stop automatic health regeneration.
If multiple spirits occupy exactly the same spot, using Gaze of Fury on one of them may destroy one of the others instead.
bdeb61cad4f194fb2f7a82df06da063799edc62c.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用愤怒凝视攻击技能的愤怒之魂。 
* 也可以瞄准并摧毁敌人的灵魂。
** 这在孙江区的派系中以及在痛苦领域面对不屈的马里克斯时特别有用 
* 考虑与毁灭、生命和恢复一起使用。
* 用于即将过期的灵魂，以及很快就会死亡的灵魂，特别是由于其自身效果，例如痛苦。 
* 可以在已经创造的愤怒之魂上重铸，允许人们无限期地回收该精神。
可以对任何目标使用，而不仅仅是精神；也可以在没有目标的情况下施放。如果目标不是敌方战魂，则会消灭距离目标最近的战魂。如果在没有目标的情况下施放，它会摧毁距离施法者最近的灵魂。
在瞄准盟友（包括灵魂）时使用此技能将停止自动生命恢复。
如果多个灵魂占据完全相同的位置，则对其中一个灵魂使用愤怒凝视可能会摧毁其他灵魂之一。

2eab1c0f2acdf4d222b4e27825c747231f21dc84.source: anomaly: Can be used on any target, not just spirits; can also be cast without a target. If the target is not an enemy spirit, it will destroy the spirit closest to the target. If cast without a target, it will destroy the spirit closest to the caster.
2eab1c0f2acdf4d222b4e27825c747231f21dc84.text: 异常：可以对任何目标使用，而不仅仅是精神；也可以在没有目标的情况下施放。如果目标不是敌方战魂，则会消灭距离目标最近的战魂。如果在没有目标的情况下施放，它会摧毁距离施法者最近的灵魂。

5b7efda2798927a29e07d5fd60da1bd91bc118f9.source: anomaly: Using this skill while targeting an ally (including spirits) will stop automatic health regeneration.
5b7efda2798927a29e07d5fd60da1bd91bc118f9.text: 异常：在瞄准盟友（包括灵魂）时使用此技能将停止自动生命恢复。

7fc38241f39a84a9cb1e6328c04a623def62118e.source: bug: If multiple spirits occupy exactly the same spot, using Gaze of Fury on one of them may destroy one of the others instead.
7fc38241f39a84a9cb1e6328c04a623def62118e.text: bug：如果多个灵魂占据完全相同的位置，则对其中一个灵魂使用愤怒凝视可能会摧毁其他灵魂之一。

2a322aab94c4d6b3b3505915e1a8b4befd6e4782.source:
* Use on spirits that will expire soon.
Can be used on any target, not just allied spirits; can also be cast without a target. If the target is not an allied spirit, it will destroy the allied spirit closest to the target. If cast without a target, it will destroy the allied spirit closest to the caster.
2a322aab94c4d6b3b3505915e1a8b4befd6e4782.text:
* 用于即将过期的烈酒。
可以对任何目标使用，而不仅仅是友军；也可以在没有目标的情况下施放。如果目标不是我方战灵，则会消灭距离目标最近的我方战灵。如果在没有目标的情况下施放，它会摧毁距离施法者最近的友军精魂。

d3c54d4fc36f658ac9a3efd03a2de4ca56ac0633.source: anomaly: Can be used on any target, not just allied spirits; can also be cast without a target. If the target is not an allied spirit, it will destroy the allied spirit closest to the target. If cast without a target, it will destroy the allied spirit closest to the caster.
d3c54d4fc36f658ac9a3efd03a2de4ca56ac0633.text: 异常：可以对任何目标使用，而不仅仅是友军精魂；也可以在没有目标的情况下施放。如果目标不是我方战灵，则会消灭距离目标最近的我方战灵。如果在没有目标的情况下施放，它会摧毁距离施法者最近的友军精魂。

8118c265245989e5d26131d65b0c240e067d339b.source:
* Consider using with skills that benefit from increased health like Flesh of My Flesh.
* Can be used to gain health by recasting early, ending the previous version.
* The sacrifice takes place before you gain the maximum health. Casting this item spell whilst already under its effect will cause you to sacrifice 10% of your increased maximum health.
8118c265245989e5d26131d65b0c240e067d339b.text:
* 考虑使用可提高生命值的技能，例如“我的肉身”。
* 可用于通过提前重铸来获得生命值，结束之前的版本。
* 牺牲发生在你获得最大生命值之前。在已经处于其效果下的情况下施展该物品法术将导致你牺牲 10% 点增加的最大生命值。

d5871b0c72325cd076a083072e3f881e28ebeffb.source: * Heroes will only use this spell if they are within earshot of a spirit.
d5871b0c72325cd076a083072e3f881e28ebeffb.text: *英雄只有在灵魂能听到的范围内才会使用这个法术。

bbba549f834b876a0598ae11a869daf61331354b.source: * Provided that you use this skill on attacking allies, it is unnecessary to put attribute points in your Communing rank specifically for this skill, since it will end as soon as the targeted ally has attacked.
bbba549f834b876a0598ae11a869daf61331354b.text: * 如果你使用该技能来攻击盟友，则不需要专门为该技能在通讯等级中添加属性点，因为一旦目标盟友受到攻击，该技能就会结束。

9da416528951f8a04cb08869756fa68cf7c7b06c.source:
*The self healing can be made profitable when using skills with a health sacrifice.
*Can be used to counter the health loss caused by healing an ally hexed with Soul Bind or Scourge Healing.
While most healing spells can't target a spirit, this one can. Though the spirit receives no healing from it, the user does.
Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes healing and not health gain.
9da416528951f8a04cb08869756fa68cf7c7b06c.text:
*当使用牺牲健康的技能时，自我治疗可以获利。
*可用于抵消因治疗被灵魂束缚或天灾治疗施咒的盟友而造成的生命值损失。
虽然大多数治疗法术不能以灵魂为目标，但这个可以。虽然灵魂没有从中得到治愈，但使用者却得到了治愈。
与简洁的描述相反，该技能的条件效果会导致治疗，而不是获得生命值。

03c03dcd5765f45e4d17fac9877d3d873c072ed4.source: anomaly: While most healing spells can't target a spirit, this one can. Though the spirit receives no healing from it, the user does.
03c03dcd5765f45e4d17fac9877d3d873c072ed4.text: 异常：虽然大多数治疗法术不能以灵魂为目标，但这个可以。虽然灵魂没有从中得到治愈，但使用者却得到了治愈。

5256deb5d05eec6244ee9ed57f74bd20a33d918f.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes healing and not health gain.
5256deb5d05eec6244ee9ed57f74bd20a33d918f.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，该技能的条件效果会导致治疗，而不是获得生命值。

811bf7ad68c457bb9ab2f0bc2bf5b7759134dae7.source: * An effective heal with low attribute points in Healing Prayers, making it a good choice for a healing spell on Protection or Smiting monks.
811bf7ad68c457bb9ab2f0bc2bf5b7759134dae7.text: * 治疗祈祷中低属性点的有效治疗，使其成为保护或重击武僧治疗法术的不错选择。

5435d17021fbd28621f4893d64aafdda07a20abd.source:
* "Create" includes spawning minions, Asura summons, and Ebon Vanguard Assassin.
* Synergy with skills that can create multiple summoned creatures, since this skill triggers when each creature is created.
** This skill will trigger simultaneously for each creature created when using Animate Bone Minions, Aura of the Lich, or Signet of Spirits.
** Using Animate Shambling Horror will trigger this skill two times eventually: once when the Shambling Horror is animated, and then once again when it dies and a Jagged Horror is spawned.
** Jagged Horrors created via Jagged Bones will trigger this skill.
5435d17021fbd28621f4893d64aafdda07a20abd.text:
*“创造”包括生成小兵、阿修罗召唤和黑锋先锋刺客。
* 与可以创建多个召唤生物的技能协同作用，因为该技能会在创建每个生物时触发。
** 使用动画骨随从、巫妖光环或灵魂徽记时创建的每个生物都会同时触发该技能。
** 使用动画蹒跚恐怖最终会触发该技能两次：一次是在蹒跚恐怖被动画化时，另一次是在它死亡并生成锯齿恐怖时。
** 通过锯齿状骨头制造的锯齿状恐怖将触发该技能。

a9cbd2718c10d6248b4add12f1f06a2e7a7eec22.source: * This hex will end on the target if the caster dies.
a9cbd2718c10d6248b4add12f1f06a2e7a7eec22.text: * 如果施法者死亡，这个六角形将在目标上结束。

93cada0278e585711f207837a000b5ead7826662.source: * This is one of the few enchantment removal skills that can remove enchantments that prevent spell targeting and doesn't need a certain circumstance to work, or a very heavy penalty for most melee professions.
93cada0278e585711f207837a000b5ead7826662.text: * 这是为数不多的结界移除技能之一，可以移除阻止法术瞄准的结界，并且不需要特定的环境来工作，或者对大多数近战职业来说是一个非常沉重的惩罚。

0fa77e3e2b3b2b9dc4429973656b328c56998bf6.source:
* This does not increase the duration of conditions on your target.
* If two foes are close to each other you can permanently maintain conditions on all nearby foes.
* The duration cap is applied before other extending effects. Upgrade components (e.g. Silencing prefixes) can be used to increase durations beyond 30 seconds.
0fa77e3e2b3b2b9dc4429973656b328c56998bf6.text:
* 这不会增加目标的状况持续时间。
* 如果两个敌人彼此靠近，你可以永久维持所有附近敌人的状态。
* 持续时间上限先于其他延长效果应用。升级组件（例如静音前缀）可用于将持续时间增加到 30 秒以上。

a4eeca08c4cac17b6b381230b40e7ed51296bfe4.source:
* This skill actually extends the next Dervish enchantment that is applied to you, no matter who cast it or how it was applied.
** It will extend Vow of Piety and Vow of Revolution when these enchantments reapply themselves.
** It will extend another ally's Watchful Intervention that targets you.
** It won't extend your Watchful Intervention that targets another ally.
The visual indicator of the maximum duration on the skill icon of Vow of Piety and Vow of Revolution in the skill monitor is not full after renewal if they were extended before.
a4eeca08c4cac17b6b381230b40e7ed51296bfe4.text:
* 该技能实际上会延长应用于你的下一个苦行僧结界，无论是谁施展它或如何应用它。
** 当这些结界重新应用时，它将延长虔诚誓言和革命誓言。
** 它将延长另一个盟友针对你的警惕干预。
** 它不会延长你针对另一个盟友的警惕干预。
如果之前延长了虔诚誓言和革命誓言的技能图标，技能监视器中的最大持续时间在更新后会显示不满。

f1d23f7ea0d018beff83f2b1c33a92435a3eddc0.source: bug: The visual indicator of the maximum duration on the skill icon of Vow of Piety and Vow of Revolution in the skill monitor is not full after renewal if they were extended before.
f1d23f7ea0d018beff83f2b1c33a92435a3eddc0.text: bug：虔诚誓言和革命誓言的技能图标上的最大持续时间如果之前延长过，更新后在技能监视器上的最大持续时间显示不满。

f18e7610319645d6331d64c2d67913b2c8be083f.source:
* Can be used in conjuction with Breath of the Great Dwarf to counter burning caused by environmental effects, especially in A Time for Heroes, on the Ring of Fire Islands, or during Dasha Vestibule.

Heroes only use Extinguish on allies within their aggro circle, even though the skill works within compass range.
f18e7610319645d6331d64c2d67913b2c8be083f.text:
* 可以与大矮人之息一起使用，以对抗环境影响引起的燃烧，特别是在英雄时代、火环群岛或达莎前庭期间。

英雄仅对仇恨圈内的盟友使用熄灭，即使该技能在罗盘范围内起作用。

bd8d40568815a2a01d49d6900562b48bbd9eb19c.source:
* Only skills which directly target the foe cause Glimmering Mark to end; the hex is unaffected by skills that might impact the target through area of effect.
* Blindness is applied before the attack skill hits.
* Blindness is applied if an attack skill is being activated when Glimmering Mark does damage. Carefully timed or quick attack skills can be activated between two damage packets of Glimmering Mark, avoiding the Blindness effect.
The concise description fails to specify the duration of the Blind condition
Unlike most area damage over time skills, Glimmering Mark does not cause AI to scatter.
bd8d40568815a2a01d49d6900562b48bbd9eb19c.text:
* 只有直接瞄准敌人的技能才会导致微光标记结束；六角形不受可能通过效果区域影响目标的技能的影响。
* 失明是在攻击技能命中之前施加的。
* 如果闪烁标记造成伤害时正在激活攻击技能，则会应用失明。可以在两个闪烁标记伤害包之间激活精心计时或快速攻击的技能，避免失明效果。
简洁的描述未能指定盲态的持续时间
与大多数随时间造成区域伤害的技能不同，微光标记不会导致 AI 分散。

c466bedd87dcd8394cc6f21624b847d3514bbc7c.source: bug: The concise description fails to specify the duration of the Blind condition
c466bedd87dcd8394cc6f21624b847d3514bbc7c.text: bug：简洁的描述未能指定盲态的持续时间

3a613f966eb781fdea32371dbf31cde5f4c360d4.source: anomaly: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Glimmering Mark does not cause AI to scatter.
3a613f966eb781fdea32371dbf31cde5f4c360d4.text: 异常：与大多数区域持续伤害技能不同，微光标记不会导致AI分散。

e94395178a646203e2417f2a51e955e5efc34577.source: * The conditional energy will be granted to the caster if the caster is under the effects of Double Dragon or Glyph of Immolation or the target is under the effects of Mark of Rodgort, since those skills apply Burning to the target before Glowing Gaze takes effect.
e94395178a646203e2417f2a51e955e5efc34577.text: * 如果施法者处于双龙或献祭雕文的效果下，或者目标处于罗格特印记的效果下，则施法者将获得条件能量，因为这些技能会在灼热凝视生效之前对目标施加燃烧。

770891542eb2ac0163f48b57c51877401a0baa9e.source:
* Use of the glyph will not prevent skills that disable the affected spell, e.g. it does not prevent Power Block.

It is sometimes possible to be interrupted by a Destroyer of Deeds using Broad Head Arrow in Glint's Challenge or by the environment effect Cathedral Collapse in Arborstone while this glyph is still active.
770891542eb2ac0163f48b57c51877401a0baa9e.text:
* 使用该雕文不会阻止禁用受影响法术的技能，例如它不会阻止电源块。

有时，在格林特的挑战中使用宽头箭的行为毁灭者或在阿伯斯通的环境效果大教堂倒塌中，当该雕文仍处于活动状态时，可能会被打断。

bc8e16034d36064233f7a6070acd570a463fccdf.source: bug: It is sometimes possible to be interrupted by a Destroyer of Deeds using Broad Head Arrow in Glint's Challenge or by the environment effect Cathedral Collapse in Arborstone while this glyph is still active.
bc8e16034d36064233f7a6070acd570a463fccdf.text: bug：有时可能会被格林特挑战中使用宽头箭的行为毁灭者打断，或者在阿伯斯通中被环境效果大教堂倒塌打断，而该雕文仍然处于活动状态。

0c649d02c7c02a307e83eb50037bca7fb67771d8.source:
* While under the effect of this glyph, heroes will not use non-elemental spells.
This skill actually behaves identically to Glyph of Energy, in that your elemental attributes are boosted for all purposes while under the effects of this glyph.
* Non-spell skills (Lightning Touch, Shock, Glyph of Immolation and Glyph of Swiftness) will take advantage of the bonus and will not count as a use of the glyph. 
* Any elemental attribute raised to at least 9 will trigger the bonus armor from Prismatic Insignia.
