**However, the secondary hits from increased ranks in the title track can affect non-demonic enemies, e.g. Kournan soldiers, provided that the initial target was valid.
*Quickening Zephyr and Serpent's Quickness decrease the recharge time as well as disabling time of this skill.
The holy damage from this skill is reduced by armor.
The animation for this skill is the same as a signet.
The additional foes are not interrupted.
cc8968f0e9226718513ed5bbe2dd6d5d8f54a933.text:
*该技能只能针对亚巴顿的恶魔仆从。它会对其他敌人失败，并显示一条通知。
**然而，标题曲目中排名增加的次要打击可能会影响非恶魔敌人，例如库尔南士兵，前提是最初的目标有效。
*加速和风和蛇的敏捷会减少该技能的充能时间以及禁用时间。
该技能的神圣伤害会因护甲而减少。
该技能的动画与图章相同。
额外的敌人不会被打断。

389abc4909f2d001fd54fbc7502ee3a47db7b5a9.text:

08463c82a5ed9bb742d42d98d1b1264ef3312375.source:
*Like Shell Shock, Cracked Armor is applied after calculating damage.
*Provided that the prerequisites for additional damage of the skills are met, Lightning Bolt, Lightning Orb, and Mind Shock deal the same amount of damage from Air Magic rank 14 to 16.
*Unlike the full description states, this skill will not cause the target to apply Cracked Armor to another target.
08463c82a5ed9bb742d42d98d1b1264ef3312375.text:
*与炮弹震击一样，裂甲是在计算伤害后应用的。
*在满足技能附加伤害的前提条件下，雷电、雷电球、心灵震击在气系魔法等级14到16之间造成同等伤害。
*与完整描述不同的是，该技能不会导致目标将裂纹护甲应用于另一个目标。

5cafdba16ccf3bd454100204123c026c077279fd.source:
* Heroes do not use this skill on non-attacking foes.
* Lightning Javelin and Spear of Lightning are the only two skills that uses this line-shaped area of effect.
** The projectile is identical to a staff's attack, and follows a high arc, similar to that of a flatbow.
** The projectile strikes foes adjacent to the target, and all foes adjacent to the projectile's flight-path originating from the caster.
** The projectile seemingly acknowledges "facing", as it does not affect "flanking" adjacent foes' immediate position to the caster's "left/right sides and rear", when facing relative to the target; despite the area of effect being centered on the caster.
** If the target foe evades towards the spell caster and the projectile misses far, the targeted foe will not receive any damage even if they are still in the projectiles flight path. This is commonly seen using lightning javelin to engage a fight with npcs.
** If the target is line of sight obstructed, the other foes in the aoe will still be struck even if they too would normally be obstructed.
5cafdba16ccf3bd454100204123c026c077279fd.text:
* 英雄不会对非攻击敌人使用此技能。
* 闪电标枪和闪电之矛是仅有的两种使用这种线状效果区域的技能。
** 射弹与法杖的攻击相同，并遵循高弧线，类似于平弓。
** 射弹会攻击目标附近的敌人，以及来自施法者的射弹飞行路径附近的所有敌人。
** 射弹似乎承认“面对”，因为当相对于目标面对时，它不会影响施法者“左/右侧和后方”的“侧翼”相邻敌人的直接位置；尽管效果区域以施法者为中心。
** 如果目标敌人向施法者躲避并且射弹偏离较远，则目标敌人即使仍在射弹飞行路径中也不会受到任何伤害。这常见于使用闪电标枪与 NPC 进行战斗。
** 如果目标视线被阻挡，范围内的其他敌人仍然会被击中，即使他们通常也会被阻挡。

2d9eb47b9bbd34fe3a639ab36402b00db74b6557.source:
* Cracked armor is applied before the damage is dealt.
* Primary PvP-only Elementalists will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on their account.
2d9eb47b9bbd34fe3a639ab36402b00db74b6557.text:
* 破裂的护甲是在造成伤害之前施加的。
* 初级 PvP 元素师将能够使用此技能，即使该技能尚未在其帐户上解锁。

a77d093eae0968ebb54bcd5a4c44eb8e078c0760.source:
* Blind covers cracked armor.
* Because this is not a spell, this will not count for the 10 spell count in Glyph of Elemental Power or 1…3…3 spell count in Glyph of Energy, but will still get the stat boost.
* Cracked armor is applied after the damage is dealt.
a77d093eae0968ebb54bcd5a4c44eb8e078c0760.text:
* 百叶窗遮盖破裂的装甲。
* 因为这不是法术，所以这不会计入元素力量雕文中的 10 法术计数或能量雕文中的 1…3…3 法术计数，但仍会获得统计提升。
* 造成伤害后会应用破裂的护甲。

e581d2f82896c6e29ce27f9bda77e49e55953309.source: *This skill does not benefit from the adrenaline it generates, since it has a recharge time.
e581d2f82896c6e29ce27f9bda77e49e55953309.text: *该技能不会从其产生的肾上腺素中受益，因为它有充电时间。

90cb8df772f2430f172221e5342618b8384e0ddd.source:
* There is a 3 second delay between dropping the ashes and resurrection.
* If you are holding this when you die, you drop it and are resurrected.
* Your team will wipe in PvE and still lose an annihilation round even if your last remaining party member is holding the ashes after being killed.
* This skill cannot be cast while under effect of Frozen Soil. The ashes, however, will successfully resurrect party members if dropped while in range of a Frozen Soil spirit.
** Combine with Frozen Soil to prevent enemy resurrection while enabling it for your own party.
* This skill has a distinctive caster aura at the end of casting and a distinctive urn graphic.
90cb8df772f2430f172221e5342618b8384e0ddd.text:
* 掉落骨灰和复活之间有3秒的延迟。
* 如果你死时拿着这个，你会丢掉它并复活。
* 即使你最后剩下的队员在被杀后持有骨灰，你的队伍也会在 PvE 中被消灭，并且仍然会输掉一轮歼灭战。
* 该技能在冻土效果下无法施放。然而，如果在冰冻土壤灵魂的范围内掉落，骨灰将成功复活队员。
** 与冰冻土壤结合，防止敌人复活，同时为自己的队伍启用它。
* 该技能在施法结束时具有独特的施法者光环和独特的瓮图形。

c61f3e3da14561abe4611adc118b4d10df649a85.source: *Only affect auto attacks. Does not affect attack skills, since non-dual attack skills cannot double strike.
c61f3e3da14561abe4611adc118b4d10df649a85.text: *仅影响自动攻击。不影响攻击技能，非双攻击技能不能连击。

bc7da624fec734c38dab06b25a1b21c321f51801.source:
* Low Blow is a touch skill, not an attack. Therefore, you gain no adrenaline after use.
* Brawling Headbutt, this skill and Body Blow could be chained.
* The Cracked Armor condition is applied before any damage from this skill.
Although no damage type is specified in the skill descriptions, the damage does not ignore armor.
bc7da624fec734c38dab06b25a1b21c321f51801.text:
* 低击是接触技能，不是攻击。因此，使用后您不会获得肾上腺素。
* 斗殴头撞，该技能和身体打击可以连锁。
* 护甲破裂的条件是在该技能造成任何伤害之前应用的。
虽然技能描述中没有指定伤害类型，但伤害不会忽略护甲。

cb5441eb6b1167605e294f26556506ff98742761.source: anomaly: Although no damage type is specified in the skill descriptions, the damage does not ignore armor.
cb5441eb6b1167605e294f26556506ff98742761.text: 异常：虽然技能描述中没有指定伤害类型，但伤害不会无视护甲。

94fa4310feb9b001b42f72e5a8008b7998822d44.source: * This skill will not prevent the burning from Cautery Signet since the condition is removed before the signets effect takes place.
94fa4310feb9b001b42f72e5a8008b7998822d44.text: * 该技能不会阻止烧灼印章的燃烧，因为在印章效果发生之前该条件已被消除。

4c7aaf39355bc3b979c4fd697e8a080901c05ec6.source: *This skill ends before the signet's effect takes place. Notably, Signet of Aggression will not cause adrenaline gain.
4c7aaf39355bc3b979c4fd697e8a080901c05ec6.text: *该技能在图章效果发生之前结束。值得注意的是，侵略徽记不会导致肾上腺素增加。

517ced2c61cea1107cc5a290e941da28799f0299.source:
* This enchantment can be kept up by using skills with a short recharge and low energy cost such as Wastrel's Worry and Wastrel's Demise.
*The skill reapplies itself before new enchantments are applied (from the likes of Magnetic Surge or Ice Spear), so those will cover Lyssa's Aura.
517ced2c61cea1107cc5a290e941da28799f0299.text:
* 这种魔力可以通过使用恢复时间短、能量消耗低的技能来维持，例如废人的忧虑和废人的灭亡。
*该技能会在应用新的结界（例如磁力涌动或冰矛）之前重新应用，因此这些结界将覆盖莱莎的光环。

a6637aebaa7ff4b4a3c4613b705547ca1bd3456a.source: * In PvE, Mirror of Disenchantment has the same energy cost, cast time, recharge time and attribute requirements as this skill, yet it is unconditional and also affects foe's party members.
a6637aebaa7ff4b4a3c4613b705547ca1bd3456a.text: * 在PvE中，幻灭之镜与该技能具有相同的能量消耗、施法时间、充能时间和属性要求，但它是无条件的，并且也会影响敌方队伍成员。

c6fb4108f747eb8006e5f9e82659fda6d287dfee.source: *This skill can be queued to prevent quarterknocking on oneself.
c6fb4108f747eb8006e5f9e82659fda6d287dfee.text: *该技能可以排队，以防止自己被击中。

df6b20c8a11ece57857f4049ca380f43a6fc408e.source:
* Using Water Magic hexes, such as Deep Freeze or Ice Spikes, can help keep foes in the area of effect.
* It is possible to cast skills with short activation times in between Maelstrom pulses.
df6b20c8a11ece57857f4049ca380f43a6fc408e.text:
* 使用水魔法六角形，例如深度冻结或冰刺，可以帮助将敌人保持在效果区域内。
* 可以在漩涡脉冲之间施放短激活时间的技能。

676389d3d214a44955982e17b5a12b6177c18e81.source:
* Heroes will use this to interrupt any skill, not just spells.
* This skill will only disable a spell if the spell is interrupted.
676389d3d214a44955982e17b5a12b6177c18e81.text:
* 英雄会用它来打断任何技能，而不仅仅是法术。
* 该技能仅在法术被打断时才会使法术无效。

b954bb53e4cecda375034ada5107e0b59838fed8.source: Against unenchanted targets this skill causes block bypassing effects such as Asuran Scan or Warrior's Cunning to be ignored.
b954bb53e4cecda375034ada5107e0b59838fed8.text: 对抗未附魔的目标时，该技能会导致绕过格挡的效果（例如阿苏兰扫描或战士的狡诈）被忽略。

b20ac7738873ba15487fb23c3f48d6522cbd323b.source: bug: Against unenchanted targets this skill causes block bypassing effects such as Asuran Scan or Warrior's Cunning to be ignored.
b20ac7738873ba15487fb23c3f48d6522cbd323b.text: bug：针对未附魔的目标，该技能会导致绕过格挡的效果（例如阿苏兰扫描或战士的狡猾）被忽略。

6a5d16d0aa2bc0064879a5fd7f2da5bef93d1b2a.source: * Contrary to the concise description, this skill does not reflect damage but instead deals a set amount to your attacker upon blocking an attack.
6a5d16d0aa2bc0064879a5fd7f2da5bef93d1b2a.text: * 与简洁的描述相反，该技能并不反映伤害，而是在格挡攻击时对攻击者造成一定数量的伤害。

9711db937405e97d03168b5fb947fc5e4155e632.source:
Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.
When Overcast, Magnetic Surge is applied to party members only.
9711db937405e97d03168b5fb947fc5e4155e632.text:
与其他针对敌人的结界类似，受到亵渎之井或灵魂影响的敌人不能成为该结界的目标。
阴天时，磁力冲击仅适用于队伍成员。

b4a81ca23a1ab65b9dd187deb35b52bff3d3918f.source: bug: When Overcast, Magnetic Surge is applied to party members only.
b4a81ca23a1ab65b9dd187deb35b52bff3d3918f.text: bug：阴天时，磁力冲击仅适用于队伍成员。

60ccde6b36771bfb37cd00add52fda2c318767c2.source: * Using skills like Apply Poison and Sharpen Daggers will still result in a critical hit, because the condition is applied before the attack.
60ccde6b36771bfb37cd00add52fda2c318767c2.text: * 使用“施毒”和“磨刀”等技能仍然会造成致命一击，因为该条件是在攻击之前应用的。

a95597d1093fc019b94f638f9c3c10a2d3366248.source:
* The spell requires the target to leave an exploitable corpse; but does not exploit the corpse.
* Healing modifiers stack multiplicatively. Combining with Deep Wound or Lingering Curse will amount to -36% healing.
* Verata's Gaze can be used to gain control of the masterless Bone Horror.
** Alternatively, if you do not intend to take control of the minion, Swap can be used to shadow step it away from your team (preferably in the opposing team). It also provides a suitable target to trigger the bonus effects of Holy Spear.
* Heroes tend to spam this skill regardless of whether the target or enemy group has healing skills, leading to several extra Bone Horrors per fight.
* Since the Bone Horror is created masterless, it will not trigger skills that depend on summoned creature creation such as Boon of Creation. It also does not gain extra max health from Spawning Power. 

Cannot be used on non-fleshy targets.
a95597d1093fc019b94f638f9c3c10a2d3366248.text:
* 该法术要求目标留下一具可利用的尸体；但不利用尸体。
* 治疗效果乘数叠加。与深伤或挥之不去的诅咒结合起来将达到 -36% 点治疗效果。
* 维拉塔的凝视可以用来控制无主的骸骨恐怖。
** 或者，如果您不打算控制该随从，则可以使用“交换”将其从您的团队中移开（最好是在对方团队中）。它还提供了一个合适的目标来触发圣枪的额外效果。
* 无论目标或敌人群体是否具有治疗技能，英雄都倾向于垃圾邮件此技能，从而导致每场战斗产生一些额外的骨头恐怖。
* 由于骨怪是无主创造的，它不会触发依赖于召唤生物创造的技能，例如创造恩惠。它也不会从产卵力中获得额外的最大生命值。 

不能用于非肉质目标。

3ea6c2aa08fb326dc80c7fb2a7faeaa16c8dc738.source: anomaly: Cannot be used on non-fleshy targets.
3ea6c2aa08fb326dc80c7fb2a7faeaa16c8dc738.text: 异常：不能用于非肉质目标。

de223b0b431a829f9080064cf55b504474eba458.source:
* Good synergy with Trampling Ox.
Although the skill name implies that the target has to be touched to be affected, this is not the case. It is a normal skill, which can be activated at casting range.
de223b0b431a829f9080064cf55b504474eba458.text:
* 与践踏牛有良好的协同作用。
虽然技能名称暗示必须触摸目标才会受到影响，但事实并非如此。这是一个普通技能，可以在施法范围内激活。

3eb1adec6247dfcb3b8ff616951545e08f0537f5.source: anomaly: Although the skill name implies that the target has to be touched to be affected, this is not the case. It is a normal skill, which can be activated at casting range.
3eb1adec6247dfcb3b8ff616951545e08f0537f5.text: 异常：虽然技能名称暗示必须触摸目标才会受到影响，但事实并非如此。这是一个普通技能，可以在施法范围内激活。

6ad826aa1bab19383232c8592852d7d6da338c7a.source:
* The caster will not gain energy if the enchantment is renewed before it ends.
* Use a self-enchantment removal skill (e.g. Contemplation of Purity) to forcefully trigger the energy gain.
* Consider using Energy Drain over this skill, as it provides more net energy and doesn't have a delay.
* An of Enchanting weapon upgrade is not advised, as it will delay the energy gain.
6ad826aa1bab19383232c8592852d7d6da338c7a.text:
* 如果结界在结界结束前更新，施法者将不会获得能量。
* 使用自我结界去除技能（例如纯净沉思）强制触发能量增益。
* 考虑使用能量吸取而不是该技能，因为它提供更多的净能量并且没有延迟。
* 不建议升级附魔武器，因为这会延迟能量获取。

a377597445a972a6623771c214dadd72a41caa6d.source: * This reduction stacks with Fast Casting. Fast Casting's recharge effect is applied to the remaining (66%) duration after Mantra of Recovery is applied.
a377597445a972a6623771c214dadd72a41caa6d.text: * 此减少可与快速施法叠加。快速施法的充能效果适用于应用恢复咒语后剩余的（66%）持续时间。

bb1fbf4247bcfc20c7ecea0dcde2c5fd8f9d1c62.source:
* When Mantra of Resolve successfully prevents an interrupt, it removes the set amount of energy; however, if the character does not have enough energy for removal, Mantra of Resolve will still prevent one interruption, then it will finally end. This also applies to Distortion.
* Does not work against interrupts that recharge the affected spell, e.g. it does not prevent Power Block.
bb1fbf4247bcfc20c7ecea0dcde2c5fd8f9d1c62.text:
* 当决心咒语成功阻止中断时，它会消除设定数量的能量；但是，如果角色没有足够的能量来移除，决心咒语仍然会阻止一次中断，然后最终结束。这也适用于失真。
* 不适用于为受影响的法术重新充电的中断，例如它不会阻止电源块。

88118874d18ec6fecf8b6b10a5d59b4ad3dd6742.source: * When Mantra of Resolve successfully prevents an interrupt, it removes the set amount of energy; however, if the character does not have enough energy for removal, Mantra of Resolve will still prevent one interruption, then it will finally end. This also applies to Distortion.
88118874d18ec6fecf8b6b10a5d59b4ad3dd6742.text: * 当决心咒语成功阻止中断时，它会消除设定数量的能量；但是，如果角色没有足够的能量来移除，决心咒语仍然会阻止一次中断，然后最终结束。这也适用于失真。

92f8b82274efaabd48c8a8cd34760f261b2efbc7.source:
* Combines well with Artificer's Insignia.
* This skill, Ether Feast, and Drain Enchantment are the only Mesmer skills that heal the user.
Similarly to Illusionary Weaponry and "I Am Unstoppable!", the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
92f8b82274efaabd48c8a8cd34760f261b2efbc7.text:
* 与技工徽章完美结合。
* 此技能、以太盛宴和汲取附魔是唯一可以治疗使用者的幻术师技能。
与幻影武器和“我势不可挡！”类似，该技能提供的护甲仅在护甲计算结束时应用。因此，它不计入 +25 的额外护甲上限，也不会因护甲穿透而减少。
与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

e1daa402cf8b3ef620ddd8b35ad4a80d46b0d3d2.source: bug: Similarly to Illusionary Weaponry and "I Am Unstoppable!", the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
e1daa402cf8b3ef620ddd8b35ad4a80d46b0d3d2.text: bug：与幻影武器和“我势不可挡！”类似，该技能提供的护甲仅在护甲计算结束时应用。因此，它不计入 +25 的额外护甲上限，也不会因护甲穿透而减少。

f20310cd526f7cd3912604a2b79b71ecdbf22e2f.source:
*Though this skill exists separately from Mantra of Signets, they share the same functionality.



Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
f20310cd526f7cd3912604a2b79b71ecdbf22e2f.text:
*虽然该技能与纹章真言分开存在，但它们具有相同的功能。



与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

8bae3431dd356dd0c8b0e8b22416d5253d3dd919.source:
* This hex only affects the duration of enchantments and stances used on the target after the hex is applied, previously applied stances and enchantments are not affected, nor will removing the hex restore the original duration of effects already shortened.
* Faster expiration in this case means a decrease in duration (contrary to Air of Disenchantment).
8bae3431dd356dd0c8b0e8b22416d5253d3dd919.text:
* 该降咒仅影响应用该降咒后对目标使用的结界和姿态的持续时间，之前应用的姿态和结界不受影响，移除该降咒也不会恢复已缩短的效果的原始持续时间。
* 在这种情况下，更快的过期意味着持续时间的减少（与幻灭之气相反）。

11f976f90908559fde95c8595b27d7e420a66aa8.source:
* Damage triggers when the target receives a physical damage packet, even a packet of 0 damage.
* The target foe with this hex will not take the damage, only foes adjacent to him.
* This skill causes the area damage over time scatter effect.
* Combines well with a high number of minions.
* Synergy with Hundred Blades or Vow of Strength as the damage they deal is physical.
11f976f90908559fde95c8595b27d7e420a66aa8.text:
* 当目标收到物理伤害包时，即使是 0 点伤害，也会触发伤害。
* 具有此六角形的目标敌人不会受到伤害，只有与他相邻的敌人才会受到伤害。
* 该技能造成区域伤害随时间分散的效果。
* 与大量小兵完美结合。
* 与百刃或力量誓言协同作用，因为它们造成的伤害是物理伤害。

72f76d2b0ee289118ca239f1f297ad6139526b7c.source:
* At 7 Divine Favor, Blessed Aura combined with 20% enchanting allows this enchantment to be maintained indefinitely.
Contrary to the description, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
72f76d2b0ee289118ca239f1f297ad6139526b7c.text:
* 神圣恩惠达到 7 时，祝福光环与 20% 附魔相结合，可以无限期地维持该附魔。
与描述相反，该技能会增加生命值而不是治疗。

ce8401d9c7b155bdf33fe9fafdc4b2d0dd07e42a.source: anomaly: Contrary to the description, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
ce8401d9c7b155bdf33fe9fafdc4b2d0dd07e42a.text: 异常：与描述相反，该技能会导致生命值增加而不是治疗。

1050db41699b4cf38bb5148c9c6ecbc26f8daa22.source:
* Effective for spreading the burning condition with low energy fire damage spells, fire damage weapons or a Hound of Balthazar animal companion, (inflicting fire damage).
* Like all spells that cause burning, it works well with "They're on Fire!".
* Frequently combined with Searing Flames to keep the target burning (as well as deal significant damage).
1050db41699b4cf38bb5148c9c6ecbc26f8daa22.text:
* 使用低能量火焰伤害法术、火焰伤害武器或巴尔萨泽猎犬动物伙伴（造成火焰伤害）可有效传播燃烧状况。
* 像所有引起燃烧的法术一样，它与“他们着火了！”配合得很好。
* 经常与灼热火焰结合使用以保持目标燃烧（并造成重大伤害）。

8cc97f14165ecdd5b93ff0d4850199de4a6f4f80.source: * This skill is triggered by any ally-targeted spell, even if the caster targets itself. It is not triggered by untargeted spells that affect the caster or the caster's allies.
8cc97f14165ecdd5b93ff0d4850199de4a6f4f80.text: * 该技能可由任何以盟友为目标的法术触发，即使施法者以自己为目标。它不会被影响施法者或施法者盟友的非目标法术触发。

978b83966d4fae8c556f2e29b72b882425da56fe.source:
* Even at 0 Expertise, using this skill with a flatbow or shortbow will be as if you had +7.5 pips of energy regeneration on top of your base energy regeneration if all attacks hit.
* Provides large potential energy returns with attacks that fire multiple arrows (such as Forked Arrow, Dual Shot, and Triple Shot).
* Asuran Scan can eliminate the chance of missing or being blocked.
978b83966d4fae8c556f2e29b72b882425da56fe.text:
* 即使在 0 专业知识下，如果所有攻击都命中，在平弓或短弓上使用此技能就好像您在基础能量再生之上还有 +7.5 点能量再生。
* 通过发射多支箭（例如叉箭、双箭和三箭）的攻击提供巨大的潜在能量回报。
* 阿苏兰扫描可以消除丢失或被阻止的机会。

8dbb0a347c32361dbc0e8b1c0b63e663d9bf983e.source:
* This spell works within party range.

* Use it in disease-heavy areas to reduce the number of victims and prevent the condition from spreading.
* Chain with Plague Touch or Plague Sending to transfer conditions to foes.
* Combine with Purge Conditions or Infuse Condition to quickly remove several conditions from the party at once.
8dbb0a347c32361dbc0e8b1c0b63e663d9bf983e.text:
* 该法术在队伍范围内有效。

* 在疾病严重地区使用它可以减少受害者数量并防止病情蔓延。
* 与瘟疫之触或瘟疫传送连动，将状况传送给敌人。
* 与净化条件或注入条件结合使用，可一次性快速消除队伍中的多个条件。

883cfe989d27032f8a672a703a670fb04c19dce7.source: Under rare circumstances, heroes with very low health will use a spell while under the effects of Masochism and accidentally kill themselves.
883cfe989d27032f8a672a703a670fb04c19dce7.text: 在极少数情况下，生命值极低的英雄会在受虐狂的影响下使用法术并意外自杀。

b00184bf823e69e2eb41dd5988679405f52a088c.source: anomaly: Under rare circumstances, heroes with very low health will use a spell while under the effects of Masochism and accidentally kill themselves.
b00184bf823e69e2eb41dd5988679405f52a088c.text: 异常：在极少数情况下，生命值极低的英雄会在受虐狂影响下使用法术并意外自杀。

256921a3ddf2cd79f5d5dc6c5e2d48a30358b084.source:
* This skill overrides any existing modifiers, including: skills that boost elemental attributes (e.g. Elemental Lord), runes, Weakness and consumables (e.g. Candy Corn).
** Bonuses will take effect if they are applied after Master of Magic (e.g. remove/reapply headgear before casting).
***Removing and reapplying runes has no effect.
** Renewing Master of Magic whilst under the attribute boosting modifiers will retain the higher attribute ranks and not reset them to the rank predicted by Master of Magic.
** Renewing Master of Magic while boosted by Heroic Refrain will cause the boost to not be renewed even if the echo is renewed. Recast Heroic Refrain immediately after renewing Master of Magic.
* Journey to the North takes precedence, setting only one attribute to 12 (and any others to 9). [Source claim needs verification]
* The most effective uses of this skill are:
** To boost the effectiveness of low-level characters, since it can allow them to reach and maintain an elemental attribute rank of 9 at only rank 3 in Energy Storage. 
** To maximize the strength of Prismatic Insignia (raising an elementalist's armor by 20).
** To free attribute points for builds that draw on several elementalist attributes or to meet the requirement of certain weapons (notably shields).
* The amount of energy regained is rounded down: 5 energy spells return 1 energy, 15 energy spells return 4 and 25 energy spells return 7.
* The amount of energy regained considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
* Elemental spells refers to spells associated with the four elemental attributes, rather than spells that deal elemental damage.
While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.
256921a3ddf2cd79f5d5dc6c5e2d48a30358b084.text:
* 该技能会覆盖任何现有的修饰符，包括：提升元素属性的技能（例如元素领主）、符文、弱点和消耗品（例如玉米糖）。
** 如果在魔法大师之后应用，奖励将生效（例如在施法前移除/重新戴上头饰）。
***移除并重新应用符文没有效果。
** 在属性提升修改器下更新魔法大师将保留较高的属性等级，并且不会将其重置为魔法大师预测的等级。
** 在英雄副歌强化的同时更新魔法大师将导致即使回声更新也不会更新强化效果。续订魔法大师后立即重铸英雄副歌。
* 北游记优先，仅将一项属性设置为 12（将任何其他属性设置为 9）。 [来源声明需要验证]
* 该技能最有效的用途是：
** 提升低等级角色的效率，因为它可以让他们在能量存储中仅达到3级，就达到并保持元素属性等级9。 
** 最大化棱柱徽章的强度（将元素师的护甲提高 20）。
** 为利用多种元素属性的构建释放属性点或满足某些武器（尤其是盾牌）的要求。
* 恢复的能量数量向下取整：5 能量法术返回 1 能量，15 能量法术返回 4，25 能量法术返回 7。
* 恢复的能量量仅考虑法术的基本成本，没有任何修饰符，例如次级能量雕文或加速和风。
* 元素法术是指与四种元素属性相关的法术，而不是造成元素伤害的法术。
在魔法大师的效果下，元素等级属性点被削弱，会导致元素等级降低1。没有属性点的元素属性不会降低1。

b6d7d8ba28bf3fdc10c356f55f408a550e51494e.source: bug: While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.
b6d7d8ba28bf3fdc10c356f55f408a550e51494e.text: bug：在魔法大师效果下，元素等级中带有属性点的削弱会导致元素等级降低1。没有属性点的元素属性不会降低1。

58385395460076a17b52f1e49025ac31edb744bc.source:
* Meditation will not trigger itself when it ends.
* Consider combining with Pious Renewal and fast recharging teardowns (like Eremite's Attack and Pious Assault) for great energy management.
58385395460076a17b52f1e49025ac31edb744bc.text:
* 冥想结束时不会自行触发。
* 考虑与虔诚更新和快速充电拆解（如埃雷米特的攻击和虔诚攻击）相结合，以实现出色的能量管理。

1679c01d60b4506aa00fde66ef7113781443f858.source:
* This skill affects foes near the target, not near the user.
The pet does not actually attack nearby foes when this skill is used, but instead deals a flat 5...20 damage to target and nearby foes in a separate packet. 
*The damage to nearby foes is not increased by Feral Aggression, "Together as One!" or Ebon Battle Standard of Honor. Heal as One does not cause extra life steal and Predatory Bond does not heal for each affected foe.
1679c01d60b4506aa00fde66ef7113781443f858.text:
* 该技能影响目标附近的敌人，而不是用户附近的敌人。
使用此技能时，宠物实际上并不会攻击附近的敌人，而是对单独的目标和附近的敌人造成 5...20 点伤害。 
*对附近敌人的伤害不会因野性侵略而增加，“团结一致！”或黑檀战斗荣誉旗。一体治疗不会导致额外的生命偷取，掠夺债券也不会为每个受影响的敌人治疗。

a43589c2ee6850d05d9de0a6c738867af4ae2f80.source:
bug: The pet does not actually attack nearby foes when this skill is used, but instead deals a flat 5...20 damage to target and nearby foes in a separate packet.

a43589c2ee6850d05d9de0a6c738867af4ae2f80.text:
bug：使用此技能时，宠物实际上并不会攻击附近的敌人，而是对单独的目标和附近的敌人造成 5...20 点伤害。 
*对附近敌人的伤害不会因野性侵略而增加，“团结一致！”或黑檀战斗荣誉旗。一体治疗不会导致额外的生命偷取，掠夺债券也不会为每个受影响的敌人治疗。

9a7b6b8b5dacd973d5902d011a0b925e55ff98ee.source:
* If standing in lava under Melandru's Resilience, you will experience +1 net health regeneration and +2 energy regeneration.
* Can be used with most skills that inflict conditions on self.
** However, be aware that henchmen or heroes in your party will attempt to remove conditions from you. Inform human players that you don't require condition removal.
9a7b6b8b5dacd973d5902d011a0b925e55ff98ee.text:
* 如果站在梅兰德鲁韧性的熔岩中，你将体验到 +1 点生命值再生和 +2 点能量再生。
* 可与大多数对自身造成影响的技能一起使用。
** 但是，请注意，你队伍中的追随者或英雄会试图消除你的条件。告知人类玩家您不需要条件移除。

66b90c5866c015aedb07e12b0e41ee4d77811c84.source: * If both conditions are applied, crippled covers bleeding.
66b90c5866c015aedb07e12b0e41ee4d77811c84.text: * 如果两种情况都适用，则残废涵盖流血。

1ff0ac2d92f616f5eca0bbf6d427aab9d4c4a8ed.source:
* Within earshot of the caster, not target.
* Because of the short recharge time, low energy cost and ability to remove multiple conditions, this skill can in some cases, such as when you have a spirit spammer in your party, be an excellent condition removal. This can make the skill very effective even at 0 Restoration Magic.
While most other ally targeted Restoration Magic spells cast a unique visual effect on the target, Mend Body and Soul places a unique visual effect on the caster instead.
1ff0ac2d92f616f5eca0bbf6d427aab9d4c4a8ed.text:
* 在施法者的听力范围内，而不是目标。
* 由于充能时间短、能量消耗低且能够消除多种条件，该技能在某些情况下（例如当您的队伍中有精神垃圾邮件发送者时）可以成为出色的条件消除效果。这使得该技能即使在恢复魔法为0的情况下也非常有效。
虽然大多数其他以盟友为目标的恢复魔法法术会对目标施加独特的视觉效果，但治愈身体和灵魂却会给施法者带来独特的视觉效果。

66f0b08f1f85b2f91061767d8d34bdfbc38c56e1.source: anomaly: While most other ally targeted Restoration Magic spells cast a unique visual effect on the target, Mend Body and Soul places a unique visual effect on the caster instead.
66f0b08f1f85b2f91061767d8d34bdfbc38c56e1.text: 异常：虽然大多数其他以盟友为目标的恢复魔法法术会对目标施加独特的视觉效果，但治愈身体和灵魂却会给施法者带来独特的视觉效果。

74d2fe8f43bfb04a5489b09f6dee16eecfde6213.source:
* It is best used as a sustained, passive self-healing skill, e.g. for navigating areas with health degeneration or numerous interrupts.
* It is a prominent optional component of 55 monk builds.
* It heals very slowly compared to other healing spells; however, it has relatively high healing when compared to other healing spells. For every 5 energy lost by the -1 energy degeneration, it heals for 90 health at rank 8 and 120 at rank 13.
74d2fe8f43bfb04a5489b09f6dee16eecfde6213.text:
* 它最好用作持续、被动的自我修复技能，例如用于在健康状况恶化或多次中断的区域中导航。
* 它是 55 武僧构建的一个突出的可选组件。
* 与其他治疗法术相比，它的治疗速度非常慢；然而，与其他治疗法术相比，它具有相对较高的治疗效果。 -1 能量衰退每损失 5 点能量，就能治愈 8 级的 90 点生命值和 13 级的 120 点生命值。

b80bbaf377658f74c47a190e614e65cb43d9480e.source:
* In PvP, it is common to use a cover condition for the most harmful condition (i.e. Blind, Crippled, Dazed, and Deep Wound) you want to keep on your target. Since the amount of conditions doesn't scale, this skill can remove both the cover and the covered condition without any investment of attribute points.
** Rangers especially can put this skill to good use since expertise will reduce its cost.
b80bbaf377658f74c47a190e614e65cb43d9480e.text:
* 在 PvP 中，通常会对您希望保持在目标上的最有害状态（即失明、残废、茫然和深伤）使用掩护状态。由于条件的数量不成比例，因此该技能可以去除覆盖物和被覆盖的条件，而无需投入任何属性点。
** 游骑兵尤其可以充分利用这项技能，因为专业知识会降低其成本。

5a942e3bd5db408d4b38b857373c6074034b946e.source: Unlike most enchantments, Mental Block does not show a cloudy white ring around the caster.
5a942e3bd5db408d4b38b857373c6074034b946e.text: 与大多数结界不同，精神方块不会在施法者周围显示出浑浊的白色环。

db837c15e2a2c448f9bd2a8e441654ff46bbfbf8.source: anomaly: Unlike most enchantments, Mental Block does not show a cloudy white ring around the caster.
db837c15e2a2c448f9bd2a8e441654ff46bbfbf8.text: 异常：与大多数结界不同，精神方块在施法者周围不会显示出浑浊的白色环。

c5a9a9fb0dc32a80f5ec09517d72badd276f57f3.source:
* This spell won't fail if your target dies while you're casting it.
There is a short delay between the skill activation and the actual effect of this spell that is not stated in the description. This spell actually hits target foe's location one second after being activated (and doesn't compensate for the movement of the target), so the effect can be avoided with speed boosts (including the speed buff given to hostile NPCs in Hard mode).
c5a9a9fb0dc32a80f5ec09517d72badd276f57f3.text:
* 如果你的目标在你施法时死亡，这个法术不会失败。
技能启动和该法术的实际效果之间存在短暂的延迟，这一点在描述中并未说明。该法术实际上在激活后一秒就击中目标敌人的位置（并且不会补偿目标的移动），因此可以通过速度提升（包括在困难模式下给予敌对 NPC 的速度增益）来避免该效果。

b0d9d190b1e484cd1f51c0ec1e898915a529fbc3.source: anomaly: There is a short delay between the skill activation and the actual effect of this spell that is not stated in the description. This spell actually hits target foe's location one second after being activated (and doesn't compensate for the movement of the target), so the effect can be avoided with speed boosts (including the speed buff given to hostile NPCs in Hard mode).
b0d9d190b1e484cd1f51c0ec1e898915a529fbc3.text: 异常：技能启动与该法术实际效果之间存在描述中未说明的短暂延迟。该法术实际上在激活后一秒就击中目标敌人的位置（并且不会补偿目标的移动），因此可以通过速度提升（包括在困难模式下给予敌对 NPC 的速度增益）来避免该效果。

286404576236102956b797ff3665f5f728227115.source:
* Although there is immediate visual indication of rocks hitting the ground, the first damage and knock down event does not occur until 3 seconds after the spell has been cast.
** Since the earliest knock down occurs after the first 3 seconds, it is recommended that foes are snared when the spell is cast.
* If knock down length is increased to 3 seconds (from Earthbind or a Stonefist Insignia), then foes will either be knocked down two times with a 3 second delay, two times with a perfect quarterknock, or three times with two perfect quarterknocks.
* This is one of the few spells that makes full use of Glyph of Energy.
* Be wary of foes using this skill against your party, especially if it is composed of mostly henchmen and heroes, as they will all stand in approximately the range of the attack (unless you order them to move), devastating your party.
286404576236102956b797ff3665f5f728227115.text:
* 虽然有立即可见的岩石撞击地面的迹象，但第一次伤害和击倒事件直到施法后 3 秒才会发生。
** 由于最早的击倒发生在第一个 3 秒之后，因此建议在施放该法术时将敌人困住。
*如果击倒长度增加到3秒（来自地缚或石拳徽章），那么敌人将被击倒两次并延迟3秒，两次完美的四分之一敲击，或三次两次完美的四分之一敲击。
* 这是少数充分利用能量雕文的法术之一。
* 警惕使用此技能对付你的队伍的敌人，特别是当它主要由追随者和英雄组成时，因为他们都会站在大约攻击范围内（除非你命令他们移动），从而摧毁你的队伍。

398d7d32be63eeb486081d7ae6d4a255057f6cd2.source: * This skill requires exactly 160 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 6 strikes and 10 units.
398d7d32be63eeb486081d7ae6d4a255057f6cd2.text: * 该技能正好需要 160 单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此 6 次打击和 10 单位。

95cbe3662f735c7148ebaac31f09540209bb2aed.source: *Since this is an attack skill, the damage connects at half the listed activation time.
95cbe3662f735c7148ebaac31f09540209bb2aed.text: *由于这是攻击技能，因此伤害会在列出的激活时间的一半时产生。

692135ee35aeb9c439d5fa849e36af341b5a1ac3.source: * Useful for energy hiding: when you drop the ashes, your current and maximum energies both drop by 30; this can result in your current energy falling below zero.
692135ee35aeb9c439d5fa849e36af341b5a1ac3.text: *有助于能量隐藏：当你掉落骨灰时，你的当前能量和最大能量都会下降30；这可能会导致您当前的能量降至零以下。

bb1bc7cf3a705d9647095035d3d589c1c52f935d.source:
Similar to Deadly Paradox, Migraine does not affect attack skill activation times.
Monsters won't cast Migraine on you when at least five of your skills are recharging.
bb1bc7cf3a705d9647095035d3d589c1c52f935d.text:
与致命悖论类似，偏头痛不影响攻击技能的激活时间。
当你至少有五个技能正在充电时，怪物不会对你施放偏头痛。

65b68e1381d2468ed5a4dfa0932e5584f7bdc0d4.source: bug: Similar to Deadly Paradox, Migraine does not affect attack skill activation times.
65b68e1381d2468ed5a4dfa0932e5584f7bdc0d4.text: bug：与致命悖论类似，偏头痛不影响攻击技能的激活时间。

f3e0380a946d25ba839d3ffd40fc0b6cad5de6d3.source: anomaly: Monsters won't cast Migraine on you when at least five of your skills are recharging.
f3e0380a946d25ba839d3ffd40fc0b6cad5de6d3.text: 异常：当你至少有五个技能正在充电时，怪物不会对你施放偏头痛。

26dc2de1a71f52e0d01a27ca87f0cb8551374c2f.source:
* Temporarily swap to a high-energy set if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target.
* While Scorch Maulclaw (during The Dawn of Rebellion) has this skill, killing him will cause a cinematic to start instantly, which makes capturing Mind Blast impossible.
26dc2de1a71f52e0d01a27ca87f0cb8551374c2f.text:
* 如果您认为需要提升才能获得比目标更多的能量，请暂时更换为高能量套装。
* 虽然焦灼大槌（在叛乱黎明期间）拥有此技能，杀死他会导致过场动画立即开始，这使得捕获心灵震爆变得不可能。

d93b6b753a54595ba2c14d04dad447ebc0068133.source:
This skill checks the energy condition independently for each target hit.
* Temporarily swap to a high-energy set if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target.
* This skill can provide the longest burning condition of all skills.
d93b6b753a54595ba2c14d04dad447ebc0068133.text:
该技能独立检查每个击中目标的能量状况。
* 如果您认为需要提升才能获得比目标更多的能量，请暂时更换为高能量套装。
* 该技能可以提供所有技能中最长的燃烧条件。

e6624230a86eecc556cb6ce1ecc9e802db3046cd.source: anomaly: This skill checks the energy condition independently for each target hit.
e6624230a86eecc556cb6ce1ecc9e802db3046cd.text: 异常：该技能独立检查每个击中目标的能量状况。

bb8242aced6f1da30b8c1d95f58c10b866507073.source: * Temporarily swap to a high-energy set if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target.
bb8242aced6f1da30b8c1d95f58c10b866507073.text: * 如果您认为需要提升才能获得比目标更多的能量，请暂时更换为高能量套装。

88bead4746ff81da7e9ecccfba7bd627f346b389.source:
* Temporarily swap to a high-energy set if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target.
* Provided that the prerequisites for additional damage of the skills are met, Lightning Bolt, Lightning Hammer, and Lightning Orb deal the same amount of damage from Air Magic rank 14 to 16.
88bead4746ff81da7e9ecccfba7bd627f346b389.text:
* 如果您认为需要提升才能获得比目标更多的能量，请暂时更换为高能量套装。
* 在满足技能附加伤害的前提条件下，从气系魔法等级14到16，闪电箭、闪电锤、闪电球都会造成同等伤害。

18277b1d50a26210387f3b567bc6f70a03dbb48d.source:
* Temporarily swap to a high-energy set if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target. 
* Especially potent in environments with opportunities to clear exhaustion (flag running, splitting) and Random Arenas - since matches tend to be short, you'll often kill the other team or lose before exhausting out)
18277b1d50a26210387f3b567bc6f70a03dbb48d.text:
* 如果您认为需要提升才能获得比目标更多的能量，请暂时更换为高能量套装。 
* 在有机会清除疲惫的环境中特别有效（旗帜跑动，分裂）和随机竞技场 - 由于比赛往往很短，你经常会杀死另一支球队或在疲惫之前输掉）

f1908584bacc3a4271e6c4eb06c8ae6495c6e088.source:
* Mind Wrack only deals damage for the energy loss it causes, not for energy loss caused by other skills.
* Works well with Aneurysm because Mind Wrack causes energy loss and notifies you when the target has no energy, also adding damage to the spike.
* The target's energy must drop to 0 to trigger the effect. Energy lost while having less than 0 energy does not trigger Mind Wrack.
* This hex will end on the target if the caster dies.
f1908584bacc3a4271e6c4eb06c8ae6495c6e088.text:
* 心灵毁灭仅对其造成的能量损失造成伤害，不会对其他技能造成的能量损失造成伤害。
* 与动脉瘤配合良好，因为心灵毁灭会导致能量损失，并在目标没有能量时通知您，同时也会增加对尖刺的伤害。
* 目标能量必须降至0才能触发该效果。能量少于 0 时损失的能量不会触发心灵毁灭。
* 如果施法者死亡，这个六角形将在目标上结束。

24d9ec8733f50b4ed45ad22130548f283470df17.source:
* Works well with Aneurysm because Mind Wrack causes energy loss and notifies you when the target has no energy, also adding damage to the spike.
* The target's energy must drop to 0 to trigger the effect. Energy lost while having less than 0 energy does not trigger Mind Wrack.
* This hex will end on the target if the caster dies.
24d9ec8733f50b4ed45ad22130548f283470df17.text:
* 与动脉瘤配合良好，因为心灵毁灭会导致能量损失，并在目标没有能量时通知您，同时也会增加对尖刺的伤害。
* 目标能量必须降至0才能触发该效果。能量低于 0 时损失的能量不会触发心灵毁灭。
* 如果施法者死亡，这个六角形将在目标上结束。

18013da79f7861381c581ec39f9bbd9ba4b44c69.source: * This casting effect stacks multiplicatively with other modifiers, such as Fast Casting, weapon modifiers, or skills such as Holy Haste.
18013da79f7861381c581ec39f9bbd9ba4b44c69.text: * 此施法效果可与其他修饰符相乘叠加，例如快速施法、武器修饰符或神圣急速等技能。

e100ae9d6748e5497e05be28ea3eeded167b08a2.source:
With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), the only Dervish enchantments this skill's damage can trigger for are Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and Mirage Cloak itself. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Mirage Cloak (plus Mirage Cloak itself).
*This skill triggers itself when it ends.
*Pious Renewal synergizes with this skill because of its "recharge on end" effect.
The concise description omits that block chance is capped to 80%.
e100ae9d6748e5497e05be28ea3eeded167b08a2.text:
对于移除“所有结界”的技能（例如纯洁沉思），该技能的伤害可以触发的唯一苦行僧结界是荆棘光环、巴尔萨泽之怒、虔诚更新、尘斗篷、惊人之力、古兰斯手指和幻影斗篷本身。相比之下，如果特定数量的结界被移除（例如通过撕裂结界或苦行僧拆卸），则对于哪些苦行僧结界将触发伤害没有限制，只要它们覆盖幻影斗篷（加上幻影斗篷本身）即可。
*该技能结束时会自行触发。
*虔诚的更新因其“结束充电”效果而与该技能产生协同作用。
简洁的描述省略了区块机会的上限为 80%。

19b8bcfe3b24d4684f4964f74581b067b66b4d21.source: anomaly: With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), the only Dervish enchantments this skill's damage can trigger for are Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and Mirage Cloak itself. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Mirage Cloak (plus Mirage Cloak itself).
19b8bcfe3b24d4684f4964f74581b067b66b4d21.text: 异常：对于移除“所有结界”的技能（例如纯洁沉思），该技能的伤害可以触发的唯一苦行僧结界是荆棘光环、巴尔萨泽之怒、虔诚更新、尘斗篷、惊人之力、古兰斯手指和幻影斗篷本身。相比之下，如果特定数量的结界被移除（例如通过撕裂结界或苦行僧拆卸），则对于哪些苦行僧结界将触发伤害没有限制，只要它们覆盖幻影斗篷（加上幻影斗篷本身）即可。

b70489df17dba93dbfa39aab9a861003a3fb6afc.source: bug: The concise description omits that block chance is capped to 80%.
b70489df17dba93dbfa39aab9a861003a3fb6afc.text: bug：简洁的描述忽略了区块机会上限为 80%。

58b0936c46aabb1a279890240b5422b765fe034a.source:
* This skill can be used to remove enchantments from all of a minion master's minions (e.g. Death Nova or Jagged Bones), since the game treats them as a party.
* This skill can remove a doublecast enchantment from both the caster and its ally if they are members of the same party.
58b0936c46aabb1a279890240b5422b765fe034a.text:
* 此技能可用于移除小兵大师的所有小兵（例如死亡新星或锯齿状骨头）的结界，因为游戏将它们视为一支队伍。
* 如果施法者及其盟友是同一队伍的成员，此技能可以移除施法者及其盟友的双重施法结界。

06541027421a9675aa53f04b560842f1fb89a7c2.source:
* As with any doublecast skill, NPCs will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's area of effect range of an ally.
* Foes suffer two damage packets if the caster is targeted; the skill also recharges 50% faster (in effect, the second packet hits a hexed target, triggering the effect).
* As this is a Hex Spell that can target an ally, Holy Veil will double this skill's casting time when it is used on a target enchanted with it, despite the fact that this ally will not be hexed.
06541027421a9675aa53f04b560842f1fb89a7c2.text:
* 与任何双施技能一样，只要盟友的法术效果范围内有敌人，NPC 就会使用该技能。
* 如果施法者成为目标，敌人会受到两次伤害；该技能还可以更快地充能 50%（实际上，第二个数据包击中了六边形目标，触发了该效果）。
* 由于这是一个可以以盟友为目标的妖术法术，因此当对被它附魔的目标使用神圣面纱时，该技能的施法时间将加倍，尽管该盟友不会被妖术化。

8e9b86cef6be5e7e41bc8458d7dcd08cdf4bd3de.source:
* The copied stance uses the foe's attribute rank, so you get the same benefit.
* Stances are copied when the foe enters them while hexed; if multiple foes are hexed, you gain the most recently used one.
** However, it cannot copy monster skills, such as Turtle Shell or Battle Scars.
** Some stances can backfire on you, e.g. Frenzy or Primal Rage.
If the copied stance has an initial effect, the initial effect will not affect you. I.e. Bestial Fury/Tiger's Fury, Deadly Paradox, and Shadow Walk will not disable your skills; Shadow Walk will also not cause you to shadow step to a foe.
8e9b86cef6be5e7e41bc8458d7dcd08cdf4bd3de.text:
* 复制的姿势使用敌人的属性等级，因此您可以获得相同的好处。
* 当敌人在施咒时进入姿态时，姿态会被复制；如果多个敌人被施咒，您将获得最近使用过的一个。
** 但不能复制怪物技能，如龟甲、战痕等。
** 有些立场可能会适得其反，例如疯狂或原始愤怒。
如果复制的姿势有初始效果，则初始效果不会对你产生影响。 IE。野兽之怒/猛虎之怒、致命悖论和暗影行走不会使你的技能失效；暗影步也不会导致你对敌人进行暗影步。

1b506c6fb0e4edd6f53d213e69247c9a1d78e9fd.source: anomaly: If the copied stance has an initial effect, the initial effect will not affect you. I.e. Bestial Fury/Tiger's Fury, Deadly Paradox, and Shadow Walk will not disable your skills; Shadow Walk will also not cause you to shadow step to a foe.
1b506c6fb0e4edd6f53d213e69247c9a1d78e9fd.text: 异常：如果复制的姿势有初始效果，则初始效果不会对你产生影响。 IE。野兽之怒/猛虎之怒、致命悖论和暗影行走不会使你的技能失效；暗影步也不会导致你对敌人进行暗影步。

c1e1f54a130357b9ce28d9a5c99cd6301cd31614.source: * The amount of healing is based on the base costs of the spell, before modifiers like Glyph of Lesser Energy. Fractional amounts are always rounded down.
c1e1f54a130357b9ce28d9a5c99cd6301cd31614.text: * 治疗量基于法术的基本消耗，在诸如次级能量雕文之类的修正之前。小数部分始终向下舍入。

65d94608180896c633c4cae4077179c5f0f1d4f0.source:
*This spell's animation is similar to those of some Paragon skills like "Fall Back!" and Focused Anger, as well as the Ritualist skill Destructive Was Glaive.
*This hex works slightly different depending on whether or not the target is casting an enemy-targeting spell when this hex is first applied to them. If not, the effect will immediately trigger the next time the target tries to cast an enemy-targeting spell. If so, the effect will trigger upon the enemy-targeting spell finishing its activation (if the hex remains on them). 
*Note that since only directly enemy-targeting spells will be affected self-centered spells such as Shockwave will be unaffected. 

Mistrust will take effect if the hexed character attempts to cast a spell on any NPC hostile to them, including other foes. For example, in Varajar Fells, an Ice Imp's Maelstrom will fail if they attempt to cast it on a Modniir Hunter.
65d94608180896c633c4cae4077179c5f0f1d4f0.text:
*该法术的动画类似于一些Paragon技能的动画，例如“后退！”和集中愤怒，以及仪式技能“破坏性是利刃”。
*该降咒的工作原理略有不同，具体取决于目标首次应用该降咒时是否正在施放以敌人为目标的法术。如果没有，该效果将在目标下次尝试施放以敌人为目标的法术时立即触发。如果是这样，该效果将在以敌人为目标的法术完成激活时触发（如果降咒仍然留在他们身上）。 
*请注意，由于只有直接针对敌人的法术才会受到影响，因此以自我为中心的法术（例如冲击波）将不受影响。 

如果被施咒的角色试图对任何与他们敌对的 NPC（包括其他敌人）施展法术，不信任就会生效。例如，在瓦拉贾荒原中，如果冰小鬼的漩涡试图对莫尼尔猎人施放，就会失败。

c9efb7d5c3b3caba99a87a91d1e707f7995a7ba0.source: anomaly: Mistrust will take effect if the hexed character attempts to cast a spell on any NPC hostile to them, including other foes. For example, in Varajar Fells, an Ice Imp's Maelstrom will fail if they attempt to cast it on a Modniir Hunter.
c9efb7d5c3b3caba99a87a91d1e707f7995a7ba0.text: 异常：如果被施咒的角色试图对任何与他们敌对的 NPC（包括其他敌人）施展法术，则不信任将会生效。例如，在瓦拉贾荒原中，如果冰小鬼的漩涡试图对莫尼尔猎人施放，就会失败。

c70a4ff4537cf59f29c894763f46d8a6a053b404.source: The damage multiplier of 75% also applies to target foe.
c70a4ff4537cf59f29c894763f46d8a6a053b404.text: 75% 的伤害倍数也适用于目标敌人。

1177922e889d92fcd4cf33bbd848223f3d2588dc.source: bug: The damage multiplier of 75% also applies to target foe.
1177922e889d92fcd4cf33bbd848223f3d2588dc.text: bug：75% 的伤害倍数也适用于目标敌人。

dec896479e46ec68f90d319dad38ee47626dc07c.source:
* The health property is checked after the damage is dealt.
* This is the only off-hand attack that must follow a dual attack. As a result, it is very effective if you plan to use multiple dual skills since all dual attack skills except for Exhausting Assault must follow an off-hand attack.
** Can be rotated with Death Blossom for constant area of effect damage.
** Combines well with Horns of the Ox to keep lone, tough foes (such as many Dungeon end bosses) locked down. 
* Watari the Infinite is an ally, but getting him killed by enemies during the Redemption for the Lost quest allows you to capture the skill.
dec896479e46ec68f90d319dad38ee47626dc07c.text:
* 造成伤害后检查健康属性。
* 这是唯一必须在双重攻击之后进行的副手攻击。因此，如果您打算使用多个双技能，那么它会非常有效，因为除了精疲力尽之外的所有双攻击技能都必须在副手攻击之后进行。
** 可以与死亡之花一起旋转以获得恒定的效果伤害范围。
** 与牛角完美结合，锁定孤独、强硬的敌人（例如许多地下城最终 Boss）。 
* 无限渡是盟友，但在救赎失落者任务中让他被敌人杀死可以让你获得该技能。

a36495d39084896fadfdf7ae373a8e11b8dbc7d9.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Muddy Terrain.
* This skill cancels the natural Movement Speed bonus foes receive in Hard mode.
* The "non-spirit" part of the description is usually unneeded since most spirits cannot move anyway (see talk page).
a36495d39084896fadfdf7ae373a8e11b8dbc7d9.text:
* 该技能会创造泥地之灵。
* 该技能取消了敌人在困难模式下获得的自然移动速度加成。
* 描述中的“非灵魂”部分通常是不需要的，因为大多数灵魂无论如何都无法移动（参见讨论页）。

6874620b3e46934ce265e7e7a1fc294636123396.source:
*This spell has infinite range and affects all party members regardless of where they are in the instance.
*The caster is healed twice if they are enchanted.
*Combines well with AoE or party-wide enchantments, such as Aegis, Dwayna's Sorrow, and Orders build skills (among various others).
6874620b3e46934ce265e7e7a1fc294636123396.text:
*该法术具有无限范围，并且影响所有队伍成员，无论他们在实例中的哪个位置。
*如果施法者被附魔，他们会被治愈两次。
*与 AoE 或全党结界完美结合，例如神盾、德薇娜的悲伤和命令构建技能（以及其他各种技能）。

e063f8db15eb4980508b0499580476af01ad3447.source: *The healing effect has an infinite range, larger than party range.
e063f8db15eb4980508b0499580476af01ad3447.text: *治疗效果有无限范围，大于队伍范围。

bbf4e1ceb0344734f0e3cf6352d37dd7dfcf0113.source: * The maximum number of enchantments is capped at 8 (including Mystic Regeneration), not the maximum number (“pips”) of health regeneration caused by this spell.
bbf4e1ceb0344734f0e3cf6352d37dd7dfcf0113.text: * 结界的最大数量上限为 8（包括神秘再生），而不是该法术造成的生命再生的最大数量（“点”）。

9609ccffdc9291c04734482d2c583b18d4f664ea.source: * You gain health for each enemy you hit (either by auto attacks or attack skills). For example, if you hit 3 adjacent enemies with your scythe, and you gain 15 health per attack, you gain a maximum total of 45 health.
9609ccffdc9291c04734482d2c583b18d4f664ea.text: * 你击中的每个敌人都会获得生命值（通过自动攻击或攻击技能）。例如，如果您用镰刀击中 3 个相邻敌人，每次攻击获得 15 点生命值，则您最多获得 45 点生命值。

623b077fc5631905076c1d817d4548ba5b12163a.source: * Consider bringing this skill as a secondary Dervish on a profession that uses few enchantments, such as Warriors, Rangers and Paragons.
623b077fc5631905076c1d817d4548ba5b12163a.text: * 考虑将此技能作为辅助苦修士带到很少使用结界的职业，例如战士、游骑兵和典范。

3cb34ae2dee41aec32fb941ad7bea9652574dced.source:
{{speed|1|8|33|12}}
* This stance only ends when an enchantment or hex is cast on you while you are in the stance. Previously cast enchantments or hexes do not affect the duration (as in, the stance does not end instantly if entered while enchanted or hexed).
3cb34ae2dee41aec32fb941ad7bea9652574dced.text:
{{速度|1|8|33|12}}
*只有当你处于该姿势时对你施放结界或妖术时，该姿势才会结束。之前施放的结界或咒语不会影响持续时间（例如，如果在结界或咒语期间进入，姿态不会立即结束）。

383636f4b3b434367b221f782e17dc1b126e0f90.source: *This skill has no activation animation or sound.
383636f4b3b434367b221f782e17dc1b126e0f90.text: *该技能没有激活动画或声音。

1d362d2296838b617c613e8e8bd96aff8c31df5a.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Nature's Renewal.
* Combines well with Tranquility for an enchantment hostile environment; however, this combo has negligible effect on teardown-focused dervishes.
1d362d2296838b617c613e8e8bd96aff8c31df5a.text:
* 该技能会产生自然更新之灵。
* 与宁静完美结合，打造迷人的敌对环境；然而，这个组合对于专注于拆解的托钵僧来说影响微乎其微。

9f9cb60a12235e1ac7520f8def16c040aae78509.source:
* Synergizes with Tainted Flesh to negate the drawback of inflicting disease on yourself.
* This skill is mechanically the same as a shadow step.
* This skill is the only shadow step skill without a recharge time.
9f9cb60a12235e1ac7520f8def16c040aae78509.text:
* 与污染之肉协同作用，消除给自己带来疾病的缺点。
* 该技能在机制上与暗影步相同。
* 该技能是唯一一个没有充能时间的暗影步技能。

184f0f295eeeb1015da0dab9e3fc057241b7d46f.source:
* Deft Strike is not disabled by Needling Shot, making it the only attack skill that can be used with a bow immediately after Needling Shot disables other bow attack skills.

The regular description is incorrect in that the target does not have to be hit for the skill to recharge.
Both descriptions are incorrect in that only bow attack skills are disabled.
184f0f295eeeb1015da0dab9e3fc057241b7d46f.text:
* 灵巧打击不会被针刺射击禁用，这使得它成为唯一可以在针刺射击禁用其他弓攻击技能后立即与弓一起使用的攻击技能。

常规描述是不正确的，因为不一定要击中目标才能恢复技能。
这两种描述都是不正确的，因为只有弓攻击技能被禁用。

6cab208a4a458bc7ed2e77be8463a371333408df.source: anomaly: The regular description is incorrect in that the target does not have to be hit for the skill to recharge.
6cab208a4a458bc7ed2e77be8463a371333408df.text: 异常：常规描述不正确，因为技能不需要击中目标才能恢复。

bfc20780ef21cfd76e20689c2824f18c5178c8b7.source: bug: Both descriptions are incorrect in that only bow attack skills are disabled.
bfc20780ef21cfd76e20689c2824f18c5178c8b7.text: bug：两种描述都不正确，因为只有弓攻击技能被禁用。

9cf471f707f122bb3318840dcd6e53af42312a45.source: *This skill requires your pet to be alive to activate.
9cf471f707f122bb3318840dcd6e53af42312a45.text: *此技能需要您的宠物活着才能激活。

ff5851889dcf5a5bca0038aa358eeb0102b791e3.source:
* The amount of life stolen is not affected by the amount of damage you would have dealt.
** As a result, consider using this skill on allies that deal the least amount of attack damage if you want to minimize Nightmare Weapon's damage reduction. 
* Every hit is counted, but misses are not. For example, if a Barrage attack successfully strikes two foes, but misses four others, Nightmare Weapon would only lose two charges.
* Consider using with Dual Shot (commonly used in conjunction with Distracting Shot) and particularly Triple Shot for a spike.
ff5851889dcf5a5bca0038aa358eeb0102b791e3.text:
* 被偷走的生命值不受你造成的伤害量的影响。
** 因此，如果您想最大限度地减少梦魇武器的伤害减免，请考虑对造成最少攻击伤害的盟友使用此技能。 
* 每次击中都会被计算在内，但未击中则不会。例如，如果弹幕攻击成功击中两个敌人，但未击中另外四个敌人，则噩梦武器只会失去两次攻击。
* 考虑使用双重射击（通常与分散射击结合使用），特别是用于尖刺的三重射击。

229dbab72fb1662fd1aa607beb413f137e5440a7.source: * This skill is used by Ebon Vanguard Assassins summoned via Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support.

0cda2de386859f37ee6f3ac8d2aba826628d5851.source:
===Order of damage modifiers===
See: Order of damage modifiers
* Pain Inverter follows these general rules:
:* Damage dealt to the hexed foe is calculated before damage reduction effects such as Protective Spirit, but after the damage reduction from Armor of Salvation.
:* Does not apply to life draining skills such as Vampiric Bite.
:* Does not apply to Duncan's Defense or Shield of Fire.
:* Applies to passive damage skills such as Empathy, Backfire, or Clumsiness.
:* Applies to traps that cause direct damage, such as Spike Trap.
:* Applies to retaliation-based damage skills, e.g. Whirling Defense, Retribution, or Holy Wrath.

* The base damage is capped at 80, but there is no limit on total damage. Pain Inverter can deal more than 80 damage by using damage modifying skills, including Frenzy and the Lightbringer title.

===Game mechanics===
* Pain Inverter triggers multiple times if the hexed foe hits multiple targets; each time a creature is hit, the skill produces a separate packet of damage, each of which is capped at 80. This makes PI especially effective in these situations: 
:* Against high-damage area of effect (AoE) spells (base damage is capped at 80 per affected ally) — examples: Searing Flames and Earthquake.
:* Against damage over time (DoT) spells (base damage is capped at 80 per pulse) — examples: Searing Heat and Fire Storm. 
:* Against high-armor foes, especially bosses, since the damage ignores armor.
:* Against blocking skills that deal damage to attackers — examples: Whirling Defense, Flashing Blades, and Gladiator's Defense
:* Against foes using skills that generate extra packets of damage on attack — example: Ignite Arrows.

* An obvious way to take advantage of PI's mechanics is to provide the target with lots of fodder for AoE and DoT skills, e.g. by bringing minions, spirits, Asura Summons, Summoning Stones and/or animal companions.
0cda2de386859f37ee6f3ac8d2aba826628d5851.text:
===伤害调整值的顺序===
请参阅：伤害修正值的顺序
* 疼痛逆变器遵循以下一般规则：
：* 对被诅咒的敌人造成的伤害是在防护精神等伤害减免效果之前计算的，但在拯救之甲的伤害减免之后计算。
：*不适用于吸血技能，例如吸血鬼之咬。
：* 不适用于邓肯防御或火焰之盾。
：* 适用于被动伤害技能，例如同理心、逆火或笨拙。
：* 适用于造成直接伤害的陷阱，例如尖刺陷阱。
:* 适用于基于报复的伤害技能，例如旋转防御、惩戒或神圣愤怒。

* 基础伤害上限为80，但总伤害没有限制。痛苦反转器可以通过使用伤害修改技能（包括疯狂和光明使者称号）造成超过 80 点伤害。

===游戏机制===
* 如果施咒的敌人击中多个目标，疼痛反转器会多次触发；每次击中生物时，该技能都会产生一组单独的伤害，每个伤害的上限为 80。这使得 PI 在以下情况下特别有效： 
：*对抗高伤害范围（AoE）法术（每个受影响盟友的基础伤害上限为 80）——例如：灼热火焰和地震。
：*对抗持续伤害（DoT）法术（每个脉冲的基础伤害上限为 80）——例如：灼热热力和火焰风暴。 
：* 针对高护甲敌人，尤其是 Boss，因为伤害忽略护甲。
：*对抗对攻击者造成伤害的格挡技能 - 例如：旋转防御、闪烁之刃和角斗士防御
：* 使用在攻击时产生额外伤害的技能对抗敌人 - 例如：点燃箭。

* 利用 PI 机制的一个明显方法是为目标提供大量 AoE 和 DoT 技能素材，例如通过携带仆从、灵魂、阿修罗召唤、召唤石和/或动物伙伴。

* This skill will end prematurely if the caster dies.
* This skill works effectively as a cover hex due to its low energy cost, cool down, and fixed duration. The healing notably provides a visual cue to the user when it is removed. 
* It is best not to remove Parasitic Bond if it is the only hex you or an ally is suffering from, because of numerous factors: the health degeneration it causes is negligible, removing it will heal the caster, it can be reapplied once it is removed due to its short recharge time, and it will end automatically once the caster dies anyway.

71e4eb87e70e7376ae7c6e388cb79afa3e72d61e.text:
* 如果施法者死亡，该技能将提前结束。
* 由于其低能量消耗、冷却时间和固定持续时间，该技能可以有效地作为掩护六角形。当其被移除时，该愈合特别为用户提供了视觉提示。
