* A target enchanted with Peace and Harmony is at a disadvantage when being targeted by hexes with end effects that do not trigger if it is removed, since Peace and Harmony will cause their end effect to trigger earlier whereas removing the hex does not cause it to trigger. Similarly, they will cause conditions to expire faster, triggering Fragility more often.
Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.
870c56f18aabd8f12793088934241b5b500015e9.text:
* 该技能从条件开始交替移除条件和六角形。
* 被和平与和谐附魔的目标在被带有最终效果的六角形目标锁定时会处于劣势，而最终效果如果被移除则不会触发，因为和平与和谐会导致其最终效果提前触发，而移除六角形不会导致其触发。同样，它们会导致条件更快到期，更频繁地触发脆弱性。
与描述相反，和平与和谐不会导致条件和咒语更快过期 90%。相反，在结界期间应用的所有新条件和咒语的持续时间将减少 90%。

ebe31b0cd3d66dc63260452677ccc1157a3986fa.source: bug: Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.
ebe31b0cd3d66dc63260452677ccc1157a3986fa.text: bug：与描述相反，和平与和谐不会导致条件和六角形的过期速度加快 90%。相反，在结界期间应用的所有新条件和咒语的持续时间将减少 90%。

742c70f827ab973cf73a87a350b9cc1b12b98f3b.source: * Consider using against physicals who are frequently enchanted such as Dervishes and Assassins.
742c70f827ab973cf73a87a350b9cc1b12b98f3b.text: * 考虑对那些经常被附魔的物理生物使用，例如托钵僧和刺客。

a01b92e7fbf1b2fd75861c0508edbefd5f327688.source: * Interrupts that also disable skills (such as Psychic Distraction, Distracting Shot or Disrupting Lunge) will still disable spells cast under this enchantment.
a01b92e7fbf1b2fd75861c0508edbefd5f327688.text: * 也会禁用技能的中断（例如心灵分心、分心射击或扰乱冲刺）仍然会禁用在此结界下施展的法术。

bd16830d67f0d06aeefc9ed03930c1b15338a008.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Pestilence.
bd16830d67f0d06aeefc9ed03930c1b15338a008.text: * 该技能会产生瘟疫之灵。

f09483fdc53a04c7886311e3c0899c973a845c79.source: * Deep Wound can be applied earlier using Shatter Delusions or Drain Delusions.
f09483fdc53a04c7886311e3c0899c973a845c79.text: * 深层伤口可以提前使用粉碎妄想或排水妄想来应用。

69633b8ce5760cd209b780cd7d96415842370d2e.source:
* The projectile's arc is much higher than similar spells like Fireball.
* This spell will not fail if the target dies during its casting.
* The healing does not affect allied spirits.
* Useful when playing alongside a Minion Master or close combat professions, as they will benefit from the healing reliably if they're targeting the same enemy.
69633b8ce5760cd209b780cd7d96415842370d2e.text:
* 投射物的弧度远高于火球术等类似法术。
* 如果目标在施法过程中死亡，该法术不会失败。
* 治疗效果不会影响盟友的灵魂。
* 与小兵大师或近战职业一起玩时很有用，因为如果他们瞄准同一个敌人，他们将受益于可靠的治疗。

748acbdf4fd93d2fe8e80fd1804dbb8f03b38e59.source:
* In PvP, most physical damage characters carry an elemental damage weapon for use against Warriors (who often have less armor against elemental damage). This stance can be quite dangerous to use since, upon seeing it used, attackers can simply swap weapons.
* This skill is often used by Warriors when farming in the Underworld.
Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Physical Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against elemental damage, Physical Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
748acbdf4fd93d2fe8e80fd1804dbb8f03b38e59.text:
* 在 PvP 中，大多数物理伤害角色都携带元素伤害武器，用于对抗战士（他们通常拥有较少的防御元素伤害的护甲）。使用这种姿势可能非常危险，因为一旦看到它被使用，攻击者就可以简单地交换武器。
* 这个技能是战士在地狱耕种时经常使用的。
类似于裂甲，该技能不会将你的护甲等级降低到60以下，或者如果你的“核心”护甲等级低于60，则你的“核心”护甲等级不会降低。
如果你使用的技能或技能与效果的组合在减去物理抗性减值后仍然获得 +26 或更高的针对元素伤害的护甲等级，则物理抗性的护甲减值不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

fe76d576148dce3a9f41573d4c4d81c1c2cc40dd.source: bug: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Physical Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against elemental damage, Physical Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
fe76d576148dce3a9f41573d4c4d81c1c2cc40dd.text: bug：如果你使用的技能或技能和效果的组合，在减去物理抗性的惩罚后，仍然获得 +26 或更高的针对元素伤害的护甲等级，则物理抗性的护甲惩罚不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

5232f14d7607b9745a5056c59088b31fd598131f.source:
*There are no traps, nor any ranger skills, that apply cracked armor.
**Therefore, consider selectively laying Piercing Trap next to a foe that has just received cracked armor, either from a secondary profession skill or a fellow party member.
*Damage is dealt in two packets. First the trap is triggered and deals unconditional damage, then the second packet is dealt only to enemies who have cracked armor. If an enemy is in a Well of Ruin when the trap is triggered, the initial damage will inflict cracked armor, causing the bonus damage to trigger as well.
5232f14d7607b9745a5056c59088b31fd598131f.text:
*没有陷阱，也没有任何游侠技能，会应用破裂的盔甲。
**因此，请考虑有选择地将穿刺陷阱放置在刚刚收到裂纹盔甲的敌人旁边，无论是来自次要职业技能还是其他队员。
*损坏分为两包。首先陷阱被触发并造成无条件伤害，然后第二个数据包仅对装甲破裂的敌人造成。如果触发陷阱时敌人位于毁灭之井中，则初始伤害将造成护甲破裂，同时触发额外伤害。

6d238510355325b1e7ae7f36a57a8fa98c5ca8c8.source:
* The full description is incorrect: a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Pious Assault will recharge in 3 seconds, regardless of other effects (such as Diversion or Shield Bash).
6d238510355325b1e7ae7f36a57a8fa98c5ca8c8.text:
* 完整描述不正确：即使此攻击未能击中，苦行僧结界也会被移除。
只要使用者在尝试激活此技能时受到苦行僧结界的影响，虔诚突击就会在​​ 3 秒内重新充能，无论其他效果如何（例如转移或盾击）。

6a6e5bdbaac14a8ecd33be568662874d44894f76.source: anomaly: As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Pious Assault will recharge in 3 seconds, regardless of other effects (such as Diversion or Shield Bash).
6a6e5bdbaac14a8ecd33be568662874d44894f76.text: 异常：只要使用者在尝试激活该技能时受到苦修士结界的影响，虔诚突击就会在 3 秒内重新充能，无论其他效果如何（例如转移或盾击）。

6bf51c2ba7c0fb2de182e40e24483dd79ee0874b.source:
* Pious Concentration will negate at least one interrupt, even if you have no enchantments.
* Although this negates the interrupt part of Power Block, if PB hits a skill that'll still be disabled which means the skill is going to fail channeling at the last moment.
6bf51c2ba7c0fb2de182e40e24483dd79ee0874b.text:
* 虔诚的专注会消除至少一次中断，即使你没有结界。
* 虽然这会取消能量阻挡的中断部分，但如果PB击中技能，该技能仍然会被禁用，这意味着该技能将在最后一刻引导失败。

ad57cebda0ee48f915ccb6f6c562f346b3d102f8.source: * Hero AI will use this without regard for long-term beneficial enchantments like Intimidating Aura.
ad57cebda0ee48f915ccb6f6c562f346b3d102f8.text: *英雄AI将使用此功能，而不考虑长期有益的结界，例如威吓光环。

67d59e4346ebec0f6168b7cad2f5206a6e5576df.source:
If your Mysticism is at 0, the skill will still remove an enchantment but only give 25% move speed instead of 50%.
* Pious Haste's conditional speed boost is enough to allow a character to pass through and trigger a trap without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by 4.17...25...29.17% if used while enchanted with a Dervish enchantment every time it recharges.
** This stance can be maintained indefinitely under Dwarven Stability.
* Consider combining with Zealous Renewal.
67d59e4346ebec0f6168b7cad2f5206a6e5576df.text:
如果你的神秘主义为 0，该技能仍会移除结界，但仅提供 25% 移动速度，而不是 50%。
* 虔诚急速的有条件速度提升足以让角色通过并触发陷阱而不受影响。
* 如果在每次充能时被苦行僧结界附魔时使用该技能，则平均速度会增加 4.17...25...29.17%。
** 在矮人稳定状态下，该姿态可以无限期地保持。
* 考虑与热心更新相结合。

1002fb8c4c1dfbe8e01241b1cf73929a939f39d4.source: bug: If your Mysticism is at 0, the skill will still remove an enchantment but only give 25% move speed instead of 50%.
1002fb8c4c1dfbe8e01241b1cf73929a939f39d4.text: bug：如果你的神秘度为 0，该技能仍会移除结界，但仅提供 25% 移动速度，而不是 50%。

d2a9e03bf3100b80e31d6cc2c03fafdc2feb8035.source: * When combined with Grenth's Fingers, this skill potentially becomes an all-purpose self-heal.
d2a9e03bf3100b80e31d6cc2c03fafdc2feb8035.text: * 当与古兰斯之指结合使用时，该技能有可能成为万能的自我治疗。

c306c014af2e58704aab06879361b5802aa3f054.source:
* Combines well with skills that draw conditions to you, such as Foul Feast.
* This spell won't fail if your target dies while you are casting it, resulting in removal of conditions and health still being sacrificed.
c306c014af2e58704aab06879361b5802aa3f054.text:
* 与给你带来条件的技能很好地结合，例如肮脏的盛宴。
* 如果你的目标在你施放该法术时死亡，该法术不会失败，从而导致条件移除且生命值仍然被牺牲。

641ca94e35f92c0af7350a062498ef013e4d3b6c.source:
* Use Epidemic to spread the conditions from the target to adjacent targets.
* Synergy with skills which inflict conditions on oneself, especially those that draw conditions from allies to you, such as Foul Feast, Draw Conditions and Verata's Sacrifice.
* Primary PvP-only Necromancers will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on your account.
* The AI will not prioritize fleshy targets when using this skill to transfer bleeding (for instance using it on minions even if their master is in range).
641ca94e35f92c0af7350a062498ef013e4d3b6c.text:
* 使用流行病将疾病从目标传播到邻近目标。
* 与给自己造成条件的技能协同作用，特别是那些从盟友那里给你带来条件的技能，例如“恶俗盛宴”、“抽签条件”和“维拉塔的牺牲”。
* 初级 PvP 死灵法师将能够使用此技能，即使您的帐户未解锁该技能。
* 当使用此技能转移流血时，AI不会优先考虑肉质目标（例如对小兵使用它，即使他们的主人在范围内）。

d1204e19479b7b88b531fa1550968697fa86dd74.source:
* This is a very useful skill for melee, as they will often be within touch range of a foe and because it can remove blindness.
* This is a skill, not a spell, and is therefore unaffected by Dazed.
d1204e19479b7b88b531fa1550968697fa86dd74.text:
* 这对于近战来说是一个非常有用的技能，因为它们通常会在敌人的接触范围内，而且它可以消除失明。
* 这是一项技能，而不是法术，因此不受 Dazed 影响。

1d45f9088fec52bdf2a1b43bcdcff974792a21c4.source: * Like other bow attacks, this skill's range is affected by height and by the style of bow wielded.
1d45f9088fec52bdf2a1b43bcdcff974792a21c4.text: * 与其他弓箭攻击一样，该技能的射程受高度和所持弓箭风格的影响。

4c941ea3ff6548a1638452381fcc4486a5f11881.source:
*Apply Poison allows to spread poison more often and more importantly without taking the elite slot. Bring Poison Arrow only if you are planning on using another preparation.
* Poison Arrow and Quick Shot are tied for the lowest recharge of bow attack skills that don't remove a preparation, making them potentially effective to trigger the effects of anthems, songs and damage from Expert Focus.
4c941ea3ff6548a1638452381fcc4486a5f11881.text:
*应用毒药可以更频繁地传播毒药，更重要的是，无需占用精英位置。仅当您计划使用其他制剂时才携带毒箭。
*毒箭和快速射击与弓箭攻击技能的最低充能相关，不会移除准备工作，使它们有可能有效地触发圣歌、歌曲和专家专注造成的伤害的效果。

9d205674b6c56a4e44ebb79b70bfd75afb368e42.source:
* Only affects the nearest target when an attack hits multiple foes, e.g. using Barrage or with a Scythe.
* Unlike Nightmare Weapon, the unsuccessful attack (e.g. missed or obstructed) is counted and discharges the skill effect.
* The condition is applied after the strike, making it valuable as a cover condition for skills that apply more valuable conditions such as Cripple or Daze.
9d205674b6c56a4e44ebb79b70bfd75afb368e42.text:
* 当攻击击中多个敌人时，仅影响最近的目标，例如使用弹幕或镰刀。
* 与噩梦武器不同的是，不成功的攻击（例如未击中或受阻）会被计算并释放技能效果。
* 该条件在攻击后应用，使其成为应用更有价值条件（例如“跛行”或“发呆”）的技能的掩护条件。

e4fcd7a75a375c63a12b485347376555f1b5941e.text: * 与野兽撕咬的协同作用。

64c73487f84b6b2cf66695123246127362169c91.source:
* If Power Block interrupts a PvE-only skill or one without a linked attribute, only that skill will be disabled; the target will still be able to use other title-track or no attribute skills.
* Wastrel's Worry and Wastrel's Demise are good sources of unconditional damage during the period that Power Block disables skills, especially against single-attribute builds (e.g. nukers).
* Power Block will extend the recharge time of skills with a shorter disable/recharge time (skills with a longer downtime will not be affected).
* Disables skills even if interruption is prevented.
64c73487f84b6b2cf66695123246127362169c91.text:
* 如果能量块打断了仅限 PvE 的技能或没有链接属性的技能，则只有该技能将被禁用；目标仍然能够使用其他标题曲目或无属性技能。
* 废人的忧虑和废人的灭亡是在能量格挡禁用技能期间无条件伤害的良好来源，特别是针对单属性构建（例如核弹）。
* 能量封锁会延长禁用/充能时间较短的技能的充能时间（停机时间较长的技能不受影响）。
* 即使阻止中断，也会禁用技能。

26a488c158099b3c6c2ed3e87f270ea127166a4e.source:
* The hex will apply even if the interruption effect is prevented.
* This skill causes a net energy loss of 2.67...6...6.67 if it lasts its full duration.
26a488c158099b3c6c2ed3e87f270ea127166a4e.text:
* 即使阻止了中断效果，降咒也将适用。
* 如果该技能持续完整持续时间，则会导致 2.67...6...6.67 的净能量损失。

a743a708d78f8454783ce821055ce4f874d6bc89.source: * Energy loss will still occur on a target even if the interruption effect is prevented.
a743a708d78f8454783ce821055ce4f874d6bc89.text: * 即使阻止了干扰效果，目标上仍然会发生能量损失。

e9833b07ab27b015fae175392385d548007ac7bc.source: * The hex effect will be applied even if the interruption is prevented.
e9833b07ab27b015fae175392385d548007ac7bc.text: * 即使中断被阻止，降咒效果也会应用。

57ab2919b59c7591fec998dbb4ffa033b5e10561.source: * Disables skills even if interruption is prevented.
57ab2919b59c7591fec998dbb4ffa033b5e10561.text: * 即使阻止中断，也会禁用技能。

0e6ad63c5b869c3fa1b202169b155bdc1439f927.source: * Gives energy to a target even if the interruption effect is prevented.
0e6ad63c5b869c3fa1b202169b155bdc1439f927.text: * 即使中断效果被阻止，也会向目标提供能量。

a5f959115365deecebf6e77bcba8c4015f87409c.source:
* Penetrating Attack/Sundering Attack will deal more damage to targets with an armor rating below 80.
* Power Shot isn't taught by the quest Choose Your Secondary Profession, it needs to be learned from Rakanja before starting that quest.
a5f959115365deecebf6e77bcba8c4015f87409c.text:
* 穿透攻击/破甲攻击会对护甲等级低于 80 的目标造成更多伤害。
* 强力射击不是由任务“选择你的次要职业”教授的，它需要在开始该任务之前从 Rakanja 那里学习。

8450c46b2de10a771848eb4a68bca7b4ddabd4d7.source: * Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.
8450c46b2de10a771848eb4a68bca7b4ddabd4d7.text: * 即使阻止中断，也会造成损坏。

8fb66317019d62bf31ea867ba3dcd892365021e2.source:
* If a preparation is activated while under the effect of this stance, the preparation will still benefit if this stance ends before you finish activation.
* The only non-elite preparations with a shorter duration than recharge are Rapid Fire (if Marksmanship is below 5), Choking Gas, and Seeking Arrows.
8fb66317019d62bf31ea867ba3dcd892365021e2.text:
* 如果在该姿势的效果下启动准备工作，则在启动完成之前结束该姿势的情况下，该准备工作仍然会受益。
* 唯一持续时间比充能时间更短的非精英准备是速射（如果射击技能低于 5）、窒息毒气和寻找箭。

5a2bbfb4ebe34c61663fb26c781676948c65c6aa.source: * The activation time of attack skills with a fixed activation time is actually half the listed amount, so Precision Shot's is actually 0.5 second.
5a2bbfb4ebe34c61663fb26c781676948c65c6aa.text: * 固定启动时间的攻击技能的启动时间实际上是列出的一半，因此精确射击的实际启动时间是0.5秒。

fd047b2f2456c8c3627b11b1339c0e062cac8eea.source:
* The health gain only occurs on a successful hit. Consider combining with Otyugh's Cry.
* The attack speed boost can help to land time sensitive pet attacks (Disrupting Lunge or Bestial Pounce, for example).
* This skill can be used when your pet is dead.
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
fd047b2f2456c8c3627b11b1339c0e062cac8eea.text:
* 健康增益仅在成功命中时才会发生。考虑与奥图格的哭泣结合起来。
* 攻击速度提升有助于对时间敏感的宠物进行攻击（例如破坏性突刺或野兽猛扑）。
* 该技能可以在宠物死亡时使用。
与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

02d295ec01757acafb6a455f99e948984fb1efc5.source:
*The health gain only occurs on a successful hit. Consider combining with Otyugh's Cry and Feral Aggression.
*This skill can be used when your pet is dead.
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
02d295ec01757acafb6a455f99e948984fb1efc5.text:
*仅在成功击中时才会获得生命值。考虑与奥图格的哭泣和野性侵略结合起来。
*该技能可以在宠物死亡时使用。
与描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

fcd9b0e218cbdb772dbe077e96e20621b11ca387.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Predatory Season.
* Synergizes well with scythes or attack skills that can deal multiple attacks.
* This skill does not reduce the effectiveness of life stealing, health regeneration or health gain, which can be used to circumvent the reduced healing.
fcd9b0e218cbdb772dbe077e96e20621b11ca387.text:
* 该技能会创造掠夺季节之魂。
* 与镰刀或攻击技能很好地协同作用，可以造成多重攻击。
* 该技能不会降低生命偷取、生命再生或生命增益的效果，可用于规避治疗效果的降低。

1bfa35642d8fb2d10a29695d732970720516c6d9.source:
* The energy loss can be split between multiple characters maintaining the same enchantment on one character. Two characters with 8 Protection Prayers will each lose 2 energy per hit. Three characters at 13 Protection Prayers will each only lose 1 energy per hit. Two characters at 13 Protection Prayers will lose 2 and 1 energy, respectively. The first to cast takes the larger energy burden on an odd split. If characters are at differing attribute ranks of Protection Prayers, the lowest rank is used.
**If the enchantment is split up so that each bonder will lose 1 energy, then each of the bonders can cast Life Bond on the character that is the target of Protective Bond, and then Balthazar's Spirit on themselves to cover all of the energy cost, and maintain Protective Bond as long as it isn't stripped. However, Life Bond only splits up damage from attacks, so 1 energy will still be lost for each packet of damage from non-attack damage. As long as the non-attack damage isn't reduced to zero, 1 energy can usually still be gained from Essence Bond.
* If more than one character is maintaining this enchantment and one character runs out of energy, all other characters stop maintaining the enchantment.
1bfa35642d8fb2d10a29695d732970720516c6d9.text:
* 能量损失可以在多个角色之间分配，并在一个角色上保持相同的魔力。两个拥有 8 个保护祈祷的角色每次攻击都会损失 2 点能量。进行 13 保护祈祷的三个角色每次击中只会损失 1 能量。进行 13 保护祈祷的两个角色将分别损失 2 和 1 能量。第一个施法的人在奇数分裂中承担更大的能量负担。如果角色的护佑祈愿属性等级不同，则使用最低等级。
**如果结界被分开，每个束缚者都会损失 1 能量，那么每个束缚者都可以对保护束缚的目标角色施放生命束缚，然后对自己施展巴尔萨泽之灵以覆盖所有能量消耗，并在保护束缚不被剥夺的情况下保持保护束缚。然而，生命羁绊只会分割攻击造成的伤害，因此每包非攻击伤害仍然会损失 1 点能量。只要非攻击伤害没有降为零，通常仍然可以从精华纽带中获得1点能量。
* 如果有多个角色维持此结界，且其中一个角色耗尽能量，则所有其他角色将停止维持此结界。

f6f7f737a84bbd1d6bc269327ded47f5621eb1df.source:
* This skill is the base for all 55 Monk builds.
* Spirit Bond and Protective Spirit stack to great effect. Even if Protective Spirit would reduce damage taken to below 50, as long as the initial damage (before reduction from Protective Spirit) is above 50, Spirit Bond will still take effect. This is the basis for the "600" monk in the 600/smite team used for farming.
* The concise description is more accurate than the verbose one: damage from signets and traps for example will also be reduced.
* Life stealing and health loss is not reduced.
f6f7f737a84bbd1d6bc269327ded47f5621eb1df.text:
* 此技能是所有 55 武僧版本的基础。
* 精神羁绊与守护精神叠加效果极佳。即使防护精神会减少受到的伤害到50以下，只要初始伤害（防护精神减少之前）在50以上，精神束缚仍然会生效。这是600/smite团队中用于耕种的“600”武僧的基础。
* 简洁的描述比冗长的描述更准确：例如印章和陷阱造成的伤害也会减少。
* 生命偷取和健康损失不会减少。

738420749dd901a68116eb23ef9c44eb52059a9e.source:
* Precast this item spell to gain reduced damage provided by the additional armor rating and drop the ashes to use as an emergency Heal Party or when energy is low to regain the benefits from your weapon set.
* Can be maintained indefinitely by re-casting the spell while still holding the ashes to retain the additional armor rating while providing a steady stream of party healing.
* Requires care when facing Soul Bind or Scourge Healing as once the item spell has been cast, the party heal cannot be stopped.
* Combines well with Herald's Insignia for an extra +10 armor rating.
** When used together these two effects provide +30 armor rating, which reduces armor-respecting damage by 41%.
738420749dd901a68116eb23ef9c44eb52059a9e.text:
* 预先施放此物品法术，以减少额外护甲等级带来的伤害，并掉落灰烬以用作紧急治疗小组，或在能量较低时重新获得武器组的好处。
* 可以通过重新施放法术来无限期地维持，同时仍然保持骨灰以保留额外的护甲等级，同时提供稳定的队伍治疗流。
* 面对灵魂束缚或天灾治疗时需要小心，因为一旦施展物品法术，队伍治疗就无法停止。
* 与先驱者徽章完美结合，可获得额外的 +10 护甲等级。
** 当一起使用时，这两种效果可提供 +30 护甲等级，从而减少 41% 护甲伤害。

966fe2fdceb446283ce1eab00b25108027eb1375.source:
* During the duration, any allies adjacent to the user are affected. It disappears and reapplies if they leave and come back.
* Although moving ends the effect, shadow stepping and teleporting do not.
* This is the only skill that can provide allied spirits a chance to block, allowing some synergy with Summon Spirits as it moves all of your spirits to adjacent range around you.
The user is affected.
Although it has no activation time, it acts like it has one (gets queued, pauses the user, cannot be used while knocked down, etc).
966fe2fdceb446283ce1eab00b25108027eb1375.text:
* 持续时间内，与使用者相邻的所有盟友都会受到影响。如果他们离开并回来，它就会消失并重新应用。
* 虽然移动会结束该效果，但暗影踏步和传送却不会。
* 这是唯一可以为友方灵魂提供格挡机会的技能，可以与召唤灵魂产生一定的协同作用，因为它将你所有的灵魂移动到你周围的邻近范围。
用户受到影响。
尽管它没有激活时间，但它的行为就像有激活时间一样（排队、暂停用户、在被击倒时无法使用等）。

7a57a457e7276a31f6ed538dcec2b07adc9f73b7.source: anomaly: Although it has no activation time, it acts like it has one (gets queued, pauses the user, cannot be used while knocked down, etc).
7a57a457e7276a31f6ed538dcec2b07adc9f73b7.text: 异常：虽然它没有激活时间，但它的行为就像有激活时间一样（排队、暂停用户、被击倒时无法使用等）。

aec2a4ff9c2fdccaa22bac6f3433e7c25ea0b357.source:
* During the duration, any allies adjacent to the user are affected. It disappears and reapplies if they leave and come back.
* Although moving ends the effect, shadow stepping and teleporting do not.
* This is the only skill that can provide allied spirits a chance to block, allowing some synergy with Summon Spirits as it moves all of your spirits to adjacent range around you.
* This skill is on the restricted list for the Codex Arena.
The user is affected.
Although it has no activation time, it acts like it has one (gets queued, pauses the user, cannot be used while knocked down, etc).
aec2a4ff9c2fdccaa22bac6f3433e7c25ea0b357.text:
* 持续时间内，与使用者相邻的所有盟友都会受到影响。如果他们离开并回来，它就会消失并重新应用。
* 虽然移动会结束该效果，但暗影踏步和传送却不会。
* 这是唯一可以为友方灵魂提供格挡机会的技能，可以与召唤灵魂产生一定的协同作用，因为它将你所有的灵魂移动到你周围的邻近范围。
* 该技能在 Codex Arena 的限制列表中。
用户受到影响。
尽管它没有激活时间，但它的行为就像有激活时间一样（排队、暂停用户、在被击倒时无法使用等）。

ac19d4ca9d0ddac37e3f0a4f97368d3a22beb579.source:
* Psychic Distraction has the fastest recharge time of all interrupt skills in the game. 
* This skill bypasses anti-interruption skills such as Mantra of Resolve, as the skill will still be disabled and so will not complete casting.
Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the skill to become disabled.
ac19d4ca9d0ddac37e3f0a4f97368d3a22beb579.text:
* 心灵分心是游戏中所有中断技能中恢复时间最快的。 
* 该技能绕过了诸如决心真言之类的反干扰技能，因为该技能仍然会被禁用，因此不会完成施法。
与简洁的描述相反，中断不需要成功即可使技能被禁用。

1bb5cba7b792f648ece2fe36b92e76aa7bab2c6d.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the skill to become disabled.
1bb5cba7b792f648ece2fe36b92e76aa7bab2c6d.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，中断不需要成功即可使技能禁用。

7f28433fb49ced768721d788bde4e0db9b48b354.source:
* Can permanently keep a group of foes on the ground in PvE if using at least 19 in Fast Casting (reachable via Heroic Refrain) under Quickening Zephyr, assuming the user manages to succesfully interrupt the first skill the mob uses every time they recover from the knockdown.
* The knockdown will not occur if the interruption is prevented.
7f28433fb49ced768721d788bde4e0db9b48b354.text:
*如果在加速和风下使用至少19的快速施法（可通过英雄副歌达到），则可以在PvE中永久地将一群敌人留在地面上，假设用户每次成功地打断暴民从击倒中恢复时使用的第一个技能。
* 如果阻止中断，则不会发生击倒。

4b6ff038b0d274398017144e70d682a9600f0ea2.source: * The knockdown will not occur if the interruption is prevented.
4b6ff038b0d274398017144e70d682a9600f0ea2.text: * 如果阻止中断，则不会发生击倒。

995e0726c74a82c80ba756c6cdf72fc6cc958e5b.source: * AI will use this for the damage and not the interrupt.
995e0726c74a82c80ba756c6cdf72fc6cc958e5b.text: * AI将使用它来造成伤害而不是打断。

f165b226df99b1711a54f0f65ae4270f2aa5615f.source: * Condition length reduction stacks with Recovery.
f165b226df99b1711a54f0f65ae4270f2aa5615f.text: * 条件长度减少与恢复叠加。

adf37a7707bff980fec752e1085571ac314c9e6b.source:
* To minimize the potential for massive energy loss, this skill is often used in combination with an energy hiding weapon set.
* Consider using Ether Signet immediately after using this skill.
adf37a7707bff980fec752e1085571ac314c9e6b.text:
* 为了最大限度地减少大量能量损失的可能性，该技能通常与能量隐藏武器组结合使用。
* 使用此技能后考虑立即使用以太印章。

28c8e94ab83c1c3c46d012bb6bad8fc66ed9b380.source:
*Good synergy with "Dodge This!", "Go for the Eyes!" and "The Power Is Yours!".
*When using shouts or chants that end when using an attack skill, Purifying Finale will remove a condition :
** After the next attack if "Find Their Weakness!", Anthem of Envy or Anthem of Flame ends. 
** Before the next attack if "Go for the Eyes!", Anthem of Weariness or Anthem of Disruption ends.
28c8e94ab83c1c3c46d012bb6bad8fc66ed9b380.text:
*与“Dodge This!”、“Go for the Eyes!”有良好的协同作用和“力量是你的！”。
*当使用攻击技能时使用结束的喊叫或吟唱时，净化结局将消除一个条件：
** 在下一次攻击后，如果“找到他们的弱点！”，嫉妒之歌或火焰之歌结束。 
** 在下一次攻击之前，如果“Go for the Eyes！”，疲倦之歌或破坏之歌结束。

954627ca8497ca7ad7b69d146f2af1a1338def98.source: * This skill has a Smiting Prayers animation and sound while it is in Protection Prayers, because it originally was in the Smiting Prayers line.
954627ca8497ca7ad7b69d146f2af1a1338def98.text: * 该技能在保护祈祷中时具有打击祈祷动画和声音，因为它最初属于打击祈祷系列。

26f4df72aba08a91898e360e69c784eb16138ad4.source: * Consider combining with Icy Veins and Putrid Explosion for a great amount of damage upon death.
26f4df72aba08a91898e360e69c784eb16138ad4.text: * 考虑与冰冷静脉和腐烂爆炸结合使用，在死亡时造成大量伤害。

1302184c709485acb03f1b6db703700b39f2319b.source:
*AI activates this skill as soon as at least one target is within range of the nearest corpse.
*Heroes will only target allies with this spell, not foes.
1302184c709485acb03f1b6db703700b39f2319b.text:
*只要至少一个目标位于最近尸体的范围内，AI就会激活该技能。
*英雄只会用此法术瞄准盟友，而不是敌人。

fa4a1b6f4f82a40a39ec0009eae35e18e82838c7.text: * 与死亡新星的巨大协同作用。

d3b17799ce924520a7d211e82a2d0771eda0ad1b.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Quickening Zephyr.
* The cost increase occurs at the beginning of the activation of a skill, while the recharge reduction occurs at the end.
* Recharge times are rounded half to even.
* The reduced recharge stacks multiplicatively with Fast Casting in PvE, for up to 74% recharge time reduction for Mesmer spells.
* Quickening Zephyr can reduce its own recharge time from rank 10 onwards, if cast while under its own effect.
* The energy skill cost is rounded half to even. The following table shows the energy skill cost increases in the presence of a Quickening Zephyr:
:{| {{STDT}}
|- align="center" style="background:lightgray;"
!Base cost 
! width="12px"| 1 || width="12px"| 5 || width="12px"| 10 || width="12px"| 15 || width="12px"| 25
|- align="center"
|Increase
| 0 || 1 || 3 || 5 || 7
|- align="center"
|Total cost
| 1 || 6 || 13 || 20 || 32
|}
* Quickening Zephyr will ignore recharge increasing effects like Energizing Wind if it's cast first.
d3b17799ce924520a7d211e82a2d0771eda0ad1b.text:
* 该技能会创造出加速和风之灵。
* 费用增加发生在技能发动初期，充值减少发生在技能发动结束时。
* 充电时间四舍五入为偶数。
* 减少的充能时间与 PvE 中的快速施法相乘，使幻术师法术的充能时间减少最多 74% 次。
* 如果在其自身效果下施放，加速和风可以从等级 10 开始减少其自身的充能时间。
* 能量技能消耗四舍五入为偶数。下表显示了存在加速和风时能量技能成本的增加：
:{| {{标准DT}}
|-align=“中心”样式=“背景：浅灰色；”
!基本成本 
！宽度=“12px”| 1 ||宽度=“12px”| 5 ||宽度=“12px”| 10 ||宽度=“12px”| 15 ||宽度=“12px”| 25
|- 对齐=“中心”
|增加
| 0 || 1 || 3 || 5 || 7
|- 对齐=“中心”
|总成本
| 1 || 6 || 13 || 20 || 32
|}
* 如果先施放的话，加速和风将忽略充能增加效果，例如能量之风。

1205d2357aee61ef66f7f3dcdd5ac5a49836b918.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Quicksand.
* Attack Skills will trigger this spirit's effect twice.
* This is the only elite Nature Ritual that has a 30 second recharge time; all others have a 15 second recharge time.
* Great synergy with Famine.
* This skill will trigger more often against foes using IAS or hexed with Reckless Haste.
* Combines well with Quickening Zephyr for an energy hostile environment.
1205d2357aee61ef66f7f3dcdd5ac5a49836b918.text:
* 该技能创造流沙之灵。
* 攻击技能会触发该战魂的效果两次。
* 这是唯一具有30秒充能时间的精英自然仪式；其他的都有15秒的充值时间。
* 与饥荒的巨大协同作用。
* 此技能在对抗使用 IAS 或使用鲁莽急速施咒的敌人时会更频繁地触发。
* 与 Quickening Zephyr 完美结合，适用于能源恶劣的环境。

5e02e757f5a8ce04e6be17f72332c2d99fd67828.source: *In PvE, consider using area of effect skills that cause scatter to force foes to move.
5e02e757f5a8ce04e6be17f72332c2d99fd67828.text: *在 PvE 中，考虑使用造成分散的区域效果技能来迫使敌人移动。

df48274003ca561cc82e68bd9bd3f66547c19f75.source: Despite the phrasing of the full description, the energy gain occurs even if the attack fails to hit (as correctly noted in the concise description).
df48274003ca561cc82e68bd9bd3f66547c19f75.text: 尽管有完整描述的措辞，但即使攻击未能命中，能量增益也会发生（正如简明描述中正确指出的那样）。

1a68290402571173ef15a997d37744df6d946437.source: bug: Despite the phrasing of the full description, the energy gain occurs even if the attack fails to hit (as correctly noted in the concise description).
1a68290402571173ef15a997d37744df6d946437.text: bug：尽管有完整描述的措辞，即使攻击未能命中（正如简明描述中正确指出的那样）也会发生能量增益。

9cf51bc949a536af24aff08632499c99fb38c2ac.source:
* This is one of the few skills that can cause maximum health degeneration on its own, by generating a field around foes diseased by a previous field.
* Does not affect spirits.
9cf51bc949a536af24aff08632499c99fb38c2ac.text:
* 这是为数不多的能够自行导致最大生命值退化的技能之一，它可以在因前一个场而患病的敌人周围产生一个场。
* 不影响精神。

0aa6810e08e916d219a949b0b9c1113091c10e16.source:
* The 3-second recharge listed is in addition to any recharge the skill affected may already have had.
* Heroes won't use this skill on their own.
0aa6810e08e916d219a949b0b9c1113091c10e16.text:
* 列出的 3 秒充能是在受影响的技能可能已经拥有的任何充能之外的。
* 英雄不会单独使用该技能。

6b6abb6ad6efcd838582260a2342e52172d1ed53.source: bug: The full description omits that this skill needs your pet to be alive to activate.
6b6abb6ad6efcd838582260a2342e52172d1ed53.text: bug：完整的描述省略了该技能需要你的宠物活着才能激活。

00e6fba04ec516b21be7a0318f5e506f95c1a0e6.source:
*When you activate this skill, all Upkeep Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
*For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use Totem of Man as it is recharging.
*When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Raven Blessing starts recharging.
*Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
00e6fba04ec516b21be7a0318f5e506f95c1a0e6.text:
*当您激活此技能时，您所维护的所有维持结界都将被移除。
*在前 30 秒内，无法使用人类图腾，因为它正在充电。
*祝福结束后，你会恢复原来的技能条，乌鸦祝福开始充能。
*由于此祝福和所有相关技能不需要使用武器，因此可以在携带包裹时使用。
虽然被归类为形态，但施法者的外观不会改变。

b5f7d835379ed5c43b3fcbfeb65e967751d8fc20.source: anomaly: Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
b5f7d835379ed5c43b3fcbfeb65e967751d8fc20.text: 异常：虽然被归类为形态，但施法者的外观不会改变。

326a13583999dcc530f2d4d94ff3416dd5ad4f02.source:
* Burning is refreshed every second that Ray of Judgment is active, e.g. a stationary target might burn as long as 7 seconds from a ray cast with a Smiting Prayers rank of 12 to 18.

Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.
326a13583999dcc530f2d4d94ff3416dd5ad4f02.text:
* 审判之光激活时每秒都会刷新燃烧，例如一个静止的目标可能会因重击祈祷等级为 12 到 18 的射线投射而燃烧长达 7 秒。

与其他反复出现的地面 AOE 技能不同，AI 单位通常不会在效果快要过期之前尝试离开。

87fbb3bbd9245a8bb9c4f22003f710fef63234e8.source: anomaly: Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.
87fbb3bbd9245a8bb9c4f22003f710fef63234e8.text: 异常：与其他反复出现的地面 AOE 技能不同，AI 单位通常不会在效果即将过期之前尝试离开。

542f5e1b6a6e601a236b859164bccd7820d13215.source:
* This skill sets a single flight time and arc for standard arrows fired from any bow:
** All standard arrows travel at the same (faster) rate and fly nearly parallel to the ground.
Some bow attack skills with a modified flight time or arc ignore the effect of Read the Wind on their flight time and arc but still benefit from the bonus damage, e.g. Broad Head Arrow and Called Shot. Quick Shot and Arcing Shot are exceptions to this.
* When used in conjunction with Favorable Winds, the bonus damage stacks. Arrow arc reduction and speed increase only stack when Favorable Winds is applied last.
** Read the Wind is a slightly better choice for Flatbows, since it lowers arc more, making it less likely that foes will dodge.
542f5e1b6a6e601a236b859164bccd7820d13215.text:
* 该技能为任何弓射出的标准箭设置单次飞行时间和弧度：
** 所有标准箭头都以相同（更快）的速度行进，并且几乎平行于地面飞行。
一些修改了飞行时间或弧度的弓攻击技能会忽略读风对其飞行时间和弧度的影响，但仍然受益于额外伤害，例如宽头箭头和呼叫射击。快速射击和弧线射击是例外。
* 当与顺风结合使用时，额外伤害会叠加。箭弧减少和速度增加仅在最后应用顺风时叠加。
** 读风对于平弓来说是一个稍微更好的选择，因为它可以降低更多的弧度，从而减少敌人躲避的可能性。

d497882b1da592589f746833329c832a9c1d46a3.source: anomaly: Some bow attack skills with a modified flight time or arc ignore the effect of Read the Wind on their flight time and arc but still benefit from the bonus damage, e.g. Broad Head Arrow and Called Shot. Quick Shot and Arcing Shot are exceptions to this.
d497882b1da592589f746833329c832a9c1d46a3.text: 异常：一些修改了飞行时间或弧度的弓攻击技能忽略了读风对其飞行时间和弧度的影响，但仍然受益于额外伤害，例如宽头箭头和呼叫射击。快速射击和弧线射击是例外。

cd5e8bb56324b36a9ed2d0d70b646c7478cc133b.source:
* This skill significantly reduces both the arc and flight time of arrows for all bow types and sets them equal to one another. Under Read the Wind, arrows fly at the same arc and speed regardless of the type of bow they are fired from. 

* This skill does not change the modified arc or flight times from certain arc-changing bow attack skills, such as Broad Head Arrow, Needling Shot, Quick Shot, etc. These skills ignore the effect of Read the Wind. Arcing Shot, however, does have its arc significantly reduced.

* The arrow speed enhancing effect of this skill does not stack with Favorable Winds. Favorable Winds will still provide additional damage; however, the flight of the arrow remains the same as Read the Wind by itself.
cd5e8bb56324b36a9ed2d0d70b646c7478cc133b.text:
* 此技能显着减少所有弓类型的箭的弧度和飞行时间，并使它们彼此相等。在“读风”下，无论用哪种类型的弓发射，箭都会以相同的弧度和速度飞行。 

* 该技能不会改变某些变弧弓攻击技能的修改弧度或飞行时间，例如宽头箭、针射、快速射击等。这些技能无视读风效果。然而，电弧射击的弧度确实显着减少。

* 该技能的箭速提升效果不与顺风叠加。顺风仍会造成额外伤害；然而，箭的飞行与读风本身相同。

41a71fa0f6523de44e23efa712023fa5c1f59e4a.source:
* The holy damage is applied only to adjacent foes (not to the target).
* This skill is extremely effective with Fragility and skills that inflict conditions (such as Apply Poison or Sneak Attack).
The holy damage is dealt to other foes adjacent to yourself, not adjacent to the target.
41a71fa0f6523de44e23efa712023fa5c1f59e4a.text:
* 神圣伤害仅适用于邻近的敌人（不适用于目标）。
* 此技能对于脆弱性和造成条件的技能（例如施毒或偷袭）非常有效。
神圣伤害是对与你相邻的其他敌人造成的，而不是对与目标相邻的敌人造成的。

71e995d219883e7149d8e77075c8ce76093db4e1.source: bug: The holy damage is dealt to other foes adjacent to yourself, not adjacent to the target.
71e995d219883e7149d8e77075c8ce76093db4e1.text: bug：神圣伤害是对与你相邻的其他敌人造成的，而不是对与目标相邻的敌人造成的。

c2a471a7fde530e153977e4ddcb2ac19a4e420f7.source:
* Excellent spell to resurrect without re-aggroing foes, but unwise to use in mid-battle as it drains all the caster's energy. 
* The amount of energy loss can be lowered by energy hiding.
c2a471a7fde530e153977e4ddcb2ac19a4e420f7.text:
* 出色的复活法术，无需重新激怒敌人，但在战斗中使用是不明智的，因为它会耗尽施法者的所有能量。 
* 能量隐藏可以降低能量损失量。

8c1966b9df0ba14d57e73e34785b92ed2b9c581e.source:
* The enchantment is maintained on the caster, not the targeted ally.
** If the target dies, you will continue to maintain Recall.
** If you dismiss the enchantment while the target is dead, you will not shadow step nor will your skills be disabled. Once the target is resurrected, the skill will resume its normal function.
** If you die while maintaining Recall your corpse will not shadow step.
* You will step to the target if the enchantment ends because you and the target move out of compass range from each other.
The full description does not state that this skill cannot self-target.
8c1966b9df0ba14d57e73e34785b92ed2b9c581e.text:
* 结界保留在施法者身上，而不是目标盟友身上。
** 如果目标死亡，你将继续维持召回。
** 如果你在目标死亡时解除结界，你将不会暗影步，也不会禁用你的技能。一旦目标复活，技能就会恢复正常作用。
** 如果你在保持召回时死亡，你的尸体将不会暗影步。
* 如果结界因你和目标移出了彼此的罗盘范围而结束，你将走向目标。
完整的描述并没有说明该技能不能自我定位。

d6c1690fc8dfe26b8212b88ea325c401b32ab4c7.source: anomaly: The full description does not state that this skill cannot self-target.
d6c1690fc8dfe26b8212b88ea325c401b32ab4c7.text: 异常：完整描述并没有说明该技能不能自我瞄准。

f3cc1f96f85dc06d1c341ed1c4007933296a2fd5.source:
* Expect the affected foes to deal 33% less damage on average.
* Like blocking, chances to miss stack multiplicatively, not additively. A foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and Price of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks, not 75%.
* Good synergy with skills like Spiteful Spirit and Empathy in normal mode; the increased attack speed will trigger these more often.
* Enemies in hard mode already attack 25% faster, so this skill's additional increase will be less effective. Expect this skill to decrease the damage of hard mode foes by 42%.
f3cc1f96f85dc06d1c341ed1c4007933296a2fd5.text:
* 预计受影响的敌人平均会减少 33% 点伤害。
* 与阻塞一样，错过堆栈的机会是乘法，而不是加法。被鲁莽急速和失败代价施咒的敌人有 62.5% 几率攻击失败，而不是 75%。
* 普通模式下与怨灵、同理心等技能有良好的协同作用；攻击速度的提高会更频繁地触发这些事件。
*困难模式下的敌人攻击25%的速度已经更快，因此该技能的额外增幅效果会减弱。预计该技能可使困难模式敌人的伤害减少 42% 点。

022ee079789235293652299b6e91d3b8456da841.source:
* This skill will destroy any spirit(s) you control so long as they are within party range.
* Heroes seem to use this skill when you cast a spirit as well.
* Consider using Ritual Lord, Soul Twisting or Spirit Channeling instead of this skill if using 12+ ranks in Spawning Power. 
** These skills provide superior energy-management, a faster recharge bonus, do not require pre-existing spirits to function at full potential and they do not destroy spirits.
022ee079789235293652299b6e91d3b8456da841.text:
* 该技能将摧毁你控制的任何在队伍范围内的灵魂。
* 英雄似乎在施放灵魂时也会使用此技能。
* 如果生成力超过12级，请考虑使用仪式领主、灵魂扭曲或精神引导来代替此技能。 
** 这些技能提供卓越的能量管理、更快的充值奖励，不需要预先存在的灵魂即可充分发挥作用，并且不会破坏灵魂。

174b412b7f29a809f415795a4e278414440773ef.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Recovery.
* Recovery will reduce the duration of burning on spirits, including itself.
The French translation of Spirit of Recovery is the same as Spirit of Recuperation but with a lower case "r", which can be misleading.
Rather than conditions expiring at a faster rate, their duration is reduced by the stated percentage.
174b412b7f29a809f415795a4e278414440773ef.text:
* 该技能会产生恢复之魂。
* 恢复会减少烈酒燃烧的持续时间，包括其本身。
Spirit of Recovery 的法语翻译与 Spirit of Recuperation 相同，但“r”小写，这可能会产生误导。
条件不会以更快的速度到期，而是会按规定的百分比减少。

8a3e0a8377927c2a2b6c22ebb28260910e2b2f07.source: bug: The French translation of Spirit of Recovery is the same as Spirit of Recuperation but with a lower case "r", which can be misleading.
8a3e0a8377927c2a2b6c22ebb28260910e2b2f07.text: bug：Spirit of Recovery 的法语翻译与 Spirit of Recuperation 相同，但“r”小写，这可能会产生误导。

155a84cf599079070f12022adfc806484d3e1152.source: anomaly: Rather than conditions expiring at a faster rate, their duration is reduced by the stated percentage.
155a84cf599079070f12022adfc806484d3e1152.text: 异常：条件不是以更快的速度到期，而是它们的持续时间按规定的百分比减少。

2575bab37e1f894c878d5da03d12fc5fecd99a3b.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Recovery.
2575bab37e1f894c878d5da03d12fc5fecd99a3b.text: * 该技能会产生恢复之魂。

eb5249739b29546521f6ceb3505cb3f2e6cab842.source:
anomaly: When Release Enchantments (or any skill that removes "all enchantments") triggers the damage effects of Mirage Cloak or Aura of Holy Might, it behaves inconsistently compared to skills that remove a specific number of enchantments:

Mirage Cloak: Damage will only trigger for a restricted list of Dervish enchantments (Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and itself).

Aura of Holy Might: Damage will trigger for all Dervish enchantments except Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, and Vow of Revolution.

Skills that remove a defined number of enchantments (like Rend Enchantments or standard Dervish teardowns) do not suffer from these restrictions.
eb5249739b29546521f6ceb3505cb3f2e6cab842.text:
异常：当释放结界（或任何移除“所有结界”的技能）触发幻影披风或圣威光环的伤害效果时，与移除特定数量结界的技能相比，其表现不一致：

幻影斗篷：伤害只会对有限的苦行僧结界触发（荆棘光环、巴尔萨泽之怒、虔诚更新、尘斗篷、惊人之力、古兰斯之指及其本身）。

圣力光环：除永恒光环、力量之盾、古兰斯光环和革命誓言之外的所有苦行僧结界都会触发伤害。

移除一定数量结界的技能（如撕裂结界或标准苦行僧拆卸）不受这些限制。

c4d41a6e3fa6dc4dbdda9e43811faf9d2176acc3.source:
*If profession is not a factor, Antidote Signet is a better skill.
*Synergies with Cautery Signet.
c4d41a6e3fa6dc4dbdda9e43811faf9d2176acc3.text:
*如果职业不是一个因素，解药徽记是一个更好的技能。
*与 Cautry Signet 的协同作用。

5debf88804afff14bfc89395a3b7338101228a32.source:
* Due to its low cost, short recharge, and simple effect, this skill is a reasonable hex removal option for any Monk-secondary character.
* There is also a non-elite Monk hex removal skill for each Monk attribute, so if you are running a build with a Monk attribute invested at a high level, you may want to use the corresponding skill instead.
5debf88804afff14bfc89395a3b7338101228a32.text:
* 由于其成本低、充能时间短、效果简单，该技能对于任何武僧辅助角色来说都是一个合理的去除六角的选项。
* 每个武僧属性还有一个非精英武僧六角去除技能，因此如果您正在运行一个高等级投入的武僧属性构建，您可能需要使用相应的技能。

5b05b46908ed115e89cd3f96fc353cab6b8d76d4.source: * This skill is particularly useful at removing a large amount of enchantments and is very effective against Monks, Elementalists, and Necromancers that use a lot of enchantments in PvP.
5b05b46908ed115e89cd3f96fc353cab6b8d76d4.text: * 此技能在移除大量结界时特别有用，并且对于在 PvP 中使用大量结界的武僧、元素师和死灵法师非常有效。

5aa5725412b1ff3207174e75c709e8fe6f9ece62.source: * If the target is knocked down using an attack skill, it does not remove an enchantment.
5aa5725412b1ff3207174e75c709e8fe6f9ece62.text: * 如果使用攻击技能击倒目标，则不会移除结界。

8229bb3af445bb8382b19790822c66f6e0632931.source:
The cold damage dealt by this skill is armor-ignoring.

The full description fails to mention that this spell has a touch range (the concise description is correct).
8229bb3af445bb8382b19790822c66f6e0632931.text:
该技能造成的冰冷伤害无视护甲。

完整的描述没有提到这个法术有接触范围（简洁的描述是正确的）。

438cc70be2a7cb0113d3674fb783727f01b72693.source: anomaly: The cold damage dealt by this skill is armor-ignoring.
438cc70be2a7cb0113d3674fb783727f01b72693.text: 异常：该技能造成的冰冷伤害无视护甲。

5fccb00b1ed7ff48e94d516f6bb2add42cd8e0ea.source: bug: The full description fails to mention that this spell has a touch range (the concise description is correct).
5fccb00b1ed7ff48e94d516f6bb2add42cd8e0ea.text: bug：完整的描述没有提到这个法术有接触范围（简洁的描述是正确的）。

faf54b4d71853114bd2fc5fce847db1314e5a0e4.source:
* The ally is not actually healed, but is resurrected at 50% plus 55…115…130 Health.
* The skill icon appears to be a picture of Mhenlo.
faf54b4d71853114bd2fc5fce847db1314e5a0e4.text:
* 盟友实际上并没有被治愈，而是以 50% 点生命值和 55…115…130 点生命值复活。
* 技能图标似乎是Mhenlo的照片。

b9adb8e5cf5ed9c79c0e067e96dcb58cbf200061.source: * The energy reduction applies to the base cost of applicable skills; the cost reduction stacks with Attuned Was Songkai and Quickening Zephyr.
b9adb8e5cf5ed9c79c0e067e96dcb58cbf200061.text: * 能量减少适用于适用技能的基本成本；成本降低可与 Attuned Was Songkai 和 Quickening Zephyr 叠加。

9021d12217994a2062c863d90d61b0f54fb9d8ce.source:
* This skill works well with the four-second knock downs caused by Backbreaker.
* Combined with a skill that improves attack speed by 33%, this attack can hit four times every three seconds (the length of a standard knock down with Stonefist Insignia).
9021d12217994a2062c863d90d61b0f54fb9d8ce.text:
* 此技能与 Backbreaker 造成的四秒击倒效果很好。
* 与提高攻击速度33%的技能相结合，该攻击每三秒可击中四次（石拳徽章的标准击倒时间）。

add8f75db320fedeafafc7b5a05fbda89d0300c0.source:
* When used with Anguished Was Lingwah, this hex will last for 12 seconds.
Unlike other hexes that affect the caster, this hex does not end if the caster dies.
add8f75db320fedeafafc7b5a05fbda89d0300c0.text:
* 当与 Anguished Was Lingwah 一起使用时，该降咒将持续 12 秒。
与影响施法者的其他巫术不同，施法者死亡后，该巫术不会结束。

1a3046bfae5e10a948242d8a6dd75b1b7a4fea3f.source: anomaly: Unlike other hexes that affect the caster, this hex does not end if the caster dies.
1a3046bfae5e10a948242d8a6dd75b1b7a4fea3f.text: 异常：与影响施法者的其他巫术不同，如果施法者死亡，该巫术不会结束。

3fd7dc4e94614d7910e3422e2a9200888d202860.source:
* When used with Way of the Empty Palm and Golden Phoenix Strike, this skill can be used repeatedly and without using any energy (except to cast Way of the Empty Palm).
* Using this skill without a requisite off-hand attack will cause it to fail, and thus still recharge instantly.
3fd7dc4e94614d7910e3422e2a9200888d202860.text:
* 与空掌之道和金凤击一起使用时，该技能可以重复使用，不消耗任何能量（施展空掌之道除外）。
* 在没有必要的副手攻击的情况下使用该技能将导致其失败，因此仍然可以立即充能。

e79e7585c96c05ce0128e02bf7b58d19b44aa5a4.source: * Combines well with Draw Conditions, Martyr, Cautery Signet, and Foul Feast for cleansing your party of conditions.
e79e7585c96c05ce0128e02bf7b58d19b44aa5a4.text: * 与抽签条件、烈士、烧灼印章和污秽盛宴完美结合，以净化你的队伍的条件。

be7893d74cdd21a7a4d75931bbf381109a1b2d2c.source:
* The +24 armor rating will reduce damage by ~34%; combines well with Ghost Forge Insignia for +15 armor rating to reduce damage by ~50%.
* If Lightning Surge ends and is the last hex, the damage is still reduced.
be7893d74cdd21a7a4d75931bbf381109a1b2d2c.text:
* +24的护甲等级将减少~34%的伤害；与幽灵锻造徽章完美结合，护甲等级为 +15，可减少约 50% 伤害。
* 如果闪电涌动结束并且是最后一个六角形，伤害仍然会减少。

16c8817a424a5c8674fdc859cb5c6f9db4edcdf3.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Preservation.
* The spirit will prioritize the lowest health ally for healing.
* The healing is a passive effect; the spirit does not use any skills, so it cannot be interrupted; however, the healing will still trigger Scourge Healing.
* Heroes only attempt to maintain this spirit in battle.
* The concise description neglects to mention that only allies in the area of the spirit will be healed.
16c8817a424a5c8674fdc859cb5c6f9db4edcdf3.text:
* 该技能会产生保护之魂。
* 灵魂会优先治疗生命值最低的盟友。
* 治疗是被动效果；神魂不使用任何技能，因此无法被打断；然而，治疗仍然会触发天灾治疗。
*英雄只是试图在战斗中保持这种精神。
* 简洁的描述忽略了只有精神领域的盟友才会被治愈。

3d1fce84ea3d942e029b4be55ba5b7028e2709d5.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Preservation.
* The spirit heals one random ally in the area, including allies with full health.
* The healing is a passive effect; the spirit does not use any skills, so it cannot be interrupted; however, the healing will still trigger Scourge Healing.
3d1fce84ea3d942e029b4be55ba5b7028e2709d5.text:
* 该技能会产生保护之魂。
* 该灵魂会治愈该地区的一名随机盟友，包括健康状况良好的盟友。
* 治疗是被动效果；神魂不使用任何技能，因此无法被打断；然而，治疗仍然会触发天灾治疗。

e6a6859ff606fea07240dfa4db96110efdd704e3.source:
* This skill triggers when the target fails to hit, for whatever reason. Hence, blocking with a skill, simply dodging a ranged attack, or even using the terrain to avoid being hit by a ranged attack will trigger the damage.
* Combine with skills that causes Blindness to increase the miss chance and improve damage rate.
* This skill can be combined with Spirit of Failure as each will cause the foe to miss more often, thereby triggering both effects more frequently than either alone; however, hexes that make the target "miss" combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and Price of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
e6a6859ff606fea07240dfa4db96110efdd704e3.text:
* 当目标因任何原因未能击中时，该技能就会触发。因此，用技能格挡、简单躲避远程攻击、甚至利用地形躲避远程攻击都会触发伤害。
* 与导致失明的技能结合，增加失误率，提高伤害率。
* 该技能可以与失败之灵结合使用，因为两者都会导致敌人更频繁地失手，从而比单独使用其中任何一个技能更频繁地触发这两种效果；然而，使目标“错过”的六角形是乘法而不是加法组合。因此，同时被鲁莽急速和失败代价诅咒的敌人有 62.5% 次攻击失败的机会。

c324755b394acd20fd5418c50f1b6e1d8139174f.source: bug: Second Wind does not trigger this skill.
c324755b394acd20fd5418c50f1b6e1d8139174f.text: bug：第二风不会触发该技能。

9467a7fc8eb32e7cf2d77e54ecbdf6724bee9173.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Primal Echoes.
* The effects of this skill are applied before the energy modifiers from Quickening Zephyr or Energizing Wind. 
* Expertise will reduce the increased cost of ranger signets. 
* This skill often ruins bonders who use Blessed Signet for energy management.
9467a7fc8eb32e7cf2d77e54ecbdf6724bee9173.text:
* 该技能会产生原始回响之灵。
* 该技能的效果在加速和风或能量风的能量调整之前应用。 
* 专业知识将减少游侠徽记增加的成本。 
* 这项技能经常会毁掉使用祝福徽记进行能量管理的绑定者。

83d6415913a3e653ca3ca5d6d36f0f2e1116f9f7.source:
*Damage reduction, such as Protective Spirit, will be taken into account after Primal Rage, therefore mitigating the double damage.
**If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, the use of a cancel stance is advisable.
* If playing PvE with a high rank in the Deldrimor title, consider bringing Drunken Master over Primal Rage since it provides a good IAS and IMS without any drawback. This is especially true if using alcohol, as the two boosts will be respectively equal.
83d6415913a3e653ca3ca5d6d36f0f2e1116f9f7.text:
*伤害减免，例如防护精神，将在原始狂暴之后考虑，从而减轻双倍伤害。
**如果不使用护魂等技能，建议使用取消姿态。
* 如果在 Deldrimor 标题中以高排名玩 PvE，请考虑将 Drunken Master 置于 Primal Rage 之上，因为它提供了良好的 IAS 和 IMS，没有任何缺点。如果使用酒精，则尤其如此，因为两种增强效果将分别相等。

1a5d86e25da5006e7a7527a2e883d79238f0f968.source:
*Damage reduction, such as Protective Spirit, will be taken into account after Primal Rage, therefore mitigating the double damage.
**If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, the use of a cancel stance is advisable.
1a5d86e25da5006e7a7527a2e883d79238f0f968.text:
*伤害减免，例如防护精神，将在原始狂暴之后考虑，从而减轻双倍伤害。
**如果不使用护魂等技能，建议使用取消姿势。

9fdb104e40710544c0b3dea19a42c388df32349e.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Restoration.
* This skill can bypass Frozen Soil's effect since this skill can indirectly resurrect party members and the caster.
** Cannot be cast in the range of a Frozen Soil spirit.
** Use this before Frozen Soil, to provide a means to resurrect your own team while suppressing enemy resurrections. 
* Combine with Feast of Souls for rapid healing after resurrection. Rupture Soul or Spirit to Flesh can respectively provide damage or healing before resurrection.
* Can be recast with skills that shorten the recharge times of Binding Rituals, such as Soul Twisting or Ritual Lord, to control when the resurrection occurs.
* If your entire party dies before this spirit does, you will not get resurrected.
* You can prevent enemy resurrections by using Signet of Binding on hostile Restoration spirits.

This spirit will also resurrect creatures created via summoning stones that were dead and in the area of the spirit.
9fdb104e40710544c0b3dea19a42c388df32349e.text:
* 该技能会产生恢复之魂。
* 该技能可以绕过冰冻土的效果，因为该技能可以间接复活队员和施法者。
** 无法在冰土精灵的范围内施展。
** 在冻土之前使用此功能，可以提供复活己方队伍并压制敌人复活的手段。 
* 与灵魂盛宴结合使用，可在复活后快速治愈。裂魂或灵肉可以在复活前分别提供伤害或治疗。
* 可以使用缩短绑定仪式充能时间的技能进行重铸，例如灵魂扭曲或仪式领主，以控制复活发生的时间。
* 如果你的整个队伍在这个灵魂之前死亡，你将不会复活。
* 你可以通过对敌对的恢复灵魂使用束缚徽记来阻止敌人复活。

该精神还会复活通过召唤已死亡的石头而在该精神区域中创建的生物。

878e6b0c47680c67dd9d1669741cfcbab4054993.source: anomaly: This spirit will also resurrect creatures created via summoning stones that were dead and in the area of the spirit.
878e6b0c47680c67dd9d1669741cfcbab4054993.text: 异常：该精神还会复活通过召唤石头而在该精神区域内死亡的生物。

a157502f6343d023762ca976adfd55e9d280cd61.source:
* This skill can bypass Frozen Soil's effect since this skill can indirectly resurrect party members and the caster.
* Cannot be cast in the area of a Frozen Soil spirit.
* Can be combined with Frozen Soil to prevent enemy resurrection (unless they have the same skill) while still enabling the resurrection of the user's party with this skill or Lively Was Naomei.
* Consider using with Rupture Soul, Feast of Souls or Spirit to Flesh.
* If your entire party dies before this spirit does, you will not get resurrected.
a157502f6343d023762ca976adfd55e9d280cd61.text:
* 该技能可以绕过冰冻土的效果，因为该技能可以间接复活队员和施法者。
* 不能在冰冻土精灵的区域施展。
* 可以与冰冻土结合使用，防止敌人复活（除非他们具有相同的技能），同时仍然可以使用该技能或活泼的直梅复活用户的队伍。
* 考虑与裂魂、灵魂盛宴或灵肉结合使用。
* 如果你的整个队伍在这个灵魂之前死亡，你将不会复活。

578e96a376426bdbfff4bf1dcb4a10ec8986cd77.source: * With this skill at 11 or more Healing Prayers, a party member is able to resurrect a 55 Monk even when the 55 Monk is at 1 maximum health due to Death Penalty (see 55 Monk for more details).
578e96a376426bdbfff4bf1dcb4a10ec8986cd77.text: * 凭借此技能，在治愈祈祷数达到 11 或更多时，即使 55 武僧因死刑而处于 1 最大生命值，队员也能够复活 55 武僧（更多详情请参阅 55 武僧）。

f2d82d447a58f9643d846e88ae4792705acb834c.source:
* Consider carefully whether to bring this skill. If it is used to resurrect a team member in the midst of battle, that member will have low health, requiring a follow-up heal. In addition, with no energy that member will likely not be able to join the battle quickly. In such situations, a non-reusable Resurrection Signet or a different resurrection skill is better. 
* Among all monk henchmen, currently only Taya has this skill.
f2d82d447a58f9643d846e88ae4792705acb834c.text:
* 慎重考虑是否带此技能。如果它用于在战斗中复活团队成员，该成员的生命值将会很低，需要后续治疗。另外，没有能量的成员很可能无法快速加入战斗。在这种情况下，不可重复使用的复活徽记或不同的复活技能会更好。 
* 在所有僧侣追随者中，目前只有塔亚拥有此技能。

59f4b9f6c7d5695b38c418bec63d24d3cd7cf2db.source:
* Because it has a quick cast time and no energy cost, this skill is a favorite for most forms of PvP.
* Since it only recharges on morale boosts (usually gained by killing bosses in PvE or flag objectives in PvP), this skill is significantly less useful in situations in which players will be fighting a long time with no morale boosts (i.e. the Underworld).
* This skill is referred to as a "soft" resurrection (contrary to a "hard" resurrection skill such as Death Pact Signet or Flesh of my Flesh) due to the fact it can only be used once per morale boost.
* As with any other skill, a morale boost will not recharge the signet if it is hidden while you are under the effect of a form with form-specific skill bar, e.g. if you kill a boss while under the effects of Ursan Blessing.

This skill, along with all other skills, recharges when zoning, despite the description text stating it requires a morale boost.
When used on an invalid target, this skill incorrectly gives the "Invalid spell target." message rather than the generic "Invalid target." message.
59f4b9f6c7d5695b38c418bec63d24d3cd7cf2db.text:
* 由于施法时间短且无能量消耗，该技能是大多数 PvP 形式的最爱。
* 由于它只能在士气提升时重新充电（通常通过在 PvE 中杀死 Boss 或在 PvP 中标记目标来获得），因此在玩家长时间战斗而没有士气提升的情况下（即地狱），此技能的用处明显较小。
* 该技能被称为“软”复活（与“硬”复活技能如死亡契约印章或我的肉身相反），因为每次士气提升只能使用一次。
* 与任何其他技能一样，如果当您处于具有特定形式技能条的形式的效果下（例如，如果你在乌尔桑祝福的影响下杀死了 Boss。

尽管描述文字表明该技能需要鼓舞士气，但该技能与所有其他技能一样，会在分区时重新充电。
当对无效目标使用时，该技能会错误地给出“无效法术目标”。消息而不是通用的“无效目标”。信息。

5f4333ee37670771f6af9adc85271cea2044ca22.source: anomaly: This skill, along with all other skills, recharges when zoning, despite the description text stating it requires a morale boost.
5f4333ee37670771f6af9adc85271cea2044ca22.text: 异常：该技能与所有其他技能一样，在分区时会重新充电，尽管描述文字表明它需要士气提升。

7bea0b0fddf2f64c18ebb742f2875513851f8c29.source: anomaly: When used on an invalid target, this skill incorrectly gives the "Invalid spell target." message rather than the generic "Invalid target." message.
7bea0b0fddf2f64c18ebb742f2875513851f8c29.text: 异常：当对无效目标使用时，该技能会错误地给出“无效法术目标”。消息而不是通用的“无效目标”。信息。

44f6180b70644a36dfb5e8aa596cbad87c5aee01.source:
* The attack damage is not reduced.
* Retribution deals holy damage.
* Damage is rounded up to a minimum of 1.
* Retribution will only trigger on the damage from attacks, not on the indirect damage from Hundred Blades or Vow of Strength.
* Returned damage is calculated after the effects of enchantments (e.g. Protective Spirit), therefore is useless for 55 Monks.
* Retribution is one of the keystone skills of 600+smiter combinations.
If you somehow manage to maintain Retribution on a foe, it will not deal damage back to you or your allies.
44f6180b70644a36dfb5e8aa596cbad87c5aee01.text:
* 攻击伤害不减少。
* 惩戒造成神圣伤害。
* 伤害向上舍入为最小值 1。
* 惩戒只会在攻击造成的伤害上触发，不会在百刃或力量誓言造成的间接伤害上触发。
* 返回伤害是在结界（例如护灵）效果之后计算的，因此对于 55 武僧来说没有用处。
* 惩戒是600+重击组合的关键技能之一。
如果你设法对敌人维持报应，它不会对你或你的盟友造成伤害。

31d1f2fa5e6b0b9f7de47d4ee1aaa4caccb0601e.source: bug: If you somehow manage to maintain Retribution on a foe, it will not deal damage back to you or your allies.
31d1f2fa5e6b0b9f7de47d4ee1aaa4caccb0601e.text: bug：如果你设法对敌人维持报应，它不会对你或你的盟友造成伤害。

05b2d8ca22bef2aa7c4a584873680e627c2aae81.source:
* Heroes tend to use this for the crippling and not the shadow step.
This spell does not have an aftercast delay.
05b2d8ca22bef2aa7c4a584873680e627c2aae81.text:
* 英雄倾向于将其用于致残而不是暗影步。
该法术没有施法延迟。

f79a6d20de1bc08c8a0c206ccabbfe6d12edcd51.source:
* This skill can not "steal" monster-only enchantments (e.g. Demonic Agility); however, the energy gain does happen and Revealed Enchantment recharges instantly.
* It is possible to steal enchantments you need to maintain, such as Mending. They will remain active when Revealed Enchantment ends.
* Heroes will use the copied skill as they normally would do.
** Maintained enchantments that heroes would dismiss can be disabled to be maintained for the duration of the copy effect. When the copy effect ends the enchantment will be dropped as soon as the AI dictates it to (i.e. the hero is not in a situation where it would normally maintain the enchantment). Out of combat, Blessed Aura, Divine Boon and Unyielding Aura are the only maintained enchantments that the AI won't immediately dismiss.
f79a6d20de1bc08c8a0c206ccabbfe6d12edcd51.text:
* 该技能不能“窃取”怪物专用的附魔（例如恶魔敏捷）；然而，能量增益确实会发生，并且显露结界会立即重新充电。
* 可以窃取你需要维持的结界，例如修补。当显露结界结束时，它们将保持活跃状态​​。
*英雄将像平常一样使用复制的技能。
** 英雄会解除的维持结界可以被禁用，以便在复制效果持续时间内维持。当复制效果结束时，一旦人工智能指示，结界就会被丢弃（即英雄不处于通常会保持结界的情况）。在战斗之外，祝福光环、神圣恩赐和不屈光环是人工智能不会立即消除的唯一保留的结界。

9d108e8a2abf34b59b4fcf8304e343a70009d525.source:
* This skill cannot "steal" monster-only hex spells (e.g. Crystal Bonds); however, the energy gain does happen and Revealed Hex recharges instantly.
* This skill is not susceptible to recharge-lengthening skills like Diversion.
* If the caster is in the process of casting the copied hex spell at the end of the 20 seconds copy duration, the casting of the spell will fail.
9d108e8a2abf34b59b4fcf8304e343a70009d525.text:
* 该技能无法“窃取”怪物专用的降咒魔法（例如水晶债券）；然而，能量增益确实会发生，并且 Revealed Hex 会立即充电。
* 该技能不受诸如转移之类的延长充值技能的影响。
* 如果施法者在20秒复制持续时间结束时正在施放复制的降咒法术，则该法术的施展将会失败。

ba35a6919fc2acb49751b2aef47ce1c84cb99e55.source:
* Damage inflicted by this skill is considered holy damage.
* If the target takes more damage than the stated maximum, then the damage taken will be reduced by that maximum and the attacker will receive the same amount. For example, at 14 Smiting Prayers, a target with Reversal of Damage on them being struck by a Lightning Orb that would deal 100 damage would take 30 damage and the attacker would take 70.
* The damage for this reversal is calculated before other damage reduction. So, a 55 Monk using Protective Spirit and Reversal of Damage can deal more than five damage, with the remaining (above the stated maximum for this skill) damage being reduced by Protective Spirit.
* This skill will still prevent damage even if there is no foe to redirect damage to, for example when struck by environmental damage.
ba35a6919fc2acb49751b2aef47ce1c84cb99e55.text:
* 该技能造成的伤害被视为神圣伤害。
* 如果目标受到的伤害超过规定的最大伤害，则受到的伤害将减少该最大伤害，而攻击者将受到相同的伤害。例如，在 14 次重击祈祷中，一个受到伤害逆转的目标被造成 100 点伤害的闪电球击中时，将受到 30 点伤害，而攻击者将受到 70 点伤害。
* 此逆转的伤害是在其他伤害减免之前计算的。因此，使用防护精神和伤害逆转的 55 武僧可以造成超过 5 点伤害，剩余的（高于该技能规定的最大伤害）伤害会被防护精神减少。
* 即使没有敌人可以将伤害重定向到该技能，例如受到环境伤害时，该技能仍然可以防止伤害。

9364d1e59287312f20b43d710b1356d6a7fb7497.source:
* Just like the concise description says, this spell converts damage to healing, up to the stated maximum. For example, at rank 12 it can negate up to 134 damage (67 damage reduced and 67 damage healed).
* Under Reversal of Fortune, the healing occurs before damage. As such, it is possible for this spell to result in a net loss of health if used on an ally at or near full health.
* This skill, unlike Reversal of Damage, will trigger after damage reduction like Protective Spirit and Protective Bond, meaning that you often won't get the full benefit from this skill with other protection in place.
Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
9364d1e59287312f20b43d710b1356d6a7fb7497.text:
* 正如简明描述所说，该法术将伤害转化为治疗，最高可达规定的最大值。例如，在等级 12 时，它最多可以抵消 134 点伤害（减少 67 点伤害，治愈 67 点伤害）。
* 在命运逆转下，治疗发生在伤害之前。因此，如果对处于或接近完全生命值的盟友使用该法术，则可能会导致生命值净损失。
* 该技能与伤害逆转不同，会在伤害减免后触发，例如防护精神和防护纽带，这意味着在有其他防护的情况下，您通常无法从该技能中获得全部好处。
与完整描述相反，该技能会带来治疗效果，但不会增加生命值。

197cf8734f6a299e19ca19b2ec547129b01865e3.source: * Reverse Hex is one of the few hex removal skills that have an activation time of 0.25 second, so this skill can be cast during the aftercast delay between a hex and its cover hex, removing it before it is covered.
197cf8734f6a299e19ca19b2ec547129b01865e3.text: * 反向六角形是为数不多的激活时间为 0.25 秒的六角形移除技能之一，因此该技能可以在六角形与其覆盖六角形之间的施法延迟期间施放，在其被覆盖之前将其移除。

bd2c4fb21a450867834ddc191dd7dbc5dffc3a2c.source:
* The range for this skill is much shorter than the resurrection range of Comfort Animal.
* As of the August 6, 2009 game update and August 26, 2026 game update, Comfort Animal or Comfort Animal (PvP) can be used instead of Charm Animal for your companion to travel with you. Heal as One was updated with the February 25, 2010 game update to also have this functionality in PvE. These updates largely render Revive Animal suboptimal because of their ability to resurrect pets, mandatory bar placement for pet usage, cast time, recharge time, pet heal and range.
bd2c4fb21a450867834ddc191dd7dbc5dffc3a2c.text:
* 该技能的范围比安慰动物的复活范围短得多。
* 自 8 月 6、2009 游戏更新和 8 月 26、2026 游戏更新起，可以使用舒适动物或舒适动物（PvP）代替魅惑动物，让您的同伴与您同行。 《Heal as One》在 2 月的 25、2010 游戏更新中进行了更新，在 PvE 中也具有此功能。这些更新在很大程度上使复活动物变得次优，因为它们复活宠物的能力、宠物使用的强制栏位置、施法时间、充电时间、宠物治疗和范围。

c303653e178ed6345d149c66dcc761efd67ad64e.source:
* The blindness is applied to foes adjacent to the target, not the user's initial location.
* This skill is mechanically the same as a shadow step.
* This skill (and its PvP version) is the only shadow step skill able to move the user to any target regardless of whether the target is a foe or ally.
c303653e178ed6345d149c66dcc761efd67ad64e.text:
* 失明适用于目标附近的敌人，而不是用户的初始位置。
* 该技能在机制上与暗影步相同。
* 该技能（及其 PvP 版本）是唯一能够将用户移动到任何目标的暗影步技能，无论目标是敌人还是盟友。

546ccafe4cd1e3db5ada55788ab98384af4f3594.source:
* This skill is mechanically the same as a shadow step.
* This skill (and its PvE version) is the only shadow step skill able to move the user to any target, regardless of whether the target is a foe or ally.
546ccafe4cd1e3db5ada55788ab98384af4f3594.text:
* 该技能在机制上与暗影步相同。
* 该技能（及其 PvE 版本）是唯一能够将用户移动到任何目标的暗影步技能，无论目标是敌人还是盟友。

63ff6245a0e60f66d02845eec88d4148d06f1e3e.source:
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* One attack will trigger your Riposte, Deadly Riposte, and Auspicious Parry/Gladiator's Defense if you have all active.
63ff6245a0e60f66d02845eec88d4148d06f1e3e.text:
* 该技能恰好需要80单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此3次打击和5单位。
* 如果您全部激活，一次攻击将触发您的还击、致命还击和吉祥招架/角斗士防御。

aa5392a62bc0bbd747b0920234d28c394ce79a6d.source:
* If a foe hexed with Rising Bile dies, all foes in the area will be damaged. (As with Parasitic Bond, the game counts the hex as ended if the target dies.)
* Re-casting Rising Bile has no effect. It will still expire after the initial 20 seconds.
aa5392a62bc0bbd747b0920234d28c394ce79a6d.text:
* 如果被上升胆汁诅咒的敌人死亡，该区域的所有敌人都会受到伤害。 （与寄生债券一样，如果目标死亡，游戏就会将降咒视为结束。）
* 重铸上升胆汁没有效果。它仍将在最初的 20 秒后过期。

30ff4c61305a51afbf71a4c7b4f12958895528ce.source:
* This skill can be used while activating a Binding Ritual, since it does not have an activation time.
* Instead of causing skills to recharge faster, Ritual Lord actually reduces the recharge time of a skill by 10…50…60%.
Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.
30ff4c61305a51afbf71a4c7b4f12958895528ce.text:
* 该技能没有启动时间，因此可以在启动束缚仪式时使用。
* 仪式领主实际上并没有使技能充能速度加快，而是将技能的充能时间减少了 10…50…60%。
仪式领主只会增加技能的技能进阶，而不会增加生成力的固有效果。

ccaa61300d04046acde582213e300ed421b1aa53.source: anomaly: Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.
ccaa61300d04046acde582213e300ed421b1aa53.text: 异常：仪式领主只会增加技能的技能进阶，而不会增加生成力的固有效果。

9f073a52182723a0c0a6faf220ecacaf18a800ab.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Roaring Winds.
* This skill also affects chants and shouts that cost adrenaline.
9f073a52182723a0c0a6faf220ecacaf18a800ab.text:
* 该技能会创造出狂风之魂。
* 该技能也会影响需要肾上腺素的吟唱和呼喊。

13446bba9251c143c5b82aeab42351f7df04b296.source: * This spell will not fail if your target dies mid-cast.
13446bba9251c143c5b82aeab42351f7df04b296.text: * 如果你的目标在施法过程中死亡，这个法术不会失败。

8613033106527d5dfcfeaa02cf8abf21f13e6725.source: * Heroes will attempt to use this skill on non-fleshy foes, so remember to enable/disable it according to the type of foe.
8613033106527d5dfcfeaa02cf8abf21f13e6725.text: * 英雄会尝试对非肉身敌人使用此技能，因此请记住根据敌人的类型启用/禁用它。

83cfbc1e956c41b76b78591fe53abc74e3becead.source:
* This skill can be used without Charm Animal, Comfort Animal nor Heal as One equipped or when your animal companion is dead.
{{speed|5|15|25|15}}
* Animal companions already run faster than normal player speed so this may not be needed for the pet's benefit though it will still allow the pet to better catch a running target.
* This skill will continue to be active for the pet even if the owner has activated another stance after it.
* Consider using in combination with Feral Aggression.
83cfbc1e956c41b76b78591fe53abc74e3becead.text:
* 该技能可以在没有魅惑动物、安慰动物或治疗作为装备的情况下使用，或者当你的动物伙伴死亡时使用。
{{速度|5|15|25|15}}
* 动物同伴的奔跑速度已经比正常玩家的速度快，因此宠物可能不需要这样做，尽管它仍然可以让宠物更好地捕捉奔跑的目标。
* 即使主人在该技能之后激活了另一个姿势，该技能也会继续对宠物有效。
* 考虑与野性侵略结合使用。

f0b8725509477da16c536ad05b5ddbdfebadc10a.source:
* Combines well with Destruction, Life, and Restoration.
* Nearby is centered on the targeted spirit (rather than the caster).
f0b8725509477da16c536ad05b5ddbdfebadc10a.text:
* 与毁灭、生命和恢复完美结合。
* 附近以目标灵魂（而不是施法者）为中心。

c1c0010b25c40bc2f34d2e1cef2789bbc98ff15e.source:
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* Rush is commonly used as a cancel stance, especially for canceling Frenzy or Primal Rage when the user begins taking heavy damage.
c1c0010b25c40bc2f34d2e1cef2789bbc98ff15e.text:
* 该技能恰好需要80单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此3次打击和5单位。
* 冲锋通常用作取消姿态，特别是当用户开始受到严重伤害时取消狂怒或原始狂怒。

2510243e6209c30bbac19d13e7fa81045e0c1fbf.source:
* Very useful in Random Arenas, as almost everyone is likely to have a Resurrection Signet equipped.
* The description is ambiguous. Rust will only disable a single signet on a target, and only if that target is casting a signet when struck. Additionally, Rust will disable that signet even if the target is under an effect that prevents interruption.
* Rust will not fail if the target dies before the skill completes casting.
2510243e6209c30bbac19d13e7fa81045e0c1fbf.text:
* 在随机竞技场中非常有用，因为几乎每个人都可能配备复活徽记。
* 描述不明确。 Rust 只会禁用目标上的单个图章，并且仅当该目标在被击中时施放图章时。此外，即使目标处于阻止中断的效果下，Rust 也会禁用该图章。
* 如果目标在技能完成施法之前死亡，Rust 不会失败。

67f1be65f21cd09a03b76152aff96e156266fdab.source: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
67f1be65f21cd09a03b76152aff96e156266fdab.text: 与所有其他同时造成伤害和额外伤害的元素使技能（除了致盲涌动和手内之风）不同，该技能的额外伤害不会在单独的数据包中造成。

59111eef8ae3972f67ee1927a0c2b70fba5d2368.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Recuperation.
* At a glance, a maximum of +3 health regeneration doesn't sound like a lot, but consider that it affects all allies within spirit range. (In regards to party healing, this equates to 17.6 health-to-energy ratio, multiplied by # of allies.) That includes non-party members such as allied NPCs (Master Togo, Mhenlo, etc.), minions, animal companions and, in the case of two-party cooperative missions, members of the other party.
* Combined with Ritual Lord, a level 17 Recuperation will heal 8 health per second, for a maximum 424 health per ally within range throughout its lifespan at rank 19 Restoration Magic and 16 Spawning Power (with Ritual Lord). 
* The following table shows the total effective health gain received by all allies within spirit range:

59111eef8ae3972f67ee1927a0c2b70fba5d2368.text:
* 该技能会产生恢复之魂。
* 乍一看，最大+3生命恢复听起来并不多，但考虑到它会影响精神范围内的所有盟友。 （就队伍治疗而言，这相当于 17.6 生命能量比，乘以盟友数量。）这包括非队员，例如盟友 NPC（Togo 大师、Mhenlo 等）、小兵、动物伙伴，以及在两方合作任务的情况下，还包括另一方成员。
* 与仪式领主结合，17 级恢复每秒可治疗 8 点生命值，在其生命周期内每个盟友在其生命周期内最多可恢复 424 点生命值，等级为 19 级恢复魔法和 16 级生成力量（与仪式领主一起）。 
* 下表显示了精神范围内所有盟友获得的总有效生命值：

12c460bd41635375b88cbc7e27b2752533a5caa4.source:
* Recurring Insecurity only reapplies itself if it lasts its full duration. Therefore using a hex removal skill, such as Remove Hex, will safely remove Recurring Insecurity without it being reapplied.
* Recurring Insecurity triggers Soul Barbs with each reapplication.
12c460bd41635375b88cbc7e27b2752533a5caa4.text:
* 反复出现的不安全感只有在其持续完整的持续时间后才会重新出现。因此，使用降咒移除技能（例如移除降咒）将安全地移除重复出现的不安全感，而无需重新应用。
* 每次重新应用时，反复出现的不安全感都会触发灵魂倒刺。

5ad5f6fd65fec1089264f4aaedc68cae2e91ad22.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Rejuvenation.
* The spirit is created with a higher level than other spirits at the same attribute rank. At 21 Restoration Magic, it is level 28, which is the highest leveled summoned spirit in the game. 
* Only heals party members below full health, so while your party hasn't started combat, try not to equip vampiric weapon modifiers.
* At level 14 (0 Spawning Power), Rejuvenation does the equivalent of 5 pips of health regeneration for a total of 38 seconds distributed amongst the party members (1 party member under its effect will receive 38 seconds while 4 party members will receive 9.5 seconds, etc.).
5ad5f6fd65fec1089264f4aaedc68cae2e91ad22.text:
* 该技能会产生回春之魂。
* 所创造的武魂等级高于同属性等级的其他武魂。恢复魔法21，就是28级，是游戏中最高等级的召唤灵。 
* 只能治疗低于完全生命值的队伍成员，所以当你的队伍还没有开始战斗时，尽量不要装备吸血鬼武器修饰符。
* 在 14 级（0 生成力）时，回春术相当于 5 点的生命再生，总共 38 秒，分配给队伍成员（1 名队伍成员在其影响下将获得 38 秒，而 4 名队伍成员将获得 9.5 秒，等等）。

b099ed663b09e812443a01b1cd168d85876bae17.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Rejuvenation.
* Only heals party members below full health, so while your party hasn't started combat, try not to equip vampiric weapon modifiers.
* This spirit's healing does trigger Scourge Healing.
* At level 15, Rejuvenation does the equivalent of 5 pips of health regeneration for a total of 30 seconds distributed amongst the party members (1 party member under its effect will receive 30 seconds while 3 party members will receive 10 seconds, etc.).
b099ed663b09e812443a01b1cd168d85876bae17.text:
* 该技能会产生回春之魂。
* 只能治疗低于完全生命值的队伍成员，所以当你的队伍还没有开始战斗时，尽量不要装备吸血鬼武器修饰符。
* 该精神的治疗确实会触发天灾治疗。
* 在 15 级，回春术相当于 5 点的健康再生，总共 30 秒，分配给队伍成员（1 名队伍成员在其影响下将获得 30 秒，而 3 名队伍成员将获得 10 秒，依此类推）。

b57cce87d823125b4a8407de18069d44f2787a7d.source:
When Release Enchantments (or any skill that removes "all enchantments") triggers the damage effects of Mirage Cloak or Aura of Holy Might, it behaves inconsistently compared to skills that remove a specific number of enchantments:

Mirage Cloak: Damage will only trigger for a restricted list of Dervish enchantments (Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and itself).

Aura of Holy Might: Damage will trigger for all Dervish enchantments except Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, and Vow of Revolution.

Skills that remove a defined number of enchantments (like Rend Enchantments or standard Dervish teardowns) do not suffer from these restrictions.
* This spell affects party members in party range.
* The enchantments are removed first, voiding any possible healing bonus from Unyielding Aura.
** However, Vigorous Spirit will trigger its healing before being removed.
b57cce87d823125b4a8407de18069d44f2787a7d.text:
当释放结界（或任何移除“所有结界”的技能）触发幻影斗篷或圣能光环的伤害效果时，与移除特定数量结界的技能相比，其表现不一致：

幻影斗篷：伤害只会对有限的苦行僧结界触发（荆棘光环、巴尔萨泽之怒、虔诚更新、尘斗篷、惊人之力、古兰斯之指及其本身）。

圣力光环：除永恒光环、力量之盾、古兰斯光环和革命誓言之外的所有苦行僧结界都会触发伤害。

移除一定数量结界的技能（如撕裂结界或标准苦行僧拆卸）不受这些限制。
* 该法术影响队伍范围内的队伍成员。
* 首先移除结界，使不屈光环带来的任何可能的治疗加成无效。
** 然而，元气之魂在被移除之前会触发其治疗。

048bb57262ef462ac4530939a8a9dcc5045b1cea.source: anomaly: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
048bb57262ef462ac4530939a8a9dcc5045b1cea.text: 异常：与所有其他同时造成伤害和额外伤害的元素师技能（除了致盲涌动和手内之风）不同，该技能的额外伤害不会在单独的数据包中造成。

e6e0eb2f251197f7a8f698b60343206e8fc609bd.source:
* Deals additional damage even if spell interruption is prevented.
* Normal mode foe AI will only use this skill to interrupt spells. Hero and hard mode foe AI will also use this to interrupt non-spell skills. 
*Not counting elite or adrenaline skills, Savage Shot has the shortest recharge time of all skills that can interrupt any action.
e6e0eb2f251197f7a8f698b60343206e8fc609bd.text:
* 即使法术中断被阻止，也会造成额外伤害。
*普通模式敌人AI只会使用此技能来打断法术。英雄和困难模式的敌人AI也会用它来打断非法术技能。 
*不包括精英技能或肾上腺素技能，野蛮射击的充能时间是所有技能中最短的，可以打断任何行动。

778761d77fb1d5ed505b99cee9f462a2a2d3525c.source: * Deals additional damage even if spell interruption is prevented.
778761d77fb1d5ed505b99cee9f462a2a2d3525c.text: * 即使法术中断被阻止，也会造成额外伤害。

65399dbe52cecbf8e6e63c75f755e1432593e483.source: * Use a snare or knock down to keep foes within the area of effect to maximize the damage.
65399dbe52cecbf8e6e63c75f755e1432593e483.text: * 使用圈套或击倒将敌人限制在影响范围内，以最大限度地提高伤害。

5a21c20cb3758d163515b231f02c5548a6d3bd42.source:
* Only attacks (including wanding and attack skills) will trigger this skill's effect.
* This skill grants energy whenever you strike a foe with a condition, i.e it does not end upon hitting a foe who is suffering from a condition.
* Energy gain occurs immediately after the hit.
** Attacks that successfully inflict a condition will cause energy gain whether or not the foe is already suffering a condition.
** If Reap Impurities removes the foe's only condition, it will still cause energy gain.
* Can be very effectively combined with Quickening Zephyr.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its skill revision history for details.
5a21c20cb3758d163515b231f02c5548a6d3bd42.text:
* 只有攻击（包括魔杖和攻击技能）才会触发该技能的效果。
* 每当你攻击患有某种疾病的敌人时，该技能都会赋予能量，也就是说，它不会在击中患有某种疾病的敌人时结束。
* 击中后立即发生能量增益。
** 成功造成某种状况的攻击将导致能量增益，无论敌人是否已经患有某种状况。
** 如果收割杂质消除了敌人的唯一条件，它仍然会导致能量增益。
* 可以与 Quickening Zephyr 非常有效地结合。
* 该技能的功能自推出以来已发生变化；详情请参阅其技能修订历史。

3e24e2fbdacf4006e9ca0a7f85d073870436f85f.source: * As this is the only skill measured in feet, it can be hard to judge the wire’s range. 75' or 900" is just slightly shorter than earshot range, shortbow and spear range, or the size of your aggro bubble.
3e24e2fbdacf4006e9ca0a7f85d073870436f85f.text: * 由于这是唯一以英尺为单位的技能，因此很难判断电线的范围。 75' 或 900" 只比听力范围、短弓和长矛范围或仇恨气泡的大小稍短。

e47ef17c2c6faf65941625343821bafc1404109f.source:
* Deals holy damage.
* This skill will deal damage if an enchantment is renewed, whether by being recast or by reapplying itself (in the cases of Critical Defenses, Lyssa's Aura, and Kinetic Armor).
* This skill is often very effective against Dervishes, since they tend to rely on casting Flash Enchantments on themselves.
e47ef17c2c6faf65941625343821bafc1404109f.text:
* 造成神圣伤害。
* 如果结界被更新，无论是通过重铸还是重新应用自身（在致命防御、莱莎光环和动能护甲的情况下），此技能都会造成伤害。
* 此技能通常对苦行僧非常有效，因为他们往往依赖于对自己施放闪光结界。

86663702eec86694d11132910540a1b36de57631.source:
* The damage from Scourge Healing is applied before the heal. This means that it's possible to kill oneself by using a self-healing skill while hexed by Scourge Healing, if it deals more damage than you have health remaining.
* This skill only affects skills that directly heal (e.g. Ether Feast or Healing Signet). It does not affect health gain via Divine Favor or life stealing, indirect healing via Divine Boon, health regeneration, or similar effects.
This hex does not trigger for Heal Area, Karei's Healing Circle, and Healing Ring.
86663702eec86694d11132910540a1b36de57631.text:
* 天灾治疗造成的伤害会在治疗之前施加。这意味着，如果受到天灾治疗咒语所造成的伤害大于你剩余的生命值，则可以通过使用自我治疗技能来自杀。
* 该技能仅影响直接治疗的技能（例如以太盛宴或治疗徽记）。它不会影响通过神圣恩惠或生命窃取获得的健康、通过神圣恩惠间接治疗、健康再生或类似效果。
该降咒不会为治疗区域、卡雷的治疗圈和治疗环触发。

71a642e6ec5c8dfe05ae106232677e5893add8f1.source: anomaly: This hex does not trigger for Heal Area, Karei's Healing Circle, and Healing Ring.
71a642e6ec5c8dfe05ae106232677e5893add8f1.text: 异常：治疗区域、卡雷的治疗圈和治疗环不会触发该六角形。

b004f546ad2965f98ec54a3abad8883e0e75f482.source: *Particularly effective when used with a Shortbow; you are guaranteed to be within earshot of a non-retreating foe, unless you have a height advantage.
b004f546ad2965f98ec54a3abad8883e0e75f482.text: *与短弓一起使用时特别有效；除非你有高度优势，否则你一定会处于非撤退敌人的听力范围内。

1532da298a47517b469a426bc84df4f550ae9888.source:
* Consider using Fire Attunement, Glowing Gaze, and Glyph of Lesser Energy to compensate for this spell's high energy cost.
* Under Glyph of Immolation, burning is applied to the target before the condition is checked for, so damage will be applied to target. Nearby foes will only suffer burning.
** Intensity can be used to perform half-damage to foes around target in addition to the previous action.
* If your target dies while you are casting Searing Flames, the spell will not fail.
1532da298a47517b469a426bc84df4f550ae9888.text:
* 考虑使用火焰调和、发光凝视和次级能量雕文来补偿该法术的高能量消耗。
* 在献祭雕文下，在检查条件之前会对目标施加燃烧，因此会对目标施加伤害。附近的敌人只会遭受灼伤。
** 除了之前的动作之外，强度还可用于对目标周围的敌人造成一半伤害。
* 如果你的目标在你施放灼热烈焰时死亡，该法术不会失败。

85b7247fac93758d7b851eadd8fa1d9ddd7bbe6b.source:
* You gain energy and health from this skill’s own overcast cost.
* You can quickly build up overcast to a useful amount by activating and canceling this skill a few times.
* This spell takes fractional points of overcast into account. For example, if you cast this skill while you’re not otherwise overcast, you will gain 5 points of overcast as you start casting it. By the time you finish casting it, you will have already regenerated 0.3333333333333333 points of overcast and this skill will give you only 4 energy and 23 health, not 5 energy and 25 health.
* It takes 15 seconds to fully recover from this skill’s overcast cost and maintain a stable level of overcast. When cast every 15 seconds, this skill gives the equivalent of 1 pip of energy regeneration for every 5 points of overcast. For ease of calculation and because fractional points of overcast aren’t visible in the user interface, this table ignores the 0.3333333333333333 point of overcast lost during this skill’s activation time.
