c9fe59dd89bc0609567dd0d551bcb4ff52d312ac.source:
*It is the party members of the target that gets the healing, not those of the caster.
**If used on a minion, all allied minions will receive the health instead of party members.
*Only the party members in compass range of the target will be healed.
*The enchantment ends if the target leaves the caster's compass range.
* Combines well with Shield of Absorption when the target of both enchantments is under heavy attack (e.g. a character tanking).
*Works very well when used on an emo who has a Life Bond on a tank.
*This skill will trigger if the damage received is 0, unlike Essence Bond. 
If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the effects monitor.
The heal amount is based on your rank of Divine Favor at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.
This skill actually causes health gain.
c9fe59dd89bc0609567dd0d551bcb4ff52d312ac.text:
*获得治疗的是目标的队友，而不是施法者。
**如果对小兵使用，则所有盟友小兵都将获得生命值，而不是队员。
*只有目标罗盘范围内的小队成员才会被治愈。
*如果目标离开施法者的罗盘范围，结界就会结束。
* 当两个结界的目标都受到猛烈攻击时（例如角色坦克），与吸收之盾很好地结合在一起。
*当用于坦克上有生命债券的情绪型人时效果非常好。
*与精华羁绊不同，该技能在受到伤害达到0时才会触发。 
如果两个人对一个目标施放此法术，则双方都会生效；然而，效果监视器上只会显示一个结界。
治疗量取决于你每次攻击时而不是初次施法时的神圣恩惠等级，即如果你的属性在结界生效时增加/减少，治疗量将相应改变。
这项技能实际上会带来健康增益。

c3bd910995abc1ac11d27819e16e4260d622bb58.source: anomaly: If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the effects monitor.
c3bd910995abc1ac11d27819e16e4260d622bb58.text: 异常：如果两个人对一个目标施放该法术，则双方都会生效；然而，效果监视器上只会显示一个结界。

1ff2ff70b1a23d5c3c92fce022468da514941864.source: anomaly: The heal amount is based on your rank of Divine Favor at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.
1ff2ff70b1a23d5c3c92fce022468da514941864.text: 异常：治疗量取决于你每次攻击时的神圣恩惠等级，而不是初始施法时的等级，即如果你的属性在结界生效时增加/减少，治疗量将相应改变。

d7c3efbd67be103b014702a340f79ff9cf88b1d2.source: bug: This skill actually causes health gain.
d7c3efbd67be103b014702a340f79ff9cf88b1d2.text: bug：该技能实际上会带来生命值增益。

9455ade4291c94100d595fb54040368beee9a3bc.source: * Practiced Stance can be used to lengthen the skill's short duration, which is, unlike most preparations, shorter than its recharge time.
9455ade4291c94100d595fb54040368beee9a3bc.text: * 练习姿势可用于延长技能的短暂持续时间，与大多数准备工作不同，它比其充电时间短。

913a891d5a907b0881a5e955d2aa637f15b0421b.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
913a891d5a907b0881a5e955d2aa637f15b0421b.text:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。

0602fa6a1094d7710085ee3b71c0f1b5725c393b.source:
* Serpent's Quickness can be maintained indefinitely while the user is enchanted with Dwarven Stability: with a Deldrimor rank of 2, the user needs a Wilderness Survival rank of 12; if the Deldrimor rank is 5 or higher, only rank 8 Wilderness Survival is required.
* Serpent's Quickness will not reduce its own recharge, since stances end before being reapplied.
* Serpent's Quickness will not end unless direct damage is dealt to the player while under 50% health. As such, it will not end early due to health sacrifice or degeneration.
* Serpent's Quickness has a reduced effect on skills with short recharge times due to rounding. For example, Quick Shot's recharge time would be unaffected (i.e. a 33% reduction would be 0.67 seconds, which rounds back up to 1 second).
0602fa6a1094d7710085ee3b71c0f1b5725c393b.text:
* 当用户着迷于矮人稳定性时，蛇的敏捷性可以无限期地保持：德尔德里莫等级为 2，用户需要荒野生存等级为 12；如果Deldrimor等级为5或更高，则只需等级8荒野生存。
*蛇的敏捷不会减少其自身的充能，因为姿势在重新应用之前就会结束。
*除非对生命值低于 50% 的玩家造成直接伤害，否则蛇的敏捷不会结束。因此，它不会因健康牺牲或退化而提前结束。
* 由于四舍五入，蛇的敏捷对充能时间短的技能的效果会降低。例如，快速射击的充电时间将不受影响（即减少 33% 秒为 0.67 秒，四舍五入为 1 秒）。

53b107a74a521dedd6fec1f10c3f97ff4ec6f46f.source:
*This skill will increase Axe Mastery, Dagger Mastery, Hammer Mastery, Marksmanship, Scythe Mastery, Spear Mastery and Swordsmanship regardless of the secondary profession selected and display them in the attributes list while the effect is active.
*Attributes are still capped at rank 20, see Attribute for more details.
53b107a74a521dedd6fec1f10c3f97ff4ec6f46f.text:
*该技能无论选择何种次要职业，都会增加斧术、匕首、锤子、射击、镰刀、枪术和剑术，并在效果生效时将其显示在属性列表中。
*属性上限仍为 20，请参阅属性了解更多详细信息。

3366eddbc90d9594fe97289fc8e4f71b464ccbeb.source:
* The last part of the skill description is superfluous.
* Popular combo with Gash.
3366eddbc90d9594fe97289fc8e4f71b464ccbeb.text:
* 技能说明的最后部分是多余的。
* 与 Gash 的热门组合。

5644092c33bc40661650328e4c54b542de0a6fca.source: * Like all spells, this skill has a 0.75 second aftercast delay.
5644092c33bc40661650328e4c54b542de0a6fca.text: * 与所有法术一样，该技能有 0.75 秒的施法延迟。

8c45a7936268ff737f6b10f104516648680b8476.source:
* Each damage packet's reduction is calculated individually, even from a single skill or attack.
* Health degeneration, life stealing, and health loss are not damage and therefore not affected by the damage reduction or cap.
* Can be used with Protective Spirit for 55 builds, as long as Protective Spirit is (re-)applied before Shadow Form every time.
* Creatures summoned by the caster, such as minions and spirits, deal full damage.
The -5 damage reduction is active for the expected duration of each enchantment, not its actual duration. Refreshing an Assassin enchantment before it ends reduces the received damage by an additional -5.
8c45a7936268ff737f6b10f104516648680b8476.text:
* 每个伤害包的减少量都是单独计算的，即使是单个技能或攻击。
* 生命值退化、生命偷取和生命值损失不是伤害，因此不受伤害减免或上限的影响。
* 可与防护精神一起使用 55 次构建，只要每次在暗影形态之前（重新）应用防护精神即可。
* 施法者召唤的生物，例如小兵和精魂，会造成全额伤害。
-5 伤害减免在每个结界的预期持续时间内有效，而不是其实际持续时间。在刺客结界结束前刷新它会额外减少 -5 点受到的伤害。

0ed146864ddcadd56bed12fd65b6aa6e879cf6fd.source: bug: The -5 damage reduction is active for the expected duration of each enchantment, not its actual duration. Refreshing an Assassin enchantment before it ends reduces the received damage by an additional -5.
0ed146864ddcadd56bed12fd65b6aa6e879cf6fd.text: bug：-5 伤害减免在每个结界的预期持续时间内有效，而不是其实际持续时间。在刺客结界结束前刷新它会额外减少 -5 点受到的伤害。

96c26e27c7d8c7cba1281bbd41ec1da9188cd9ff.source: *As the recharge time of spells can never be reduced by more than 50%, there is no way to permanently maintain this skill without outside assistance due to its short duration. While Deadly Paradox, Arcane Echo and Arcane Mimicry can be used to prolong the duration, they are insufficient to maintain Shadow Form.
96c26e27c7d8c7cba1281bbd41ec1da9188cd9ff.text: *由于法术的充能时间永远不会减少超过50%，因此由于持续时间短，没有外部帮助就无法永久维持该技能。虽然致命悖论、奥术回响和奥术拟态可以用来延长持续时间，但它们不足以维持暗影形态。

642731b34ec680b2f0950c2b8cc5b19e1818845a.source:
* You cannot maintain multiple copies of Shadow Meld. 
* You shadow step when you return to your initial location.
This spell does not have an aftercast delay.
642731b34ec680b2f0950c2b8cc5b19e1818845a.text:
* 您无法维护 Shadow Meld 的多个副本。 
* 当您返回初始位置时，您会进行影子步。
该法术没有施法延迟。

a13aa3c38cfd50390653ad72b69a3e34c9a2c5b7.source:
* Use a cancel stance to control when this ends.
* Re-using this skill before it ends resets the original location.
a13aa3c38cfd50390653ad72b69a3e34c9a2c5b7.text:
* 使用取消姿势来控制何时结束。
* 在结束前再次使用该技能会重置原始位置。

efe3515755277057632a8d478d78e2866328f210.source:
* The shadow step and the hex are considered separate effects:
**If the shadow step fails (i.e. if the target is in an inaccessible location), the target will still be affected by the movement speed hex.
**If the hex fails (i.e. the target is under the effects of Hex Breaker), you will still shadow step to the target.
efe3515755277057632a8d478d78e2866328f210.text:
* 阴影步和六角形被视为独立的效果：
**如果暗影步失败（即目标位于无法到达的位置），目标仍会受到移动速度降咒的影响。
**如果降咒失败（即目标受到降咒破坏者的影响），你仍然会暗影步到目标。

2b47fef815d748d75e2e26a1ba275fa616c4b37d.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*Combines well with Asuran Scan on martial classes.
2b47fef815d748d75e2e26a1ba275fa616c4b37d.text:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
*与武术课上的阿苏兰扫描完美结合。

b65866f995a22d68079703a3d59ef9fa29308467.source:
* Creatures affected by the shroud can still cast enchantments that do not require targeting (e.g. Shadow Form or Conjure Flame).
* Foes with this hex cannot be targeted by enchantment spells that target a foe, like Ice Spear.
b65866f995a22d68079703a3d59ef9fa29308467.text:
* 受裹尸布影响的生物仍然可以施放不需要瞄准的结界（例如暗影形态或召唤火焰）。
* 具有此六角形的敌人无法成为以敌人为目标的结界法术的目标，例如冰矛。

f0f3d8c9be29759cd8be25981ecacebe2bbcf8b2.source:
* Shadow Theft can buff itself. This can be done at rank 16 by casting it just as it recharges, raising the duration to 25s and attribute increase to 6.
* The attribute reduction effect persists if the caster dies.
* With at least rank 14 Critical Strikes, Shadow Theft will push the Critical Strikes attribute over rank 18 which is the threshold to gain 4 energy per critical hit.
* This skill only increases the primary profession's primary attribute and primary and secondary profession's secondary attributes, it doesn't increase attributes obtained through blessings or Seven Weapons Stance.
f0f3d8c9be29759cd8be25981ecacebe2bbcf8b2.text:
* 暗影盗窃可以增强自身。这可以在等级 16 时通过在充电时施放来完成，将持续时间提高到 25 秒，属性增加到 6。
* 如果施法者死亡，属性减少效果仍然存在。
* 在暴击等级至少为 14 的情况下，暗影盗窃会将暴击属性推至等级 18 以上，这是每次暴击获得 4 能量的阈值。
* 该技能仅增加主职业的主属性以及主副职业的副属性，不会增加通过祝福或七兵势获得的属性。

0dd71217866b248789755063b11ad4647f354506.source:
* Consider bringing a cancel stance so that you get to choose when you return to your activation location.
* If you reuse this skill before its duration ends (for example, through recharge from Morale Boost), you will shadow step to the second target (as expected), but you will return to your original location (from the first time you used the skill).
* When the stance ends, the character is returned to his original location via shadow step.
* Avoid using with adrenaline attack skills; the adrenaline will be lost when those skills are disabled.
* This is the only shadow step skill that teleports you to your target and lacks an aftercast delay, which allows you to attack your target instantly. Since Shadow Walk disables your attack skills, it is not commonly used with martial professions; however, spellcaster professions that rely on close combat skills, such as Star Burst or saccers that rely on Death Nova, may find this skill useful.
0dd71217866b248789755063b11ad4647f354506.text:
* 考虑带上取消姿势，以便您可以在返回激活位置时进行选择。
* 如果您在持续时间结束之前重复使用该技能（例如，通过士气提升进行充能），您将暗影步到第二个目标（如预期），但您将返回到原来的位置（从您第一次使用该技能开始）。
* 当姿态结束时，角色会通过暗影步回到原来的位置。
*避免与肾上腺素攻击技能一起使用；当这些技能被禁用时，肾上腺素就会消失。
* 这是唯一一个可以将你传送到目标并且没有施法延迟的暗影步技能，可以让你立即攻击目标。由于暗影行走会禁用你的攻击技能，因此它不常用于武术职业；然而，依赖近战技能的施法者职业，例如星爆或依赖死亡新星的法杖，可能会发现这个技能很有用。

2f220d0295a714b4373a9f73cffd1ead8fd20786.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Shadowsong that uses the Shadowsong attack skill. 
The non-concise description states that the "spirit dies after 30 second" instead of using the plural "seconds" with Communing rank 0 and 1.
2f220d0295a714b4373a9f73cffd1ead8fd20786.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用影歌攻击技能的影歌之魂。 
不简洁的描述指出“灵魂在 30 秒后死亡”，而不是使用复数“秒”，通信等级为 0 和 1。

1c78f6c6b00a9146e006382d6d24af77aea77927.source: bug: The non-concise description states that the "spirit dies after 30 second" instead of using the plural "seconds" with Communing rank 0 and 1.
1c78f6c6b00a9146e006382d6d24af77aea77927.text: bug：不简洁的描述指出“灵魂在 30 秒后死亡”，而不是使用复数“秒”，通信等级为 0 和 1。

824206f93888615e191f0aa56d370a543f884cc8.source: The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the armor cap and the effects of Cracked Armor and Armor Penetration.
824206f93888615e191f0aa56d370a543f884cc8.text: 该技能的护甲减值会在护甲上限以及护甲破裂和护甲穿透的效果之后应用。

52ce56565911d93c1c4541bb65e93764f1bc3d88.source: anomaly: The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the armor cap and the effects of Cracked Armor and Armor Penetration.
52ce56565911d93c1c4541bb65e93764f1bc3d88.text: 异常：该技能的护甲减值是在护甲上限以及护甲破裂和护甲穿透效果之后施加的。

793e063ef33ac71e7a3baebef076d5fbfc27ac57.source: * This is the only player skill that increases the movement speed of a foe.
793e063ef33ac71e7a3baebef076d5fbfc27ac57.text: * 这是唯一可以提高敌人移动速度的玩家技能。

f03427f2b1bae34c0ade7c891fb0cbf22fa73962.source:
* Bleeding will cover conditions inflicted by attack skills.
* If using with Apply Poison, Poison will cover bleeding. If using with Poison Tip Signet, the conditions apply in order, so bleeding will cover poison if Sharpen Daggers is applied second.
* Attacks while wielding daggers will trigger the bleeding, so Melee Attacks are included.
** Secondary targets for skills such as Golden Phoenix Strike or Death Blossom do NOT trigger the bleeding.
** Combine with Whirlwind Attack to apply bleeding on a large scale.
If a ranged weapon is swapped for daggers after the attack was made and before the projectile hit, Sharpen Daggers will count this projectile hit as a dagger attack.
f03427f2b1bae34c0ade7c891fb0cbf22fa73962.text:
* 流血将涵盖攻击技能造成的状况。
* 如果与Apply Poison一起使用，Poison会覆盖出血。如果与毒尖印章一起使用，则条件按顺序适用，因此如果其次使用锐化匕首，出血将覆盖毒药。
* 挥舞匕首时的攻击会引发流血，因此包含近战攻击。
** 金凤击或死亡绽放等技能的次要目标不会触发流血。
** 与旋风攻击结合使用可造成大范围出血。
如果在攻击后、射弹击中之前将远程武器替换为匕首，则锐化匕首会将此次射弹击中视为匕首攻击。

83fa1beaaccc0d97d197eb8d12d7811a9fc82499.source: bug: If a ranged weapon is swapped for daggers after the attack was made and before the projectile hit, Sharpen Daggers will count this projectile hit as a dagger attack.
83fa1beaaccc0d97d197eb8d12d7811a9fc82499.text: bug：如果在攻击后、射弹击中之前将远程武器更换为匕首，锐化匕首会将这次射弹击中视为匕首攻击。

b05f47929e77f6ecc4d8351f5035432cac38b0ea.source:
* Combines well with Mesmer hexes that have an effect upon ending, such as Phantom Pain.
* Since the foe is targeted before the hex is removed, the energy loss and damage from Mind Wrack will still trigger.
b05f47929e77f6ecc4d8351f5035432cac38b0ea.text:
* 与对结束有效果的催眠咒很好地结合，例如幻痛。
* 由于敌人在六角形被移除之前就已成为目标，因此心灵毁灭的能量损失和伤害仍然会触发。

0965a8aa2efeda24960865ed6ee45d6a1720b1ee.source:
* Combines well with Ether Phantom, Overload, Phantom Pain, Shrinking Armor, Wastrel's Demise, and Web of Disruption.
* Be careful if you are partied with several other Mesmers. On one hand, you have a good chance of being able to use this skill on any target, at any time. On the other hand, you may remove a well-planned hex placed by an ally who won't appreciate your undoing of their hex.
0965a8aa2efeda24960865ed6ee45d6a1720b1ee.text:
* 与以太幻影、过载、幻痛、收缩护甲、废物之灭亡和破坏之网完美结合。
* 如果您与其他几位幻术师一起组队，请务必小心。一方面，你很有可能随时对任何目标使用此技能。另一方面，你可能会移除一个盟友精心策划的六角形，而他们不会欣赏你撤销他们的六角形。

62269d94bf10f9409b5a344ced773e242039c65f.source: * This skill removes the enchantment before applying the damage.
62269d94bf10f9409b5a344ced773e242039c65f.text: * 此技能会在造成伤害之前移除结界。

bdc0eede73ce20141b85ab2ec6f6ac956b8ccd30.source:
* The AI will prioritize targets with foes in range.
* The AI will only use this on party members, not other allies.
bdc0eede73ce20141b85ab2ec6f6ac956b8ccd30.text:
*人工智能将优先考虑范围内有敌人的目标。
* AI只会对队员使用此功能，而不会对其他盟友使用。

ad43c4e255061c1e832b130b5814188c29e51fa9.source:
* Each of the two attacks removes an enchantment after dealing damage.
This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.
ad43c4e255061c1e832b130b5814188c29e51fa9.text:
* 两次攻击都会在造成伤害后移除结界。
该技能将匕首的攻击伤害替换为规定的伤害，这是非无视护甲的伤害（与分散射击和针刺射击等其他攻击技能不同）。该伤害受到匕首掌握、暴击、护甲穿透、铭文和铭文等效武器伤害加值以及目标护甲等级的影响，但不受益于定制伤害加值。

c639c422a8196a579ab517a6d8c2ee9b3d21c3a7.source: bug: This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.
c639c422a8196a579ab517a6d8c2ee9b3d21c3a7.text: bug：该技能将匕首的攻击伤害替换为规定的伤害，这是非无视护甲的伤害（与其他攻击技能如分散射击和针刺射击不同）。该伤害受到匕首掌握、暴击、护甲穿透、铭文和铭文等效武器伤害加值以及目标护甲等级的影响，但不受益于自定义伤害加值。

0094391c1e528c8306e4a2cf1c0e5e58582f674d.source:
* Consider using with skills that require a Water Magic hex for a decent spike, such as Freezing Gust.
* Unlike Incendiary Bonds, Lightning Strike, and Lightning Surge, removing Shatterstone prematurely using a hex removal skill will still trigger the end effect damage.
* The additional damage will occur if the target dies before the hex expires.
0094391c1e528c8306e4a2cf1c0e5e58582f674d.text:
* 考虑使用需要水魔法六角形才能获得不错的峰值的技能，例如冰冻阵风。
* 与燃烧债券、闪电打击和闪电涌动不同，使用六角形移除技能过早移除碎石仍然会触发最终效果伤害。
* 如果目标在魔法失效之前死亡，则会产生额外伤害。

df9072e78717f47083f962e8858346e6350c9d73.source: * Like Lightning Hammer, Cracked Armor is applied after calculating damage.
df9072e78717f47083f962e8858346e6350c9d73.text: * 与闪电之锤一样，裂甲是在计算伤害后应用的。

980920d49336f619deed7ac3cd1e9f87ded3d64d.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Shelter at the user's location and removes any previous allied Spirit of Shelter.
* Often used with Displacement and Union to provide superior damage reduction.
** Shelter and Union's effects are applied in the order they're created. For maximum damage reduction, always cast Shelter before Union.
* If Protective Spirit is applied on a target before Shelter is cast, the spirit does not lose health when the target would have taken high damage.
Armor of Unfeeling will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its damage mitigation effect.
While skill descriptions state "attacks", damage from spells and signets is also reduced.
Shelter's effect persists briefly after it prevents damage in a way that would have killed it (video).
980920d49336f619deed7ac3cd1e9f87ded3d64d.text:
* 该技能会在用户所在位置创建一个庇护之灵，并移除任何先前的盟友庇护之灵。
* 通常与位移和联合一起使用，以提供卓越的伤害减少。
** 庇护所和联盟的效果按照它们创建的顺序应用。为了最大限度地减少伤害，请始终在联合之前施放庇护所。
* 如果在施放庇护所之前对目标施加保护精神，则当目标受到高伤害时，精神不会失去生命值。
无情之甲会减少该精神因其减伤效果而造成的生命值损失。
虽然技能描述中注明“攻击”，但法术和徽记造成的伤害也会减少。
庇护所的效果在以一种可能杀死它的方式防止伤害后会短暂持续（视频）。

77d3bfe608be08b60236ecdf101d66ec03cccce0.source: anomaly: Armor of Unfeeling will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its damage mitigation effect.
77d3bfe608be08b60236ecdf101d66ec03cccce0.text: 异常：无情之甲会减少该精神因其减伤效果而造成的生命值损失。

ee79d6acd3a765d9b9e72ae86fc61df202a980a7.source: anomaly: While skill descriptions state "attacks", damage from spells and signets is also reduced.
ee79d6acd3a765d9b9e72ae86fc61df202a980a7.text: 异常：虽然技能描述中注明“攻击”，但法术和徽记造成的伤害也会减少。

8e03e739d60233f21976a43bdffb348bb86d71a6.source: anomaly: Shelter's effect persists briefly after it prevents damage in a way that would have killed it (video).
8e03e739d60233f21976a43bdffb348bb86d71a6.text: 异常现象：庇护所的效果在以一种可能杀死它的方式防止伤害后会短暂持续（视频）。

12efbe57fc67ef2118c08fb4d3c50818d0ac0857.source:
*This skill creates a Spirit of Shelter at the user's location and removes any previous allied Spirit of Shelter.
*If Protective Spirit is applied on a target before Shelter is cast, the spirit does not lose health when the target would have taken high damage.
While skill descriptions state "attacks", damage from spells and signets is also reduced.
12efbe57fc67ef2118c08fb4d3c50818d0ac0857.text:
*此技能会在用户所在位置创建一个庇护之灵，并移除任何先前的盟友庇护之灵。
*如果在施放庇护所之前对目标施加保护精神，则当目标受到高伤害时，精神不会失去生命值。
虽然技能描述中注明“攻击”，但法术和徽记造成的伤害也会减少。

13852df0c75cbad0c5388bd7742a849017fef7fc.source:
* Often used by secondary warriors in PvP for several reasons :
** Like most skills without an activation time, this skill can be used while knocked down.
** This skill is still useful with 0 rank in Strength as the attribute rank only affects its duration and not its effect on foes.
** If struck by a melee attack skill that cannot be blocked while Shield Bash is active, the attacker is still knocked down and the skill still suffers the increased recharge. 
* Especially effective against Assassins due to their unique attack skill system, but also against opponents using skills with conditional effect (e.g warriors) if their keystone skill is disabled.
13852df0c75cbad0c5388bd7742a849017fef7fc.text:
* 经常被 PvP 中的次要战士使用，原因如下：
** 与大多数没有启动时间的技能一样，该技能可以在被击倒时使用。
** 该技能在力量等级0的情况下仍然有用，因为属性等级只影响其持续时间，而不影响对敌人的效果。
** 如果在盾击激活时被无法格挡的近战攻击技能击中，攻击者仍然会被击倒，并且该技能仍然会受到增加的充能效果。 
* 由于其独特的攻击技能系统，对刺客特别有效，而且如果他们的基石技能被禁用，也对使用具有条件效果的技能的对手（例如战士）有效。

e08eedaab904883cef26996f75d05ba87418aeec.source:
* If one party member blocks an attack, the enchantment ends only on that party member (the healing can potentially trigger for each affected party member if they block an attack).
* Healing is within earshot of the ally that blocked.
e08eedaab904883cef26996f75d05ba87418aeec.text:
* 如果一名队员阻挡攻击，则结界仅对该队员结束（如果每个受影响的队员阻挡攻击，则可能会触发治疗）。
* 治疗是在阻挡的盟友的听力范围内。

6bbb4c7e23c4cb7ae074833c93401f3d602d482b.source:
* The damage reduction increases with every hit received. Damage from the first hit will be reduced by 5, damage from the second by 10, damage from the third by 15 and so on, until the enchantment ends or is recast.
* This skill is particularly useful for a tank absorbing a lot of damage. For a low armor rating tank being hit rapidly, coupling this skill with Spirit Bond is extremely beneficial, as Spirit Bond takes care of sustaining the tank at first, and thereafter Shield of Absorption usually reduces any damage to zero.
* Combines well with Seed of Life when the target of both enchantments is under heavy attack (e.g. a character tanking).
* One of the better enchantments to use with any way of extending Monk Enchantments, such as the Of Enchanting Weapon upgrade and Blessed Aura due to how this enchantment improves its effectiveness the longer it lasts.
* For characters upholding Melandru's Accord, unlocking Tahlkora will not unlock this skill for other heroes or skill trainers. As a result, it only becomes available much later in Nightfall, in the Desolation or the Gate of Torment instead of Istan.
6bbb4c7e23c4cb7ae074833c93401f3d602d482b.text:
* 每次受到攻击时，伤害减免都会增加。第一次命中的伤害将减少 5，第二次的伤害将减少 10，第三次的伤害将减少 15，依此类推，直到结界结束或重铸。
* 此技能对于吸收大量伤害的坦克特别有用。对于被快速击中的低装甲等级坦克来说，将此技能与精神束缚结合起来是非常有益的，因为精神束缚首先负责维持坦克，然后吸收护盾通常会将任何伤害降至零。
* 当两个结界的目标都受到猛烈攻击时（例如角色坦克），与生命之种很好地结合。
* 与任何扩展武僧附魔的方式一起使用的更好的附魔之一，例如附魔武器升级和祝福光环，因为这种附魔如何随着持续时间的延长而提高其有效性。
* 对于维护梅兰德鲁协议的角色，解锁塔尔科拉不会为其他英雄或技能训练师解锁该技能。因此，它只能在黄昏之后、荒凉之地或折磨之门而不是伊斯坦中使用。

6279c5b44be221d38a283b8ec7eb5008ef061916.source: *Queue this skill while knocked down to avoid being quarterknocked.
6279c5b44be221d38a283b8ec7eb5008ef061916.text: *在被击倒时排队该技能以避免被击倒。

23791f1e4b82de0a8a0ea82b81934810fb2032d9.source:
* This spell is occasionally used for the 55 Monk build.
* Perpetually maintainable using Arcane Echo and a 20% of Enchanting weapon mod.
* If this is cast on an ally that turns hostile, such as a minion, then any allies attacking the enemy will be knocked down but not take any damage.
Shield of Judgment will not be listed in the damage monitor if its damage is reduced to 0.
The concise description states that foes attacking target ally will be knocked down and suffer damage; however, this effect only occurs when the target ally is successfully hit.
23791f1e4b82de0a8a0ea82b81934810fb2032d9.text:
* 该法术偶尔会用于 55 武僧版本。
* 使用奥术回声和 20% 附魔武器模组可永久维护。
* 如果此技能施放于敌对的盟友（例如小兵）上，则任何攻击敌人的盟友都会被击倒，但不会受到任何伤害。
如果审判之盾的伤害降低至 0，则不会出现在伤害监视器中。
简洁的描述表明，攻击目标盟友的敌人会被击倒并受到伤害；然而，此效果仅在成功击中目标盟友时才会发生。

8affaef6c18be4634f7a57aca41b4f0e699049f5.source: bug: Shield of Judgment will not be listed in the damage monitor if its damage is reduced to 0.
8affaef6c18be4634f7a57aca41b4f0e699049f5.text: bug：如果审判之盾的伤害降低到0，则不会出现在伤害监视器中。

0d0782b75e034ce70c14cae71749fb6112236bff.source: anomaly: The concise description states that foes attacking target ally will be knocked down and suffer damage; however, this effect only occurs when the target ally is successfully hit.
0d0782b75e034ce70c14cae71749fb6112236bff.text: 异常：简洁的描述表明攻击目标盟友的敌人会被击倒并受到伤害；然而，此效果仅在成功击中目标盟友时才会发生。

38ff9b961c60e521b2c128f6fce99ba71d6844a3.source:
* Because this is not a spell, this will not count toward the 10-spell limit on Glyph of Elemental Power or 1…3…3-spell limit on Glyph of Energy, but will still get the stat boost.
* Frequently used by melee characters, especially warrior and assassin, to meet the knocked-down target requirement of certain skills. The touch range is not an issue.
**Warriors can extend the knockdown by 1 second using a Stonefist Insignia.
**Warriors relying on Adrenaline will not mind the overcast toll.
**The knockdown will occur at Air Magic 0.
**Can be used while blinded or affected by anti-melee hexes such as Ineptitude. Additionally, it cannot be blocked.
38ff9b961c60e521b2c128f6fce99ba71d6844a3.text:
* 因为这不是法术，所以不会计入元素力量雕文的 10 法术限制或能量雕文的 1…3…3 法术限制，但仍会获得统计提升。
* 近战角色经常使用，尤其是战士和刺客，以满足某些技能击倒目标的要求。触摸范围不是问题。
**战士可以使用石拳徽章将击倒时间延长 1 秒。
**依赖肾上腺素的战士不会介意阴天。
**击倒将发生在Air Magic 0。
**可以在失明或受到反近战咒语（例如无能）影响时使用。此外，它无法被阻止。

d59011202271ccad93661e80d1259489f224d1a6.source: * The projectile from this spell has the same trajectory as - and moves slightly faster than - an arrow fired from a Shortbow.
d59011202271ccad93661e80d1259489f224d1a6.text: * 此法术发射的射弹与短弓射出的箭具有相同的轨迹，并且移动速度稍快。

3a4059b3c31fbb3c4cd338564e108834fef37a60.source:
*The damage is delivered in three independent packets. Adjacent foes are hit three times, nearby foes twice, and foes in the area only once.
**One-time damage reduction skills, such as Reversal of Fortune, and damage cappers, such Protective Spirit, do not fully protect against this skill, however skills that protect against multiple packets, such as Union, are more effective.
**Pain Inverter will deal damage back for each packet.
*Cracked Armor is applied before any damage.
The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.
3a4059b3c31fbb3c4cd338564e108834fef37a60.text:
*损坏的物品以三个独立的包裹交付。相邻的敌人会被击中 3 次，附近的敌人会被击中两次，而该区域内的敌人只会被击中一次。
**一次性减伤技能，如逆运，以及伤害封顶，如守护之灵，并不能完全防御该技能，但防御多个包的技能，如联盟，效果更佳。
**疼痛逆变器将为每个数据包造成伤害。
*破裂的护甲是在任何伤害之前应用的。
技能描述暗示“盲”覆盖了“破甲”，而“破甲”又覆盖了“弱点”，而实际上“盲”覆盖了“弱点”，而“弱点”又覆盖了“破甲”。

7542775152a7dff974a0d34edb34b4ed521ac673.source: anomaly: The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.
7542775152a7dff974a0d34edb34b4ed521ac673.text: 异常：技能描述中暗示“盲”覆盖了“破甲”，而“破甲”又覆盖了“弱点”，而实际上“盲”覆盖了“弱点”，又覆盖了“破甲”。

b31ff98d484d21df214952c5eabceb89c1686d18.source: This skill has no aftercast delay.
b31ff98d484d21df214952c5eabceb89c1686d18.text: 该技能没有施法后延迟。

c088ecd720342a91ee20f42fe3b572365aa32be1.source: * Cracked Armor can be applied earlier using Shatter Delusions or Drain Delusions.
c088ecd720342a91ee20f42fe3b572365aa32be1.text: * 可以使用破碎妄想或吸取妄想来更早地应用裂纹护甲。

a3d8cd013806e6d562bf3cfac7ffc0c100833eab.source:
When having less than 50% health, the block chance applies immediately while the health regeneration is delayed. Using any skill or swapping from a vampiric weapon to a non-vampiric one will provide you the proper health regeneration immediately.
* Heroes usually will wait until their health is below 30%, rather than below 50%, to start casting this, and they do not reserve energy to cast it. This typically means that heroes will die without ever managing to successfully cast it.
a3d8cd013806e6d562bf3cfac7ffc0c100833eab.text:
当生命值低于 50% 时，格挡几率立即生效，同时生命值恢复会延迟。使用任何技能或从吸血鬼武器更换为非吸血鬼武器都会立即为您提供适当的生命恢复。
*英雄通常会等到生命值低于30%而不是低于50%时才开始施放此技能，并且他们不会储备能量来施放此技能。这通常意味着英雄将在无法成功施放它的情况下死亡。

bbd536889ac9fe97e4d8c4a8882988e04a51b1dc.source: bug: When having less than 50% health, the block chance applies immediately while the health regeneration is delayed. Using any skill or swapping from a vampiric weapon to a non-vampiric one will provide you the proper health regeneration immediately.
bbd536889ac9fe97e4d8c4a8882988e04a51b1dc.text: bug：当生命值低于 50% 时，格挡几率会立即生效，而生命值恢复会延迟。使用任何技能或从吸血鬼武器更换为非吸血鬼武器都会立即为您提供适当的生命恢复。

b45c8ccfdfe002499fbb3379668ff5d7272e8c2c.source:
* This skill will remove existing Blindness when applied, although this is not stated in its description. This is similar to other skills that provide immunity to a condition, except for Frigid Armor.
* When used with Spirit's Strength, it functions both as a good cover enchantment and an insurance against being Blinded.
b45c8ccfdfe002499fbb3379668ff5d7272e8c2c.text:
* 该技能在应用时将消除现有的失明，尽管其描述中没有说明。这与其他提供对某种状况免疫的技能类似，除了冰冷护甲之外。
* 当与精神之力一起使用时，它既可以作为良好的掩护结界，又可以防止被致盲。

cc2edccff4f034f6cd1d30f316448303b9a0f01a.source:
* Is useful between battles to build and maintain adrenaline and start the next battle with all adrenaline skills charged.
** "I Am the Strongest" is good for this due to its incredibly long duration. 
* Has synergy with the Warrior Shout "For Great Justice!".
cc2edccff4f034f6cd1d30f316448303b9a0f01a.text:
* 在战斗之间非常有用，可以建立和维持肾上腺素，并在所有肾上腺素技能已满的情况下开始下一场战斗。
** “我是最强的”非常适合这个，因为它的持续时间非常长。 
* 与战士呼喊“为了伟大的正义！”有协同作用。

447632febfb2db78441bd3d5f4eb88af3163e21c.source:
*When used with Contagion and Dark Aura, Dark Aura's damage will be triggered twice.
*Can be followed with Unholy Feast to quickly recover the lost health and for additional AoE damage.
*Consider bringing Plague Touch or Plague Sending to transfer the bleeding.
*This skill is commonly used by Saccers to force-trigger Death Nova.
*The AI will only use this skill if at least two foes are within range.
447632febfb2db78441bd3d5f4eb88af3163e21c.text:
*与传染和黑暗光环一起使用时，黑暗光环的伤害会触发两次。
*可以在邪恶盛宴之后快速恢复损失的生命值并造成额外的 AoE 伤害。
*考虑使用瘟疫之触或瘟疫传送来转移出血。
*此技能常被射手用来强制触发死亡新星。
*只有至少有两个敌人在范围内时，人工智能才会使用此技能。

3cd12b581a3b033f9a8ee870c192cb4b1642ffec.source:
* When used with Contagion and Dark Aura, Dark Aura's damage will be triggered twice.
* Can be followed with Unholy Feast to quickly recover the lost health and for additional AoE damage.
* Consider bringing Plague Touch or Plague Sending to transfer the bleeding.
3cd12b581a3b033f9a8ee870c192cb4b1642ffec.text:
* 与传染和黑暗光环一起使用时，黑暗光环的伤害会触发两次。
* 可以在邪恶盛宴之后快速恢复损失的生命值并造成额外的 AoE 伤害。
* 考虑使用瘟疫之触或瘟疫传送来转移出血。

f3a124648d51ab70d15b6f6da9bdf61442264d6f.source:
* As it only works on enemy-controlled spirits, hostile NPC spirits that are not controlled by another creature will not be affected by this skill. Examples of such spirits are:
** Spirit of Portals.
** Binding Guardians.
** The Ritualist spirits that appear in Slavers' Exile and Oola's Lab.
** The four spirits in Mallyx's chamber in the The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
* If this skill fails due to low Spawning Power, the user does not lose health.
Spirits taken control of with this skill ignore the restriction of having multiple allied spirits of the same name within range of each other. The restriction will however be correctly applied should the spirit be teleported via Draw Spirit, Swap or Summon Spirits, preserving only the most recent spirit.
f3a124648d51ab70d15b6f6da9bdf61442264d6f.text:
* 由于该技能仅对敌方控制的精魂起作用，因此非其他生物控制的敌对NPC精魂不会受到该技能的影响。此类精神的例子有：
** 传送门之魂。
** 绑定监护人。
** 奴隶放逐者和乌拉实验室中出现的仪式灵魂。
** 马里克斯乌木城堡中马里克斯房间中的四个灵魂。
* 如果该技能因生成力低而失败，用户不会损失生命值。
通过该技能控制的战魂无视范围内有多个同名战魂的限制。然而，如果通过抽取灵魂、交换或召唤灵魂来传送灵魂，则该限制将被正确应用，仅保留最近的灵魂。

8c7e80ed64fc0488c8942478b6fbc90b1c2ac301.source: anomaly: Spirits taken control of with this skill ignore the restriction of having multiple allied spirits of the same name within range of each other. The restriction will however be correctly applied should the spirit be teleported via Draw Spirit, Swap or Summon Spirits, preserving only the most recent spirit.
8c7e80ed64fc0488c8942478b6fbc90b1c2ac301.text: 异常：用该技能控制的战魂无视范围内有多个同名友方战魂的限制。然而，如果通过抽取灵魂、交换或召唤灵魂来传送灵魂，则该限制将被正确应用，仅保留最近的灵魂。

8269c815eacb12b882d4dedd33017b419fc3f776.source:
* Each time a character learns a new elite, they gain another point of progress in the relevant Skill Hunter title track.
* Unlike other skills, it is possible to obtain multiple copies of Signet of Capture.
* This skill counts as a PvE skill:
** It cannot be equipped for PvP or by heroes.
** You can equip up to three copies of this signet on your skill bar.
** Although this allows you to have multiple elites after capturing, when you zone, you will be left with only one elite.
*** The game will drop any extra elites on the left side of the skill bar.
*** You may rearrange your skills so that the skill you wish to keep is on the right before you zone.
* This skill cannot be Echoed, unlocked, or learned by using a skill tome.
* Non-fleshy bosses leave a spot on the ground rather than a visible corpse.

Signet of Capture's actual range is larger than earshot.

=== Dialogue (if no skills for your professions) ===
: No valid skills were found. You can only capture skills that correspond to your profession.
8269c815eacb12b882d4dedd33017b419fc3f776.text:
* 每次角色学习新的精英时，他们都会在相关的技能猎人标题曲目中获得另一个进步点。
* 与其他技能不同，捕获印章可以获得多份。
* 该技能算作 PvE 技能：
** 它不能为 PvP 或英雄装备。
** 您的技能栏上最多可以装备三个此印章。
** 虽然这允许你在占领后拥有多个精英，但当你进行分区时，你将只剩下一个精英。
*** 游戏将在技能栏左侧掉落任何额外的精英。
*** 您可以重新排列您的技能，以便您希望保留的技能位于您区域之前的右侧。
* 该技能无法回显、解锁或通过使用技能书学习。
* 非肉身的 Boss 会在地面上留下一个点，而不是一具可见的尸体。

捕获纹章的实际范围比听觉范围还要大。

=== 对话（如果没有适合您职业的技能）===
：没有找到有效的技能。您只能获得与您的职业相对应的技能。

66d8283616e9fd3ce1621ad3d8ecd260e8079a83.source: anomaly: The skill trainers in Lion's Arch, Camp Rankor, Vasburg Armory, and Ascalon Settlement in North Kryta Province do not sell this skill. Tyrian (Prophecies) characters can purchase a Signet of Capture in Lion's Arch from Magi Malaquire.
66d8283616e9fd3ce1621ad3d8ecd260e8079a83.text: 异常：北科瑞塔省的狮子拱门、兰克营、瓦斯堡军械库、阿斯卡隆定居点的技能训练师不出售该技能。泰瑞安（预言）角色可以在狮子拱门向玛吉·马拉奎尔购买捕获徽记。

2049a0207889040d502fd3ca2a0d54a81f6f0f1d.source: anomaly: Signet of Capture's actual range is larger than earshot.
2049a0207889040d502fd3ca2a0d54a81f6f0f1d.text: 异常：捕获纹章的实际范围比听觉范围大。

10e80a251584e2ff4d5dd4adf5253df443bd9e4f.source:
* If under the effects of a skill which prevents interruption, the target will not be knocked down yet will still receive damage.
* The full description is incorrect. Adjacent foes that are attacking will still be interrupted even if target foe is not attacking, and they will not take damage unless interrupted.
10e80a251584e2ff4d5dd4adf5253df443bd9e4f.text:
* 如果处于防打断技能效果下，目标不会被击倒，但仍会受到伤害。
* 完整描述不正确。即使目标敌人没有攻击，正在攻击的相邻敌人仍然会被打断，并且除非被打断，否则他们不会受到伤害。

e5d089fc1d585d7e0417eaa0df6aaf5bcc274d83.source: * If under the effects of a skill which prevents interruption, the target will not be knocked down yet will still receive damage.
e5d089fc1d585d7e0417eaa0df6aaf5bcc274d83.text: * 如果处于防打断技能效果下，目标不会被击倒，但仍会受到伤害。

29abcb030add7b2ec74bee0c1ea4824d67185112.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*Works well with Suffering and Ether Nightmare, and for mobs with disease
29abcb030add7b2ec74bee0c1ea4824d67185112.text:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
*适用于痛苦和以太梦魇，以及患有疾病的生物

352b19611cab24b1b7820d36c0a119517b2f1c7f.source: * The skill counts spirits and minions, but does not count creatures summoned by Asura summoning skills, Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support, or by summoning stones.
352b19611cab24b1b7820d36c0a119517b2f1c7f.text: * 该技能计算精灵和小兵，但不计算阿修罗召唤技能、黑锋先锋刺客支援或召唤石召唤的生物。

5366b4eff6f4d402e1dd1aa2cf7f0c77f1721c13.source: *If the target has zero conditions, the skill will deal an instance of 0 damage.
5366b4eff6f4d402e1dd1aa2cf7f0c77f1721c13.text: *如果目标状态为零，该技能将造成一次0点伤害。

704fb075b444a4e75e81b3f9902bf8a087ebbd61.source:
* One of the few skills that can remove enchantments that prevent spell targeting.
* To minimize the skill's downside:
** Hide energy.
** Alternatively, cast an energy regeneration skill before using the signet, e.g. Ether Lord.
704fb075b444a4e75e81b3f9902bf8a087ebbd61.text:
* 少数可以移除阻止法术瞄准的结界的技能之一。
* 为了尽量减少该技能的缺点：
** 隐藏能量。
** 或者，在使用图章之前施放能量再生技能，例如以太主。

8f1037381b0c5f5d05bacfdf6350162205fba5ad.source:
* Has good synergy when interrupting a foe hexed by Frustration.
* Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.
8f1037381b0c5f5d05bacfdf6350162205fba5ad.text:
* 在打断被挫败咒咒的敌人时具有良好的协同作用。
* 即使阻止中断，也会造成损坏。

6b06e37352d6917c049c36c90137f0918878fbe5.source:
* Similar to Psychic Distraction, Signet of Distraction will bypass anti-interrupt skills. While you may not be able to interrupt the spell during casting, the foe's spell will become disabled and not be able to complete casting.
Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the spell to become disabled.
6b06e37352d6917c049c36c90137f0918878fbe5.text:
* 与心灵分心类似，分心徽记将绕过反打断技能。虽然你可能无法在施法过程中打断法术，但敌人的法术将被禁用并且无法完成施法。
与简洁的描述相反，中断不需要成功即可使咒语被禁用。

b413b78238ddad4051fcef2393a3441cbfde0468.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the spell to become disabled.
b413b78238ddad4051fcef2393a3441cbfde0468.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，中断不需要成功即可使咒语被禁用。

2e1c654d60bae7187d15564d2df41ff2f0b1168a.source:
* Bloodsong and Vampirism will not benefit from the increased damage (they steal health), but they will still attack faster.
* The effect is applied on skill activation on spirits within range. It is not applied to spirits summoned and/or brought within earshot after skill activation.
* The additional damage from this skill happens before Anguish's damage-doubling property comes into effect.
2e1c654d60bae7187d15564d2df41ff2f0b1168a.text:
* 血歌和吸血鬼不会从增加的伤害中受益（它们会窃取生命值），但它们的攻击速度仍然会更快。
* 该效果适用于范围内的精灵的技能发动。它不适用于技能激活后召唤和/或带到听力范围内的灵魂。
* 该技能的额外伤害发生在痛苦的伤害加倍属性生效之前。

abc992298f8224bb544da57236ed4ab0b69666f0.source:
* The additional damage from this skill happens before Anguish's damage-doubling property comes into effect.
* If you use this signet on a target that is not a summoned ally, the nearest allied summoned creature within spell range of your target will be affected. If there are no allied summoned creatures within spell range of your target, you will receive the message "Invalid Spell Target". This can prove useful as it allows you to affect summons that might be too far away to target directly or to quickly affect a summon that is likely to attack the foe you are targeting.
abc992298f8224bb544da57236ed4ab0b69666f0.text:
* 该技能的额外伤害发生在痛苦的伤害加倍属性生效之前。
* 如果你对非召唤盟友的目标使用此印章，则距离你目标法术范围最近的盟友召唤生物将受到影响。如果你的目标的法术范围内没有盟友召唤的生物，你将收到“法术目标无效”的消息。这可以证明是有用的，因为它可以让你影响距离太远而无法直接瞄准的召唤，或者快速影响可能攻击你瞄准的敌人的召唤。

48fe81dfc2bba2f8fbbf985185d0c70e8fe25e52.source:
* This skill will disable all of the target's elite skills.
** Players can have multiple elites by copying skills (e.g. using Arcane Larceny or a Signet of Capture). In addition, several monster skills can also capture elites.
** A small number of NPCs have multiple elites.
48fe81dfc2bba2f8fbbf985185d0c70e8fe25e52.text:
* 该技能会禁用目标的所有精英技能。
** 玩家可以通过复制技能（例如使用奥术盗窃或捕获徽记）来拥有多个精英。另外，几个怪物技能还可以捕获精英。
** 少数NPC拥有多个精英。

f74ee740b8f098cf14a3b03203e51d492ee0b073.source:
* Signet of Illusions has good synergy with spell copying skills (e.g. Inspired Hex or Arcane Thievery), since the copied skills will be used with a high effective rank.
* Spells with a failure chance below a certain attribute rank (such as Slippery Ground) used while under this skill's effect retain their chance to fail.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
* No Attribute spells still use charges.
* Although they are not technically linked to attributes, Signet of Illusions will work with spells linked to title tracks.

f74ee740b8f098cf14a3b03203e51d492ee0b073.text:
* 幻象徽记与法术复制技能（例如灵感妖术或奥术盗贼）具有良好的协同作用，因为复制的技能将具有较高的有效等级。

* 没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。
* 无属性法术仍然使用费用。

bcbc3e6928e9dba1fb874de74d70fc7fd394f2c4.text: 异常：有 20% 几率为幻象魔法添加 +1 的物品不会影响此印章激活时施展的法术。例如，您无法使用“我的领域大师”来获得上表中的等级21。相反，法术将使用未经修改的幻象等级。

cc3ffe0d6b6b51513ca7dc4a80ebe9d1833628e8.source:
* Consider using this with Plague Touch or Plague Sending for a second blind.
* Consider using with condition spreading skills such as Epidemic for spreading blind to mobs.
* The AI will only use this skill on a foe wielding a martial weapon, regardless of it being Normal or Hard mode. This is similar to Eruption, but unlike Blinding Flash and Throw Dirt. 
** The AI uses this skill on spirits which are immune to all conditions except burning.
cc3ffe0d6b6b51513ca7dc4a80ebe9d1833628e8.text:
* 考虑将其与瘟疫之触或瘟疫发送一起使用以进行第二次盲注。
* 考虑使用条件传播技能，例如流行病来向小怪盲目传播。
* AI只会对使用军用武器的敌人使用此技能，无论是普通模式还是困难模式。这与爆发类似，但与致盲闪光和投掷污垢不同。 
** AI对灵魂使用此技能，这些灵魂免疫除燃烧之外的所有条件。

7e4ba34f642daaf329173f6826367cdf40f27f40.source:
* This skill will affect both targeted enchantments targeted at the caster as well as all untargeted enchantment spells (which include party-wide enchantments such as Aegis).
** Combines well with Mystic Healing and Orders build skills.
** Consider using this signet to cast Eternal Aura instantly to resurrect allies in mid-battle.
* Even though enchantments are made to cast instantly, they are still queued and cannot be cast while moving, knocked down etc.
* Unlike Flash enchantments, this skill does not cause enchantments to bypass aftercast delay.

The counter does not reset if the signet is recast before the original duration ends.
7e4ba34f642daaf329173f6826367cdf40f27f40.text:
*此技能将影响以施法者为目标的有针对性的结界以及所有非目标结界法术（其中包括全队范围的结界，例如宙斯盾）。
** 与神秘治疗和命令构建技能完美结合。
** 考虑使用此徽记立即施放永恒光环，以在战斗中复活盟友。
* 即使结界是立即施放的，它们仍然会排队并且无法在移动、击倒等情况下施放。
* 与闪光结界不同，该技能不会导致结界绕过施法后延迟。

如果在原始持续时间结束之前重新铸造图章，计数器不会重置。

a300b80ac20879cef7abaa3404b502f6dfe3cb06.source: bug: The counter does not reset if the signet is recast before the original duration ends.
a300b80ac20879cef7abaa3404b502f6dfe3cb06.text: bug：如果在原始持续时间结束之前重新铸造图章，计数器不会重置。

96c29d423ae4c265340bce771ce8026d70351b27.source:
* Using with Vital Boon or Faithful Intervention can provide a large healing boost.
* Can be combined with Pious Renewal to create quickly recharging skill chain for healing and managing energy.
As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Signet of Pious Light will recharge in 5 seconds, regardless of other effects.
96c29d423ae4c265340bce771ce8026d70351b27.text:
* 与 Vital Boon 或 Faithful Intervention 一起使用可以提供巨大的治疗效果。
* 可以与虔诚更新相结合，创建快速充电技能链，用于治疗和管理能量。
只要使用者在尝试激活此技能时受到苦行僧结界的影响，虔诚之光徽记就会在 5 秒内重新充能，无论其他效果如何。

32c6522b98f9db594ea5dd8243a822f3c6cd0a24.source: anomaly: As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Signet of Pious Light will recharge in 5 seconds, regardless of other effects.
32c6522b98f9db594ea5dd8243a822f3c6cd0a24.text: 异常：只要使用者在尝试激活该技能时受到苦修士结界的影响，虔诚之光徽记就会在 5 秒内重新充能，无论其他效果如何。

52022d34e7032f28a0f30a76124c04e4e8a668b8.source: * Can be combined with Pious Renewal to create a quickly recharging skill chain for AoE snares.
52022d34e7032f28a0f30a76124c04e4e8a668b8.text: * 可以与虔诚更新相结合，为 AoE 圈套创建快速充电技能链。

08a66602a7624cac435cac2fdb6e89dc9cf87b2b.source:
* You lose exactly 8 energy from the -4 pips over 6 seconds.
* If the signet is renewed before it ends, the caster will gain energy for each time the skill was activated.
* This skill will provide more total energy gain per second than Ether Signet.
* Signet of Recall is particularly useful:
**When encountering heavy energy denial, e.g. from a Mursaat Tower (the energy degeneration from Signet of Recall will have no effect since your energy has already been depleted).
**When you already have Ether Signet on your skill bar and need even more energy without having to use skills that require energy. 
**When you are facing many short battles (since Signet of Recall can be used right before the battle, during which time the energy degeneration is not disadvantageous).
**When energy hiding, you will not lose any energy from this skill while your current energy is 0.
08a66602a7624cac435cac2fdb6e89dc9cf87b2b.text:
* 在 6 秒内，您从 -4 点中损失了 8 能量。
* 如果印章在结束前被更新，施法者每次激活技能都会获得能量。
* 该技能每秒提供的总能量增益比以太印章更多。
* 召回徽记特别有用：
**当遇到严重的能量拒绝时，例如来自穆尔萨塔（Mursaat Tower）（召回徽记的能量退化将不起作用，因为你的能量已经耗尽）。
**当你的技能栏上已经有以太印章并且需要更多能量而不必使用需要能量的技能时。 
**当你面临很多短暂的战斗时（因为召回徽记可以在战斗前使用，在此期间能量衰退并不不利）。
**能量隐藏时，当前能量为0时，该技能不会损失任何能量。

f7ffb856a09335406eb701247da961e657be3900.source: * Heroes use this skill as a general heal and do not make active attempts to achieve the conditional heal.
f7ffb856a09335406eb701247da961e657be3900.text: * 英雄使用此技能作为一般治疗，并且不会主动尝试实现有条件治疗。

1a238100a4d354891e0395be10b5d17a1c5954da.source:
*This skill removes a hex and then removes a condition.
*Since it has no energy cost and needs an enchanted target, this skill is useful for bonders, as well as any Protection Prayers monk builds that need passive energy management.
*Useful for self-removal of hex spells that trigger on casting a spell, such as Shame, Mark of Subversion or Backfire, since they can be removed without triggering their effect.
1a238100a4d354891e0395be10b5d17a1c5954da.text:
*此技能会移除一个六角形，然后移除一个条件。
*由于它没有能量消耗并且需要一个附魔目标，因此该技能对于绑定者以及任何需要被动能量管理的保护祈祷僧侣构建很有用。
*对于施放法术时触发的降咒法术的自我移除很有用，例如羞耻、颠覆印记或逆火，因为它们可以在不触发其效果的情况下被移除。

befbe07eb4d838ca6b99cb2150023500662f69a0.source: * Party members within earshot counts any living party members, including the user; it does not include dead ones.
befbe07eb4d838ca6b99cb2150023500662f69a0.text: * 听力范围内的队员包括所有活着的队员，包括用户；它不包括死者。

b692593da909565461f70a9ce5623af8feac95fb.source: * Party members within earshot only counts living party members, including the user.
b692593da909565461f70a9ce5623af8feac95fb.text: * 听力范围内的队员仅计算在世队员，包括用户。

aa7328eab7a8a07d193f327d023eaa8fb938d86a.source:
* This skill summons a Spirit of Anger, a Spirit of Hate and a Spirit of Suffering. These spirits use the Pain attack skill.
* This skill triggers effects of skills like Boon of Creation, Spirit's Gift and Explosive Growth on all three spirits.
* Combines with Feast of Souls for a cheap powerful party heal.
* Combines well with Shaman's Insignia for +15 armor rating.
aa7328eab7a8a07d193f327d023eaa8fb938d86a.text:
* 此技能召唤愤怒之灵、仇恨之灵和痛苦之灵。这些精灵使用痛苦攻击技能。
* 该技能会触发所有三个精灵的创造恩赐、精灵的礼物和爆炸成长等技能的效果。
* 与灵魂盛宴相结合，可获得廉价而强大的团队治疗效果。
* 与萨满徽章完美结合，护甲等级为 +15。

3a6bdada08a88ce313158fe92a67f0c793d29e01.source:
* The main difference of this skill compared to its related elite counterparts is the fact that it is a signet. Offering of Spirit is a spell which has a faster activation time, grants more energy, and has a shorter recharge (especially if using weapons providing HCT and HSR), on top of that it also ensures energy gain even when not within earshot of a spirit. Spirit Channeling can return much more energy but is an enchantment and requires investment in Spawning Power.
* Spirit Siphon in particular, but also Signet of Creation and Boon of Creation (both in Spawning Power) are good, non-elite alternatives if your build uses several spirits.
3a6bdada08a88ce313158fe92a67f0c793d29e01.text:
* 该技能与相关精英技能的主要区别在于它是印章。提供精神是一个法术，具有更快的激活时间，提供更多的能量，并且具有更短的充电时间（特别是在使用提供HCT和HSR的武器时），最重要的是，即使不在精神的听力范围内，它也能确保能量增益。精神引导可以返回更多的能量，但它是一种结界，需要投资生成力。
* 特别是精神虹吸，如果您的构建使用多种精神，那么创造徽记和创造恩惠（两者都在产卵能力中）都是很好的非精英替代品。

5d629637fbe1705790607c28259d043a6024e4c3.source:
*Useful for running as the Health boost cannot be removed unless the user plans to attack.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
*When used for running, consider temporarily switching to an armor piece with a rune of superior strength before activating this signet.
*Can be used in conjunction with Illusionary Weaponry because Signet of Stamina won't end when you swing your weapon.
*Can be used by a mesmer to good effect with Symbolic Celerity.
5d629637fbe1705790607c28259d043a6024e4c3.text:
*对于跑步很有用，因为除非用户计划攻击，否则无法消除生命值提升。
* 没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。
*用于奔跑时，请考虑在激活此印章之前暂时切换到具有超强度符文的盔甲。
*可以与幻象武器一起使用，因为当你挥舞武器时，耐力徽记不会结束。
*可以由幻术师使用，与象征敏捷一起使用，效果良好。

f126906e62eaa8f383d9c7322d69ca2d2e996efa.source:
* This skill loses charges depending on the number of foes struck, not the number of swings. For example, if Signet of Strength had 5 charges (Strength attribute of 4) and a Warrior using it used Cyclone Axe against five foes, all five charges of Signet of Strength would be expended in a single swing.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
f126906e62eaa8f383d9c7322d69ca2d2e996efa.text:
* 该技能损失的能量取决于击中敌人的数量，而不是挥动的次数。例如，如果力量徽记有 5 个冲锋（力量属性为 4），并且使用它的战士使用旋风斧对抗 5 个敌人，则力量徽记的所有 5 个冲锋将在一次挥击中消耗掉。
* 没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。

0e6bc3df421dcbb86c87eb216bd4aacf243568c3.source:
* Bleeding will be applied first when using a skill; this means it will trigger the conditional effects of skills such as Oppressive Gaze, Vile Miasma, and Necrosis.
* Works well with Angorodon's Gaze and Ulcerous Lungs.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.
0e6bc3df421dcbb86c87eb216bd4aacf243568c3.text:
* 使用技能时会先施加出血；这意味着它会触发压迫凝视、邪恶瘴气和坏死等技能的条件效果。
* 与安戈罗顿的凝视和溃疡肺配合良好。
* 没有持续时间（这是少数无需维护即可无限期持续的技能之一）。
尽管没有激活时间，但该图章（类似于多利亚克图章）在被击倒或执行动作时无法使用。
复活后，如果玩家在站立动画中间使用该技能，他们将不会开始流血。

4ee3d8eafcd357d4630770eb1a43a33b455eb3fe.source: anomaly: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
4ee3d8eafcd357d4630770eb1a43a33b455eb3fe.text: 异常：尽管没有激活时间，但该徽记（类似于多利亚克徽记）在被击倒或执行动作时无法使用。

7ff55e35e1ecf74948ddaf28af2b84216fac1495.source: anomaly: After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.
7ff55e35e1ecf74948ddaf28af2b84216fac1495.text: 异常：复活后，如果玩家在站立动画中间使用技能，他们将不会开始流血。

56557f7f40118862bb6296754093d212c752ed92.source: * Heroes will use this skill on any hexed foe regardless if they are enchanted or not.
56557f7f40118862bb6296754093d212c752ed92.text: *英雄会对任何被施咒的敌人使用此技能，无论他们是否被附魔。

460798111adec342b137f3f8d64bcf6f395d95e0.source:
*Simple Thievery will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, Simple Thievery is disabled for 10 seconds after the copy effect ends.
*This skill will not disable and become a copied version of a skill if it is prevented from interrupting that skill.
460798111adec342b137f3f8d64bcf6f395d95e0.text:
*简单盗贼只有在没有技能被复制的情况下才会正常充值。如果技能被复制，则复制效果结束后，简易盗窃会被禁用 10 秒。
*如果阻止该技能打断该技能，则该技能不会禁用并成为该技能的复制版本。

865ec9bdb6045de847a095ad5c3958bfee80d78d.source: * Dazed is applied even if the interruption is prevented.
865ec9bdb6045de847a095ad5c3958bfee80d78d.text: * 即使阻止了干扰，也会应用 Dazed。

ad3fab8bebddc74e984e64142410a77446dc5d33.source: * Damage is dealt directly after a spell is cast, but before the spell's effect takes place. For example, if an assassin uses Death's Charge on an elementalist enchanted with Sliver Armor, the assassin will take damage from Sliver Armor before being healed by Death's Charge.
ad3fab8bebddc74e984e64142410a77446dc5d33.text: * 伤害是在法术施放之后、法术效果发生之前直接造成的。例如，如果刺客对附魔了银甲的元素使使用死亡冲锋，则刺客会受到银甲的伤害，然后被死亡冲锋治疗。

17306c745384335c67bd2d43afaebb1c81ea3bce.source:
* If you interrupt with this skill (while target is Dazed for example), the interrupt occurs first, then the bonus damage is applied, even if the target was using a skill.
* Consider using along with shutdown methods, such as interrupts, to give yourself a window of time in which to hit.
17306c745384335c67bd2d43afaebb1c81ea3bce.text:
* 如果您使用此技能打断（例如，当目标处于茫然状态时），则打断会先发生，然后会应用额外伤害，即使目标正在使用技能也是如此。
* 考虑与关闭方法一起使用，例如中断，给自己一个可以击中的时间窗口。

9535ea0595ad6218542044d6f4a12cb6a3102be7.source: bug: The effect area is actually nearby foes.
9535ea0595ad6218542044d6f4a12cb6a3102be7.text: bug：效果区域实际上是敌人附近。

dc0b782166cfb7d4f5f03425f9d00fb5bac63044.source:
* The AI will use this as a general hex removal skill, it does not prioritize targets with foes in range.
** Heroes will run into range of enemies to trigger the damage before self-casting this skill.
dc0b782166cfb7d4f5f03425f9d00fb5bac63044.text:
* AI 会将其用作一般的降咒移除技能，它不会优先考虑范围内有敌人的目标。
** 英雄在自施该技能前会跑入敌人范围内触发伤害。

8eea6af2813a214001115e994c9e328eb251ac08.source: * This skill is triggered by any incoming damage (not conditions or life steal), ending the stance, causing AoE blind, and halving the first packet of damage received.
8eea6af2813a214001115e994c9e328eb251ac08.text: * 该技能由任何传入伤害（不是条件或生命窃取）触发，结束姿态，造成范围盲，并使收到的第一包伤害减半。

fc2629b7c64f6464723a6f819a9ce42c9a5b2ffd.source:
* Blind covers dazed.
* Veldrunner Centaur (boss) is an ally, but getting him killed by enemies during the Kodonur Crossroads mission can allow you to capture the skill very early in the game.
fc2629b7c64f6464723a6f819a9ce42c9a5b2ffd.text:
* 百叶窗遮住了茫然。
* Veldrunner Centaur（boss）是一个盟友，但在Kodonur Crossroads任务中让他被敌人杀死可以让你在游戏早期就掌握该技能。

a9981567721ebe1f89b78633c3960605f7e9ac52.source: *Smooth Criminal will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, Smooth Criminal is disabled for 20 seconds after the copy effect ends.
a9981567721ebe1f89b78633c3960605f7e9ac52.text: *只有在没有复制法术的情况下，犯罪高手才会正常充电。如果法术被复制，犯罪高手在复制效果结束后会被禁用 20 秒。

93ae018d828fb462238144ef62734f042eaff2af.source:
* When used with a scythe, this skill inflicts blindness to all foes struck by the attack. 
When sorting skills by type in the Skills and Attributes Panel, this skill is under its own "Melee Attack" category, while all the other melee attacks are in a separate "Melee Attack" category.
93ae018d828fb462238144ef62734f042eaff2af.text:
* 当与镰刀一起使用时，该技能会使所有被攻击击中的敌人失明。 
在技​​能和属性面板中按类型对技能进行排序时，该技能属于其自己的“近战攻击”类别，而所有其他近战攻击都属于单独的“近战攻击”类别。

b1f48bf5761ea1dd10127a5458d38b5db2db46cf.source: anomaly: When sorting skills by type in the Skills and Attributes Panel, this skill is under its own "Melee Attack" category, while all the other melee attacks are in a separate "Melee Attack" category.
b1f48bf5761ea1dd10127a5458d38b5db2db46cf.text: 异常：在技能和属性面板中按类型对技能进行排序时，该技能属于其自己的“近战攻击”类别，而所有其他近战攻击都属于单独的“近战攻击”类别。

23668694529c92d93919c0f1d2e02b700cb945b3.source: Adrenaline will be gained even for attacks blocked by another blocking source (regardless of whether the user is under the effects of a shout or chant).
23668694529c92d93919c0f1d2e02b700cb945b3.text: 即使攻击被另一个阻挡源阻挡，也会获得肾上腺素（无论用户是否受到喊叫或圣歌的影响）。

3867f118716200ff8c61ad64c7b179874d3fac2d.source: anomaly: Adrenaline will be gained even for attacks blocked by another blocking source (regardless of whether the user is under the effects of a shout or chant).
3867f118716200ff8c61ad64c7b179874d3fac2d.text: 异常：即使攻击被另一个阻挡源阻挡，也会获得肾上腺素（无论用户是否受到喊叫或圣歌的影响）。

c0773939a4e236ecfcd8241771a28f0c29b6fa32.source:
* The total adrenaline gain increase from the increased attack speed and the adrenaline gain boost is exactly +99.5%, so slightly less than +100%.
Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Soldier's Fury's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
c0773939a4e236ecfcd8241771a28f0c29b6fa32.text:
* 攻击速度增加和肾上腺素增益提升带来的总肾上腺素增益增量正好是 +99.5%，因此略小于 +100%。
与裂甲类似，该技能不会将你的护甲等级降低到60以下，或者如果你的“核心”护甲等级低于60，则你的“核心”护甲等级不会降低。
如果你使用的技能或技能与效果的组合赋予 +46 或更高的护甲等级，则士兵之怒的护甲减值不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

960d65e711921c844aa49068b5c6e908d0f9501c.source: bug: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Soldier's Fury's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
960d65e711921c844aa49068b5c6e908d0f9501c.text: bug：如果你使用的技能或技能和效果的组合提供 +46 或更高的护甲等级，士兵之怒的护甲惩罚将不起作用。另请参见护甲计算。

1ae3dccc4491766dfd9036415405beac6e6a9c32.source: * This skill can provide a long duration speed boost when combined with a shout such as "To the Limit!" or "I Am the Strongest!".
1ae3dccc4491766dfd9036415405beac6e6a9c32.text: * 当与诸如“极限！”之类的喊叫相结合时，该技能可以提供长时间的速度提升。或“我是最强的！”。

ca5ee62fb697435836ffc439a1d7ef5bbb6bcf58.source:
*Inform your allies whenever you are about to use this skill. This way, your allies will know when to refrain from using skills.
*This skill can be used after combat to let allies quickly regain energy.
ca5ee62fb697435836ffc439a1d7ef5bbb6bcf58.text:
*每当您要使用此技能时通知您的盟友。这样，你的盟友就会知道何时不要使用技能。
*该技能可以在战斗后使用，让盟友快速恢复能量。

2da4aa6210fe743b443967539850723eaa2d21df.source:
*Using Shadow Sanctuary while under this chant will not make you lose blindness. This is because you are blinded after this skill's effect is activated.
*Song of Purification will prevent Bleeding from being applied while using Cultist's Fervor (technically, the bleeding will have a duration of zero, which causes it to trigger Fragility and similar skills twice).
*Synergy with Wearying Spear.
Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.
2da4aa6210fe743b443967539850723eaa2d21df.text:
*在此吟唱下使用暗影庇护所不会让你失去失明。这是因为该技能效果发动后，你会被致盲。
*净化之歌将防止在使用邪教狂热时施加流血（从技术上讲，流血的持续时间为零，这会导致它触发脆弱和类似技能两次）。
*与疲倦之矛协同作用。
重新申请不会重置剩余的使用次数，直到原始申请结束为止。它似乎会计算两个应用程序的所有技能使用次数，如果原始应用程序剩余的使用次数达到 0 次，吟唱就会结束。

541a30873eb681d03de8557b369590a74a32b3fb.source: bug: Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.
541a30873eb681d03de8557b369590a74a32b3fb.text: bug：重新申请不会重置剩余的使用次数，直到原始申请结束为止。它似乎会计算两个应用程序的所有技能使用次数，如果原始应用程序剩余的使用次数达到 0 次，吟唱就会结束。

9e0f08ab23df52f961bad9c8573304fef6b96ca9.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Soothing.
9e0f08ab23df52f961bad9c8573304fef6b96ca9.text: * 该技能会产生舒缓之灵。

* AI seems to cast it on targets with at least one adrenaline skill.
* This skill may actually increase the Black Bear's damage per second by effectively preventing the use of Brutal Mauling.
d187ac8bea43c849d1d640a644dd62a6c073c86c.text:
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。
* AI似乎会将其施放于至少具有一项肾上腺素技能的目标上。
* 该技能实际上可以通过有效防止野蛮猛击的使用来增加黑熊的每秒伤害。

da1601ee47d605a6c6db04b7e8a0ab143c038939.source: * Combine with Attuned Was Songkai for a free heal.
da1601ee47d605a6c6db04b7e8a0ab143c038939.text: * 与 Attuned Was Songkai 结合以获得免费治疗。

8897a1f8dfe3e581601a644566d27c7df6b881a4.source:
* This skill will still deal damage if an enchantment or hex is renewed, whether by being recast or by reapplying itself (such as with Critical Defenses, Lyssa's Aura, Kinetic Armor, or Recurring Insecurity).
* Damage occurs when the enemy gains the effect of an enchantment or hex. Accordingly:
** Using an enchantment spell on an enemy will not trigger Soul Barbs damage.
** Spells that only count as hexes under certain conditions, such as Lightning Strike or Ash Blast, will not trigger Soul Barbs damage unless their condition is met.
8897a1f8dfe3e581601a644566d27c7df6b881a4.text:
* 如果结界或妖术被更新，无论是通过重铸还是重新应用（例如致命防御、莱莎光环、动能护甲或反复出现的不安全感），该技能仍然会造成伤害。
* 当敌人获得结界或妖术效果时，就会造成伤害。因此：
** 对敌人使用结界法术不会触发灵魂倒刺伤害。
** 在某些条件下仅算作六角形的法术，例如闪电打击或灰烬爆炸，除非满足条件，否则不会触发灵魂倒刺伤害。

9f2ebbef0e39aa8aa99ac7aafb58cdcde61b83bc.source:
* Damage caused by this skill is applied before the healing takes effect. This is important for healing skills targeting yourself as it is possible to die from using such skills when having low health.
* This skill affects only skills that directly heal. It does not affect Divine Favor healing, health gain due to life stealing or Vigorous Spirit's effect, the additional healing due to Divine Boon, health regeneration and similar effects.
** This skill will only damage foes of the caster, therefore skills such as Healing Ring which heal foes who are hexed by this, will not trigger the damage back to your ally or yourself.
9f2ebbef0e39aa8aa99ac7aafb58cdcde61b83bc.text:
* 该技能造成的伤害会在治疗生效之前施加。这对于针对自己的治疗技能很重要，因为在生命值较低时使用此类技能可能会导致死亡。
* 该技能仅影响直接治疗的技能。它不会影响神圣恩惠治疗、因生命偷取或活力之灵效果而获得的生命值、因神圣恩赐而产生的额外治疗、健康再生和类似效果。
** 该技能只会对施法者的敌人造成伤害，因此诸如治疗戒指之类的技能可以治愈被该技能施咒的敌人，不会将伤害触发回你的盟友或你自己。

5969de753889a949b36a25d4fc37ba31faf99f40.source:
* The Burning duration is applied every second and matches the amount of Overcast removed.
** Under all attribute ranks, Burning is continuous for the purpose of skills like Fragility and Contagion (unless the condition is removed, in which case it will be reapplied the next second).
* Combine with Frigid Armor to prevent the burning on the user.
* Can be used to counteract the overcast building effects of Over the Limit or Iron Mist.
* Although not stated in the skill description, the enchantment automatically ends when the user has no overcast.
* Unlike the PvE-only elite skills, the descriptions fail to mention that this is a PvE skill.
* At low Energy Storage ranks, Purifying Veil prevents burning on the user entirely. Recovery is, as noted on the skill's own page, a reduction in duration and requires more than 50% reduction to reduce a 1 second duration burn to a value that is rounded to 0.
The animation of the Burning condition does not occur the first time the skill is used in an explorable area.
5969de753889a949b36a25d4fc37ba31faf99f40.text:
* 燃烧持续时间每秒应用一次，并与移除的阴暗量相匹配。
** 在所有属性等级下，对于脆弱和传染等技能来说，燃烧是持续的（除非条件被移除，这种情况下下一秒会重新施加）。
* 与冰冷装甲结合使用可防止使用者被灼伤。
* 可用于抵消“超越极限”或“铁雾”的阴建筑效果。
* 虽然技能说明中没有说明，但当使用者没有阴气时，结界会自动结束。
* 与仅限PvE的精英技能不同，描述中没有提及这是PvE技能。
* 在能量存储等级较低时，净化面纱可以完全防止使用者被灼伤。正如技能本身页面上所述，恢复是持续时间的减少，需要减少 50% 以上才能将 1 秒的持续时间燃烧减少到四舍五入到 0 的值。
第一次在可探索区域使用该技能时，不会出现燃烧状态的动画。

f3f3b897206d6f91f64fdbfabbfe18544fbea0b2.source:
anomaly: * Although not stated in the skill description, the enchantment automatically ends when the user has no overcast.
* Unlike the PvE-only elite skills, the descriptions fail to mention that this is a PvE skill.
* At low Energy Storage ranks, Purifying Veil prevents burning on the user entirely. Recovery is, as noted on the skill's own page, a reduction in duration and requires more than 50% reduction to reduce a 1 second duration burn to a value that is rounded to 0.
f3f3b897206d6f91f64fdbfabbfe18544fbea0b2.text:
异常： * 虽然技能说明中没有说明，但当使用者没有阴气时，结界会自动结束。
* 与仅限PvE的精英技能不同，描述中没有提及这是PvE技能。
* 在能量存储等级较低时，净化面纱可以完全防止使用者被灼伤。正如技能本身页面上所述，恢复是持续时间的减少，需要减少 50% 以上才能将 1 秒的持续时间燃烧减少到四舍五入到 0 的值。

97e7f8eb1e4e6f45fc95e595e9b4879f55b64c8e.source: bug: The animation of the Burning condition does not occur the first time the skill is used in an explorable area.
97e7f8eb1e4e6f45fc95e595e9b4879f55b64c8e.text: bug：首次在可探索区域使用该技能时，不会出现燃烧状态的动画。

83fbf39b2f616910b2342d02f365a9ad10c645a5.source:
* As a punishment hex, this skill is more effective in Hard mode since enemies have faster casting and are thus able to cast more often. 
* Unlike Backfire, the AI will cast until death while under the effects of this hex.
83fbf39b2f616910b2342d02f365a9ad10c645a5.text:
* 作为惩罚降咒，该技能在困难模式下更有效，因为敌人的施法速度更快，因此能够更频繁地施法。 
* 与逆火不同的是，AI 在该咒语的影响下会施放直至死亡。

04a4b7d7f8a206d6f292b9288b424b7fedb3cb18.source:
* Usually combined with Dark Aura for AoE armor-ignoring damage.
** Live Vicariously can help offset the health loss of Dark Aura.
* The health sacrifice occurs for each hit rather than for each attack, so skills such as Cyclone Axe or Whirlwind Attack can trigger the health sacrifice multiple times, while skills such as Vigorous Spirit will trigger once, and Illusionary Weaponry will not trigger it at all.
** Blood Bond can help offset the health sacrifice.
** This can lead to a spike when combined with Dark Aura.
* The health sacrifice occurs even if the attack misses or is blocked.
* The concise description is correct: the damage is armor-ignoring bonus damage.

The health sacrifice does not appear on the damage monitor.
04a4b7d7f8a206d6f292b9288b424b7fedb3cb18.text:
* 通常与黑暗光环结合使用，造成 AoE 无视护甲伤害。
** 替代生活可以帮助抵消黑暗光环造成的生命值损失。
* 生命牺牲是每次击中而不是每次攻击，因此旋风斧或旋风攻击等技能可以多次触发生命牺牲，而烈神之类的技能只会触发一次，幻兵器根本不会触发生命牺牲。
** 血缘纽带可以帮助抵消健康牺牲。
** 当与黑暗光环结合时，这可能会导致峰值。
* 即使攻击未命中或被阻挡，也会造成生命值牺牲。
* 简洁的描述是正确的：伤害是无视护甲的额外伤害。

健康牺牲不会出现在伤害监视器上。

419f1f1e5f385309963b2bd0c2865a6ff13ee14b.source: anomaly: The health sacrifice does not appear on the damage monitor.
419f1f1e5f385309963b2bd0c2865a6ff13ee14b.text: 异常：健康牺牲不会出现在伤害监视器上。

27948c65af81e1bbe173a433de17476bfeaddcc6.source:
* Used with Boon of Creation at rank 12, this skill can reduce the cost of binding rituals to 0 energy.
* While this skill has no casting time, it cannot be used while performing other actions or while knocked down.
* Distracting Shot is the only interrupt that disables Soul Twisting's effects.
** Interrupted rituals will not benefit from this skill's instant recharge effect and will be disabled by that attack.
** In contrast, those interrupted by Psychic Distraction will benefit from this skill's instant recharge effect, even though they will have been disabled briefly.
27948c65af81e1bbe173a433de17476bfeaddcc6.text:
* 与等级12的创造恩惠一起使用，该技能可以将绑定仪式的消耗降低至0能量。
* 虽然该技能没有施法时间，但在执行其他动作或被击倒时无法使用。
* 分散注意力射击是唯一禁用灵魂扭曲效果的中断。
** 被中断的仪式不会受益于该技能的即时充能效果，并且会被该攻击禁用。
** 相反，那些被心灵分心打断的人将受益于该技能的即时充能效果，即使他们会被短暂禁用。

63e9ff6dc3825f368817c935352c30e7ab1be2fb.source:
*After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
*The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*Anthem of Weariness, Anthem of Flame, and "Find Their Weakness!" will trigger before Spear of Fury.
When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Factions skill.
63e9ff6dc3825f368817c935352c30e7ab1be2fb.text:
*达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
*Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
*疲倦之歌、火焰之歌、以及“找出他们的弱点！”将在愤怒之矛之前触发。
当按战役对技能进行排序时，尽管它是一项派系技能，但它仍列在核心下。

0cd4831d711b8d8a6972440640f4af564df19b03.source: bug: When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Factions skill.
0cd4831d711b8d8a6972440640f4af564df19b03.text: bug：当按战役对技能进行排序时，尽管它是派系技能，但它列在核心下。

0ca7a96798083052b213d5d2c1ee5136ef1f7540.source: Unlike Smite, this spell deals the additional damage on an attacking foe in a separate packet.
0ca7a96798083052b213d5d2c1ee5136ef1f7540.text: 与 Smite 不同，该法术对攻击的敌人造成额外伤害，并以单独的方式进行。

7eda0ab14bdec674af498f026af127fc8b611b99.source: anomaly: Unlike Smite, this spell deals the additional damage on an attacking foe in a separate packet.
7eda0ab14bdec674af498f026af127fc8b611b99.text: 异常：与惩击不同，该法术对攻击的敌人造成额外伤害，并以单独的方式进行。

b4b6f8dd04987e3b0fc53de77f854d4cbf69dc6a.source:
*This attack skill causes the attack to deal lightning damage as opposed to only the bonus damage being lightning damage as stated by the skill description.
**Conjure Lightning's bonus damage will trigger for this attack.
*Spear of Lightning and Lightning Javelin are the only two skills that uses this line-shaped area of effect. 
**Using the skill counts as an attack only against the target (the listed lightning damage is added to the spear's base damage, and the attack is affected by blocking, blind, weapon spells, and other effects). All other enemies are dealt the listed lightning damage as a separate instance.
b4b6f8dd04987e3b0fc53de77f854d4cbf69dc6a.text:
*此攻击技能会导致攻击造成闪电伤害，而不是技能说明中所述的仅额外伤害为闪电伤害。
**此攻击将触发召唤闪电的额外伤害。
*闪电之矛和闪电标枪是仅有的两种使用这种线状效果区域的技能。 
**使用该技能仅算作对目标的攻击（列出的闪电伤害会添加到长矛的基础伤害中，并且攻击会受到格挡、致盲、武器法术和其他效果的影响）。所有其他敌人都会作为单独的实例受到列出的闪电伤害。

0a9000d301d5a309c577cdb85067946c7aca77cb.source:
* Works well if you get blinded.
* Consider using this attack while behind an object to remove a condition.
0a9000d301d5a309c577cdb85067946c7aca77cb.text:
* 如果你失明的话效果很好。
* 考虑在物体后面使用此攻击来消除状况。

de9b58ef1273cacb1c90e772c4a4676a6029c661.source:
Contrary to what the concise description suggests, this is not a melee attack, but a spear attack with touch range. Skills such as Strength of Honor will not trigger. "Can't Touch This!" will protect against this skill.
*The AI will use this skill as a normal attack skill, regardless of the Daze effect or melee range requirement.
de9b58ef1273cacb1c90e772c4a4676a6029c661.text:
与简洁的描述相反，这不是近战攻击，而是具有接触范围的长矛攻击。荣誉之力等技能不会触发。 “这个不能碰！”将防御该技能。
*无论眩晕效果或近战范围要求如何，AI都会将该技能用作普通攻击技能。

51e849a397d40b75f39b4d392b87561730462dff.source: anomaly: Contrary to what the concise description suggests, this is not a melee attack, but a spear attack with touch range. Skills such as Strength of Honor will not trigger. "Can't Touch This!" will protect against this skill.
51e849a397d40b75f39b4d392b87561730462dff.text: 异常：与简洁的描述相反，这不是近战攻击，而是具有接触范围的长矛攻击。荣誉之力等技能不会触发。 “这个不能碰！”将防御该技能。

64452c4876b909d1a3e1cd9e045ef454b36c1910.source: * Only certain skills can remove this enchantment from a foe.
64452c4876b909d1a3e1cd9e045ef454b36c1910.text: * 只有某些技能才能消除敌人的结界。

6f3d110f1b65bb0e53ed8278b99cddfcac875835.source:
* If this enchantment is renewed before it ends, it will not disable your skills. Some ways to achieve this are:
** Rank 16 Divine Favor, Glyph of Swiftness and a perfect of Enchanting upgrade.
** Rank 15 Divine Favor, Blessed Aura and a perfect of Enchanting upgrade.
The concise description omits that only enemy spells cannot target you.
6f3d110f1b65bb0e53ed8278b99cddfcac875835.text:
* 如果此结界在结束前被更新，它不会使你的技能失效。实现这一目标的一些方法是：
** 等级 16 神圣恩惠，迅捷雕文，完美的附魔升级。
** 等级15 神恩，祝福光环，附魔升级完美。
简洁的描述忽略了只有敌人的法术不能以你为目标。

c53e7b7d73c40fdb35fc3087091b26e4b68bc7fe.source: anomaly: The concise description omits that only enemy spells cannot target you.
c53e7b7d73c40fdb35fc3087091b26e4b68bc7fe.text: 异常：简洁的描述忽略了只有敌人的法术不能瞄准你。

1c11ffedca49c7013a94f254543c5fe9de12acc0.source: * Works well with other traps as the knock down and crippling makes sure the sufferer stays longer in the traps' area of effect.
1c11ffedca49c7013a94f254543c5fe9de12acc0.text: * 与其他陷阱配合良好，因为击倒和致残可确保受害者在陷阱的影响区域停留更长时间。

b2be7ee803d7cfd72054be757efe710da4d891c0.source:
* Works well with Snow Storm and Winter.
* This hex will end on the target if the caster dies.
b2be7ee803d7cfd72054be757efe710da4d891c0.text:
* 适用于暴风雪和冬季。
* 如果施法者死亡，这个六角形将在目标上结束。

7b3ba53acf3936b5c95ac547c05d5b0b4e157b05.source:
* The count is refreshed when recast.
* Contrary to the description, Spirit Bond will heal whenever an ally would take a damage packet above 50, even if it is reduced to 50 or below by other means, such as Protective Spirit or Shield of Absorption.
** Spirit Bond and Protective Spirit make the basis for the "600" monk in the 600/smite team used for farming.
* This skill can be used to mitigate the downside of skills that cause double damage (such as Frenzied Defense) or armor reduction on their user. 
* Spirit Bond will trigger its healing before the damage is registered.
Contrary to the descriptions, Spirit Bond will only end prematurely if it triggers ten times.
Despite causing healing, triggering the healing from the skill does not cause Scourge Healing or Soul Bind to inflict damage.
7b3ba53acf3936b5c95ac547c05d5b0b4e157b05.text:
* 重铸时计数会刷新。
* 与描述相反，每当盟友受到超过 50 的伤害包时，精神纽带就会治愈，即使通过其他方式（例如保护精神或吸收之盾）将其减少到 50 或以下。
** 精神纽带和保护精神是 600/smite 团队中用于耕作的“600”武僧的基础。
* 此技能可用于减轻对用户造成双倍伤害（例如疯狂防御）或护甲减少的技能的负面影响。 
* 灵魂羁绊会在伤害被记录之前触发其治疗。
与描述相反，灵魂羁绊只有触发十次才会提前结束。
尽管会造成治疗，但触发该技能的治疗不会导致天灾治疗或灵魂束缚造成伤害。

97342cea1b288c118ca2662832e57cad25b3fc47.source: bug: Contrary to the descriptions, Spirit Bond will only end prematurely if it triggers ten times.
97342cea1b288c118ca2662832e57cad25b3fc47.text: bug：与描述相反，灵魂羁绊只有触发十次才会提前结束。

a53dc6cba76f7bf77b9bbbc5ba46bf8e4f6166db.source: anomaly: Despite causing healing, triggering the healing from the skill does not cause Scourge Healing or Soul Bind to inflict damage.
a53dc6cba76f7bf77b9bbbc5ba46bf8e4f6166db.text: 异常：尽管会造成治疗，但触发技能治疗不会导致天灾治疗或灵魂束缚造成伤害。

54fbd95813d87dcde7a74a4a041ccef681c2dfee.source: *One of the few skills that heal spirits.
54fbd95813d87dcde7a74a4a041ccef681c2dfee.text: *为数不多的治愈灵魂的技能之一。
