b615c39d94d470cb7d3471d1e47a62546df2ed01.source: * Sacrifice occurs before healing, so this can kill the caster if used as a self heal without spirits around.
b615c39d94d470cb7d3471d1e47a62546df2ed01.text: * 牺牲发生在治疗之前，因此如果在周围没有灵魂的情况下用作自我治疗，这可能会杀死施法者。

8132435076117089efb9222cadea72684f231a6e.source:
* The health gain at 12 Restoration Magic equals a health regeneration of 10.5 pips (21 pips within earshot of a spirit) and 13 pips at 16 Restoration Magic (26 pips within earshot of a spirit).
* Heroes will cast Spirit Light Weapon to overwrite non-defensive weapon spells when the target's health is at critical levels.

Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
8132435076117089efb9222cadea72684f231a6e.text:
* 12 恢复魔法时的健康增益等于 10.5 点（在灵魂的听力范围内 21 点）和 16 恢复魔法时的 13 点（在灵魂的听力范围内 26 点）的生命恢复。
* 当目标生命值处于临界水平时，英雄会施放灵光武器来覆盖非防御性武器法术。

与简洁的描述相反，该技能的条件效果会导致生命值增加而不是治疗。

5fe8a122a63189319db40e9cd093c72349e7063d.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
5fe8a122a63189319db40e9cd093c72349e7063d.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，该技能的条件效果会导致生命值增加而不是治疗。

52abe293b1667bd7deeef32a937891c6d17e8afc.source:
* This skill triggers when the target fails to hit. Blocking with a skill, dodging a ranged attack, or even using the terrain to avoid being hit by a ranged attack will trigger the energy gain.
* Great synergy with other effects that further increase the chance to miss, notably the Blind condition, and to a lesser extent the hexes Blurred Vision, Calculated Risk, Price of Failure and Reckless Haste.
* Combine with Distortion for good blocking and energy management.
* As with blocking, "missed" hexes combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and Spirit of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
52abe293b1667bd7deeef32a937891c6d17e8afc.text:
* 该技能在目标未击中时触发。使用技能格挡、躲避远程攻击、甚至利用地形躲避远程攻击都会触发能量增益。
* 与其他效果的巨大协同作用，进一步增加错过的机会，特别是失明状态，以及较小程度的视力模糊、计算风险、失败代价和鲁莽仓促的六角形。
* 与失真结合以实现良好的阻塞和能量管理。
* 与阻塞一样，“错过”的六角形是乘法而不是加法结合。因此，同时被鲁莽急速和失败之灵施咒的敌人有 62.5% 次攻击失败的机会。

b5ea6ddc1540bf485ab2e0599647154153ae3c77.source:
* The Cracked Armor is applied after the damage.
* This skill has a distinguishable animation during the 3 seconds before it takes effect, which makes it easy for players to avoid the damage.
* This spell will not fail if your target dies mid-cast.
b5ea6ddc1540bf485ab2e0599647154153ae3c77.text:
* 破损护甲会在伤害后生效。
* 该技能生效前3秒内有可区分的动画，方便玩家躲避伤害。
* 如果你的目标在施法过程中死亡，这个法术不会失败。

624cbffbe4dcf32739a9b314befb71bb77b707c8.source:
* Foes in PvE will attack whenever they get the chance, making this skill a very potent way to deplete foes of their energy, provided they don't spam spells or other non-attack skills.
** In case they have a tendency to spam spells or other non-attack skills, disabling those or using Backfire (in case of spells) can be a reliable way to force them into attacking. 
** This allows to trigger Mind Wrack much more easily.
* Could be combined with Famine to cause damage.
624cbffbe4dcf32739a9b314befb71bb77b707c8.text:
* PvE中的敌人一有机会就会攻击，这使得该技能成为消耗敌人能量的非常有效的方法，前提是他们不发送垃圾法术或其他非攻击技能。
** 如果他们有垃圾邮件法术或其他非攻击技能的倾向，禁用这些技能或使用逆火（如果是法术）可能是迫使他们攻击的可靠方法。 
** 这可以更容易地触发 Mind Wrack。
* 可以与饥荒结合造成伤害。

7869e0f31c1b3254cc2ea1db69b3e04a69c37b70.source:
* Spirits have four pips of energy regeneration; they regain their maximum energy (30 energy) in about 23 seconds.
** In Hard mode, enemy spirits have 41 energy, making them a better source.
** Spirits do not use energy to attack, so Spirit Siphon will not reduce their effectiveness.
* When used on multiple spirits, this skill allows for better energy returns over Offering of Spirit or Signet of Spirits (PvP).
* This skill always targets the spirit closest to the caster. If two or more spirits are equal distance, the target is chosen at random.
** There is no effect unless the closest spirit is within casting range; however, the skill will activate (and waste energy) with spirits outside of casting range or without spirits at all.
7869e0f31c1b3254cc2ea1db69b3e04a69c37b70.text:
* 精神有四点能量再生；他们在大约 23 秒内恢复最大能量（30 能量）。
** 在困难模式下，敌方灵魂拥有 41 能量，使它们成为更好的来源。
** 灵魂不使用能量进行攻击，因此灵魂虹吸不会降低其效果。
* 当对多个灵魂使用时，该技能比灵魂献祭或灵魂徽记（PvP）有更好的能量回报。
* 该技能总是以距离施法者最近的灵魂为目标。如果两个或多个灵魂距离相等，则随机选择目标。
** 除非最近的灵魂在施法范围内，否则没有效果；然而，当灵魂超出施法范围或根本没有灵魂时，该技能将激活（并浪费能量）。

6576d4337186f5554ff859c933552a7dc131414a.source: * Healing takes place before any effects gained by destroying a spirit. (e.g. used on a Restoration spirit, living allies are healed, then dead party members are resurrected)
6576d4337186f5554ff859c933552a7dc131414a.text: * 治疗发生在因摧毁灵魂而产生任何效果之前。 （例如，用于恢复精神，治愈活着的盟友，然后复活死去的队员）

c7c45991fb38e32acb6f4e3b84a0b186dc54d60a.source:
* This skill works on both allied and enemy spirits.
** Allied spirits that are good candidates for this spell are Bloodsong and Vampirism (since they heal themselves with their attacks), along with Destruction and Life (since they effect upon death).
** The range of the spell is casting range, making it useful even in the remote vicinity of a spirit.
Can be cast while targeting a spirit, in which case the spirit will lose health and no one will be healed.
c7c45991fb38e32acb6f4e3b84a0b186dc54d60a.text:
* 此技能对我方和敌方的灵魂都有效。
** 适合此法术的盟友灵魂有血歌和吸血鬼（因为它们通过攻击治愈自己），以及毁灭和生命（因为它们对死亡有效）。
** 该法术的范围是施法范围，因此即使在距离灵魂较远的地方也很有用。
可以在瞄准灵魂时施放，在这种情况下，灵魂会失去生命值，并且没有人会被治愈。

c124292b5d25df9bedb05f8e60a638506c65cc0d.source: anomaly: Can be cast while targeting a spirit, in which case the spirit will lose health and no one will be healed.
c124292b5d25df9bedb05f8e60a638506c65cc0d.text: 异常：可以在瞄准灵魂时施放，在这种情况下，灵魂会失去生命值，并且没有人会被治愈。

e5febc13c7dd96ade688ce1bcdd65a7ab76d055b.source: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

b77e855b49e8e7e6267c2d59dc6f08bbc83578b3.source:
* "Create" includes spawning minions, Asura summons, and Ebon Vanguard Assassin.
* Synergy with skills that can create multiple summoned creatures, since this skill triggers when each creature is created.
** This skill will trigger simultaneously for each creature created when using Animate Bone Minions, Aura of the Lich, or Signet of Spirits.
** Using Animate Shambling Horror will trigger this skill two times eventually: once when the Shambling Horror is animated, and then once again when it dies and a Jagged Horror is spawned.
** Jagged Horrors created via Jagged Bones will trigger this skill.
* The healing occurs before any effect that can happen due to a spirit's death when renewing it ; therefore the condition "below 90% Health" of Lacerate and Edge of Extinction will be checked after the healing, but the bleeding from Lacerate will not be removed if applied.
b77e855b49e8e7e6267c2d59dc6f08bbc83578b3.text:
*“创造”包括生成小兵、阿修罗召唤和黑锋先锋刺客。
* 与可以创建多个召唤生物的技能协同作用，因为该技能会在创建每个生物时触发。
** 使用动画骨随从、巫妖光环或灵魂徽记时创建的每个生物都会同时触发该技能。
** 使用动画蹒跚恐怖最终会触发该技能两次：一次是在蹒跚恐怖被动画化时，另一次是在它死亡并生成锯齿恐怖时。
** 通过锯齿状骨头制造的锯齿状恐怖将触发该技能。
* 在更新灵魂时，治疗会发生在因灵魂死亡而可能发生的任何效果之前；因此，愈合后会检查“低于 90% 生命值”的撕裂和灭绝边缘的情况，但如果应用撕裂，撕裂的出血将不会被消除。

44ecd44a30d4417ad150a36b7c9feaeda49ca696.source:
* Combine with Sight Beyond Sight to use as a cover enchantment and negate Blindness.
* Usually paired with Great Dwarf Weapon, Weapon of Fury, Vital Weapon, Warmonger's Weapon, or Weapon of Aggression.
44ecd44a30d4417ad150a36b7c9feaeda49ca696.text:
* 与超越视线结合使用作为掩护结界并消除失明。
* 通常与大矮人武器、愤怒武器、致命武器、好战者武器或侵略武器搭配使用。

da648571cc0c0bedb848d28ff4e07b4c824f0fd2.source:
* Combine with Bloodsong or Vampirism to gain additional life stealing without damage reduction.
* Can be used to make up for Wanderlust's health loss.
* The effect is applied on skill activation on spirits within range. It is not applied to spirits summoned and/or brought within earshot after skill activation.
* Heroes use this skill inefficiently in builds with multiple spirits, activating it before they have summoned all spirits available to them.
da648571cc0c0bedb848d28ff4e07b4c824f0fd2.text:
* 与血歌或吸血鬼结合可获得额外的生命偷取效果且不会减少伤害。
* 可用于弥补流浪癖的健康损失。
* 该效果适用于范围内的精灵的技能发动。它不适用于技能激活后召唤和/或带到听力范围内的灵魂。
*英雄在使用多个灵魂的构建中效率低下，在召唤出所有可用的灵魂之前激活它。

0e7e1948f44b7bb0c09abd0f31ff8f2330990da1.source:
* This skill is more powerful in hard mode as it benefits from the increased attack speed and decreased activation time of foes.
** In Normal Mode, you can use Reckless Haste to increase the foe's attack speed.
* Arcane Echo can be used to help facilitate this strategy by duplicating the skill.
* Capturing this skill from Harvest Soulreign in the mission Against the Charr is fairly difficult as a cinematic will start shortly after he is killed, and his corpse will be removed immediately afterwards. It is however possible to do so by killing Gordam Griefgiver first, starting activating Signet of Capture when Soulreign is nearly dead, and with quick reflexes capture Spiteful Spirit before the cinematic starts.
0e7e1948f44b7bb0c09abd0f31ff8f2330990da1.text:
* 该技能在困难模式下更加强大，因为它受益于敌人攻击速度的提高和激活时间的减少。
** 普通模式下，可以使用鲁莽急速来提高敌人的攻击速度。
* 奥术回响可用于通过复制该技能来帮助促进此策略。
* 在对抗夏尔的任务中从收获灵魂统治中获得这个技能是相当困难的，因为电影将在他被杀后不久开始，并且他的尸体将在之后立即被移走。然而，可以通过先杀死戈达姆·悲伤给予者，在灵魂统治几乎死亡时开始激活捕获徽记，并在电影开始之前通过快速反应捕获怨恨之灵来做到这一点。

aee26ff9e25d057ee3edd2f3f6cce5a090c0c30b.source:
* Damage is only dealt to foes adjacent to the target, not to the target itself. 
* Splinter Weapon will trigger once for each attack when used with scythes or attack skills that can deal multiple attacks.
* Damage from this skill is armor-ignoring physical damage: it benefits from Winnowing and triggers Mark of Pain and Barbs. However, it does not trigger the three weapon modifications that depend on the weapon hitting the foe (i.e. Furious, Vampiric, and Zealous weapons hit the target, while the Splinter Weapon damage affects the adjacent foes).
aee26ff9e25d057ee3edd2f3f6cce5a090c0c30b.text:
* 伤害仅对目标附近的敌人造成，不会对目标本身造成。 
* 与镰刀或可造成多次攻击的攻击技能一起使用时，碎片武器每次攻击都会触发一次。
* 该技能的伤害是无视护甲的物理伤害：它受益于风选并触发痛苦印记和倒刺。然而，它不会触发取决于击中敌人的武器的三种武器修改（即狂怒、吸血鬼和狂热武器击中目标，而裂片武器伤害影响相邻敌人）。

5951b794e8b2c1735682d44a75067dd6602edcb1.source:
* More effective in hard mode, where foes have higher health and attack rate and will thus trigger it more often.
* This skill is highly potent against bosses, especially end-game bosses who have many times the health of a player character, assuming the boss attacks or casts targeted spells.
* Spoil Victor or alternatively Spiteful Spirit can be used for solo farming. 
** Spoil Victor is especially effective for characters with low health, typically 55hp, as the character will almost always have low health and meet the requirement.
* This skill will trigger when a healer casts a healing spell on an ally with less health; however, self-targeting a healing spell will not cause health loss. Resurrecting an ally with a spell will also trigger Spoil Victor.
5951b794e8b2c1735682d44a75067dd6602edcb1.text:
* 在困难模式下更有效，因为敌人的生命值和攻击率更高，因此会更频繁地触发它。
* 该技能对 Boss 非常有效，尤其是在游戏结束时，如果 Boss 攻击或施放目标法术，其生命值是玩家角色的许多倍。
* Spoil Victor 或 Spiteful Spirit 可用于单独耕种。 
** Spoil Victor 对于生命值低的角色尤其有效，通常为 55hp，因为该角色几乎总是生命值低且满足要求。
* 当治疗师对生命值较低的盟友施放治疗法术时，该技能将会触发；然而，自我瞄准治疗法术不会造成生命值损失。用法术复活盟友也会触发破坏胜利者。

a9b046c53f6a59b64b7d455dd062cfafad95ff70.source: * This skill will trigger when a healer casts a healing spell on an ally with less health; however, self-targeting a healing spell will not cause health loss. Resurrecting an ally with a spell will also trigger Spoil Victor.
a9b046c53f6a59b64b7d455dd062cfafad95ff70.text: * 当治疗者对生命值较低的盟友施放治疗法术时，该技能将会触发；然而，自我瞄准治疗法术不会造成生命值损失。用法术复活盟友也会触发破坏胜利者。

f3f1ed78d2eb6ff3592a4e00a3c6cb44c67e7046.source: * The first hex is removed after 5 seconds.
f3f1ed78d2eb6ff3592a4e00a3c6cb44c67e7046.text: * 第一个降咒在 5 秒后被删除。

ca93020812e4b06592b62c70b371c31a6e56ce0e.source:
* The first condition is removed after 3 seconds.
* At rank 15, with a 20% of Enchanting weapon, Spotless Soul lasts 18 seconds, being able to remove a condition 6 times.
ca93020812e4b06592b62c70b371c31a6e56ce0e.text:
* 第一个条件在 3 秒后被删除。
* 等级15，拥有20%的附魔武器，一尘不染的灵魂持续18秒，能够消除状态6次。

9897ae6e30dc60ad70fac883b7279b797ebef66c.source:
* One of the few Factions elite skills that are obtainable in Nightfall.
In the Polish translation, description was not updated when skill functionality changed. It still says: You lose 5 Energy if more than one foe is struck.
9897ae6e30dc60ad70fac883b7279b797ebef66c.text:
* 在《黄昏》中可获得的少数派系精英技能之一。
在波兰语翻译中，当技能功能发生变化时，描述不会更新。它仍然说：如果超过一个敌人被击中，你会损失 5 点能量。

5d4b4c550913276cadaf01d9d9ead3a938ba89cf.source: bug: In the Polish translation, description was not updated when skill functionality changed. It still says: You lose 5 Energy if more than one foe is struck.
5d4b4c550913276cadaf01d9d9ead3a938ba89cf.text: bug：在波兰语翻译中，当技能功能发生变化时，描述没有更新。它仍然说：如果超过一个敌人被击中，你会损失 5 点能量。

e59a989e85c03efac831375079a23070262c5494.source: *Steady Stance will still trigger while under effects that prevent knockdown, such as "I am Unstoppable!".
e59a989e85c03efac831375079a23070262c5494.text: *在防止击倒的效果（例如“我势不可挡！”）下，稳定姿态仍会触发。

80bf98e8e4a00dc3fdd806579b28ee1a944e1bce.source:
* Even with a small investment in Water Magic, an elementalist primarily using Fire Magic can use this skill to great effect to blind foes.
* Synergy with Double Dragon and Glyph of Immolation, since the burning condition applies first.
80bf98e8e4a00dc3fdd806579b28ee1a944e1bce.text:
* 即使在水系魔法上投入很少，主要使用火系魔法的元素师也可以利用该技能对致盲敌人产生巨大的效果。
* 与双龙和献祭雕文协同作用，因为燃烧条件首先适用。

7593b7ca3a1309077b62365be4aa84faab32cde7.source:
* Effective against Assassins who use Critical Strikes to manage their energy.
* As with any doublecast skill, NPCs will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's area of effect range of an ally.
* Foes suffer two damage packets if the caster is targeted.
* If a foe is targeted when Stone Sheath is cast, then the enchantment will automatically target the ally nearest to the foe.
7593b7ca3a1309077b62365be4aa84faab32cde7.text:
* 对使用暴击来管理能量的刺客有效。
* 与任何双施技能一样，只要盟友的法术效果范围内有敌人，NPC 就会使用该技能。
* 如果施法者成为目标，敌人会受到两包伤害。
* 如果施放石鞘时目标是敌人，则结界将自动瞄准距离敌人最近的盟友。

78092e450d5e37af077f7e387622a9265e752363.source:
This also converts chaos, dark, holy and spirit attacks damage types into earth damage.[Source claim needs verification]
This skill does not convert damage but instead forces the damage type of all dealt damage to be earth damage. For example when applying Winter on top of stone striker, physical damage is not converted into earth damage, since winter has no effect on it - it still considers the damage to be of physical type. This is irrespective of which damage converting skill is used first.
* While under this effect, outgoing attacks do not benefit from Conjure spells and (if melee) do benefit from Ebon Dust Aura.
** This is the case even when conflicting damage type conversions are in effect, regardless of the order they are applied. Most other skills (such as Dust Cloak and Grenth's Fingers) use the most recently applied effect for this purpose instead.
* Good synergy with Mantra of Earth or Storm Chaser.
* Consider using with Geomancer Insignia, Earthbound Insignia and a shield or focus item with a "Like a Rolling Stone" inscription.
78092e450d5e37af077f7e387622a9265e752363.text:
这也将混沌、黑暗、神圣和精神攻击伤害类型转换为大地伤害。[来源声明需要验证]
该技能不会转换伤害，而是强制所有造成的伤害的伤害类型为土属性伤害。例如，当在石头前锋上应用冬季时，物理伤害不会转换为大地伤害，因为冬季对其没有影响 - 它仍然认为伤害是物理类型的。这与首先​​使用哪种伤害转换技能无关。
*在此效果下，传出攻击不会从召唤法术中受益，并且（如果是近战）会从黑檀之尘光环中受益。
** 即使冲突的伤害类型转换生效，情况也是如此，无论它们的应用顺序如何。大多数其他技能（例如防尘斗篷和古兰斯之指）会使用最近应用的效果来实现此目的。
* 与大地咒语或风暴追逐者有良好的协同作用。
* 考虑与风水师徽章、地缚徽章以及带有“像滚石一样”铭文的盾牌或焦点物品一起使用。

cb751104aed8e831dad24f6b541b2d75d367ef6c.source: anomaly: This also converts chaos, dark, holy and spirit attacks damage types into earth damage.[Source claim needs verification]
cb751104aed8e831dad24f6b541b2d75d367ef6c.text: 异常：这还将混沌、黑暗、神圣和精神攻击伤害类型转换为大地伤害。[来源声明需要验证]

72496349fbbb6eccced47d778f147db837951b6f.source: bug: This skill does not convert damage but instead forces the damage type of all dealt damage to be earth damage. For example when applying Winter on top of stone striker, physical damage is not converted into earth damage, since winter has no effect on it - it still considers the damage to be of physical type. This is irrespective of which damage converting skill is used first.
72496349fbbb6eccced47d778f147db837951b6f.text: bug：该技能不会转换伤害，而是强制所有造成的伤害的伤害类型为土属性伤害。例如，当在石头前锋上应用冬季时，物理伤害不会转换为大地伤害，因为冬季对其没有影响 - 它仍然认为伤害是物理类型的。这与首先​​使用哪种伤害转换技能无关。

35b46095ff6cdc57d7d3b0e56e1d3fd06e0a7f3e.source:
* This skill reduces all types of damage, including armor-ignoring damage.
* This is a popular damage reduction skill for farming, sometimes coupled with Protective Spirit (cast before Stoneflesh Aura) with less than 330 health, to ensure losing no health at all. This build is known as the 330Hp, similarly to the 600 and 55 Monk build.
* When removed with a damaging removal skill, such as Shatter Enchantment, the damage from the removal will still be reduced.
* This skill can be particularly effective against Assassins, as many of their builds deal much of their damage through critical hits and rely on them for energy management.
This enchantment does not actually make you immune to critical hits, but prevents extra damage from them. As such, effects that may result from them, such as knock down, or the re-applying effect of Critical Agility and Critical Defenses will still apply. However, the damage-nullified critical hit will not trigger the energy gain of Critical Strikes.
35b46095ff6cdc57d7d3b0e56e1d3fd06e0a7f3e.text:
* 该技能可以减少所有类型的伤害，包括无视护甲的伤害。
* 这是一种流行的农业减伤技能，有时会与生命值低于 330 的防护精神（在石肉光环之前施放）结合使用，以确保完全不损失生命值。该版本被称为 330Hp，类似于 600 和 55 Monk 版本。
* 当使用破坏性移除技能（例如粉碎结界）移除时，移除造成的伤害仍然会减少。
* 这项技能对刺客特别有效，因为他们的许多建筑通过重击造成大部分伤害，并依赖他们进行能量管理。
这个结界实际上并不能让你免疫重击，但可以防止它们造成额外伤害。因此，它们可能产生的效果，例如击倒，或暴击敏捷和暴击防御的重新应用效果仍然适用。然而，伤害无效的暴击不会触发暴击的能量增益。

a0ad2f68081b5cf550b3bd3c58f9578178819546.source: bug: This enchantment does not actually make you immune to critical hits, but prevents extra damage from them. As such, effects that may result from them, such as knock down, or the re-applying effect of Critical Agility and Critical Defenses will still apply. However, the damage-nullified critical hit will not trigger the energy gain of Critical Strikes.
a0ad2f68081b5cf550b3bd3c58f9578178819546.text: bug：这个结界实际上并不能让你免疫重击，但可以防止它们造成额外伤害。因此，它们可能产生的效果，例如击倒，或暴击敏捷和暴击防御的重新应用效果仍然适用。然而，伤害无效的暴击不会触发暴击的能量增益。

303a50ea8895a6d287fc4574fe5ac9667db60bf6.source: * This skill is used by Naga Shamans summoned via Summon Naga Shaman.
303a50ea8895a6d287fc4574fe5ac9667db60bf6.text: * 此技能由通过召唤娜迦萨满召唤的娜迦萨满使用。

558ebad5e521584bac29ade292e3a3aac0f9bf8e.source: * While moving when under the effects of this enchantment, you suffer the equivalent of -3 energy degeneration.
558ebad5e521584bac29ade292e3a3aac0f9bf8e.text: * 在该结界的影响下移动时，你会遭受相当于 -3 点能量衰退的痛苦。

238ab6eaf5acc147f085726e37748b5336b655a3.source:
*This skill increases average speed by 8.33% if used every time it recharges, assuming it does not get renewed.
*Decent synergy with Greater Conflagration or Stone Striker.
238ab6eaf5acc147f085726e37748b5336b655a3.text:
*如果不更新，每次充电时使用此技能，平均速度会增加 8.33%。
*与大烈火或石击者有不错的协同作用。

7d9e4d55be189ebaff33465de32f2a5aa8baaa3d.source:
*The additional damage is armor-ignoring, so a character without the required attribute rank for their melee weapon will still deal Strength of Honor's damage.
* More than one monk can maintain this enchantment on a target but the effects will not stack.
7d9e4d55be189ebaff33465de32f2a5aa8baaa3d.text:
*额外伤害是无视护甲的，因此没有近战武器所需属性等级的角色仍然会造成荣誉之力的伤害。
* 不止一名武僧可以对目标维持此结界，但效果不会叠加。

a4ff1bee7788f588e609983c100b69fa855d3793.source:
* This skill will shadow step your pet to a target ally (or even to yourself); this also activates the skill's effect, allowing you to prep before engaging the enemy.
** Your animal companion must be alive to use this skill.
** You must be within casting range of your target, although your pet can be farther away.

Targeting yourself or an ally will sometimes cause your pet to stop moving. It will unfreeze when an opponent enters your aggro bubble or attacks it. This is exploited to perform the portal jumping technique known as a SaO chain.
Strike as One's description omits the fact that it has a limited duration of 30 seconds.
The French description of the skill mention an "enemy target" for the shadow step despite the fact that the skill can target either foe or friend
a4ff1bee7788f588e609983c100b69fa855d3793.text:
* 此技能会将你的宠物暗影步到目标盟友（甚至你自己）；这也会激活技能的效果，让你在与敌人交战之前做好准备。
** 你的动物伙伴必须活着才能使用此技能。
** 您必须在目标的施法范围内，尽管您的宠物可能离您更远。

以你自己或盟友为目标有时会导致你的宠物停止移动。当对手进入你的仇恨气泡或攻击它时，它会解冻。这被用来执行称为 SaO 链的门户跳跃技术。
《Strike as One》的描述忽略了它的持续时间有限这一事实：30 秒。
法语对该技能的描述提到了暗影步的“敌人目标”，尽管该技能可以瞄准敌人或朋友

f1849ad9712ac17ca12d2ecf4a0f5f62304f9924.source: bug: Targeting yourself or an ally will sometimes cause your pet to stop moving. It will unfreeze when an opponent enters your aggro bubble or attacks it. This is exploited to perform the portal jumping technique known as a SaO chain.
f1849ad9712ac17ca12d2ecf4a0f5f62304f9924.text: bug：瞄准自己或盟友有时会导致你的宠物停止移动。当对手进入你的仇恨气泡或攻击它时，它会解冻。这被用来执行称为 SaO 链的门户跳跃技术。

6cedabb04d538d4ce594b0b8fcb44c40b3de729c.source: anomaly: Strike as One's description omits the fact that it has a limited duration of 30 seconds.
6cedabb04d538d4ce594b0b8fcb44c40b3de729c.text: 异常现象：Strike as One 的描述忽略了它的持续时间有限这一事实：30 秒。

ff9ef9c2a16f4cefc1ba166ae423d136331bc4e3.source: anomaly: The French description of the skill mention an "enemy target" for the shadow step despite the fact that the skill can target either foe or friend
ff9ef9c2a16f4cefc1ba166ae423d136331bc4e3.text: 异常：该技能的法语描述提到了暗影步的“敌人目标”，尽管该技能可以瞄准敌人或朋友

e7fb51a945b26bf86e8125bddb8a5eeceed19150.source: * The daze will trigger if this skill is used in conjunction with condition-applying skills such as Anthem of Weariness or Apply Poison.
e7fb51a945b26bf86e8125bddb8a5eeceed19150.text: * 如果该技能与“疲倦之歌”或“施毒”等条件施加技能一起使用，则会触发眩晕。

c6475edfb8275459a6a0543fb49aa1cc6a30ca78.source:
* Succor is a boon for Paragons, Rangers and Warriors, the three professions with no spells, and the latter two with few non-elite options for energy management.
* The Assassin and Dervish builds that are heavily invested into melee attacks (and not spells) also mutually benefit from Succor's energy gain, and its status as an enchantment (a conditional for many Dervish skills).
c6475edfb8275459a6a0543fb49aa1cc6a30ca78.text:
* 救助对于Paragons、Rangers和Warriors来说是一个福音，这三个职业没有法术，而后两个职业在能量管理方面几乎没有非精英选择。
* 大量投入近战攻击（而不是法术）的刺客和苦行僧构建也从救助者的能量增益及其作为结界的地位（许多苦行僧技能的条件）中相互受益。

c6dcc5d20811268286ce1208cc08269b8eefa040.source:
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* It deals cold damage with attacks, which use less than normal wand or spell range.
* It will cast hexes on multiple targets.
* At level 20 (rank 5) it has 15 in Water Magic.

The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
c6dcc5d20811268286ce1208cc08269b8eefa040.text:
* 当召唤物死亡时，它会留下一具不可利用的尸体。 
* 它使用比正常魔杖或法术范围更小的攻击造成寒冷伤害。
* 它会对多个目标施放六角形。
* 等级 20（等级 5）时，水系魔法为 15。

该描述具有误导性：每个玩家可以拥有一个活跃的阿修罗召唤。

ea385599590797c041dcf1d279102ce46ea43884.source: anomaly: The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
ea385599590797c041dcf1d279102ce46ea43884.text: 异常：描述具有误导性：每个玩家可以拥有一个活跃的阿修罗召唤。

69604d319e2626df875aa5cd2b530fcd309378f8.source:
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* The summoned Mursaat is not infused against Spectral Agony.
* It deals lightning damage on normal attacks.
* It will not cast Enervating Charge on foes suffering from Weakness; at high enough Asura rank, it can maintain that condition on two targets.
* At level 20 (rank 5) it has 15 in Air Magic.

The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
69604d319e2626df875aa5cd2b530fcd309378f8.text:
* 当召唤物死亡时，它会留下一具不可利用的尸体。 
* 召唤的穆尔萨特没有注入对抗幽灵痛苦的能力。
* 普通攻击会造成闪电伤害。
* 不会对虚弱的敌人施放虚弱冲锋；当修罗等级足够高时，可以对两个目标保持这种状态。
* 等级 20（排名 5）时，空气魔法为 15。

该描述具有误导性：每个玩家可以拥有一个活跃的阿修罗召唤。

5ee59b1dbb7c36192c29039b7edc5b5098335ebd.source:
* Combat stats at level 20 (rank 5 or above): 
** It will normally do three attacks between Stoning with one cast every 6 seconds. However, it benefits from its staff's chance for half recharge time of spells 20% of the time. On these occasions it will complete its second normal attack at 2.625 seconds before casting Stoning again (see Activation Time and Attack speed). 
** Its normal attacks deal between 16 and 46 earth damage on targets with 60 armor, and can benefit from weapon spells.
** It has 15 in Earth Magic.
** It has enough energy to use stoning 10 times during its lifespan, and will use it 9-10 times depending on the staff's recharge effect. As such, using a skill that reduces recharge time, like Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom, will not have any noticable effect unless combined with a skill that grants energy. 
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* The summoned Naga is not infused against Spectral Agony.
* Its Stoning works best if one or more members of the party inflict Weakness on targets. However, it will not always cast the spell on weakened foes.
* It is considered a non-spirit ally.

The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
5ee59b1dbb7c36192c29039b7edc5b5098335ebd.text:
* 20级战斗统计（5级或以上）： 
** 它通常会在石击之间进行 3 次攻击，每 6 秒施放一次。然而，它受益于其员工有机会获得当时法术 20% 一半的充能时间。在这些情况下，它会在 2.625 秒完成第二次普通攻击，然后再次施放石击（参见激活时间和攻击速度）。 
** 它的普通攻击对护甲值 60 的目标造成 16 到 46 点土属性伤害，并且可以从武器法术中受益。
** 土系魔法有15。
** 生命周期内能量足以使用石击10次，根据法杖的充能效果会使用9-10次。因此，使用减少充能时间的技能，如智慧黑锋战旗，除非与赋予能量的技能结合使用，否则不会产生任何明显的效果。 
* 当召唤物死亡时，它会留下一具不可利用的尸体。 
* 召唤的娜迦不会注入对抗幽灵痛苦的能力。
* 如果队伍中的一名或多名成员对目标造成虚弱，则石击效果最佳。然而，它并不总是对虚弱的敌人施展该法术。
* 它被认为是非精神盟友。

该描述具有误导性：每个玩家可以拥有一个活跃的阿修罗召唤。

bf840b308039f58c2e19a1b40da4608306e3d3e3.source:
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* At level 20 (rank 5) it has 15 in Fire Magic.
* This creature attacks at less than normal range for wands and spells.
The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
Unlike regular Ruby Djinn, the creature summoned by this skill is fleshy.
bf840b308039f58c2e19a1b40da4608306e3d3e3.text:
* 当召唤物死亡时，它会留下一具不可利用的尸体。 
*在20级（等级5）时，它的火魔法有15。
* 该生物的攻击距离低于魔杖和法术的正常范围。
该描述具有误导性：每个玩家可以拥有一个活跃的阿修罗召唤。
与普通的红宝石巨灵不同，该技能召唤的生物是肉质的。

d3973a33562e38bd7185a5b66aef4f918ff6c484.source: anomaly: Unlike regular Ruby Djinn, the creature summoned by this skill is fleshy.
d3973a33562e38bd7185a5b66aef4f918ff6c484.text: 异常：与普通的红宝石巨灵不同，该技能召唤的生物是肉质的。

6ff2c70132ec671fcf6ef0b8d90964a2b6de3c39.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* This skill shadow steps all spirits you control in compass range to your location, thus has a greater range than Draw Spirit.
* This skill shares most of the quirks of other shadow steps:
** If the caster is standing on or below a bridge, the spirits may move to either side of the bridge; this is consistent with the game's inability to understand three dimensions.
** If a spirit is targeted by an area damage over time spell, the area of effect sometimes moves with the spirit.
** Unlike other shadow steps, this will not cancel any skills the spirits were activating when stepping.
* If there are more than one spirit of the same type within compass range, the nearest shadow steps to your location and others are destroyed.
* Since Summon Spirits' range is about radar range and the limitation of duplicate allied spirits is about 3/5 of radar range, you can make tactical use of two sets of spirits as follows: When you come within radar range of the next anticipated battle location set up your 1st set of spirits and then move to that location. When your binding rituals recharge, set up a 2nd set of spirits and draw the opponents to them and use them as meat shield. When all or most of the 2nd set have died, cast Summon Spirits to draw the 1st set to the battle, even if the binding rituals have not yet recharged.
6ff2c70132ec671fcf6ef0b8d90964a2b6de3c39.text:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 该技能影子将罗盘范围内你控制的所有灵魂移动到你的位置，因此比绘制灵魂有更大的范围。
* 此技能与其他暗影步有大部分相同的特点：
** 如果施法者站在桥上或桥下，灵魂可能会移动到桥的两侧；这与游戏无法理解三个维度的情况是一致的。
** 如果一个精魂成为区域持续伤害法术的目标，则效果范围有时会随着该精魂一起移动。
** 与其他暗影步不同，这不会取消灵魂在迈步时激活的任何技能。
* 如果罗盘范围内有多个相同类型的精魂，则距离您所在位置最近的暗影步和其他暗影步将被摧毁。
* 由于召唤精灵的范围与雷达范围有关，而重复的盟友精灵的限制约为雷达范围的 3/5，因此您可以按如下方式战术使用两组精灵：当您进入下一个预期战斗位置的雷达范围内时，设置您的第 1 组精灵，然后移动到该位置。当你的束缚仪式充能时，设置第2组精神并将对手吸引到他们身上并将其用作肉盾。当第 2 组全部或大部分死亡时，即使绑定仪式尚未充能，也可以施放召唤灵魂来吸引第 1 组加入战斗。

189362b9d886b51c6fb2093648a4a14eb94c636b.source:
* Swords with a Vampiric mod, Hundred Blades, Order of the Vampire, Conjure Flame/Frost/Lightning, etc. synergize well with Sun and Moon Slash because the effect triggers twice.
* Unlike Dual attacks, both attacks from this skill hit simultaneously, meaning both hits will connect even through skills such as Shield Bash or Shield of Judgment.
189362b9d886b51c6fb2093648a4a14eb94c636b.text:
* 带有吸血鬼模组的剑，百刃，吸血鬼令，召唤火焰/冰霜/闪电等与日月斩有很好的协同作用，因为效果会触发两次。
* 与双重攻击不同，该技能的两次攻击同时命中，这意味着即使通过盾击或审判之盾等技能，两次攻击也会连接。

e6cbd5958f34e228a2234c2a691afc871051d839.source: * The arrow leaves the bow 0.375 seconds into this skill's activation, as attack skills hit halfway through their stated activation time.
e6cbd5958f34e228a2234c2a691afc871051d839.text: * 箭在该技能激活后 0.375 秒离开弓，因为攻击技能在规定的激活时间中途击中。

277a00920efa3d40c3805747fd671a9e0c5335af.source: * The arrow leaves the bow 0.5 seconds into this skill's activation, as attack skills hit halfway through their stated activation time.
277a00920efa3d40c3805747fd671a9e0c5335af.text: * 箭在该技能激活后 0.5 秒离开弓，因为攻击技能在规定的激活时间中途击中。

5e28a37e314fcfcb983297a427bfc0b08268a6cf.source:
* Unlike Judge's Insight, this skill sets base armor penetration directly to 10%, and therefore does not stack with other sources that modify this value, such as the warrior's Strength bonus or that of a Penetrating Blow.
* Good synergy with any attack skill requiring Cracked Armor (such as Body Blow, Body Shot and Chest Thumper), as Cracked Armor applies before the attack skill hits; this also means that the attack benefits from the armor rating reduction.
5e28a37e314fcfcb983297a427bfc0b08268a6cf.text:
* 与法官洞察不同，该技能将基础护甲穿透直接设置为 10%，因此不会与修改该值的其他来源叠加，例如战士的力量加值或穿透打击的加值。
* 与任何需要裂甲的攻击技能（例如身体打击、身体射击和胸膛重击）有良好的协同作用，因为裂甲会在攻击技能命中之前生效；这也意味着攻击会受益于护甲等级的降低。

89df649d47072ca8de252e2faf94308dd68f14d2.source:
* This skill can be used to move spirits out of the way when confronting Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
* It can also be used to move clones and phantom copies of Reiko during The Final Confrontation.
This spell does not have an aftercast delay.
89df649d47072ca8de252e2faf94308dd68f14d2.text:
* 在奴隶放逐中面对黑邓肯时，可以使用此技能将灵魂移开。
* 它也可用于在最终对抗期间移动玲子的克隆体和幻影副本。
该法术没有施法延迟。

1b79990b74748dba9a9633d7b200d2b40b14fda1.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Symbiosis.
* Works well with party members that stack enchantments (e.g. bonders) or with party-wide enchantments (e.g. Order of the Vampire).
* Be ready for a sudden drop in maximum and current health whenever the spirit dies or the party leaves the area.
1b79990b74748dba9a9633d7b200d2b40b14fda1.text:
* 该技能创造共生之灵。
* 与堆叠结界（例如束缚者）或全党结界（例如吸血鬼骑士团）的队伍成员配合良好。
* 每当灵魂死亡或队伍离开该地区时，请做好最大和当前生命值突然下降的准备。

778069af66173e4599822e8d95c25582ddd0ab3f.source:
* The damage redirected to the user is calculated after the pet's armor, but before other damage reduction (by skills like Call of Protection). If you use this skill and you're taking too much damage, consider +armor rating skills for your pet rather than +damage reduction.
* If Balthazar's Spirit is also on the user, the energy gain triggers each time the pet takes damage.
* Being a shout, you can't end it if you're taking too much damage.
* The damage dealt to the user is typeless.
Upon reconnecting from a disconnect when having this skill active it will appear as a maintained enchantment. (See the discussion page for more information and screenshots.)
778069af66173e4599822e8d95c25582ddd0ab3f.text:
* 重定向到用户的伤害是在宠物护甲之后计算的，但在其他伤害减免之前（通过保护召唤等技能）。如果您使用此技能并且受到太多伤害，请考虑为您的宠物提供+护甲等级技能，而不是+伤害减少。
* 如果巴尔萨泽的灵魂也在使用者身上，每次宠物受到伤害时都会触发能量增益。
* 作为一个喊叫，如果你受到太多伤害，你就无法结束它。
* 对用户造成的伤害是无类型的。
当激活此技能时，从断开连接重新连接后，它将显示为维持的结界。 （有关更多信息和屏幕截图，请参阅讨论页面。）

2136bb7850dd2e66ff4b3a3306c26e41e308b1c7.source: bug: Upon reconnecting from a disconnect when having this skill active it will appear as a maintained enchantment. (See the discussion page for more information and screenshots.)
2136bb7850dd2e66ff4b3a3306c26e41e308b1c7.text: bug：在激活此技能时从断开连接重新连接时，它将显示为维护的结界。 （有关更多信息和屏幕截图，请参阅讨论页面。）

0b179d6c0a4fff81858c085534e9f68c901a35cc.source:
While the functionality of this spell has changed with the June 24, 2026 update, its animation has not. There is no visible animation to highlight the new area of effect.
Contrary to other skills dealing Area damage over time (such as Fire Storm), this skill will fail if the target dies before the spell finishes casting.
0b179d6c0a4fff81858c085534e9f68c901a35cc.text:
虽然该法术的功能在 6 月 24、2026 更新中发生了变化，但其动画却没有变化。没有可见的动画来突出显示新的效果区域。
与其他随时间造成区域伤害的技能（例如火焰风暴）相反，如果目标在法术施法完成之前死亡，则该技能将会失败。

e66c778e34fccebf926d6aa10a669277ed7a10b2.source: bug: While the functionality of this spell has changed with the June 24, 2026 update, its animation has not. There is no visible animation to highlight the new area of effect.

36586f5c1d1b8b53fad74cf0eb203babacd09ca7.source: bug: Contrary to other skills dealing Area damage over time (such as Fire Storm), this skill will fail if the target dies before the spell finishes casting.

* Symbolic Celerity works with signets linked to title tracks.

b1105c280bbf7f403bd918dedd58d9d71d186dd7.source: * This stance ends only after you have successfully activated a signet. The stance will not end when you cancel or a foe interrupts the activation of a signet.
b1105c280bbf7f403bd918dedd58d9d71d186dd7.text: * 此姿势仅在您成功激活图章后结束。当你取消或敌人打断印章的激活时，姿态不会结束。

4bf89b64cdb624df76205cf259903e63421f6974.source:
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* This skill has the third highest damage increase of any Warrior attack skill, surpassed only by Decapitate and by Final Thrust used against a target below 50% health.
4bf89b64cdb624df76205cf259903e63421f6974.text:
* 该技能恰好需要80单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此3次打击和5单位。
* 该技能的伤害增幅在所有战士攻击技能中排名第三，仅次于斩首和针对生命值低于 50% 的目标使用的最终推力。

dfc60290432c06d1e1352304618b4d7eb0d596bf.source:
* Unlike all other skills that "steal" skills, this does not disable the corresponding original and instead is placed as a skill icon in the Effects Monitor. When you hover over the skill icons of elite spells in the Effects Monitor, their skill descriptions will appear to have effects based on their normal ranks, but the Fast Casting rank will be used when the spells are cast.
* Symbols of Inspiration will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, Symbols of Inspiration is disabled for 15 seconds after the copy effect ends.
* All elite spells on your skill bar will use your Fast Casting attribute rank even if they were obtained by other means, such as Arcane Mimicry, Arcane Thievery or Signet of Capture. This will work with skills linked to title tracks, specifically Norn Forms.

857b761b4d88e75b9e35cf7090f913f3c4ba6d17.source:
* Sympathetic Visage coupled with Famine (and, to a lesser extent, Mind Wrack) is extremely powerful when used on a single tank who is absorbing damage. It is one of the combinations that becomes more and more powerful as the number of enemies (particularly melee enemies) increases.
* Can be effectively used as a prot against adrenaline skills, hampering their ability to pressure/spike effectively.
857b761b4d88e75b9e35cf7090f913f3c4ba6d17.text:
* 当对吸收伤害的单个坦克使用时，同情的面容与饥荒（以及较小程度的心灵毁灭）相结合非常强大。它是随着敌人（特别是近战敌人）数量的增加而变得越来越强大的组合之一。
* 可以有效地用作对抗肾上腺素技能的保护，从而阻碍他们有效施加压力/尖峰的能力。

8e76bb0bc63398447aee4a87de8e5dd31a60e286.source:
* This skill will remove existing Disease when applied, although this is not stated in its description. This is similar to other skills that provide immunity to a condition, except for Frigid Armor.
* Heroes will maintain this on themselves in combat, but will not recast it to enchant other allies.
Although this is a PBAoE skill with an effect centered around the caster, it still needs an allied target and you will run towards that target if not in cast range. Similar to Hex Eater Signet, the target won't be affected if it is not in range.
Because it is a targeted enchantment spell, it will always trigger Shame and Mark of Subversion. If standing in a Well of the Profane, you will be able to cast this enchantment if you pick any ally in cast range that is not inside the well.
8e76bb0bc63398447aee4a87de8e5dd31a60e286.text:
* 该技能在应用时将消除现有的疾病，尽管其描述中没有说明。这与其他提供对某种状况免疫的技能类似，除了冰冷护甲之外。
* 英雄会在战斗中将其保留在自己身上，但不会重铸它来迷惑其他盟友。
虽然这是一个 PBAoE 技能，效果以施法者为中心，但它仍然需要一个盟友目标，如果不在施法范围内，你就会跑向该目标。与噬妖者徽记类似，目标不在范围内时不会受到影响。
因为它是一个有针对性的结界法术，所以它总是会触发耻辱和颠覆印记。如果站在亵渎之井中，如果您选择施法范围内不在井内的任何盟友，您将能够施展此结界。

ab80a2c7ab6252a951ac60e93b67d431e7c81d1d.source:
* As with all life stealing, this skill can only heal you for the amount of health that the target has left. As such, be sure you target a minion with plenty of health if you need the healing effect.
* Can be combined with Death Nova, although Putrid Flesh may be preferred in that regard.
* The health of minions follows the formula health=level*20+80, so the life stealing is a guaranteed kill on minions with level equal to your level of Death Magic+1, unless the minion's health has been increased by Spawning Power. 
** Assuming a caster both summons the minion and steals health from it, and stays at the same Death Magic rank while doing so, the minion is guaranteed to die if it was a jagged horror or a bone minion. Any other minion (except Star Servant or Flesh Golem) will die if the caster is at rank 7 or less in Death Magic, and be left with maximum 20 health at higher ranks. Flesh Golems will lose around 70% of their health.
*** Can be used with Jagged Bones as a steady source of jagged horrors.
*** Using Aura of the Lich will spawn a bone horror and then increase the Death Magic rank by 1, effectively allowing to kill the summoned bone horror from full health at any Death Magic rank.
ab80a2c7ab6252a951ac60e93b67d431e7c81d1d.text:
* 与所有生命窃取一样，此技能只能治疗你目标剩余的生命值。因此，如果您需要治疗效果，请确保您的目标是生命值充足的小兵。
* 可以与死亡新星结合使用，尽管腐肉在这方面可能是首选。
* 小兵的生命值遵循公式health=level*20+80，因此生命偷取对于等级等于你的死亡魔法+1等级的小兵来说是有保证的杀死，除非小兵的生命值已经通过产卵力增加。 
** 假设施法者召唤该随从并从中窃取生命值，并且在此过程中保持相同的死亡魔法等级，则如果该随从是锯齿状恐怖物或骨头随从，那么该随从肯定会死亡。如果施法者的死亡魔法等级为 7 或更低，则任何其他随从（星仆或血肉傀儡除外）都会死亡，并且在更高等级时最多保留 20 生命值。血肉傀儡将失去大约 70% 点生命值。
*** 可与锯齿状骨头一起使用，作为锯齿状恐怖的稳定来源。
*** 使用巫妖光环会产生骨恐生物，然后将死亡魔法等级提高 1，有效地允许在任何死亡魔法等级下以满血状态杀死召唤的骨恐生物。

df2cdce5a98b8dac0044cb6973f44fb16ded3d24.source: Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
df2cdce5a98b8dac0044cb6973f44fb16ded3d24.text: 与简洁的描述相反，该技能会增加生命值而不是治疗。

03de5ba5bd8e7c234cc832f80a46f02dcd7bcb0f.source: bug: Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
03de5ba5bd8e7c234cc832f80a46f02dcd7bcb0f.text: bug：与简洁的描述相反，该技能会导致生命值增加而不是治疗。

ef9ed38d4e99ab1afd6170650ff6d5551178eb8a.source: * Steals energy from target and foes in the area even if interruption is prevented.
ef9ed38d4e99ab1afd6170650ff6d5551178eb8a.text: * 即使阻止了干扰，也会从该区域的目标和敌人那里窃取能量。

0c4784f5c2495941c47d09cd49f549e26a95323b.source:
* Technobabble interrupt targets casting spells, an inherent effect of applying the Dazed condition.
* To Daze a boss, cast it on an adjacent foe.
** This skill will apply Dazed if the target is a boss-like foe, such as the Apocrypha or the Undead Lich. 

Exception: this skill will not daze Murakai, Lady of the Night, a boss-like foe.

Technobabble's damage respects armor, even though it deals untyped damage.
0c4784f5c2495941c47d09cd49f549e26a95323b.text:
* Technobabble 中断目标施放法术，这是应用 Dazed 条件的固有效果。
* 要迷惑 Boss，请将其施放于相邻的敌人身上。
** 如果目标是类似 Boss 的敌人，例如 Apocrypha 或不死巫妖，则该技能将适用 Dazed。 

例外：此技能不会使暗夜女士村凯（Murakai）眩晕，这是一个像 Boss 一样的敌人。

技术巴布的伤害与护甲有关，尽管它会造成无类型伤害。

07f2570ce3ab848b84a2b66d8f7e273a6eb70f32.source: anomaly: Exception: this skill will not daze Murakai, Lady of the Night, a boss-like foe.
07f2570ce3ab848b84a2b66d8f7e273a6eb70f32.text: 异常：例外：该技能不会迷惑村凯，夜之女士，一个boss般的敌人。

04c22267b60ba01516fefc113a2fee31764b0aa8.source: anomaly: Technobabble's damage respects armor, even though it deals untyped damage.
04c22267b60ba01516fefc113a2fee31764b0aa8.text: 异常：Technobabble 的伤害与护甲相关，尽管它会造成无类型伤害。

b20f8006fdf5620026e80f8896c1a761467e0038.source:
* This is one of the few skills that can cause maximum health degeneration on its own.
* Cracked Armor does not need to be pre-applied to trigger the secondary effect. Degeneration occurs whenever a target suffers from this hex at the same time as Cracked Armor.
** For example, casting Teinai's Crystals after this skill will inflict all effects from both skills.
b20f8006fdf5620026e80f8896c1a761467e0038.text:
* 这是为数不多的能够导致最大健康退化的技能之一。
* 裂纹护甲无需预先应用即可触发次要效果。每当目标与裂纹护甲同时遭受该咒语时，就会发生退化。
** 例如，在该技能之后施放手内水晶将造成两个技能的所有效果。

f30c9069b9164b88462815da4b38bc9a3b6aadd7.source:
* Glyph of Immolation can be used to meet the burning requirement.
* The interruption takes effect before the additional damage.
Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Sandstorm), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
f30c9069b9164b88462815da4b38bc9a3b6aadd7.text:
* 献祭雕文可用于满足燃烧要求。
* 中断在额外伤害之前生效。
与所有其他同时造成伤害和额外伤害的元素使技能（除了致盲涌动和沙尘暴）不同，该技能的额外伤害不会在单独的数据包中造成。

e52ddac02d0224e254f7b9e31cb944ac79c7d997.source: anomaly: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Sandstorm), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
e52ddac02d0224e254f7b9e31cb944ac79c7d997.text: 异常：与所有其他同时造成伤害和额外伤害的元素师技能（除了致盲涌动和沙尘暴）不同，该技能的额外伤害不会在单独的数据包中造成。

09df44d1f42a1f71417fb835feff5942df082d84.source:
* Blind covers dazed.
* It is easier to capture this skill from the Assassin's Construct in Silent Surf than in Sunjiang District.
09df44d1f42a1f71417fb835feff5942df082d84.text:
* 百叶窗遮住了茫然。
* 在无声冲浪中从刺客构造体中获取该技能比在孙江区更容易。

c308de39d9a726c408693aebf9e617c3a158d676.source: The full description does not mention that this skill operates at touch-range.
c308de39d9a726c408693aebf9e617c3a158d676.text: 完整的描述并没有提到该技能是在接触范围内起作用的。

ec485735711f202e5893d8e1998c687894ac507c.source: anomaly: The full description does not mention that this skill operates at touch-range.
ec485735711f202e5893d8e1998c687894ac507c.text: 异常：完整的描述没有提及该技能在接触范围内起作用。

65cc6c717ef10cad164136619e9b99621ac3ff79.source:
* In Normal mode, the AI will only use this skill on a foe wielding a martial weapon (similar to Eruption and Signet of Midnight). In Hard mode, the AI will only use this skill on a martial primary profession foe wielding a martial weapon. This is similar to Blinding Flash. 
** The AI uses this skill on spirits which are immune to all conditions except burning.
65cc6c717ef10cad164136619e9b99621ac3ff79.text:
* 在普通模式下，AI只会对使用军用武器的敌人使用此技能（类似于爆发和午夜徽记）。在困难模式下，AI只会对挥舞着武术武器的武术初级职业敌人使用此技能。这与致盲闪光类似。 
** AI对灵魂使用此技能，这些灵魂免疫除燃烧之外的所有条件。

6c8b3f7d293c512f1a5f2237776bc89dc26255d9.source:
* Weakness covers Cracked Armor. 
* Unlike Shockwave, Cracked Armor and Weakness are applied after damage is dealt.
* This skill can only be captured from Mursaat.
6c8b3f7d293c512f1a5f2237776bc89dc26255d9.text:
* 弱点包括破损的护甲。 
* 与冲击波不同，裂甲和虚弱会在造成伤害后生效。
* 该技能只能从穆萨特身上获得。

6ea79ef06ca835b3b64adb98b0f8b5c1e4b0a32a.source: * Consider using with Asuran Scan, which can eliminate the chance of missing or being blocked.
6ea79ef06ca835b3b64adb98b0f8b5c1e4b0a32a.text: * 考虑与Asuran Scan一起使用，这可以消除丢失或被阻止的机会。

267432895dd50a9179fd3fa8540431c3c00bb2ce.source:
*This is a core skill, but Guild Wars Eye of the North is required to obtain the skill.
*At rank 14 Fast Casting, Time Ward can be maintained constantly without the need for external recharge time modifiers. 
**At rank 12 Fast Casting, Time Ward is self sustaining provided the initial casting is affected by an additional recharge reduction (or a previous cast at 14+ Fast Casting). 

* The AI cannot detect a ward's presence. Although remaining inside the ward would be favourable, even flagged NPC allies will leave the ward's area of effect whilst taking damage or targeting an enemy beyond their spell and attack range.
267432895dd50a9179fd3fa8540431c3c00bb2ce.text:
*这是核心技能，但需要激战北方之眼才能获得该技能。
*在快速施法等级 14 时，时间结界可以持续维持，无需外部充电时间修改器。 
**在等级 12 快速施法中，时间结界是自我维持的，前提是初始施法受到额外补给减少的影响（或之前在 14+ 快速施法时施法）。 

* AI无法检测到守卫的存在。虽然留在守卫内是有利的，但即使是被标记的 NPC 盟友也会在受到伤害或瞄准超出其法术和攻击范围的敌人时离开守卫的影响区域。

38a757e300e8743b179e2060eac27493d71febba.source:
* Damage is done before checking if the target has hexes or enchantments. This is relevant if the target is under the effect of skills such as Reversal of Fortune or Spinal Shivers.
* If the target has 3 enchantments or less, this skill can provide the longest lasting poison condition of all skills. Otherwise, Envenom Enchantments will last longer.
38a757e300e8743b179e2060eac27493d71febba.text:
* 在检查目标是否有六角形或结界之前就造成伤害。如果目标处于诸如逆转命运或脊椎颤抖等技能的效果下，这一点是相关的。
* 如果目标的结界数量为3或更少，则该技能可以提供所有技能中持续时间最长的中毒状态。否则，毒液结界的持续时间会更长。

0b6f26d589aba4e2f15a26c4a53b9a1eb4009e95.source: * This skill creates a Spirit of Toxicity.
0b6f26d589aba4e2f15a26c4a53b9a1eb4009e95.text: * 该技能会产生剧毒之灵。

2fbf8bc6f96a3a793864e1afc07c4b0c80f441f5.source:
* If cripple is applied with this skill (e.g. through Grenth's Grasp), the knock down will also trigger.
* Good synergy with Mantis Touch and Palm Strike.
2fbf8bc6f96a3a793864e1afc07c4b0c80f441f5.text:
* 如果使用此技能应用残废（例如通过古兰斯之握），击倒也会触发。
* 与 Mantis Touch 和 Palm Strike 具有良好的协同作用。

fb41427f93ec4eaf44b442b243aaed04a3acdfb1.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Tranquility.
* Enchantment durations are rounded down.
* Combines well with Nature's Renewal for an enchantment hostile environment.
fb41427f93ec4eaf44b442b243aaed04a3acdfb1.text:
* 该技能创造宁静之灵。
* 结界持续时间向下取整。
* 与自然更新完美结合，营造迷人的敌对环境。

b3ed2ab1237579b2e57d72352dc58f544c3a3d3f.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Tranquility.
* Enchantment durations are rounded down.
* Combines well with Nature's Renewal (PvP) for an enchantment hostile environment.
b3ed2ab1237579b2e57d72352dc58f544c3a3d3f.text:
* 该技能创造宁静之灵。
* 结界持续时间向下取整。
* 与自然更新 (PvP) 完美结合，营造迷人的敌对环境。

057dc876e187b1cb2a99a5f4c369d7303baadbbe.source: *The Wilderness Survival increase affects preparations before they replace Trapper's Focus.
057dc876e187b1cb2a99a5f4c369d7303baadbbe.text: *荒野生存的增加会影响取代捕手焦点之前的准备工作。

7c647542055cc0c9842b728f68cc0b8846f0cf93.source:
* Triple Chop makes one attack and one hit for each available target; the foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
The concise description incorrectly implies a single attack hitting multiple targets.
7c647542055cc0c9842b728f68cc0b8846f0cf93.text:
* Triple Chop 对每个可用目标进行一次攻击和一击；该技能击中的敌人是与使用者相邻的敌人，而不是目标。
简洁的描述错误地暗示一次攻击击中了多个目标。

f95b723741848c1fd7ac3d085b95f56392daf357.source: anomaly: The concise description incorrectly implies a single attack hitting multiple targets.
f95b723741848c1fd7ac3d085b95f56392daf357.text: 异常：简洁的描述错误地暗示一次攻击击中多个目标。

a2d9bbaa3dfe5d19b999acbfd905bd3e21122c26.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* Bonus damage (i.e. from Conjure spells, Glass Arrows and certain weapon spells) is not reduced.
* Even with the large damage reduction per arrow at rank 1, Triple Shot will still do more damage than Dual Shot under normal circumstances.
The base attack damage from this skill is 50...35% less damage rather than the 40...25% stated.
a2d9bbaa3dfe5d19b999acbfd905bd3e21122c26.text:
* 达到第一忠诚等级后，Kurzick/Luxon支持者，等级20的角色可以从Kurzick官僚或Luxon清道夫3,000派系学习此技能。
* Kurzick版本的技能图标在上方，Luxon版本的技能图标在下方。
* 额外伤害（即来自召唤法术、玻璃箭和某些武器法术的伤害）不会减少。
* 即使在等级 1 时每支箭的伤害大幅降低，正常情况下三重射击仍会比双箭造成更多伤害。
该技能的基础攻击伤害比规定的 40...25% 少 50...35%。

52668470b1d72138b19f618f6ce5d6ddaafff87a.source: bug: The base attack damage from this skill is 50...35% less damage rather than the 40...25% stated.
52668470b1d72138b19f618f6ce5d6ddaafff87a.text: bug：该技能的基础攻击力比规定的 40...25% 少 50...35%。

a96780d3ac312d419a83f743c0dd42ea619a6111.source: * If Barbed Trap (which inflicts cripple) and Tripwire are both placed in the same location, a foe setting both traps off at once will only sometimes be knocked down by Tripwire.
a96780d3ac312d419a83f743c0dd42ea619a6111.text: * 如果倒刺陷阱（造成瘫痪）和绊线都放置在同一位置，同时设置两个陷阱的敌人有时只会被绊线击倒。

47148ab4fdeea7d9ee40ba6f033770a191c99e90.source: *This skill is a useful snare against foes with Natural Resistance and Dhuum, as he is also immune to conditions.
47148ab4fdeea7d9ee40ba6f033770a191c99e90.text: *此技能对于对抗具有自然抵抗力和德姆的敌人来说是一个有用的陷阱，因为他也对条件免疫。

854c4f9304e39b182543c4089e5e03aee905b7e3.source:
*Twin Moon Sweep always attacks only once, even when an enchantment is removed. However, it hits twice in the latter case.
*Melee weapons with a Vampiric mod, Vow of Strength, Hundred Blades, Order of the Vampire, Conjure Flame/Frost/Lightning, etc. synergize well with Twin Moon Sweep because the effect triggers twice.
*Unlike Dual attacks, both attacks from this skill hit simultaneously, meaning both hits will connect even through skills such as Shield Bash or Shield of Judgment.
The concise description incorrectly states the target is attacked twice, instead of hit twice.

{{DEFAULTSORT:Twin Moon Sweep}}
854c4f9304e39b182543c4089e5e03aee905b7e3.text:
*双月横扫始终只攻击一次，即使结界被移除。然而，在后一种情况下，它会击中两次。
*带有吸血鬼模组、力量誓言、百刃、吸血鬼令、召唤火焰/冰霜/闪电等近战武器与双月横扫有很好的协同作用，因为该效果会触发两次。
*与双重攻击不同，该技能的两次攻击同时命中，这意味着即使通过盾击或审判之盾等技能，两次攻击也会连接。
简洁的描述错误地指出目标被攻击两次，而不是击中两次。

{{DEFAULTSORT：双月扫}}

facc1235a96d7e8bc95004d8aec926b3d18fb90d.source: anomaly: The concise description incorrectly states the target is attacked twice, instead of hit twice.
facc1235a96d7e8bc95004d8aec926b3d18fb90d.text: 异常：简洁的描述错误地指出目标被攻击两次，而不是击中两次。

d8e16e8cda4555b8c93e4011b8ea466c8d11215c.source:
* Deep wound covers bleeding.
* Each of the two attacks inflicts both conditions.
d8e16e8cda4555b8c93e4011b8ea466c8d11215c.text:
* 较深的伤口覆盖流血。
* 这两种攻击都会造成两种情况。

02bf798266d97e07dba6a380add6f34a0d24329d.source:
* Cast this skill after using Signet of Suffering to cause immediate bleeding on the target and thereby triggering the -4 degeneration.
* Works well with Barbed Signet.
02bf798266d97e07dba6a380add6f34a0d24329d.text:
* 使用痛苦印记后施放该技能会导致目标立即流血，从而触发-4退化。
* 与倒钩印章配合良好。

1297e0bd851166d000151f7e76618b9463f8ed5a.source: *Since this is an attack skill, the activation time is actually 0.5 seconds.
1297e0bd851166d000151f7e76618b9463f8ed5a.text: *由于这是攻击技能，所以激活时间实际上是0.5秒。

2cb6a9dd6153146e8e182e4e3e139bae4bcd8ba4.source: * Heroes will move into adjacent to target range prior to casting this spell.
2cb6a9dd6153146e8e182e4e3e139bae4bcd8ba4.text: * 在施展此法术之前，英雄会移动到目标范围附近。

4d4eb087e3100d366e6083074bb8962b7bc0b766.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Union.
* Often used with Displacement and Shelter to provide superior damage reduction. 
** Shelter and Union's effects are applied in the order they're created. For maximum damage reduction, always cast Shelter before Union.
* Also affects allied minions, thus making the spirit die almost instantly if there are allied minions taking damage.
* Armor of Unfeeling can be used to reduce the damage taken by this spirit.
* If a damage packet deals less than 15 damage, the spirit only takes damage equal to the amount of damage it prevents.
4d4eb087e3100d366e6083074bb8962b7bc0b766.text:
* 该技能创造出团结精神。
* 通常与位移和庇护所一起使用，以提供卓越的伤害减少效果。 
** 庇护所和联盟的效果按照它们创建的顺序应用。为了最大限度地减少伤害，请始终在联合之前施放庇护所。
* 也会影响友军小兵，因此如果有友军小兵受到伤害，灵魂几乎会立即死亡。
* 绝情之甲可以用来减少该战魂受到的伤害。
* 如果伤害包造成的伤害低于 15，则灵魂只会受到与其阻止的伤害相同的伤害。

bcdaaabec156e876b17b6d2f0e21a33e4c522447.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Union.
* Often used with Displacement (PvP) and Shelter (PvP) to provide powerful damage reduction.
* Also affects allied minions, thus making the spirit die almost instantly if there are allied minions taking damage.
bcdaaabec156e876b17b6d2f0e21a33e4c522447.text:
* 该技能创造出团结精神。
* 经常与位移 (PvP) 和庇护所 (PvP) 一起使用，以提供强大的伤害减免。
* 也会影响友军小兵，因此如果有友军小兵受到伤害，灵魂几乎会立即死亡。

1250f49f0657afaf27ecfa6eb4b0036153f2bae5.source:
*Make sure the target has a cover enchantment, since a well-placed enchantment removal from a foe will cause your party member to die.
*Dying while enchanted by this skill does not count as a death; teams on Kill Count and Alliance Battle maps will not be awarded points for deaths of players under the effects of Unyielding Aura.
1250f49f0657afaf27ecfa6eb4b0036153f2bae5.text:
*确保目标有掩护结界，因为从敌人身上移除适当的结界会导致你的队伍成员死亡。
*被该技能附魔时死亡不算死亡；击杀数和联盟战地图上的队伍在不屈光环作用下死亡的玩家不会获得积分。

c97fd5790b8cf6be88b96db6c1c9ce274ffa16a9.source:
* When you activate this skill, all Upkeep Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
* For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use Totem of Man as it is recharging.
* When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Ursan Blessing starts recharging.
* Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
* Several effects do not end upon activating this skill: 
** Air of Superiority is not lost upon using this skill. Since it has a 10% chance on killing an enemy to instantly recharge Totem of Man, it may allow you to transform back into Human form before the 30 seconds.
** Troll Unguent and Protector's Defense are also kept when this skill is activated.
** Even though Signet of Stamina does not end upon activation, you will not gain any additional Maximum Health.
** Together as One and Never Rampage Alone are also kept.
{{research needed|Which effects do the Norn elite forms remove and which ones do they leave?}}
*Synergizes well with Binding Rituals; the spirits will keep attacking even when your normal skills are disabled, and the spirits' attacks are affected by Ursan Roar. 

Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
If you obtain a new skill (as a quest reward) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.
c97fd5790b8cf6be88b96db6c1c9ce274ffa16a9.text:
* 当您激活此技能时，您所维护的所有维持结界都将被移除。
* 在前 30 秒内，无法使用人类图腾，因为它正在充电。
* 祝福结束后，你会恢复原来的技能条，乌尔山祝福开始充能。
* 由于此祝福和所有相关技能不需要使用武器，因此可以在携带捆绑包时使用。
* 一些效果不会在激活该技能后结束： 
** 使用此技能后，霸气不会消失。由于它有 10% 几率杀死敌人立即充能人类图腾，因此它可能会让你在 30 秒之前变回人类形态。
** 激活此技能时，巨魔药膏和保护者的防御也会保留。
** 即使耐力徽记不会在激活后结束，您也不会获得任何额外的最大生命值。
** 合而为一和永不独行横冲直撞也被保留。
{{需要研究|诺恩精英形态消除了哪些效果，又留下了哪些效果？}}
*与束缚仪式很好地协同作用；即使你的普通技能失效，精灵也会继续攻击，并且精灵的攻击会受到乌山咆哮的影响。 

虽然被归类为形态，但施法者的外观不会改变。
如果您获得新技能（作为任务奖励），您可以将其装备在任何免费插槽中并使用它。变回人类形态后，你会保留该技能，但无法使用它，直到你将其交换为其他技能。

8d43b0bc144e73aab1fc5f6091c5c86d746088ed.source: bug: If you obtain a new skill (as a quest reward) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.
8d43b0bc144e73aab1fc5f6091c5c86d746088ed.text: bug：如果您获得新技能（作为任务奖励），您可以将其装备在任何免费插槽中并使用它。变回人类形态后，你会保留该技能，但无法使用它，直到你将其交换为其他技能。

b903e03edb456c43d7756f087048871a682adc38.source:
* This is the only Assassin skill that steals health.
* Can be used with Nightmare Weapon to cause a large life stealing spike on your target.
b903e03edb456c43d7756f087048871a682adc38.text:
* 这是唯一窃取生命值的刺客技能。
* 可与梦魇武器一起使用，对目标造成大量生命窃取。

853ea0bce01016e518ccfb2251525495c9266822.source: * The foe AI (e.g. Wallows) will only use Vampiric Bite on a target with less than 50% health or when they themselves are below 50% health; however, heroes will use it regardless of the target's or their own current health.
853ea0bce01016e518ccfb2251525495c9266822.text: *敌人AI（例如Wallows）只会对生命值低于50%的目标或生命值低于50%的目标使用吸血鬼之咬；然而，无论目标或他们自己当前的健康状况如何，英雄都会使用它。

33d74a247845bfb495020887eff3300398efec75.source: * Heroes use this spell against foes with less than 50% health, or when below 50% health.
33d74a247845bfb495020887eff3300398efec75.text: * 英雄对生命值低于 50% 或生命值低于 50% 的敌人使用此法术。

92a5a0c1fa08214310a2dafdd420b2faf6d1e42c.source:
* The second and third life steal effects occur 1 and 2 seconds (respectively) after spell activation.
* Casting requires a target which must be in spell range. The second affected foe must be in the area of the target. The third affected foe must be in the area of the second affected foe. 
The hits of this spell don't have an animation, unlike Deathly Swarm.
92a5a0c1fa08214310a2dafdd420b2faf6d1e42c.text:
* 第二次和第三次生命窃取效果分别在法术激活后 1 秒和 2 秒发生。
* 施法要求目标必须在法术范围内。第二个受影响的敌人必须位于目标区域内。第三个受影响的敌人必须位于第二个受影响的敌人的区域内。 
与死亡群不同，该法术的命中没有动画。

0281d9aa9639852ab9ddab9ed675d7f58a21b669.source: anomaly: The hits of this spell don't have an animation, unlike Deathly Swarm.
0281d9aa9639852ab9ddab9ed675d7f58a21b669.text: 异常：与死亡群不同，该法术的命中没有动画。

955e3c6e03478c14c4ce81e9fa6b66be55bb7aa1.source: * The foe AI (e.g. Moss Scarabs) will only use Vampiric Touch on a target with less than 50% health or when they themselves are below 50% health; however, heroes will use it regardless of the target's or their own current health.
955e3c6e03478c14c4ce81e9fa6b66be55bb7aa1.text: *敌人AI（例如苔藓圣甲虫）只会对生命值低于50%的目标或自身生命值低于50%的目标使用吸血鬼之触；然而，无论目标或他们自己当前的健康状况如何，英雄都会使用它。

6128078c7e837a29a701218df517d49e725e50ef.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Vampirism that uses the Vampirism attack skill.
* The attacks used by this spirit steal life, so it does not receive the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might.
* The amount which you are healed will always be the same because Vampirism heals you. The amount of health left on a target only affects how much the spirit is healed by the life stealing, not how much you are healed. Therefore, additional life stealing from Spiritleech Aura does not give additional healing to you.

Contrary to the description, the healing from this skill is gained through life stealing rather than a heal. Therefore, the heal is unaffected by hexes that reduce healing such as Lingering Curse or Defile Flesh, and the spirit will not take damage from healer-punishing hexes such as Scourge Healing or Soul Bind.

The distance of healing is much greater than spirit range and it seems that healing covers all the current location.

The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. Unlike the progression of other Sunspear skills after the May 17, 2012 update, Vampirism's life stealing continues to follow the progression prior to that update (i.e. maximum effectiveness is reached at Sunspear rank 10 instead of 5) even though the descriptions display 20 life stealing from rank 5 to 9.
6128078c7e837a29a701218df517d49e725e50ef.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用吸血鬼攻击技能的吸血鬼之魂。
* 该精魂使用的攻击会窃取生命，因此不会受到鬼威徽记的额外伤害。
* 你得到的治疗量将始终相同，因为吸血鬼会治愈你。目标上剩余的生命值只影响灵魂被生命窃取所治愈的程度，而不影响你被治愈的程度。因此，从吸灵光环中窃取额外的生命不会给你带来额外的治疗效果。

与描述相反，该技能的治疗是通过生命窃取而不是治疗获得的。因此，治疗不会受到诸如“挥之不去的诅咒”或“玷污肉体”等减少治疗效果的咒语的影响，并且灵魂也不会受到诸如“天灾治疗”或“灵魂束缚”等惩罚治疗者的咒语的伤害。

治疗的距离远远大于精神范围，似乎治疗覆盖了当前的所有位置。

吸血鬼之魂的攻击技能是与阳矛等级无关的怪物技能。与 5 月 17、2012 更新后其他烈阳之矛技能的进展不同，吸血鬼主义的生命窃取继续遵循该更新之前的进展（即在阳矛等级 10 而不是 5 时达到最大效果），尽管描述显示从等级 5 到 9 有 20 生命窃取。

a2c8b28a4ac4f429a67a3fe34297a19ae41fa117.source:
* The damage bonus affects direct damage; damage from degeneration and hexes is excluded.
* Make sure the target has a cover enchantment, since a well-placed enchantment removal from a foe will cause your party member to die.
* Dying while enchanted by this skill does not count as a death; teams on Kill Count and Alliance Battle maps will not be awarded points for deaths of players under the effects of Vengeance.

This skill's duration can only be extended by any of Enchanting modifier on the target's weapon. The caster's weapon and buffs like Blessed Aura do not extend the duration.
a2c8b28a4ac4f429a67a3fe34297a19ae41fa117.text:
* 伤害加成影响直接伤害；退化和六角形造成的损坏被排除在外。
* 确保目标有掩护结界，因为从敌人身上移除适当的结界会导致你的队伍成员死亡。
* 被该技能附魔时死亡不算死亡；杀戮计数和联盟战斗地图上的队伍不会因玩家在复仇影响下死亡而获得积分。

该技能的持续时间只能通过目标武器上的任何附魔修饰符来延长。施法者的武器和祝福光环等增益效果不会延长持续时间。

0bb322f1a42c97ffc90c23d7e5ac771a1b937dd5.source: anomaly: This skill's duration can only be extended by any of Enchanting modifier on the target's weapon. The caster's weapon and buffs like Blessed Aura do not extend the duration.
0bb322f1a42c97ffc90c23d7e5ac771a1b937dd5.text: 异常：该技能的持续时间只能通过目标武器上的任何附魔修饰符来延长。施法者的武器和祝福光环等增益效果不会延长持续时间。

3a488fab3644e7370519c7ded053a583a3af2ae4.source:
* Vengeful Was Khanhei is the key skill for a wide range of solo builds, including boss farming, Underworld farming and running.
* Can be kept up almost continuously with Ghostly Haste and Glyph of Swiftness.
* Can be used 3 times consecutively when combined with Arcane Echo.
3a488fab3644e7370519c7ded053a583a3af2ae4.text:
* Vengeful Was Khanhei 是各种单人构建的关键技能，包括 Boss 耕种、地狱耕种和奔跑。
* 几乎可以连续使用幽灵急速和迅捷雕文。
* 与奥术回响结合时可连续使用3次。

98e0dddf61a9d057ab786bd9e7f9d3e9354ad5eb.source:
* Vengeful Weapon's life stealing occurs before the target ally takes the damage or life stealing.
* If damage with no source, such as the Madness Dart in Jokanur Diggings, is taken, the life stealing from Vengeful Weapon is dealt to the target ally.
* When being attacked by minions, the summoner receives this skill's life steal. If the minion is masterless, the life stealing will be dealt to the minion.
98e0dddf61a9d057ab786bd9e7f9d3e9354ad5eb.text:
* 复仇武器的生命窃取发生在目标盟友受到伤害或生命窃取之前。
* 如果受到无源伤害，例如乔卡努尔矿坑中的疯狂飞镖，则从复仇武器中窃取的生命将传递给目标盟友。
* 当受到小兵攻击时，召唤者会获得该技能的生命偷取。如果随从没有主人，则生命偷取将被处理给随从。

4757ce5fbbb8132704e4f7ed3114b4d094b51196.source:
* This is the only skill that affects all hostile minions, making it a powerful counter to minion masters.
* Cover this enchantment to avoid its untimely removal.
* The minions become bound to you only at the moment you cast the enchantment. This enchantment is not a persistent 'aura' effect that constantly binds minions close to you.

Recasting Verata's Aura starts a new timer; it does not reset the original one (as would be the case with other enchantments). The minions covered by the original Aura will become masterless as scheduled; any created between the two castings will be covered by the second enchantment. Consider bringing self enchantment removal skills such as Contemplation of Purity, and only renew the enchantment near its end.
4757ce5fbbb8132704e4f7ed3114b4d094b51196.text:
* 这是唯一能影响所有敌对小兵的技能，使其成为对抗小兵大师的强大武器。
* 覆盖此结界以避免其不及时移除。
* 只有在你施放结界的那一刻，小兵才会与你绑定。这种结界并不是一种持久的“光环”效果，可以不断地将小兵束缚在你身边。

重铸维拉塔的光环会启动一个新的计时器；它不会重置原始结界（与其他结界的情况一样）。被原始光环覆盖的小兵将如期变得无主；两次铸造之间产生的任何东西都将被第二个结界覆盖。考虑带上自我结界移除技能，例如纯粹沉思，并且只在结界接近结束时才更新结界。

a3a30643347ced1ff537a5e5a6bb3ff336d86445.source: anomaly: Recasting Verata's Aura starts a new timer; it does not reset the original one (as would be the case with other enchantments). The minions covered by the original Aura will become masterless as scheduled; any created between the two castings will be covered by the second enchantment. Consider bringing self enchantment removal skills such as Contemplation of Purity, and only renew the enchantment near its end.
a3a30643347ced1ff537a5e5a6bb3ff336d86445.text: 异常：重铸Verata的光环会启动一个新的计时器；它不会重置原始结界（与其他结界的情况一样）。被原始光环覆盖的小兵将如期变得无主；两次铸造之间产生的任何东西都将被第二个结界覆盖。考虑带上自我结界移除技能，例如纯粹沉思，并且只在结界接近结束时才更新结界。

575cf97ba59a44a35d9673713b5bee10141c01a1.source:
* Although it only allows you to disconnect one minion or to take control of one, its quick recharge and low energy cost is good for taking small groups of minions or taking masterless undead.
* Good synergy with Malign Intervention.
* Although it is possible to take control of a minion, it is not possible to take control of effects on that minion. For example, Death Nova will damage the enemies of whoever cast it and not the present controller of the minion. Similarly, Dwayna's Sorrow will heal the party of the caster. The exception to this is Jagged Bones, which will create a minion under the control of whoever controls the minion when it dies.
When casting Verata's Gaze on a masterless minion that was in a well, the effects of that well will persist even after the minion leaves, until the well expires.
When used on a Bone Horror immediately after it was created via Malign Intervention, the Bone Horror becomes stuck and will not move until you engage an enemy.
If this is cast on a minion, it will still follow its original owner, not the new owner. If the minion is turned hostile and then has this skill used on it as it is being summoned, it will follow the user of this skill, however if too slow it will follow its original owner again.
This skill has no aftercast delay.
575cf97ba59a44a35d9673713b5bee10141c01a1.text:
* 虽然它只允许你断开一个小兵的连接或控制一个小兵，但其快速充电和低能量消耗非常适合带走小群小兵或控制无主的不死生物。
* 与恶性干预具有良好的协同作用。
* 虽然可以控制一个随从，但无法控制该随从的效果。例如，死亡新星会伤害施放它的人的敌人，而不是该小兵当前的控制者。同样，德薇娜的悲伤也会治愈施法者的队伍。锯齿骨是个例外，它会在该随从死亡时，在控制该随从的人的控制下创建一个随从。
当对井中的无主随从施放维拉塔凝视时，即使在随从离开后，该井的效果仍将持续，直到井失效。
当通过恶意干预制造出白骨恐怖后立即对其使用时，白骨恐怖会被卡住并且不会移动，直到您与敌人交战。
如果对随从施放该技能，它仍会追随其原主人，而不是新主人。如果随从变得敌对，然后在召唤它时对其使用此技能，它会跟随此技能的使用者，但如果速度太慢，它会再次跟随其原始主人。
该技能没有施法后延迟。

436e7fb4a8731c00282dbfcc69c1069e284da142.source: bug: When casting Verata's Gaze on a masterless minion that was in a well, the effects of that well will persist even after the minion leaves, until the well expires.
436e7fb4a8731c00282dbfcc69c1069e284da142.text: bug：当对井中的无主仆从施放维拉塔凝视时，即使在仆从离开后，该井的效果仍将持续，直到井过期。

f6279f3e453b862827391c1fed0d5c28ec755b55.source: bug: When used on a Bone Horror immediately after it was created via Malign Intervention, the Bone Horror becomes stuck and will not move until you engage an enemy.
f6279f3e453b862827391c1fed0d5c28ec755b55.text: bug：当通过恶意干预创建骨头恐怖后立即对其使用时，骨头恐怖会被卡住并且不会移动，直到你与敌人交战。

2dff2da2993c36cb4b6faed905222a0e5315ed69.source: bug: If this is cast on a minion, it will still follow its original owner, not the new owner. If the minion is turned hostile and then has this skill used on it as it is being summoned, it will follow the user of this skill, however if too slow it will follow its original owner again.
2dff2da2993c36cb4b6faed905222a0e5315ed69.text: bug：如果对小兵施放该技能，它仍然会追随其原始所有者，而不是新所有者。如果随从变得敌对，然后在召唤它时对其使用此技能，它会跟随此技能的使用者，但如果速度太慢，它会再次跟随其原始主人。

1f0969de8f22fc13172f23db583dde8ea843b5aa.source:
* This skill can be used without any minions. 
* Aside from Illusion of Weakness when at low health, and the elite Blood Is Power, this is the second fastest skill to kill oneself. Order of Pain is slightly faster.
The concise description fails to mention that only the caster's undead servants are affected.
1f0969de8f22fc13172f23db583dde8ea843b5aa.text:
* 该技能可以在没有小兵的情况下使用。 
* 除了生命值较低时的虚弱幻象和精英血脉力量之外，这是第二快的自杀技能。痛苦之令稍微快一些。
简洁的描述并没有提及只有施法者的不死仆从受到影响。

7610ef5a507c7331d8a8cbc8a35f51a1b79114a6.source: bug: Heroes take minions of other party members into consideration.
7610ef5a507c7331d8a8cbc8a35f51a1b79114a6.text: bug：英雄会考虑其他队员的随从。

ce32b46f09c0ec674ae53649737d02368efcdd6e.source: bug: The concise description fails to mention that only the caster's undead servants are affected.
ce32b46f09c0ec674ae53649737d02368efcdd6e.text: bug：简洁的描述没有提及只有施法者的不死仆从受到影响。

08adad8b1e08805cd8883e92d30f86bde0ec1e15.source: * In PvE, one may consider using an Spear Grip of the Assassin to increase the chance for critical hits.
08adad8b1e08805cd8883e92d30f86bde0ec1e15.text: * 在PvE中，可以考虑使用刺客之矛之握来增加暴击几率。

38fe69e4c7e1f1f8dcba25fc987214630bb18372.source: * Though the full skill description says "target foe", if this hits more than one foe with less health than you, you also gain health for each additional foe.
38fe69e4c7e1f1f8dcba25fc987214630bb18372.text: *虽然完整的技能描述说“目标敌人”，但如果这击中了不止一个生命值比你少的敌人，你也会为每个额外的敌人获得生命值。

290929ea92fcc53759b4fd26ee37abc93cd71a32.source:
*Because the healing triggers on attacks and not on hits, skills that cause multiple attacks will trigger Vigorous Spirit multiple times, whereas skills that cause only multiple hits trigger Vigorous Spirit once.
**The attacker is healed very quickly when attacking with daggers due to their fast attack speed and chance to double strike.
**Activates with skills like Illusionary Weaponry, since Vigorous Spirit only requires an attack, not a hit.
* Dervishes are a good target for this skill, since they tend to frequently use flash enchantment while simultaneously attacking with melee attacks, both of which triggers the healing.
Empathy triggers on failed attack skills, whereas Vigorous Spirit does not.
290929ea92fcc53759b4fd26ee37abc93cd71a32.text:
*由于治疗是攻击触发而不是命中触发，所以造成多次攻击的技能会多次触发元气，而只造成多次攻击的技能只会触发一次元气。
**使用匕首攻击时，由于攻击速度快并且有机会进行双重打击，攻击者的治疗速度非常快。
**使用幻兵之类的技能来激活，因为精气神只需要攻击，而不需要击中。
*苦行僧是该技能的一个很好的目标，因为他们往往会频繁使用闪光结界，同时进行近战攻击，这两者都会触发治疗。
共情会在攻击技能失败时触发，而精气神则不会。

4dbd0149e6ca9d807b80abe78c5ac4c8a92b0e58.source:
Unlike regular degeneration hexes, Vile Miasma causes a health bar to turn green such as poison or disease, or pink if used from bleeding.
* Using this skill after Signet of Suffering or Glyph of Immolation will apply this hex.
4dbd0149e6ca9d807b80abe78c5ac4c8a92b0e58.text:
与常规的退化六角形不同，邪恶瘴气会导致健康条变成绿色，例如中毒或疾病，或者如果因流血而使用则变成粉红色。
* 在痛苦徽记或献祭雕文之后使用此技能将应用此降咒。

9756c8e4e030a6445584308aed3f218a6e4e340a.source: anomaly: Unlike regular degeneration hexes, Vile Miasma causes a health bar to turn green such as poison or disease, or pink if used from bleeding.
9756c8e4e030a6445584308aed3f218a6e4e340a.text: 异常：与常规的退化六角形不同，邪恶瘴气会导致健康条变成绿色，例如中毒或疾病，或者如果因流血而使用则变成粉红色。

1dc87303b63806d3c913c547e1770aba957f3524.source:
* You can target any NPC, including allies, foes, or interactive objects.
** You will shadow step directly away from your target.
** When self-targeting, you will step to a random location within earshot distance.
** If you self-target while adjacent to a charmable animal, it will be poisoned, but it will not turn hostile.

* It can also be used to jump on or off bridges, shorter hills, or walls.
This spell does not have an aftercast delay.
1dc87303b63806d3c913c547e1770aba957f3524.text:
* 你可以瞄准任何 NPC，包括盟友、敌人或互动对象。
** 你将直接影子步远离你的目标。
** 当自我瞄准时，您将走到听力范围内的随机位置。
** 如果你在靠近迷人动物时进行自我瞄准，它会中毒，但不会变得敌对。

* 它也可以用来跳上或跳下桥梁、较短的山丘或墙壁。
该法术没有施法延迟。

f770550238c71a5f1811bf04c24816bc60d7d0f6.source: * This is the only trap linked to the Beast Mastery attribute.
f770550238c71a5f1811bf04c24816bc60d7d0f6.text: * 这是唯一与驯兽属性相关的陷阱。

69e592a261b66e649990d815b2df4a4a9693bb16.source:
* Poison covers weakness, which covers disease.
* Combine with Epidemic or with teammates using Fevered Dreams and/or Extend Conditions to rapidly spread the effects of Virulence.
* Glyph of Immolation's burning is sufficient to trigger Virulence's effects.
* Can be used with Fragility for a spike at zero Death Magic.
* This is one of only two player skills that can generate three new conditions without spreading them from other foes or from self (the other being Shockwave).
69e592a261b66e649990d815b2df4a4a9693bb16.text:
*毒掩盖了弱点，弱点掩盖了疾病。
* 与流行病或队友一起使用狂热梦想和/或扩展条件来快速传播毒力的影响。
* 献祭雕文的燃烧足以触发毒力的效果。
* 可与脆弱性一起使用，以达到零死亡魔法的峰值。
* 这是仅有的两种玩家技能之一，可以产生三种新的条件，而不会从其他敌人或自身传播它们（另一个是冲击波）。

ab11421754fe9ddadba09428c7a568ad6b84df38.source:
* NPCs will cancel skills if casting it would cause them to die from this hex's effect, and afterwards they will not use skills until the hex expires or is removed.
* Just like Spiteful Spirit, this hex is extremely useful in Hard mode as enemies cast and use skills faster.
ab11421754fe9ddadba09428c7a568ad6b84df38.text:
* 如果施放技能会导致 NPC 因该咒语的效果而死亡，NPC 将取消技能，之后他们将不会使用技能，直到该咒语过期或被移除。
* 就像恶意之魂一样，这个六角形在困难模式下非常有用，因为敌人可以更快地施放和使用技能。

0595776c0fdc77839fe44cb166c5324d65dae7bd.source:
* NPCs will cancel skills if casting it would cause them to die from this hex's effect, and afterwards they will not use skills until the hex expires or is removed.
* This skill is on the restricted list for the Codex Arena.
0595776c0fdc77839fe44cb166c5324d65dae7bd.text:
* 如果施放技能会导致 NPC 因该咒语的效果而死亡，NPC 将取消技能，之后他们将不会使用技能，直到该咒语过期或被移除。
* 该技能在 Codex Arena 的限制列表中。

9b7e886890865c8393005bc6d069babc085c070e.source:
* If you recast this skill while it is still active, you will not receive the health gain effect, nor will it trigger other skills' effects upon end.
* Combines well with Signet of Pious Light or Pious Restoration for a large self spike health gain. Also with Twin Moon Sweep for quick enchantment removal and greater health gain.
* An excellent cover enchantment particularly against skills such as Shatter Enchantment as the health gain often cancels out the damage.
* Can be used to "trick" NPC AI into avoiding your character, since characters with the lowest maximum health will aggro NPCs first.

Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
9b7e886890865c8393005bc6d069babc085c070e.text:
* 如果在该技能生效时重施该技能，则不会获得生命值增益效果，结束时也不会触发其他技能的效果。
* 与虔诚之光徽记或虔诚恢复徽章完美结合，可大幅提高自身生命值。还可以使用双月横扫来快速消除结界并获得更大的生命值。
* 一个出色的掩护结界，特别是针对诸如粉碎结界之类的技能，因为生命值增益通常会抵消伤害。
* 可用于“欺骗”NPC AI 避开您的角色，因为最大生命值最低的角色会首先攻击 NPC。

与描述相反，该技能会增加生命值而不是治疗。

d899c7ef3d185179c30875a785e574752c314009.source: * Useful with skills that benefit from an increased maximum health like Flesh of My Flesh.
d899c7ef3d185179c30875a785e574752c314009.text: * 对于受益于最大生命值增加的技能很有用，例如“我的肉身”。

b3df4054bcaea92ba68c8d1fe4d93326f01d16d6.source:
* Very effective against Paragons, who usually rely on shouts and/or chants.
* Can be effective against beast masters, as most staple skills are shouts such as Strike as One and Otyugh's Cry.
b3df4054bcaea92ba68c8d1fe4d93326f01d16d6.text:
* 对通常依赖喊叫和/或口号的典范非常有效。
* 对抗野兽大师非常有效，因为大多数主要技能都是喊叫，例如“一击必杀”和“奥图格的呐喊”。

f12507e6073aa942f845c8875578a97235f04c83.source:
*For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use Totem of Man as it is recharging.
*When you activate this skill, all Upkeep Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
*When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Volfen Blessing starts recharging.
*Good synergy with Quickening Zephyr, especially at higher Norn ranks, because Volfen Bloodlust can be maintained indefinitely.
*Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
*Synergizes well with Binding Rituals; the spirits will keep attacking even when your normal skills are disabled, and the spirits' attacks are affected by Volfen Bloodlust. 
Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
f12507e6073aa942f845c8875578a97235f04c83.text:
*在前 30 秒内，无法使用人类图腾，因为它正在充电。
*当您激活此技能时，您所维护的所有维持结界都将被移除。
*祝福结束后，你会恢复原来的技能条，沃尔芬祝福开始充能。
*与加速和风有良好的协同作用，特别是在较高的诺恩等级时，因为沃尔芬嗜血可以无限期地维持。
*由于此祝福和所有相关技能不需要使用武器，因此可以在携带包裹时使用。
*与束缚仪式很好地协同作用；即使你的普通技能失效，精灵也会继续攻击，并且精灵的攻击会受到沃尔芬嗜血的影响。 
虽然被归类为形态，但施法者的外观不会改变。

e7215b30d8f7a74581d9bde197b6bd2048c45d87.source:
* Each of Volley's arrows counts as a separate attack.
* Effects that trigger on attack/hit usually trigger multiple times, although some take effect only once or not at all.[Source claim needs verification] 
Volley also removes Glyphs. Hero AI can use Volley right after a glyph, which removes its effect.
e7215b30d8f7a74581d9bde197b6bd2048c45d87.text:
* Volley 的每支箭都算作一次单独的攻击。
* 攻击/击中时触发的效果通常会触发多次，但有些只生效一次或根本不生效。[来源声明需要验证] 
齐射还删除了雕文。英雄 AI 可以在雕文之后立即使用齐射，从而消除其效果。

04f4fdd81e5fcb9dd57e629d7bcfad1b09afda20.source: bug: Volley also removes Glyphs. Hero AI can use Volley right after a glyph, which removes its effect.
04f4fdd81e5fcb9dd57e629d7bcfad1b09afda20.text: bug：齐射也会删除雕文。英雄 AI 可以在雕文之后立即使用齐射，从而消除其效果。

dbdb7567506a627a30f2536084ac3b8a09bba5ff.source:
* Self-renewing enchantments (e.g. Lyssa's Aura, Vow of Revolution or Critical Defenses) do not renew this enchantment when they are renewed.
* Vow of Piety triggers Soul Barbs with each reapplication.


When a character is enchanted with Vow of Piety and at least one Air Magic, Earth Magic, Fire Magic or Water Magic enchantment (e.g. Windborne Speed), and loses all enchantments (e.g. due to the effects of Gaze of Contempt, Release Enchantments or Second Wind, but not Rend Enchantments nor Strip Enchantment that remove a certain number of enchantments), Vow of Piety will still be reapplied. This does not occur for Energy Storage, dervish nor monk enchantments. {{{|Video}}}.
dbdb7567506a627a30f2536084ac3b8a09bba5ff.text:
* 自我更新结界（例如莱莎光环、革命誓言或临界防御）在更新时不会更新此结界。
* 每次重新应用虔诚誓言都会触发灵魂倒刺。


当角色被虔诚誓言和至少一种风系魔法、土系魔法、火系魔法或水系魔法结界（例如风行速度）所附魔时，并且失去所有结界（例如由于蔑视凝视、释放结界或第二风的效果，但不是撕裂结界或去除一定数量结界的剥离结界），虔诚誓言仍然会被重新应用。对于能量存储、托钵僧或僧侣结界来说，不会发生这种情况。 {{{|视频}}}。

98b86de1ae315088a23698be4d5ef511c68e0a47.source: anomaly: When a character is enchanted with Vow of Piety and at least one Air Magic, Earth Magic, Fire Magic or Water Magic enchantment (e.g. Windborne Speed), and loses all enchantments (e.g. due to the effects of Gaze of Contempt, Release Enchantments or Second Wind, but not Rend Enchantments nor Strip Enchantment that remove a certain number of enchantments), Vow of Piety will still be reapplied. This does not occur for Energy Storage, dervish nor monk enchantments. {{{|Video}}}.
