d089ed809304efe06f7f9b9b7396a89f0cec634c.source:
See: Guide to playing as a dervish#Builds and team roles
*The skill reapplies itself before new enchantments are applied, so those will cover Vow of Revolution.
*This skill enables the dervish to play a support role in PvE using its secondary profession (i.e. Orders build); either defensively with Ritualist's Restoration Magic skills or Monk's Protection Prayers skills, or offensively with Necromancer's Blood Magic skills.
d089ed809304efe06f7f9b9b7396a89f0cec634c.text:
请参阅：苦行僧游戏指南#构建和团队角色
*该技能会在应用新的结界之前重新应用，因此这些结界将涵盖革命誓言。
*此技能使苦行僧能够利用其次要职业（即命令建造）在 PvE 中扮演支持角色；要么用仪式师的恢复魔法技能或武僧的保护祈祷技能进行防御，要么用死灵法师的血魔法技能进行进攻。

aed31c941d1411d7cc727795675667b7f9edc6bb.source:
* This enchantment also prevents allied spells.
* Heroes will attempt to maintain this enchantment at all times.
aed31c941d1411d7cc727795675667b7f9edc6bb.text:
* 此结界还可以阻止友方法术。
* 英雄会尝试始终保持这种魅力。

3eb175fc6fef47a2404d4754f26e50bc7c3224ab.source:
* Synergizes well with attack skills that can cause multiple attacks with a scythe (Eremite's Attack, Twin Moon Sweep, and Whirlwind Attack) and with hex spells that deal damage whenever the hexed foe takes physical damage (Barbs and Mark of Pain).
** When Eremite's Attack or Whirlwind Attack is used, this skill will trigger for each adjacent foe hit.
* Because this triggers on attack, you don't actually have to hit for the damage to occur.
* The damage from Vow of Strength is inflicted before the damage from your scythe. This is relevant for skills such as Reversal of Fortune or Empathy.
* Because this damages all foes adjacent to the user, kiting opponents will avoid damage if they have moved away by the time the attack connects.
* Extend Enchantments can be used to maintain this enchantment.
3eb175fc6fef47a2404d4754f26e50bc7c3224ab.text:
*与攻击技能很好地协同作用，可以用镰刀造成多次攻击（Eremite的攻击，双月横扫和旋风攻击），并与每当被施咒的敌人受到物理伤害时造成伤害的咒语法术（倒钩和痛苦印记）配合良好。
** 使用埃雷米特攻击或旋风攻击时，每击中相邻敌人就会触发该技能。
* 因为这会在攻击时触发，所以你实际上不必击中就会发生伤害。
* 力量誓言造成的伤害先于镰刀造成的伤害。这与命运逆转或同理心等技能相关。
* 因为这会伤害与用户相邻的所有敌人，所以如果风筝对手在攻击连接时已经离开，他们将避免受到伤害。
* 延长结界可用于维持此结界。

5ea978d03ddbe4e431e99b5f5c2e7032bcc2cdb7.source:
* This skill will render most targets ineffective, regardless of their profession or equipped skills.
* The short activation time of this skill means it can decrease the attribute rank of a skill that is being activated by a foe, making it an effective way to neutralize Dervish forms, summoned creatures, or various damage over time skills.
** Some skills are better to interrupt, e.g. resurrection or No Attribute skills.
** Self-renewing skills will also be affected, if they renew themselves while this hex is active.
* This skill does not affect attributes boosted by an of the (Profession) mod.
5ea978d03ddbe4e431e99b5f5c2e7032bcc2cdb7.text:
* 该技能将使大多数目标失效，无论其职业或装备技能如何。
* 该技能的激活时间短意味着它可以降低敌人激活的技能的属性等级，使其成为中和苦行僧形态、召唤生物或各种持续伤害技能的有效方法。
** 有些技能最好打断，例如复活或者无属性技能。
** 如果自我更新技能在此六角形激活时自我更新，也会受到影响。
* 该技能不影响（职业）mod 所提升的属性。

e729fb1513722011ee53ef170a14c06159e36d25.source: Although essentially identical to Touch of Agony, Wallow's Bite isn't stated to deal shadow damage.
e729fb1513722011ee53ef170a14c06159e36d25.text: 虽然本质上与痛苦之触相同，但瓦洛之咬并未说明会造成暗影伤害。

bd5ac57aa265fa181b3cbfb2ac5c42da2fb88c94.source: anomaly: Although essentially identical to Touch of Agony, Wallow's Bite isn't stated to deal shadow damage.
bd5ac57aa265fa181b3cbfb2ac5c42da2fb88c94.text: 异常：虽然本质上与痛苦之触相同，但瓦洛之咬并未说明会造成暗影伤害。

e69118285fdc32f82085340194362d3895ee10e3.source:
* If this skill and Clumsiness are active on the same target, both spells will trigger from the same attack.
Skills which prevent interruptions will trigger when hexed with Wandering Eye but will not prevent their target from being interrupted nor from taking damage
Miniatures seem to trigger the damage animation of this spell.
e69118285fdc32f82085340194362d3895ee10e3.text:
* 如果此技能和笨拙对同一个目标有效，则这两个法术将从同一次攻击中触发。
防止打断的技能会在使用游走之眼施咒时触发，但不会阻止目标被打断或受到伤害
模型似乎会触发该法术的伤害动画。

f90c8ad10b48687388f4c105868f2545d8de5482.source:
* Very useful against assassins, since it can easily break their attack skill chain.
Skills which prevent interruptions will trigger when hexed with Wandering Eye but will not prevent their target from being interrupted nor from taking damage
f90c8ad10b48687388f4c105868f2545d8de5482.text:
*对抗刺客非常有用，因为它可以轻松打破他们的攻击技能链。
防止打断的技能会在使用游走之眼施咒时触发，但不会阻止目标被打断或受到伤害

57fe0d4af237462aaf2120f4c7d4b6e9d90e8562.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Wanderlust that uses the Wanderlust attack skill.
* The spirit's attack inflicts 0 damage, which is considered damage for the purposes of skills and effects that trigger when the target takes damage, such as Painful Bond or Spiritleech Aura.
* The health loss this spirit receives can be recovered by Spirit Boon Strike or Blood Bond.
* Combine with Earthbind to increase the duration of the knock down.
57fe0d4af237462aaf2120f4c7d4b6e9d90e8562.text:
* 该技能会创造出使用“旅行癖”攻击技能的“旅行癖之魂”。
* 精魂的攻击会造成0点伤害，对于目标受到伤害时触发的技能和效果（例如痛苦束缚或灵魂吸血光环）而言，该伤害被视为伤害。
* 该灵魂受到的健康损失可以通过灵魂恩赐打击或血缘契约来恢复。
*与Earthbind结合使用可以增加击倒的持续时间。

dad6270cb08152cf541983000faa2343e94ade2e.source: * Primary PvP-only Ritualists will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on their account.
dad6270cb08152cf541983000faa2343e94ade2e.text: * 仅初级 PvP 仪式师将能够使用此技能，即使其帐户未解锁。

c6c11bb4462ba852a357fbf06befb9e93c6d8395.source:
* Can provide defense against other damage types when used with skills that convert damage to elemental damage, such as Stone Striker, Conflagration, and Greater Conflagration.
* The AI cannot detect a ward's presence. While remaining inside would be favourable, even flagged NPCs characters will run out of its protection whenever hit.
c6c11bb4462ba852a357fbf06befb9e93c6d8395.text:
* 与石击、火焰、大火焰等将伤害转化为元素伤害的技能一起使用时，可以防御其他类型的伤害。
* AI无法检测到守卫的存在。虽然留在里面会是有利的，但即使是被标记的 NPC 角色，只要受到攻击，也会失去其保护。

This skill does not actually become disabled, as it can be instantly recharged by Glyph of Renewal, and the recharge reduced by Glyph of Swiftness.
* The ward actually grants +12…22…24 armor against non-elemental damage and +24…43…48 against elemental damage. This distinction is important for the armor cap and armor calculation.
* The AI cannot detect a ward's presence. While remaining inside would be favourable, even flagged NPCs characters will run out of its protection whenever hit.

* 该守卫实际上针对非元素伤害提供 +12…22…24 点护甲，针对元素伤害提供 +24…43…48 点护甲。这种区别对于装甲帽和装甲计算很重要。
* AI无法检测到守卫的存在。虽然留在里面会是有利的，但即使是被标记的 NPC 角色，只要受到攻击，也会失去其保护。

The weakness duration is independent of duration modifiers such as the Heavy weapon upgrade.

00b9a9d9586863eee03f15babab15a7b8003e135.text:
与稳定结界类似，该结界法术的充能时间无法减少。例如。在重生雕文或迅捷雕文效果下激活此守卫法术会消耗该雕文，但充能时间不会减少。但是，可以增加充电时间，例如通过牺牲雕文。
弱点持续时间与重型武器升级等持续时间修正无关。

E.g. activating this ward spell while under the effects of Glyph of Renewal or Glyph of Swiftness will consume the glyph, but the recharge time will not be decreased. However, the recharge time can be increased, e.g. by Glyph of Sacrifice.
55b4bbf8d1c7046c5513d69d4473d91971e84416.text: bug：与稳定结界类似，该结界法术的充能时间无法减少。例如。在重生雕文或迅捷雕文效果下激活此守卫法术会消耗该雕文，但充能时间不会减少。但是，可以增加充电时间，例如通过牺牲雕文。

d98c52be45f39b2fa0d59e4e8648eb88c4c38f5e.source: anomaly: The weakness duration is independent of duration modifiers such as the Heavy weapon upgrade.
d98c52be45f39b2fa0d59e4e8648eb88c4c38f5e.text: 异常：弱点持续时间与重型武器升级等持续时间修正无关。

9580781f74a7cb85f0a97db71ce6bfa67843cd11.source:
* Consider using a skill that increases attack speed, such as Flurry, to interrupt more often.
* This skill synergizes well with attack skills that can hit multiple foes (e.g. Barrage or Whirlwind Attack) or scythes.
9580781f74a7cb85f0a97db71ce6bfa67843cd11.text:
* 考虑使用提高攻击速度的技能，例如乱舞，更频繁地打断。
* 该技能与可以攻击多个敌人的攻击技能（例如弹幕或旋风攻击）或镰刀很好地协同作用。

1526aa962f1c5bfa884fc6255ad078843e5b9e8d.source: * Works well when combined with scythes and melee attack skills that hit multiple targets.
1526aa962f1c5bfa884fc6255ad078843e5b9e8d.text: * 与镰刀和攻击多个目标的近战攻击技能结合使用时效果很好。

a72e25cc4c6ae85e594947787078e9a078c7899d.source:
* As specified in the skill descriptions, auto attacks do not trigger the effect.
* Does not block Pet attacks, despite them technically being attack skills. This is because they buff the next attack of their owner's pet rather than affecting an enemy directly like other attack skills. 
* Unlike most effects that guarantee blocking, attack skills can still miss instead (and will not trigger this skill's effect).
a72e25cc4c6ae85e594947787078e9a078c7899d.text:
* 根据技能说明，自动攻击不会触发该效果。
* 不阻挡宠物攻击，尽管它们在技术上是攻击技能。这是因为它们会增强主人宠物的下一次攻击，而不是像其他攻击技能一样直接影响敌人。 
* 与大多数保证格挡的效果不同，攻击技能仍然可能会失手（并且不会触发该技能的效果）。

dff4799028e74c31b91a0f6a94becff31aa29858.source:
* This skill has a 0.75 second aftercast delay despite not being a spell, in line with any shadow step skill that has an activation time.
* Wild Throw has a similar drawback, but instead disables non-spear attack skills.
* Heroes will use this skill indiscriminately on the foes which cannot be knocked down because of Stun Immunity.
dff4799028e74c31b91a0f6a94becff31aa29858.text:
* 尽管不是法术，该技能仍有 0.75 秒的施法延迟，与任何具有激活时间的暗影步技能一致。
*狂野投掷也有类似的缺点，但会禁用非矛攻击技能。
* 英雄会对因眩晕免疫而无法击倒的敌人无差别地使用该技能。

f1d1766934623da2bcda900766f588e13da4c7b1.source:
* The bonus damage begins to apply after the first damage pulse.
* Synergises with Psychic Instability.
* Useful to cover other hexes that punish foes for using skills, such as Diversion or Shame, forcing your target to choose between taking the damage or suffering the covered hex's effect.
** However, this skill does not cover other hexes if the target uses their own hex removal skill, since activation of the hex removal will end Wastrel's Demise, allowing the skill to remove the next hex in the effects monitor.
* This skill is very effective against targets that do not use skills (e.g. minions or pets) or rarely use them (e.g. The Jade Quarry Carrier Juggernauts and Hauler Turtles activate their skill, Carrier Defense, under limited situations); it does the maximum damage against them and adjacent foes.
If the hex is reapplied before it ends, Wastrel's Demise will continue to add up the bonus damage until the first hex would have run out. After that, the bonus damage cycle will start over.
Unlike most area damage over time skills, Wastrel's Demise does not cause AI to scatter.
f1d1766934623da2bcda900766f588e13da4c7b1.text:
* 奖励伤害在第一个伤害脉冲后开始生效。
* 与精神不稳定有协同作用。
* 用于覆盖其他惩罚敌人使用技能的六角形，例如转移或羞辱，迫使你的目标在受到伤害或遭受覆盖六角形的效果之间做出选择。
** 然而，如果目标使用自己的六角形移除技能，则该技能不会覆盖其他六角形，因为激活六角形移除将结束黄蜂的灭亡，从而允许该技能移除效果监视器中的下一个六角形。
* 该技能对于不使用技能的目标（例如小兵或宠物）或很少使用技能的目标非常有效（例如采石场航母剑圣和搬运龟在有限情况下激活他们的技能航母防御）；它对他们和邻近的敌人造成最大伤害。
如果在结束之前重新应用了降咒，废人之死将继续增加额外伤害，直到第一个降咒用完。之后，额外伤害循环将重新开始。
与大多数随时间造成区域伤害的技能不同，废物之死不会导致 AI 分散。

7785f968f2b32071f30527655d869c544c89acd9.source: anomaly: If the hex is reapplied before it ends, Wastrel's Demise will continue to add up the bonus damage until the first hex would have run out. After that, the bonus damage cycle will start over.
7785f968f2b32071f30527655d869c544c89acd9.text: 异常现象：如果在结束之前重新应用了降咒，废物之死将继续增加额外伤害，直到第一个降咒用完。之后，额外伤害循环将重新开始。

de7c69f8da795d371154e1fcc746c5197e22a1ac.source: anomaly: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Wastrel's Demise does not cause AI to scatter.
de7c69f8da795d371154e1fcc746c5197e22a1ac.text: 异常：与大多数随时间推移造成区域伤害的技能不同，废物之死不会导致 AI 分散。

f99a76ac9daea81482a6e3c18d60376db19cb88c.source:
* The foe must successfully activate a skill for Wastrel's Worry to end early. An interrupted/canceled skill does not count.
* The description is somewhat misleading; if Wastrel's Worry ends early for any reason, the foe does not take damage.
* Casting Wastrel's Worry on a foe already hexed with it has no effect.
* The hex is especially effective on foes that do not use skills (e.g. minions and pets) and those with active hex reduction (e.g. most bosses, Natural Resistance).
* Wastrel's Worry is also useful to force targets to choose how they take damage — from (a) failure to use a skill (this hex) or by using a skill (e.g. Visions of Regret, Empathy, Backfire).
* Heroes preferentially use this on casters.
f99a76ac9daea81482a6e3c18d60376db19cb88c.text:
* 敌人必须成功激活一项技能，黄鼠之忧才能提前结束。被中断/取消的技能不计算在内。
* 描述有些误导；如果荒野之忧因任何原因提前结束，敌人不会受到伤害。
* 对已经被施咒的敌人施放荒野之忧没有任何效果。
* 降咒对于不使用技能的敌人（例如小兵和宠物）和具有​​主动降咒减少功能的敌人（例如大多数 Boss、自然抵抗）特别有效。
* 浪费者的担忧对于迫使目标选择如何承受伤害也很有用——（a）未能使用技能（此降咒）或使用技能（例如遗憾幻象、移情、逆火）。
* 英雄优先使用脚轮。

ed01b937dc686e10c3be62851b143a0c52e64083.source:
* The foe must successfully activate a skill for Wastrel's Worry to end early. An interrupted/canceled skill does not count.
* The description is somewhat misleading; if Wastrel's Worry ends early for any reason, the foe does not take damage.
* Casting Wastrel's Worry on a foe already hexed with it has no effect.
* The hex is especially effective on foes that do not use skills (e.g. minions and pets) and those with active hex reduction (e.g. foes affected by Peace and Harmony).
* Wastrel's Worry is also useful to force targets to choose how they take damage — from (a) failure to use a skill (this hex) or by using a skill (e.g. Visions of Regret, Empathy, Backfire).
ed01b937dc686e10c3be62851b143a0c52e64083.text:
* 敌人必须成功激活一项技能，黄鼠之忧才能提前结束。被中断/取消的技能不计算在内。
* 描述有些误导；如果荒野之忧因任何原因提前结束，敌人不会受到伤害。
* 对已经被施咒的敌人施放荒野之忧没有任何效果。
* 降咒对于不使用技能的敌人（例如小兵和宠物）以及那些具有活跃降咒减少的敌人（例如受和平与和谐影响的敌人）特别有效。
* 浪费者的担忧对于迫使目标选择如何承受伤害也很有用——（a）未能使用技能（此降咒）或使用技能（例如遗憾幻象、移情、逆火）。

c26cc892a9d137a065b5fa63bb76422f4147669c.source:
*Use as a cover enchantment to protect other vital enchantments from being stripped away and to benefit from enemy removal of this skill.
*Use with skills that remove enchantments, such as Contemplation of Purity or Release Enchantments.
*If removed with a skill that deals damage, such as Shatter Enchantment, the healing will occur before the damage.
c26cc892a9d137a065b5fa63bb76422f4147669c.text:
*用作掩护结界，以保护其他重要结界不被剥夺，并从敌人移除此技能中受益。
*与消除结界的技能一起使用，例如纯洁沉思或释放结界。
*如果用造成伤害的技能移除，例如粉碎结界，治疗将在伤害之前发生。

99f16340632e4a9c641520bb62e697457de414a5.source: *This is the only Dervish enchantment spell that can target another ally.
99f16340632e4a9c641520bb62e697457de414a5.text: *这是唯一可以瞄准另一个盟友的苦行僧结界法术。

ea189125b8f336a8c22fa81e404e1f6b4f708ceb.source: End effect healing is not affected by Unyielding Aura.
ea189125b8f336a8c22fa81e404e1f6b4f708ceb.text: 最终效果治疗不受不屈光环影响。

0352470ea02076363d1f52eb977d53f82c77e184.source: bug: End effect healing is not affected by Unyielding Aura.
0352470ea02076363d1f52eb977d53f82c77e184.text: bug：最终效果治疗不受不屈光环影响。

2fb5c9e1b698905fb96e92dfc5e327c1c363b096.source: * The amount of energy regained is rounded; for example, a 5{{energy}} spell returns 3{{energy}} instead of 2.5{{energy}}, and a 15{{energy}} spell returns 6{{energy}} instead of 5.5{{energy}}.
2fb5c9e1b698905fb96e92dfc5e327c1c363b096.text: * 恢复的能量数量四舍五入；例如，5{{energy}}咒语返回3{{energy}}而不是2.5{{energy}}，15{{energy}}咒语返回6{{energy}}而不是5.5{{energy}}。

dc0642d35ebd591a5fb52871cc95f930eba11566.source: * In combination with a speed reducing skill, this is an effective method to snare up to three foes.
dc0642d35ebd591a5fb52871cc95f930eba11566.text: * 与减速技能结合使用，这是诱捕最多三个敌人的有效方法。

bbfc6bc3032a74ad121cf37fa05f7ccad5d4be48.source:
* In PvE, one may consider using a weapon upgrade of the Assassin to increase the chance for critical hits.
Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
bbfc6bc3032a74ad121cf37fa05f7ccad5d4be48.text:
* 在PvE中，可以考虑使用刺客的武器升级来增加暴击几率。
与简洁的描述相反，该技能的条件效果会导致生命值增加而不是治疗。

eca578ca5e89bda839239ab67082defed4224e12.source:
* Makes it easier to maintain Critical Defenses or Critical Agility.
* Can be used with Critical Eye to further increase the chance of critical hits. The real value to combining these skills is not in the extra damage, but the increased energy return at a mid-level Critical Strikes rank.
* This is the only Assassin skill that increases attack speed in PvP.
eca578ca5e89bda839239ab67082defed4224e12.text:
* 更容易保持关键防御或关键敏捷。
* 可以与批判之眼一起使用，进一步增加暴击几率。结合这些技能的真正价值不在于额外的伤害，而在于中级暴击等级时增加的能量回报。
* 这是唯一能在 PvP 中提高攻击速度的刺客技能。

22da2d9a3689574fbbeff7a45b1064ac0e4050a1.source:
* Great synergy for Repeating Strike as the skill will not consume energy and can be easily spammed.
* This skill does not affect non-attack skills which count as off-hand attacks.
22da2d9a3689574fbbeff7a45b1064ac0e4050a1.text:
* 与重复攻击有很大的协同作用，因为该技能不会消耗能量，并且可以轻松发送垃圾邮件。
* 该技能不影响非攻击技能，该技能算作副手攻击。

3bd008219dfa813467ed9664d929e46b419cbc99.source: * This skill works well with skills that reap benefits from critical hits, such as Critical Chop, Vicious Attack, "Find Their Weakness!" (PvP), Keen Arrow and Disrupting Accuracy.
3bd008219dfa813467ed9664d929e46b419cbc99.text: * 此技能与从暴击中获得好处的技能效果很好，例如暴击斩、恶毒攻击、“找到他们的弱点！” (PvP)、利箭和破坏性的准确性。

8ebc750afa5ba2735411693069fea5f9e8ce60ec.source: * Both descriptions neglect to mention that the damage done while moving occurs each second.
8ebc750afa5ba2735411693069fea5f9e8ce60ec.text: * 两个描述都忽略了移动时每秒都会发生的伤害。

6cb898c58b2b640a2f5930842b56c14417c56ecc.source: *The energy cost of this trap will not be reduced by Expertise.
6cb898c58b2b640a2f5930842b56c14417c56ecc.text: *该陷阱的能量消耗不会因专长而减少。

74b4307953a7bcd04a2d7a6f0b6ccc899d1e1b1a.source:
* Combines well with Spirit's Strength.
* This is the only weapon spell that cannot target an ally.
74b4307953a7bcd04a2d7a6f0b6ccc899d1e1b1a.text:
* 与精神之力完美结合。
* 这是唯一不能以盟友为目标的武器法术。

fbc611280baaff618c2759de01e483cb735917df.source:
* Only the standard adrenaline gain from making an attack is doubled, not any other effects that generate adrenaline, even if they are part of the attack (such as Enraged Smash or Thrill of Victory).
* Stacks additively with Dark Fury (for a total of 3 adrenaline per hit) or Mark of Fury (2-5 adrenaline per hit depending on rank). Does not stack with "For Great Justice!", Focused Anger, or Infuriating Heat.
* Heroes will cast Weapon of Fury on attacking allies with priority to those with enhanced attack-rating and/or striking multiple foes.
fbc611280baaff618c2759de01e483cb735917df.text:
* 只有通过攻击获得的标准肾上腺素才会加倍，任何其他产生肾上腺素的效果不会加倍，即使它们是攻击的一部分（例如愤怒粉碎或胜利的兴奋）。
* 与黑暗之怒（每次命中总共 3 肾上腺素）或愤怒印记（每次命中 2-5 肾上腺素，具体取决于等级）叠加。不能与“为了伟大的正义！”、“集中愤怒”或“真气之热”叠加。
* 英雄会对攻击盟友施放愤怒武器，优先于那些攻击力增强和/或攻击多个敌人的盟友。

9630e5d734f4313de17cf6b6efb385d56b40d687.source:
* This skill takes effect as soon as damage is dealt. When triggered by an attack or skill that also applies a condition, that condition will be removed only if it is applied before the damage is dealt.
** Condition-applying attack skills and preparations apply their conditions after the attack damage is dealt; Weapon of Remedy will not remove these conditions.
** Enchantments such as Grenth's Grasp and Double Dragon which add a condition application to subsequent attacks or skills trigger before damage is dealt, allowing Weapon of Remedy to remove their conditions immediately if triggered by the same action.
** Some spells, such as Immolate, deal damage before applying their conditions, whereas others, such as Eruption, apply conditions first. {{research needed|Lots more skills to test, if it's worth doing so. See talk page}}
If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.
9630e5d734f4313de17cf6b6efb385d56b40d687.text:
* 该技能在造成伤害后立即生效。当由同时施加条件的攻击或技能触发时，只有在造成伤害之前施加该条件才会被移除。
** 附加条件的攻击技能和准备在造成攻击伤害后应用其条件；补救武器不会消除这些情况。
** 诸如古兰斯之握和双龙之类的结界会在造成伤害之前为后续攻击或技能触发添加一个条件应用，如果由同一动作触发，则允许补救武器立即消除其条件。
** 有些法术，例如献祭，会在应用条件之前造成伤害，而其他法术，例如爆发，会先应用条件。 {{需要研究|如果值得的话，还有更多的技能需要测试。请参阅讨论页}}
如果仅在一次攻击中受到多个来源的伤害时使用，治疗武器将触发多次。例如，如果被倒刺施咒的敌人受到物理伤害，治疗武器将同时触发物理伤害和倒刺伤害。

5990bce8789640f3ecffcbdb61961a2724aabee4.source: bug: If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.
5990bce8789640f3ecffcbdb61961a2724aabee4.text: bug：如果仅在一次攻击中受到多个来源的伤害时使用，治疗武器将触发多次。例如，如果被倒刺施咒的敌人受到物理伤害，治疗武器将同时触发物理伤害和倒刺伤害。

82270d53300a3367a8487bea05bc9c2339655dac.source:
* Attackers are blinded after their attack.
* This skill can dramatically hinder a spike done by weapon attacks.
The descriptions do not mention that this weapon spell ends after the affected target ally causes blindness the allotted number of times.
82270d53300a3367a8487bea05bc9c2339655dac.text:
* 攻击者在攻击后会失明。
* 该技能可以极大地阻碍武器攻击造成的尖峰。
描述中没有提及该武器法术会在受影响的目标盟友造成指定次数的失明后结束。

459044a945f8634be7dca08c1df2224413b84cb6.source: bug: The descriptions do not mention that this weapon spell ends after the affected target ally causes blindness the allotted number of times.
459044a945f8634be7dca08c1df2224413b84cb6.text: bug：描述中没有提到该武器法术会在受影响的目标盟友造成指定次数的失明后结束。

b86ea1b30adb92e17d64142c959d238bdfa6f19f.source:
*Since this skill does not target an ally, it will not remove conditions with Wielder's Remedy.
*The created weapon spells are chosen randomly for each ally and cannot be a PvE-only weapon spell.
*The created weapon spells will have the same duration as Weapons of Three Forges (factoring in the Spawning Power bonus) and their attributes all match the original caster's Spawning Power rank.
**The created weapon spells will not list the correct duration in the effect window as a result.
b86ea1b30adb92e17d64142c959d238bdfa6f19f.text:
*由于该技能不以盟友为目标，因此它不会通过使用者的补救措施消除状况。
*创建的武器法术是为每个盟友随机选择的，不能是仅限 PvE 的武器法术。
*创建的武器法术将与三炉武器具有相同的持续时间（考虑到生成力加成），并且它们的属性都与原始施法者的生成力等级相匹配。
**因此，创建的武器法术不会在效果窗口中列出正确的持续时间。

c4fdc26fc0cebc5860210a98009c9b5b5242bcdc.source: *Weakness is applied when this attack hits the target.
c4fdc26fc0cebc5860210a98009c9b5b5242bcdc.text: *当此攻击击中目标时，将应用弱点。

bfa013fdc942dcf4e16bc3c56bf9f0629c2b3077.source:
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
bfa013fdc942dcf4e16bc3c56bf9f0629c2b3077.text:
{{过时的信息|}}
；2月05、2019更新；请验证 AI 行为的变化。

593db3a527e640fc8e3706b45446756961677d17.source:
* This spell does not need to interrupt a foe for the hex to be applied.
* If the hex is ended early by any source, the second interrupt will be triggered. This makes Web of Disruption useful with Shatter Delusions or Drain Delusions.
* Be careful giving this skill to heroes, as they treat it as a regular hex and will use it on foes who aren't using any skills.
This skill's standard description does not specify whether it can interrupt only skills or all actions, including attacks. The effect is clarified in the concise description which states that both the initial and ending interrupts only affect skills.
593db3a527e640fc8e3706b45446756961677d17.text:
* 此法术不需要打断敌人即可应用妖术。
* 如果降咒被任何源提前结束，则将触发第二个中断。这使得破坏之网对于粉碎妄想或耗尽妄想非常有用。
* 将此技能交给英雄时要小心，因为他们将其视为常规降咒，并将其用于不使用任何技能的敌人。
该技能的标准描述并没有明确说明它是否只能打断技能或所有动作，包括攻击。简洁的描述阐明了效果，指出初始中断和结束中断仅影响技能。

e2afaa816edf1c415f3e9a75907dec3d836e9dc8.text: * 这是唯一的精英井法术。

a36e4e56465ac281c1cb75144293041a4b755585.text: bug：只有非精神敌人会经历生命值退化。

1d140f60d46d29a2c21b71699a32c18c094bc7a5.source:
*Removes all enchantments any time the well is entered.
*Foes in this well cannot be targeted by enchantment spells that target a foe, like Ice Spear.

Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments; however, untargeted enchantments still work, which includes all flash enchantment spells, and spells like Shadow Refuge. These enchantments don’t get stripped simply by being inside the well, but only each time the well is entered. If one manages to gain an enchantment while inside (i.e. Aegis, Orders, etc.), it is not removed. Source.







{{DEFAULTSORT:Well of Profane}}
1d140f60d46d29a2c21b71699a32c18c094bc7a5.text:
*每次进入井时都会移除所有结界。
*此井中的敌人不能被针对敌人的结界法术（如冰矛）瞄准。

此井中的敌人会失去所有结界，并且无法成为进一步结界的目标；然而，非目标结界仍然有效，其中包括所有闪光结界法术，以及诸如暗影避难所之类的法术。这些结界不会仅仅因为进入井内而被剥夺，而是只有在每次进入井时才会被剥夺。如果一个人在内部成功获得结界（即神盾、命令等），则该结界不会被移除。来源。







{{DEFAULTSORT：亵渎之井}}

94178096460020a5f9818b53b0c5b30678f637e5.source:
* Furious Axe can help meet the adrenaline cost against an opponent with a blocking stance. 
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
94178096460020a5f9818b53b0c5b30678f637e5.text:
* 狂怒之斧可以帮助应对具有格挡姿态的对手的肾上腺素消耗。 
* 该技能恰好需要80单位的肾上腺素才能充满，因此3次打击和5单位。

31fec18905adeb0e41e4d7a5a282f29a223581a1.source:
* Damage will not occur if this enchantment is removed with a teardown attack (or by any means other than hitting an enemy). This is the case even if the teardown hits multiple enemies (using a scythe).
* Attacks with ranged weapons cause damage to be dealt to other foes near the target rather than yourself.
31fec18905adeb0e41e4d7a5a282f29a223581a1.text:
* 如果通过拆卸攻击（或通过击中敌人以外的任何方式）移除此结界，则不会发生伤害。即使拆卸击中多个敌人（使用镰刀）也是如此。
* 使用远程武器攻击会对目标附近的其他敌人造成伤害，而不是对你自己造成伤害。

5c0cfea328ad503b271fdd4aac2c29f1907b6db3.source:
Although the damage is nondescript, it does trigger Mark of Pain and Winnowing, making it armor-ignoring physical damage.
The non-concise description is wrong, this skill will deal damage even if the projectile is blocked from another blocking source.
5c0cfea328ad503b271fdd4aac2c29f1907b6db3.text:
虽然伤害不伦不类，但它确实会触发痛苦印记和风选，使其成为无视护甲的物理伤害。
不简洁的描述是错误的，即使射弹被其他阻挡源阻挡，该技能也会造成伤害。

eec538e97583f070cc3736f8d4c8467dcaf34d3d.source: anomaly: Although the damage is nondescript, it does trigger Mark of Pain and Winnowing, making it armor-ignoring physical damage.

b9ebac2e14d0ad107416841d9ba96028bc866d5e.source:
* This spell is an effective knock down even with no points in Air Magic.
* The enemies do not have to be attacking the user to be knocked down.
* This skill combines well with Aftershock.
b9ebac2e14d0ad107416841d9ba96028bc866d5e.text:
*即使没有空气魔法点数，该法术也能有效击倒。
* 敌人不一定要攻击用户才能被击倒。
* 该技能与余震结合得很好。

5368c354829af4a79d0a9b89d9aac46bb30aabca.source:
* Whirlwind Attack is a single attack that can hit multiple foes. 
** When wielding a scythe, each target will only be hit once.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to hit kiting opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
* The 1 second recharge prevents the skill from being easily spammed, since it will not benefit from the adrenaline it generates.
**Echo can overcome this with six adjacent foes, or with three adjacent foes when under an effect that doubles adrenaline gain such as "For Great Justice!".
5368c354829af4a79d0a9b89d9aac46bb30aabca.text:
* 旋风攻击是一次攻击，可以击中多个敌人。 
** 使用镰刀时，每个目标只会被击中一次。
* 该技能击中的敌人是与使用者相邻的敌人，而不是目标。
** 如果风筝对手（包括目标）在攻击连接时已经离开，则此攻击将无法击中。
* 1 秒的充能可防止该技能轻易被垃圾邮件发送，因为它不会从其产生的肾上腺素中受益。
**回声可以克服六个相邻敌人的问题，或者当处于使肾上腺素增益加倍的效果（例如“为了伟大的正义！”）时，与三个相邻的敌人克服这个问题。

7b96889387b690c4de131d532d39c6eab9a4af49.source: * Be careful when facing a foe with Soul Bind or Scourge Healing, as the conditional heal is a separate packet, and will make Wielder's Boon trigger these hexes twice.
7b96889387b690c4de131d532d39c6eab9a4af49.text: * 面对具有灵魂束缚或天灾治疗的敌人时要小心，因为条件治疗是一个单独的包，并且会使持用者的恩惠触发这些六角形两次。

b85216d01e69b549305fe673283dbb814f6ac09b.source: * The shortest recharging weapon spell (with a recharge time of 1s) is Ghostly Weapon. Since the rank in Communing affects only Ghostly Weapon's duration, it can be used effectively even at 0 Communing. Other short recharging item spells are Vital Weapon (2s), Vengeful Weapon, Weapon of Remedy and Xinrae's Weapon (3s). The activation time is of 1/4s for all those skills except Vital Weapon (1s). Other weapon spells that synergize with Wielder's Remedy have a recharge time of at least 5s for a casting time of 1s.
b85216d01e69b549305fe673283dbb814f6ac09b.text: * 充能最短的武器法术（充能时间为1秒）是幽灵武器。由于交流的等级只影响鬼兵的持续时间，因此即使在0交流时也能有效使用。其他短时间充电物品法术包括重要武器（2s）、复仇武器、治疗武器和辛莱武器（3s）。除致命武器（1秒）外，所有技能的激活时间均为1/4秒。其他与持用药剂协同作用的武器法术的充电时间至少为 5 秒，施法时间为 1 秒。

ed2d61345976fe242a6603692a6a1b1e46be01ef.source:
* This skill is useful with scythes, as it can end the stances of and cause a critical hit on up to three adjacent foes. 
* Very useful to secondary warriors in general, as no attribute points are needed to be invested and other melee attack skill users do not have much use for adrenaline (with the exception of some Dervish skills or PvE skills such as "Save Yourselves!" or Brawling Headbutt).
* Adrenaline loss won't occur if the attack is interrupted.
ed2d61345976fe242a6603692a6a1b1e46be01ef.text:
* 此技能对于使用镰刀很有用，因为它可以结束最多三个相邻敌人的姿态并造成致命一击。 
* 一般来说，对二级战士非常有用，因为不需要投入任何属性点，并且其他近战攻击技能用户对肾上腺素没有太多用处（除了一些苦行僧技能或 PvE 技能，例如“救救自己！”或“争吵头撞”）。
* 如果攻击被中断，不会发生肾上腺素损失。

1fb327dc4c37f7fd26ae929f9597fce51ffe9a4a.source: * Wastrel's Collapse has a similar drawback, but instead disables non-dagger attack skills.
1fb327dc4c37f7fd26ae929f9597fce51ffe9a4a.text: * 荒废者的崩溃也有类似的缺点，但它会禁用非匕首攻击技能。

d0ac51764d44cf8085b7a17f7639283b31b5b996.source:
* The Masters of Winds aid movement in the explorable areas of the Battle Isles with this spell.
* The skill affects average speed by -1.7%…+18.4% if used on self every time the enchantment ends, including casting time and aftercast delay.
d0ac51764d44cf8085b7a17f7639283b31b5b996.text:
* 风之大师使用此法术帮助在战斗群岛的可探索区域中移动。
* 如果每次结界结束时对自己使用，该技能会影响平均速度 -1.7%…+18.4%，包括施法时间和施法后延迟。

401f5d3dc0755e851829e86aa16db7d10134e4e1.source: * Unlike nature rituals, Winds affects only foes instead of all creatures in range. It still shares effects common to all rituals, such as having its energy cost reduced by Expertise.
401f5d3dc0755e851829e86aa16db7d10134e4e1.text: * 与自然仪式不同，风只影响敌人，而不影响范围内的所有生物。它仍然具有所有仪式共有的效果，例如通过专业知识降低其能量成本。

0152aa6365be2071165fa6764b1c0ec80843a346.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Winnowing.
Contrary to the full description, creatures in range deal +4 damage, not receive. This means that all creatures, including spirits, do take +4 damage.
0152aa6365be2071165fa6764b1c0ec80843a346.text:
* 该技能会产生风选之魂。
与完整描述相反，范围内的生物会造成 +4 点伤害，而不是受到伤害。这意味着所有生物，包括灵魂，都会受到 +4 点伤害。

c0c158ae3f5d501a9626d6d355004473a9d39f2a.source: bug: Contrary to the full description, creatures in range deal +4 damage, not receive. This means that all creatures, including spirits, do take +4 damage.
c0c158ae3f5d501a9626d6d355004473a9d39f2a.text: bug：与完整描述相反，范围内的生物会造成 +4 点伤害，但不会受到伤害。这意味着所有生物，包括灵魂，都会受到 +4 点伤害。

05639545e9e21a99b19afa753c1cf7677eea02b4.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Winter.
* Mechanically, this skill is vastly different than how Conflagration, Greater Conflagration, Kindle Arrows and elemental bowstrings work:
** Spirit of Winter will not allow you to trigger the requirement of Conjure Frost, as it changes the elemental damage received to cold, rather than change the damage output of an elemental weapon to cold. 
** Conflagration, Greater Conflagration, Kindle Arrows and Elemental bowstrings change the damage type output to fire or other elements, which allows you to trigger conjure spells with them, but not with Winter.
* Because of this, Winter will not stop Conjure Flame from working with Kindle Arrows when under it's effect; it will simply change the final damage caused on the enemy from Fire to Cold Damage.
** Hence winter will not ever activate Conjure Frost on you, but will be able to activate cold damage reception triggers on the enemy such as Spinal Shivers.
* Great synergy with skills like Mantra of Frost or Spinal Shivers.
Unlike Greater Conflagration or Conflagration this skill requires either the attacker or the damage receiver to be inside the spirit area of effect.
05639545e9e21a99b19afa753c1cf7677eea02b4.text:
* 该技能会创造冬之精灵。
*从机制上讲，该技能与大火、大大火、点燃箭和元素弓弦的工作方式有很大不同：
** 凛冬之灵不会让你触发召唤冰霜的要求，因为它会将受到的元素伤害改为寒冷，而不是将元素武器的伤害输出改为寒冷。 
** 大火、大大火、点燃箭和元素弓弦将伤害类型输出更改为火焰或其他元素，这允许您用它们触发召唤法术，但不能用冬天触发。
* 因此，冬季不会阻止召唤火焰在其效果下与 Kindle Arrows 配合使用；它只会将对敌人造成的最终伤害从火焰伤害更改为冰冷伤害。
** 因此，冬天永远不会对你激活召唤冰霜，但能够对敌人激活寒冷伤害接收触发器，例如脊椎颤抖。
* 与冰霜真言或脊椎颤抖等技能有很好的协同作用。
与大火灾或大火不同，该技能要求攻击者或伤害接收者位于精神效果区域内。

1be486d71bcb6c22a6b64038b025c16e26199307.source: anomaly: Unlike Greater Conflagration or Conflagration this skill requires either the attacker or the damage receiver to be inside the spirit area of effect.
1be486d71bcb6c22a6b64038b025c16e26199307.text: 异常：与大火灾或大火不同，该技能要求攻击者或伤害接收者位于精神效果区域内。

fe40b20d58afc9de944b94356bfcb50eea2c9778.source:
* The weakness applies before the attack hits.
Unlike Grenth's Aura, switching to a melee weapon before a weapon projectile hits does not trigger this skill.
fe40b20d58afc9de944b94356bfcb50eea2c9778.text:
* 弱点在攻击发生前生效。
与古兰斯的光环不同，在武器射弹击中之前切换到近战武器不会触发该技能。

62283ddcb47904a54148562ac8444a6e11594b12.source: anomaly: Unlike Grenth's Aura, switching to a melee weapon before a weapon projectile hits does not trigger this skill.
62283ddcb47904a54148562ac8444a6e11594b12.text: 异常：与古兰斯的光环不同，在武器射弹击中之前切换到近战武器不会触发该技能。

e1664a70ccd14941ae208d8fdd2a1f5682cc73cb.source: The increased recharge is not reduced by effects such as Serpent's Quickness.
e1664a70ccd14941ae208d8fdd2a1f5682cc73cb.text: 增加的充能不会因蛇的敏捷等效果而减少。

01ccb3e2b6cf33b3257b705a27ae8242dc8cd21c.source: * The conditional healing is sent in a separate packet, triggering hexes like Scourge Healing twice.
01ccb3e2b6cf33b3257b705a27ae8242dc8cd21c.text: * 有条件的治疗是在一个单独的数据包中发送的，会触发像天灾治疗这样的咒语两次。

c4c02eddcb698b65a6d780f71c9e737be4420e63.source:
*Bleeding covers deep wound.
Despite the full description, a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
c4c02eddcb698b65a6d780f71c9e737be4420e63.text:
*流血覆盖较深的伤口。
尽管有完整的描述，即使这次攻击未能击中，苦行僧结界也会被移除。

d2a2aacd424cd1b39d0ab5f40be69be63767666c.source: anomaly: Despite the full description, a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
d2a2aacd424cd1b39d0ab5f40be69be63767666c.text: 异常：尽管有完整的描述，即使这次攻击未能击中，苦行僧结界也会被移除。

077605fc039b2193576a7dce248791b41ce45a2a.source:
*Primary PvP-only Dervishes will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on your account.

{{DEFAULTSORT:Wounding Strike}}
077605fc039b2193576a7dce248791b41ce45a2a.text:
*初级 PvP 苦行僧将能够使用此技能，即使您的帐户未解锁该技能。

{{DEFAULTSORT：伤害打击}}

a3a4e6697ae330e881c3e20fd143e036997fc2b4.source:
* Unlike Earth Shaker, which knocks down target foe and foes adjacent to the target, this attack hits foes adjacent to the user hence the attack can miss on kiting foes as with Cyclone Axe and Crude Swing.
* Good synergy with "You Are All Weaklings!" and Belly Smash (preceded by an elite knock-down, e.g. Earth Shaker).
* Skills like Withering Aura inflict conditions before Yeti Smash hits.
* In normal and hard mode, the AI will use this skill on a foe even if it is not adjacent to another foe nor suffering from a condition.
a3a4e6697ae330e881c3e20fd143e036997fc2b4.text:
* 与击倒目标敌人和目标附近敌人的撼地者不同，此攻击会击中用户附近的敌人，因此与旋风斧和粗暴挥击一样，攻击可能会错过风筝敌人。
* 与《你们都是弱者！》有良好的协同作用和 Belly Smash（之前是精英击倒，例如 Earth Shaker）。
* 诸如凋零光环之类的技能会在雪人粉碎击中之前造成条件。
* 在普通和困难模式下，即使敌人不与另一个敌人相邻或患有某种疾病，AI也会对敌人使用此技能。

d43b1c0cc0b98b90496a8a3b6b16b5935c2f8d78.source:
* This is the only Monk skill to deal a damage type other than holy damage.
The concise description is wrong: the energy loss is applied every time the user uses a skill that targets an ally, regardless of any damage dealt.
d43b1c0cc0b98b90496a8a3b6b16b5935c2f8d78.text:
* 这是唯一一个可以造成神圣伤害以外伤害类型的武僧技能。
简洁的描述是错误的：每次用户使用针对盟友的技能时都会施加能量损失，无论造成任何伤害。

9e3b0bac466774b3fc40eac1b1691a06a14e15ab.source: bug: The concise description is wrong: the energy loss is applied every time the user uses a skill that targets an ally, regardless of any damage dealt.
9e3b0bac466774b3fc40eac1b1691a06a14e15ab.text: bug：简洁的描述是错误的：每次用户使用针对盟友的技能时都会应用能量损失，无论造成任何伤害。

38b0b5c24518cc0a096be8d7ce4d141c3cc98a08.source: *This chant is triggered the next time an attack skill is successfully activated.
38b0b5c24518cc0a096be8d7ce4d141c3cc98a08.text: *下次成功发动攻击技能时会触发此咏唱。

a37dafe70fb2f667bd63ab3ec85e8d22944b7e70.source: * Out of all the monk spells, this spell is capable of healing the most health in a single packet unconditionally.
